listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada redefines masculine intensity with Paradigme Le Parfum—a hyper-lasting, sophisticated fragrance that challenges everything you know about traditional scent structures. Built from the bottom up in a reversed pyramid that mirrors Prada’s iconic triangle, this avant-garde signature isn’t just noticed; it lingers for up to 12 hours, ensuring you leave an unforgettable impression all day long.. The Notes Fragrance Family: Woody Amber Top Note: Gourmand Geranium Heart Note: Leathery Vanilla Base Note: Amber. How It Smells Paradigme Le Parfum opens with an unexpected, aromatic twist of gourmand geranium, revealing rich, rosy floral facets. At its heart, a dark, leathery vanilla reinvented specifically for the modern man takes centre stage. But the real magic lies in the base: master perfumers Marie Salamagne, Bruno Jovanovic, and Nicolas Bonneville have infused the scent with Amberever—a next-generation molecule that turbocharges the fragrance's power, diffusion, and longevity, all grounded by the warm, sensual contrast of Peru balm, benzoin resin, and smoky guaiac wood.. The Flacon & Sustainability The aesthetic is pure Prada. The fragrance is housed in a striking, gradient green-to-black bottle that looks incredibly sharp on any vanity. True to Prada Beauty’s commitment to conscious luxury, the entire Paradigme range is 100% refillable. By opting for a 150ml refill over three standard 50ml bottles, you’ll drastically reduce your environmental footprint—using 65% less glass, 75% less plastic, 50% less cardboard, and zero metal.. The Paradigme Collection Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum: Floral & Ambery Prada Paradigme Le Parfum: Woody, Leathery & Intense.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Step into the electrifying atmosphere of Manhattan’s most exclusive nightlife with Ralph’s Club New York Parfum by Ralph Lauren. Crafted for men who were born to stand out, this intoxicating fragrance captures the spirit of effortless sophistication, bold confidence, and after-dark allure.. From the very first spritz, the fragrance draws you in with a vibrant top note of resinous, crisp blackcurrant. The scent then deepens into an intensely rich heart, blending the warmth of smooth cognac with a decadent aged oud wood accord. The result is a powerful, indulgent, and unforgettable signature created by an iconic designer renowned for defining American style.. Housed in a sleek, silver rhombus bottle inspired by New York City’s emblemic art deco architecture, this fragrance is as striking on the outside as it is inside.. Why We Love It The After-Dark Allure: It effortlessly captures the exclusive energy of a modern Manhattan evening—sensual, confident, and magnetic.. Intense Depth: The smooth blend of rich, sweet oud wood aged in smooth cognac notes creates a deeply indulgent trail that lingers.. Vibrant Contrast: Crisp, resinous blackcurrant brings a sharp, modern freshness that elevates the warmth of the wood and spirit notes.. Showstopping Bottle: The silver rhombus flask adds a touch of art deco architectural elegance to any fragrance collection.. Notes Top Note: Blackcurrant Heart Note: Cognac Accord Base Note: Aged Oud Wood. How to Use Spray generously onto your pulse points—wrists, neck, chest, or anywhere you feel a heartbeat—to allow the warmth of your skin to diffuse the fragrance throughout the day and night..

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Le Sel d’Issey Parfum — the new woody-marine-leather perfume for men. Discover the new intense perfume for men in the Le Sel d’Issey fragrance line — Le Sel d’Issey Parfum. Enhanced with a leather facet, the original Le Sel d’Issey signature is taken to a new dimension. As the cold sea meets the incandescent land, salt turns black, concentrating its essence.. For this new intensified masculine fragrance, Quentin Bisch, the renowned perfumer behind the entire Le Sel d’Issey collection, has created a long-lasting marine scent with refined leather and woody accents. An encounter between the ultra-freshness of the sea and the heated rocks of the land — two polarities pushed to the extreme. • TOP: The energy of a vivid salty accord is enhanced by a vibrant saffron accord • HEART: Natural-origin marine seaweed meets the depth of dark woody notes • BASE: The warmth of a natural-origin amber accord contrasts with the oceanic notes of natural-origin oakmoss Le Sel d’Issey Parfum is a long-lasting vegan perfume made with 92% natural-origin ingredients.. How to intensify your Le Sel d’Issey experience Begin your daily ritual with Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel and matching Deodorant Spray, then apply Le Sel d’Issey Parfum to your pulse points for a long-lasting trail.. A warm and vibrant perfume bottle As if forged in salt, Tokujin Yoshioka’s design embodies a deep vibration, featuring a glossy black cap and a dark gradient bottle made with 20% recycled glass. The matte brown outer box is made using 10% upcycled natural seaweed..

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Unlock the party with Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Pink Glaze, a bold and playful interpretation of one of the world’s most iconic fragrances.. Designed for those who embrace confidence, spontaneity, and individuality, Pink Glaze captures the electric energy of unforgettable nights. This contemporary edition transforms the legendary Black Opium signature into a juicy, sophisticated scent that radiates modern femininity and effortless glamour.. Seductive, energetic, and full of personality, it’s the ultimate fragrance for anyone who loves to stand out.. Why We Love It Black Opium Pink Glaze is the ultimate crowd-pleaser for 2026. It takes the dark, addictive coffee core we all love and bathes it in a mouth-watering, juicy strawberry glaze. It is youthful yet sophisticated, making it the perfect statement scent for a night out or whenever you want an instant confidence boost. The Scent Pink Glaze opens with an irresistibly vibrant burst of strawberry, green mandarin superessence, and bergamot essence, creating an energetic and mouth-watering introduction.. At its heart, luminous jasmine combines beautifully with rich orange flower absolute to add a sensual, floral depth.. The fragrance settles into a warm, long-lasting base where vanilla absolute, resinoid benzoin tear, and the iconic coffee accord mingle with woody amber and patchouli. The result is a deliciously smooth trail that is both comforting and captivating. Key Notes Top - Strawberry, Green Mandarin Superessence, Bergamot Essence Heart - Jasmine (from YSL Ourika Community Gardens), Orange Flower Absolute Base - Vanilla Absolute, Resinoid Benzoin Tear, Coffee Accord, Woody Amber Accord, Patchouli. How To Use To get the most out of your fragrance trail, apply to clean skin and choose your intensity:. Light Intensity: Spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, letting the scent fall gently around you. Medium Intensity: Spray in a Y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other (a great alternative if you are wearing jewellery). Maximum Intensity: Apply directly to your pulse points (wrists, inner elbows, and the base of your neck). The natural heat of your body will intensify the trail.. Escentual Tip: Hold the bottle approximately 5 inches away from your skin and resist the urge to rub your wrists together after spraying, as this can break down the delicate top notes! . The Fragrance Family Pink Glaze joins the celebrated Black Opium collection as its most playful, fruit-forward expression:. Black Opium EDP: The warm, classic coffee and vanilla original. Black Opium Over Red: A deep, dramatic cherry-infused twist. Black Opium Le Parfum: The richest, most intense vanilla experience. Black Opium Pink Glaze: The sweetest, juiciest fruity-gourmand edition..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Absolue Longevity MD Reset The Serum 30ml
listings.description: What if you could choose your age? . Discover the future of proactive skincare with Lancome Absolue Longevity MD. This revolutionary, targeted solution is Lancome’s very first skincare range designed to actively reverse your skin's visible biological age, no matter your life stage.. Find Your Perfect Longevity Protocol: Anticipate: For ages 35 and under Intercept: For ages 35–55 Reset: For ages 55+. The Stars of the Formula Lancome Absolue Longevity MD Reset The Serum Expertly tailored for those aged 55 and over, this high-performance longevity serum proactively targets visible signs of ageing after they appear.. At its heart is Mitopure® by Timeline—bringing the power of the renowned Urolithin-A longevity supplement into advanced topical skincare. This innovative formula is scientifically proven to target your visible biological skin age* by helping to supercharge surface cell renewal³. Experience transformative, visible results on key ageing markers, delivering up to +41% tighter skin¹ and a +22% boost in skin firmness¹. It proves that your skin's biological age is the only age you can truly rewrite.. How To Use: Your Longevity Ritual Turn your daily application into a luxurious, age-defying ritual with these six targeted steps:. Step 1: Application – Place a small amount of Reset The Serum into your palm. To actively support skin longevity, gently smooth it over your chest and face using a flat hand in light, gliding motions.. Step 2: Chest to Cheek – Apply medium pressure with a flat hand over the chest, neck, and face to visibly enhance firmness and target wrinkles. Complete the movements on one side of your face first, then repeat on the other.. Step 3: Jawline & Cheekbones – Using your index and middle fingers, glide firmly along the jawline and over the cheekbones to visibly sculpt, lift, and define your facial contours while smoothing lines.. Step 4: Eyebrow – Pinch the skin above the eyebrow between your thumb and index finger, then gently twist in a back-and-forth motion to release facial tension and soften wrinkles.. Step 5: Forehead – Massage the forehead using slow, circular motions, sweeping back and forth across the entire area to encourage relaxation and ease expression lines.. Step 6: Final Gliding – Seal your protocol by slowly gliding your hands from your forehead all the way down to your chest. This soothing final gesture leaves the skin with a rejuvenated glow and a deep sense of well-being.. *Clinical study, 94 women, 2 x daily application. Average results, visual grading. Equivalence in years of improving 6 key signs (forehead, glabellar & crows feet wrinkles, corner of the lips wrinkles, nasolabial fold and ptosis) in 2 months of using Reset the Serum. Individual results will vary. ¹ Instrumental test, 40 people. ² Instrumental test, 35 persons after 22 days..

The body cream settles with a soft, comforting base of tonka bean, leaving your skin deeply moisturised and wrapped in a lingering, addictive veil of sensuality. . . Fragrance family: Floral-Amber. . Top notes: Queen of the Night Flower. . Heart notes: Benzoin Duo. . Base notes: Tonka Bean. . . Why It's Escentual: . Gaultier’s defiant, audacious spirit is brought to life in a sumptuous, body-loving texture with La Favorite Body Cream. Created for the woman who owns every room she enters, this body cream provides the perfect foundation for a truly hypnotic fragrance experience. . Housed in a chic, revolutionary container that pays homage to Gaultier's playful, iconic aesthetic, it turns daily hydration into a moment of pure drama. Use it alone for a soft, intimate scent aura, or layer it under La Favorite Eau de Parfum to intensify projection and ensure you're ready to command the spotlight all night long. . . The Best Way To Use It: . We also recommend the following body care tips: . Apply the body lotion generously to clean, dry skin just after showering to lock in essential moisture while your pores are warm. . Gently massage into the skin until fully absorbed, paying special attention to drier areas like elbows, knees, and wrists. . To intensify the aroma and make your scent trail last even longer, layer your La Favorite Eau de Parfum directly onto pulse points after applying the cream. . Store your body cream in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and heat, to keep the formula fresh and rich . .

listings.rawTitle: NIOD Copper Amino Isolate Lipid 1% 15ml
listings.description: Revolutionise your evening skincare routine with the NIOD Copper Amino Isolate Lipid 1% (CAIL), a highly advanced, blue gel-to-oil formula designed to intensely repair, plump, and rebuild the appearance of healthy skin.. Part of NIOD’s pioneering approach to skin health, CAIL 1% is a next-generation treatment that focuses on maintaining healthy epidermal volume and lipid density. Specifically engineered for evening use, its unique, rich texture melts into the skin to target loss of elasticity, deep wrinkles, and structural thinning. By mimicking the skin’s natural lipid barrier, it creates an optimal environment for cellular renewal, leaving your complexion looking exceptionally firm, smooth, and resilient.. Benefits . Volume & Density Enhancement: Actively targets skin thinning to encourage a plumper, more youthful-looking facial contour.. Structural Support: Helps repair and fortify the skin’s natural moisture barrier, sealing in essential hydration.. Advanced Age-Defying: Visibly reduces the appearance of fine lines, dynamic wrinkles, and structural sagging.. Texture Refinement: Smooths surface irregularities, rough patches, and unevenness for a uniform complexion.. Intense Overnight Repair: Works alongside the skin's nocturnal recovery cycle to combat signs of environmental stress and fatigue.. The Science Behind the Formula NIOD operates at the absolute forefront of cosmetic science, utilising a concentrated concentration of advanced peptides and bio-lipids:. 1% Pure Tripeptide-1 Copper (GHK-Cu): A high concentration of this premium, clinically proven peptide that focuses on overall skin health, supporting collagen production, elasticity, and natural healing mechanisms.. Ziziphus Jujuba Extract: A botanical active that helps maintain skin firmness and elasticity by supporting the skin's natural architectural matrix.. Isolated Squalane: A highly stable, non-comedogenic lipid that mirrors the skin's natural sebum to deeply condition, prevent moisture loss, and deliver actives deep into the epidermis.. Why We Love It We love CAIL 1% because it challenges traditional moisturising textures by combining the potency of a serum with the deep comfort of a lipid balm. Its striking blue hue, a natural result of the high copper peptide concentration, melts into a clear, luxurious oil upon application. It’s a targeted, science-forward investment for anyone serious about restoring volume and density to thinning or compromised skin.. How To Use It . Designed exclusively for evening use as a key step in your nighttime routine.. Apply a very small amount to the entire face and neck after cleansing and applying lightweight, water-based serums.. Warm the blue gel between your fingertips to transform it into a smooth oil-fluid, then massage gently into the skin.. Note: To maintain maximum potency, do not mix or layer this product in the same routine as strong antioxidants, direct acids (AHA/BHA), or pure Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid).. Works Well With Layer this over NIOD Multi-Molecular Hyaluronic Complex (MMHC2) to intensely hydrate the deeper layers of the skin before sealing it in with CAIL’s rich lipid barrier.. Values Cruelty-free, vegan, alcohol-free, silicone-free..

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Black Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "1 Million Black Eau de Parfum is an absolute game-changer! Usually, fruity and gourmand notes can be overwhelming, but this contrast of tropical sweetness and deep woodiness is pure magic—plus, a trail that lasts up to 48 hours is unheard of!" - Escentual Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Rabanne 1 Million Black:. It's a bold, magnetic scent that makes you feel instantly freer and more confident.. 1 Million Black introduces an addictive new era for the iconic franchise—it's impossible not to be captivated by it!. It boasts incredible longevity, delivering an intense trail designed to last up to 48 hours.. Creamy vanilla gives the scent a luxurious, mouth-watering smoothness.. It offers a striking contrast of vibrant tropical freshness and deep, sensual woods that everyone around you will notice.. It's an unexpected roasted pineapple burst balanced by rich, dark base notes; a modern, powerful twist on a classic favorite.. . What Does Rabanne 1 Million Black Smell Like?. 1 Million Black is a magnetic, addictive Eau de Parfum defined by a contrast of vibrant tropical energy and deep sensuality. The fragrance opens with an unexpected burst of roasted pineapple that delivers immediate, luminous energy. Soon after spraying, the scent reveals a creamy, gourmand heart where an overdose of vanilla melts seamlessly into a rich, dark base of ebony woods, giving this powerful composition sophisticated depth and warmth.. . Fragrance family: Gourmand-Woody. . Top notes: Roasted Pineapple. . Heart notes: Vanilla. . Base notes: Ebony Woods. . . Why It's Escentual:. Master perfumers Christophe Raynaud and Quentin Bisch created 1 Million Black to mark a bold new era for the 1 Million universe—reinventing Rabanne's iconic gold bar since 2008 into a sleek, metallic black finish sculpted around an oversized "1".. 1 Million Black has an intense, captivating quality that's bound to turn heads. Designed for those who embrace every moment, its powerful trail gradually reveals its full intensity on the skin. It’s refined enough for daytime wear, yet truly comes into its own as a magnetic, intoxicating signature after dark.. . The Best Way To Use It:. We also recommend the following perfume tips:. For optimal projection, apply 2 to 4 sprays to moisturised pulse points where the blood vessels are closest to the skin: wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent. . Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance. . Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance. . If your perfume fades throughout the day, con sider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Infinite Eau de Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: "Montblanc Explorer Infinite captures the magnetic allure of sunset; its vibrant, sun-warmed woody trail has an intense yet fresh quality that is like the cooling mystery of a desert night settling on the skin." - Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Montblanc Explorer Infinite:. A powerful woody fragrance balanced by a vibrant, zesty burst of fresh fruit.. Offers lasting depth with a refined and powerful sillage.. Reimagines the iconic Explorer heritage into a bright yet sensual new facet.. Encased in a sophisticated bottle featuring Montblanc's signature Saffiano pattern.. . What Does Montblanc Explorer Infinite Smell Like?. Explorer Infinite has an intense, magnetic quality with touches of bright citrus for an intimately smooth, musky trail that commands attention. The dynamic Eau de Parfum has a dual-nature freshness that remains undeniably seductive thanks to its sensual musk heart and rich, warm base; it perfectly captures the transition where day meets night.. The scent opens with a vibrant burst of zesty lemon and juicy blackcurrant for an immediate rush of freshness. At its heart lies a sophisticated, velvety touch of jasmine that adds an elegant, cool mystery. As the fragrance warms on the skin, it fades into a deep, woody signature complemented by the smooth, comforting warmth of vanilla.. . Top notes: Lemon and Blackcurrant. . Heart note: Jasmine. . Base notes: Refined Musk, Deep Woods, and Vanilla. . . Why It's Escentual:. We know that fans of the original Montblanc Explorer will fall head over heels for this intense and magnetic twist. The team described it using words like powerful, refined, and mysterious. One team member said it’s the ultimate transition scent from a sunny afternoon straight into a sophisticated night out!. Crafted for the modern adventurer, Explorer Infinite tells the story of contrasting textures and elements. Mimicking the intimate sensation of the desert’s intense residual warmth meeting the crisp, cool air of twilight, this fragrance embodies a timeless, rugged sophistication. Its classic woody signature is elevated by a bright, fruit-forward energy, creating a powerful aura that feels refined rather than overwhelming.. . The Best Way To Use It:. Spritz directly onto the pulse points: your neck and wrists, letting the warmth of your skin unlock the deep, shifting layers of this sunset-inspired fragrance..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer 10ml / 01
listings.description: Clarins Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer evens, illuminates and sculpts the face for an immediate fresh, rested complexion.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer: . 24-hour natural coverage* (*clinical test, 33 women). Luminous matte finish. Long-term reduction in the visibility of dark circles, imperfections and redness. Hydrated skin. . Why It's Escentual: . Clarins Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer corrects the appearance of dark circles, conceals the slightest imperfection, neutralises redness and can even be used to illuminate or sculpt the face. With its multi-purpose applicator, it can be applied in just 10 seconds* for a flawless complexion all day long. . Lightweight and buildable, its texture blends easily and melts naturally into the skin. Available in 14 shades, it suits all skin tones and types.. From the very first application*, its natural, high-coverage formula with a luminous matte finish instantly corrects imperfections and refreshes the eyes. It offers an unbeatable 24 hours of transfer-proof hold**. The result? The effect of 10 hours' sleep* in a single step!. With more than 83% ingredients of natural origin, Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer conceals dark circles, puffiness, imperfections & redness while reducing their appearance on bare skin long term. Its formula provides 24-hour hydration for plumped, smoothed skin that lasts.. The star of this beneficial cocktail: organic biden pilosa extract combined with [HA + Caffeine + Plant] Sleep Illusion Complex, a unique plant-molecule combination for visibly more beautiful skin day after day.. . Clarins' Innovation and plant expertise: . Beyond make-up, Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer's 2-in-1 formula combines the benefits of a concealer and a skincare product. At the heart of this feat is the [HA + Caffeine + Plant] Sleep Illusion Complex, a unique combination of plant and molecular extracts, with star active ingredients horse chestnut escin to promote a radiant complexion, plant caffeine to help reduce the appearance of puffiness and hyaluronic acid, an industry-favourite molecule known for its moisturising action.. Featuring [Skin Fit Technology], Skin Illusion All-in-One Concealer offers a comfortable texture that withstands all the emotions of an intense day, so you can live every moment with the assurance of a flawless complexion.. How to Use: . Correct - Use a similar shade to your foundation one;. Illuminate - Use a lighter shade to your foundation one;. Sculpt - Use a deeper shade to your foundation one;. Conceal dark circles - Use a shade similar to your skin tone or, for a colour correction effect, shade 6, which is a peachy shade perfectly suited to neutralising dark circles. . Conceal imperfections/redness - Use a shade similar to your skin tone and apply with the tip of the applicator.. *Clarins Consumer test, 158 women. **Clarins Clinical test, 33 women..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Vitamin C+ Multi-Dose 40ml
listings.description: Wish your Vitamin C did a little bit more? Enter the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C+ Multi-Dose Antiox Maxifier. This multi-tasking daily treatment is designed for anyone looking to completely overhaul their skincare routine, targeting everything from deep-set wrinkles and loss of firmness to uneven skin tone.. Why You’ll Love It Skin ageing isn't one-dimensional, so your skincare shouldn’t be either. Between daily pollution and UV rays, our skin faces constant environmental "oxidisers" that drain its natural glow. To combat this, La Roche-Posay has introduced their innovative 3 AOX System - a high-performance antioxidant shield.. By combining two ultra-stable forms of Vitamin C (Ascorbyl Glucoside and Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate) with Carnosine, this clever formula neutralises free radicals at multiple levels. The result? It actively prevents the "grey" dullness and sallow yellow tones that often creep into mature complexions, leaving you with an instant, healthy radiance.. The Powerhouse Ingredients La Roche-Posay hasn't stopped at antioxidants. They’ve supercharged this formula with a synergy of three dermatological gold-standards:. Pro-Retinol (Retinyl Palmitate): Gently resurfaces the skin to smooth away the look of stubborn, deep-set wrinkles.. Matrixyl Peptides: Firms and plumps, reinforcing the skin’s natural support system for a bounce-back texture.. Glycolic Acid: A micro-exfoliating AHA that sweeps away dull surface cells, instantly refining pores and skin texture.. Together, this dream team creates a 20x more effective synergy than Vitamin C alone*.. Texture and Application If you hate heavy or sticky layers, you’ll love this texture. It’s an invisible, dry-touch gel that sinks in beautifully, leaving the skin feeling smooth, fresh, and perfectly prepped for the day ahead.. How to Use: Smooth over your cleansed face and neck every morning, taking care to avoid the eye area. Because this formula contains active Glycolic Acid and Pro-Retinol, it’s essential to pair it with a daily broad-spectrum SPF to keep your freshly radiant skin protected.. Consumer Benefits . Instant Glow and Oil Control: 70% of users saw immediately brighter skin. 2/3 of users agreed skin looks less oily with visible sebum reduction and shine control.. Total Ageing Correction: After 6 months, 85% saw a reduction in the appearance of wrinkles and 95% felt their skin was firmer. 86% agreed their skin looked younger overall.. Refined Surface: 90% saw a refined skin texture, while 85% reported less visible pores.. Clinical proof: 78% saw a visible reduction in fine lines*. 91% saw a significant improvement in skin smoothness*. 80% saw a more even, uniform skin tone*. 90% saw a visible boost in skin radiance*. 77% saw a visible improvement in skin firmness*. (Clinical evaluation, 61 subjects, 6 months). *In-vitro test vs. pure Vitamin C..

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Nuxuriance Ultra The Anti-Dark Spot + Anti-Aging Cream SPF30 50ml
listings.description: Protect and perfect your skin in one simple step with the Nuxe Nuxuriance Ultra The Anti-Dark Spot + Anti-Aging Cream SPF30, a beautifying daily moisturiser that shields against UV rays while delivering a natural, sun-kissed glow to all skin tones.. Nuxe's high-protection formula offers advanced broad-spectrum defence against UVA/UVB rays and blue light, thanks to an exclusive patented filter system. It provides anti-ageing cellular protection and intense moisture, working hard to shield the skin from the oxidative stress and dark spots caused by daily sun exposure.. Part of the advanced Nuxuriance Ultra collection, this fluid cream features a unique, beautifying texture infused with 100% natural-origin pigment particles. It melts seamlessly into all complexions without leaving a greasy or sticky residue, providing a long-lasting, transfer-free tint that evens out the skin tone. In trials, 100% of users noted a more even, moisturised, and radiant complexion immediately after use.. As with all Nuxe formulations, the sensory experience is unmatched. The ultra-light fluid glides effortlessly over the skin, releasing an evocative, holiday-inspired scent with warm notes of coconut, tiare flower, and vanilla that instantly transports your senses to summer.. . Why We Love It . We love a multi-tasking hero that keeps skin protected while making it look instantly better. This cream does the job of a high-factor sunscreen, an anti-ageing moisturiser, and a subtle skin-tint all at once. It’s the ultimate shortcut to a healthy, radiant complexion, saving you time in the morning while ensuring your skin is fully shielded from the ageing effects of the sun. Plus, the non-comedogenic formula is dermatologically tested and ocean-friendly, so you can wear it with total peace of mind.. . How To Use It . Use every morning as the final step in your skincare routine.. Dispense a small amount onto your fingertips and smooth evenly over your face, neck, and décolleté, working from the center of your face outwards. Blend carefully into the hairline and jawline to ensure a seamless, natural finish. Reapply frequently, especially after swimming, sweating, or towelling, to maintain full sun protection.. . Works Well With . To keep your complexion fully protected and rejuvenated around the clock, pair this beautifying day cream with the Nuxe Nuxuriance Ultra Eye and Lip Contour Cream..

listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Longevity Epigenetic Night Care 50ml
listings.description: Unlock your skin’s youthful potential and actively reverse the visible signs of time with the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +Reverse Epigenetic Night Care, a pioneering overnight treatment engineered with advanced epigenetic technology.. As we age, lifestyle factors and environmental stressors silence the genes responsible for keeping our skin looking youthful. This cutting-edge night cream works during the skin's peak nocturnal regeneration phase to help reset those cellular switches. Its rich, deeply comforting formula floods the epidermis with moisture while working on a structural level to redefine facial contours, plump out deep-set wrinkles, and firm up slackened tissue, allowing you to wake up to a visibly transformed, smoother, and completely revitalised complexion.. Benefits . Epigenetic Structural Reset: Helps reactivate the skin's natural youth mechanisms to reverse visible structural ageing.. Fills Deep Wrinkles: Plumps out stubborn expression lines, deep furrows, and crow's feet from the inside out.. Restores Elasticity and Firmness: Accelerates natural renewal processes to lift and tighten slackened facial contours.. Nocturnal Barrier Repair: Intensely conditions the stratum corneum to eliminate dry patches and morning tightness.. Revives Cellular Radiance: Re-energises a dull, structurally fatigued face, revealing a luminous, fresh-faced glow by morning.. The Science Behind the Formula Eucerin combines medical-grade dermatological humectants with groundbreaking gene-support technology:. Epicelline®: Eucerin's powerful, proprietary active ingredient that works on an epigenetic level to reactivate silenced youth genes, helping skin cells behave like much younger tissue. . Macro & Micro Hyaluronic Acid: A multi-layered hydration duo—high molecular acid locks moisture at the surface to smooth texture, while micro-sized molecules sink deeper to expand the skin matrix and fill deep lines.. Glycine Saponin: A high-performance botanical extract clinically proven to stimulate the skin’s own natural Hyaluronic Acid production, multiplying hydration retention from within.. Dexpanthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5): An intensive overnight conditioning active that supports the skin’s natural healing and cellular repair mechanisms while you sleep.. Why We Love It We love this epigenetic night care because it represents the absolute future of clinical anti-ageing skincare. It moves past basic superficial line-filling, working instead to target the root cellular causes of skin maturation. It's beautifully plush, velvety texture melts seamlessly into parched skin layers without a greasy or heavy residue, wrapping your face in a comforting moisture cocoon. It delivers genuine, visible structural transformation, making the skin look noticeably denser, bouncy, and completely rested.. How To Use It . listings.rawTitle: Lancome Nutrix Rich Face Cream 125ml
listings.description: Give dry, fragile skin the ultimate comforting embrace with the iconic Lancome Nutrix Face Cream. A beloved beauty secret since 1936, this legendary multi-purpose moisturizer delivers an instant blanket of relief to complexions prone to tightness, sensitivity, and extreme dryness.. Despite its deeply comforting, buttery texture, it melts effortlessly into the skin without leaving a heavy or greasy residue. Why We Love It There’s a reason this cream has been a vanity staple for nearly a century. It is the definition of a skincare icon. We love how versatile it is—functioning as a daily moisturizer, an intensive overnight mask, or a targeted treatment for dry patches. It provides that immediate, sigh-of-relief comfort that sensitive skin craves, leaving the complexion looking visibly plumper, smoother, and beautifully revived.. How To Use Warm a hazelnut-sized amount between your fingertips. Gently massage into clean, dry skin using upward circular motions, moving from the center of the face outwards until fully absorbed. Use morning and evening, or whenever your skin needs an extra boost of nourishment.. Benefits Instant Relief: Immediately soothes tightness, irritation, and discomfort. Deeply Nourishing: Enriched with lanolin to intensely hydrate and repair very dry skin. Barrier Boosting: Strengthens fragile skin against environmental aggressors. Radiant Finish: Restores elasticity and suppleness for a healthy, soft glow. . Dermatologically Tested: Safe and gentle enough for even the most sensitive skin types..

listings.rawTitle: Elemis Balancing Lavender Toner 200ml
listings.description: Purify, balance, and soothe your skin matrix with the Elemis Balancing Lavender Toner, a refreshing daily treatment mist engineered to regulate excess oil while calming reactive skin profiles.. Specially designed for oily, combination, and easily irritated skin types, this gentle, alcohol-free toner works to restore your complexion's optimal natural pH balance after cleansing. It acts as a vital priming step, removing any lingering traces of cleanser or hard tap water residue without stripping away essential moisture layers. Infused with pure botanical hydrosols, it works to naturally tighten the appearance of dilated pores and cool down localised redness, leaving your face looking clear, matte, and thoroughly balanced.. Benefits . Balances Surface Oils: Regulates excess sebum production to help maintain a long-lasting, fresh, matte finish.. Soothes Reactive Redness: Effectively calms skin irritation, active blemish inflammation, and seasonal sensitivity.. Alcohol-Free Hydration: Purifies and tightens the skin matrix without causing the tightness, drying, or stinging associated with traditional toners.. Preps the Skin Canvas: Hydrates the stratum corneum to dramatically improve the absorption and efficacy of your subsequent serums and moisturisers.. Multi-Tasking Refreshment: Functions as a cooling, aromatherapeutic facial mist to revive tired skin and clear the mind throughout the day. . The Science Behind the Formula Elemis utilises natural high-purity saponins and targeted essential oils to safely clarify the epidermis:. Lavender Essential Oil: A globally celebrated botanical active prized for its natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to soothe tissue stress and heal the complexion.. Quillaja Saponaria (Soap Bark Wood Extract): A nature-derived, ultra-mild foaming agent that naturally binds to and lifts away lingering daily impurities and dead cells without disrupting the lipid shield.. Sweet Betty Flower (Saponaria Officinalis): A natural cleansing active that tones, refreshes, and rebalances the skin's pH levels while providing a natural softening effect.. Why We Love It We love this balancing toner because it completely dismantles the myth that clarifying toners have to strip your skin bare to keep oil in check. The fine, atomised mist feels incredibly refreshing on application, instantly cooling the face while delivering a clean, herbal aroma that feels like a boutique spa experience. It is an indispensable multitasker that keeps combination skin perfectly stable, effortlessly shifting zones from greasy to beautifully hydrated, smooth, and matte.. How To Use It . Use daily, every morning and evening, immediately after your purifying cleansing step.. Method One: Moisten a soft cotton pad with the toner and sweep it gently across your face, neck, and décolletage, avoiding the immediate eye area.. Method Two: Hold the bottle roughly 6–8 inches away from the face, close your eyes, and mist directly onto the skin as a cooling, weightless hydration layer.. Tip: Keep a bottle in your bag or refrigerator during hot summer months for an instant, ice-cool skin reset.. Works Well With To create the ultimate pore-refining and clarifying ritual, apply this mist immediately after pulling out impurities with the Elemis Herbal Lavender Repair Mask.. Values Cruelty-free, paraben-free, alcohol-free, mineral oil-free, silicone-free, suitable for combination, oily, and highly sensitive skin profiles..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Lip Idole CuddleBlur Inflatable Lip Velvet 8.5ml / 21 - Blushing Blanket

Simply layer the velvety formula to build up your desired intensity, and reapply throughout the day whenever you need a flawless, matte refresh..

listings.rawTitle: Lierac The Cleansing Foam Duo 2 x 150ml
listings.description: Experience a new generation of facial purification with Lierac The Foaming Cream Double Cleanser, an advanced treatment that targets impurities at every level, from surface debris to deep cellular congestion.. Engineered to counteract the daily environmental stressors that dull and age the complexion, this sophisticated formula combines surface cleansing with innovative ionic technology. It effortlessly lifts away makeup, urban pollution, excess sebum, and sweat before they can degrade into skin-ageing free radicals. Its luxurious, velvety cream texture transforms into a cushiony mousse upon contact with water, delivering a deep, purifying action that leaves the skin feeling impeccably clean, smooth, and revitalised.. Benefits . Double Cleansing Action: Cleanses the skin's surface while utilising an innovative ionic magnet method to draw out deep-seated impurities.. Anti-Ageing Defence: Removes the daily buildup of pollution, dead cells, and oxidised sebum responsible for lines and wrinkles.. Gentle Resurfacing: Incorporates mild alpha hydroxy acid pathways to polish away rough, dulling skin cells.. Microbiome Protection: Formulated to feed, stabilise, and protect the skin's beneficial flora during the wash cycle.. Transformative Texture: Glides on as a rich, comforting cream, then builds into a light, purifying foam.. The Science Behind the Formula Lierac fuses balancing prebiotics with gentle, resurfacing dermatological acids to optimise skin health:. The Prebiotic Complex: A highly calibrated, three-part nutritional matrix composed of nutrient-dense Sea Water, Green and Brown Algae, and pure Plant Sugar. Together, they supply essential minerals, carbon, and nitrogen to maintain a diverse, resilient, and stable skin microbiota.. Lactic Acid (AHA): A hydrating alpha hydroxy acid that gently breaks down the cellular bonds of dead skin, sweeping away flakiness while drawing vital moisture into the newly cleared skin layers.. Ionic Cleansing Matrix: An innovative compound that acts like a microscopic magnet, binding to microscopic pollution particles and lifting them away without disrupting the lipid barrier.. Why We Love It We love this foaming cream because it offers the deep-cleansing benefits of a professional two-step routine in one single, elegant texture. It solves the problems of traditional clarifying cleansers by avoiding harsh, drying surfactants and using a skin-loving prebiotic complex to shield sensitive faces from irritation. It washes off completely clean without leaving a tight or stripped residue, making it an exceptional daily champion for keeping early fine lines and dullness at bay.. How To Use It . Use daily, every morning and evening as the vital first step in your skincare ritual.. Apply a small amount to damp hands and rub together to initiate the creamy mousse transformation.. Massage the lather over the face and neck using gentle, circular motions, avoiding the immediate eye area.. Rinse away thoroughly with warm water and gently pat dry.. Works Well With After neutralising free radicals with this deep cleanse, apply Lierac The Moisturising Lotion to seal the skin barrier and balance the skin's natural pH.. Values Vegan formulation, suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin..

listings.rawTitle: Elemis Pro-Collagen Rose Cleansing Balm 20g
listings.description: Indulge your skin and your senses with the Elemis Pro-Collagen Rose Cleansing Balm, a soothing, rose-infused edition of the iconic luxury cleanser that effortlessly melts away makeup and impurities.. listings.rawTitle: Lancome Absolue Longevity MD Reset The Cream 50ml
listings.description: What if you could choose your age? . Discover the future of proactive skincare with Lancome Absolue Longevity MD. This revolutionary, targeted solution is Lancome’s very first personalized skincare range designed to actively reverse your skin's visible biological age, no matter your life stage.. Find Your Perfect Longevity Protocol: Anticipate: For ages 35 and under Intercept: For ages 35–55 Reset: For ages 55+. The Stars of the Formula Lancome Absolue Longevity MD Reset The Cream Expertly tailored for those aged 55 and over, this new-generation longevity cream works to effectively reset visible signs of ageing after they appear.. At its heart is Mitopure® by Timeline, a powerhouse ingredient clinically proven to reverse biological skin ageing*. Experience truly transformative results on key ageing markers, delivering up to a +55% boost in skin rebound¹ and turning back the clock by up to -4 years on your skin's biological age². It proves that your skin's biological age is the only age you can truly rewrite.. How To Use: Your Longevity Ritual Turn your daily application into a luxurious, age-defying ritual with these six targeted steps:. Step 1: Application – Place a small amount of Reset The Cream into your palm. To actively support skin longevity, gently smooth it over your chest and face using a flat hand in light, gliding motions.. Step 2: Chest to Cheek – Apply medium pressure with a flat hand over the chest, neck, and face to visibly enhance firmness and target wrinkles. Complete the movements on one side of your face first, then repeat on the other.. Step 3: Jawline & Cheekbones – Using your index and middle fingers, glide firmly along the jawline and over the cheekbones to visibly sculpt, lift, and define your facial contours while smoothing lines.. Step 4: Eyebrow – Pinch the skin above the eyebrow between your thumb and index finger, then gently twist in a back-and-forth motion to release facial tension and soften wrinkles.. Step 5: Forehead – Massage the forehead using slow, circular motions, sweeping back and forth across the entire area to encourage relaxation and ease expression lines.. Step 6: Final Gliding – Seal your protocol by slowly gliding your hands from your forehead all the way down to your chest. This soothing final gesture leaves the skin with a rejuvenated glow and a deep sense of well-being.. *Clinical study, 94 women, 2 x daily application. Average results, visual grading. Equivalence in years of improving 6 key signs (forehead, glabellar & crows feet wrinkles, corner of the lips wrinkles, nasolabial fold and ptosis) in 2 months of using reset cream. Individual results will vary. ¹ Instrumental test, 40 persons. ² Clinical study, 94 persons, 2 months..

listings.description: Refresh, firm, and wake up a fatigued complexion with The Ordinary Caffeine 3% + Escin 1% Face Serum, an intensive treatment engineered to combat dullness and loss of definition.. The ultimate antidote to tired-looking skin, this high-performance face serum targets the visible impacts of modern lifestyle factors like poor sleep quality and diet. By promoting a firmer, more lifted, and highly defined look, it works over time to visibly sculpt and support your natural facial structure for a healthy, thoroughly well-rested glow.. Benefits . The Science Behind the Formula True to The Ordinary’s commitment to clinical clarity, this serum pairs proven, high-concentration actives with advanced ferment technologies:. 3% Caffeine: A renowned stimulating ingredient that energises the skin matrix, boosts natural radiance, and promotes a brighter, more uniform complexion while supporting hydration.. 1% Escin: A potent group of active molecules extracted from Horse Chestnut Seed. Escin works in perfect synergy with caffeine, directly contributing to the formula’s intensive tightening and firming benefits.. Bacillus Ferment: A cutting-edge, fermentation-derived biotech active that works on a structural level to hydrate, energise, and reinforce the skin’s visible firmness and architectural integrity.. Why We Love It We love this serum because it acts like an instant espresso shot for a tired, puffy complexion. While most caffeine treatments focus exclusively on the delicate eye area, this formulation is uniquely designed for the entire face, filling a crucial gap in routines stressed by modern life. It leaves no heavy or tacky residue, making it an effortless step to layer under your daily moisturiser or makeup for a beautifully contoured, fresh-faced finish.. How To Use It . Can be used daily as part of your morning and evening skincare regimes.. Apply a few drops to a clean, dry face and neck before applying heavier creams or oils.. Tip to Reduce Morning Puffiness: Massage the serum gently into the skin for 1–3 minutes to promote microcirculation and maximize the sculpting effect.. Works Well With For ultimate hydration and defense, layer this beneath The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA to seal in the serum's energising actives while supporting your surface moisture barrier.. Values Cruelty-free, vegan, suitable for all skin types..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome O Oui Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Summertime is here, and your mood is entirely up to you. Which emotion will you choose today?. Say hello to O Oui, the exhilarating new Eau de Toilette to join the iconic Lancome Les O collection. Designed to amplify your mood with a shot of pure euphoria, this fragrance was born under the golden sun of Le Domaine de la Rose. Enriched with its signature, hand-nurtured Grasse rose, O Oui is an electrifying "yes!" to life—an ode to freedom, thrills, and celebrating every radiant moment exactly your way.. The Story Behind the Scent The Les O collection by Lancome is all about fusing luxury fragrance with genuine emotion. Crafted in the sun-drenched fields of Le Domaine de la Rose in the heart of Grasse, each scent features exclusive ingredients nurtured by the Mediterranean sun. Created by master perfumers, Les O isn't just a fragrance collection; it’s a line-up of living emotions backed by science and adored by fragrance lovers.. As for the bottle? O Oui is a bright, addictive blend: Fragrance Family: Floral, Rose, Fruity Key Notes: Sparkling Lychee Accord, Jubilant Grasse Rose, and a delicate hint of Ambrette.. Created by Givaudan and powered by cutting-edge Happy&Blissful™ technology, O Oui delivers a fresh, petal-soft "skin-on-skin" sensation. It is scientifically designed to awaken positive emotions, lift your spirits, and infuse your day with a surge of optimism.. The Results? Lancome tested the scent on 180 women (aged 18-60 across France, the US, and China), and the mood-boosting stats speak for themselves:. 82% said the fragrance instantly put them in a good mood. 77% felt a surge of happiness with every spritz. 74% agreed it helped them instantly feel delighted.. How to Apply To get the absolute most out of your scent, focus on your pulse points: spritz onto your wrists, neckline, and behind the ears. Let the fragrance naturally bloom on your skin to maximise its sillage.. Escentual Tip: If you're looking for an enduring olfactive presence, the Les O Eau de Toilettes offer a sophisticated, impressive depth. Engineered for long-lasting wear, the formula creates a captivating trail that evolves beautifully on the skin throughout the day, ensuring you make a statement wherever you go..

listings.rawTitle: Ultrasun Family SPF50+ 150ml
listings.description: Provide your family’s skin with ultimate, long-lasting solar defense using the Ultrasun Family SPF50+, a highly advanced, ultra-gentle sunscreen specifically formulated for very sensitive or delicate skin.. Engineered by Swiss sun-care specialists, this high-tolerance formula delivers very high broad-spectrum protection tailored for the entire family—including children and babies. It features an exceptionally clean, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a sticky or chalky residue. Designed to drastically reduce the risk of sun allergies and irritation, it ensures that even the most reactive skin types can enjoy the outdoors safely and comfortably. . Benefits . Very High Protection: Offers premium SPF50+ defence against harmful UVB rays and exceptional broad-spectrum UVA screening. . Sensitive Skin Approved: Free from perfumes, emulsifiers, and oils to prevent skin irritation and reduce the risk of "majorca acne" or heat rashes. . Water-Resistant Formula: Designed to withstand swimming, sweating, and towelling for reliable, heavy-duty protection. . Family-Friendly: A versatile, single-product solution that is gentle enough for the delicate skin of toddlers yet effective enough for adults.. Fast-Absorbing Texture: The smooth gel-cream consistency glides on effortlessly, leaving a comfortable, invisible finish.. The Science Behind the Formula . Ultrasun integrates cutting-edge dermatological technology to ensure superior stability and protection throughout the day:. GSP-T (Grape Seed Extract Complex): A powerful antioxidant blend that neutralises free radicals and actively protects skin cells from the oxidative stress caused by Infrared-A (IR-A) rays.. Lamellar Technology: Ultrasun's signature encapsulation delivery system anchors the broad-spectrum filters seamlessly within the stratum corneum (the skin's outermost layer). This provides exceptionally long-lasting, water-resistant protection that doesn't easily rub off or migrate. . Why We Love It . We love this sunscreen because it removes the stress of family sun protection. Instead of packing multiple bottles for different age groups or skin sensitivities, this single, high-performance pump bottle covers everyone. It eliminates the thick, greasy, and uncomfortable texture often associated with high-SPF kid sunscreens, absorbing into the skin like a light daily lotion while offering heavy-duty defence against the elements.. How To Use It . Apply to clean, dry skin at least 15 to 30 minutes before sun exposure to allow the lamellar technology to fully bond with the skin.. Dispense a generous amount and massage thoroughly across the face and body.. Reapply frequently especially after prolonged swimming, excessive sweating, or vigorous towelling to maintain maximum protection. . Note: Avoid direct contact with eyes and clothing to prevent staining.. Works Well With . To soothe and restore moisture to the skin after a long day in the sun, follow up with the Ultrasun After Sun Gel to cool, hydrate, and prolong your skin’s natural recovery process.. Values . Fragrance-free, emulsifier-free, mineral oil-free, preservatives-free, silicone-free, water-resistant, vegan-friendly, cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Bergamotto La Spugnatura Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A precious limited-edition Eau de Parfum crafted from the ancient La Spugnatura technique, featuring a soft rounded bottle cap with a hand-finished organic effect. Designed by Laura Gonzalez, it is inspired by La Caletta — an ode to independence, the freedom of choosing one’s own rhythm, and finding elegance in restraint and gestures that are unmistakably authentic. . The bottle features a soft rounded bottle cap with a hand-finished organic effect, while the designer’s hot-stamped signature on the label adds a refined finish. . At its heart lies La Spugnatura, a centuries-old extraction technique that continues to live on through the skilled hands of a select few artisans. The bergamot essence is manually extracted from the citrus peel using a sponge and skillful gestures that have been passed down through generations, preserving its full vibrance and natural strength—an essence so rich and nuanced that it can stand on its own. Bright notes of citruses open with vibrant luminosity, enriched by green and floral accents, before ending with soft woods, adding depth to the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Red Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Experience a burst of fiery femininity with Giorgio Armani Si PASSIONE RED BLOOM Eau de Parfum, a vibrant floral-ambery-fruity fragrance that captures the essence of passion in full bloom.. The Story Si PASSIONE RED BLOOM is an invitation to embrace your most daring, joyful self. This flanker takes the iconic Si Passione DNA and turns up the heat, offering a more opulent and textured floral experience. It’s a scent designed for the woman who lives with intensity, blending the tangy sweetness of summer fruits with a sophisticated, velvety floral heart and a dangerously addictive woody base.. The fragrance opens with a "red" energy that is impossible to ignore. A luscious, tangy raspberry accord takes centre stage, energized by sparkling bergamot and the tart, green edge of blackcurrant bud absolute.. As it settles, the heart reveals a luxurious floral depth. Elegant Iris Pallida provides a powdery, skin-like texture that intertwines with two distinct facets of Rose: the fresh, spiced aroma of Rose Petals and the deep, honeyed richness of Rose Absolute. The result is a beguiling, multi-dimensional bouquet.. The dry-down is where the true "Passione" lingers. Premium Vanilla Bourbon from Madagascar brings a creamy, balsamic sweetness that is woven into the ambery warmth of Cashmeran, creating a modern, powerful trail that lasts long into the night.. Notes Top: Raspberry Accord, Bergamot, Blackcurrant Bud Absolute. Heart: Iris Pallida, Rose Petal, Rose Absolute Heart. Base: Vanilla Bourbon Premium, Cashmeran.. Why We Love It If you loved the original Si Passione but want something with more "bite" and a richer, more velvety texture, RED BLOOM is the one. We love how the Iris adds a high-fashion, sophisticated touch to the playful raspberry opening. It feels more "grown-up" and opulent, making it the perfect choice for evening wear or when you want your fragrance to make a statement. . The Design: The iconic Si silhouette is bathed in a vivid, radiant red. The Si PASSIONE RED BLOOM bottle features a frosted finish that gives the glass a soft glow, topped with the organic, stone-shaped cap in a matching vibrant red. For a final touch of couture, the ‘Si’ logo is embossed directly into the glass in transparent lettering, celebrating the craftsmanship of the Armani house..

listings.description: Unapologetic. Radiant. Unforgettable. . Atkinsons Shine Despite Everything is more than just a fragrance; it is a manifesto in a bottle. Inspired by the legendary motto of Sarah Bernhardt—the "Divine Sarah" of the Belle Epoque—this Parfum Intense is an ode to those who refuse to be dimmed. It is a scent for the rule-breakers, the icons, and the dreamers who dazzle with a blend of unrelenting intensity and effortless glamour.. Why You’ll Love It: The Vibe: A bold, theatrical masterpiece that balances fiery spices with a sophisticated, gourmand sweetness.. The Performance: A high-concentration Parfum Intense designed to linger on the skin with exceptional depth and sillage.. The Versatility: A truly genderless scent that commands attention regardless of who wears it.. The Ingredients: Features premium Orpur® qualities—the gold standard of natural raw materials in perfumery.. The Story: Sarah Bernhardt was the world’s first true modern celebrity. A cultural provocateur and a fearless artist, she lived by the phrase “Quand Meme” (Despite Everything). Atkinsons captures this indomitable spirit in a scent that mirrors her life: dramatic, pioneering, and fiercely independent. This fragrance celebrates the power of redefining oneself, blending the old-world elegance of the Belle Époque with a contemporary, avant-garde edge.. The Fragrance Notes: Shine Despite Everything is a complex Woody-Amber-Floral built around three distinct, evocative accords:. The Flamboyant Accord (Top): The scent demands attention from the first spritz. Ethereal swirls of Somalia Orpur Incense are ignited by the golden warmth of Turmeric Seeds and the sharp, vibrant kick of Pimento Berry.. The Avant Gardista Accord (Heart): The heart reveals a sophisticated duality. Luxurious Orris Germanica Orpur provides a soft, powdery elegance, while a decadent splash of Caramel meets the luminous, musky-rose glow of Ambrofix and Rosyfolia.. The Charismatic Accord (Dry-down): The base is where the fragrance finds its soulful depth. Vanilla Madagascar Orpur and Cumarine Pure create a velvety, skin-hugging warmth, grounded by the earthy, spicy structure of Akigalawood.. . Why It’s "Escentual": Atkinsons has a knack for turning history into high fashion, and Shine Despite Everything is the perfect example. We love how it subverts expectations - taking a "diva" inspiration and turning it into a spicy, woody powerhouse that feels incredibly modern. If you’re looking for a signature scent that tells a story of resilience and radiant confidence, this is it.. . listings.rawTitle: Amouage Opus XVI Timber Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Opus XVI begins with tremendous monumentality: a firm, sturdy, boldly vertical expression of woods. However, within moments, the scent begins to reveal a wealth of nuances.. The bright, woody facets of Cypress, Cardamom and Lavandin add luminosity. Frankincense, Juniper and Fir Balsam introduce their own uniquely kinetic energy. Finally, Palo Santo, Sandalwood, Cedarwood and Patchouli ground the whole with their uncompromising authoritativeness: symbols of a wisdom that remains firm and is not swayed by the tides of changing fashions. Vast, monolithic and yet never anything less than approachable, Opus XVI Timber celebrates the most primal, most natural forms of past knowledge while keeping its optimistic sights set on the wisdom yet to be acquired in the future.. Top Notes: Cypress, Cardamom, Juniper, Pink Pepper, Cocoa Heart Notes: Lavandin, Fir Balsam, Hojari Frankincense Base Notes: Palo Santo, Vanilla Bourbon, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Patchouli .

listings.rawTitle: Atelier Des Ors Cocoa Kimiya Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Cocoa Kimiya is part of Atelier des Ors' Abstraction Collection. A collection that inspires a shift in perspective, introduces fresh viewpoints, and reveals things in a new light... A hybrid approach, much like the seahorse: neither entirely terrestrial nor marine, neither distinctly feminine nor masculine, neither fully real nor unreal, yet encompassing all of these elements at once.. Originating from the far reaches of Latin America, cocoa is revered as a sacred plant, the “food of the gods” (the meaning of Theobroma in Greek). The divine embodied in matter. This creation centres around a dark, intense cocoa, its depth contrasted by the luminous brilliance of a unique, radiant cardamom. Rich in exceptional and natural ingredients, this second extract boasts a 40% concentration—materials amplified to their fullest expression. It flows between shadow and light, allure and mystery, sweetness and bitterness..

listings.rawTitle: Donna Karan Cashmere Mist Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml

Fragrance Family: Amber Floral . Top Note: Jasmine Heart Note: Lily of the Valley Base Note: Sandalwood . Crafted with a high concentration of essences, it’s the perfect, lasting indulgence for all-day wear. .

listings.rawTitle: Donna Karan Cashmere & Wild Fig Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Donna Karan Cashmere & Tiare Flower Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml

The fragrance embodies joyful sophistication as it plays on the juxtaposition of tropical freshness, gentle floralcy, and ambery woodiness. listings.rawTitle: Donna Karan Cashmere & Rose Absolu Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: From the Donna Karan Cashmere Collection. Cashmere & Rose Absolu is a radiant ambery rose fragrance inspired by the layers of a woman.. Layers of opulent florals and deep musk merge creating a captivating balance of softness and depth.. Top note: Raspberry . Heart Note: Rose . Base Note: Musk .

listings.rawTitle: Donna Karan Cashmere & Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml

listings.description: Photo Age Control Fluid Anti Pigmentation SPF50 delivers full solar spectrum protection from the sun’s harmful rays. Photo Age Control Fluid Anti Pigmentation SPF50 can be applied as part of your daily skincare regime. Apply to clean dry skin 15 minutes before sun exposure. listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Ultra-Light Day SPF50 50ml
listings.description: This ultra-light anti-ageing face moisturiser is specially developed for mature skin seeking improved firmness, elasticity, and high UVA/UVB protection. The advanced daytime formula blends high- and low-molecular Hyaluronic Acid to help visibly plump deep wrinkles, a Collagen-Elastin Complex to support collagen renewal, and Eucerin’s patented Thiamidol®, the most effective anti-spot ingredient*, clinically proven to reduce the appearance of age spots and help prevent them from returning. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing, non-greasy texture provides lasting hydration while SPF 50 helps protect the skin from photoageing and UV-related damage. Suitable for all skin tones and dermatologically and clinically tested, it is ideal for everyday use.. Benefits . Ultra-light, fast-absorbing day moisturiser with SPF 50 to help defend against sun-related skin ageing . Supports improved elasticity and firmness with Collagen Elastin Complex for smoother, more resilient skin . Helps visibly plump and smooth deep wrinkles with a powerful Hyaluronic Acid complex . Reduces the appearance of age spots and helps prevent their recurrence with Thiamidol® . Non-greasy, non-sticky texture suitable for daily use and under makeup . Clinically and dermatologically tested. This anti-ageing moisturiser combines Collagen Elastin Complex with high- and low-molecular Hyaluronic Acid to deliver intensive hydration. The formula also contains Creatine to support skin elasticity and collagen production, Thiamidol® to help correct age spots, and broad-spectrum SPF 50 to protect against UV-induced ageing and pigmentation.. *Tested against the most commonly used anti-spot ingredients in the face care market.. How To Use . Apply each morning to cleansed face, neck, and décolleté. Gently massage into the skin until fully absorbed, avoiding the eye area. For optimal results, use alongside other products from the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range, particularly the Face Serum and Night Cream, and apply consistently to improve firmness, reduce wrinkles, and target pigmentation..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Experience the searing heat of the desert with Stronger With You Spices, a limited-edition masterpiece that reimagines the iconic Armani signature with an opulent, ambery intensity.. Stronger With You Spices is a fragrance of contrasts—at once fiercely hot and elegantly cool. It opens with a vibrant burst of citrus, immediately grounded by the woody, sharp bite of black pepper extract. This initial spark gives way to a heart of pure luxury: a bittersweet saffron accord that weaves through a trio of smouldering spices and the refined, aromatic freshness of lavender diva essence.. As the fragrance settles, it reveals a base of undeniable addiction. The signature vanilla bourbon premium extract provides a creamy, balsamic warmth that lingers on the skin, creating a sensual projection that is both powerful and comforting.. Notes Top Notes: Black Pepper, Citrus Heart Notes: Saffron, Hot Spice Trio, Lavender Diva Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon. Our Verdict A must-have for collectors, this limited edition is a more daring, adventurous take on the DNA we love. It’s the perfect choice for those who want their signature scent to radiate warmth and sophistication.. The Collector’s Edition Bottle Reflecting the juice within, the iconic Stronger With You silhouette is transformed. Encased in a striking metallic terracotta, the bottle evokes the shifting sands and golden light of desert dunes. The tactile experience is completed by a radiant gold cap, intricately detailed with the signature entwined rings—a symbol of the unbreakable bond that defines the Stronger With You collection..

From the lightest veil to the deepest intensity, every tone is designed to create your own signature looks.. Inspired by Couture fabrics, from sheer to opaque, this palette takes you from day to night without limits.. Nude Hours: one palette, endless ways to play bold..

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumee The Imperial Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Eau Parfumee The Imperial derives its evocative name from an era when empires thrived on the exchange of precious commodities.. Tea and citrus, once reserved for royalty and the elite, became potent symbols of power and cultural exchange. In China, tea flourished as a refined art and symbol of wisdom, while in Rome, citrus fruits embodied vitality and abundance, gracing imperial feasts and gardens.. The term 'Imperial' captures this union of two legacies—East and West—reflecting the fragrance’s ability to transport the wearer to a time of emperors, lavish courts, and the far-reaching influence of these coveted ingredients on civilizations.. In Eau Parfumee The Imperial, the uplifting harmonies of Sri Lanka Black Tea mingle with the vibrant nuances of Italian citruses, revealing a luminous and elegant Citrus Musk fragrance. Inspired by the proud elegance of ancient Roman columns, the design is embellished by the iconic glass decollete, symbolizing a sensory experience as rich and intimate as wearing a jewellery creation.. The cap bears the BVLGARI round logotype recalling ancient Roman coins. It features a crackled golden inlay, echoing celadon ceramics, originating in China a thousand years ago. The flacon reveals a new harmony of orange nuances, glowing softly as if lit from within. This radiant, energizing colour evokes tea leaves bathed in golden light and citrus ripening in the garden, adding a new chromatic chapter to the Eau Parfumee collection..

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Gummy Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Prepare to meet your new sweet obsession. Moschino Gummy is here, and it’s a masterclass in high-fashion gourmand. It strikes that perfect, playful balance between vibrant light and deep, sophisticated shadow - all wrapped up in a scent that’s as bold as the Moschino runway. . The Lowdown: What Does It Smell Like? Moschino Gummy is an irresistible, bright fragrance that evolves from a zesty pop into a sophisticated, sweet addiction. Think of it as a delicious caramel candy—but reimagined for the grown-up fragrance connoisseur.. The Opening : It kicks off with a fresh, sparkling burst of bergamot and juicy blood orange. But here’s the twist: it’s enlivened by unexpected wine essence and the rich, toasted crunch of golden hazelnut.. The Heart: As it settles, it gets seriously indulgent. A velvety praline accord melts into a dreamy milk cream accord. It’s kept from being "too" sweet by the spicy, woody depth of akigalawood, which adds a sophisticated edge.. The Base: The dry-down is where the sensuality lives. Resinous myrrh and balsamic benzoin create a warm glow, while Madagascan vanilla lingers on a soft, musky veil. . Why we love it: Moschino never plays it safe, and Gummy is no exception. We love how it takes the 'sweet' category and gives it a sophisticated, resinous backbone. It’s playful enough for the day but has enough depth to carry you right through the night.. Notes Top - Bergamot, Blood Orange, Wine Essence, Golden Hazelnut Heart - Praline Accord, Milk Cream Accord, Akigalawood Base - Myrrh, Benzoin, Madagascan Vanilla, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Yummy Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Looking for a scent that feels like bottled sunshine? Say hello to Moschino Yummy. Designed for those who crave a daily dose of joy, this fragrance is a high-energy blend of citrus zest, floral elegance, and a spicy kick that leaves a trail of pure radiance in its wake.. It’s the ultimate pick-me-up—think of it as the sophisticated, fine-fragrance version of your favourite fizzy lemon candy.. . The Lowdown: What Does It Smell Like? Moschino Yummy is all about optimism. It opens with a zesty, mouth-watering brightness before evolving into a complex, spicy floral that feels both fresh and incredibly refined.. The Opening: A total wake-up call for the senses. It leads with the juicy, sun-drenched brightness of yellow mandarin and bergamot. To keep things interesting, a touch of Mystikal (a sheer, modern incense) adds a refined, spicy sparkle that you won't find anywhere else.. The Heart: This is where the "fizz" really happens. Luminous geranium and radiant Sambac jasmine provide a floral heart, but it’s the double-hit of Timut pepper and black pepper that gives the scent its addictive, energetic edge.. The Base : As it dries down, the scent softens beautifully. Velvety Bulgarian rose takes centre stage, grounded by the earthy, sophisticated tones of Haitian vetiver and wrapped in a soft, musky caress of Serenolide.. Why we love it : If Moschino Gummy is the decadent dessert, Yummy is the sparkling cocktail. We love the way the peppery heart notes mimic that 'fizzy' sensation of citrus candy without losing its couture edge. It’s bright, bold, and brilliantly wearable for anyone who needs an instant mood boost.. Notes Top - Yellow Mandarin, Bergamot, Mystikal (Incense) Heart - Geranium, Sambac Jasmine, Timut Pepper, Black Pepper Base - Bulgarian Rose, Haitian Vetiver, Serenolide (Musk) .

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Lumiere d'Issey Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Capture the essence of a new dawn with Lumiere d’Issey, the latest refillable Eau de Parfum from the house of Issey Miyake. Inspired by the transformative power of light, this fragrance is a bottled promise of optimism—an ethereal scent designed to chase away the shadows and leave you feeling vibrant, hopeful, and truly alive.. The Scent: A Solar Symphony Crafted by master perfumers Fabrice Pellegrin and Marie Salamagne, Lumiere d’Issey is a modern Floral Ambery masterpiece that translates the brilliance of a sunrise into a captivating olfactory experience.. Top Notes: The fragrance awakens with an effervescent burst of organic green mandarin, offering a zesty, sparkling introduction that mirrors the first rays of morning light.. Heart Notes : At its core, a generous aura of solar orange blossom unfolds, diffusing a sun-drenched warmth that feels both elegant and inviting.. Base Notes: A unique and addictive pistachio wood accord melds with creamy sandalwood, grounding the fragrance in a sophisticated, sensual glow that lingers beautifully on the skin.. Conscious Luxury Lumiere d’Issey proves that high-end perfumery and sustainability go hand-in-hand. This vegan-friendly composition is crafted with 90% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin French alcohol, ensuring your signature scent is as kind to the planet as it is to your senses.. An Architectural Masterpiece The Lumiere d’Issey bottle is a stunning play on refraction and purity.. Made in France with 15% recycled glass, the transparent, multi-faceted design catches the light from every angle, echoing the "energetic movement" of the scent within. The bottle is delicately tinted with a sunrise pink, hinting at the luminous juice it protects. Even the outer box is a work of art, featuring silver-toned triangular cut-outs that make it appear as though the fragrance is literally bursting with light.. Why we love it It’s more than just a perfume; it’s a wearable glow. Refillable, radiant, and undeniably Issey Miyake.. Wear the light. Spread the light. Discover Lumiere d’Issey..

Conscious Luxury Lumiere d’Issey proves that high-end perfumery and sustainability go hand-in-hand. This vegan-friendly composition is crafted with 90% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin French alcohol, ensuring your signature scent is as kind to the planet as it is to your senses.. An Architectural Masterpiece The Lumiere d’Issey bottle is a stunning play on refraction and purity.. Made in France with 15% recycled glass, the transparent, multi-faceted design catches the light from every angle, echoing the "energetic movement" of the scent within. The bottle is delicately tinted with a sunrise pink, hinting at the luminous juice it protects. Even the outer box is a work of art, featuring silver-toned triangular cut-outs that make it appear as though the fragrance is literally bursting with light.. Why we love it It’s more than just a perfume; it’s a wearable glow. Refillable, radiant, and undeniably Issey Miyake.. Wear the light. Spread the light. Discover Lumiere d’Issey..

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum is a striking study in contrasts. It is a fragrance that exists at the intersection of the earth and the laboratory, where raw botanical strength is refined by cutting-edge innovation. This is intensity, evolved.. The Olfactive Journey The Vibe: Dark, sophisticated, and enigmatically gourmand.. The Notes: A breath of fresh, aromatic Lavender meets the deep, bittersweet pull of a Liquorice Accord, all grounded by the woody, structural elegance of Cypress.. Why We Love It The Inspiration: Nature, Augmented Inspired by the elemental power of carbon—the very foundation of life—this fragrance is built for the man who refuses to compromise. It represents a new frontier where the organic meets the engineered, inviting you to push beyond your personal best and explore uncharted territories.. The Face The Luna Rossa Carbon man is the quintessential modern explorer. He is as comfortable navigating the complexities of modern technology as he is respecting the power of the natural world. He is a man of progress, constantly testing his physical and intellectual limits with a quiet, passionate intensity.. Pushing Boundaries Master perfumer Daniela Andrier has pushed the boundaries of traditional masculine scents. By using technology to isolate the purest, most vibrant facets of her ingredients, she has created a "dark gourmand" signature. The result? A fragrance that feels both timelessly masculine and incredibly futuristic.. Refillable Luxury In line with Prada’s commitment to the future, Luna Rossa Carbon is now refillable. It’s a fragrance designed for peak performance, ensuring your signature scent lasts a lifetime while reducing environmental impact..

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Elixir Parfum Spray 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum evokes the sea breeze caressing the skin. A luminous fragrance that holds an unusual ingredient at its heart: seawater cypress, whose essential oil is extracted after the branches are immersed in sea water. The aromatic notes blend with salty and mineral nuances, offering authentic masculine freshness. THE DESIGN The transparent glass bottle reveals the bright golden hues of the fragrance itself, while the sinuous lines are embellished with elegant gold details. The blue enamel cap, inspired by the ceramics of the Amalfi coast, is completed by the famous DG monogram, now in its golden version. Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum: golden, luminous, refined. The fragrance was created by Alberto Morillas exclusively for Dolce&Gabbana. . THE NOTES . TOP - The fragrance opens with the lively citrus freshness of Calabrian Yellow Mandarin. HEART - The heart reveals an accord of aromatic and salty notes thanks to Seawater Cypress. BASE - The fragrance closes on a sensual base of Cedarwood, creating a refined, woody, and modern composition. Yellow Mandarin: sparkling sweetness. Seawater cypress: salty and aromatic. Cedarwood: decisive and sensual. .
