listings.rawTitle: Lancome Renergie Collagen Lift-Xtend Cream 50ml
listings.description: Why go back, when you can go forward? Born from 40 years of scientific expertise, Lancome unveils a new dimension of Collagen science. Introducing Lancome Renergie Collagen Lift-Xtend, a lifting and tightening effect cream proven to rebuild up to 10 years of collagen loss* with 9/10 women agreeing their skin feels firmer.*** WHAT IS COLLAGEN? Collagen is a natural structural protein present in skin that helps support firmness, texture and elasticity. As we age, our collagen does too, which can be associated with visible signs of aging such as loss of firmness and skin laxity. Renergie Collagen Lift-Xtend Cream helps to address this age-related effect in appearance by improving key, visible signs associated with loss of collagen. A NEW DIMENSION OF COLLAGEN SCIENCE Featuring Lancome's most advanced collagen complex developed from 36 years of scientific research, Renergie Collagen Lift-Xtend encapsulates Collagen Fractions, Collagen Peptides and Copper Tripeptides to help target the visible signs associated with collagen loss. This tightening and lifting effect cream combats the visible appearance of skin aging for facial features that look recontoured, and skin that feels lifted and more firmed. Get the lifted look, without compromise. A UNIQUE THREAD-LIKE TEXTURE For the first time at Lancome, Renergie Collagen Lift-Xtend has been formulated in a unique, sensorial thread-like texture inspired by lifting techniques, targeting the look of skin sagginess as skin ages. THE RESULTS: LIFTING & TIGHTENING EFFECT - Proven to rebuild up to 10 years of collagen loss* - 9/10 women agree skin feels firmer*** - Up to +57% tighter skin in 4 hours* - Up to +27% firmer skin in 4 hours* WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT - Proven to help rebuild up to 10 years of collagen loss.* - Delivers visible lifting and tightening effect. - Formulated with Lancome’s most advanced collagen complex. - Features a sensory, thread-like texture inspired by lifting techniques. - Leaves skin feeling firmer, more lifted and defined. WHAT ELSE YOU NEED TO KNOW: - Suitable for all skin types, even sensitive. - For face and neck. - Avoid direct contact with eyes. *Instrumental test measuring collagen quantity of 78 women after 3 months of daily use. Based on average collagen loss of 1% per year. Based on scientific literature. **Instrumental test, 40 women ***Self assessment, 12 weeks, 78 women. .

The sunny sensuality of tuberose meets the caress of rose and the powdery notes of iris and violet. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent LoveNude Kiss Shaper Lip Liner 1.2g / 1 - Undressed Pink
listings.description: Elevate your everyday look with the YSL LOVENUDE Kiss Shaper, a high-performance sculpting liner designed to redefine your pout with couture precision. Whether you’re looking to subtly enhance or boldly overline, this liner offers a "second-skin" feel that blurs beautifully into the lips. Its creamy, ultra-gliding texture ensures a seamless application, providing a soft-focus matte finish that stays flawless for up to 12 hours.. Available in a wardrobe of versatile nudes, the Kiss Shaper is the ultimate "ready-to-go" essential. Designed to be worn alone for a minimalist matte look or layered for infinite combinations, it’s the perfect partner for your favourite YSL lip icons.. The Benefits 12-Hour Wear: A long-lasting formula that defines and shapes from morning to night. Creamy Precision: An ultra-gliding texture that prevents tugging and ensures an effortless finish. Volumising Effect: Designed to create a visibly fuller, sculpted pout in seconds. Universal Nudes: A curated range of shades expertly crafted to complement every skin tone.. The Finish A long-wear creamy matte that blurs the line between makeup and skin. Use a deeper nude to contour for a naturally enhanced, "my lips but better" dimension.. How To Apply Prep: For a sharp, professional finish, ensure your Kiss Shaper is freshly sharpened. Shape: Start at the centre of your Cupid’s bow and work outwards with short, delicate strokes. For a high-fashion, fuller look, subtly overdraw just outside your natural lip line. Fill: Complete your look with a YSL LOVENUDE Lip Blusher. Choose a matching shade for a sophisticated monochromatic effect, or a clashing nude for a custom edge. Layer: To add high-octane dimension, finish with a swipe of YSL LOVESHINE Plumping Lip Oil Gloss for a high-shine, voluminous glow..

listings.description: Discover the next generation hybrid serum foundation powered by Clarins Double Serum technology. With a luminous, satin finish and customisable medium to full coverage thanks to the unique dial for a made-to-measure dose.. Double Serum Foundation is enriched with 14 active ingredients, including new stabilized papaya to restore glow, alongside hyaluronic acid for deep hydration and peptides to boost collagen production.. Long-Lasting Skin Care Benefits: . Improved glow of bare skin. Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Bare skin smoothed. Keeps skin hydrated and comfortable. Instant Make-up Results: . Instant youthful radiance. Women see 12-hour* hold and comfort (*Consumer test, 213 women). A more refined complexion.. Its [COLOUR + HYDRIC] system, inspired by Double Serum's unique technology, offers a double radiance innovation*.. Within the [COLOUR] phase, new A.U.R.A. (Advanced Ultra Radiance Amplifier) technology with light-boosting ingredients and illuminating microcrystals, help to give an immediate glow effect.. Within the [HYDRIC] phase, exfoliating stabilized papain offers a skin-like-new effect for renewed radiance. With 14 active ingredients, this breakthrough foundation offers skin care efficacy like never before*: 5 pure active molecule and plant extract pairings help revive the skin's five vital functions.. listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion 60ml
listings.description: The Ordinary Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion is an ultra-lightweight moisturiser to deliver 24-hour soothing hydration and translucent-looking, radiant skin. The moisturiser delivers all the hydration of a rich cream in our lightest format.1. Optimizing skin hydration requires a mixture of oil and water-loving ingredients. Rice Lipids, a lipid extract made from whole rice, retains skin hydration, and the supporting ingredient Jojoba Oil provides high emollience to reduce water loss from the skin. The amino acid derivative, Ectoin, and a blend of supporting Natural Moisturising Factors in the formulation have a high affinity for water molecules to boost skin’s water content and deliver deeply hydrated skin. . This face moisturizer provides intense soothing hydration from one use, reduces visible redness, and repairs the skin barrier, making the formula ideal to combat dry and sensitive skin. The micro-fluidized texture offers an ultra-lightweight emulsion that absorbs instantly without a greasy after-feel.. Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion can be incorporated into any skincare regimen for dewy and radiant skin. Apply Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion after Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner for a 62% boost in moisture2 and to boost firmness. 100% of users saw boosted luminosity and glossiness with 1 use together.2 . For very dry skin, layer Rice Lipids + Ectoin Microemulsion with another moisturiser. This moisturizer is also compatible under SPF or foundation for smooth, blendable makeup application.. Testing shows after the first use: . Delivers 24-hour soothing hydration . Reduces visible skin redness . Skin looks more radiant and dewy . Repairs the skin barrier .

listings.rawTitle: Sachajuan Detangling Brush White
listings.description: The Sachajuan Detangling Hairbrush is expertly designed to minimise breakage and gently detangle hair, leaving it soft, smooth, and naturally glossy. Its combination of soft nylon bristles and flexible round pins glides effortlessly through strands, reducing tension and protecting against external damage.. The brush stimulates and invigorates the scalp while ensuring a comfortable detangling experience, making it ideal for daily use. Suitable for both wet and dry hair, it helps prevent unnecessary pulling or breakage, allowing you to maintain healthy, resilient hair.. Perfectly complemented by Sachajuan’s treatment products, this detangling brush enhances your haircare routine by promoting smoothness, shine, and overall hair wellbeing..

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne Eau de Toilette Intense 60ml
listings.description: LIQUID ICE IN A SPRAY A SHOT OF Y ENERGY Spray Y ICED COLOGNE, the Eau de Toilette Intense by Yves Saint Laurent for the self-accomplished man. A striking 12-hour* icy intensity for a long-lasting trail. A shot of powerful energy to start your successful day. Fragrance Notes: . listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Peach 'N Roses Eau de Parfum 25ml
listings.description: Discover the new Lancôme Idole Peach’N Roses Eau de Parfum, a juicy, bold, and feminine fragrance that celebrates the vibrant confidence of modern women. Perfect for any occasion, this long-lasting fruity floral perfume leaves a radiant trail of peachy sweetness on the skin. THE SCENT: PEACHY SWEETNESS This irresistible scent opens with a burst of sparkling Red Berries Accord, awakening the senses with a lively freshness. At its heart, the exclusive Peach Orpur™ extract, an innovation by Givaudan, captures the luscious essence of a perfectly ripe peach - tangy, sweet, and utterly alluring. Finally, the velvety Damascena Rose Absolute envelops the composition with sensual warmth, reimagining the iconic Idole floral signature with a juicy twist. Top Notes: Red Berries Accord Heart Notes: Peach Orpur™ Base Notes: Damascena Rose Absolute THE BOTTLE: The elegant bottle, finished in glowing peach tones, embodies the spirit of optimism and light. Lancôme Idole Peach’N Roses is the fragrance that makes every moment feel just peachy. HOW TO USE: 1. Apply to pulse points - wrists, neckline, and behind the ears - to let the fragrance bloom naturally. 2. Allow the fragrance to develop naturally on the skin, and reapply as desired for more intensity. 3. Perfect for day or evening wear and ideal for layering with other Idole fragrances. .

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Advanced Body Creator Super Slimming Reducer 200ml
listings.description: Sculpt, firm, and refine with Shiseido’s advanced, science-led body contouring treatment.. Ready to elevate your body care routine? The Shiseido Advanced Body Creator Super Slimming Reducer is a high-performance, dewy gel-cream designed to visibly target cellulite and sculpt your silhouette. Combining innovative skincare science with an uplifting sensory experience, this refreshing formula melts into the skin to firm, smooth, and redefine key areas like the thighs, waist, hips, and upper arms.. Why You’ll Love It Sculpts & Refines: Visibly tones the waist and thighs for a more contoured, streamlined silhouette.. Fights Cellulite : Powered by Shiseido’s exclusive Fat Fighting System to target and smooth stubborn areas.. Hydrating & Softening: The lightweight gel-cream texture floods the skin with moisture, leaving it incredibly soft and supple.. The Science Behind the Slenderness At the heart of this advanced formula is Shiseido’s scientifically proven Fat Fighting System, which works on a triple-action level to break down, burn, and prevent fat accumulation:. The Breakdown: An easily absorbed Caffeine Complex efficiently converts neutral fat into free fatty acids.. The Prevention: Western Hawthorn Extract and Grapefruit Oil work together to limit future fat accumulation.. Massage thoroughly into the skin using upward, circular motions until fully absorbed.. Take a moment to deeply inhale the uplifting fragrance to activate its aromacological benefits..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Tabac Sahara Eau de Parfum Spray 125ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Tabac Sahara, a captivating nocturnal journey to the heart of the desert. Mysterious and smoky wreaths of tobacco meet the sensual addiction of a raspberry accord, beautifully enhanced by the warmth of an ambergris accord. Through its tangy freshness, the red berry creates a vibrant contrast with tobacco’s golden nuances, suggesting the pink halo that surrounds the dunes at nightfall. “Tabac Sahara is the perfume of a desert of pink dunes by starlight. the encounter of tobacco’s golden nuances with a pink raspberry note.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Tabac Sahara comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. It takes on an enigmatic purple shade, reminiscent of the dunes by starlight. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily. *in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water..

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Ideal Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain’s first almond scent for men, L’Homme Idéal is revealing a new limited edition: L’Homme Idéal Cologne Forte, a burning-cool almond that unveils an unprecedented fragrance expression of the collection’s iconic and signature ingredient. As fresh as an eau de cologne and as strong as an eau de parfum, L’Homme Idéal Cologne Forte holds paradoxes in harmony. A real style exercise for Delphine Jelk, Creative Director of Guerlain Fragrances Perfumer, who unveils an unprecedented expression of almond through this dual eau de parfum. On one side, grapefruit notes deliver a burst of invigorating freshness at the top, creating a bitter-edged interplay of almond and citrus notes. On the other side, vetiver and incense come together to form a backdrop, offering the fragrance a deep woody warmth tinged with mystery. An unprecedented variation on L’Homme Idéal, Cologne Forte embodies Guerlain’s virtuous approach by using alcohol made from French leguminous plants grown using responsible farming methods. Facetted edges, pared-back lines: L’Homme Idéal’s historic bottle owes its harmonious lines to a model taken from the Maison’s archives. For this new limited edition, the metallic finish of its square label and the intense grey shade of the fragrance evoke the powerful freshness of this new composition..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger With You Powerfully Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prepare for the most intense chapter of the Stronger With You saga yet. . Stronger With You Powerfully is a bold, high-voltage reimagining of the iconic DNA we know and love. It takes the signature warmth of the original and sets it alight with a dark, smoky edge and a succulent splash of cherry. Designed for the man who wants to leave a lasting impression, this is an "extreme" interpretation that promises to turn heads for up to 24 hours.. Why It’s Escentual: If you’re a fan of the original chestnut accord but want something with more "bite," this is it. The addition of a syrupy, addictive cherry note transforms the fragrance from a sweet gourmand into something much more mysterious and sophisticated. It feels modern, daring, and undeniably premium. Plus, that deep crimson bottle looks incredible on any fragrance shelf.. The Notes: . Top Notes: A bright, exhilarating burst of Italian Mandarin and Calabrian Lemon Heart meets a luscious, sweet Cherry accord for a captivating opening.. . Heart Notes: The aromatic freshness of French Diva Lavender provides a clean, masculine anchor, balanced by a warm, woody spice accord that adds layers of depth.. . Base Notes: The soul of the scent. Armani’s iconic sugared chestnut is fused with a new, smoky chestnut accord . This is wrapped in a luxurious duo of Madagascar Vanilla (Bourbon and Absolute) and grounded by mineral-rich Amber Woods.. . The Longevity: True to its name, Powerfully lives up to the hype. It boasts an impressive 24-hour longevity , meaning that smoky, vanilla-drenched dry down will stay with you from your morning meeting well into the night.. The Design: The classic, weighted Stronger With You bottle has been given a powerful makeover. The juice is now a deep, smoky red, reflecting the intensity and the "red-hot" cherry notes hidden within..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Captured in a ruby-toned, jewel-like bottle, Power of You encapsulates a new gourmand addiction - a sensual concentrate created to be worn from day to night. . As the fragrance opens, it unveils a vibrant, captivating passion fruit accord, evoking the fruit's purest essence. . At the very heart of the composition, the fragrance finds its radiant soul: a transparent frangipani accord reverberates through the fragrance, creating addictive warmth and sweetness. . A profound, sensual depth then emerges: a creamy vanilla absolute from Madagascar is beautifully woven with the nuanced, caramel-like sweetness of benzoin resinoid. . More than a scent, this is a fragrance that instantly owns the space of its projected, radiant halo, inspiring others to embrace their own power, to light up the room. The ruby-toned flacon proudly crowns this fragrance as jewel. . Power of You: a day to night exotic radiance. . Instruction of use: . Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.. Fragrance Family: . Fruity Floral. Key Notes: . Passion Fruit Accord, Frangipani Accord, Vanilla Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Air Tinted Serum Sunscreen SPF50+ 50ml / Light
listings.description: Experience the ultimate fusion of dermatological expertise and weightless luxury with the La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Air Tinted Serum Sunscreen SPF50+. . Why Your Skin Will Love It If you’ve been searching for a high-protection sunscreen that feels completely weightless, this is the one. This innovative serum-sunscreen melts effortlessly into the skin, leaving behind a subtle, tinted glow while acting as a powerhouse treatment for your complexion.. Infused with a trio of skin-loving ingredients—Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, and Vitamin E—it deeply hydrates and reinforces the skin barrier. The result is a clever dual-action formula that keeps your skin moisturised for up to 24 hours while delivering an impressive 16-hour mattifying effect, keeping excess shine at bay from dawn to dusk.. The Benefits Invisible Feel: An ultra-light, "air-like" texture that completely vanishes upon application.. Dermatological Power: Enriched with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid to promote a healthy, hydrated skin barrier.. Long-Wear Comfort: Offers 16 hours of oil control alongside 24 hours of continuous hydration.. No-Sting Formula: Specially tested to ensure it is ultra-gentle around the delicate eye area.. Trusted Protection: Formulated by the #1 Dermatologist-recommended brand for sun protection in the UK.. How To Use Apply evenly across your face every morning as the final step in your skincare routine. Thanks to its weightless, breathable finish, it also acts as the perfect smoothing primer before makeup application.. Key Details Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Safety: Hypoallergenic, dermatologically and ophthalmologically tested. Finish: Tinted with a natural matte finish.. Consumer test on 97 subjects; Instrumental test on 30 subjects. UK Consultant Dermatologist study 2025..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Air Vitamin Sun Stick SPF50+ 10ml
listings.description: Glow on the go just got a serious upgrade. The La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVAIR Vitamin Sun Stick is the ultimate weightless wonder for those who want high-level protection without the heavy feel. Delivering a "light-as-air" sensation, this anti-pollution stick leaves your skin with a transparent, healthy radiance that looks as good as it feels. . Why You’ll Love It. If you’re a fan of a satin finish but hate the feel of traditional sunscreens, this is your new holy grail. It glides onto the skin with a touch-free application—no messy fingers required—and is completely "unseen" once applied. Designed for the modern life, it’s the perfect companion for city living, doubling as an anti-pollution shield that keeps your complexion clear and luminous. . The Ingredients. Vitamin E and Astaxanthin: A powerhouse antioxidant duo. While Vitamin E hydrates, Astaxanthin (one of nature’s most potent antioxidants) helps to neutralise free radicals and nourish the skin barrier.. Sweat and Water Resistant: Despite its airy texture, it’s built to stay put, making it ideal for humid days or a busy commute.. The "Top-Up" Hero: Formulated to glide effortlessly even over makeup , making it the easiest way to ensure your SPF50+ protection never dips throughout the day. . How To Use. Keep this in your handbag for effortless reapplication. Simply glide the stick over your face and neck whenever you need a boost of protection and a fresh, transparent glow. It’s so light, you’ll forget you’re wearing it. . The Details. Finish: Transparent, satin glow. Texture: Weightless, non-greasy, and "light-as-air." Best For: Daily city wear, reapplication over makeup, and all skin types.. Editor’s Tip: In a consumer test of 138 subjects, users loved the immediate sense of "comfortable nourishment." It doesn't just protect; it makes your skin feel better from the very first swipe. .

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVSPORT Pro-Resistance Stick SPF50+ 10ml
listings.description: Meet the pocket-sized powerhouse your gym bag has been waiting for. The La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVSPORT Pro-Resistance Stick is their most efficient protection yet, specifically engineered to withstand the rigours of high-intensity activity. Whether you’re scaling a mountain or mid-tennis match, this stick ensures your sun protection is as relentless as your workout. . Why You’ll Love It. The beauty of a stick is all in the precision and portability . This formula creates a protective, invisible film on the skin that won’t run or sting your eyes—a total game-changer for runners and cyclists. It’s completely residue-free and so lightweight that it even sits beautifully over your morning makeup for effortless midday touch-ups. . The Innovation. Mexoryl 400: Featuring La Roche-Posay’s most advanced filter to date, targeting even the most penetrative ultra-long UVA rays [380 – 400nm] to prevent premature ageing and deep cell damage.. Vitamin E: Infused with this essential antioxidant to help your skin defend itself against environmental aggressors and oxidative stress.. Pro-Resistance: Designed to stay put through sweat and movement without feeling heavy or greasy.. The Expert Verdict: As the #1 Dermatologist recommended brand in the UK*, La Roche-Posay has perfected the art of high-tech sun care. This stick is a must-have for anyone who needs reliable, "no-look" application while on the move. . How To Use. Glide the stick directly over the face and sensitive zones (like the tops of ears and the nose) just before heading out. To stay fully shielded, re-apply frequently and generously throughout the day—especially during heavy exercise. . Safety First. While we love the sun, over-exposure is a serious risk. Even with high SPF, try to stay out of the midday heat and keep babies and young children in the shade. . The Fine Print. *Ultra-long UVA rays [380 – 400nm]. **Study of 78 UK Consultant Dermatologists, 2025. For more information, visit laroche-posay.co.uk/no1claim2025. .

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVSPORT Sweat & Wet Pro-Resistance Lotion SPF50+ 200ml
listings.description: The ultimate endurance partner for your skin has arrived. Designed for those who refuse to slow down, the La Roche-Posay UVSPORT Wet and Sweat Lotion offers high-performance, very high UV protection that thrives under pressure. Whether you're mid-marathon or diving into the pool, this lotion is engineered to stay put when you're at your most active. . Why We Love It. The real game-changer here is the Wetskin Technology . We’ve all been there—trying to re-apply sunscreen to damp or sweaty skin, only for it to slide right off. This innovative formula creates a film that repels water, allowing the lotion to absorb instantly even on wet skin without losing any of its protective power. It’s efficient, effective, and completely fuss-free. . The Ingredients. Wetskin Technology: An invisible gel that creates a hydrophobic film on the skin to repel water and sweat.. Antioxidant Vitamin E: Acts as a shield against free radicals and environmental aggressors.. Glycerin and LRP Thermal Water: A hydrating duo that works to replenish moisture levels and soothe the skin barrier, preventing the dehydration often caused by sun and salt.. Editor’s Tip: This is the perfect choice for swimmers or outdoor athletes who need a reliable SPF that doesn't require a full towel-dry before every re-application. . How To Use. Apply generously to the face and body just before heading out. Thanks to the Pro-Resistance formula , you can apply this directly onto wet or sweaty skin during your workout. To stay fully protected, remember to re-apply frequently, especially after swimming or towelling. . The Details. Texture: Non-greasy, easy-to-blend lotion.. Finish: Invisible on the skin.. Best For: High-intensity sports, swimming, and active lifestyles..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVSPORT Invisible Refreshing Mist SPF50+ 200ml
listings.description: Whether you’re hitting a personal best on the track or just enjoying a high-energy day in the sun, La Roche-Posay’s Anthelios UV Sport Mist is your new ultimate workout partner. This isn’t just sun care; it’s ultra-refreshing, high-performance protection designed to keep up with you, no matter how hard you train. . Why You’ll Love It. The genius of this mist lies in its barely-there feel . It delivers a cool, clean sensation upon application and dries down to a completely invisible, dry-touch finish. No white casts, no greasiness, and zero transfer onto your favourite activewear. It’s the fuss-free way to stay protected while you move. . . The Benefits. Triple-Resistant: Expertly formulated to withstand water, sweat, and even sand.. Skin-First Formula: Infused with Antioxidant Vitamin E, Glycerin, and the iconic LRP Thermal Spring Water to hydrate and reinforce your skin’s natural barrier.. Sensitive Skin Friendly: Hypoallergenic and dermatologically tested, ensuring even the most reactive skin stays comfortable under the sun.. The Expert Verdict: As the #1 Dermatologist recommended brand for sun protection in the UK*, La Roche-Posay continues to lead the way in innovative, high-efficacy formulas that don't compromise on texture. . How To Use. Shake well before use.. Spray at a minimum distance of 15cm from the skin.. Apply the sunscreen product just before exposure. Do not spray directly onto the face. Spray on palms and then apply with palms on the face.. Re-apply frequently and generously to maintain protection, especially after swimming, perspiring or towelling. In case of contact with eyes, rinse them immediately and thoroughly. . Notes: Do not intentionally inhale. Over-exposure to the sun is dangerous. Keep babies and young children out of direct sunlight. Do not stay too long in the sun, even while using a sunscreen product because it does not provide you 100% protection. . . The Fine Print. *Study of 78 UK Consultant Dermatologists, 2025. For more information, visit laroche-posay.co.uk/no1claim2025. .

listings.rawTitle: NIOD Superoxide Dismutase 3 Enzyme Mist (SDEM3) 50ml
listings.description: Superoxide Dismutase 3 Enzyme Mist (SDEM3) is our third-generation antioxidant face mist designed to help preserve long-term skin integrity, help prevent and reverse visible signs of ageing, and support a healthy, more radiant appearance. Superoxide dismutase is naturally present within the body, where it acts as one of the most fundamental protective forces against damage that can occur when exposed to stressors from the environment. These stressors include vehicle emissions and air pollutants, and damage from them can result in the early onset of ageing signifiers, including fine lines and wrinkles, a dulled skin tone, and an overall loss of visible skin quality. SDEM3 contains a newly-isolated form of superoxide dismutase - superoxide dismutase 3 (SOD3). Natural SOD3 levels deplete with age, contributing to the breakdown of collagen within the skin, and resulting in the development of visible signs of ageing such as fine lines and wrinkles. By topically supplementing SOD3, Superoxide Dismutase 3 Enzyme Mist works to help preserve skin’s natural collagen to help minimise visible signs of ageing, delivers visible repair of multiple types of wrinkles and promotes skin that looks firmer, more even-toned, and radiant. . Key Ingredients . Superoxide Dismutase 3: Reduces visible ageing signs by helping to preserve skin’s natural collagen content in the face of environmental stressors. . Mirabilis Jalapa Extract: Significantly soothes visible skin redness and reinforces the skin’s protective barrier. . Algin Biosaccharide Gum-4 : Smooths the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while promoting firmness. . Acetyl Zingerone: Strengthens the skin’s natural defences while visibly smoothing skin texture to diminish signs of ageing. . Nicotiana Benthamiana Hexapeptide-40 sh-Polypeptide-2: Protects the skin from damaging environmental aggressors while improving skin tone uniformity. . . Key Benefits . Prevents Visible Skin Damage: Proactively guards against environmental aggressors before damage occurs. . Visibly Repairs Existing Wrinkles: Helps reverse multiple types of wrinkles for a smoother complexion. . Preserves Natural Collagen: Minimises signs of ageing by protecting the skin's natural collagen. . Instant Hydration Boost: Delivers an instant 74% increase in hydration after a single application.* . Promotes Healthier-Looking Skin: Enhances overall skin radiance. . Improves Skin Tone Uniformity: Reduces visible redness and promotes an even complexion. . *In a clinical study of 20 panellists after single use application. . . How To Apply . Apply to the face in the morning and evening. . . Values . Vegan.. Alcohol-free, silicone-free, gluten-free, oil-free, cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar L'Essence Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: The first amber perfume in history created by Jacques Guerlain, Shalimar celebrates its 100th anniversary. A homage to the timeless modernity, daring and seduction of Guerlain’s most famous scent for women.. More than a perfume, Shalimar L’Essence is a declaration of love. Delphine Jelk has added the precious Madagascan vanilla tincture stemming from Guerlain's ancestral know-how to the ethylvanillin found in Jacques Guerlain’s original formula, giving Shalimar a new intensity without detracting from its signature. Discreet and subtle bergamot illuminates the floral heart, which blends rose absolute with the powdery elegance of iris. Little by little, Shalimar’s amber note unfolds, deeper than ever. Used in abundance, vanilla infuses it with new facets – smooth and woody with a hint of leather.. Guerlain has reinterpreted the logo of its iconic bottle for Shalimar L’Essence. A nod to Art Deco, the artistic movement contemporary to Shalimar. Assembled in a bold graphic logo, the letters are crafted in a golden shade reminiscent of the perfume itself. Firmly anchored in its history yet unmistakably contemporary, the Shalimar L’Essence bottle forms a bridge between the eternal Shalimar and its future iteration.. How to Use. Spray Shalimar L'Essence Eau de Parfum on the pulse points: neck, chest and wrist..

Unlike other anti-dandruff shampoos, this one won’t dry out your hair or strip it of colour. listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Eau de Gingembre Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: The exhilarating aroma of Eau de Gingembre is reminiscent of an adventurous journey to India, where it’s common for locals to refresh the air with spritzes of ginger water. The fragrance opens with stimulating Calabrian bergamot oil, Tunisian neroli, and ginger – a spicy combination that calls to mind the intense sensation of biting into a freshly grated piece of ginger. The blend immediately wakes up the senses – like a dive into icy water – then uncovers an energetic hit of fig leaf and cypress oil. A mellow accord of white woods brings everything into balance. . Eau de Gingembre is the ideal scent for those who appreciate a clean sparkling fragrance with a touch of the exotic. . Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot Oil, Ginger Co2 Extract, Tunisian Neroli, Petit Grain Oil . Heart Notes: Fig Leaf, Cypress Oil . Base Notes: White Wood .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Poudre d'Or Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: This warm and sensual fragrance is an ode to the calming beauty of a sunset. The combination of Paradisone® and soft tiare flower is balanced out with powdery iris and sensual sandalwood. Warm and relaxing, Poudre d’Or is the perfect scent to wear with your coziest clothes. . Top Notes : Tiare Flower, Paradisone. . Heart Notes: Exaltone, Iris. . Base Notes: Sandal Wood Essence, Madagascar Vanilla. .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Ideal Oud Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A tantalizing experiment, Ideal Oud juxtaposes two opposite raw materials: rose and oud wood. The unexpected yet harmonious mix of fragility and power, light and darkness, is balanced with a beautiful duet of Bulgarian and Centifolia roses. Woody, leathery and mysterious, the scent gets a jolt of spice with fiery notes of rose pepper and precious saffron. The warm fullness of papyrus wood and labdanum elevate the scent and showcase its complexity. . The result is a magical accord that provides endless intrigue for those who dare to wear it. . Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose Essence, Rose Centifolia Absolute, SFE Pink Pepper Essence Heart Notes: Essence Of Ylang Ylang, Saffron Absolute, Essence Of Oud From Laos Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla Absolute, Papyrus Wood Essence, Labdanum Absolute .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Ambre Magique Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Luminous and sensual with a vibrant, woody intensity. Encompassing amber notes created by a woody-amber accord, Ambre Magique forms a kaleidoscope of olfactory sensations. Lively mandarin and cardamom are softened by the introduction of orange blossom, and elegant Bulgarian rose is contrasted with the bold sweetness of bourbon vanilla and musk. At the base, sandalwood creates a magical experience that sends vibrations to the skin. . Vibrant and light yet rich, Ambre Magique is a unique elixir; a complex concentrate of a thousand scents and the stories that inspired them. . Top Notes: Mandarin Essence, Orange Blossom Absolute Heart Notes: Cardamom Essence, Bulgarian Rose Essence Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla Absolute, Benzoin Essence .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Legend Leather Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Legend Leather encapsulates a moment that left an indelible mark on perfumer Alberto Morillas. Inspired by a drive in a dream car through Madrid, the fragrance combines the rich essence of soft leather, speed, and freedom.. The scent, named Legend Leather, is a blend of strength and subtlety, modern yet iconic. Its olfactory pyramid features top notes of guaiac wood and aldehydes, a heart of raspberry and saffron-infused iris, and a base of immortelle and styrax, creating a powerful yet refined composition. Morillas aimed to merge the intensity and softness of leather, evoking a skin-on-skin sensation reminiscent of cherished memories and emotions.. Top Notes : Guaiac Wood Essence, Aldehydes, Cistus Essence . Heart Notes: Raspberry Accord, Iris Absolute, Saffron Essence . Base Notes: Immortelle Essence, Styrax Essence, Ambergris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Blue Gin Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: An olfactory delight around a theme dear to Alberto Morillas: freshness. A fragrance inspired by ingredients used in spirits, Blue Gin’s heart notes of juniper and blackberries create a beautiful balance and contrast when blended with the spicy notes of Sichuan pepper and bitter notes of mandarin. Blue Gin is a play on the senses, evoking the supple texture of cotton denim and the freshness of ice cubes before the gin ignites on the palate.. Top Notes: Cardamom Essence, Mandarin Essence , Cascalone (Marine Accord). . Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper Essence , Juniper Berry Essence.. Base Notes: Irone | Cetalox (Ambergris), Tonka Bean Absolute..

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Musc Eternel Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Crafted to envelop you like a second skin, this sensual blend surrounds the senses with a voluptuous bouquet of roses, jasmine, and hawthorn. The lively floral opening settles into a soft, powdery veil of iris. At the base, white musk caresses the fragrance with a dose of woody warmth. For a lasting impression, tonka bean infuses Musc Eternel with a touch of sweetness and nuttiness that’s reminiscent of freshly picked almonds. . Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose Oil, Paradisone. . Heart Notes : Iris Absolute, Egyptian Jasmine Absolute, White Hawthorn. . Base Notes: White Musk, Tonka Bean Absolute. .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Tres Chere Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Très Chère is like a poetic love letter in a bottle, a passionate confession detailing a fleeting encounter with a stranger. . “This letter might never reach you even though this is for you, just like this perfume. Our eyes have only met once but I feel like I have always known you. You brushed past me, I looked at you. You said ‘Sorry!’ My eyes stared at you, your profile, your eyelashes curves, the hem of your lips. One second which will last for eternity. One second, just enough time to create this perfume. It tells the story of this moment which has made such an impression on me,” the lovestruck writer, Alberto, reveals. . The graceful fragrance boasts an alluring melange of orange blossom, bourbon vanilla, and sandalwood. The seductive scent lingers on the skin–like the gentle touch of a lover that you can’t get out of your mind. . Top Notes: Orange Tree Blossom Extract. Heart Notes: Ambroxide, Paradisone, Jasminum sSambac. Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Exaltone®, Australian Sandalwood Essential Oil..

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Solar Blossom Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Solar Blossom is a joyful interpretation of Alberto Morillas’s favorite childhood memories. Paradisone and neroli conjure up images of fresh water slapping against the hot cobblestone roads in Seville. The heart of the fragrance features notes of orange blossom like the ones Morillas was surrounded by as a child. Solar Blossom finishes with vanilla for warmth and sweetness. . Top Notes: Neroli Bigarade, Paradisone (Jasmine) . Heart Notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom . Base Note : Vanilla .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Sweet Praline Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: This playful and decadent scent is Master Perfumer’s take on a beloved confection. Sweet raspberry and caramelized benzoin tame the spicy middle note of Sambac jasmine, while smoky incense and papyrus wood take the blend to sophisticated heights. The result is a seductive accord that’s begging to be devoured. . Top Notes: Raspberry, Hedione (Jasmine Freshness) . Heart Notes: Sambac Jasmine, Incense . Base Notes: Benzoin Resin, Ambrox, Papyrus Wood (Cypriol) .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Golden Oud Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Oud Assafi, the extraordinary ingredient the center of this captivating fragrance comes from an essential oil found near the Bangladesh-India border. One leisurely summer day, Alberto Morillas caught a whiff of the scent lingering in the air while walking along Lake Geneva. He instantly recognized it and was inspired to craft Golden Oud. Beginning with a delicate Bulgarian rose and incense, the fragrance slowly merges with earthy papyrus and soulful Oud Assafi, the purest essential oil there is. Amyris wood and Cétalox at the base infuse Golden Oud with a richness and sensuality that’s hard to forget. . Top Notes: Incense, Bulgarian Rose . Heart Notes: Oud Assafi, Papyrus . Base Notes: Amyris Wood, Cetalox .

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir For Your Love Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Intimate and enchanting, For Your Love captures the olfactory sensations of a passionate kiss. With the strangely human scent of Exaltone, notes of raspberry, and the carnal pleasure of Cachalox, the fragrance replicates the closeness of skin, the classic powdery scent of makeup, and the warm musk of the neck that lovers inhale when locked in an embrace. Benzoin and patchouli heart bring depth and the warmth of flushed cheeks to the base. . Top Notes: Raspberry, Exaltone . Heart Notes : Caremelised Flowers, Rose, Paradisone, Cachalox . Base Notes: Benzoin, Patchouli. The result is a fragrance as soft and sensual as a caress. This unforgettable blend is about taking risks and getting lost in the moment..

listings.rawTitle: Mizensir Perfect Oud Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Designed to mimic the feeling of powerful emotion building to a crescendo, this smoky blend rises like a slow heat, as leathery and woody notes captivate the senses.. Beginning with energizing Bulgarian rose and a cooling combination of coriander and Bergamot oil, this scent continues to unfold, evoking the memory of burnt wood with smoldering oud and iris concrete. The fragrance is anchored by invigorating cade oil and the elusive incense notes of Alaskan cedar. Feverous and alive, . Top Notes : Bergamot Oil, Coriander Oil, Bulgarian Rose Oil . Heart Notes: Iris Concrete, Oud Wood . Base Notes: Alaska Cedar Essence, Cade Oil . Perfect Oud will entice men and women who gravitate towards scents that are laced with warmth, sensuality, and depth. .

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum Spray 40ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love is a radiant fragrance that exudes modern femininity, capturing the essence of joy and irresistible allure.. From the very first spritz, it envelops you in a luminous pink aura that lingers from top to base. At the opening, a burst of fresh, tart raspberry dances with playful energy, setting the stage for a vibrant heart of delicate hibiscus. The fragrance evolves into a sensual, yet light, base where the red berry facets of musk harmonize beautifully with the smooth, addictive warmth of Madagascar vanilla. The result is a uniquely pink-toned scent – a deliciously sweet, modern vanilla that's both fun and feminine, radiating an air of confidence and charm.. Inspired by the iconic pink of the Jimmy Choo brand, this fragrance is a celebration of joy, making it utterly captivating and impossible to resist.. Fragrance Family: Floral, Fruity, Amber. Top Notes: Raspberry, Orange Flower. Heart Notes: Rose Essence, Rose Infusion, Hibiscus Flower, Freesia. Base Notes: Vanilla, Santal, Musks..

listings.description: A trio of miniature hero products, with reusable cotton pads, to brighten and hydrate uneven skin tone.. The set also includes The Ordinary complimentary reusable cotton pads to support the application of Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner.. Gift Set Contains: . HEART NOTES Delicate Floral Notes.. BASE NOTES Woody Notes, Sandalwood & Intense Vanilla.. A powerful woody scent with dry notes wrapped in vanilla.. Mancera invites you to wander through a haze of sweetness and spice with its Aoud Vanille eau de parfum. Delicate floral and rich woody accords combine with the enchanting notes of Nepalese Oud and intense vanilla for an unforgettable creamy aroma..

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Roses Greedy Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Roses Greedy Eau de Parfum . Roses Greedy is a sophisticated and sexy scent. Expertly blended fruity, floral, sweet and warm notes create an exceptional gourmand fragrance that has to be experienced. . HEAD NOTES Basket of Fruits: Mandarin, Peach, Coconut, Blackcurrant.. HEART NOTES Imposing French Rose, Jasmine, Aquatic flowers.. BASE NOTES Amber, Vanilla, White Musk & Tears of Benzoin.. Looking for a rose sophisticated enough for an adult but too sexy for the nursing home? Look no further than Roses Greedy. As its name suggests, the Roses Greedy eau de parfum boasts a sophisticated and alluring floral aroma. Mancera's perfumer Pierre Montale creates each spritz to transport you to new, unknown lands. Wear this potent elixir from day to night and bewitch those around you as its romantic scent wafts as you walk by. .

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Royal Vanilla Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Royal Vanilla Eau de Parfum . Royal vanilla envelops us with sensuality, sublimed by orange blossom, violet and rose. A fragrance that does not lack temperament . Head notes Citrus Fruits, Rose Water, Pink Rhubarb Leaves.. Heart notes Caramel, Rose Petals, Violet, Orange Blossom.. Base notes Amber, White Musk, Vanilla & Patchouli leaves.. Mancera looks to the Jazz Age as the inspiration behind its Royal Vanilla eau de parfum. As the name suggests, this scent celebrates vanilla in all its guises, enhancing it with notes of orange blossom, rhubarb and patchouli. To say it doesn’t lack temperament would be an understatement – in fact, this hedonistic blend is one to keep reserved for only the finest events in your social calendar. .

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Cherry Cherry Eau de Parfum 120ml
listings.description: Cherry Cherry Eau de Parfum . The cherry note, reimagined as a luxurious liqueur, delivers an addictive richness from the first spray, while the floral and musky undertones add layers of depth that evolve beautifully on the skin. This pronounced intensity makes it the perfect choice for anyone desiring a fragrance that not only allures but also leaves a strong, lasting impression. . Head notes Black Cherry, Bergamot & Lemon from Calabria.. Heart notes Orris & Lush Jasmine, Heliotrope Blossom, Earthy Patchouli.. Base notes White musk, Vanilla pods. . Cherry Cherry captures the essence of opulent black cherry with a bold, unisex twist. Elevated by fresh bergamot and lush floral notes of iris and jasmine, it settles into a sensual trail of white musk and vanilla, leaving behind a luxurious and unforgettable signature. .

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Juicy Flowers Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Juicy Flowers Eau de Parfum . Juicy, sweet and cheeky, Juicy Flowers reveals delicate fruity notes combined subtly with innocent rose, seductive jasmine and mystical sandalwood. . Head notes Juicy Pear, Red Fruits, Citrus Fruits, Pink Pepper.. Heart notes Precious Rose, Sweet Peach, Jasmine, Sandalwood.. Base notes Grey Amber, Black Vanilla Pods, Tasty Raspberry & Powdery White Musk. Founded by father and daughter duo, Pierre and Amélie Montale, Mancera creates fragrances inspired by journey and myth, drawing on ancestral knowledge passed down by master perfumers. The delicate scents of rose, Calabrian bergamot and Indian star jasmine combine with fruity notes of lemon, peach and raspberry in the ethereal Juicy Flowers eau de parfum. .

listings.rawTitle: Mancera Juicy Flowers Eau de Parfum 120ml
listings.description: Juicy Flowers Eau de Parfum . listings.rawTitle: Montale Intense Cafe Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Intense Café Eau de Parfum . Intense Café is an Oriental-vanilla fragrance that’s anything but ordinary. Indulge in a sensory dessert festival with the delicious aroma that wears well throughout the day and far into the night. . Montale's Intense Cafe opens with a perfect waft of fresh brewing coffee that will take your breath away. The flourish of coffee bean is paired with a fresh, vegetal rose. . The two combine for an unexpectedly dry and refreshing top note. As the coffee softens, a vanillic white musk emerges, slightly sweetening the brew with just a hint of cream and sugar. . Even in the final ambery drydown the coffee remains as a rich and nutty presence. This addictive and surprising gourmand is suitable for both men and women, and is the perfect fix for the coffee addict in all of us. . Top Notes: Floral. Middle Notes: Rose, Coffee Beans. Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla, White Musk. As the coffee softens, vanilla hints enveloped by white musk emerge, slightly sweetening the brew with just a hint of cream and sugar. .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Starry Nights Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Starry Nights Eau de Parfum. Shining like a star, the Bergamot from Calabria lights the way to a floral heart of Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Jasmine empowered by oriental notes of Patchouli from Sumatra, and leaves a warm silage of Sensual White Musk and Powdery Notes.. Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Apple Middle Notes: Patchouli, Rose, Jasmine Base Notes: Amber, White Musk. Bringing the sensual beauty of Arabian scents to the Western world, Montale presents Starry Nights. Shining like stars, hints of bergamot enlighten the way to a floral heart of Bulgarian rose. Infused with Egyptian jasmine, the scent is empowered by oriental notes of patchouli, leaving a warm silage of sensual powdery notes..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Infinity Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Infinity Eau de Parfum. For their 20th year, Montale is becoming your guest to this borderless country where the black Cherry will guide you through Vanilla and Amber aromas. Infinity stands as a compass, as a new reference for the whole community of signature scents lovers.. Discover a new character of the Montale family. The Pink Pepper comes to pick you up and introduces him to you... His measured eloquence contrasts with the brightness of this smiling summer styled scent.. Follow the purple wave of Plum and Black Cherry and wait a second for the White Flowers to find the way to your soul. This is when the soft Indian Rose gently balances the Leather and Black Oud in a semi-hypnotic pendulum where Sandalwood and Vanilla mingle without excess. You will fall for this rare ambered and deeply oriental feeling, where subtlety and mystery set themselves as character traits.. Top Notes: Black Cherry, Purple Plum, Peruvian Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Saffron Middle Notes: Black Aoud, Leather, Indian Rose, Solar Tuberose, Sandalwood, Vetiver Base notes: Vanilla sugar, Intense amber, Tobacco leaves, Tonka beans, Musks. Montale’s founder, Pierre Montale, used to create custom fragrances for the royal family in Saudi Arabia, but when he finally returned to Paris, he wanted to introduce the wondrous scents of the East to the Western world. The result is the Infinity eau de parfum, with notes of black cherry, vanilla and amber..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Black Aoud Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Black Aoud Eau de Parfum. A magnificent Cambodian Aoud blended with Indonesian Patchouli Leaves over a combination of Mandarin, Musk and Roses petals.. Black Aoud is a dramatic fragrance – but don't confuse that with overly strong. It's medium bodied and very rich, a bubbling potion of velvety rose and the old leather feel of labdanum, mixed with mystical oud tree oils. It's a rare journey somewhere where you've probably never been and will beg to return to… all it takes is a little whiff of this amazing, rare elixir. If you seek a deeply incensed rose and sandalwood fragrance, one that would have scented the brightly dyed pillows of a harem, you need look no further.. Top Notes: Oud Middle Notes: Patchouli Leaves, Mandarin Base Notes: Musk, Rose Petals . Montale’s Black Aoud is a rare journey to somewhere you have never been and cannot wait to return to. A fragrance for those seeking a deeply incensed rose and sandalwood perfume, it would have lent itself perfectly to an Eastern harem..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum . Chocolate Greedy unwraps into a fragrant symphony of warm, rich chocolate. . Chocolate Greedy is a mouthwatering ode to delectable creaminess, a luscious, rich ganache of incredible scrumptiousness. The middle stage has an attractive hint of powderiness that makes us think of the highest-quality Cocoa generously sprinkled on very expensive truffles with a subtle undertone of Bitter Orange. The Chocolate creaminess turns the drydown of Chocolate Greedy into an exquisitely, subtly gourmand skin scent, delicate, enveloping and very sensual.. A must have for chocoholics, which is to say, a must have for everybody!. Top Notes: Moka Bean, Bitter Orange . Middle Notes: Cacao Cream . Base notes: Vanilla pods. Lovers of gourmand fragrances will delight at the smell of the Chocolate Greedy eau de parfum from Montale. With each spray, you'll immerse yourself in a mouth-watering world of orange, cacao cream and vanilla – essentially, you'll be presented with the perfect opportunity to smell like your favourite pleasure: a rich, ganache-filled truffle. .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Sensual Instinct Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Sensual Instinct Eau de Parfum . A lush, warm and dense fragrance that combines vibrant notes of roasted coffee with the mysteries of the rose and creates a praline balance of mesmerizing sensuality. A seductive women's perfume. . Sensual Instinct invites you to let your primitive instinct take over . . This olfactory nugget is sublimated by precious amber notes and the subtlety of cedarwood and oakmoss. . An irresistible sillage, elegant and beastly obsessive. . Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Spices, Whisky Notes Middle Notes: Amber, Jasmine, Rose, Tiramisu, Leaves of Patchouli Base Notes: Cacao, Coffee, Vanilla, Oakmoss, Cedarwood . If you’ve ever wondered what sensuality smells like, introduce your fragrance wardrobe to Montale’s Sensual Instinct – an irresistible fragrance that’s bound to delight fragrance connoisseurs and explorers alike. Vibrant notes of roasted coffee are mingled with the mysteries of the rose, creating a balance of sensuality that’s set to captivate all the senses entirely. .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Oud Tobacco Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Oud Tobacco Eau de Parfum. Hypnotic and wonderfully savage, Oud Tobacco intrigues with its Tonka - Tobacco accord.. Citrus, Cumin and Red Sumac delight the senses, while Incense, Oud and Orange Blossom draw sophisticated narcotic volutes.. Top Notes: Sweet Sumac, Lemon, Black Pepper, Spicy Notes Middle Notes: Tobacco, Orange Blosso,, Patchouli Leaves Base Notes: Cambodian Oud, Amber, Sandalwood, Musk, Tonka. Drawing inspiration from Pierre Montale’s travels across Saudi Arabia, where he journeyed to curate a selection of perfumes to please the country's Royal Family, his eponymous label presents Oud Tobacco. An intriguing, subtly hypnotic profile, this eau de parfum seeks to delight the senses with its unique balance of fruity and woody notes..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Arabians Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Arabians Eau de Parfum. A powerful oriental scent inspired by the 'King of the Desert': The Arabic Horse.. Arabians is inspired by the majestic regal figure of the Arabian Horse; Get that same spice of the wild with top notes of Nutmeg and cardamom.. One to speak to the heart of connoisseurs of rare scents, Arabians Tonka echoes Pierre Montale’s time spent creating perfumes for the Saudi Royal family. Fiery and bold, it opens with a spicy blend of bergamot and saffron, to find its irresistible heart in a rich fusion of oud, amber, tonka beans and musk..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Dark Vanilla Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dark Vanilla Eau de Parfum;. Dark Vanilla will warm your heart thanks to its sensual notes of resinous Vanilla, Spices and Amber. Sandalwood, Leather and Oud Wood give it an intense oriental sillage, intimate and narcotic. A delightful fragrance for this winter that you will not get enough of.. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Saffron, Cumin, Cardamom, Italian Lemon, Coriander Middles Notes: Sandalwood, Black Leather, Cambodian Oud, Indonesian Patchouli Base Notes: Precious Vanilla Pods, Intense Amber, Powdery Musk. After creating a range of fragrances for Saudi Arabian royalty, Pierre Montale returned to Paris with the mission to introduce the West to the sensual scents of the East. Montale’s Dark Vanilla is just one of these exquisite aromas, with its sultry blend of vanilla and amber underpinned by sandalwood and oud, leaving an intense trail that warms you from summer right through to the coldest day of winter..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Wood & Spices Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Wood & Spices Eau de Parfum . A spicy woody scent that both men and women can wear. The opening of this fragrance is bold and beautiful. Velvety smooth that is cozy and comfortable to wear all year round. It is a blend of cardamom, agar wood, pimento, frankincense, sandalwood, vetiver and ebony wood. . Ebony, Sandalwood, Vetiver, this precious wood trio combined with Incense Notes, Cardamom and Spices brings us to the Indian borders . Top Notes: Cardamom, Spices. Heart Notes: Ebony, Incense. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver. . . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Vanille Absolu Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Vanille Absolu Eau de Parfum . The Vanilla reveals her definitely original nature with this Absolu: deep, authentic, dry, hot. Pure sensuality. . Smooth and sweet, Vanille Absolu is everything you could ever desire in an upscale Vanilla: swirly folds of boozy Vanilla are set off and enhanced by sweet Cherry and Plum Notes. A refined Vanilla without being snooty with a little touch of Caramel.. The must-have Vanilla of our collection.. Top Notes: Plum, Cherry. Heart Notes: Vanilla Pods, Caramel. Base Notes: Powdery Notes. Vanille Absolu is the product of master perfumer Pierre Montale’s travels to Saudi Arabia, where he ventured to create a range of fragrances to please their Royal Family. Bringing memories of the culture’s spicy yet soothing scents back to Paris, he created this eau de parfum which arouses subtle thrill with its combination of deep, dry notes alongside sensually creamy ones. .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Mukhallat Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Mukhallat is an Amber Vanilla perfume with sweet tones. This heady fragrance brings together scents that form a harmonious blend to seduce and captivate everyone around you.. The greedy perfume.. Top Notes: Wild Strawberries, Sweet Almonds. Heart Notes: Balsam from Peru, Vanilla Pods. Base Notes: White Musk. A sweet harmony of wild Strawberries and sweet Almonds combined with Balsam from Peru and Vanilla from Madagascar, subtly rounded by White Musk..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Crazy In Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Crazy In Love Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the wondrous Kingdom of Montale emotions, this fragrance opens itself to mystery and wonder with Wild Roses, Violet Leaves, Saffron and Intense Amber. Recalling the nostalgic goodness of brown sugar infused with the sensual warmth of a vanilla bean - that kind of "signature" scent that we love to create, will warm your soul. Rich with contrast, dreamlike in its serenity, Crazy in Love will brings you subtle energies and passion in your life. A Montale talisman full of luck.. Top Notes: Saffron, Rose Petals, Indian Cardamom, Lemon Middle Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Sandalwood, Violet Leaves Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla , Brown Sugar, Oakmoss , White Musk. Each of Montale’s scents tells a story of founder Pierre’s travels to Saudi Arabia, with the Crazy In Love eau de parfum telling one of romance and enchantment. In a pursuit to introduce the Western world to the captivating scents of the East, the brand fuses top notes of saffron, rose petals and cardamom with a heart of violet leaves and fresh accord and a rich, woody base for a transportive fragrance that has quickly become one of the Parisian perfumer’s signature scents. .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Rose Elixir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rose Elixir Eau de Parfum. A juicy fruity floral perfume with a playful personality. With irresistible fruit notes, this rose scent is simply delicious.. The magnetic Rose is the center of a composition of Citrus, Strawberry Leaves, Jasmine, Orange Blossom to hatch in Amber, Musk and Vanilla. A dancing fragrance for an intense feminine sillage.. Top notes: Rose, Citrus Fruits, Strawberry Leaves Heart notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom Base notes: Rich Amber, white musk, Vanilla pods.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Oud Dream Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Oud Dream Eau de Parfum. Oud Dream is a fragrance that is both bewitching and sensual. The combination of sweet honey, oud and rose wrap around the wearer enticing the senses with the honeyed, spiciness of the fragrance. A wonderfully exotic, spicy and honeyed fragrance. Gently sweet and slightly musky, Oud Dream is a sensual and bewitching fragrance.. The Rose, the Oud and the Patchouli leaves envelop, as in a dream, this new refined creation with a leathery sillage.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cardamom, Coriander, Black Pepper, Sweet Honey Middle Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Oud, Leaves of Patchouli Base Notes: Cedarwood, Leather, Amber Musk. Using the years of expertise its founder acquired when creating perfumes for the Royal family in Saudi Arabia, Montale is driven by a desire to introduce the enchanting scents of the East to the Western world. Oud Dream is like an exotic voyage contained in an elegant bottle; tempting you at first the notes of rich florals and spices, it cements its irresistible status with strong accords of oud, patchouli, musk and leather..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Dark Purple Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The seductive aroma of the Montale Dark Purple fragrance creates a timeless allure for wearers. Top notes of plum produce the sensual essence of the fragrance.. Floral and luscious notes on a dark, earthy and opulent base of Musk and Patchouli envelop a top notes of Plum and Voluptuous Roses.. A sensual, oriental and bewitching fragrance that will seduce audacious minds.. Top Notes: Plum Middle Notes: Sandalwood from Mysore, Black Leather, Cambodian Oud, Indonesian Patchouli Base Notes: Precious Vanilla Pods, Intense Amber, Powdery Musk . Using the years of expertise its founder acquired when creating perfumes for the Royal family in Saudi Arabia, Montale is driven by a desire to introduce the enchanting scents of the East to the Western world. Dark Purple confidently fuses plum and teakwood, enriching it with hints of rose, to later introduce a bold blend of musk and patchouli for a sillage that simply cannot be ignored..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Aoud Night Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Provides the mysterious power of Malaysian Oud accompanied by citruses and juicy fruit notes, with the opulence of Moroccan rose shades. The mysterious power of an Aoud from Malaysia reveals a precious heart of subtle Rose and Patchouli and leaves a very rich silage of Amber and Leather harmoniously intertwined with pleasing Guaiac Wood and Sandalwood from Mysore.. Top Notes: Oud, Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot Middle Notes: Moroccan Rose, Indonesian Patchouli Leaves Base Notes: Amber, White Musk, Leather, Gaia Wood, Sandalwood. Upon returning to Paris from Saudi Arabia, Pierre Montale decided to introduce the Western world to the wonderful scents of the East in the form of Aoud Night..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Blue Matcha Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Blue Matcha Eau de Parfum. Blue matcha is the summer obsession. Cedarwood, Leather and a captivating touch of Maté, mingle with Patchouli Leaves for more roundness and harmony around this astonishing ingredient: the Blue Matcha.. Rich and luminous, evocative of a journey to the heart of Indonesia, discover your new summer obsession. Cedarwood, Leather, Tobacco Leaves and a captivating touch of Maté, mingle with Patchouli Leaves for more roundness and harmony around this astonishing ingredient: the Blue Matcha. A touch of masculine and mysterious beauty that will not disappoint bold women.. Top Notes: Matcha Tea, Sicilian Mandarin, Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot, Blackcurrant Middle Notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Virginian Cedar, Leather, Tobacco Base Notes: African Maté Absolute, Grey Amber, Powdery Musks. When Pierre Montale returned to Paris from Saudi Arabia – where he’d been creating perfumes for the royal family – he decided to introduce the Western world to the wondrous scents of the East. Rich and luminous, the Blue Matcha eau de parfum is evocative of a journey to the heart of Indonesia, captivating with layers of maté, tobacco and amber alongside the powdery top notes of its namesake tea..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Oudmazing Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Oudmazing Eau de Parfum . An amazing Aoud from Malaysia, audaciously blended with Orange and Bergamot, sweetened by mouth-watering Pear and Fig, unveils a sensual combination of Iris, Jasmine and Patchouli, and warms the skin with rich Leather notes, Vanilla, Pink Grape and White Musk. . Top Notes Fig, Agarwood (Oud), Pear, Sicilian Orange and Sicilian Bergamot. Heart Notes Patchouli Leaf, Iris and Egyptian Jasmine. Base Notes Leather, Vanilla Pods, Pink Grapes and Guaiac Wood . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Montale Lucky Candy Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lucky Candy Eau de Parfum. Montale designed a modern but highly sentimental scent made to transmit the magic hidden in your fondest memories into your present life. Lucky Candy will turn an adult routine into a teenage adventure reborn, where youthful imagination will fill you with a carefree energy.. Wearing Lucky candy is like drawing a tarot card that continually unveils a delicious surprise. When the marshmallow pops up, you know you’re in for a treat .. your wheel of fortune has appeared. Bergamot and honey commence this sweet celebration, joined by a dollop of coconut cream.. Then enters frangipani flower, which raises this scent to another level of delectation. Follow this with a creamy caramel wave of amber and musk kissed by vanilla and sweet toffee. Say hello to your new lucky charm.. Top Notes: Roasted Mexican Cocoa Beans; Sicilian Bergamot Zest; Sweet Honey Middle Notes: Marshmallow; Neroli; Mexican Coconut Cream, Frangipani Flower Base notes: Vanilla pods; Sweet toffee; Dry amber; Fluffy musk. Pierre Montale started out in the Middle East, bringing olfactory immersion and his collection of ouds to Europe and beyond for the last 20 years. Today, the eponymous perfumer presents Lucky Candy, inspired by a surprising tarot card; with notes of marshmallow, bergamot, honey and florals, it’s a lucky fragrance with an oh-so-sweet heart..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Rendez-Vous A Paris Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rendez-Vous A Paris Eau de Parfum. A tribute to the eternal City of Love.. From the outset, sublime gourmand notes of pear and rhubarb.The floral and oriental heart reveals an opulence of rose petals and white flowers, and unveils the bold nature of Ginger. A hint of musk and vanilla prolongs the amber accents of this honey-like sillage.A sophisticated fragrance, a passionate embrace.. As the city of Paris awakens, your path leads you to the Grand Palais... The sun rises, the boulevards fade behind the Seine, guardian of the secrets of Paris. The water flows sensually under the Alexandre III bridge to the iron lady who pleads allegiance to the bewitching river.. Top Notes: Pear, Fresh Rhubarb Middle Notes: Rose Petals, White Flowers, Indonesian Patchouli, Hint Of Ginger Roots Base Notes: Powery Musks, Vanilla Sugar, Amber Gris.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Amber Musk Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Amber Musk Eau de Parfum. A mysterious and carnal fragrance that intertwines Musk and Ambergris in a dance of the senses.. Can you imagine a fragrance that doesn't overwhelm the entire body? Like a caress, Amber Musk arouses a thrill, an emotion.. Top Notes: Sweet Amber Middle Notes: White Musk, Powdery Note Base Notes: Grey Amber, Cedarwood. Amber Musk is the product of Pierre Montale’s travels to Saudi Arabia, where he ventured to create a range of fragrances to please their Royal Family. Bringing memories of the culture’s spicy yet soothing scents back to Paris, he created this eau de parfum which arouses subtle thrill as it opens with sweet amber, from where it descends into darker woody notes..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Pure Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Pure Love Eau de Parfum. This tantalizing perfume blends spicy, woody and aromatic accords for a rich and seductive aroma that's sure to make hearts beat faster.. Pure Love is a luminous fragrance tenderly woody, spicy and leathery. The powerful scent of Rose blends effortlessly with the sophisticated scent of Sandalwood and Vetiver, and everything softened by a subtle touch of Ambergris, Vanilla and Leather. An astonishing composition resonating with love and harmony.. "Each person’s life is like a mandala: a vast, limitless circle. We stand in the center of our own circle, and everything we see, hear and think forms the mandala of our life" -Pema Chodron. Top Notes: Lemon, Mandarin, Cardamom, Black Pepper Middle Notes: Sandalwood, Rose, Violet, Vetiver Base Notes: Amber Wood, Vanilla Pods, Tanned Leather, Powdery Musks. Bringing wonderful scents of the East to the Western world, Montale presents Pure Love. A surprising composition, this luminous fragrance tenderly bonds notes of rose and violet with aromatic hints of cardamom and black pepper for a bewitching and addictive tribute to love..

listings.rawTitle: Montale Oud Island Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Oud Island Eau de Parfum. Oud Island is an open space jealously wrapped in Amber, surrounded by an infinity of Labdanum and Vanilla. He designed a generous land bathed in Tiaré, a tuberic inner continent. Oud Island is not an island. It is your own personal island.. This Sparkling tide of Bergamot and Tangerine leads you on the shore... When you wake up from this Citrusy dream, it's time for you to raise your head to contemplate the heights of Nepalese Oud. Your first foot lands now on a ground of Black Leather.. Breathe... and enjoy those warm and solar top notes. No time to rest though, the wind brings you some waves of Tiaré and Sandalwood comes for you on a bed of Tuberose and dried Coconut chips.. When your attention arrives at its peak, warmed up by the Musk and the Labdanum, Oud Island unravels all its nobility thanks to the eternal Tobacco-Ambergris duo.. Top Notes: Sicilian Bergamot, Sparkling Tangerine, Italian Lemon Middle Notes: Nepalese Oud, Black Leather, Solar Tiara Flower, Indian Tuberose, Warm Sandalwood Base notes: Warm vanilla, Oriental labdanum, Sensual musks, Intense tobacco, Dry amber. Montale’s founder, Pierre Montale, used to create custom fragrances for the royal family in Saudi Arabia, but when he finally returned to Paris, he wanted to create a scent that encompassed the wonder and beauty of the region for the Western world. The result is the Oud Island eau de parfum, with notes of vanilla, amber and labdanum..

listings.rawTitle: BURBERRY Goddess Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess is a story of self-discovery found through confidence, strength and kindness. In this new chapter, Emma Mackey now radiates the power within, creating an intense magnetism that captivates those around her. . Inspired by the shades of a radiant sunset, Burberry Goddess Parfum is housed in a refillable bronzed square bottle. Its elegant light brown packaging with a gold label is inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric. . At the top of the fragrance, a vibrant raspberry accord complements the radiant lavender essence from Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts unveils its richness at the heart, while a suede leather accord brings more warmth, texture and sensuality to the gourmand vanilla base of this powerful scent..

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Precious. Bold. Extraordinary.. Embrace the new Perfect Marc Jacobs Absolute, a celebration of empowerment, positive affirmation and believing in yourself. Rooted in the universal belief that you are perfect as you are, this fragrance embodies the transformative power of self-affirmation. Make a precious and bold statement of self-love.. THE SCENT . Perfect Absolute features a caramelised fig accord, luscious blooming jasmine absolu blend and a rich amber accord. Make a precious and bold statement of self-love. This elevated fragrance radiates warmth and uninhibited confidence.. THE COLLECTION . A luxurious, concentrated take on our original Eau de Parfum, Perfect Absolute is a long-lasting, vegan fragrance that represents the most concentrated product of the Perfect Marc Jacobs lineup.. It’s Perfect, just like you.. HOW TO USE . Apply Perfect Marc Jacobs Absolute to the pulse points on your wrists, neck, chest and behind the ears. Avoid rubbing or dabbing skin after application, as this breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly..

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Success is not only about pursuing personal ambitions, but also about celebrating peers. From aspirational stardom to relatable fandom, discover how BOSSes get inspired and inspire others. BOSS recognise BOSS.. Bradley Cooper, Vinicius Junior, and Maluma embody this spirit of brotherhood as the three global ambassadors of BOSS Bottled Beyond. Spark admiration with BOSS Bottled Beyond, the first premium ginger-leather fragrance where opposites collide in a balanced interplay, delivering long-lasting intensity. The duality of this distinctive Eau de Parfum, echoed with the Double B monogram design, incites double the motivation, double the success. Bold. Balanced. Beyond. . In this powerful dual blend, the stimulating freshness of ginger extracted through cutting-edge technology meets the carnal sophistication of leather. Playing on a harmonious duality of spices, ginger diffuses the scent’s pure, vibrant profile, while leather exudes sensuality. To shape this new olfactory signature, master perfumers Daphné Bugey, Frank Voelkl, and Bruno Jovanovic have brought their personal best to the collaboration. The lines are blurred between niche craftsmanship and blockbuster allure, creating a balanced, enduring trail.. Reinventing an iconic design, the BOSS Bottled Beyond bottle stands out in black lacquered glass, complemented with a double-leather trim and a gunmetal-gray cap. A radiant gradient, from black to smoky gray, completes its masculine aesthetic. An engraved Double B monogram cements the fragrance’s duality.. How To Use . Spray BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him on the pulse points around the body to increase the performance of this long lasting masculine scent..
