listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Sulfur 10% Powder-to-Cream Concentrate 5g
listings.description: “The Ordinary's Sulfur 10% Powder-to-Cream Concentrate is a targeted blemish formulation that starts to help minimise the appearance of breakouts on application for visible results in under 1 hour." - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Targeted Blemish Treatment Is.... Finding the right product for blemishes can feel like a real chore, especially when you want something that works fast. That's exactly why The Ordinary Sulfur 10% Powder-to-Cream Concentrate is so brilliant. It's a quick and targeted solution for those pesky breakouts that seem to pop up out of nowhere. The most important thing here is just how quickly it gets to work, helping to minimise the look of blemishes and visible redness in under an hour. When you've got a spot you just want to vanish, that's the kind of speed that feels like a breath of fresh air.. . Why You’ll Love This Blemish Concentrate:. It's a fast-acting treatment for blemishes and breakouts.. Clinical tests show it reduces the look of breakouts and minimises visible redness by 50% in just one hour.. It helps absorb excess oil and reduce visible shine on contact.. The unique powder-to-cream texture makes it super easy to apply and blend discreetly into your skin.. . Product Claims:. This product promises to be a quick and effective way to deal with localised blemishes. The unique powder-to-cream texture is a total game-changer, giving you control over how much you use and making it easy to carry with you.. When you rub the powder into your skin, it transforms into a cream that blends in so you don't have to worry about a visible white spot on your face. It's formulated to get to work on contact, helping to make blemishes less noticeable and soaking up excess oil for a shine-free finish.. . Hero Ingredients:. The star of the show here is 10% Sulfur . You might have heard of it before in blemish treatments, but this one is a bit different because it uses what's called colloidal sulfur . This means the particles are smaller, which helps the ingredient get to where it needs to go more effectively while also keeping the natural sulphur smell to a minimum. Sulfur is great because it helps to soothe the look of blemishes, offering a gentler approach to targeting breakouts, especially if you have sensitive skin.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. This is a product unlike any other you've probably used. It starts as a fine, soft powder. The texture is really unique, and it feels like a really lightweight powder that almost disappears. As you rub it in, it transforms into a smooth, creamy consistency that blends seamlessly into your skin, leaving no trace behind. It doesn't have a strong, overwhelming smell, which is a big win for a sulphur product. It's a clean, simple product that feels discreet and easy to wear.. . The Best Way To Use It:. Using this product is really straightforward. Simply dispense a small amount of the powder onto a clean finger. Then, gently apply it directly onto your blemish and rub it into the skin. You don't need to rinse it off, which makes it perfect for a quick, targeted application. It's best to use this on clean, dry skin. The brand suggests new users start with just one application a day to see how your skin responds, and from there you can adjust as needed. It's not for use on broken skin, so it’s best to avoid any open or healing wounds.. . Why It’s Escentual:. We believe that effective skincare should be accessible to everyone, and The Ordinary embodies that perfectly. Their dedication to creating hardworking formulas with transparent ingredients has really changed the game. It's not just about a quick fix; it’s about providing you with a reliable tool to take control of your skin. You don't need a complicated routine to get real results.. . Sustainability:. The brand focuses on reducing waste and using recyclable packaging wherever possible. The bottle is made of glass, and the outer carton is recyclable, fitting in with our commitment to being mindful of our planet.. . Values:. The Ordinary is known for its transparent and honest approach to skincare, which really aligns with a dedication to customer trust.. It's formulated without parabens, sulphates, and mineral oil. The brand is also cruelty-free, and this product is vegan..

listings.description: “La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Suractivated Anti-Wrinkle Cream is a moisturiser that firms, smooths, and intensely hydrates your skin.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Anti-Wrinkle Cream Is.... This cream is all about giving your skin a youthful boost by focusing on three key areas: firming, smoothing, and plumping.. It’s an expert formula that works to correct signs of ageing while also repairing and strengthening your skin's natural barrier. It's especially brilliant because it’s suitable for all skin types, even sensitive and oily ones, so you can feel confident knowing it will work for you without causing irritation.. . Why You’ll Love This Plumping Cream:. It combines three forms of Hyaluronic Acid to plump and smooth the look of wrinkles.. It works to repair and strengthen your skin barrier, helping it feel more resilient.. The non-greasy texture feels comfortable on the skin.. It intensely hydrates, helping to protect against dehydration and lock in moisture.. . Product Claims:. This cream is a suractivated anti-wrinkle cream that is designed to firm, smooth, and replump your skin. The expert formula combines three forms of Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, and Ectoin to correct ageing signs, repair the skin barrier, and intensify hydration. It is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and oily ones.. . Hero Ingredients:. The star of the show is the combination of 3 forms of Hyaluronic Acid. A High-Weight HA works to protect the skin barrier and retain moisture. An Encapsulated HA is paired with Vitamin B5 to help repair the skin to help repair skin., while a Low HA is known for its ability to replump the skin and correct the look of wrinkles. Finally, a Stimulating Complex intensifies the natural production of Hyaluronic Acid in the epidermis and reduces its degradation.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. This cream has a lovely, non-greasy texture that feels rich yet comfortable on the skin. It absorbs beautifully, leaving your skin feeling soft and deeply hydrated without any heavy residue.. It has a minimalistic, fresh scent that's not overpowering. . The Best Way To Use It:. You can use this cream in the morning and/or evening. After cleansing, apply a pea-sized amount to your fingertips and gently massage it into your face and neck. It can be used alone or after a serum, depending on your routine. Always remember to follow up with SPF in the morning.. . Why It’s Escentual:. As a trusted beauty destination, we love that this cream brings together the expertise of a respected dermo-cosmetic brand like La Roche-Posay with highly effective ingredients. The way it combines three different forms of Hyaluronic Acid is a brilliant example of smart skincare science. It feels deeply nourishing and works wonders on all skin types, making it a reliable choice for anyone looking to improve the look of fine lines and dehydration. It’s the kind of moisturiser you reach for when your skin needs that extra boost of firming and plumping, and it never disappoints.. . Values:. This product is alcohol-free and paraben-free. It has also been dermatologist-tested..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: STRONGER WITH YOU AMBER is a deeper and warmer interpretation of the original STRONGER WITH YOU fragrance, inspired by the perpetual luminosity of the amber stone. The fragrance opens with lavender, which brings a freshness and luminosity to the scent. At the heart is an amber accord, conjured by balsamic notes and lends a warm, and sensual flamboyance to the fragrance. The bright radiance of warm spices heightened by the fresh citrus of mandarin essence, complement this amber accord. To make this amber accord richer, the vanilla bourbon premium infuses the scent with its balsamic and floral aspect. POWERFUL & SWEET AMBERY TOP NOTES: Fresh Lavender HEART NOTES: Rich and Sensual Amber Accord BASE NOTES: Warm and Sweet Vanilla STRONGER WITH YOU AMBER is captured in the distinctive EMPORIO ARMANI fragrance glass bottle, shaped with essential lines and curves. Crafted for this edition in a translucent ambery shade, the bottle conjures the ever-radiant amber stone. listings.description: HIGH REGENERATION AND HIGH NUTRITION DRAWN FROM THE ROOTS OF YOUTH. Orchidée Impériale The Rich Cream, now available as a refill, is exceptional complete care that helps. To regenerate ten vital layers of dry skin. To preserve, regenerate and prolong 12 signs of youth . A pioneer in the science of longevity through the orchid, Guerlain Research is for the first time combining the high regeneration of Orchid Totum technology with the high nutrition of the orchid oleo-concentrate to activate and extend skin’s longevity and increase its regeneration fivefold.. Skin is visibly younger. The Rich Cream’s mimetic lamellar texture fuses perfectly with skin for intense nutrition and a non-greasy finish. Its formula is made up of 96% naturally-derived ingredients.. The Rich Cream’s unique texture has a “millefeuille” structure that mimics the lamellar phases of the epidermis and is designed to amplify the diffusion of the orchid’s active ingredients through skin’s multiple vital layers up to 15-fold.. Jojoba ester and plant squalane, similar to the waxes that make up human sebum.. .

listings.rawTitle: Antipodes Ceramide Souffle Fresh Hydration Cream 60ml
listings.description: “Antipodes Ceramide Souffle Fresh Hydration Cream is a high-tech moisturiser that works to replenish the skin barrier and deliver lasting hydration.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Hydration Cream Is.... This is a wonderfully light, whipped moisturiser that’s all about strengthening your skin's natural barrier. It’s perfect for anyone dealing with dehydration or a compromised barrier, which can lead to fine lines and a dull complexion. By focusing on repair and deep hydration, this cream helps your skin feel more comfortable, bouncy, and resilient, giving you that soft, dewy glow you’ve been looking for.. . Why You’ll Love This Whipped Cream:. It gives you a soft, dewy finish, with 96% of people saying their "skin looked soft, fresh and hydrated".. It helps to strengthen your skin barrier and boost collagen production.. The light, whipped texture melts into your skin for an effortless feel.. It’s packed with potent ingredients that deliver long-lasting moisture and tackle the early signs of ageing.. . Product Claims:. This high-tech moisturiser is designed to replenish your skin barrier and provide enduring hydration. Next-generation plant-based ceramides help restore and strengthen your skin’s barrier, locking in long-lasting moisture. It's been scientifically shown to stimulate Type I collagen production in human fibroblast skin cells by up to 55%.. . Hero Ingredients:. This formula uses Ceramide III to strengthen your skin’s barrier and restore lost moisture. It also includes Sepilift™ DPHP , a peptide that helps to smooth fine lines and support collagen. Finally, a dose of Plant-based Hyaluronic Acid hydrates and plumps the skin, helping to protect against moisture loss.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. This moisturiser has a beautifully light, whipped-cream texture that feels incredibly fresh and airy. It melts into the skin easily, leaving a soft, dewy finish that never feels heavy or greasy. It has a fresh, floral marine fragrance that has been COSMOS-certified, making the experience even more delightful.. . The Best Way To Use It:. You can use this cream every morning and night. For best results, first apply a hydrating serum like the Maya Hyaluronic 72-Hour Hydration Serum to damp skin. Then, gently massage the Ceramide Souffle Fresh Hydration Cream into your face, neck, and décolletage using upward strokes. The upward motion not only helps with absorption but also gives your skin a little lift.. . Why It’s Escentual:. At Escentual, we appreciate brands that bring together natural ingredients with real science, and Antipodes is a prime example of this. They have a focus on in-vitro scientific investigations, which adds a layer of scientific excellence to their natural skincare products. The way this cream feels that light, airy souffle texture is just so lovely to use, and it makes you look forward to your skincare routine. It’s a wonderful product for anyone who wants a moisturiser that feels light but still works hard to support their skin's health.. . Sustainability:. This product is a testament to the brand's commitment to sustainability, coming in a glass jar with an aluminium lid. The outer packaging is FSC-approved cardboard, and it's printed with 100% eco-inks from vegetables. The tamper seal is also biodegradable.. . Values:. This moisturiser is certified vegetarian by VegSoc (the Vegetarian Society of the UK)..

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Absolu Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Like a haute couture dress, ELIE SAAB fragrances adorn a woman’s body with radiant sensuality. The ultimate expression of elegance and majestic femininity, ELIE SAAB Le Parfum Absolu reinterprets the iconic trail of Le Parfum with a rare intensity. An ambery floral that celebrates the light and complexity of its precious raw materials. Dazzling mandarin essence illuminates a sumptuous bouquet of white flowers in which the delicate olive flower accord offers a unique Mediterranean signature. It is interlaced with resplendent orange blossom and Madagascan ylang-ylang, which unfold into a luminous sensuality. The enveloping olive wood and solar amber accord extends the deep, unforgettable trail, making this creation even more elegant. The ELIE SAAB Le Parfum Absolu bottle is as precious as the fragrance itself, with an amber glow and resplendent facets that express the aura of a majestic femininity. Olfactory family: Amber Floral Top notes: Italian Mandarin Essence, Orange Blossom Accord, Organic Madagascan Ylang-Ylang Heart notes: Olive Flower Accord, Indian Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Tuberose Accord Base notes: Olive Wood Accord, Indonesian Patchouli Oil, Solar Amber Accord, Cedarwood Accord, Musk Accord .

listings.rawTitle: Dermalogica Active Clearing Breakout Biotic Moisturiser 50ml
listings.description: Daily gel targets and helps prevent breakouts. Lightweight moisturizer with a prebiotic blend hydrates and supports skin’s microbiome, helping aging skin look healthier, now and in the future.. Bioengineered Plankton Extract and Glycerin hydrate skin’s barrier, helping to defend against signs of premature aging and soothe skin. A prebiotic blend with Indian Mulberry, Glutamic Acid, and Agave-derived Inulin hydrates and helps balance skin’s microbiome. Salicylic Acid reduces breakouts by exfoliating away dead skin cells, helping to keep pores clear and prevent future breakouts. Niacinamide and Jojoba strengthen the skin barrier, helping to reduce the look of pores and post-blemish marks to brighten and smooth. Manuka and Magnolia extracts visibly reduce sebum for more balanced skin. .

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: See your world like never before with the Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum Spray, a fragrance for men steeped in masculine energy.. Between work and play lies Prada Luna Rossa Black, a seductive Eau de Parfum that’ll give you a brand new perspective. Inspired by urban exploration, the woody aroma echoes the possibilities and dangers of all situations with its intense composition that builds and crashes.. Luna Rossa Black opens with a bright flash of vivacious bergamot and magnetic angelica facets. In the heart sophistication lingers as patchouli and coumarin make their intentions of seduction clear, before an amber base makes for a moody signature.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Angelica. Heart Notes: Patchouli, Coumarin. Base Notes: Musk, Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino a Freddo Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A vibrant and bold fragrance, Acqua di Parma Gelsomino a Freddo is crafted from the ancient technique of cold enfleurage, a thorough and time-consuming process that gently captures the purest olfactive essence of jasmine. This Signatures of the Sun fragrance by Daphne Bugey is a sensory celebration of contrasts. The radiant white jasmine notes bring an air of lightness and purity, while smoky undertones of black tea and guaiac wood add depth and intrigue. The dynamics of light notes and irresistible honeyed nuances create a captivating tension, resulting in a bold composition. Time is the most precious ingredient in this new composition where the name ‘a Freddo’ reflects the rare craftsmanship of the method. Delicate jasmine flowers are layered onto purified shea butter multiple times under the supervision of a master perfumer, ensuring every nuance of the olfactive molecule is captured, preserving the flower’s natural complexity and richness in the resulting jasmine enfleurage essence. . Gelsomino a Freddo opens with a bright burst of Italian lemon, pink pepper, and artemesia notes, before revealing its heart of jasmine enfleurage and orris extract, and black tea essence. The base notes of gaiacwood, cypriol, and patchouli fraction essence anchor the fragrance with warm, woody facets, leaving a lasting impression of elegance and modernity. The new transparent Signatures of the Sun fragrance bottle showcases the coloured jus and features a redesigned label. It is presented in a new hatbox with updated colour and finish. .

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Be bold and dynamic with the BVLGARI Man In Black Eau de Parfum, an oriental warm-spicy fragrance for men. . With Bvlgari Man in Black, Bvlgari expresses the impetuous and mysterious character of fire, a transformative element symbolizing strength and energy. A magnetic fragrance with notes of rum, leather and vibrant spices that creates a daring and charismatic new statement of masculinity.. A sensual ambery eau de parfum inspired by raw power of fire..

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: The mythical power of fire captured in an intense and charismatic ambery woody signature for a very sophisticated and unique masculinity. Exuding a unique elegance, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum takes the original Eau de Parfum to a new level of density, richness and refinement, embodying a contemporary masculinity through its ambery woody signature.. With addictive and vibrant spicy top notes that smoothly morph into the lavish floralcy of tuberose and iris, before yielding to the intensity of dark wood accord, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a contrasted and textured composition. Crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, it is the richest and most concentrated fragrance in the Bvlgari Man collection as we know it now.. The all-black flacon delivers an intense interpretation of the Bvlgari Man in Black aesthetic codes. The dramatic and audacious use of the colour black visually recalls the higher concentration of the Parfum, differing from the more marked contrast between the black and rose gold of the Eau de Parfum..

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum Spray: . A bright, floral perfume that’s sophisticated and feminine.. It’s a more intense version of Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette.. It’s long-lasting, so you don’t need to keep topping up.. Master Perfumer, Alberto Morillas created it.. . . What Bvlgari Say: . A more precious and intense interpretation of Bulgari’s most iconic feminine fragrance. Crafted around the same signature accords of Nashi Pear and Lotus as the Eau de Toilette, Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum pushes the boundaries of creativity and olfactive craftsmanship with a new composition signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. The Eau de Parfum exalts the beauty of the original vision with three new vibrant gems of nature: Green Mandarin essence, Jasmine absolute and Sandalwood essence.. To express new levels of radiant confidence and add a rich florality to the heart of the Eau de Parfum, Alberto Morillas has selected Jasmine. And not just any Jasmine: for the first time in its fragrances’ creation, Bulgari introduces the Jasmine harvested from the “Flower Gems of India” program. The initiative leverages permaculture principles to create a new sustainable jasmine farming model and is a living example of Bulgari's long-term commitment to the highest standards of ethics in sourcing and production.. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, Omnia's iconic flacon's curves are warmed up by subtle pink nuances, elegantly playing with light and rose gold reflections.. Fragrance family is floral woody. . Top note is pear. . Heart note is jasmine. . Base note is sandalwood. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum is a more intense version of the original. Fans of the first will recognise it; it has the same accords alongside new additions that improve the perfume’s longevity (we could smell it 6+ hours after application). The Eau de Parfum is clean and sharp; it’s a soft floral scent that’s elegant and pretty.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. How To Refill: . Remove the bottle cap, then unscrew the fragrance pump, and screw the refill onto the bottle’s neck. The refill will stop automatically once the perfume bottle is filled. Unscrew the refill, screw the fragrance pump back onto the bottle and replace the cap..

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Rediscover Omnia Crystalline in a new shape, with its inimitable original scent untouched.. Like a frame of light, the iconic fascination of OMNIA is now characterised by a new, more precious flacon design. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas.. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musk.. Bottle Design Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon.. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold coloured frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweller to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections.. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.. Notes . Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a duo bathed in light. The crispness of nashi pear accord is enhanced by the freshness of a bamboo accord.. Heart Notes: A delicate alliance transports the heart of the fragrance towards floral and resolutely feminine tones. The aquatic transparency of lotus accord is tinged with the purity of a white peony note.. Base Notes: At dry-down, the warm balsa wood accord reveals a tender woody trail combined with the soft sensuality of a crystal musks accord. .

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Pour Femme Absolu Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Pour Femme Absolu is the embodiment of femininity in its purest form—delicate, sensual and sweet. An Ambery, Fruity, Floral fragrance opening with the bright zest of Italian mandarin, juicy pear, and a hint of pink pepper. At its heart, radiant Damask rose, amplified by Rosyfolia, blooms over grounding vetiver. The base lingers with sensual Madagascan vanilla, addictive tonka bean, and warm benzoin for lasting depth. It’s more than a fragrance - it’s a statement of style and confidence. The dramatic, distinctive bottle is inspired by a chain that is a powerful fashion symbol, evoking both uptown polish and downtown edge, opulence and refinement, connection and individuality. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria FloraBloom Eau de Parfum Spray 125ml
listings.description: THE SENSUALITY OF A BEWITCHING BOUQUET Florabloom Absolu is an enchanting floral bouquet by moonlight. Tuberose becomes more sensual and hypnotic, accompanied by an enigmatic Four O’Clock Flower accord. The warm depth of sandalwood and the woody refinement of patchouli beautifully enhance this powerful and addictive composition, inspired by the fascinating spectacle of desert superblooms at nightfall.. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria FloraBloom Hand Cream 50ml
listings.description: A HAND RITUAL BETWEEN SKINCARE AND FRAGRANCE Enriched with beeswax butter and composed of more than 97% natural-origin ingredients*, Florabloom hand cream gently hydrates and nourishes hands. Its lightweight formula melts into skin without greasy effect. It leaves hands supple, soft and subtly scented with Florabloom’s fruity floral notes.. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Aqua Allegoria hand creams are composed of more than 97% natural-origin ingredients. Inspired by the hexagonal shape of a honeycomb, Aqua Allegoria hand creams fall within Guerlain’s sustainable development approach. Their single-material bottle is mostly recyclable and entirely made in France like the rest of the fragrances in the collection. A highly desirable, travel-friendly object available in several irresistible shades..

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Le Rouge Velvet Matte Lipstick 2.3g / 01 - Nude Mousseline
listings.description: Introducing Givenchy Le Rouge Velvet Matte Lipstick : a formula that achieves for the first time a 24H plumping effect** in a natural blurring matte finish. Le Rouge Velvet Matte combines long lasting high coverage with 6H hydration*. Upon the first application, lips appear plumped, smoothed & fuller. A natural matte lipstick available in a wide range of 17 wearable nude shades, so you can find your perfect shade to provide an instant healthy glow effect. • Benefits: Long lasting, plumping effect, hydrating • Finish: Natural Blurring Matte • Ingredient Preferences: hyaluronic acid and shea butter complex • Coverage: High A New Couture Icon Le Rouge Velvet Matte celebrates couture legacy with its new sleek and edgy silhouette. Embossed with the Givenchy 4G emblem, the bullet’s slim shape allows for ultra-precise application. A timeless jewel-like 4G logo adorns the pack as the centrepiece underlining an elegant design. . Visibly Perfected Lips 24-hour plumping effect** 12-hour smoothing effect** . A No-Compromise Natural Matte Finish 12-hour wear2** 24-hour even colour** 24-hour no feathering** . Instantly Protected Lips 6-hour moisturising effect* 50% increase in hydration upon application* 6-hour comfort* . *Instrumental test on 33 women **Clinical test on 25 women ***Self assessment on 25 women. . Tips & Application Starting at the centre of the lips, apply the ultra-precise bullet of Le Rouge Velvet Matte to the corners of the mouth, beginning with the upper lip and continuing with the lower lip. Pair Le Rouge Velvet Matte with Le Rouge Baume for even more care. 1. Apply Le Rouge Baume and let the 24-hour hydration*, from 96% natural origin** ingredients, penetrate the lips. 2. Remove any excess before applying Le Rouge Velvet Matte for a blurry matte couture finish. *Instrumental test on 10 subjects ** Based on ISO 16128 norm. Including water. The remaining 4% contributes to the sensorial texture of the formula and its integrity. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Givenchy introduces L'Interdit Parfum, a sensual and sophisticated fragrance with notes of iconic white flower, mimosa absolute, and precious balms. The New Thrill of L’Interdit L’Interdit Parfum unveils a sensual floral woody and balmy scent. Infused with the smoothness of Bitter Almond Essence, the iconic white bouquet of L’Interdit, composed of Orange Blossom, Tuberose, and Jasmine, then blends with the floral and velvety notes of Mimosa Absolute. The signature blend of Vetiver and Patchouli unveils the most elegant and captivating balmy trail. A Precious & Radiant Bottle L’Interdit dares to reinvent its iconic bottle playing with the contrast between deep black, subtle golden details, and light reflections. More than just a bottle, L’Interdit Parfum becomes a true object of desire. The Shiver of L’Interdit Givenchy invites you beyond the Forbidden. More sophisticated, more precious, more opulent than ever, L’Interdit has never been so coveted. Olfactory Notes L'Interdit Parfum reveals a precious composition where the iconic white bouquet of L'Interdit, composed of Orange Blossom, Tuberose, and Jasmine, blends with the floral and velvety notes of Mimosa Absolute. A fragrance destined for lovers of opulent fragrances, seeking a distinctive imprint. Top Notes: Bitter Almond Essence Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Tuberose, Jasmine, Mimosa Absolute Base Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Myrrh Absolute, Opoponax, Benzoin. .

listings.rawTitle: Sachajuan Clarifying Scalp Scrub 220ml
listings.description: This gentle, sugar based scalp scrub is ideal for reducing dandruff, removing product build up, balancing oil and calming itchy and irritated scalps. . Using a deep cleansing blend of climbazole, soy bean and shea butter oil, along with lightly exfoliating natural sucrose, it instantly helps to buff away dead skin cells that can cause dandruff, detoxify and remove product build up, whilst re-balancing sensitive and oily scalps. Designed to be used weekly, it combines shea butter and soybean oils which are natural emollients, helping to retain moisture, soothe itchiness and re-hydrate. Perfects as a weekly scalp detox, or post-colour treatment, it unclogs hair follicles, promotes new cell growth and reduces the tingling sensation on the scalp that can often occur after colouring. . Key Benefits . Ideal for oily and sensitive scalps. Reduces dandruff and itchiness. Re-balances and removes product build up . Perfect as a post-colour treatment. Infused with naturally exfoliating sucrose . Contains calming shea butter and soybean oils. How to use Sachajuan Scalp Scrub. Apply to wet hair . Massage a small amount in circular motions to exfoliate the scalp. Rinse thoroughly. Follow with shampoo and condition if desired. Ideal for use once a week.

listings.rawTitle: Sachajuan Clarifying Conditioner 250ml
listings.description: Elevate your hair routine with our clarifying conditioner, designed to nourish and detangle without adding extra weight. This lightweight formula rinses away lingering impurities and buildup while restoring essential hydration, leaving hair soft, smooth, and effortlessly manageable. Crafted without harsh additives, it’s gentle enough for all hair types, including colour-treated and sensitive scalps.. Perfect for pairing with our clarifying shampoo, this conditioner brings out your hair’s natural vibrancy and leaves it feeling refreshed, bouncy, and full of life with every use..

listings.rawTitle: Sachajuan Clarifying Shampoo 250ml
listings.description: Unleash the power of a true fresh start with our sulphate-free clarifying shampoo, featuring a groundbreaking formula that detoxifies your hair. This potent yet gentle cleanser dives deep to eliminate impurities, excess oils, and stubborn product buildup, instantly revitalising your locks without disrupting natural moisture. . Packed with carefully selected ingredients and free from harsh chemicals, it leaves your hair weightless, invigorated, and visibly full of life. Perfect for every hair type even colour-treated and sensitive scalps, this clarifying shampoo offers an essential, high-performance reset, restoring your hair’s ultimate vibrancy, health, and bounce with every use..

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Dia Woman Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Mirages of Aldehydes.. The transparency of Cyclamen rubs up against the freshness of Bergamot and the metallic zing of Sage, fusing their impetuous aldehydes to brighten a bouquet where the fruity and sophisticated greenness of Violet Leaf is expressed alongside that of a sweet and fresh Fig. The heart then overflows with a dewy and lemony Rose Essence verticalized by the soothing scent of freshly cut Peony. On a bed of porcelain-Iris, Wild Peach reveals its acidulous and powdery sensuality, rounded by Tarragon and warmed by the pastel-honey hues of Orange Blossom Absolute. The dazzling floral greenness fades away under an unexpected cloud of Vanilla, Heliotrope and soapy White Musks, whose purity, prolonged by a mildly almondy Sandalwood, leads to a smoky dry down of Guaiacwood, Cedarwood and Frankincense.. A vibrant and sophisticated nod to vintage aldehydic florals, Dia Woman is a testament to a mystifying sense of femininity.. Floral | Aldehyde . Perfumer: Jean-Claude Ellena . Top Notes: Fig, Cyclamen, Bergamot, Tarragon, Sage, Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Bush Peach Blossom, Rose Oil, Orange Flower, Peony, Orris. Base Notes: White Musk, Frankincense, Vanilla, Heliotrope, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Gaiac Wood..

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Cyprus Shell Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance, softly floral yet touched by unexpected salty facets, where femininity rises from the embrace of the sea, as Venice itself emerges from the waters.. The iconic grace of rose and powdery touch of iris intertwine with the whispers of waves reflecting a romantic and mystical allure.. Top notes : Salty Accord, Mandarin Integral, Pear. Heart notes: Rose Absolute, Orris Germanica Resinoid, Incense Somalia Opur. Base notes : Patchouli, Oakmoss, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Quelques Fleurs l'Original Shower Gel 250ml
listings.description: Experience the timeless elegance of Quelques Fleurs L’Original shower gel, a refined invitation to luxury and delicacy. . This gentle formula softly cleanses your skin while enveloping it in a subtly floral, iconic fragrance. In contact with water, it transforms into a light, fragrant lather, turning each shower into a serene moment of sensory pleasure. . After rinsing, your skin feels soft, hydrated, and supple, delicately perfumed with this legendary scent. . The enchanting, radiant essence bombards the olfactory senses with soft, voluptuous flowers arranged in immaculately-nuanced, concordant tonalities. . Sensual and charming, its heart speaks of pure emotion, underpinned by Jasmine, Tuberose, Lily of the Valley, Violet, Rose, Ylang Ylang, Carnation, Broom Flower, Orange Blossom and Clove. . Its vivacious, alluring head of Bergamot, Galbanum, Tarragon, Lemon dries-down to a cultivated base of Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Civet, Cedarwood, Musk, Orris, and Tonka Bean. . To prolong the delicate floral trail of your perfume, discover the complete Quelques Fleurs L’Original collection, including the Eau de Parfum, Extrait de Parfum, Body Cream and Body Lotion. Let the legendary fragrance of Quelques Fleurs envelop you in an aura of grace and refinement, celebrating over a century of perfumery excellence. . Top Notes . Bergamont, Galbanum, Tarragon, Lemon . Heart Notes . Jasmine, Tuberose, Lily of the VValley, Violet, Rose, Ylang Ylang, Carnation, Broom Flower, Orange Blossom, Clove. . Base Notes . Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Civet, Cedarwood, Musk, Orris, Tonka Bean. . Directions for use . Apply a small amount of gel to damp skin or between your hands. Gently lather to reveal its airy texture and unmistakable floral signature. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. . Ideal for daily use, this shower gel refreshes the skin and enhances the lasting trail of Quelques Fleurs L’Original. .

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Quelques Fleurs l'Original Body Lotion 250ml
listings.description: Houbigant Paris introduces a new bath and body line, featuring body lotion and shower gel available in three of its most beloved fragrances: Quelques Fleurs l'Original, Quelques Fleurs Royale, and Mon Boudoir. Quelques Fleurs l'Original - Bergamot, Lemon, Jasmine, Tuberose, Rose, Ylang Ylang, Sandalwood and Musk . Apply generously to your skin and massage gently. Its light, silky texture absorbs quickly, offering immediate hydration and enduring comfort. With each use, immerse yourself in the legendary 1912 composition, a masterful harmony of over 15,000 flowers and 250 rare, hand-selected ingredients.. A true tribute to the refined art of French perfumery, Quelques Fleurs L’Original transforms your skincare into a ritual of sophistication and grace..

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The new feminine fragrance by Miu Miu - a duo of wild strawberry accord with vanilla & brown sugar twists an iconic warm floral signature with a hint of gourmand. Unconstrained and unconventionally feminine, Miutine Eau de Parfum reaffirms the essence of Miu Miu with a bold, memorable scent for those who navigate life on their own terms. • Top Note: Wild Strawberry accord • Heart Note: Gardenia accord • Base Note: Brown Sugar accord, Vanilla, Patchouli oil Youthful and unconstrained, Miutine offers a Miu Miu twist on an iconic fragrance family: the warm floral. Inspired by Miuccia Prada’s unconventional aesthetic, master perfumer Dominique Ropion teases the vintage genre into an effortlessly cool floral with a gourmand twist that subverts expectations. “I started from a classic and I twisted it with a surprising resonance, a harmony of mischievous freshness and opulent sensuality.” - Dominique Ropion, master perfumer of Miutine Miutine Eau de Parfum is the signature Miu Miu fragrance for those who are confident in their contradictions. Featuring juicy wild strawberry to express the Miu Miu girl’s spontaneous and unyielding spirit. A radiant, milky gardenia accord to embody her effortless charm. A sweetly provocative blend of chic patchouli oil, brown sugar accord, and vanilla for her unconventional femininity. Cheeky but sophisticated. Youthful yet assertive. Irreverent and carefree. Twisted into a modern icon for Miutine, Miu Miu’s signature retro-modern bottle becomes more covetable than ever. Irreverent and sophisticated, with the famous matelassé glass inspired by the luxury house’s iconic leather handbags. Instantly desirable, with the Miu Miu tag as a ring around the collar. Bold and playful, with its round black cap in the shape of a sequin. The unexpected modern brown tint of the transparent glass expresses a different, ultra-contemporary type of femininity, with a touch of boyish. Youthful as ever. But all grown up. .

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L'Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The first feminine fragrance by Miu Miu, the floral green musky L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum opens the door to the house’s contrasted femininity. Effortless and sophisticated, the transparent yet vivid accords capture the bloom of youthful springtime energy. Miu Miu’s energizing twist on lily of the valley, gone rogue with earthy peppery Akigalawood. Spring has never smelled so cool. • Top Note: Lily of the valley accord • Heart Note: Damask Rose • Base Note: Akigalawood Joyfully floral. Musky and clean. Freshened by a touch of green. L’Eau de Muguet’s youthful energy stems from the most fragrant flower of spring. A dewy, transparent lily of the valley accord, elevated by the vivid twist of verdant notes. Earthy, peppery Akigalawood, a unique material derived from patchouli, adds a vibrant contemporary edge to the blend. Channeling Miu Miu’s irreverent codes, L’Eau de Muguet’s bottle conjures the texture of the luxury house’s iconic matelassé leather handbags. The brand’s signature azzurro blue tints the opaque glass, in a vibrant contrast with the translucent ruby red of the sequin-shaped stopper, and the collar’s black and white Miu Miu tag ring. .

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L'Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A floral green feminine fragrance by Miu Miu, L’Eau Bleue is a sweet whisper on a cloudy day, blowing away the grey, to reveal the sky’s azure radiance. Fresh and limpid. Spring’s light and delicate grace awakens. Dotted with dew drops, the tiny white bells of lily of the valley bloom, edged in velvety leaves. listings.rawTitle: Atelier Des Ors Blue Madeleine Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Blue Madeleine pays tribute to the souvenir of shared moments between Jean Philippe and his grandmother Madeleine. . ‘ My dear Madeleine…you forged and filled my imagination. I now have, thanks to you, my great theatre of memories. . You are in all my happy memories. I owe my first olfactory memories to you: rhubarb tart, Auton pear jam, egg cream and all the other desserts I've patiently prepared alongside you’. . Like a souvenir of a gourmand madeleine, spiced up with smoky tea notes and a drop of spices.. In every Atelier Des Ors fragrances, we find 24K gold flakes in the bottle, to offer the promise of a unique experience and eternal elegance.. And on every bottle, their signature : the embossed rays symbolizing the radiance of the sun and the silage of the fragrance. A homage to the fine crystal cutting techniques once used in the Haute Perfumeries during the Art Deco period.. . Fragrance Notes . Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Cinnamon Heart: Rose Centifolia «infusion pays», Black Tea, Milky Note Base: Cade, Peruvian Balsam, Praline, Sandalwood. Jean-Philippe Clermont, Founder: . “With our move to Grasse in the Villa Primerose, a magnificent house from 1886, I decided to dive back into my memories and into the memories of this witness of the Grasse perfumery. . I wanted to pay tribute to the emotional power of perfume, its tremendous ability to trigger past memories and also to forge future ones .” . Marie Salamagne's Perfumed Note: . " The olfactory expression of a souvenir during an afternoon tea at the villa, blending madeleine and black tea." . A TRIBUTE TO THE EMOTIONAL POWER OF THE OLFACTIVE MEMORY . "My dear Madeleine, many times have I heard these stories, and never once have we tired of them. You forged and filled my imagination. Your tales of the tribulations and wild imaginings of the different members of our family are so close to my heart that they seem like a dream to me.. I now have, thanks to you, my great theatre of memories, in which fantastic fables worthy of Jules Verne endlessly re-enact. You have surrounded me with all your attentions and are in all my happy memories. I owe my first olfactory memories to you : rhubarb tart, Auton pear jam, egg cream and all the other desserts I've patiently prepared alongside you.. This Blue Madeleine fragrance is for you.". . .

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: What if there’s another way?. Paradigme, the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. A fragrance that transcends traditional preconceptions by asking – what if there’s another way?. A question as an invitation to experiment and open new perspectives. Confidence is redefined as curiosity, strength as finesse, and success as the freedom to create your paradigm.. Another way to name a fragrance Paradigme : [pa-ruh-dym] noun. A new perspective. A new way of thinking, doing, being. An augmented anagram of Prada creating a direct connection with our feminine icon: Paradoxe. . Another way to compose a fragrance Paradigme Eau de Parfum rethinks the traditional way to create a fragrance. Our master perfumers Marie Salamagne, Bruno Jovanovic, and Nicolas Bonneville decided to open a new olfactive paradigm by inverting the traditional fragrance composition architecture, tracing from the bottom up in a reversed pyramid; a symbolic echo of the iconic Prada triangle itself. . The result is an avant-garde yet highly sophisticated Ambery Woody signature oscillating between enveloping warmth and exhilarating freshness.. Opening on the warm sensuality of ambery woods composed of Peru Balm and Benzoin resin and vigorous Guaiac wood.. At the heart, an iconic green Bourbon Geranium this time reinvented with floral rosy facets unfolding on a fusing Calabrian Bergamot Heart and airy musks uplifting the entire composition.. « The obsession for this composition was audacity, the audacity to challenge classicism propose a new model, more sensual and magnetic ». The Paradigme bottle immediately invites curiosity.. An architectural silhouette of radical elegance softened by rounded edges and an avant-garde statement through the tactile tilted Prada triangle, the house’s iconic signature.. A bottle lacquered in an intense and alluring black to green gradation, the house’s iconic colour. . The outer box is etched to echo the brand’s signature Saffiano leather cross-hatching, signed with a silver Prada logo.. When conceiving the Paradigme bottle, we drew upon the Prada fragrance archives, then looked for ways to reimagine the design through a contemporary lens. The green colour feels unexpected; the bevelled edge of the inverted triangle emerges as a tactile and surprising detail. In this way, it is characteristically Prada, being both undeniably sophisticated, but with a touch of eccentricity.” Coralie Salem, Creative Director, Prada Beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum Sensuelle 30ml
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude by Lancôme is a floral musky gourmand feminine fragrance that combines glazed vanilla and solar jasmine with an enveloping base of creamy, white musk and sandalwood. A powerful skin scent that elevates your natural essence and lasts all-day long with an exceptional, up to 5-hour intensity.*. THE SCENT: LANCOME'S FIRST MUSKY VANILLA Crafted by two of the most renowned French perfumers - Dominique Ropion and Anne Flipo - this floral, musky gourmand fragrance fuses the radiance of solar jasmine from Lancôme's Le Domaine de la Rose in Grasse, France with the sweetness of glazed Bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, culminating in an overdose of creamy white musks and sandalwood that melt into your skin. Inspired by the feeling of biting into a delicious French patisserie, this fragrance prolongs happiness with every note and reveals your most genuine essence, wrapped in a jewel-like bottle that's pure desire.. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Orange Essence, Pink Pepper Heart Notes: Jasmine, Iris, Fluffy Coconut Accord Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musk, Sandalwood. A SKIN SCENT: HAPPINESS BECOMES YOUR SECOND SKIN La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude is more than a perfume. It is a powerful skin scent that becomes one with you to reveal your most enticing self and elevate your natural essence with striking intimacy, lasting all-day long* on your skin with an exceptional, up to 5-hour intensity* to carry you from day to night. The last ingredient is you.. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT - A long-lasting, eau de parfum with audacious, enveloping sensuality, crafted by world-class French perfumers. - Lancome's first musky vanilla that creates an intimate connection between fragrance and skin. - A powerful skin scent that becomes one with you to reveal your most irresistible self. - Designed to empower you to feel confident as you surrender to a moment of happiness.. THE BOTTLE: AN IRRESISTIBLE, IRIDECENT SMILE Draped in a precious, opal pink lacquer, this jewel-like bottle captures the feeling of being dressed only in self-love. Crafted in the iconic La vie est belle silhouette, a fusion of sensual curves and sharp lines, the bottle is set with the signature La Vie Est Belle crystal smile, symbolising the fragrance’s celebration of happiness, while the pale pink and silver toned wings represent a nod to the to the nude gourmand effect of this skin-caressing fragrance. *Self-assessment test, 69 women.. HOW TO APPLY Spray La vie est belle Vanille Nude onto your bare skin, focusing on the sensual areas of your body: the inside of your wrists and along your neckline..

listings.description: “GUERLAIN’s Abeille Royale Bee Lab Shot is an intensive, 7-day treatment that provides a much-needed repair for dull, lacklustre skin.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Vitamin C Treatment Is.... The most important thing about GUERLAIN’s Abeille Royale Bee Lab Shot is that it’s an intensive, week-long treatment that works to repair skin and correct the signs of ageing. It’s like a powerful shot of goodness for your skin, bringing it back to life and leaving it feeling stronger and more resilient.. . Why You’ll Love This Intensive Shot:. It’s an ideal treatment for periods of fatigue or intense stress, when your skin needs a boost.. It works fast, leaving your skin looking visibly fresher and brighter, with wrinkles filled in from the very first dose.. Clinical testing on 104 women showed that after just seven days, their skin was visibly transformed, intensely plumped, and deep wrinkles were corrected.. The unique format makes it feel like a real luxurious experience, with the spheres melting into the serum to create a fresh, powerful formula.. . Product Claims:. This product promises to be a 7-day intensive treatment that delivers immediate and lasting results. It’s formulated to repair skin that’s looking a little stressed and to correct the signs of ageing, such as dullness and fine lines. The clever format is made up of crystallised spheres that contain 98% age-defying ingredients. When you blend these with the brand’s iconic Youth Watery Oil Serum, they create a fresh and potent formula that gets straight to work on making your skin look refreshed, radiant, and plumped.. . Hero Ingredients:. The star of the show here is the unprecedented concentration of Black Bee honey from Trøgstad . GUERLAIN research has specifically chosen this honey because of its purity and potency. It’s also enriched with a high concentration of Vitamin Cg . This is a powerful antioxidant that helps to protect the skin from environmental stressors while also brightening the complexion and promoting a more even skin tone. Together, these two ingredients create a powerful and effective formula that helps your skin look and feel more youthful and resilient.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. This treatment feels incredibly luxurious from the moment you start. The crystallised spheres feel unique and exciting, and they melt effortlessly into a silky, fresh liquid when mixed with the Youth Watery Oil Serum.. The texture is lightweight and absorbs into the skin beautifully, without any sticky or greasy residue. As with the entire Abeille Royale line, it has a signature, subtle honey scent that’s delicate and uplifting, making each application a real pleasure.. . The Best Way To Use It:. Because this is a seven-day intensive treatment, it’s designed to be used as a targeted shot in your routine.. The best way to use it is to take one of the little balls in the palm of a clean hand, and melt it together with 10 drops of the Youth Watery Oil Serum. Then, apply this mixture immediately to your cleansed face and neck, either morning or evening. Just remember not to use it on its own - you must mix it with the serum. This is a brilliant treatment to use when you’re preparing for a big event, or simply when your skin feels like it needs a major boost after a period of stress or travel. . Why It’s Escentual:. Here at Escentual, we’re proud to offer products that combine scientific innovation with a truly beautiful user experience. The Bee Lab Shot embodies that by offering a powerful, fast-acting solution for a common skincare complaint. It’s the kind of product you turn to when you want to see a noticeable difference, and it delivers on that promise beautifully. The feeling of those spheres melting and releasing their potent ingredients is a moment of pure indulgence that makes taking care of your skin feel like a treat, not a chore.. . Sustainability:. Formulated with 100% naturally-derived ingredients, GUERLAIN’s commitment to preserving nature is at the heart of their Abeille Royale line. The Black Bee honey is sourced from an exclusive, responsible channel, reflecting the brand's efforts to protect and sustain bee populations.. . Values:. Made with 100% naturally-derived ingredients, this product aligns with the brand’s focus on natural, potent formulations.. This product is free from parabens and sulphates.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Tubereuse Noire Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Disrupt your senses with Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: When touched by salt, nature is enhanced. Emotions are strengthened, experiences are amplified. The senses are ignited as salt brings flavour to life, with even more intensity. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this new woody marine dry amber fragrance reveals sea freshness with warm land vibrancy. . Evoking the sea, a salty polarity combines a vivid salt accord with natural origin marine seaweed and natural origin oakmoss. . Evoking the land, the earth polarity is infused with the sensual notes of natural origin incense and natural origin amber notes. Upcycled cedarwood enhances the enveloping warmth. A long-lasting fragrance combining the intensity of salt with a masculine elegance. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is made with 94% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin French alcohol, and is vegan-certified. A refillable perfume bottle with an intensified design . Designer Tokujin Yoshioka has intensified the pure and sharp aesthetic of the Le Sel bottle with amplified masculinity. The 20% recycled glass is warmed with a smoky grey gradient lacquer, and the cap is revisited in a deep gunmetal shade. The 50ml and 100ml formats are refillable with a 150ml refill. In perfect harmony, the outer box features gunmetal colour details on matte grey textured paper. It is made with 10% upcycled seaweed and material from well-managed, FSC™ certified forests and other controlled sources. How to enhance your perfume experience . Start with the Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette shower gel, then apply Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum all over, focusing on your pulse points, to enhance your fragrance experience. .

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Gently Effective Blemish-Targeting Cleansing Paste 125ml
listings.description: “Kiehl's Blemish-Targeting Cleansing Paste is a smart, three-in-one solution for blemish-prone skin.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Cleanser Is.... It’s a multi-tasking hero for anyone dealing with blemishes. The Kiehl’s Gently Effective Blemish-Targeting Cleansing Paste is designed to tackle spots without stripping or drying out the skin. It feels gentle and calming but is incredibly effective, working in three different ways to help you achieve a clearer, more balanced complexion.. . Why You’ll Love This Cleansing Paste:. It helps to visibly reduce current blemishes and prevent future breakouts.. It works as a daily cleanser, a ten-minute mask, and an overnight spot treatment.. The non-drying formula tackles blemishes without leaving your skin feeling tight or uncomfortable.. It helps to diminish the look of post-blemish marks and refines skin texture.. . Product Claims:. Kiehl’s has created a clever, non-drying charcoal paste that can be used in three different ways to target blemishes. The formula visibly reduces existing spots and helps to prevent new ones from forming. It also works to minimise the appearance of post-blemish marks, leaving your skin looking clearer and more balanced.. . Hero Ingredients:. The star ingredient here is a 2% concentration of salicylic acid, a brilliant beta-hydroxy acid that gets deep into pores to help clear blemishes and refine the skin's texture. It’s also enriched with bio-based charcoal, which acts like a magnet to draw out excess oil. Finally, bio-based Cica-Centella, derived from the medicinal plant Centella Asiatica, helps to soothe sensitive skin and reinforce the skin’s natural barrier, preventing dryness.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. It’s a soft, greyish-black paste with a smooth texture that transforms into a light lather with water. It feels creamy and gentle on the skin, a welcome relief from some of the more harsh blemish-tackling products on the market. It has a very subtle, clean, and earthy scent from the natural charcoal.. . The Best Way To Use It:. This is where the Kiehl's Cleansing Paste really shines because you can use it in three different ways. As a daily cleanser, massage a small amount onto damp skin and rinse. As a mask, apply a thin layer to your face and leave it on for ten minutes before rinsing. As a targeted spot treatment, dab a little directly onto a blemish and leave it on overnight. The key is to listen to your skin and choose the method that best suits its needs on any given day.. . Why It’s Escentual:. Kiehl’s has a heritage built on apothecary-inspired formulas and a focus on efficacy, and this product is no exception. We love that it’s not just another harsh blemish treatment but a genuinely thoughtful, non-drying solution. It’s a great example of how you can treat blemishes without compromising your skin's health. It’s smart, effective, and fits seamlessly into any routine, making it a product we are proud to recommend.. . Sustainability:. Kiehl’s is a brand dedicated to improving its sustainability commitments over time.. . Values:. This product is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and blemish-prone skin. It is also a cruelty-free formula..

listings.description: “Avene Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Concentrated Serum is the perfect daily dose of radiance for even the most sensitive skin.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Radiance Serum Is.... This serum is all about getting that luminous, glowing look without any of the irritation that can sometimes come with powerful brightening ingredients. It’s a great option for those with sensitive skin who still want to target dullness, fine lines, and dark spots. It helps your skin feel more comfortable while looking visibly healthier and more radiant.. . Why You’ll Love This Serum:. You'll notice a more radiant, glowing complexion from the very first use.. It works to target wrinkles, dark spots, and dullness all at once.. It's the perfect solution for dull, tired skin showing the early signs of ageing.. The lightweight, non-sticky texture absorbs quickly, making it a dream to apply.. The formula is vegan-friendly and comes in sustainable glass packaging.. . Product Claims:. The Avene Vitamin Activ Cg Serum is your daily go-to for a radiant glow. This revitalising serum is powered by a trio of dermatological actives designed to tackle dullness, pigmentation, and early signs of ageing, all while being gentle enough for sensitive skin. With continued use, your skin will look visibly more radiant, plump, and youthful. After just 15 days, it feels smoother and more luminous, and by one month, dark spots appear reduced and your skin looks healthier overall.. . Hero Ingredients:. At the heart of the formula is 1.8% Vitamin Cg (Ascorbyl Glucoside) , a stable and potent antioxidant that instantly brightens and protects against environmental stress. This is paired with 3% Niacinamide , which works to even out skin tone, smooth its texture, and support your skin’s natural barrier. What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. This serum has a lovely, lightweight texture that feels silky and smooth on the skin. It absorbs quickly, so there’s no sticky residue, just a fresh, comfortable feel. The formula is fragrance-free, making it perfect for those who prefer their skincare without a scent.. . The Best Way To Use It:. You can use this serum both morning and evening. Simply apply 1-2 pipettes to clean, dry skin. Gently smooth it over your face, neck, and décolleté before following up with your favourite moisturiser.. An expert tip: for a truly radiant glow, make sure to massage it in with upward strokes to encourage circulation and get that plump, healthy look.. . Why It’s Escentual:. We love this serum for its effective yet gentle approach to skin ageing. Unlike some traditional Vitamin C formulas, Avene’s Vitamin Cg offers brightness without irritation, which makes it an absolute hero for daily use, even on sensitive skin.. The pipette-style bottle not only looks beautiful but also gives you a precise application every single time, making your routine feel just a little more special. It's a testament to Avene’s dedication to creating gentle yet powerful products that truly care for your skin.. . Sustainability:. The formula is made with 94% natural-origin ingredients and comes in recyclable glass packaging, reflecting the brand’s commitment to more eco-conscious choices.. . Values:. This product is vegan, non-comedogenic, and dermatologist-tested on sensitive skin. It is free from fragrance..

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 30ml
listings.description: THE MOST CONCENTRATED PARADOXE Paradoxe Radical Essence, the new feminine fragrance by Prada. This new signature rethinks gourmand scents with the most addictive Paradoxe: a concentration of unexpected gourmand notes in a sophisticated Parfum.. RETHINKING GOURMAND SCENTS Paradoxe’s sensorial floral ambery signature is reinvented with a new gourmand dimension. To open a new perspective on gourmand scents, our master perfumers Nadège Le Garlantezec, Shyamala Maisondieu and Antoine Maisondieu chose iconic ingredients and reinvented them to reveal new olfactory sensations. Top notes of the sensorial floral signature of Paradoxe, reinterpreted as a sweet edible flower thanks to the Neroli Oil and the Orange Flower Heart Absolute. Heart notes revealing an unexpected Salted Pistachio Accord, with addictive roasted and salty notes. Base notes of a powerful and creamy Sandalwood Accord that brings sophistication to this gourmand scent for a sensual and modern trail.. THE ICONIC TRIANGLE REINVENTED Like the original fragrance, its renewed bottle is an expression of the House’s essence of reinvention. In a shift from traditional perfume bottle architecture, the flacon is minimal and delicate at first glance, inspired by the original iconic Prada triangle logo disruptively designed to rest on its side. The Prada coat of arms logo contrasts with the sophisticated deep pink lacquering of the bottle. Paradoxe Radical Essence outer box is etched to echo the brand’s signature Saffiano leather cross-hatching. An interplay of the fragrance’s pink signature and the black Prada logo, twisting the Paradoxe labels in black to reflect the maximal intensity of this Radical Essence. . Olfactory family - Floral Ambery Woody Top note - Neroli Oil and Orange Flower Heart Absolute Heart note - Salted Pistachio Accord Base note - Sandalwood Accord . Instruction of use Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a strong and long lasting perfume scent. After applying your fragrance, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly. If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent hand-washing, as this tends to rinse off the scent..

listings.rawTitle: bareMinerals Original Pressed Powder Foundation SPF15 9g / Fair 01
listings.description: The Original Icon: Loved By You, Evolved For You. Same Skin-Loving Benefits, Now In Brand New Format. Buildable Coverage. Natural Radiant Finish. Minimal Ingredients. . Why We love it: This mineral-powered foundation is made with minimal ingredients that instantly improves skin texture and clarity while reducing redness. This hydrating pressed powder foundation with mineral SPF 15, improves skin immediately and overtime leaving a naturally luminous finish. The longwear, buildable coverage formula instantly reduces redness and improves skin's barrier function while improving skin blemishes by 25% in just 1 week. How to use: PRESS. TAP. SWEEP. PRESS the Precision Face Brush (sold separately) gently into the pressed powder foundation. TAP away any excess powder that hasn’t been absorbed into the brush to avoid an uneven application. SWEEP the brush across the skin starting in the center of the face & working outwards. Repeat until desired coverage is achieved. To build coverage in specific areas, gently pat the Precision Face Brush over areas of concern. SPONGE Application (Included): Press sponge into compact. Sweep product onto the skin. Press to build coverage where desired. . Ideal for all skin types. Does not clog pores. Non-irritating. Non-acnegenic. Non-comedogenic. Dermatologist-tested. Key ingredients: Mineral SPF 15: Protects from UVA and UVB rays. Mineral Silica: Imparts comfortable coverage and helps to balance and blur skin texture. Mineral Pigments: Natural alternative to standard colorants that are safe for all skin types. . Clinical claims*: Immediately hydrates and improves skin’s barrier function. 12hr wear formula immediately promotes clearer skin and reduces skin redness. 32% improvement in appearance of skin health after 7 days. 31% improvement in skin’s clarity and 29% reduction in skin imperfections after 7 days. 29% reduction in skin redness after 4 weeks. 16% reduction in appearance of lines and wrinkles after 7 days. 11% improvement in skin’s barrier function after 7 days. Refines skin’s texture by 24% after 7 days and reduces appearance of pores by 21% after 4 weeks. *Based on an independent clinical study .

listings.rawTitle: Mason Pearson Brushes Hair Serum 75ml
listings.description: A lightweight serum that instantly smooths, hydrates, and repairs hair while reducing breakage and adding shine.. The Mason Pearson Serum is the final step in your haircare routine.. How To Use . After washing the hair with the Mason Pearson Shampoo and Mason Pearson Conditioner, pump a small amount, depending on your hair length, onto your hands, and massage onto damp or dry hair.. Work the serum from the mid-lengths to the end of your hair, avoiding the roots and crown. When the Serum is fully absorbed into your hair, style as normal. Some may wish to leave the serum to work overnight as a deeply nourishing hair mask.. Warnings . Avoid contact with eyes, if the product gets into your eyes, please rinse immediately..

listings.rawTitle: Mason Pearson Brushes Leave-In Conditioner 150ml

listings.rawTitle: Mason Pearson Brushes Purple Conditioner 250ml

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Total Eye Lift 15ml
listings.description: Revitalise tired and ageing eyes with the Clarins Total Eye Lift, an effective anti-ageing eye cream that lifts, smooths and brightens the eyes and is suitable for all skin types.. Gentle enough for even sensitive eyes, the multi-tasking eye care solution is powered by 94% natural origin ingredients. The Total Eye Lift formula helps to rejuvenate the eye area, reduce dark circles and de-puff the eye contour for a youthful, refreshed and well-rested look. The delicate skin around the eyes is re-densified as the soothing cream smooths away wrinkles, fine lines and crow's feet for a visibly lifted finish.. Rich in fatty acids, the eye cream uses cassie wax - one of Clarins' most efficient anti-ageing ingredients - which is renowned for its toning properties. This sits alongside organic harungana, a natural skin-tightening ingredient that helps to create an immediate smoothing effect, while promoting long-term lift and targeted nourishment.. The highly replenishing formula helps to visibly revitalise the eye area, thanks to added natural ingredients such as firming and radiance-boosting albizia and de-puffing guarana. Finally, horse chestnut helps to brighten shadows areas to mask signs of fatigue.. Why We Love It . Clarins' has redefined their iconic cult-classic eye cream to make it even more powerful. As big fans of the original, we couldn't wait to try the updated formulation - and it doesn't disappoint!. It's ideal that the eye cream helps to target multiple signs of ageing in one and is suitable for all skin types. Whether you suffer from dark circles or you want to smooth fine lines and wrinkles (or tackle both at the same time), the Total Eye Lift cream will transform tired, fatigued and ageing eyes.. Plus, we love Clarins' commitment to being more sustainable. The powerful eye concentrate is held in a scarlet-hued ombre glass bottle - which is both recyclable and airless - while the eye cream itself is driven by nature.. How To Use It . To apply, dab gently onto the eye contour and eyelids, and smooth between the eyebrows and on the temples.. Works Well With . listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto di Panarea La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto di Panarea La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray is an intense and multi-nuanced fragrance from a 2-month maceration process, where rich myrtle and lavender essences interweave with the resinous warmth of myrrh and labdanum. . An homage to the wild myrtle fruit and rugged landscape of Panarea's volcanic fields, Mirto di Panarea La Riserva is crafted from a two-month maceration process, infusing it with depth and texture that results in a full, intense, and silky essence. The light is scintillating, golden, and radiant, where each note harmonizes in a beautiful balance, thanks to the prolonged development. . The top notes open with the crispness of cedrat essence, sage, and juniper berries, offering a fresh and invigorating start. The heart introduces a rich blend of myrtle and lavender essences, with the depth of myrrh absolute. At the base, patchouli fraction, labdanum absolute, and lentiscus absolute create a warm, earthy foundation, for a lasting impression. . Mirto di Panarea La Riserva features a cap and bottle in a new, more intense shade of blue, embodying the long-lasting sillage of the fragrance. The fragrance comes in an enlarged hatbox, complemented by a refreshed label with updated finishings. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Fresh Scrub 50ml
listings.description: Give your dehydrated skin a boost of radiance with the Clarins Fresh Scrub, a facial exfoliator with natural beads for all skin types, especially those that lack hydration.. The cream exfoliant that thirsty skin cannot live without... Fresh Scrub instantly exfoliates and refreshes the face. Formulated with beads of natural origin, the scrub removes impurities and dead skin cells to help refine skin texture.. Skin is left soft and supple thanks to the Organic leaf of life extract in the formula, which helps to naturally moisturize the skin by boosting hyaluronic acid production in the skin's epidermis.. With 95% ingredients of natural origin and a fully recyclable tube, this product is good for your skin and good for the planet. . . Why We Love It . Thirsty complexions will adore this facial scrub, it won't dry out the skin or leave it feeling tight or irritated like some exfoliators can and it's really effective while still being gentle on the skin.. How To Use It . Begin by thoroughly cleansing your face, then moisten. Apply a 50p sized amount of scrub and warm up between your hands. Apply to the face without rubbing or applying pressure and gently massage in, taking care to avoid the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with water. Use once or twice a week.. Top tip: Exfoliate your skin is in the morning to slough away dead skin cells because renews itself at night.. Works Well With . Combined with wild Mango Butter, which is rich in essential fatty acids and chosen for its highly nourishing properties, even the driest of skin is exfoliated and left nourished and comfortable, with a luminous complexion.. With 99% ingredients of natural origin and a fully recyclable tube, this product is good for your skin and good for the planet. . Why We Love It . Dry and sensitive skin should exfoliate too, and this is the best scrub for the job; it leaves even the most fragile complexions feeling smooth and comfortable. Another thing we love about this exfoliator is just how good it smells! Imagine cutting up a juicy mango and the aroma as you pop the first slice into your mouth and that's exactly what the Comfort Scrub smells like - you'll be soon counting down to every use, as we do!. How To Use It . We recommend using your face scrub in the morning because the skin renews itself overnight and this is the best time of day to remove dead skin cells. After thoroughly cleansing your face, moisten and then warm up a 50p sized amount between your hands. Massage in gently taking care not to rub or apply pressure to the face. Rinse thoroughly.. Top tip: Comfort Scrub can also be used as a lip scrub to help to eliminate any dry and flaky skin, simply massage in gently and prepare yourself for totally kissable lips!. Works Well With . listings.description: “You will love Vanille Soleil if you're looking for a vanilla fragrance that's not too sweet. It's effortless, uplifting and smells divine” - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You’ll Love Roger & Gallet Vanille Soleil: . It will make you feel comforted and serene for 4-5 hours.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. Sustainability And Values: . Roger & Gallet has a long-standing tradition of harnessing nature's benefits. The Vanille Soleil Wellbeing Fragrant Water is made with an impressive 93% natural origin ingredients and is enriched with natural vanilla extract for its soothing properties. The brand is committed to a vegan formula and using ethically sourced ingredients, ensuring their products are not only beautiful but also kind to your skin and the planet. .

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe My Pink Crush Travel Kit Travel Kit
listings.description: Dive into the irresistible My Pink Crush set, a selection of our Nuxe essentials to see life in pink! What's inside: - VERY ROSE - SOOTHING CLEANSING MICELLAR WATER 100ML Formulated with moisturizing and soothing rose floral water. 99% ingredients of natural origin. - CRÈME PRODIGIEUSE® BOOST - MULTI-CORRECTION GEL CREAM 15ML With natural-origin Hyaluronic Acid and anti-oxidant Jasmine extract. 92% ingredients of natural origin - PRODIGIEUSE BOOST® - VITAMIN-ENRICHED DETOX MASK 75ML With citrus extract. Vegan formula (registered by The Vegan Society), with no ingredients or derivatives of animal origin. 98% of the total is of natural origin. 51% of total ingredients are organically grown. - HUILE PRODIGIEUSE® FLORAL GOLD 10ML 7 precious 100% vegetable oils with complementary virtues, selected for their affinity with the skin: Tsubaki oil, argan oil, macadamia oil, borage oil, camellia oil, hazelnut oil, sweet almond oil. Texture enriched with natural pearly particules. Products formulated and produced in France. How to use VERY ROSE - SOOTHING CLEANSING MICELLAR WATER Soak a cotton pad, preferably reusable, with micellar water. Sweep over the entire face and eyes until all traces of makeup are removed. Repeat the process until the cotton pad comes out clean. No need to rinse off. Use in the night as a makeup remover and in the morning as a cleansing step. PRODIGIEUSE® BOOST - MULTI-CORRECTION GEL CREAM Take a generous dab of cream and warm it between your hands. Apply it to your face with both hands flat, always working from the center outwards, avoiding the eye contour area. Also apply to your neck and décolleté. Massage until completely absorbed. In the morning, apply after your serum and finish by lightly tapping your fingertips all over your face to awaken the radiance of your complexion. In the evening, gently apply your hands to your cheeks, then your forehead and chin, and finally to the center of your face (around the nose). PRODIGIEUSE BOOST® - GLOW BOOSTING DETOX MASK Apply the mask to cleansed, dry skin. Take a generous dab of mask and spread over cheeks, forehead, chin, nose and neck, avoiding the eye area. Then spread a thin layer over the entire face and neck. Leave on for 5 minutes, then massage with both hands, making small concentric circles all over the face. If you feel the need, insist on the T-zone (wings of the nose, forehead and chin), then rinse thoroughly with water. Ideally, apply once or twice a week. HUILE PRODIGIEUSE® FLORAL GOLD Use Huile Prodigieuse® Or Florale all year round, winter and summer, on face, body and hair. Shake before use. On the face, apply in small dabs with a flat brush or fingertips, focusing on the high points of the face: cheekbones, bridge of the nose, forehead above the eyebrows. On the body, place a few drops in your palm and warm the oil between your hands. Choose the areas you wish to highlight and smooth over them. On hair, apply a few dabs to lengths and ends to enhance them with shimmery highlights. Hazards and Cautions Do not store in direct sunlight .
