listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumee The Vert Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: Eau Parfumee The Vert, launched in 1992, was initially designed as an exclusive gift aiming to cater to the close circle of the Maison's top high jewellery clients. Today, Bvlgari invites its clients to rediscover its original perfume creation through a new design, an upgraded formula featuring natural tea and a new conceptual story. Inspired by a dreamlike place where gems of nature spark the imagination, clients are welcome to experience Eau Parfumee's unique olfactive botanical harmonies inside the Botanical Garden. Eau Parfumee The Vert Eau de Toilette traces an awakening path through this garden, unveiling the revitalizing olfactive botanical properties of green tea. With Eau Parfumee The Vert, Master-Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena captures the irresistible vitality of the young tea leaves as well as their vegetal, grassy, and refreshing aroma. The citrus aromatic signature is a skilful combination of green tea notes with a luminous floral accord of neroli petals. The fizzy texture of bergamot essence mingles with crispy, young tea leaves recreating the timeless pleasure of being immersed in nature's healing, resourcing bounty, bringing new energy to all the senses. The silhouette of the flacon is inspired by the proud elegance of ancient Roman columns. The design is embellished by the iconic glass decollete, symbolizing a sensory experience as rich and intimate as wearing a jewellery creation. A crackled inlay adorns the beige gold cap and echoes the tradition of celadon ceramics originating in China. The front label is enriched with new hand-drawn botanical illustrations, meticulously crafted by a French botanist exclusively for Bvlgari and exquisitely embossed thanks to new selected paper made from hemp. .

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande God is a Woman Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Ariana Grande’s striking fragrance, God is a Woman, is inspired by the grand power of nature. . listings.rawTitle: Phyto Anti-Itching Dermo Soothing Shampoo 250ml
listings.description: From the first use, the Phyto Anti-Itching Dermo Soothing Shampoo calms the itching and redness of the sensitive, irritated, and dry scalp. As the applications progress, the sensations of irritation and discomfort are soothed. At the heart of the formula, fermented bisabolol calms itching and reduces redness. Thanks to a rosemary extraction, the scalp is protected against external aggressions and rebalanced. Formulated without alcohol or perfume with optimal tolerance for sensitive skin. Dermatologically tested on sensitive scalps and prone to irritation. Silicone-free, sulfated surfactants-free. Suitable for frequent use.. Active Ingredients . Bisabolol Of Fermented Origin: Significantly soothes itching and immediately reduces skin redness, inhibiting the production of cytokines, proteins responsible for scalp discomfort.. Rosemary Extraction: Soothes the scalp and protects it 100% against external aggressions and oxidative stress. It strengthens the skin barrier and thus preserves the balance of the scalp.. How To Use . Apply to wet scalp, massaging gently to remove impurities at the root and rinse. A small amount is enough thanks to its concentrated formula.. Repeat the application, leave for up to 1 minute to penetrate the active ingredients and reinforce the soothing action then rinse. In case of eye contact, rinse thoroughly.. Recommended duration of use: 1 month. Suitable for frequent use. As the applications progress, the effectiveness increases: the intensity of redness and itching decrease significantly after 1 month..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Roseliane Redness-Neutralizing Smoothing Serum 30ml
listings.description: The new ROSELIANE Visible Redness-Neutralizing Smoothing Serum is the anti-inflammaging* solution for skin prone to couperosis. Anti-redness and anti-aging, it helps to prevent premature aging of sensitive skin thanks to 3 pharmacological molecules: hesperidin, enoxolone and niacinamide. 2X less redness, fine lines and heating sensations. Key dermatological ingredients are formulated in a fresh, soothing serum with a green texture that neutralizes redness. . The combination of the TLR2-Regul complex and the SK5R complex (Specific-Kallikrein-5-Regulator) regulates the activity of Kallikrein-5, the protease responsible for inflammation and vascular problems, for a powerful soothing effect. Unscented. Dermatologically tested on skin prone to couperosis. 97% natural origin. Recommended by dermatologists. . Apply morning and night before your daily skin care routine. Avoid contact with eyes. *Premature aging of sensitive skin .

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Billie Eilish Says:. Your Turn is the newest chapter from Eilish Fragrances - a warm, woody, and fresh scent that blends bright ginger, velvety peach skin, and smooth sandalwood.. Made for everyone, this captivating fragrance redefines versatility.. The Notes . Top Note: Fresh Ginger, Bergamot, Cardamom Heart Note: Velvet Peach Skin, Jasmine, Coconut Water Base Note: Sandalwood, Musk, Amber . The Bottle . The Your Turn bottle is inspired by Billie’s cherished elements of personal expression and home decor.. Crafted as stacked dice, its sleek silver chrome finish makes it a modern art piece, bringing both playfulness and intrigue to any space.. The Concept . Your Turn opens with a vibrant contrast of zesty bergamot, spicy cardamom, and the warm, invigorating bite of ginger.. As the fragrance unfolds, velvety peach skin, delicate night-blooming jasmine, and the airy essence of coconut water come together, revealing a soft, alluring heart.. The warmth of sandalwood, enveloping musks, and sustainable amber wraps the scent in an unforgettable finish.. Escentual Says:. Comments in the office included: ''Wow, I'm surprised how much I love it.'' ''I adore the bottle" "I like its warm, woody smell. I think every gender will love it!". It's NOT your average pretty perfume, it's a fresh take on a classic woody aroma with a spicy, sweet side. It smells expensive, and has that understated and minimalist quality that Santal 33 has (even though the bottle is very statement), but Your Turn is lighter, fresher and slightly spicier. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Gentleman Society Ambree Eau de Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy introduces a new facet of the Gentleman attitude with Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Ambrée, a sensual and opulent fragrance crafted for those who are born to live in the spotlight. Revealing a one-of-a-kind accord that gives the impression of being shrouded in gold, this Eau de Parfum celebrates the essence of the most dazzling gentlemen: those who are as inspired as they are inspiring. . . AN INCLUSIVE COMMUNITY . New members of the Gentleman Society come together in this new chapter with a bold, assertive attitude. Creative, passionate, free-thinkers, game changers of all backgrounds - this fragrance is an invitation to join a community that’s more daring and inclusive than ever. . . A SENSUAL AND OPULENT NEW SIGNATURE . Narcissus Absolute and a quartet of Vetivers combine to create the iconic olfactory signature of the original Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum, which is reinvented with a spicy twist in this ambery new addition. Enriched with dark notes of Leather, Tobacco, and Sandalwood from Australia, Balsam from Peru and Opoponax interact with Tasuki Vanilla from Madagascar for a rich, textured and deeply addictive sillage, contrasted by the freshness of Juniper essence. . . A DAZZLING SYMBOL . For Eau de Parfum Ambrée, the iconic Gentleman Society bottle is lacquered entirely in black and adorned with an elegant champagne golden crest, putting the spotlight on a perfume that is bound to draw attention. Combining opulence and timelessness, the 4G metal plate is recognisable at first glance, like a rallying symbol of the Gentleman Society. . . Join the Gentleman Society. It’s not a place, it’s a state of mind. .

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance with a fresh and sparkling character, Buongiorno captures the thrills of new beginnings inspired by the arrival of spring in the Tuscan hills. Evoking the uplifting freshness and vitality of the season through the essence of the co-distillation of basil and petitgrain, the scent is an ode to being Italian where beauty is found even in the smallest things. . Crafted through the co-distillation process, which harmonizes the distinct characters of petitgrain and basil essences, Buongiorno is an olfactory symphony of invigorating freshness and comforting warmth. . The eau de parfum opens with a bright and energizing top note, featuring a blend of citrus, aromatic, and green notes. Lemon, spearmint, and rosemary intertwine with the unique co-distillation of basil and petitgrain, creating a captivating and refreshing initial impression. . As the fragrance evolves, the middle notes unveil a delightful fusion of lavandin and mandarin leaves accord, adding a touch of floral elegance. This leads to a robust and grounding base, where cedarwood leaves, amber accord, and white musk accord unite to provide a rounded and voluminous base. . The new Buongiorno comes in a yellow-coloured bottle, embodying luminous essence within. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Ever Bronze Powder 10g / 01 - Light
listings.description: "If you're looking to create the ultimate sun-kissed glow in a matter of moments, then you need to add the Clarins Ever Bronze Powder to your makeup bag." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Ever Bronze Powder: . Compact bronzing powder that adds a warm radiance to your skin.. Features two compatible shades in one sleek compact.. Includes a lighter shade to catch the light and a darker shade for long-lasting results.. Smooths, nourishes and protects your skin with each wear.. Helps to prolong your natural tan.. Available in three shades.. . Why It's Escentual: . Designed to deliver made-to-measure results, the Ever Matte Bronze Powder pairs skin-loving actives with bronzing pigments to mimic the look of a natural tan. The 90% natural origin bronzing powder adds radiant warmth to your complexion and smooths, hydrates, and protects your skin. Organic coconut oil nourishes and softens after sun exposure, while Clarins' Anti-Pollution Complex protects against daily exposure to damaging, skin-dulling pollutants. The powder even helps to prolong your tan, thanks to the addition of organic safflower, so you can enjoy a healthy glow for even longer.. But the thing that really sets the Ever Matte bronzing compact apart is the fact that each compact features two slightly different shades. The shade on the left side is enriched with thin pearls to catch the light and make your look pop, while the slightly darker variation on the right delivers even longer-lasting bronzed results.. . The Best Way To Use It: . You can dust the powder all over your complexion for a warm bronzed look by swirling a large fluffy makeup brush around the compact and gently sweeping over your skin, or you can apply the bronzing powder to the places that would naturally be touched by the sun. You can then add a touch of the darker shades under the cheekbones for longer-lasting results.. Alternatively, you can use the shades to sculpt and define by running the deeper shade along the forehead, jawline and under the cheekbones and then use the lighter shade as a highlighter, adding touches to the high points of the cheekbones, the nose, etc.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Clarins Ever Bronze Powder is housed in a cardboard carton that uses materials sourced from sustainably-managed forests.. .

Buildable syrupy colour in the most intense level of shine of the whole YSL Loveshine products.. BENEFITS. Instantly glossy, lips look puffier & bouncier with a smackable non-sticky feel. Discover our 10 juicy shades for your perfect pout. . Enjoy 8 hours of luscious, glassy shine and 24-hour hydration for a perfectly plumped pout. Infused with hyaluronic acid, it provides a comfortable, non-sticky texture that nourishes lips while delivering buildable, juicy shades. The formula creates a high-shine finish with the ultimate plumping effect, ensuring your lips stay moisturized, smooth, and irresistibly radiant. . . WHAT IT DOES. Buildable syrupy colour in the most intense level of shine of the whole YSL Loveshine products.. BENEFITS. Instantly glossy, lips look puffier & bouncier with a smackable non-sticky feel. The formula is boosted by a hot spicy sensation that make your lips feel plumped. Lips are drenched in care thanks to the 95% oil-infused formula with hyaluronic acid and delicious fig pulp from YSL Beauty Ourika Community Gardens. The formula is powered by stimulating ginger and pepper oils.. How to Use: . • Define your lip contours with Touche Éclat (sold separately) before applying lip colour for extra definition. • Remove gloss plush applicator from the pack. • Apply the lip gloss applicator directly by starting at the centre of the lip and gliding towards the corners of the mouth..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Renergie C.R.x Triple Serum Retinol 20ml
listings.description: OUR RETINOL REVOLUTION: . 100% RENEWED SKIN, 2X FASTER THAN RETINOL ALONE.. Rethink retinol with Rénergie C.R.x. Triple Serum Retinol. . Lancôme’s scientific innovation continues in this high-performance anti-ageing serum, which combines 3 potent active ingredients into one triple dose to reach a new level of skincare efficacy. For our first time, Pure Retinol is combined with brightening Pure Vitamin C and soothing X-Peptide. . Experience this formula in our creamy textured serum: more potent and more effective than retinol used alone yet remaining gentle, non-irritating and suitable on all skin tones and types, including sensitive skin. . CLINICALLY PROVEN ON UK WOMEN . Clinically proven to visibly firm, brighten and reduce wrinkles in just 8 weeks, in an independent trial of over 50 women in the UK. . CLINICALLY PROVEN RESULTS. -24% FOREHEAD WRINKLES -23% FROWN WRINKLES -24% PORES VISIBILITY . RETINOL FOR ALL: TESTED ON A WIDE RANGE OF SKIN TONES & TYPES . 95% agree skin feels firmer 90% agree fine lines look reduced 95% agree skin looks more radiant 96% agree skin texture appears refined . THREE HIGH-PERFORMANCE ACTIVES IN SINGLE BOTTLE: . Pure Retinol: A serum-emulsion formulated with pure retinol to improve ageing signs. . Pure Vitamin C: A gel-serum with pure concentration of vitamin C to boost the skin radiance. . X-Peptides: A creamy texture serum with x-peptide to refine skin texture and sooth. . OUR RETINOL ROUTINE . As retinol is a powerful active ingredient, experts recommend that you integrate it gradually into your routine to accommodate your skin to its effects. To do so, follow the skin cycling routine below. . Average results based on the speed of skin surface cell renewal compared to using retinol alone in a 22-day instrumental test, forearm. . Average Results- Clinical study of 76 women after 56 days, visual grading. . Clinical study of 50 women in the UK, using SPF & Serum, 56 days. Self-assessment, 80 individuals, 56 days. Self-assessment, 50 women, 8 weeks..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Renergie H.P.N UVMUNE Cream SPF50 30ml
listings.description: Renergie enters a new chapter, with H.P.N. UVMUNE SPF50 Cream: Lancome's first anti-ageing cream to combine H.P.N.’s 300-Peptide with UVMUNE technology powered by patented Mexoryl 400, for their strongest UV protection. Our innovation in SPF texture and finish, Renergie H.P.N. UVMUNE SPF50 Cream feels silky and velvety to the touch, leaving skin soft and luminous, with no greasiness or white cast.. CLINICALLY PROVEN ON UK WOMEN*. 9/10 UK WOMEN AGREE**. ✓ Skin appears more radiant ✓ Skin tone has improved ✓ Skin looks smoother. INGREDIENTS. 300-Peptide: Renergie H.P.N. UVMUNE SPF50 Cream is highly concentrated with Lancome’s iconic 300-Peptides: over 300 types of peptides obtained from biotech, helping skin regenerate faster. Mexoryl 400: UVMune based on UV technology containing the patented molecule: Mexoryl 400, which delivers high protection against the most insidious UV rays, known as Long UVA rays (between 380nm and 400nm), and helps protect against major signs of photo-ageing such as dark spots, wrinkles, and skin firmness.. EXPERIENCE A COMPLETE RETINOL ROUTINE. Partnered as the ultimate retinol routine, together, new Renergie C.R.x. Triple Serum Retinol and Renergie H.P.N. UVMUNE SPF50 Cream are a complementary skincare power duo designed for all skin tones, types, and ages. Apply Renergie C.R.x. Triple Serum Retinol at night and follow with Renergie H.P.N. UVMUNE SPF50 Cream in the day to help you wake up to your best skin, day after day.. *Clinical study of 50 women in the UK, using SPF, 56 days. *Self-assessment, 50 women, using SPF, 8 weeks. . listings.rawTitle: Pharmaceris A Hyaluro-Sensibiotic Intensive Moisturising Serum 30ml
listings.description: Based on a combination of HA acids and neo-PGA, multifunctional natural biopolymers, the serum creates a mesohybrid moisturising system, providing multi-level, deep and intense hydration to the skin, lasting up to 11h. . The compilation of 15% humectants in the formula allows to achieve immediate hydration, soothing and restoring comfort to sensitive skin, while protecting it from dehydration and recurrence of dryness. . SENSIBIOM prebiotic complex restores the balance of the skin's microbiota, strengthening its immunity and barrier function. . A complex with properties that support the beneficial epidermal microbiota calms hyper-reactive skin, reducing symptoms of sensitive skin such as itching, burning, tightness, redness, heating and general discomfort. . The serum soothes and relieves existing skin irritation. . Niacinamide accelerates the regeneration process of the skin, effectively preventing signs of aging. . Visibly firms, smoothens and improves the elasticity of the skin. . Formulated with a light texture, it is quickly absorbed, does not grease the skin, does not clog pores and does not cause blackheads. . Main Ingredients . Hyaluronic Acid and neo-PGA - provides multi-level, deep and intense skin hydration lasting up to 11h.. Prebiotic complex SENSIBIOM - restores the balance of the skin microbiome, strengthening its immunity and barrier function. Niacinamide - accelerates the skin regeneration process, effectively preventing signs of aging.. How To Use . Serum for daily use on cleansed skin (dry or wet) of the face, eye area, neck and décolleté, in the morning and evening.. For use also under makeup.. Indications . Recommended for daily care of skin (face, eye area, neck, décolleté) requiring intensive hydration, strengthening and nourishment.. Ideal for hypersensitive, delicate skin, with a tendency to allergic reactions, dehydration, dryness and the formation of irritation and redness exacerbated during the pollen season.. listings.rawTitle: Clarins Invisible Sun Care Stick SPF50 17g
listings.description: Keep skin protected on-the-go with the Clarins Sun Care Stick SPF50, a compact, highly-protective chemical sunscreen that is gentle enough for sensitive skin.. listings.rawTitle: Clarins Youth-protecting Sunscreen Very High Protection for Body SPF50+ 150ml

L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme Eau de parfum is a vegan fragrance, made with 92% natural origin ingredients. The 100% natural origin cedarwood is upcycled. listings.rawTitle: Antipodes Jasmine Flower Menopause Facial Cream 15ml
listings.description: This ultimate luxury cream targets skin concerns from perimenopause to post-menopause. Formulated for sensitive skin, it helps with signs of menopause such as redness, severe dehydration, hormonal blemishes, and signs of ageing to smooth and balance your evolving complexion. Organic oat extract calms red, itchy, and sensitive skin. Peptides from chamomile and fermented jasmine flowers help relax lines and wrinkles. New Zealand avocado oil, with collagen boosting properties, fuses with manuka honey to ease signs of ageing whilst reducing blemishes. Certifications Certified vegetarian by the UK Vegetarian Society. Skin Benefits . Organic oat extract targets redness, sensitivity and irritation . Sustainably sourced New Zealand manuka honey hydrates and targets blemishes . New Zealand avocado and kiwi seed oils stimulate collagen production . Skin Types . Suited to all skin types, especially from perimenopause to post-menopause. . Dermatologically approved for sensitive skin . Packaging Recyclable glass jar. Outer box made from biodegradable cardboard from sustainable forests, printed with 100% eco inks derived from vegetables. Fragrance COSMOS-certified fragrance of jasmine How to Use . Apply this menopause skincare cream each morning for best results and smooth, calm skin. . Massage a generous amount into your face, neck and décolletage each morning after your favourite Antipodes serum. . Partner Products . Antipodes Culture Probiotic Night-Recovery Water Cream . Antipodes Flora Probiotic Skin-Rescue Hyaluron Mask . Antipodes Grace Gentle Cream Cleanser & Makeup Remover . Values . Paraben-free. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Foam In Cream 150ml
listings.description: The secret of longevity begins with healthy, perfectly cleansed skin. The Foam in Cream thus represents a key step in the Orchidée Impériale longevity ritual, offering deep skin purification. Its delicate, luscious foam that forms on contact with water rids skin of impurities and pollution microparticles. Its formula derived from saponification is enriched with a 50% skincare base for optimal skin comfort and high cleansing efficacy. It combines the high regeneration of Orchid Totum™ molecular extract with Orchid Equilibrium™ technology, which helps to maintain skin’s balance. Skin is comfortable and softer, skin texture refined and the complexion luminous. Skin reveals the purity of youth. . How to use . Step 1: place a small amount of cream in the palm of your hand and add water to form a lather. Step 2: massage with the fingertips in circular movements all over the face. Step 3: rinse off with clean water .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Make Me Blush Bold Blurring Powder Blush 5g / 03 - Mischievous Magenta
listings.description: Why You’ll Love YSL Make Me Blush Bold Blurring Powder Blush: . Skincare-infused formula blurs the look of pores.. Silky texture melts into the cheeks and feels weightless.. Ultra-pigmented formula - a little bit goes a long way.. Sweatproof and waterproof.. Available in satin and matte finishes.. 11 shades to choose from.. . What YSL Say: . I never blush so make me - new MAKE ME BLUSH BOLD BLURRING BLUSH by YVES SAINT LAURENT, an ultra-sensorial silky powder blush that blurs the looks of pores. Waterproof and sweatproof formula ensures 24h all day long bright coloured flush*. Give Me More . Its ultra sensorial texture that melts seamlessly onto cheeks, so silky that skin does not feel dry but comfortable and weightless, no flaking or caking. Infused with Squalane, Make Me Blush blurs the looks of imperfections and pores on the cheeks, skin looks mattified throughout the day. Infused With Rosehip from YSL Beauty Ourika community gardens for a healthy-looking skin.. Show Me Colour . Coated couture pigments technology, it gives instant colour crush for 24h all day long fresh blushed complexion. Ultra-buildable sheer-to-super bold shades, true-colour payoff.. Make Me Couture . 11 bold and buildable shades for a blush statement.. 2 couture finishes: matte and satin. . Collectable couture shade-matched packaging that make you to want them all.. . Why It’s Escentual: . You shouldn’t judge a product by its packaging, but we’ve made an exception for the Make Me Blush Powder Blush. They’re the talk of our office! The compacts have a padded leather design, similar to the YSL All Hours Hyper Finish and Hyper Bronze. The blushes, however, are round and colour-coded to reflect the colour of the blush inside, so if you plan on picking up more than one shade (highly encouraged), they’ll be easy to differentiate in your makeup bag.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to the apples of the cheeks, and blend along the cheekbone.. .

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Lash Idole Flutter Extension Mascara 8.5ml / Black
listings.description: Ready to step into your length era? The Lancome Lash Idole Flutter Extension Mascara is the ultimate upgrade your makeup bag has been waiting for. Engineered to deliver a jaw-dropping +5.5mm of instant, visible length, this is your new holy grail for high-impact, fan-like volume.. Whether you are channelling your inner pop star or just want an everyday flutter that stands out, this long-wear formula keeps your lashes looking pristine for up to 24 hours. No wonder the global face of Lancôme, Olivia Rodrigo, is completely obsessed.. Why We Love It At Escentual, we are always on the hunt for a mascara that genuinely delivers on its promises, and Lash Idole Flutter Extension does exactly that. The magic is all in the engineering: a super-precise brush packed with 480 ultra-thin micro-bristles. It grips every single lash from root to tip, instantly elongating, separating, and flaring them out without a clump in sight. The lightweight, flake-free formula ensures your flutter stays lifting and locked in place from morning meetings to late-night drinks.. The Results The proof is in the performance. In clinical testing, this powerhouse mascara delivered:. Instant Length: Up to +5.5mm visibly longer lashes.* Maximum Impact: Up to 75% visibly longer lashes right away.* All-Day Power: Up to 24 hours of flawless, smudge-proof wear.. How To Use Place the micro-bristle brush at the base of your lash line. Wiggle and comb the wand through to the tips to coat, separate, and lift. Add a second coat while the formula is still wet for a dramatic, buildable extension effect.. *Instrumental test on 28 women..

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Extraintense Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Mugler Alien Extraintense: . It’s a vanilla twist on the original Alien perfume.. You’ll smell warm, cosy and clean when you wear it.. It’s long-lasting; we could still smell it after 8+ hours.. You can refill your bottle when you finish it.. . . What Mugler Say: . Fiercely addictive. Ferociously feminine. Intensely floral. An extra-sensual twist to the Alien signature. The ultra-addictive creamy vanilla accord is amplified to the extreme by extra-powerful solar flowers. Dare the excessive florality of Alien's jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion lashed with the bright green bite of cardamom and amplified by the carnality of tuberose flowers. Alien's signature cashmeran infuses the scent with the musky aura of sun-heated skin. Elevated by a mighty woody accord, its extreme sensuality creates an extra-powerful trail.. Fragrance family is Woody Floral. Top note is Petitgrain. Heart notes are Tuberose, Jasmine. Base notes are Vanilla, Cashmeran, Amberwood. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Alien has been a divisive fragrance since it launched in 2005. People either love or hate its polarising floral aroma. But those who love it, worship it, us included. Alien is radiant and powerful and Extraintense promises more, but not in the way you’d expect. The 2025 release may be called ‘Extraintense’ but in many ways, it’s softer. The main difference is the addition of vanilla, which makes the composition creamier and cosier. But don’t let its softness fool you, this perfume packs a punch (it’s Alien after all); it’ll be the talking point in any room and last all day.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

The non-oily, fast-absorbing formula contains colour-correcting green pigments for a redness-masking effect, reducing the appearance of flushing and soothing the look of irritated skin.. Fragrance free, non-comedogenic formula. . Key Ingredients This intensive concentrate that combines the ingredients Ambophenol, Neurosensine and Thermal Spring Water.. Thermal Spring Water: a mineral-rich ingredient that instantly soothes irritated and inflamed skin.. A blend of Ambophenol and Neurosensine: to promote a more even skin tone. . The Toleriane Rosaliac Anti-Redness Concentrate Formula: Enriched with probiotic-derived fractions, Neurosensine and La Roche-Posay Thermal Spring Water, this formula instantly hydrates, soothes skin and contains colour-correcting pigments to neutralise redness. . Directions For Use: Apply this lightweight moisturiser morning and evening to the entire face. In the morning, follow with Rosaliac AR SPF 30..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel Refill 400ml
listings.description: Gently cleanse your imperfection-prone skin with the La Roche-Posay Effaclar Foaming Gel, a cleansing gel for oily and sensitive complexions.. A daily, foaming facial cleanser, specifically formulated for oily, blemish-prone skin. Clinically proven to reduce the visibility of blemishes and blackheads.. The purifying formulation lifts dirt, grime and sebum away from the surface of the skin without disrupting its delicate balance. Your skin is left feeling clean and fresh, and is soothed with restorative La Roche-Posay thermal spring water.. Paraben Free. Soap Free.. Powered by Zinc PCA, Thermal Spring Water, Citric Acid and active ingredient Phylobioma - powered by microbiome science – this wash lifts dirt, grime and excess sebum away from the skin surface without disrupting its delicate pH balance. *Refill pouch uses 73% less plastic vs. our 400ml Effaclar Cleanser bottle. . KEY BENEFITS . 90% agree imperfections look reduced* 93% agree pores look less visible^ Number of blackheads looks reduced Leaves skin feeling clean and fresh, looking healthier *Self-assessment, 46 subjects. ^Self-assessment, 63 subjects. . . SPECIFICALLY FORMULATED FOR . Specifically formulated for oily, blemish-prone skin in adults and teenagers. Also suitable for those who may be prone to acne or breakouts. This is a cosmetic product. For medical conditions seek advice from your GP. . DIRECTIONS OF USE . Lather cleanser in hands with warm water. Massage gently onto face, avoiding eye area. Rinse thoroughly. Pat dry. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs rinse thoroughly with water. Can also be used as a body wash. . ROUTINE FOR OILY, BLEMISH-PRONE SKIN . 1. Cleanse to lift dirt and excess oil from the skin surface. Effaclar Gel Cleanser is suitable for oily, blemish-prone skin. Rinse with water and avoid the eye area.. 2. After cleansing, apply Effaclar Duo+M Anti-Blemish Corrective Gel Moisturiser onto your fingers. Blend evenly over your face. Allow product to fully absorb before layering on top.. 3. Follow with daily sun protection with a minimum of SPF30. We recommend Anthelios UVMune 400 Oil Control Fluid.. 4. For fast-acting results on early or raised spots, use Effaclar Duo+M 3HR Spot Patches. Wear for 3-8 hours, in the daytime or overnight. . RECOMMENDED BY DERMATOLOGISTS . La Roche-Posay is the No. 1 Dermatologist recommended brand in GB*. *Study of 78 Consultant Dermatologists Jan-April 2025..

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary GF 15% Solution 30ml

Firms the face and neck, and the jawline looks more lifted and defined.. Helps to promote skin elasticity to reduce the look of lax skin.. The Ordinary GF 15% Solution helps minimise the look of skin damage to regenerate the appearance of ageing skin across the face and neck.. An EGF complex helps to support skin’s natural elasticity and process of skin renewal, to target the appearance of ageing factors like wrinkles, while promoting firmness.. A solution of TGF improves skin’s integrity to minimise the appearance of lines and wrinkles, while promoting skin firmness and elasticity and smoothing skin texture.. Testing Shows: . Instantly Healthier-looking Skin: Immediately improves the look of rough skin and enhances skin radiance. Targets Signs of Ageing: Reduces the appearance of wrinkles.. Ageing Skin Regeneration: Helps restore the appearance of damaged skin.. Firming and Lifting: Firms the face and neck and jawline looks more lifted.. The Ordinary GF 15% Solution is proof that high-performance skincare doesn’t have to come with a luxury price tag. We love how it instantly makes skin look healthier and more resilient, all while staying true to The Ordinary’s mission of delivering science-backed formulas at accessible prices. If you're looking for a no-fuss, effective solution for stronger, smoother skin, this is one to have on your radar.. . The Best Way To Use It: . listings.rawTitle: Roger & Gallet Cologne Twist After Shave Gel 75ml
listings.description: The cult freshness of Sicilian and Calabrian citruses combined with the muscular strength of white woods in a hydrating and soothing aftershave gel. The Cologne Twist Aftershave Gel hydrates and soothes the skin from razor burn, reducing irritations. Applied generously after each shaving, its ultra fresh texture enriched with sage extract penetrates easily without leaving greasy film and let the skin smooth and toned. Associating the freshness of Sicilian and Calabrian citruses, the peppery strength of elemi and the enveloping elegance of white woods, its fragrance provides a feeling of freshness after each shaving..

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Prisme Libre Glow Serum Foundation 30ml / 0N
listings.description: Why You’ll Love The GIVENCHY Prisme Libre Glow Serum: . New and improved version of Prisme Libre Skin-Caring Glow Foundation. . Medium, buildable coverage. . Radiant and blurring finish on the skin. . Ultra-hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid. . Waterproof and transferproof. . . . What GIVENCHY Say: . The serum foundation that improves your skin, even when you take it off. . 24h blurring glow , 24h wear, 48h hydration. . The efficacy of a serum, the performance of a foundation with long wear blur and glow boosted by powerful skincare ingredients. . This high-performance formula from GIVENCHY improves your skin during and after wear. In just 3 weeks, skin is 4X more radiant, more blurred and more visibly hydrated - even after removing the foundation.*** . Unifies, illuminates, hydrates. . . This weightless formula is: . Powered by Micro Hyaluronic Acid that penetrate the deeper layers of the epidermis for long-lasting hydration and by Ceramides Yuzu Extract to help maintain plumped and bouncy skin. . Enriched with 4 color powders**** calibrated to even skin tone and neutralize color imperfections. . Boosted by Prismatic Light™ technology, a blend of soft-focus powders that create a blurring effect while light-reflecting pearls contribute to diffusing the light for natural looking radiance. . . Find Your Shade: . Available in 30 shades, Prisme Libre Glow Serum foundation is designed to suit all skin tones and skin types. Find your shade in 2 easy steps: choose your shade intensity and then, choose your undertone between warm, neutral and cool. . . Tested and approved by dermatologists: . +62% more blur instantly* . -71% less color imperfections instantly* . 4x more blur, more glow and more visible hydration in just 3 weeks*** . . Tested and approved by users: . 100% of users felt their skin is plumped and smoothed**** . 98% of users saw a perfecting & blurring effect**** . 93% of users saw the appearance of pores visibly reduced**** . 93% of users felt their skin quality was visibly improved**** . *Clinical test on correction, perfection and glow 25 volunteers. . **Instrumental test on 30 volunteers. . ***Clinical assessment by a dermatologist on 37 volunteers on the evolution of the product performance. Comparison between the 1st week effects and the effects after the 4th week. After 4 weeks of wear, results measured on bare skin 48h after removing the foundation. . ****Questionnaire after 1 week on 104 panelists in China . . Why It’s Escentual: . The Givenchy Prisme Libre Skin-Caring Glow Foundation (2021) has been upgraded! The French fashion and beauty house has reformulated the base, loved for its skincare-infused formula and glowing-giving finish. The new version, released in early 2025 keeps everything we love about the original but levels it up. Now known as Prisme Libre Glow Serum Foundation, the new formula offers double the hydration, more coverage, and more glow, and will improve your skin even after you take it off. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the foundation directly to your foundation brush, then blend in circular motions from the centre of the face outwards. . .

The serum foundation that improves your skin, even when you take it off. . 24h blurring glow , 24h wear, 48h hydration. . The efficacy of a serum, the performance of a foundation with long wear blur and glow boosted by powerful skincare ingredients. . This high-performance formula from GIVENCHY improves your skin during and after wear. In just 3 weeks, skin is 4X more radiant, more blurred and more visibly hydrated - even after removing the foundation.*** . Unifies, illuminates, hydrates. . . This weightless formula is: . Powered by Micro Hyaluronic Acid that penetrate the deeper layers of the epidermis for long-lasting hydration and by Ceramides Yuzu Extract to help maintain plumped and bouncy skin. . Enriched with 4 color powders**** calibrated to even skin tone and neutralize color imperfections. . Boosted by Prismatic Light™ technology, a blend of soft-focus powders that create a blurring effect while light-reflecting pearls contribute to diffusing the light for natural looking radiance. . . Find Your Shade: . Available in 30 shades, Prisme Libre Glow Serum foundation is designed to suit all skin tones and skin types. Find your shade in 2 easy steps: choose your shade intensity and then, choose your undertone between warm, neutral and cool. . . Tested and approved by dermatologists: . +62% more blur instantly* . -71% less color imperfections instantly* . 4x more blur, more glow and more visible hydration in just 3 weeks*** . . Tested and approved by users: . 100% of users felt their skin is plumped and smoothed**** . 98% of users saw a perfecting & blurring effect**** . 93% of users saw the appearance of pores visibly reduced**** . 93% of users felt their skin quality was visibly improved**** . *Clinical test on correction, perfection and glow 25 volunteers. . **Instrumental test on 30 volunteers. . ***Clinical assessment by a dermatologist on 37 volunteers on the evolution of the product performance. Comparison between the 1st week effects and the effects after the 4th week. After 4 weeks of wear, results measured on bare skin 48h after removing the foundation. . ****Questionnaire after 1 week on 104 panelists in China . . Why It’s Escentual: . The Givenchy Prisme Libre Skin-Caring Glow Foundation (2021) has been upgraded! The French fashion and beauty house has reformulated the base, loved for its skincare-infused formula and glowing-giving finish. The new version, released in early 2025 keeps everything we love about the original but levels it up. Now known as Prisme Libre Glow Serum Foundation, the new formula offers double the hydration, more coverage, and more glow, and will improve your skin even after you take it off. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the foundation directly to your foundation brush, then blend in circular motions from the centre of the face outwards. . .

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Bois Rouge Un Safran Magnifie Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Moncler Bois Rouge Un Safran Magnifie Eau de Parfum: . Fresh, woody, and floral notes, inspired by alpine landscapes.. Its rich, uplifting scent will make you feel confident.. You’ll still smell its long-lasting aroma at the end of the day.. Crafted with high-quality ingredients and luxurious packaging.. . . What Moncler Say: . A fragrance capturing the essence and intensity of woods. . A woody ambery accord blends with a trio of deep and powerful cypriol, patchouli and cedarwood. Saffron, known as 'red-gold', warms the composition with its rich, flamboyant spiciness, whilst cashmeran and cristal moss bring their elegant mineral inflections. . . Fragrance family is Woody. . Top notes is Saffron. . Heart notes is Patchouli. . Base notes is Moss Crystal. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Each Moncler fragrance blends fresh, woody, and floral notes to capture the essence of the great outdoors. Bois Rouge has a deep, rich aroma that's smoky, intense and subtly spicy. "Bois Rouge" translates to "Red Wood" in French. The name evokes imagery of warm, rich woods, hinting at the earthy and inviting qualities of the fragrance.. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Le Teint Glow Foundation 35ml / 0C - Cool/Rose
listings.description: Why You’ll Love The GUERLAIN Terracotta Le Teint Glow Foundation : . Your skin will look hydrated and glowing.. Its medium coverage looks natural yet flawless.. Feels weightless and comfortable.. It won’t transfer and stays all day.. 95% naturally derived ingredients.. 31 shades to choose from.. . . What Guerlain Say: . Following Terracotta Le Teint, with a luminous matte finish, Guerlain is enriching its iconic franchise and putting its expertise to the service of a radiant complexion with Terracotta Le Teint Glow: a liquid foundation, formulated with 95% naturally derived ingredients², ensuring long-wearing³ and no-transfer⁴ hold. Skin is plumped and glowing with health thanks to this makeup essential that creates a fresh and luminous complexion.. Its formula infused with active skincare water delivers 24-hour radiance³ and 48-hour hydration⁵ for a naturally luminous result all day long. Terracotta Le Teint Glow’s ultra-light texture holds the promise of flawless, sensory and intuitive application with a second-skin effect. Its ultra-buildable, tailor-made coverage offers a natural finish, with a barely-there feel.. ¹Clinical test on made-up skin on 42 women. Measurement of the change in the product’s radiance performance. Comparison between the effect immediately after application and the effect after 4 weeks. ²Based on ISO 16128 standard. The remaining 5% contribute to the product integrity and sensoriality. ³Instrumental test on 25 women. ⁴Instrumental test on 32 women. ⁵Instrumental test carried out on 31 women. Terracotta Le Teint Glow’s wide array of 30 shades is made up of 16 intensities and 3 undertones (neutral, cool, warm). Identical to Terracotta Le Teint, this palette allows a made-to-measure result designed for all skin tones. These unique shades remain stable for 24 hours, for a natural glow that lasts until evening.. . . Why It’s Escentual: . If the luminous matte finish of Terracotta Le Teint wasn’t glowing enough for you, you’ll love Le Teint Glow. The original marries powder and foundation, whereas this edition combines skincare and makeup, for a healthy-looking radiant finish that cares for your complexion while you wear it. Like Terracotta Le Teint, Le Teint Glow offers medium, natural-looking coverage that’s transfer-proof and long-lasting.. Le Teint Glow Foundation is a compliment magnet. It's the perfect glow, not too dewy or wet-looking. Instead, your face looks fresh, even, smooth and radiant.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the foundation directly to your foundation brush, then blend in circular motions from the centre of the face outwards..

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Flaky/Itchy Scalp Anti-Dandruff Shampoo Eco Refill Pouch 1000ml
listings.description: Philip Kingsley have made the switch to refill pouches for their 1000ml Flaky/Itchy Scalp Anti-Dandruff Shampoo. Why? Easy to pour and easy to store, they are 100% recyclable and reduce plastic waste by 87%. The new pouches are ready to use as they come, or, simply unscrew the re-closable cap, squeeze the middle of the pouch and decant. Extremely soothing, with a fresh apple fragrance, this shampoo relieves scalp irritation while clearing flakiness and build-up. It is mild enough for daily use, and will leave your hair shiny and manageable. Philip Kingsley' Flaky/Itchy Scalp Shampoo’s exceptional ingredients include Lauryl Betaine, which cleanses without redness or irritation; and anti-microbial Piroctone Olamine, which helps relieve flaking and itching. Unlike other anti-dandruff shampoos, this one won’t dry out your hair or strip it of colour. Use it as your main shampoo, or in conjunction with the recommended shampoo for your hair texture, for an occasional deeper cleanse. An independent consumer perception study was conducted among people with scalp concerns . Here are the results: 100% of people said Flaky/Itchy shampoo SOOTHED their scalp* 100% of people said their scalp felt more COMFORTABLE after using Flaky/Itchy Shampoo* 99% said Flaky/Itchy Shampoo CLEARED their flaky scalp* 90% said they found Flaky/Itchy Shampoo MORE EFFECTIVE than other similar products on the market* *95 person independent consumer perception trial. All participants suffered with dandruff/flaky/itchy scalp. .

No matter what foundation finish you prefer, Shiseido's Self Refreshing Foundation makes skin look healthy and 'perfected' with buildable, medium coverage. Waterproof and oil-free, this foundation recreates a 'just applied' look throughout the day, even you're when up against humidity and exercise; it's a foundation you can always rely on.. As well as a naturally-radiant base, this multi-purpose makeup offers skin all-day hydration and the protection of an SPF30. But what makes this foundation different from any other that you've tried is Shiseido's unique ActiveForce technology, a tech never used before in any foundation. Hour after hour, its breathable, but beautiful finish refreshes itself to create a fresh look favoured by all skin types, but particularly those that feel the need to top up more than others.. . Why We Love It . Shiseido's innovative science labs combine skincare and pigment to make this foundation one of the most pioneering makeup bases to date; this is a foundation that will fit your busy schedule, and never 'get used to your skin', giving you smooth, unified results, every hour of every day.. Even oily t-zones and dehydrated skin types with benefit from its soft, balmy texture. Whether you apply this with a sponge, your fingertips or a brush, you always get flawless results, and even better long-lasting results when your skin is prepped, primed and powdered.. When you get the box home and open it, it's hard not to be wowed by the clean lines of the sophisticated bottle design. To dispense, you need to turn the black lid to the right, then press the button down. You'll notice a little bit goes a long way, but you should always get the correct amount for your whole face in just one pump.. How To Use It . Before you apply, make sure your skin is clean and moisturised. Apply with a sponge or a brush in stippling motions to create the coverage you desire.. Works Well With . If you like the sound of this foundation, the whole Synchro Skin base collection is worth exploring. There are concealers, and primers waiting to take the flawlessness of your complexion to the next level.. Values . Waterproof, smudge-proof, humidity-resistant, transfer-resistant, non-comedogenic.. Fragrance-free, oil-free..

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Synchro Skin Radiant Lifting Foundation SPF30 30ml / 110 Alabaster
listings.description: Why You’ll Love The Shiseido Synchro Skin Radiant Lifting Foundation SPF30: . Medium-to-full, buildable coverage.. Addresses three obstacles to radiance; fine lines and wrinkles, uneven skin tone, and a loss of hydration.. Binds moisture to the skin for 24-hour hydration.. Firms and lifts bare skin over time.. SPF30 protection against UV rays.. 30 shades to choose from.. . What Shiseido Say: . Flawless to the Finish. With continued use, bare skin is firmer and visibly lifted. This 24-hour* longwear foundation illuminates the skin in any light, while also providing hydration for 24-hour**.. TECHNOLOGY: Light-Adjusting™ Technology and skincare ingredients such as again oil and microcrystals tackle signs of ageing, hyperpigmentation, and dryness to achieve a radiant complexion.. IT WORKS: TEST RESULTS. 95% of women reported that the foundation instantly made their skin look more even***. 93% of women reported that the foundation created a smooth finish on their skin***. 93% of women reported that the foundation made their skin look radiant in different lighting conditions.***. 89% of women reported that the foundation made their skin look more lifted and firm***. 90% of women reported that the foundation smoothed and blurred the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.***. 89% of women reported that the foundation reduced the appearance of pores and uneven skin texture.***. *Clinically tested on 31 women. **Instrumental test on 26 volunteers. ***Consumer tested on 100 women.""". . Why It’s Escentual: . We fell for Synchro Skin Self-Refreshing Foundation when it first launched, its weightless feel, long-lasting wear, and self-refreshing technology won us over. Now, there’s even more to love with Synchro Skin Radiant Lifting Foundation! This glow-boosting addition brings the same breathable performance, now enhanced with skincare-infused ingredients that help visibly lift and firm over time. Plus, both formulas have been updated to offer even stronger protection against dryness, UV rays, blue light, and pollution.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the foundation directly to your foundation brush, then blend in circular motions from the centre of the face outwards.. . Values: . Fully recyclable packaging.. Non-comedogenic. Dermatologist-tested.. .

listings.description: Clarins Research has created a firming skincare product with powerful active ingredients that help boost collagen reserves* for firmer skin in just 7 days.**. Wrinkles are smoothed, cheekbones are plumper and facial contours are more defined. . Texture : . Clarins laboratories have combined a unique combination of ingredients to create this enveloping texture that provides a sensation of comfort, without an oily feel. . How to use: . Apply every morning after your serum, pressing gently to promote skin radiance. To complete your routine, apply your night cream every evening. . *Ex vivo test carried out on photoaged explants, measuring the quantity of high quality, well-structured collagen.. **Consumer test, 109 women.. ***In a 50ml pot of cream..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Bright Plus Advanced Brightening Dark Spot-Targeting Expert Serum 30ml
listings.description: The Clarins Bright Plus Advanced Brightening Dark Spot-Targeting Expert Serum works to combat dull, pigmented skin to help reduce the appearance of dark spots and bring a healthy radiance to all skin types, including sensitive.. With many pollutants affecting your skin daily, the Dark Spot Expert Serum fights toxins through its inclusion of purple tea extract and acerola seed extract, the hero ingredients to Clarins' famous double oxygenation technology for evenness and radiance. These specially selected ingredients will help to increase the skin cell's ability to breathe, leading to a healthier and more unified complexion that looks luminous.. Fuelled by plant-power, the lightweight serum is packed with natural ingredients known for their brightening qualities, such as vitamin C and organic sea lily, which will help to reduce pigmentation. It also contains niacinamide to plump and hydrates the skin so that your complexion will look smooth, supple and radiant. The 100 per cent green formula makes the Clarins Bright Plus Expert Serum suitable for even the most sensitive skin, as it works gently and calmly under the surface.. Why We Love It . The texture itself is a combination of an emulsion and serum, producing a white water-like consistency that is fast-absorbing. It can even be mixed with your favourite moisturiser and foundation to create the ideal BB cream or tinted moisturiser, that will bring an immediate glow to your complexion.. How To Use It . Apply to thoroughly cleansed skin morning and evening, before heavier creams. listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . A velvety floral fragrance with creamy cocoa butter and juicy raspberry.. A head-turning and uplifting scent.. Lasts up to 6-hours.. Lancome Say: . Now, this exhilarating emotion of pursuing what matters most to you, has a signature scent: La vie est belle L’Elixir.. Our first velvety floral. More than a scent, a true emotion. Man Extreme is the new addition to the Jimmy Choo Man fragrance collection, made for those with a daring spirit seeking a new adventure. As the first Eau de Parfum in the Man franchise, discover a deeper and more intense fougere aromatic amber scent with an irresistible and powerful trail.. Opening with a burning red thyme fused with the spicy facets of black pepper riding exhilarating lemon notes. In the heart, an aromatic accord is intertwined with the notes of geranium, lavandin and clary sage for an unrivalled fresh sensation. The base anchors a powerful woody ambery masculinity where the sensuality of tonka beans blends with the sophistication of the vetiver raising the addiction to new heights.. This edition is an update to the iconic original square-shaped, silver capped flask, the new version is cast in a vibrant scarlet lacquer. Jimmy Choo Man Extreme is printed in a flash of silver writing, a sensual red printed leather lid houses the bold scent contained within. . Fragrance family: Fougere Aromatic Ambery Top Note: Red Thyme, Black Pepper Heart Note: Clary Sage, Geranium Base Note: Tonka Bean, Vetiver . . Why It’s Escentual: . The Jimmy Choo Man collection has always been about confidence and style. The original (2014) is fresh and modern with melon and patchouli, perfect for every day. Man Blue is a more rugged interpretation with leather, while Aqua's lighter, citrus-woody aroma is ideal to wear in summer and Ice's musky base pairs well with a sophisticated suit. Now, there’s Man Extreme, a bold, energising citrus with earthy depth and spicy warmth, perfect for standing out. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum: . Modern take on the classic Colonia fragrance.. Smells fresh, clean and expensive.. It’s more long-lasting than typical citrus scents.. Men and women will love it.. . What Acqua di Parma Say: . A contemporary reinterpretation of Acqua di Parma's cherished fragrance heritage, presented in a sophisticated Eau de Parfum that exalts the vibrant, golden character of their signature citrus fruits through a refined blend of ylang ylang and patchouli.. A modern and intensified interpretation of the Maison’s first ever fragrance, the iconic Colonia, originally launched in 1916, Colonia Il Profumo draws from the golden radiance of the Italian sun with a refined blend of ylang ylang and patchouli, which enhance and prolong the citrus notes throughout the fragrance.. The top notes feature an exquisite blend of bergamot, grapefruit, blood orange, and petitgrain, delivering an initial burst of fresh, zesty aroma that captivates the senses.. At its heart, Colonia Il Profumo blooms with the aromatic allure of rosemary, the volume, intensity and opulence of ylang ylang, and the unique touch of orange leaves absolute. Ylang ylang was specifically chosen for its multi-dimensional notes that sublimates the golden fruits and their presence throughout the whole sillage adding modernity and richness to a timeless icon.. The base notes are anchored by the sophisticated depth of vetiver oil and patchouli, giving structure and character to the fragrance. The fragrance's yellow hue evokes the warmth of the Italian sun and the zest of citrus fruits, while the bottle features a golden-tinted base for an intense and robust visual experience.. Fragrance family is Citrus Aromatic Chypre. . Top notes are Italian Bergamot, Grapefruit, Blood Orange, Petitgrain. . Heart notes are Rosemary, Ylang Ylang, Orange Leaves Absolute. . Base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Colonia is one of the most famous citrus fragrances in the world. An icon in its own right, Colonia is loved for its timeless, fresh and bright aroma. Colonia Il Profumo takes this classic scent to new heights. The DNA of the original remains, with citrus notes at its heart, but adding ylang-ylang enhances the aroma's depth and longevity. Marking a new chapter in the Colonia story, Profumo smells clean and fresh like its predecessor, but this interpretation feels modern and strikes the perfect balance between masculine and feminine.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

It's makeup with skincare benefits.. Skin looks even, smooth, and demi-matte.. Stays put all day and won’t transfer.. 38 shades to choose from.. . What You Need To Know: . Looks like foundation but works like skincare. Clarins Skin Illusion Full Coverage has been developed to the same exacting standards as a skincare product: its formula is powered by a combination of active ingredients and plant extracts, which include the mattifying and purifying properties of Zinc Gluconate, to reduce the appearance of blemishes, as well as the combined action of hyaluronic acid and plant-based micro patch, which help to hydrate the skin for 24 hours*. This comfortable formula moves with your facial expressions for a long-lasting hold and 12H of luminous matte coverage. The result: smoother skin, a matte but luminous complexion and visibly reduced imperfections! Skin looks more beautiful, even bare, day after day.. *Consumer test, 243 women.. After several years of research into organic oat sugars, Clarins Laboratories have brought their unique properties to Skin Illusion Full Coverage for a long-lasting and comfortable makeup hold.. Oat - forms a film on the skin that helps make-up stay put. White horehound - helps the skin fight against the harmful effects of pollution. Furcellaria - helps protect the skin from pollution and dehydration. Nipplewort - helps to stimulate the skin's natural defences. Zinc Gluconate - Helps reduce the appearance of shiny skin. Acacia Senegal - Helps to protect the skin from dehydration. . . Why It’s Escentual: . We have a special love for Clarins, one of the very first brands we ever stocked. With over 65 years of heritage, the family-owned brand (like us) is celebrated for its unique blend of skincare benefits and makeup artistry. Their foundations not only provide flawless coverage but also hydrate and nourish the skin, making you feel beautiful inside and out. The Skin Illusion Full Coverage is further proof of that - delivering natural-looking coverage while caring for your skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . You can apply this foundation with a sponge, brush, or your fingers, whichever you prefer. Start from the centre of the face and work outward.. .

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Palatine Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Parfums de Marly Palatine Eau de Parfum: . Feminine fragrance that smells clean, soft and comforting.. It’ll make you feel pretty and put together.. Powdery violet accents exude elegance and confidence.. Luxurious purple glass bottle with tassels and mouldings inspired by the 18th-century.. . What Parfums de Marly Say: . This empowering, yet sophisticated Eau de Parfum revolves around a modern floral bouquet enhanced with fresh, fruity and powdery notes. An opening of mandarin, bergamot and pear lead to a daring, contemporary violet petal. For a velvety sensation, the overall fragrance settles on musk and creamy sandalwood.. Palatine encourages confidence, instilling a feeling of assertiveness, and freedom.. Fragrance family is floral-woody-musk. . Top notes are Mandarin, Bergamot, Pear. . Heart notes are Violet Petal, Lavandin, Floral Bouquet. . Base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Every Parfums de Marly fragrance has an intriguing story inspired by the 18th-century French court. Palatine draws its name from Princess Palatine, a free-spirited woman who often visited Chateau de Marly. With its luxurious bottle and exquisite notes, the fragrance is an ode to regal opulence.. Paletine may be inspired by grandeur, but its aroma has a quiet confidence that doesn’t overwhelm the senses but instead hypnotises it.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

A cherry accord gives the floral scent a delicious tartness.. Its powerful silage will fill every room you walk into.. Gem-like ornate glass bottle.. . What Elie Saab Say: . Elie Saab Elixir Love is a manifesto to love that lingers like an unforgettable potion.. A floral bouquet that radiates sensuality.. Brilliant red roses converge with rose essence, dazzling white neroli and luminous jasmine notes. This enticing florality is intensified by an addictive cherry accord. The exquisitely cut spherical bottle is infused with sensual pomegranate shades and gleams like a fiery love potion. The golden cap, signed with the monogram of the House of ELIE SAAB, exemplifies the brand's haute couture expertise.. Elie Saab Elixir Love is a love potion that burns with sensuality.. Base notes are oakmoss, patchouli, ambroxan and love accord. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Red rose petals have taken over the original white floral bouquet of Elie Saab Elixir for this addition to the range. Elixir Love is more romantic and sensual, with a tart-like cherry notethat gives the composition a moreish sweetness that’s hard to resist.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Chloe L’Eau de Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: We are Chloe.. Chloe L'Eau de Parfum Intense captures the emotion and energy of Chloe through four inspiring women who embody the values of the brand. Of different ages and from different backgrounds, they are beautiful, strong, and free. Surrounded by lush nature, they change the direction of the wind itself. A breath of feminine energy spreads to the four corners of the world. A wave of joy, optimism, and freedom. The expression of the power of women according to Chloe.. The Fragrance . Chloe L'Eau de Parfum Intense is an addictive floral fragrance for women that opens with vibrant, juicy raspberry notes, underlining the sensuality of the rose that lies beneath. As alive as if captured at any moment of the day, its strong fragrance evokes at once the fresh morning rose, green and slightly crisp, the open midday rose, rich and deep, and the honeyed evening rose, with its sensual, addictive accents. Then, a bouquet of warm and ambery woods unfolds, each more concentrated than the last. Ambrox brings its musky, woody notes, Cashmeran offers its voluptuous sensuality, and cedar reinforces the fragrance's unique character. A Chloe fragrance that's perfect for any occasion and lasts all day long.. The Bottle . For L'Eau de Parfum Intense, the famous pleated Chloe perfume bottle has been given a new look, now stamped with a sleek black and ecru label for an even more modern and refined style. Its ribbon has also taken on a new, deep garnet hue, echoing the fragrance's composition and the flower at its heart. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum Spray : . White floral fragrance that exudes strong, feminine energy.. Coconut and palm flowers make the scent creamy and sun-kissed.. You’ll still be able to smell it on your skin after 4+ hours.. Created by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm.. . . What YSL Say: . LIBRE FLOWERS & FLAMES, the signature LIBRE scent, enhanced with a sultry floral blast. Radiant and feminine, featuring the unique and luscious desert lily, with a sun-kissed palm flower accord. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty.. LIBRE, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s enduring spirit of empowering people to live their lives as authentically and unapologetically as possible. Since 1961 authenticity has dressed the YSL woman: fierce, bold, unapologetic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody LIBRE is British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa.. For those who are unafraid to ignite their freedom and blaze their own trail, YSL Beauty introduces LIBRE FLOWERS & FLAMES. A true floral fragrance, characterised by sensual orange blossom, luscious desert lily, and a sun-kissed palm flower accord, for a uniquely radiant bouquet.. The new LIBRE FLOWERS & FLAMES brings a captivating femininity to the original LIBRE olfaction. Unapologetically floral but with arrestingly original notes, the fragrance is an immediate enveloping embrace as it adorns the skin. Opulent and sensual orange blossom absolute, LIBRE’s signature heart note, intertwines with the unique and luscious desert lily. In tribute to Yves Saint Laurent’s favourite flower, this masterful accord is composed of white floral notes, set ablaze by a spicy clove note characteristic of the lily's natural scent. Vanilla further intensifies the lily flower’s warmth, conjuring the thought of searing sand. In contrast to these incandescent notes, a sun-kissed palm flower accord reproduces the unique scent of the Moroccan bloom. With hints of coconut, monoi, ylang-ylang and jasmine, it imparts a pleasing creamy softness to the fragrance.. Fragrance family is solar floral. . Top notes are Lavender, Bergamot. . Heart notes are Orange Blossom, Lavender, Coconut, Lily, Palm Flower Accord. . Base notes are Vanilla. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Libre Flowers and Flames is feminine and fierce. It celebrates all sides of being a woman; it’s soft and balanced yet bold and sensuous. It has DNA similar to previous Libre perfumes, but the coconut in this composition smoothes it out and makes it less heady. We love its tagline ‘Don’t Bloom, Blaze’; it’s a perfume that will make anyone who wears it feel comfortable in their skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C12 Serum 30ml
listings.description: Reveal your skin's health with the La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C12, a radiance-revealing formula suitable for all skin types that will fight free radical damage and add vitality to the complexion.. Skin ageing can be caused by many things. Genetic factors account to 30% of the ageing process due to the slow down of the metabolism of skin cells, with the remaining 70% is caused by exposure to external factors such as UV rays, pollution, infrared and tobacco smoke. Created to address this issue, and specifically formulated to be suitable for use on sensitive skin, Pure Vitamin C12 is the first serum formulated at a physiological pH of 5.5 which offers the best tolerance for sensitive skin and helps to preserve the skin's barrier function.. Enriched with 12% pure vitamin C, otherwise known as ascorbic acid, this biologically active form of vitamin C will brighten, stimulate collagen production and reduce the damage of free radicals. The inclusion of 0.45% salicylic acid will smooth and exfoliate away dead skin cells, while a duo of neurosensine and La Roche-Posay's own thermal spring water will eliminate inflammation, soothe redness and relieve sensitivity.. Why We Love It . With regular use, Pure Vitamin C12 will reveal a younger-looking complexion, diminishing fine lines and wrinkles and encouraging a healthy vitality. Plus, thanks to it being housed within a bright orange UV filtered bottle, the active molecules within the serum will be protected from UV rays-induced degradation, so you can count on the long term stability of the formula.. How To Use It . Apply in the morning before your moisturiser.. Works Well With . Why not complete your anti-ageing routine with the rest of the La Roche-Posay Anti-Ageing Face Care collection? Whether you're concerned with addressing signs of dullness, the delicate eye area or you're looking for your new deep wrinkle combatting go-to, this collection will cater to you..

If you fall under this category, then the Uriage Hyseac SOS Paste is sure to become your new must-have. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Top Secrets Gentle Biphase Expert Makeup Remover 200ml
listings.description: Remove all traces of mascara and lipstick with the Yves Saint Laurent Top Secrets Gentle Biphase Expert Make-Up Remover, a bi-phase formula that works on even the most sensitive eyes.. Without dragging or tugging, the Top Secrets Expert Make-Up Remover gently dissolves waterproof mascara and long-lasting lip colours. Its refreshing and hydrating formula is super comfortable to use and a little bit goes a long way.. Just what you need if you're looking for speedy removal, this YSL make-up remover comforts and soothes eyes without leaving an oily, or greasy film.. Why We Love It . Simply put, it'll transform your cleansing routine tenfold. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Top Secrets Instant Makeup Remover Micellar Water 200ml
listings.description: Intensely refresh your skin with the Yves Saint Laurent Top Secrets Instant Makeup Remover Micellar Water, a refreshing all-in-one micellar water for all skin types.. A beauty lovers' favourite, the Top Secrets Instant Makeup Remover Micellar Water is essential for speedy makeup removal. Create for those who are constantly on-the-go and don't have a lot time to spare, this fast and efficient micellar water will dissolve makeup and impurities with ease..
