For heavy makeup, use this as a first step before using a rinse-off cleanser..

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray Refill 150ml
listings.description: Le Sel d'Issey by Issey Miyake -- the dynamic new men's perfume. Introducing the new refillable eau de toilette for men by Issey Miyake -- Le Sel d'Issey. Salt particles are suspended within clear water. As water evaporates, salt crystallizes, leaving its sensorial scent on the skin. The senses sharpen, and energy moves forward. The power of salt brings flavour to life.. A fresh woody-marine masculine fragrance. Made with 95% natural origin ingredients, and 100% natural origin French alcohol, this woody-marine vegan perfume encapsulates the essence of salt. Expressing perpetual motion, from the sea to the land, it is composed of two olfactive polarities. The salty polarity reveals a vibrant salt accord combining natural origin marine seaweed and natural origin oak moss. The earthy polarity is infused with intense woody notes of natural sand vetiver and upcycled cedarwood -- a natural ingredient sourced from furniture making. Effervescent natural ginger enhances the vitality of the salt accord.. Le Sel d'Issey reveals the fragrance of scentless salt. A masculine eau de toilette with a powerful freshness.. A perfume bottle inspired by salt. Designed by Tokujin Yoshioka, Le Sel d'Issey features a pure aesthetic, embodying the energy of salt. Revealing the light grey fragrance within, the transparent bottle is made with 20% recycled glass.. With the same salt-inspired shade of natural grey, the outer pack's matte texture is reminiscent of salt crystals. The box is made -- for the first time -- from 10% upcycled natural seaweed, along with material from well-managed, FSC(TM)-certified forests and other controlled sources.. Available in 50ml and 100ml sizes, Le Sel d'Issey is refillable with a 150ml refill format. Made in France.. How to refill your bottle? . You can refill the Le Sel d'Issey eau de toilette bottle using the 150 ml refill.. Step 1: Unscrew the pump dispenser from your Le Sel d'Issey eau de toilette bottle.. Step 2: Screw the refill onto the bottle. Refilling will automatically stop once the bottle is full.. Step 3: Screw the pump dispenser back on and close your Le Sel d'Issey eau de toilette bottle.. Refilling your bottle: a simple gesture. .

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette Refillable Spray 50ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey: . Its woody-aromatic fragrance smells clean and fresh.. Vegan formula made with 95% natural origin ingredients.. Created by Master Perfumer, Quentin Bisch.. The refillable bottle is by internationally renowned designer Tokujin Yoshioka.. . . What Issey Miyake Say: . Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette is the dynamic new vegan perfume by Issey Miyake, harnessing the power of salt. Water. Copious and crystal-clear. Within its vital current, salt, elusive and imperceptible, is carried. As water evaporates, the salt crystalises, leaving its tactile fragrance upon the skin. A surprising scent that awakens the senses, salt reveals the flavour of life. Flow with the movement and feel your pulse beat. Savour the vitality.. Made with 95% natural origin ingredients and 100% natural origin French alcohol, Le Sel d'Issey is a fresh, woody marine perfume. A vegan fragrance in which the power of salt is revealed by masculine earthy notes. With this new Eau de Toilette, perfumer Quentin Bisch gives scentless salt a fragrance, bringing an olfactory dimension to the otherwise odourless substance. This vibrant perfume journeys from the sea to the land, expressed through two olfactive polarities. The salty polarity encapsulates the sea with its vigorous salt accord. Natural origin marine seaweed blends with natural origin oak moss '” a type of algae that migrated inland, linking to the fragrance's second olfactive polarity. Enhancing the freshness of the salt accord, notes of sparkling ginger rush forth in the earthy polarity. Woody notes reveal their intensity, infusing the fragrance with density and texture. Natural sand vetiver combines with cedarwood '” a natural upcycled ingredient distilled from side stream dust in furniture making. The dynamic interplay between the salty and earthy polarities invigorates the fragrance, for a raw and powerful masculinity.. Fragrance family is woody aromatic. . Top notes are sea salt and ginger. . Heart notes are seaweed and vetiver. . Base notes are cedarwood and oakmoss. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Le Sel D’Issey is a unique fragrance that goes beyond beauty; it’s a work of art. Quentin Bisch is the Master Perfumer behind it; he created iconic scents like Parfums de Marly Delina and Mugler Angel Muse. For Le Sel D’Issey, Bisch has imagined the smell of salt, resulting in an extremely wearable, crisp, masculine aroma that's laidback and charming with an intriguing twist.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. . Sustainability And Values: . The refillable bottle is made with 20% recycled glass.. The cardboard packaging is from FSC-certified forests and contains 10% upcycled seaweed.. .

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Southern Bloom Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: Southern Bloom honours the rare and enchanting native scented flower, the Boronia during its short September 'spring-bloom', on Australia's southernmost island, Bruny off the coast of Tasmania.. The absolute of boronia is distinctive and one of the most expensive perfume materials in the world.. An immediately lavish, pure and sensational floral-woody fragrance, with a smooth, velvety sensation and glimpses of exquisite green notes combined with red coloured fruity notes. Opulent, feminine, sophisticated and intensely luxurious..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Blue Cypress Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: A haze of light incense fuses with the scents of the morning in a deep blue-green forest. Blue Cypress is inspired by the scent of dew evaporating from soft foliage as the cool air blows over a rainbow of towering eucalyptus and cypress trees. . Blue Cypress is a sophisticated fragrance of rich woods and aromatic spices that is at once invigorating and grounding. The cobalt-coloured Australian Blue Cypress provides a fragrant woody base, lifted by a fusion of invigorating lavender and exotic patchouli, clove and star anise. A fragrance for men and women, inspired by the scent of dew evaporating from soft foliage as the sun casts its morning rays across a rainbow of towering eucalyptus and cypress trees. .

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Velvet Splendour Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: Velvet Splendour is like holding a large bunch of sunburnt wildflowers in both arms and pressing one's face gently into it. An impressionist's painting of a long drive through the open, breezy and cloudless countryside.. The mimosa (wattle) tree bursting into bloom, marking the first sign of spring in Australia. Soft yellows are shaded against blue skies. The first inhale is an immediate mix of green stems, yellow blooms, cool air and warm light. Bold, sensual and glamorous..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Elixir Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: Dark and excessive, Silky Woods Elixir is a smoky reawakening of the Australian Agarwood originally used in Silky Woods Eau de Parfum.. This exotic botanical is one of the most mysterious and revered essences in perfumery.. Meticulously crafted with fig, saffron, orris, and syrupy balsam to reveal both the complex heart of agarwood and its verdant foliage, this woody and gourmand perfume is rich with luxurious intensity and sensuality.. A woody and gourmand perfume, Silky Woods Elixir is for true connoisseurs.. Committed to showcasing Australia's world-leading expertise in botanical research and development, Goldfield & Banks has encased this creation in packaging as lavish as the scent it holds.. Every French glass bottle is coated in a russet lacquer, in a tribute to the precious Agarwood found deep in the dark and secretive rainforests in Far North Queensland. Reminiscent of the lush tropical flora, this bottle represents the unmatched opulence and richness of perfumes in ancient times..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Wood Infusion Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the lush nature of the balmy heritage listed Fraser Island in the Pacific Ocean, Wood Infusion is a celebration of all wood species found around the island. This fragrance is an exotic infusion of Australian woods enriched with Sandalwood Album, Iris and velvety Agarwood (Oud Wood).. The perfume exudes the creamy, rich and quintessentially Australian scent of the eucalypt, the buttery and fragrant sandalwood, and the exotic and sumptuous agarwood.. This unique combination offers men and women a sensation of a creamy and rich scent crafted from nature's most noble botanicals..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Mystic Bliss reflects upon the Aurora Australis, adorning the starry night sky over Tasmania. Cooled by pure Antarctic air, the delicate violet hues of fig fruit and cassis lend colour to aromatic notes of native Kunzea, cardamom, clary sage and immortelle. The vigour of cedarwood and hypnotic incense fused with the powdery softness of orris leaves a celestial trail that is grounding, calming and addictive.. An invigorating perfume of aromatic notes, heady woods and ripe fig, Goldfield & Banks presents an olfactory interpretation of southern Australia's rugged charm, its ethereal beauty and its enduring mystery with Mystic Bliss. A perfume for men and women..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Island Lush Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: South Pacific Sandalwood; the epitome of wild tropical beauty. Carnal and bountiful, Island Lush is a sumptuous perfume with a heart of precious woods. A wind of exoticism transports you on a journey to islands beyond the horizon, where radiant spices, vegetal roots and luscious resins envelop smooth wood species.. A masterful blend of buttery South Pacific Sandalwood, rich in bourbon-like vanilla nuance and orris powderiness, and the greener, spicier, smokier Australian Sandalwood, Island Lush offers a Sandalwood heart as enchantingly nuanced as it is seductive, embellishing it further in swathes of vetiver, leather, and indulgent benzoin..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Encased in molten gold and infused with precious Agarwood, Silky Woods is the aptly named debut fragrance in a new luxury collection called the Botanical Series by Goldfield & Banks.. Showcasing the precious wood species harvested sustainably for the first time in perfume history in the Daintree Rainforest in Tropical Queensland, Silky Woods is a delightful and delicate yet very sensual blend that captures Australia's sensorial experience.. To a modern sillage of suede, exotic vanilla and smoky tobacco leaves, Goldfield & Banks has added refined essences of saffron, incense, ylang ylang and native sandalwood.. Silky Woods is a celebration of the abundance of organic ingredients in Australia, and the home-grown innovation with which they are transformed into essences coveted across the globe.. Silky woods offers a fragrance expressing a new olf active discovery - a wood species named agarwood, secretly harvested with the highest scientific standards in tropical Australia. Silky Woods is delicate yet sensual, and to enhance its exotic sillage of suede, vanilla and smoky tobacco leaves, Goldfield & Banks adds to the perfume refined essences of saffron, incense, ylang ylang and Australian sandalwood.. An exotic perfume of woods, spices and vanilla that carries Silky Woods from dusk to dawn..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Purple Suede Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tasmanian lavender - a French affair. Born of Provence lavender introduced to Tasmania's rich climate a century ago, Purple Suede expresses the scent of aromatic fields of sunburnt lavender, where blossoms are crisped by the fierce heat of the sun. Paired with the scent of rust-coloured saddles, this perfume reveals a distinctively rich and dry sillage.. Purple Suede is the beguiling new addition to the Goldfield & Banks Botanical Series.. A leathery aromatic perfume of lavender, pink pepper, hyssop flowers, civet, smoky woods and dark amber that encapsulates the dry heat of Australian summers among fields of purple.. An olfactory imagination expressing the scent of aromatic fields of sunburnt lavender, where blossoms are crisped by the fierce heat of the sun. Paired with the scent of rust-coloured saddles, this sensual perfume reveals a distinctively rich and dry sillage. A contemporary and unexpected take on lavender and leather..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks White Sandalwood Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: This heavenly, sophisticated scent stands out because of its unique blend of exotic spices and rich wood. It evokes the fragrance of sizzling scented oil flowing down the balmy leaves of a sacred tree.. A sophisticated scent that is at once both exotic and richly enveloping. White sandalwood and amber provide a comforting base, while saffron, pepper and thyme cast an exotic dry heat, tempered by a heart of sweet powdery Turkish rose.. Delightful, comforting and elegant..

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Desert Rosewood Perfume Spray 100ml
listings.description: This unusual, resinous and comforting leathery fragrance reveals an exceptional encounter between a rainbow of woods and the spectacular Australian desert under the burning sun.. Desert Rosewood presents a rich, amber and woody fragrance that evokes thick, arid deep forests. A heady rush of resinous Australian Desert Rosewood reveals a sweetness of mandarin and vanilla, before finally settling into an exotic blend of wood and spices.. The perfect scent for women and men who love amber, vanilla and leathery notes..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Lait Anti-Dryness Body Lotion 48HR 400ml
listings.description: Deeply hydrate dry, uncomfortable skin with the La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Milk, a lightweight body moisturiser with lipid-restoring properties.. Containing 20% Shea butter and canola oil (rich in Omega 3 and 6), Lipikar Body Milk immediately soaks into dry skin, helping to replenish lipids and reinforce the skin's natural barrier properties.. The skin's barrier is restored and nourished, with regained suppleness. Apply once a day to the skin of both children and adults.. DERMATOLOGICALLY TESTED: Lipikar has been through rigorous dermatological testing to ensure it is suitable for use on even the most sensitive skin - including on babies from 3 months +.. The minimalist formula contains the best of our creations - designed for sensitive skin and all of its needs. Tested and re-tested for its efficacy and mildness on sensitive skin. listings.rawTitle: DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love DKNY 24/7: . It smells fresh, clean, and pretty.. It will make you feel joyful and feminine.. It's a modern take on a rose perfume. . Unique, hourglass-shaped chrome bottle.. . What DKNY Say: . Step into the pulsating rhythm of New York with DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum, a Textural Floral Woody fragrance as dynamic as the city itself.. Experience the energetic rush of Times Square with a burst of pink pepper, then embrace a diverse tapestry of a blooming rose heart. Finally, the lingering embrace of cedarwood and musk embodies the city's enduring sophistication and strength. DKNY 24/7 is a tribute to those who live life with no limits always ready, always moving, and always on.. Fragrance family is Floral Woody. . Top notes are Pink Pepper, Rhubarb. . Heart notes are Rose, Jasmine Sambac, Tuberose, Quince. . Base notes are Cedarwood, Ambrox, Sandalwood, Musk. . . Why It’s Escentual: . We’ve been eagerly awaiting a new female fragrance range from DKNY, and 24/7 was worth the wait! It brings something unique to the brand’s collection and stands out in a sea of new perfumes with its chrome bottle and mouth-watering juice created by Master Perfumer Frank Voekl, who says, “It’s a well-balanced juice, full of energy…”. 24/7 is a bright, fruity-floral-woody aroma that's perfect for every day and will be a fail-safe choice for fans of DKNY, and those who want a floral fragrance with an intriguing twist.. The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.description: Why You’ll Love BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum Spray: . A bright, floral perfume that’s sophisticated and feminine.. It’s a more intense version of Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette.. It’s long-lasting, so you don’t need to keep topping up.. Master Perfumer, Alberto Morillas created it.. . . What Bvlgari Say: . A more precious and intense interpretation of Bulgari’s most iconic feminine fragrance. Crafted around the same signature accords of Nashi Pear and Lotus as the Eau de Toilette, Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum pushes the boundaries of creativity and olfactive craftsmanship with a new composition signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. The Eau de Parfum exalts the beauty of the original vision with three new vibrant gems of nature: Green Mandarin essence, Jasmine absolute and Sandalwood essence.. To express new levels of radiant confidence and add a rich florality to the heart of the Eau de Parfum, Alberto Morillas has selected Jasmine. And not just any Jasmine: for the first time in its fragrances’ creation, Bulgari introduces the Jasmine harvested from the “Flower Gems of India” program. The initiative leverages permaculture principles to create a new sustainable jasmine farming model and is a living example of Bulgari's long-term commitment to the highest standards of ethics in sourcing and production.. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, Omnia's iconic flacon's curves are warmed up by subtle pink nuances, elegantly playing with light and rose gold reflections.. Fragrance family is floral woody. . Top note is pear. . Heart note is jasmine. . Base note is sandalwood. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum is a more intense version of the original. Fans of the first will recognise it; it has the same accords alongside new additions that improve the perfume’s longevity (we could smell it 6+ hours after application). The Eau de Parfum is clean and sharp; it’s a soft floral scent that’s elegant and pretty.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. How To Refill: . Remove the bottle cap, then unscrew the fragrance pump, and screw the refill onto the bottle’s neck. The refill will stop automatically once the perfume bottle is filled. Unscrew the refill, screw the fragrance pump back onto the bottle and replace the cap.. .

listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . A refined, smoky fragrance for all genders.. Spicy-leather aroma that's vegan-friendly.. Crafted by British fragrance house, Miller Harris.. Edith Wharton's "The Age of Innocence".. . Notes: . Top notes: Cinnamon Leaves*, Cardamom Co2*, Organic Ginger*, Clove buds* Saffron. . Heart notes: Rose, Sambac, Jasmine*, Leather, Honey. . Base notes: Tobacco*, Ambergris, cade* Benzoin Siamm* Cedarwood*. *Natural raw materials . . Fragrance Family: . Woody Floral Spicy. . Miller Harris Say . The forbidden love of two characters meeting in a New York apartment. A fragrance that ignites the senses with its intoxicating opening blend of ginger, cardamom, clovebuds and cinnamon and saffron. The cocktail of spices merge with a floral heart of rose, touched with a subtle sweetness of honey that bring delicacy. A deep smoky blend of Chinese cedarwood, tobacco and benzoin round off this alluring scent.. Addictive and smoky, the scent is inspired by a page taken from the novel 'An Age of Innocence' . Why It's Escentual: . Karine Vinchon-Spehner's olfactory interpretation of Edith Wharton's The Age of Innocence is a captivating exploration of forbidden desire. Set against the backdrop of New York society, the fragrance weaves a tale of passion and restraint.. Delicate rose notes, a nod to the novel's refined characters, intertwined with the sweetness of honey, symbolising the underlying longing.. A complex blend of spices evokes the allure of the exotic and the underlying tension between societal expectations and personal desires. Smoky Chinese cedarwood and tobacco notes create a sense of intimacy reminiscent of private moments and hidden passions, while ambergris adds a touch of opulence and nostalgia, capturing the essence of old-world romance. . .

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Mineir Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . A sophisticated, aromatic fragrance.. Fresh, oceanic scent, vegan-friendly.. Crafted by British fragrance house, Miller Harris.. Inspired by Virginia Woolf's "To the Lighthouse.". . . Notes: . Top notes: Green Grass, Crispy Sage*, Eucalyptus*, Cardamom Guatemala*, Mint. . Heart notes: Sea Salt, Cold Air, Dark Cashmere Wood, Cedarwood, White Flowers. . Base notes: Moss, Myrrh*, Papyrus*, Patchouli*, Dry Woods. *Natural raw materials . . Fragrance Family: Aromatic / Aquatic. . Miller Harris Says: . "The isolation and cold nights of the lighthouse. Ravaged cliffs and icy water set the backdrop of 'Mìneir' with crisp aromatic notes of sage, eucalyptus and mint bringing a crisp darkness to this evocative scent.. A refreshing fragrance that captures the invigorating essence of crisp, cold and dark water. With notes reminiscent of icy water on dark cliff rock and cool, clean air, it revitalizes the senses and leaves a trail of pure freshness in its wake.. Aromatic green notes blend with the cold and and dark notes of the aquatic rock face. A brightness is found in a plush white floral note, while Patchouli brings a depth and earthiness along with Moss and Myrrh.. Dive into the depths of 'Mìneir' a fragrance inspired by a single page from the novel 'To the Lighthouse'.". . Why It's Escentual: . Miller Harris' Stories collection transforms literary inspiration into perfume. Mineir is a perfect example of this artistry. Perfumer Emilie Bouge sought to recreate the icy, dark night air described in Woolf's novel, capturing the exhilarating sensation of freedom and isolation. This fragrance is a testament to the power of scent to evoke emotions and transport us to different worlds.. .

For BVLGARI, this is more than a narrative; it is a commitment to timelessness. This philosophy is echoed in the scent’s signature flacon, featuring a refillable design and the iconic BVLGARI engravings that honour the Maison’s heritage of Roman craftsmanship and sustainable luxury.. The Design The Wood Essence bottle is a stunning fusion of Roman architectural precision and contemporary Italian audacity. Its structured, geometric silhouette feels powerful in the hand, while the warm golden hues and deep forest greens reflect the vibrant, life-affirming energy of the forest floor.. Why You’ll Love This Set Perfect for the fragrance connoisseur or as a sophisticated gift, this set ensures you are never without your signature scent. The 100ml Eau de Parfum provides a bold statement for your daily ritual, while the 15ml miniature is the ideal travel companion for maintaining your elemental edge on the go.. This Gift Set Contains: . BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml. BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum Miniature 15ml.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum Spray : . A statement white floral fragrance with hints of pepper and vanilla.. It’s a more intense version of the original MYSLF, lasting 8+ hours!. It’s a sensual scent that’ll make you feel confident and powerful.. Sleek, matte black bottle design.. . . What YSL Say: . MYSLF Le Parfum, the new radical intensity. Highly sensual, with a velvety vanilla and amber trail. MYSLF, the masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent.. An expression of who you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions.. My scent, MYSLF. Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty.. YSL MYSLF LE PARFUM SCENT More intense. More powerful. More sensual. MYSLF Le Parfum isn’t a reinvention of the original - it’s a radicalization. With a lavish dose of orange blossom, paired with layers of textured wood, MYSLF is a woody floral fragrance. For MYSLF Le Parfum this floral-wood fusion discovers new depths. As it opens, the soaring shiny freshness of bergamot is met with a multifaceted cocktail of spices - the sweet warmth of cinnamon, the bite of black pepper, the zesty.. MYSLF Le Parfum, the new radical intensity. Highly sensual, with a velvety vanilla and amber trail.. MYSLF, the masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. . An expression of who you are, with all your nuances.. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions.. My scent, MYSLF. . Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty.. . Fragrance family is woody floral. . Top note is a vibrant & spicy accord with black pepper essence. . Heart note is a radiant & rich orange blossom absolute heart. . Base note is a wood accord with velvety vanilla bourbon infusion. . . Why It’s Escentual: . MYSLF Le Parfum has a similar DNA to the Eau de Parfum. Both are orange blossom fragrances through and through, but the Le Parfum takes things up a notch. The Le Parfum isn’t as bright or airy, which makes it more of an evening, date-night fragrance choice. The orange blossom is bold and intoxicating, paired with spices and vanilla, which give the composition an addictive creaminess that is suave and masculine.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . An elegant, soft but spicy rose scent that will boost your confidence.. Elevates your every day with its distinguished rose aroma and sleek bottle design.. Heart notes: Rose Bulgaria Oil, Geranium, Fresh Black Pepper.. Base notes: Vetiver Oil, Gaiac Wood, Cedarwood.. . Acqua di Parma Say: . Luce di Rosa is the sublimation of a contemporary and dynamic rose sculpted by light that counters mineral sharpness with a chiaroscuro effect. It gives life to a multifaceted gender-neutral scent whose vibrant, clean, and bright notes are reminiscent of a symphony that alternates between piano and forte, adagio and vivace.. Luce di Rosa, an embodiment of contrasts and dynamism, is a gender-neutral Signatures of the Sun fragrance that illuminates the essence of rose with the unexpected prism of vibrant sophistication.. A fragrance sculpted by light that unfolds like a radiant glow, blending luminous citrus notes with warm undertones. The fragrance opens with an invigorating citrus blend, where Bergamot and Mandarin intertwine and is heightened by the spicy nuances of fresh Black Pepper and Pink Pepper CO2 extract, alongside the subtle accents of Cardamom Oil. At its heart, Luce di Rosa flourishes with the noble Bulgarian Rose Oil, the centrepiece of this olfactive masterpiece, extracted through steam-water distillation to capture the essence of the rose at its most vibrant, with a unique olfactory profile that is rosy, green, and spicy, with hints of honey. This dynamic rose is complemented by the verdant Geranium Oil, creating a floral and profoundly rich core. In the base, Luce di Rosa settles into a deep, grounding essence of Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, and Cedarwood, all enveloped by the soft, sensual embrace of Musk nuances, crafting a finale that unveils and reflects ever-different sensations over time.. . Luce di Rosa's elegant blend of rose, citrus, and spice creates a captivating aroma perfect for any occasion. With its long-lasting formula and sleek bottle, this perfume is a luxurious addition to your collection. Whether you're heading to a special event or simply want to elevate your everyday routine, Luce di Rosa will leave a lasting impression.. .

listings.description: Moscado, the new Eau de Parfum draws its inspiration from musk, a unique and extraordinary odorous raw material that historically became fundamental to the development of perfumery in Venice, so much so that perfumers were called Muschieri. listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum: . Its bright, citrusy scent will make you feel positive and energised.. People will smell its juicy citrus top notes from across the room.. Refreshing and invigorating fragrance that's perfect for everyday.. It's earthy-green dry down reminds people of the iconic Creed Aventus.. It lasts a lot longer than traditional citrus fragrances - 7+ hours on us!. . . What Versace Say? . Love, passion, beauty, and desire. Eros Energy is a citrus woody perfume that pays tribute to the Greek God of love through its joyful reincarnation of the original Eros Eau de Parfum.. The powerful sillage and long-lasting presence of the fragrance symbolise the enduring power of love and beauty, while fresh waves of citrus pay homage to the breathtaking serenity of the Mediterranean coastline. Playfulness and intrigue are found at the heart of the fragrance through surprising and delicious notes of pink peppercorn and sharp blackcurrant. Finally, this spirited scent is rounded off with warm green notes of patchouli and oakmoss, providing a deep and earnest tribute to the natural world.. Fragrance family is citrus woody. . Top notes are Italian Bergamot, Blood Orange Italian Orpur, Peruvian Lime Oil. . Heart notes are Vert de Mandarin, Italy Orpur Grapefruit, Italian Lemon. . Base notes are Patchouli, Indonesia Orpur, Musk Oakmoss. . . Why It's Escentual: . Versace Eros Energy screams summer. It's everything we love about the original fresh-woody Eros, but brighter and sweeter. The original blue bottle is yellow, and the composition contains notes like lemon and grapefruit, which give it a happy and sunny disposition. Energy is a bright, playful Eau de Parfum that'll make those who wear it feel confident and positive.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle L'Elixir Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . A velvety floral fragrance with creamy cocoa butter and juicy raspberry.. A head-turning and uplifting scent.. Lasts up to 6-hours.. Lancome Say: . Happiness starts with you. It starts with a commitment to yourself. It means having the confidence to follow your intuition and to defy expectations. It’s a belief embodied by the fierce human who has never been afraid to follow her desire: true happiness. Now, this exhilarating emotion of pursuing what matters most to you, has a signature scent: La vie est belle L’Elixir.. Our first velvety floral. More than a scent, a true emotion. An unexpected sillage built around the clash of a noble violet leaf absolute and a delicious cocoa butter absolute, evoking the liberation that comes with radical act of self-love.. More than a bottle, a crystal statement. It captures L’Elixir’s contrast of femininity, in the curves of its crystal smile that emerges from the glass, with the fragrance’s boldness, symbolized by the bottle’s sharp and sleek silhouette. What makes it different Two renowned french perfumers - Christophe Raynaud and Antoine Maisondieu reinvent the scent of happiness. The result? A head-turning and uplifting scent that that embraces the most noble ingredients. Reimagined by Suzanne Dalton - a famous glass designer - the iconic La vie est belle’s smile speaks to the highest craftsmanship, where for the first time the iconic La vie est belle’s smile is engraved in the glass and can be felt under the fingers of the person holding it.. Notes of sparkling raspberry accord, intertwined with the brightness of bergamot, open the fragrance. Heightening the scent's intensity, the velvety violet is amplified by the rose heart absolute, evoking a floral and modern fragrance. L'Elixir's sensuality is revealed through the delicious effect of a cocoa butter absolute, enhanced by a leather accord and the depth from an elegant cedar virginia wood. . Why It's Escentual . Introducing L'Elixir , a captivating new fragrance reimagining the iconic La Vie Est Belle. Crafted by the same master perfumers, Christophe Raynaud and Antoine Maisondieu this darker, fruitier, and creamier scent offers a bold and alluring experience. . Immerse yourself in a symphony of floral and gourmand notes. L'Elixir opens with a burst of juicy raspberries and zesty bergamot, followed by a heart of sweet violet and rose absolute. The fragrance concludes with a warm, inviting base of leather, cocoa butter, and cedarwood. . A Bold Statement: . L'Elixir is perfect for those who crave a powerful and unforgettable scent. Its intense projection and long-lasting wear make it a standout choice for any occasion. . Sustainability Matters: . Lancome's commitment to the environment is reflected in L'Elixir's refillable bottle and recyclable packaging. You can enjoy your fragrance while minimizing your impact on the planet. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Double Serum - Complete Age-Defying Concentrate 50ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love Clarins Double Serum: . New and improved (9th generation) version of the iconic formula.. Works over time to restore your skin's vitality.. Targets the root causes of ageing.. Helps to diminish fine lines, improve texture, and restore radiance.. New sustainable packaging made from 94% recyclable materials.. Completely customisable dispensing for a personalised skincare experience.. . . What Clarins Say: . Double Serum is pushing the boundaries of anti-ageing innovation and reinventing itself in a new generation with the power to change your skin's future. Its unique dual formula, consisting of/containing 95% naturally-sourced ingredients combines 22 powerful plant extracts, including the iconic turmeric extract, with 5 new pure active molecules to boost the skin's 5 vital functions. Inspired by the science of epigenetics, Clarins' new exclusive Epi-Ageing Defence Technology targets the signs of ageing linked to lifestyle. This technology is powered by Organic Giant Provencal Reed extract, which helps strengthen skin's resistance to its environment and reduces the appearance of ageing linked to lifestyle. New bottle now made from 41% recycled materials.. 94%* of women said their skin looked younger than yesterday. In 4 weeks, women perceived:. Wrinkles -21%**. Firmness +32%**. Radiance +54%**. Pore visibility -25%**. *Consumer test - 353 volunteers/women, multi-ethnic panel - after 1 month **Self-evaluation - 388 women, multi-ethnic panel - on a structured scale.. Why It's Escentual: . One bottle of Double Serum is sold every 5 seconds worldwide. It's an anti-ageing icon that Clarins keeps updated with the latest innovations in skincare; this is the 9th version since it first launched in 1985. Each new version blows the other out of the water, and 2024's release is no different. The packaging has minimal changes for this edition; the most notable is the rounded edges, which give the serum a more luxurious feel. But the formula combines Clarins' 40 years of skincare experience with 4 years of epigenetic research. At the heart of the cutting-edge Epi-ageing Defense technology is a plant never used in cosmetics: Provence tall reed extract, which strengthens the skin's resistance and neutralises 100% of epigenetic modifications linked to lifestyle.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use every day, morning and night. Turn the dial to adjust the amount needed according to skin type or needs. Apply with your fingertips; apply draining pressure 3 times on each cheek, forehead, and sides of the neck.. Sustainability and Values . . Awards: . Clarins Double Serum has won 450 awards worldwide.. Batch Codes: . 30ml - 0604213. 50ml - 0414134. 75ml - 0602043. .

listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . Bold and Unconventional: Defies gender norms with a unisex fragrance.. Intense and Long-Lasting: Rich, captivating aroma that lingers throughout the day.. Versatile and Timeless: Suitable for any occasion, day or night.. Luxurious Experience: Sleek black bottle inspired by the GIVENCHY fashion codes. . GIVENCHY Say: . Givenchy L'Interdit Absolu reveals a new floral woody ambery composition, a chase between iconic scents and unconventional notes.. For the most immediate thrill, a fresh aromatic facet of lavender galvanizing all the senses is paired with a magnetic cardamom essence and unique quality of Neroli Essential. These new radical and modernised top notes blur into the iconic L'Interdit white bouquet made of orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine sambac absolutes.. Like all Givenchy fragrances, L'Interdit Absolu reveals a contrasted facet: the florality leaves room for woody notes of vetiver and patchouli, bringing depth and elegance to the fragrance. Addiction reaches its climax with the new mysterious trail of tobacco and cistus absolutes; a long-lasting experience which will leave you forever transformed.. Like a true icon, L'Interdit dares to reinvent its intemporal bottle. Bolder and more faceted, L'Interdit Absolu showcases a new sharpened design. To amplify this new luxurious shape, the bottle is dressed in black from top to toe. A clash between opacity and light diffraction. Preciousness to the next level. A pure mysterious object you just crave to touch.. . Why It's Escentual: . An audacious and modern take on a timeless fragrance, L'Interdit Absolu boasts a powerful sillage that leaves a lasting impression. It's a sophisticated scent that complements a variety of styles. This premium fragrance is crafted with high-quality ingredients and comes in a stunning, sleek black bottle incorporating design elements from the Givenchy fashion house..

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Why You’ll Love Montblanc Signature: . Soft, comforting fragrance with a powdery sweetness.. A unique take on a vanilla perfume.. Its clean, creamy-smelling aroma will make you feel classy and put together.. White and gold glass bottle inspired by the iconic Meisterstück pen.. . What Montblanc Say: . Some women are impossible to forget because they are like no others. Their remarkable personality and the strength of their convictions leave a lasting impression to anyone who comes across them.. The Montblanc Signature woman leaves a unique echo in the minds of those around her, because she has chosen to be the author of her own life. And her perfume matches her personality: a truly exceptional character. Signature intermingles the sensuality of an enveloping vanilla with a contrasting, clean musk, creating an addictive, chic, deliciously feminine trail. Perfectly echoing this precious perfume, the bottle is a tribute to the iconic inkwell, part of Montblanc's heritage. Signature exudes perfect femininity, an alliance of purity and mystery, of revelations and secrets. To write your next chapter, simply open the bottle.. Fragrance family is floral-musk. . Top notes are clementine. . Heart notes are vanilla. . Base notes are white musk. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Montblanc Signature is a head-turning fragrance that’ll add something unique to any perfume collection. It’s a complex scent that delights the senses at every stage of its composition; it has sparkly top notes, an elegant heart and a base that’s both sexy and clean-smelling. The perfumer behind the composition, Natalie Gracia-Cetto (alongside Guillaume Flavigny), aimed to “...infuse more light, more breath and transparency”, and she did! Signature is feminine, graceful and sensuous. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Prisme Libre Loose Setting Powder 4 x 2.5g / 02 - Satin Blanc
listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . Global makeup artist-approved! It has been a top favourite setting powder for over 35 years.. Celebrity-favourite face powder (spotted in Kylie Jenner's makeup bag).. It makes skin appear flawless in seconds.. It also helps makeup last longer and appear airbrushed.. . GIVENCHY Say . Ultra-fine setting powder with 24-hour luminous matte finish and 12-hour set & blur.. 24H LUMINOUS MATTE ¹, 12H SET & BLUR ¹. With its 4-in-1 action, Givenchy Prisme Libre 4-Color Loose Powder blurs and sets for 12 hours ¹, as it mattifies and illuminates the complexion for 24 hours ¹.. MICRONIZED POWDER, LIGHTER THAN BEFORE. GIVENCHY's new ultra-fine formula, 46% thinner than the previous one, is made of micronized powder to provide a comfortable, breathable finish for a long-wear, bare-skin sensation.. POWERED BY PRISMATIC LIGHT TECHNOLOGY. Prisme Libre 4-Color Mattifying & Blurring Setting Loose Powder is now powered by Prismatic Light Technology, for an all-day blurring effect that enhances skin's natural radiance.. ¹ Instrumental test on 27 volunteers after application.. COLOUR CORRECTION EXPERTISE. For a perfect complexion, combine the loose powder with the Prisme Libre routine:. 1. CORRECT - Correct colour imperfections with Prisme Libre Skin-Caring Corrector. 2. UNIFY - Unify your complexion with the Prisme Libre Skin-Caring Glow or Matte Foundations. 3. SET - Set your foundation with the iconic Prisme Libre 4-Color Loose Powder. 4. COLOUR - Colour your cheeks with Prisme Libre Blush. 5. EXTEND - Extend makeup wear with Prisme Libre Prep & Set Glow Mist.. . 35 YEARS OF 4-COLORS SINCE 1989. Born in 1989 at Givenchy, Le Prisme was the first signature 4-colour powder inspired by the science of colour correction. It materialized Hubert de Givenchy's vision of the harmony of colour and marked the beginning of Givenchy's makeup. Cultivating the heritage of Maison Givenchy, this emblematic 4-colour powder combines historical heritage and scientific modernity.. With technology and colour expertise at its core, Prisme Libre 4-Colour Loose Powder reinvents the codes of Givenchy with audacity for an edgy and tailor-made approach to the science of colour correction.. . Why It's Escentual A makeup artist and celebrity darling for over 3 decades. This iconic loose powder instantly transforms skin with a flawless, airbrushed finish.. Its innovative colour correction technology, featuring a quad of expert shades, neutralises redness, brightens dullness, blurs imperfections, and sets makeup for long-lasting perfection.. Luxurious yet lightweight, Prisme Libre delivers a radiant, ethereal glow while blurring pores and controlling shine. There's no wonder it's trusted by professionals and adored by millions worldwide. . .

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Flower By Kenzo Ikebana Mimosa Eau de Parfum Spray 40ml
listings.description: This second opus in the Flower Ikebana collection dreamt up by perfumer Marie Salamagne, brings a new flower to the fore: the Mimosa.. FLOWER IKEBANA BY KENZO is an ode to Kenzo Takada's love of flowers and art de vivre. Like a sun-infused bouquet of fresh flowers, FLOWER IKEBANA MIMOSA BY KENZO is a floral powdery fragrance for women, like the warm embrace of a winter sun.. With this new Ikebana, the perfumer chose to convey a velvety and enveloping olfactory sensation. Mimosa Absolute and the unique capture of its ambient air are at the heart of the scent and offer a unique floral expression close to nature. In the base notes, the verticality of hinoki wood supports the entire composition, with golden sesame extract as an intermediary, resonating in a sillage of addictive comfort.. FLOWER IKEBANA MIMOSA, the new blooming sunshine bouquet, arranges the highest quality of mimosa, Tanneron Mimosa, alongside exceptional raw ingredients to create an Eau de Parfum composed of 91% ingredients of natural origin*.. Fragrance Family: Floral . Top Note: Kumquat Zest. Middle Note: Golden Sesame Extract, Mimosa Absolute. Base Notes: Hinoki Wood Accord. Its outerpack is inspired by the Japanese kakemono and a dreamlike mimosa flower adorns the long, slim glass bottle. FLOWER IKEBANA perfume bottles feature a precious glass cap, which can be recycled. This perfume reflects the Maison's commitments to a more beautiful world, with an outerpack fully made in France, the use of 15% recycled glass, a paper outerpack from well-managed FSC certified forests and other controlled sources and bio-based inks..

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Fantasm Eau de Parfum Spray Refill 100ml
listings.description: Enticing facet (top notes): shiny, acidulous and addictive, the augmented fruitiness of a very modern mouthwatering, juicy pineapple accord sparks off Angel Fantasm with a flash.. Luscious facet (heart notes): wrapped in the intense sensuality of a creamy coconut accord, you dive into the heart of fantasy. The luscious note melds with the voluptuous sweetness of an exotic tiaré cream accord.. Carnal facet (base notes): an intense woody accord morphs Angel's iconic, gourmand patchouli signature with a modernized, more unctuous, and luminous patchouli essence heart. Unleashing the power of the precious vanilla pod, a sublime premium Bourbon vanilla infusion intensifies the carnal addiction with its powdery, enveloping, indulgent tones.. How To Refill . Remove cap, unscrew pump. Twist refill bottle on. Wait for refill to stop. Twist off, screw pump and cap back on..

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Fantasm Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 25ml

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Intense Spray Refill 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Longevity Epigenetic Serum 30ml
listings.description: Turn back the cellular clock and unlock your skin’s youthful potential with the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Longevity Epigenetic Serum, a groundbreaking clinical treatment engineered to reactivate youth genes at the root.. Skin ageing is heavily accelerated by lifestyle and environmental factors that alter the skin’s epigenetic patterns over time. This process effectively deactivates your "youth genes," causing visible structural degradation, loss of tone, and deep-set lines. Born from 15 years of advanced epigenetic research and driven by a patented Age Clock Technology, this revolutionary formula works to systematically correct these epigenetic errors. By introducing a multifaceted mechanism that teaches aged skin cells to act younger, it aggressively reverses 10 visible signs of ageing to reveal a completely rejuvenated, firm, and radiant complexion.. Benefits . Reverses 10 Signs of Ageing: Clinically proven to target, treat, and reverse 10 major indicators of structural skin maturation within 4 weeks.. Reactivates Youth Genes: Uses cutting-edge genetic technology to reactivate dormant genes switched off by modern lifestyle stress.. Intensified Surface Plumping: Delivers an immediate flood of hydration to smooth out rough texture, dry patches, and visible pores.. Protects Cellular Longevity: Actively prevents the natural breakdown of existing moisture reservoirs while supporting natural DNA repair.. Redefines Facial Contours: Increases density and elasticity to visibly lift slackened jawlines and thinning facial tissue.. The Science Behind the Formula Eucerin combines medical-grade dermatological humectants with groundbreaking gene-support technology:. Epicelline®: Eucerin’s multi-faceted, proprietary breakthrough innovation. Discovered after testing over 50,000 substances, this powerhouse active ingredient addresses epigenetic errors at the root, resetting cellular patterns so cells act younger and age more slowly. . Macro & Micro Hyaluronic Acid: A multi-layered hydration duo that floods the epidermis with moisture, immediately expanding the skin matrix to plump up deep wrinkles and fine lines.. Glycine Saponin: A high-performance botanical extract that dynamically stimulates the skin’s own natural production of Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen, and Elastin from within.. Enoxolone: A targeted active complex that slows down the degradation of natural Hyaluronic Acid within the skin tissue while helping to promote cellular DNA repair.. Why We Love It We love this longevity serum because it marks a massive evolution in anti-ageing skincare, moving past temporary superficial line-filling to reprogram how your skin ages at a cellular level. Our team tested this powerhouse formula for 4 weeks and witnessed incredible, visible results: stubborn wrinkles faded, enlarged pores appeared beautifully diffused, and a tired, city-worn face was replaced by a smooth, illuminated, and bouncy complexion. It behaves like a true vitality shield, ensuring your skin looks noticeably younger than its actual age.. How To Use It . Use daily, every morning and evening, as the critical first treatment step in your skincare routine.. Apply a small amount to a thoroughly cleansed face, neck, and décolletage.. Massage gently into the epidermis using light, upward circular motions.. Follow up immediately with Hyaluron-Filler +Reverse Epigenetic Day SPF30 or Night Care to lock in the active gene technology.. Works Well With To create an unyielding, 24-hour cellular reset and lock in maximum structural density, layer the advanced Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +Reverse Epigenetic Night Care directly over this serum before sleeping.. Values Clinically and dermatologically tested, non-comedogenic (won't clog pores), outstanding efficacy confirmed in product-in-use tests over 4 weeks with over 160 volunteers..

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Intense Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love It . Amber floral perfume is guaranteed to get you compliments.. Long-lasting = fewer top-ups. Powerful silage that passers-by will smell.. Gorgeous golden bustier bottle made to stand out.. The Notes: Salt, Lily, Benzoin, Frangipani, Amber and Benzoin.. . Jean Paul Gaultier Say . Enhanced solar notes, a bold twist and an extra dose of sensuality define the intensity of this original accord. Majestic lily mingles with passionate frangipani blossom for a radiant and divinely sexy feminine fragrance. Precious benzoin enhances the amber opulence of the fragrance, while a salty kiss adds a tangy freshness. Gaultier Divine! . Divinely feminine and magnificently Gaultier in a corset forged of dazzling light. This amber floral scent opens with a burst of freshness, blending seamlessly into the creamy, tropical notes of frangipani and salt. As it settles, the scent deepens into a warm, honeyed caramel base of benzoin and amber, creating a long-lasting and unforgettable trail. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Contour G Lip Pencil 1.04g / 01 - Le Bois de Rose
listings.description: Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Contour G Lip Pencil: . High pigment colour in one swipe.. No transfer formula extends lipstick wear-time.. Smooth, creamy texture feels comfortable.. Six shades to enhance the original tone of all lips.. Comes with a pencil sharpener.. . What Guerlain Say: . With its highly pigmented, long-lasting, no-transfer formula, Contour G redefines and outlines lips in a single stroke. Featuring an ultra-fine tip and a pencil sharpener, it redefines lips with extreme precision to beautifully enhance make-up. Its featherlight texture offers instant comfort and fuses with lipstick to optimise its hold.. Contour G is available in six shades, designed to enhance the original tones of all lips and perfectly match Guerlain's lipsticks:. 01 Le Bois de Rose: a light rosewood 02 Le Beige Praline: a soft nude beige 03 Le Brun Tonka: a timeless brown 04 Le Rouge Feu: a vibrant bright red 05 Le Rouge Rubis: an intense bluish-red 06 Le Burgundy: a deep burgundy. Infused with castor oil and botanical squalane, Contour G lip pencil's creamy, smooth formula offers a bare lip and an instant comfort sensation. The colour is impeccable, even throughout the day. Guerlain has created Contour G to complement their iconic Rouge G Lipstick. The luxurious lip liner is the first step, helping you enhance your lip shape thanks to its ultra-precise tip (thanks to the included sharpener) and preventing smudging or bleeding.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use the pencil sharpener to refine the tip and ensure ultra-precise application. To apply, trace the lip contour, starting from the centre and linking the ends..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love It: . Fresh, long-lasting fragrance for men.. Has a clean, sophisticated, and bold presence.. Ocean-like clean scent keeps you feeling fresh for up to 6 hours+. The Notes: . Top notes are marine notes and bergamot. Heart note is everlasting essence. Base notes are cistus absolute and patchouli.. Armani Say . Acqua Di Gio Profondo Parfum captures the addictive and intense attraction of the sea's unknown depths. Conveying a sensation of deep freshness, the fragrance encapsulates the experience of being immersed in the ocean's mysteries. The fragrance's captivating juice evokes a dense, resinous, and mineral facet of Acqua Di Gio. Crafted around bergamot notes, balsamic cistus absolute, and the richness of everlasting essence, these notes lend Acqua Di Gio Profondo Parfum its depth and intensity. Evoking the ocean's infiniteness, the fragrance is presented in a deep blue bottle, with a tone that graduates from deepest blue at its top to translucent turquoise at the base. The flacon is designed with a sleek metallic blue cap, with a silver accent at its neck. . Why It's Escentual . Profondo Parfum's powerhouse longevity and fresh ocean-like fragrance are making waves worldwide. As soon as you spray it, you can smell the zingy, green freshness of bergamot but the depth of this scent makes itself present from the start. There is a soft, subtle dried flower aroma similar to crisp lavender; this gives the scent more texture and dimension. Earthy notes of patchouli and the woodiness of cistus absolutely warm up the scent, providing a deeper, darker dry-down that still feels fresh hours later. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Rouge G Velvet Lipstick Refill 3.5g / 159 - Le Beige Amande
listings.description: Why You'll Love Guerlain Rouge G Velvet Lipstick Refill: . Bold colour payoff in one swipe.. 89% skincare formula smooths and regenerates lips.. Comfortable velvet-matte finish.. Long-lasting formula holds for 12 hours.. Available in a selection of colours.. It's customisable; slot the refill into a Rouge G case.. . What Guerlain Say: . Rouge G, Guerlain's iconic jewel lipstick that can be customized and refilled at will, has been reinvented in an ultra-care version paired with a wide range of highly pigmented, long-wearing shades available in a satin or velvet matte version. 89% skincare-based, its formula exclusively developed with natural-origin waxes includes a lily oleo extract with smoothing and regenerating properties for exceptional comfort.. The satin and velvet matte formulas of this new-generation Rouge G boasts an ultra-light enveloping texture for a bare-lips sensation and 16-hour comfort. The satin formula coats lips in a luscious texture, leaving them plumped and perfectly shaped. Its silky finish offers a long-lasting satin sheen. The velvet matte formula smooths and coats lips in unequalled softness for a velvety result, ensuring exemplary hold for 12 hours.. Rouge G is available in an exclusive colour palette designed for all styles and skin tones. Each shade has been meticulously formulated by the Guerlain laboratories with high-impact colour pigments incorporated one by one and boosted by the colour-enhancing power of Abyssinian oil for vibrant, luminous hues.. For your first Rouge G purchase, choose a shade and a case to create your complete lipstick. For the following ones, refill the shade or change the case as you wish.. The new Rouge G cases are only compatible with the new-generation refills and vice versa. . *Cases and lispticks are sold separately. . . . Why It's Escentual: . The interchangeable design makes it easy to mix and match, giving you a unique and personalised beauty experience.. For 2024, Guerlain has given the best-selling Rouge G a makeover. The lipstick refills now come in velvet and satin finishes, contain an 89% skincare-based formula, and the cases have been transformed from silver to a luxurious, more eco-friendly gold. They're 19% lighter and reduce CO2 emissions by 30%.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Pair this lipstick refill with a GUERLAIN Rouge G Lipstick Case. Remove the lid, twist the lipstick bullet, and glide over the lips..

listings.description: ''Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum is perhaps even sexier than its predecessor; it's intense, full-bodied and effortlessly seductive as it blends the iconic tonka bean note with a zesty citrus start and a cosy vanilla backdrop.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Code Eau de Parfum: . Effortlessly seductive and subtly intense fragrance for men.. Smooth, sensual and seductive, Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum conveys the mood of intense yet effortless seduction. The warm and intense scent opens with a surprisingly zesty start thanks to the sparkling essence of lemon, which is energised by luminous mandarin and tart bergamot. The heart is both soft and aromatic as rosemary and lavender provide a magnetic aromatic effect before the warm base of Code's signature tonka bean shines through. This is now even more sensual and rich, thanks to an enhanced roasting process, while cedar wood provides a dry and musky woodiness. A suede accord offers a masculine and powdery edge, but the true star has to be the vanilla, which shines through with a multifaceted depth and a creamy warm cosiness.. Top notes are lemon essence, mandarin and bergamot. Heart notes are rosemary and lavender. Base notes are tonka bean, suede, vanilla and cedar. . . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we're big fans of the Code range, and have fallen in love with each of its flankers. Code Eau de Parfum is no exception; it's beautifully unique in its cosy warmth yet shares a similar DNA as the rest of the Code family, so you can tell it's a signature Armani scent. It's ideal for the modern man who likes his fragrance to remain sensual and seductive, but with a sweet and soft edge. It plays with contrasts as the zesty lemon start soon warms to a soft aromatic feel before welcoming in that cosy addictive vanilla note that will make you want to snuggle up and stay close.. And we have to tell you about the bottle! Standing tall, the Code Eau de Parfum bottle exudes an understated elegance. The signature flacon retains the same elongated design, and is dressed in a glossy black shade, like the original. It now has the addition of a sleek chrome gold lid, which only fits on in a certain way to maintain the slightly-curved yet silky-smooth shape. Our favourite part has to be the textured band at the neck of the bottle; it's inspired by the classic tailoring of a tuxedo's cummerbund, ensuring the bottle is dressed in pure sophistication.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray Armani Code Eau de Parfum onto the pulse points for an intense and prolonged wear..

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream 28ml
listings.description: A cult-favourite moisturiser, Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream will hydrate your skin for up to 24 hours, leaving behind a smooth finish that looks radiant and healthy.. One of these bestselling day creams is sold every minute worldwide! Loved by all skin types, but particularly those with dry skin, its clever formula infuses an intensive yet lightweight dose of moisture, keeping your skin topped up with hydration throughout the day without a heavy feel or greasy finish.. When it comes to moisture, the Ultra Face Cream is richer than the Ultra Facial Moisturiser. Its thicker texture is enriched with squalene, imperata cylindrica and antarcticine and will help to maintain hydration and intensively nourish thirsty skin. Even in cold, harsh weather conditions, the Ultra Face Cream never fails to restore comfort and balance back to skin.. Why We Love It . It's the best-loved Kiehl's day cream and if its global track record doesn't show you that, its glow-giving results will do all the talking. Fun fact: the Ultra Facial Cream was used to protect the team of explorers who embarked upon the first ever ascent of Greenland's ice covered peaks. If the moisturiser prevailed when up against that cold weather, think about what it can do for your skin!. Are you looking for a moisturiser that has SPF benefits? Try the Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream SPF30 instead; it's the same best-loved formula, just with added protection.. How To Use It . Massage onto your face and neck every morning and/or night - just make sure to apply it to thoroughly cleansed skin.. Works Well With . Before applying your cream at night, why not pair with a reviving-formula from the Kiehl's Midnight Recovery collection? It will help boost your skin's health and radiance come morning..

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream 28ml
listings.description: Keep oily skin feeling optimally hydrated with the Kiehl's Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream, a non-greasy face moisturiser that provides your complexion with 24-hour hydration and shine control.. This Kiehl's oil-free moisturiser was made with combination skin in mind. Its non-greasy texture is the perfect match for an oily t-zone and its lightweight, yet comforting formula is exceptional for dehydrated areas that need a boost of hydration. If you struggle with the longevity of your makeup or maintaining your skin's moisture balance, the Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream will be just what you're looking for.. This mattifying moisturiser works by helping your skin to retain its natural moisture. It contains imperata cylindrica root extract (rich in potassium) and antarcticine and will attract water molecules to help skin feel more balanced as well as protect your skin from dehydration, aiding the retention of natural moisture reserves for more plump, smooth and fresh-feeling skin.. Why We Love It . The Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream is the perfect base for makeup. We love the fact that it's free from oil, parabens and fragrance. Plus when you apply it to your skin, its refreshing texture has an instant cooling effect on the skin, which is perfect for an early wakeup call when you need it most.. How To Use It . We advise that you use the gel-cream every morning and evening. Apply it to clean skin, and a little bit goes a long way with this one - you only need to use a 50p-sized amount.. Works Well With . Kiehl's have an entire range for oily skin, why not explore this selection for more products suited to skin that has a nasty habit of shining when you don't want it to!.. Values . Non-comedogenic. Allergy-tested. Oil free, paraben free, fragrance free..

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Midnight Recovery Concentrate 15ml
listings.description: A powerful night-time remedy, the Kiehl's Midnight Recovery Concentrate is an intensively rejuvenating oil blend that will help you to wake up to younger-looking skin.. If you find that your skin still looks tired and lacklustre in the morning, this is the skincare solution you need. Midnight Recovery Concentrate is an innovative elixir that supports your skin during its natural night-time recovery process and works to help improve the radiance, tone and softness of your complexion.. Its rich blend of 99.8% natural-derived ingredients includes a fusion of lavender essential oil and evening primrose oil, and will help to soothe inflammation and boost your skin's glow. In addition, Midnight Recovery Concentrate contains squalane derived from olives and will help restore the natural balance of moisture within the skin, ensuring that your complexion is plumped, smoothed and fresh-looking.. This potent cocktail of ingredients leaves skin feeling revived and reenergised. And the best part? It does it all while you're sleeping.. Why We Love It . This is a Kiehl's bestseller for a reason! If you don't have time for a multiple-step evening skincare routine but you still want to give your skin all of the support it needs, the Midnight Recovery Concentrate is the answer. It will assist with enhancing your skin's recovery process so that you wake up to skin that is softer, smoother and more toned, so your routine will be much quicker in the morning as well.. How To Use It . After cleansing, warm 2-3 drops between your fingertips and then press onto your cheeks, forehead and chin. Massage all over the face, avoiding the eye contour.. Works Well With . Craving more? Discover the rest of the Kiehl's Midnight Recovery collection and wake up to more refreshed and revived-appearing skin.. Values . Paraben-free, Mineral-Oil free..

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum Spray 40ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum: . Floral gourmand perfume will elevate your confidence and ensure you stand out.. Ideal for both day and night, it adapts to any occasion.. Enhances your presence in a boardroom meeting or for an elegant evening out.. The beautiful bottle makes a statement even before the first spritz.. . . The Notes: . Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Pear, Gardenia Heart Notes: Jasmine, Patchouli, Ambrette Base Notes: Moss, Amber, Sandalwood, Praline. . Jimmy Choo say: . I Want Choo Le Parfum embodies the bold, glamorous, and exceptional craftsmanship synonymous with Jimmy Choo. 'I Want Choo Le Parfum' is a playful, vibrant ode to empowering female friendships, evoking glamorous and memorable nights. This amber floral woody fragrance opens with vibrant notes of pear and is adorned by the solar inflexion of golden gardenia. The middle notes combine a creamy, warm heart with sweet jasmine, irresistible patchouli, and ambrette. The glamorous base notes, blending with moss, amber, sandalwood, and praline accord, give the creation a long-lasting trail. . . Why It's Escentual Whether you admire the original I Want Choo or seek a new signature scent, this perfume will elevate your confidence and ensure you stand out. Spray it on, embrace the allure, and become the main character in your own story. . Housed in a metallic golden glass bottle adorned with the signature JC monogram and a hammered-effect accent ring, I Want Choo Le Parfum is as captivating on the outside as it is within. The shimmering gold box complements the luxurious packaging, making it a perfect gift for yourself or a loved one. Experience a fragrance that lasts. I Want Choo Le Parfum endures for 4-6 hours, with its sillage gracefully trailing behind you. Initially, it fills the room with its presence, making you noticeable as you walk by. The scent remains close to you as time passes, perfect for intimate encounters.. .

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum: . It's the iconic Daisy perfume inspired by a wildflower bouquet.. Uplifting perfume that'll make you feel happy and carefree.. Light, airy floral that's great to wear everyday.. You'll smell it on your skin for around 6 hours.. The refillable bottle is art; it looks like flowers in a vase.. . . What Marc Jacobs Say: . Embark on an outdoors adventure with Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild, a bold and feminine fragrance for women.. Jasmine, vetiver, and notes of banana blossom capture the irresistible essence of nature, sparking a sense of discovery. The new refillable Eau de Parfum exudes a fresh fragrance reminiscent of a wildflower bouquet. It inspires you to reconnect with nature and embody your young, free-spirited self.. The fragrance bottle has been reimagined in a mesmerising shade of light green, adorned with pink and green signature Daisy flowers around the cap. Inside the bottle, flower stems peep through “ a playful nod to the Daisy Wild blooming wilderness. On the perfume's box is a charming '˜overgrown' flower border, further playing on the untamed beauty of the juice.. Fragrance family is floral. . Top notes are Banana Blossom Accord. . Heart notes are Jasmine, Macadamia Accord. . Base notes are Sandalwood, Vetiver des Sables. . . Why It's Escentual: . Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is special because it reimagines the iconic Daisy fragrance from 2007. Despite its name Daisy Wild isn't'¦ wild; this perfume is charming and cheerful, it celebrates the untamed beauty of nature and its wildness. It's been created to transport those who wear it to a lush meadow. It contains banana blossom, a first in luxury perfumery, which infuses the scent with a sense of freshness that's like a breath of crisp, clean air.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Super Restorative Rose Radiance Cream 50ml
listings.description: A daily boost for mature skin, the Clarins Super Restorative Rose Radiance Cream is an anti-ageing day cream for all skin types and tones that will offer an instant glow to the face as well smooth, lift and intensely nourish your complexion.. For this generation of Rose Radiance Cream, Clarins Research targets the loss of rosy radiance in menopausal skin. At the heart of its unique formula is the new [PEPTIDE - POMEGRANATE POWER] radiance complex that helps to even out the complexion and re-energise the skin. The result: Smoother skin comes to life with an instantly healthy rosy glow. Clarins has combined organic gorse and harungana extracts to target the signs of sagging skin caused by the change in hormones induced by menopause. Together, they form a powerful duo with lifting and densifying properties. Skin appears re-densified, lifted and firmed. The rosy hue of Rose Radiance Cream acts as an energy booster for both you and your skin, offering an immediate beautifying effect that revives the radiance of all women, whatever their skin type and complexion. Made of 93% natural ingredients, Rose Radiance Cream offers a smooth, enveloping texture. It absorbs easily with no greasy residue when applied to the skin. . For an energising, radiance-enhancing effect, Clarins Research has developed the [Peptide - Pomegranate Power] Radiance Complex. At the heart of this innovation: a duo of complementary active ingredients - Organic Pomegranate extract: Helps to boost energy production in cells and provide anti-oxidant action. Radiance peptide: Biomimetic peptide that contributes to cell renewal and to smooth micro-relief of the skin. . Why We Love It . This is no ordinary day cream. The Rose Radiance Cream offers the same replenishing properties as the much-loved Clarins Super Restorative Day Cream but with an immediate rosy glow effect which is just perfect for daywear. It will add an extra veil of luminance to your face and the best part? While you're getting on with your day, it's working behind the scenes to gently exfoliate your skin to leave it smooth, bright and with a more even texture. It looks great worn alone for those days where you don't want to wear lots of makeup but also looks fantastic layered underneath your base to add little glow and dimension to your skin. If all that wasn't enough, it's jar is eco-friendly too and is made from 25% recycled glass.. How To Use It . In the morning, after cleansing your skin apply to dry skin (ideally after your favourite Clarins serum) by warming in the hands then pressing the product onto your face and neck, working from the centre of the face outwards.. Works Well With . Why not combine with other products from the Clarins Super Restorative range? A collection of skincare solutions for both the face and body specifically designed for more mature skin..

listings.rawTitle: Diesel D Red Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: D RED embodies the men of today: real, evolving and daring. Men who show their radicality and live each moment with unregretful passion. . The minimalist scent embodies the secret white petit-coat worn under a glamorous gown or, more modernly, the timeless style of a crisp white shirt; the classic airy signature creates a radiant aura that you wear rather than a scent that wears you.. . Like a rich gold chain warmed by sun-kissed skin, it radiates sophistication, beauty and strength through its multi-faceted scent notes and exceptionally long-lasting finish.. The journey begins with fresh notes of mandarin, pink peppercorn and black currant. This opening, juicy and tantalizing, awakens the senses and energizes body and soul. The heart of the fragrance is luxe and feminine, a refined bouquet of delicate jasmine and robust rose blossoms made modern by the harmonious balance of sparkling fruit top notes and an earthy wood base. Over time, the deep and lasting sensuality of the fragrance reveals itself thanks to the sillage of base notes including creamy vanilla, seductive musk and woody patchouli leaves.. Bold and unforgettable, this floral woody musk fragrance has an elegant finish that lingers on the skin..
