listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Maria Callas Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Maria Callas by The Merchant Of Venice is an Eau de Parfum with floral notes that expresses the Divina's femininity and conceals a deep amber base with a multifaceted yet persistent character.. In celebration of the 100th anniversary of Maria Callas' birth, The Merchant of Venice presents the first official fragrance inspired by the Divina. An iconic scent that embodies her essence and elegance.. Top notes: Mandarin, Lemon, black Pepper Oil.. Heart Notes: Blackcurrant, Rose, Neroli. Base Note: Cedarwood, Akigalawood, Georgywood. How to use . Hold the fragrance 5 inches away and spray your skin, focusing on pulse points (neck and wrists). Alternatively, spray generously in front of you and walk through for a full coverage. Don't rub the fragrance in, as it will affect the trail..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum Refill 100ml
listings.description: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum is a modern classic, marking a new generation of fragrances. Revolutionary scents in both their design and blends, deliverying strong and powerful femininity reflective of the Millenial Woman. . The fragrance of a new generation of conquering women. Strong. Outspoken. Empowered. The fragrance of the leaders of tomorrow, who dare to reach the sky and open new horizons. The fragrance of the new idols, who pave the way for others. Idôle.. Idole is a celebration of the rose. A note close to Lancome's heart and the hero of the Lancome logo. Rose is the royalty of scents , and the main facet in many of Lancomes best-selling fragrances. The result is an Eau de Parfum with tradition at its core but an entirely contemporary energy. Sustainably-sourced rose and rose water is at the centre of this transformation, and lends a dewy, yet radiant freshness that doesn't smell artificial in the slightest. The composition's modern twist comes from a fruity bergamot opening, and subtle threads of sensual jasmine with creamy musk; a blend that is clean and glowing. . Notes: Top Notes: Bergamot Essence Middle Notes: Rose Essence, Rose Absolute, Rose Water, Jasmine Infusion, Jasmine Base Notes : Patchouli Essence, Cedar Essence, Vanilla Extract . .

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Eau de Toilette Spray 25ml
listings.description: Embrace your inner strength. Discover Idole Eau de Toilette, our first fragrance to turn a rare freshness into a true trail, enclosed in an elegant and sleek bottle.. Idole Eau de Toilette is the perfect encounter between strong notes and a subtle, surprising freshness. The fragrance opens with a green shincha tea accord, followed by a duo of roses, with green notes and a rose damascena essence, combined with a fresh bergamot that adds juicy and fresh tones to preserve an elegant citrus heart.. To elevate your trail, delicately mist from a distance of approximately 20 cm onto your skin, emphasizing the pulsating points..

listings.description: "Want your lashes to look thicker and longer with and without mascara? Choose the Clarins Wonder Volume XXL Mascara; it's makeup and skincare in one!" - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Clarins Wonder Volume Mascara XXL: . Doubles the length and volume of lashes.. Boosts bare lashes' volume by 25% in 28 days.. Jet-black pigment.. Doesn't smudge or run.. . What You Need To Know: . The Wonder Volume XXL Mascara provides immediate makeup results and long-lasting skincare benefits. The smudge-proof formula is jet-black and instantly thickens, lengthens and doubles lash volume with a unique Volumising Wax Complex. A Lash Boosting Complex defines and protects lashes for up to 12 hours, plus natural (86%) skincare ingredients nourish eyelashes daily, leading to a 25% volume increase on bare lashes after just 28 days.. The mascara has an innovative brush made from castor fibres and 3 cutouts, which serve as reservoirs loaded with formula to maximise volume.. Why It's Escentual: . Clarins is one of the first brands we launched at Escentual over two decades ago. They have a pioneering approach to skincare and makeup, emphasising plant-based formulations that deliver effective results. XXL Mascara is proof of that!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use the brush to coat lashes evenly from root to tip. Repeat until you're happy with the volume.. .

listings.rawTitle: BURBERRY Hero Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Why You'll Love Burberry Hero Parfum Spray: . Rich, woody aroma smells masculine and sophisticated.. Stronger, more long-lasting version of Hero Eau de Parfum.. Incense and benzoin notes ensure you'll still smell it on your skin after 8+ hours.. It's refillable, so you don't have to buy another bottle.. . What Burberry Say: . Burberry Hero Parfum portrays a modern man. Sincere yet courageous, he constantly surpasses himself in every challenge. No longer held back by preconceptions, he connects with his inner self to embrace the extraordinary within.. Hero Parfum is the latest Burberry fragrance for men. Intense and powerful, the scent is led by a base of warm cedarwood oils. On top, notes of Amyris and Cypriol oil enliven the aroma for a deep woody finish. Housed in an angular glass bottle detailed with the Burberry logo. Intense and powerful, Burberry Hero Parfum.. Fragrance family is woody. . Top notes are Cypriol Oil. . Heart notes are Amyris. . Base notes are Cedarwood Trio. . . Why It's Escentual: . Burberry Hero Parfum is a more intense version of Hero Eau de Parfum, offering deeper and richer notes. It features a strong blend of cedarwood and pine needles, creating a warm, woody scent, enhanced by incense and benzoin for a long-lasting, bold finish. This Parfum is ideal for those who enjoyed the fresh, vibrant feel of the original Eau de Toilette and warm, woodiness of the Eau de Parfum but want something stronger and more sophisticated. Perfect for anyone seeking a long-lasting, masculine fragrance that works from day to night.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Prodigieuse [Hyalu] Boost Night Recovery Oil Balm 50ml
listings.description: Recharge and rejuvenate your skin as you rest with the Nuxe Creme Prodigieuse Boost Night Recovery Oil Balm, an anti-ageing balm of 92% natural-origin for all skin types that allows you to wake up to a smooth, luminous and refreshed complexion.. As you sleep, Nuxe's ultra-sensorial face balm helps the skin recover from the harmful effects of everyday life, including damage caused by stress, fatigue and pollution - making it the perfect overnight treatment for city dwellers.. Making the most of the skin's natural overnight repair process, the fruity-floral scented balm relaxes the facial features, so you can wake up to fresh, re-energised skin. While respecting your skin's natural balance, the recovery oil balm cocoons the complexion in a comforting and softening blend of ingredients, including ultra-nourishing macadamia oil, without creating an oily feel.. Nuxe's luxe, overnight formula also protects against damaging free radicals using a jasmine flower complex, while it also boosts the skin's 'collagen capital' to fight against early wrinkles using Nuxe's unique patented calendula flower. The anti-ageing balm also showcases cellular sugar, which encourages skin firmness and elasticity by boosting cell activity to trigger the synthesis of proteins in the skin. Finally, nopal flower extract boosts cell renewal to reveal a smoother-looking complexion.. Inviting you to enjoy a moment of bliss and relaxation before you slumber, the Nuxe Night Recovery Oil Balm also releases a sensual aroma as intoxicating jasmine pairs with tangy, refreshing lychee and musk.. Why We Love It . For a lot of us, our night-time skincare routine must be at least two things; hard-working and sensorial. And thankfully, Nuxe ticks both boxes as the oil balm supports the skin's naturally repairing and rejuvenating process as you rest, by addressing early signs of ageing, while also featuring a comforting texture and a delightful scent that you'll want to breathe in every night before bed.. How To Use It . Apply to the face, neck and decollete in the evening.. Works Well With . Why not indulge in the sensorial textures and aromas of the Nuxe Creme Prodigieuse Boost range in your waking hours, too, by exploring the full collection for a daily cream or mask?. Values . Non-comedogenic.. Paraben-free, mineral oil-free..

UV Expert Supra Screen SPF 50+ combines an optimised level of hydrophilic filters in an invisible UV serum formula for very high protection against UVA, XL UVA, UVB, and pollution to prevent signs of photo-ageing. A true invisible finish, it leaves no greasiness or white marks. This formula is tested on all skin types, including oily and sensitive. An unskippable step, 9 out of 10 women would use Supra Screen every day in their skincare routine.. . Why It's Escentual: . Supra Screen SPF50+ will slot seamlessly into your beauty regime but deliver incredible results. The innovative formula combats visible signs of photo-ageing in just 1 month. The Best Way To Use It: . Apply 20 minutes before sun exposure so that the sunscreen can soak into the skin properly. listings.rawTitle: Initio Oud For Greatness Neo Eau de Parfum Spray 90ml
listings.description: "It's the best-selling Oud for Greatness fragrance, but fresher! Initio Oud for Greatness Neo Eau de Parfum is a lighter, cooler interpretation of the original oud aroma. " - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . . Why You'll Love Initio Oud For Greatness Neo: . Part of The Black Gold Project.. Fresher, softer interpretation of Oud for Greatness.. It'll make you feel confident and positive.. It lasts way longer than a traditional Eau de Parfum -12 hours on us!. Psychoactive properties are used to heal and to encourage meditation.. The fragrance features some of the most expensive notes in perfumery.. It's a pared-back version of the classic Oud for Greatness; it has the same oud-musky scent profile intertwined with green-woody notes. Rather than leap off your skin and command attention like the original, Neo softly lingers around you.. . Initio Say: . NEO, a three-letter word for metamorphosis.. NEO, a burst of energy that pushes the boundaries of fragrance.. NEO, a self-confidence booster.. The result of an alchemy between the power of nature and science, NEO a subtle blend of freshness and power.. A bold formula with a raw and majestic interpretation of natural Oud Wood essence in the thrilling new freshness of Balsam Fir and a synergy of Lavender Orpur® and Bergamot.. The psychoactive molecules of Oud enhance our ability to think and feel. The synergistic pairing of Lavender Orpur® and Bergamot soothes and strengthens the mind. Meanwhile, the positive energy of Balsam Fir enhances well-being. Its brain-boosting scent promotes self-confidence and determination. These dominant notes amplify the fragrance's impact, propelling it to new heights and underlining its power and enthralment.. NEO is resolutely a confidence booster. It gives the strength to take action and radiates the positive motivation that makes the greatest dreams come true.. . The Notes? . Fragrance family is Aromatic. . Notes: Oud, Bergamot, Fir Balsam, Orpur Lavender. . . . Why It's Escentual: . Oud For Greatness Neo has an 'Anything is Possible' outlook that exudes positivity and confidence. Whereas the original stops you in your tracks, Neo has a gentler approach which makes it an excellent choice for anyone who usually doesn't like oud fragrances, is just trying them for the first time, or loves ouds and wants something more subtle for everyday wear.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We also recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6-8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm..

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner 100ml
listings.description: Boost your skin's natural radiance with The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner, a mild acid exfoliator for normal skin types that delivers a visibly brighter complexion with an even texture.. The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner gently exfoliates the skin without any rubbing, leaving a glowing complexion with visible clarity. The use of ginseng root and aloe vera add an additional boost of radiance while also soothing the skin.. The formula contains a natural Tasmanian pepperberry derivative that limits any irritation linked to acid use. Combined, with a water-like formula that also maintains a pH balance of 3.6, which directly matches the pKa strength of glycolic acid for the least irritation possible.. Why We Love It . With an extensive knowledge of the benefits of natural ingredients and a sound understanding of the way in which pH and pKa work together, The Ordinary uses modern scientific advancements to create a direct acid formula that delivers bright and smooth skin while minimising redness or irritation.. The peach-hued liquid is held in a transparent bottle with a simple nozzle top, reflecting The Ordinary's sleek, stripped back approach to presentation. The Ordinary lets the formula and its results, speak for itself!. How To Use It . Use in the evening, no more frequently than once per day. After cleansing skin, pour the formula onto a cotton pad and sweep across the face and neck, avoiding the eye contour. Do not rinse off.. Note: this formula should not be used on sensitive, peeling or compromised skin. Limit sun exposure and apply SPF for a week after using this product.. Works Well With . Why not take a look at The Ordinary's full collection of Direct Acids for more skin-smoothing formulas that will improve the appearance of your complexion?. Values . pH 3.5-3.9, Vegan.. Alcohol-free, oil-free, silicone-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympea Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Olympea Parfum by Rabanne lets your divine aura shine to reveal your inner goddess.. Olympea Parfum is a hypnotic ambery green floral fragrance crafted with exceptional ingredients. A luminous vegetal accord blends with a white flower bouquet and mysterious vanilla to liberate the goddess within. To capture her mystery, the iconic Olympea bottle evolves into lacquered black, with a glossy cap and divine golden wings. Olympea Parfum captures the most mysterious facet of her divine power.. THE FRAGRANCE . Let your divine aura shine with new Olympea Parfum by Rabanne: An ambery green floral fragrance that captures the sensuality within. Crafted with exceptional ingredients, Olympea Parfum brings a fearless new intensity, blending a luminous vegetable accord with spicy notes of pink pepper, along with an irresistible bouquet of jasmine, absolute rose, and orange blossom. Mysterious vanilla and sensual musk create the most hypnotic facets of femininity.. THE BOTTLE . Blended to reveal her all“conquering confidence and hypnotic allure, the new Olympea Parfum bottle reimagines its iconic design and comes in a glossy black finish for the first time. As striking and fearless as the Rabanne goddess, the black bottle is offset by a precious golden cap. Metallic gold wings of divine beauty envelop the bottle. Together, the new colours are a symbol of the ultimate goddess as she rises to claim her power..

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Rise to greatness and unleash the epic hero within, with new Invictus Parfum by Rabanne.. Captures your inner legend and empowers you to conquer divine heights. Blended with exceptional ingredients, Invictus Parfum is a powerful aromatic woody watery fragrance. Fresh lavender collides with sensual black soap and addictive sandalwood in an olfactive clash for gods. The iconic Invictus bottle comes with a stronger V shape silhouette and a gold cap to make way for a more powerful trophy than ever before. Invictus Parfum: a fragrance for the half-god hero who turns life into legend.. THE FRAGRANCE . Rise to greatness and unleash the epic hero within. Invictus Parfum by Rabanne is an aromatic, woody, watery olfactive clash for the half-god hero who turns life into legend. Clean, addictive and exhilarating, it's blended with exceptional ingredients. Fresh lavender is made brighter by the minerality of the hazy marine accord. The leathery facets of the soap contrast with the voluptuousness of the violet leaf. Finally, addictive sandalwood blends with carnal musk.. THE BOTTLE . The iconic Invictus bottle gets reinvented as the trophy takes on a stronger shape than ever before. Entering a new era of epic fantasy, the bottle features a V“shape silhouette so sharp, it could have been sculpted by lightning. Surpassing all limits, the bottle comes in a gradient of deep blues with an intense lacquered finish to celebrate the impossible feats of the hero within. Invictus Parfum becomes more precious than ever with a cap adorned in gold..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Teint Idole Ultra Wear C.E. Skin Transforming Bronzer 10g / 01 - Fair

Why You'll Love Lancome Skin Transforming Bronzer: . Buildable colour.. Selection of shades for all skin tones.. Natural matte finish.. Skincare ingredients perfect skin over time.. Long-wearing formula that doesn't go patchy.. Luxurious makeup compact design with mirror.. . Lancome Say: . Teint Idole Ultra Wear C.E. SKIN TRANSFORMING BRONZER, our new 24H serum-infused bronzer that delivers INSTANT SUN-KISSED SKIN through a fusion of technology and skincare for complexion perfection. A SUN-sational, breathable, and blendable formula enriched with Vitamin C derivative, Vitamin E, and Moringa Oil for a natural bronze that wears up to 24H. Beat the heat and unlock 365 Days of sun with this buildable, skin-fusing matte powder bronzer. Achieve your desired intensity with its buildable formula, offering up to 24 hours of flawless wear.. . Why It's Escentual: . Celebrity makeup artist Lisa Eldridge collaborated with Lancome on this bronzer, and it shows. The bronzing powder has a smooth, velvety formula that blends into the skin with ease. Whether you're an amateur or a pro like Lisa, this powder bronzer promises a natural-looking, sunkissed glow that mimics the real thing!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use a fluffy brush to sweep over the high points of your face where the sun hits your skin naturally (your cheeks, temples, forehead and nose).. .

Fragrance-free. Hypoallergenic. Non-comedogenic..

Why You'll Love Mugler Alien Hypersense Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray: . Refills all sizes of Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum.. Reduces plastic, cardboard and glass waste.. Smoother, spicier interpretation of the best-selling Prada Luna Rossa Ocean.. It'll linger on your skin for 8-10 hours.. Main notes you'll smell are amber, saffron and oak.. Compliments include: you smell luxurious and sophisticated!. . Prada Say: . Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum is a powerful and sophisticated Ambery Fougère scent. Opening on a vigorous and fresh lemon essence, contrasted with the magnetic sophistication of saffron accord and smoky notes of leathery oakwood.. Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum, the new refillable captivating intensity, by Prada. A fragrance as an invitation to go beyond, to surpass and transcend your limits to open new horizons. Built on a conviction that with technology as an extension of ourselves, we can re-imagine what's possible and achieve extreme performances. Luna Rossa Ocean is refillable, allowing for less packaging materials. A 50ml bottle & 150ml refill contain 55% less materials in total* as opposed 4 bottles of 50ml Prada Luna Rossa. This includes 55% less glass, 70% less metals, 45% less plastics and 50% less cardboard.. *Combined reduction of glass, plastic, metal, and cardboard. Reductions vary depending on original bottle size.. **Reductions vary depending on original bottle size, between 30-55% for glass, 70% for metal, 20-45% for plastic and 35-50% for cardboard.. The Notes? . Fragrance family is ambery-fougere. . Top note is lemon essence. . Heart note is saffron accord. . Base note is oakwood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum brings something unique to the Ocean range. The freshness is dialled back and replaced with spicy, smoky notes that give the iconic fragrance for men a subtle and unassuming suaveness. You can still pinpoint the blue DNA of Ocean, especially when it dries down, but Ocean Le Parfum stands alone. It blends freshness, spiciness and woodiness to make a crowd-pleasing masculine aroma.. . The Best Way To Use It: . 1. Unscrew the cap of your Ocean Le Parfum bottle.. 2. Align the refill cartridge with the bottle's opening and gently insert it into the bottle.. 3. Wait for the refill to stop automatically and then twist off.. 4. Rescrew the cap back onto the Ocean Le Parfum bottle.. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6-8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.description: Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi offers a vitalising scent that continuously surprises just like the spectacular view of the Amalfi coast. . Nectar accords meet green leaves notes to evoke the softness of figs.. Fico di Amalfi Eau de Toilette is a composition that expresses the perfume of the fig tree in all its complexity, Fico di Amalfi blends nectar accords with green notes of the leaves to convey the fruit's soft and enveloping nature. The fragrance combines the citrus notes of bergamot, lemon, and grapefruit with the notes of fig nectar, pink pepper, and jasmine petals.. Fico di Amalfi comes in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle, a must-have design object with Art deco influences. The glass, which is pure, luxurious, and thick, is tinged with a deep blue that in a play of reflections evokes the transparency of the sea.. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum.. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart a vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender.. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for women is encased in an elegant square-shaped bottle designed to be refilled. Refill sold separately. Gabardine beige and gold packaging adorned with a medallion reference the brand's rich heritage. Thanks to a sustainable and innovative refill system, all Burberry Goddess bottles can be refilled with ease.. Fragrance family is ambery. . Top notes are Vanilla, Lavender, Cacao and Ginger. . Heart notes are Vanilla Caviar. . Base notes are Vanilla Absolute. . . Why It's Escentual: . Goddess offers a different take on traditionally sweet vanilla perfumes. Burberry has used bright Lavender Diva essence from Provence, earthy cocoa, and ginger root notes to balance the vanilla and give the fragrance a more aromatic composition. The vanilla used in Goddess is special; each bean is collected by hand and dried in the sun for five to seven weeks. They are then stored in wooden boxes to mature and develop their rich, signature aroma.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Klorane Centaury Anti-Yellowing Conditioner for Grey and Blonde Hair 200ml
listings.description: A conditioner created by selecting Organic Centaury, a source of cyanocentaurein and a plant-based pigment with bluish undertones - traditionally used to give white or grey hair a pretty silver sheen. The Perks of Klorane Centaury Anti-Yellowing Conditioner for Grey and Blonde Hair: . Detangling: the high-tolerance formula detangles and deeply nourishes to protect lengths and ends when combing.. Neutralises: the formula of the Conditioner with Organic Centaury, actively neutralises yellowing white, grey or platinum blonde hair.. listings.rawTitle: Daniel Sandler Blossom Colour Beauty Glow Multi-Tasking Primer 30ml
listings.description: A revolutionary liquid formula that instantly gives skin a healthy, feel-good glow - it's a confidence boost in a bottle!. Light-reflecting particles soften the appearance of age spots, fine lines and other minor imperfections. Beauty Glow Multi- Tasking Primer leaves skin with a hydrated, more even-toned, brighter complexion. The non-greasy, lightweight formula won't weigh you down or leave your skin feeling oily. Creating a beautiful base for makeup is key, and that's where Beauty Glow shines. Worn as a primer, your makeup will prove easier to apply and last longer as a result. The best part? It's versatile. You can use it both under, over, or mixed with your foundation - or without on makeup-free days! It's perfect for those days when you want to give your skin a break but still want a natural-looking, glowing complexion.. How to Use: . On first usage, may take a few pumps until product appears.. As a primer/ on its own: after applying skincare, pump bottle and apply a single dot on your forehead then one on each cheekbone and chin then blend with fingers to melt onto skin until evenly distributed. Apply more if desired.. Can be mixed with foundation or moisturiser to add a dewy-fresh finish to your base.. Can be layered over makeup as a liquid highlighter. Apply to the top of cheekbones, brow bone, or anywhere you'd like to catch the light..

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Loveshine Candy Glaze Lip Gloss Stick 3.2g / 44 - Nude Lavalliere
listings.description: "I hate lipgloss, and the Yves Saint Laurent Loveshine Candy Glaze Lip Gloss Stick has won me over! It's lip gloss reinvented - it isn't sticky or stringy." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love YSL Loveshine Candy Glaze Lip Gloss Stick: . Bold colour payoff in one stroke.. High-shine lip gloss finish without stickiness.. Lips look plumper and fuller.. Luxurious silver and pink packaging.. . What You Need To Know: . The YSL Loveshine Candy Glaze Lip Gloss Stick combines a lipstick's bold colour payoff and longevity with the glazed shine of a lip gloss. The lip colour comes in various shades; each has an ultra-hydrating formula and a jelly-like texture. The formula contains pomegranate extract from the YSL Ourika Community Garden, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E; lips look visibly plumper and fuller.. . Why It's Escentual: . The YSL Candy Glaze is the first lip gloss stick on the market. As soon as they launched, they took the internet by storm, going viral on TikTok. The gloss-meets-balm formula stole beauty lovers (including our team's) hearts for their mirror-like shine and pigmented colour!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Remove the cap, and swivel up the lipstick with 6 clicks of twist (around 1mm). Start by applying to the centre of the lips and working outwards. Apply an added layer across the centre of the bottom lip to increase shine further.. . Please note: YSL Beauty is in the process of updating this product's packaging and product name. During this process you might receive the product in ROUGE VOLUPTE or LOVESHINE packaging, but don't worry the product formulation and size remains exactly the same. .

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Exuding the modern scent of organic rose, Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum for women is a new woody rose perfume fragrance, connecting the strength and spontaneity of nature with that of the free-spirited Chloe girl. Taking us back to only the essentials, she resonates with a confident, authentic femininity relieved of all artifice. The Chloe spirit, in its purest form.. The Eau de Parfum Intense is a vegan perfume formulated with a 100% natural origin fragrance. Each gentle whisper of the emblematic and woody rose will remind you of a serene, natural setting that soothes and awakens the spirit. Chloe took special care when sourcing Rose Naturelle Intense's main ingredients. A sweet, fresh bergamot makes a debut in the composition. In its wake comes a pure and light neroli with hints of petals; followed by a noble and refined essence of organic rose; a distinctive note tinted with a slightly smoky and vanilla-tinged oak wood upcycled from the timber industry. A base of creamy sandalwood lends fullness, while a touch of cedar steeps the fragrance in a timeless elegance.. Pursuing its initiatives towards a lower impact on the environment, recycled materials now represent 25% of the glass and 40% of the cardboard used for the box. Inspired by Maison's iconic crepe de chine blouse with a feminine neck tie, the timeless vintage-inspired bottle is adorned with a 100% recycled hand-tied ribbon in a new, intense shade of green.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Neroli.. Heart Notes: Organic Rose, Oakwood.. Base Notes: Cedar, Sandalwood..

UVA/UVB protection without white cast.. Liquid texture feels weightless.. Suits all skin types, including sensitive.. . What You Need To Know: . The Original Pure Serum Liquid Foundation offers medium coverage and leaves a radiant, natural finish on the skin. While covering imperfections and evening skin tone, the formula smooths and perfects your bare skin, so you'll feel confident with and without makeup.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Shake well before use. For a more radiant, natural finish, apply with fingertips. Dispense 1 drop onto fingertips and blend into the skin, beginning at the centre of the face and working outward. Work all over the face until fully blended. Build coverage where needed. Combination or oily skin types may want to pair it with a powder to boost longevity.. . Sustainability and Values . listings.rawTitle: Amouage Love Delight Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Love Delight's candied vanilla, soft and sensual boozy aroma makes me feel feminine and confident. The sensual trail it leaves is empowering. However, the overall aroma is lifted by the brightness of citrus notes at the top. Delicate rose and heliotrope florals in the heart add a soft, feminine touch; this combination mellows the sweetness, imparting a sensation reminiscent of strolling through spring gardens at dawn - vibrant, clean, and refreshing.. . Top notes: Ginger, Mandarin, Rose Water, Cinnamon. . Heart note: Heliotrope, Jasmine, Rose. . Base note: Vanilla, Cocoa, Rum Absolute, Cypriol. . . Why It's Escentual . As a retailer of Amouage fragrances for over 10 years, every launch never fails to impress us. Amouage is perfection, from the exquisite box presentation to the beautifully crafted scents. The Amouage bottle detail is stunning, and the shell cap with pink gemstone and magnetic neck exudes opulence, a stunning reflection of the gorgeous scent inside. . The Best Way To Use It: . Love Delight's versatility ensures it complements any occasion with grace and sophistication.. .

They first launched in 2000, and everyone had one - I'm so glad Lancome's brought them back." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . . . Why You'll Love The Lancome Juicy Tubes: . Ultra-shiny lip gloss.. Tube-tip applicator for easy top-ups.. Available in sparkle, creamy and jelly finishes.. Fruity flavour and scent.. . Why It's Escentual: . Juicy Tubes were everywhere in the 2000s'; they were the '˜IT' gloss. Unfortunately, when trends moved toward matte lips Lancome decided to discontinue them in 2018. Luckily, all trends come back around and Lancome has relaunched this cult-hero.. Juicy Tubes are back and better than ever! The nostalgic lip formula gives lips a juicy, high-shine finish that makes lips look plump and hydrated - never sticky. Available in an array of finishes and colours, there's something for a pared-back day at the office or a statement pop of colour for an evening out.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use the tube-tip to apply directly to the lips.. . Values: . Alcohol-free..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Meet the Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger collection's newest fragrance, With You Absolutely - an irresistibly warm fougere scent for men I love!" - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Giorgio Armani Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely: . An ambery scent with aromatic tones of lavender, woods and creamy vanilla.. Lasts for four to six hours.. Part of the iconic Stronger With You collection.. Bottled in signature Stronger With You range style.. . . What Does Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Smell Like? . You're instantly warmed up by a boozy opening of rum accord, met by lavender's classically masculine aromatic scent in the heart. The last impression of this perfume is opulent with notes of sensual cedarwood and creamy sweet vanilla.. Top notes are Rum Accord. Heart notes are Lavender. Base notes are Vanilla, Cedar Wood. . . Why It's Escentual: . The Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely scent is new for 2023. Like all perfumes in the Stronger With You collection, the inspiration is love. The scent embodies classic masculinity-featured notes typically appreciated by refined gentlemen, like the shot of rum accord, herbaceous lavender and a distinctly smokey tobacco undertone that runs through every level of the scent but isn't listed in the notes. The vanilla and lavender notes and the scent's subtle smokiness give it a similar signature to Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme, so if you're a fan, you'll adore this, too.. Packed into the Stronger With You range's signature glass bottle topped with a metal round lid with a double-ringed bottleneck.. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray on your pulse points.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer cardboard box.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y L'Elixir Spray 60ml
listings.description: "YSL Y L'Elixir is a more intense, woodier, and richer version of the Y fragrance for men; this version is perfect for evenings, special occasions or anyone who wants everyone to notice their fragrance. " - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love Yves Saint Laurent Y L'Elixir: . Y L'Elixir will make you feel suave and confident.. Deep, sensual woody-spicy interpretation of the classic Y scent.. Iconic bottle is transformed with a matte, frosted texture.. Y L'Elixir is a sensual fragrance that marries Y's classic freshness with wood and oud notes; this juxtaposition makes for a fragrance that's easy to wear, and hard to ignore.. . YSL Say? . Y is a testament to the YSL modern man. A man who dares to follow his passions and carve his own path. From inspiration, through hard work and collaboration, to self-accomplishment and success. A man confident to take all of life's challenges. For the authentic and bold, YSL Beauty creates Y: the fragrance for those who dare to ask themselves 'why not'.. The YSL modern man is embodied by YSL Beauty fragrance ambassador Lenny Kravitz. Y L'Elixir, the quintessential fragrance for the self-accomplished man. A NEW exceptional scent, this evolution of the Y fragrance has a powerful presence, blending radiant freshness with a luxuriously woody twist. Opening with bergamot and ginger, L'Elixir is crisp and refreshing. At its heart, elegant, clean notes of lavender and geranium impart a timeless sophistication. As the scent evolves, delve into the opulence of a contrasting dark accord: a warm and rich incense evokes a sense of mystery, paired with notes of natural oud wood, exuding a leathery, sensual allure.. With long-lasting intensity, this olfaction has been artfully crafted by master perfumer Dominique Ropion.. Fragrance family is Woody Fougere. . Top notes are Bergamot essence, ginger essence, elemi essence, saffron accord. . Heart notes are Diva lavender heart, sage essence, juniper essence, living geranium. . Base notes are Fir Balsam absolu, Olibanum Essence, cypriol essence, patchouli essence, oud essence. . . Why It's Escentual: . YSL Y is a best-selling fragrance range for men with something for everyone. Each version stays true to the original, keeping the fresh, blue DNA, but adding something new each time; for L'Elixir it's a luxurious twist with leathery oud nuances that exude confidence and charm.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6-8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion de Gingembre Eau de Parfum 100ml

Heart notes are Ginger, Geranium. . Base note is Vetiver. . . Why It’s Escentual: . Les Infusions de Gingembre is a love letter to the note, ginger. It’s both sharp and spicy and light and elegant, making it a wonderful unisex fragrance that can be worn in all seasons. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent All Hours Hyper Finish 7.5g / 1
listings.description: "Yves Saint Laurent All Hours Hyper Finish has a finely milled texture that even people who hate face powder will love; it's so smooth and light that it won't highlight skin texture or make your complexion look cakey or chalky." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love YSL All Hours Hyper Finish: . Multi-use face powder mattifies and sets makeup.. Skincare-infused formula, including hydrating hyaluronic acid.. Finely milled formula is light and smooth.. Available in various shades to suit all skin tones.. . What YSL Say: . All Hours Hyper Finish Powder, the new couture multi-use matte powder, mattify and set complexion for up to 24H (consumer test on 110 women).. Infused with skincare actives and consisting of 90% natural-origin ingredients, All Hours Hyper Finish blurs imperfections and minimises appearance of pores, while smoothing skin. With Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide and Limetta from our YSL Beauty Ourika Community Garden, this formula leaves skin feeling comfortable and smooth, without drying out the skin. Fully blendable and breathable thanks to its finely milled texture, Hyper Finish ensures a seamless application, whether it is layered onto foundation as a setting powder, or glided onto skin as a powder foundation itself.. Hyper versatile, this multi-use matte powder is perfect to: Set foundation all day, mattify complexion with a soft-touch finish, wear alone to enhance a no-makeup makeup look and give a healthy skin finish. Makeup is locked and never feeling cakey or creasy.. All Hours Hyper Finish blurs imperfections and minimises the appearance of pores while smoothing skin.. . Why It's Escentual: . All Hours Hyper Finish is the first 24-hour mattifying powder from YSL. It follows the best-selling All Hours Foundation, which is best-loved for its long-lasting, high-coverage formula. The Hyper Finish face powder is an excellent addition to this range; not only does it extend the wear-time of your base, but it helps to blur pores and minimise the look of imperfections. Perfect for on-the-go, the luxurious makeup compact has a faux leather case, mirror, and two-sided applicator for a perfect makeup result. The beige sponge side is designed to deliver the ideal amount of powder, while the white fluffy side can be used for easy touch-ups.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use the included sponge to apply the powder to your face. Use in the t-zone to keep shine at bay, or apply all over for a matte finish.. . Values: . Non-comedogenic.. Waterproof, Sweatproof..

listings.rawTitle: Bioderma Cicabio SPF50+ Ultra-Repairing Soothing Cream 40ml
listings.description: Protect the skin of the entire family with Bioderma Cicabio SPF 50+ Soothing Repairing Care, a 2-in-1 formula that both repairs skin and shields it from the sun.. Created to aid reconstruction after skin becomes damaged, Cicabio SPF 50+ has the added bonus of high SPF protection to prevent post-scarring hyperpigmentation that can be caused by sun exposure. As well as improving the appearance of the skin, Cicabio SPF 50+ relieves the urge to scratch skin as it heals, and moisturises the area to ensure optimum comfort for adults, children and infants*.. At the heart of the formula is a synergistic combination of resveratrol, copper and centella asiatica, which provide the optimum environment for quality skin restoration. Added antibacterial zinc keeps the area purified and fresh, Antalgicine relieves the sensation of discomfort from the skin, and hyaluronic acid keeps the skin well hydrated.. Apply to the affected area, and reapply frequently during sun exposure. Use until skin is completely repaired. If irritation persists, consult your doctor.. listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vetiver Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: To reinterpret Vétiver's iconic fragrance, Guerlain's perfumers have turned to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and the spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients, to create a scent of unparalleled seduction. . Composed much like a gin, Vétiver Le Parfum opens with slightly bitter, aromatic notes of juniper berry. Invigorating and energizing, an exceptional vetiver essence follows, revealing its freshest facets. Distilled from vetiver roots, this noble ingredient showcases the full depth of vetiver's woody tones. Blended with captivating smoky notes and the addictive Tonka bean, beloved by Guerlain, the result is a fragrance that reveals a sublime balance of brightness and earthiness, power and elegance. . "For Vétiver Le Parfum, I created an even more aromatic and intense opening with juniper berries, coriander and licorice. all in the spirit of an infused gin." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. . Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, Vétiver Le Parfum's bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker green label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Ideal Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: To reinterpret the iconic woody scent of L'Homme Idéal, Guerlain's perfumers have looked to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients, to create a scent of unparalleled seduction. . With its inimitable character borrowed from amaretto, a bitter almond flavored Italian liqueur, L'Homme Idéal Le Parfum, doubles down on the richly gourmand sensuality of its original fragrance. Deep and mysteriously leathery at the heart, this captivating fragrance unfolds against mysterious woody accents and intensely seductive patchouli notes followed by a cocoon of musky notes for an altogether irresistibly sensual scent. . "For L'homme Idéal Le Parfum, I evoked the almond in amaretto, making it all the more woody and all the more intense." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer . Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, L'Homme Idéal Le Parfum's bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker grey label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: To reinterpret Habit Rouge's iconic amber fragrance, Guerlain's perfumers have turned to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and the spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients to create a scent of unparalleled seduction.. As the first amber fragrance to be created for men, Habit Rouge was inspired by equestrianism, the pastime that was dear to its creator, Jean-Paul Guerlain. First released in 1965, Habit Rouge's woody, spicy fragrance enveloped with round vanilla became an olfactory symbol of French elegance. Taking its inspiration from the bold intensity of bourbon, Habit Rouge Le Parfum opens with the rich tonalities of a rum accord, followed perfectly with Guerlain's unique vanilla tincture that is made according to its own special in-house process. Set alongside patchouli, it's this vanilla tincture that lends Habit Rouge's signature its unparalleled depth.. "For Habit Rouge Le Parfum, I created a leathery vanilla liqueur with plenty of bold bourbon-inspired intensity." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. . Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, Habit Rouge Le Parfum's bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker red label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern..

Touches of Everlasting Pure Jungle Essence with its Mediterranean facets blend harmoniously with the marine Woody note of Driftwood, sublimating in an Ambery trail of Orcanox and Vanilla Pure Jungle Essence. . Top Notes: Red Algae, Prickly Pear. Heart Notes : Salty Woods, Helichrysum. Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Gentleman Society Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy invites the most unstoppable Gentlemen to join the edgiest society with Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme, the bold new signature for men who set their own rules.. A dark iced coffee accord pushes this powerful woody floral spicy fragrance to sensational limits for the most extreme Eau de Parfum.. Crafted with Givenchy savoir-faire, Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme is composed of exceptional raw materials, carefully chosen for their optimum olfactory qualities.. Top notes of Clary Sage are heightened with ice-cold Peppermint and fiery Nutmeg creating an immediate aromatic and spicy twist.. The mysterious heart reveals the original Gentleman Society accord, blending Narcissus Absolute and Iris Concrete, contrasted by the signature quartet of Vetiver. A powerful and unexpected Coffee Extract Absolute develops out of this accord. Paired with Peppermint Essence, this Coffee note seems iced revealing a new and extremely textured facet.. At the base, woody notes of Cedar and Sandal are deepened by Patchouli Essence and Vanilla Absolute, perfecting this deep trail.. Inspired by couture, the iconic design of the Gentleman bottle is reinterpreted for a new high-impact look. The deep black lacquer finish is enhanced with the Givenchy signature: the 4G logo, emblazoned like a crest, in a striking new gunmetal finish. The Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass..

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Blossom Special Edition Eau de Parfum Spray 40ml
listings.description: "Floral elegance shimmers out of Jimmy Choo Blossom Special Edition Eau de Parfum, a limited-edition update on the iconic Blossom scent." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Jimmy Choo Blossom Special Edition: . Joyous fruity-floral fragrance with a woody undertone.. Eau de Parfum format with gentle sillage.. Limited-edition perfume within the beloved Blossom line.. Features a textured pink ombre design.. . What Does Jimmy Choo Blossom Special Edition Smell Like? . A burst of sweetness dances out of Blossom Special Edition as the top note of exotic fruit offers a sparkling, juicy start. The heart of frangipani flowers creates a delicately warm and naturally sweet floral scent that feels smooth and creamy. The slight floral warmth is then intensified by the base note of sandalwood, adding a soft woody quality that enhances the perfume's existing sweetness to offer a hint of rich earthiness.. Top note is Exotic Fruit Accord. Heart note is Frangipani Flower. Base note is Sandalwood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Jimmy Choo's vibrant fragrance combines sweet juicy fruits, delicate florals and a warm woody base to capture the playful optimism of a bright, sunny day in spring. Just one spritz of Blossom Special Edition feels warm and comforting, inspiring joy just like the original Blossom scent. But the limited-edition fragrance feels lighter than the original Blossom, giving a sweeter floral feel that is made for the young at heart.. The limited-edition perfume shares similarities to Blossom Eau de Parfum, living in the same delicately sweet fruity-floral fragrance family. However, the-limited edition version has frangipani flower at its heart, compared to the original's rose and sweet pea tones, while it also has a more exotic fruity opening than the original to ensure it stands out as a signature scent in its own right.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your neck, wrists and behind your ears. Apply to moisturised skin for increased scent longevity.. .

listings.rawTitle: Hair Gain Peptide Puff Dry Shampoo 5g
listings.description: "The Hair Gain Peptide Puff Dry Shampoo is my secret weapon for stretching hairstyles out between washes; it refreshes hair quickly and discreetly!" - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Hair Gain Peptide Puff Dry Shampoo: . Refreshes greasy hair in seconds.. Doesn't leave any chalky white residue.. Adds volume, body and texture to roots.. Safe for sensitive scalps.. Non-aerosol alternative dry shampoo.. . What You Need To Know: . The Hair Gain Peptide Puff Dry Shampoo is a finely milled dry shampoo for all hair types. Unlike many other dry shampoos, the Peptide Puff comes in a non-aerosol format; it has a sustainable, padded puff applicator that's dabbed directly onto the hair.. The unique formula contains biotin, caffeine, acetyl tetrapeptide-3 and red clover extract. These complex peptides and natural botanicals revitalise and extend styles, absorbing oil, sweat and odour while adding body and texture.. . Why It's Escentual: . Hair Gain is loved for its vegan hair growth supplements, so it's no wonder the Peptide Puff does more than refresh the hair. Its gentle formula is recommended and endorsed by trichologists (scalp experts). It is packed with a scientifically formulated blend of active ingredients to care for your scalp and hair in between washes.. It's been a while since we've seen innovation in the dry shampoo category. The Peptide Puff's clever design solves a common problem with traditional aerosol dry shampoos: waste. The Peptide puff allows for targeted application and is discreet, too, so you can touch up tired-looking tresses wherever you go.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Divide your hair into sections. Pat the powder puff onto your hair, then wait for 30 seconds. Gently massage the dry shampoo into your scalp and roots with your fingers. Brush through and style your hair as normal.. . Sustainability and Values . Vegan, Cruelty-free, Dermatologically-tested, Trichologist-approved.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Bronzer Refill 8.5g / 00 - Light Cool
listings.description: Extend the life of your Terracotta Powder case with the refill format. The Terracotta refills are only compatible with the new-generation cases.. The legendary Terracotta Bronzing Powder recreates a seamless true-to-skin bronzed glow in one simple, instant step. With 96% naturally-derived ingredients, including pigments and luminescent shimmer, its texture instantly fuses with the skin to ensure a skin-perfecting bronzed glow finish. Infused with natural Moroccan argan oil, known for its nourishing properties, its formula maintains the skin's moisture levels for long-lasting comfort.. For generations, the legendary Terracotta powder fragrance has been transporting into summer with its sunny notes of ylang-ylang and orange blossom, warmed by vanilla and tonka bean, on a sensual background of white musk. This instantly recognisable cult fragrance is a voluptuous one-way ticket to warmth, sun and travel all year long. It combines ultimate pleasure with desirability.. Six shades designed to beautifully enhance all skin tones.. This formula offers an ultra-fine second-skin texture that preserves the natural finish of each complexion. A unique combination of naturally-derived pigments and shimmers that naturally bronze the complexion. . How to Use. . Refill your Terracotta in a simple step using the powder refill option.. In harmony with the House's eco-friendly approach, the bronzing powders are designed to be refillable, seamlessly extending your sun-kissed complexion's radiant glow.. Once your powder is finished, place the refill tool in the slot under the case and lift the used powder until it comes out of the case. Then, insert your new refill and close your case..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Blush 5g / 000 - Pearly Beige
listings.description: Terracotta Blush, formulated with 90% naturally-derived ingredients¹, transparently reveals and sets off the cheekbones with a delicate shade reminiscent of the freshness that rises to the cheeks after an outdoor escape. . With its lightweight and airy texture, this long-lasting² and comfortable powder blush reveals skin’s natural undertones under a perfectly balanced, ultra-buildable and second-skin veil of colour. . . Deeply connected to the spectacle of nature, Guerlain has designed a palette of 8 blush shades, reflecting the original spectrum of the earth. . Shades with a matte or pearlescent finish for a makeup result with a buildable intensity. Five tones – beige, nude, pink, coral and red – each available in two intensities: light and deep. . They can be worn to match your complexion and personal preferences. . 000 Pearly Beige: a luminous iridescent beige.. 00 Light Nude: a fresh and delicate beige pink. . 01 Light Pink: a soft and elegant bluish pink. . 02 Light Coral: a velvety apricot, set off with a subtle hint of pink. . 03 Deep Nude: a deep rosy brown. . 04 Deep Pink: a mysterious plum pink. . 05 Deep Coral: a vibrant and warm coral . 06 Deep Red: a intense and flamboyant red. Best Way to Wear: . For an even more natural result, apply Terracotta Blush to the centre of the cheek, where skin naturally blushes. To add dimension and create contrast, blend a warm and a cool shade of blush to create a unique colour tailored to each person.. ¹Based on ISO 16128 standard. The remaining 10% contribute to product integrity, sensoriality and pigmentation. . ²Instrumental test and clinical evaluation on 30 women. . .

It makes you feel confident and seductive with alluring cherry, sweet vanilla and boozy cognac notes.. The star perfume note: hedione is responsible for a heightened libido.. It lasts way longer than a traditional Eau de Parfum -12 hours on us!. The luxurious box and heavyweight purple bottle are covetable.. It's a spicier Side Effect; It's got a vanilla overload similar to Atelier Des Ors Rouge Saray, and we'd say it's more Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille than Lost Cherry. . Initio Say: . At the heart of the fragrance lies hedione, a molecule that stimulates the brain's pleasure centres and acts as the final trigger in a formula that is decidedly sensuous.. Narcotic Delight, is a tantalising bright juice that ignites the senses. A subversive concentration exciting the imagination. An incandescent liquor that lights the heart and skin ablaze.. Narcotic Delight is all of these things at once. Ecstatic and wild instinct. It set its sights on the erogenous vanilla bean, electrified by pink pepper, drenched in a draught of cognac, before finally succumbing to the intoxicating swirls of a cigar. A cheeky twist of plump and juicy cherry celebrates the indulgence of a polished proposition.. The spell is inescapable. The infatuation is phenomenal. The pleasure is absolute. Narcotic Delight is a sensual shot of provocation. This time, obsession intensifies, and addiction leads you by the nose. You have been warned.. . The Notes? . Fragrance family is Gourmand. . Top notes Cherry, Pink Pepper and Black Pepper. . Heart notes are Cognac and Hedione. . Base notes are Tobacco and Vanilla. . . Why It's Escentual: . Initio created The Carnal Blends for the ultimate seduction; each prive is an olfactory symbol of hedonism and gratification.. Bochum University in Germany recently proved that certain fragrances containing key compounds like hedione can tap into brain regions linked to libido. Initio have ensured this perfume contains at least 50% of hedione for long-lasting pleasure!. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. When spraying, hold the perfume bottle about 6-8 inches away from your skin. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria FloraBloom Eau de Toilette Spray Refill 200ml
listings.description: "Florabloom is a celebration of the power and beauty of nature that's both wild and poetic." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain perfumer . Florabloom is a joyful, multicoloured explosion of rainbow florals within a bouquet whose heart beams with true-to-nature tuberose. Set around dazzling white tuberose flower, roses, iris and violets accords come together against a mossy background to reveal sunny and bright creamy facets.. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon known as a superbloom, this creation evokes the multicoloured carpets of desert flowers that so spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall.. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable and recyclable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass.. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles..

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet is the new Eau de Toilette Intense by Issey Miyake born under the sun. A fragrance for women in which water meets matter in a new light.. In the springtime, nature reawakens at a time of rebirth. Water is refreshed by a cool breeze. Matter is warmed by the first rays of sunshine.. For this women's perfume, water blends with delicate violet to bring an explosion of purple to life. Warmth contrasts with freshness, and delicacy meets intensity to create a modern take on violet.. Top notes of juicy, solar pear notes open the perfume, enhancing the powerful powdery luminosity of violet leaf absolute at the scent's heart.. Blossoming under the leaves of the plant, violets represent modesty, sensuality, and grace. Their intense and enchanting scent leaves a delicate floral trail that awakens the senses. As the fragrance dries down onto the skin, the tenderness of the violet is textured by the elegant silky base notes of iris.. A celebration of nature, this vegan-certified perfume is made with 90% natural origin ingredients. The 100% natural origin violet in L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet is sourced responsibly in Egypt..

What You Need To Know: . Super BB Concealer stands out because of Its proven skincare benefits and full coverage finish. Helps smooth and hydrate skin with 2% white ginseng complex, a 6-year-old Korean skincare secret.. Brightening and anti-imperfection actions with 5% niacinamide.. For maximum coverage, apply the concealer first and blend by patting gently with your finger, a makeup brush or a sponge – whichever you prefer.. Then, apply the Super BB cream over the top. listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Rediscover Omnia Crystalline in a new shape, with its inimitable original scent untouched.. Like a frame of light, the iconic fascination of OMNIA is now characterised by a new, more precious flacon design. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas.. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks.. Bottle Design Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon.. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold coloured frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweller to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections.. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.. Notes . Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a duo bathed in light. The crispness of nashi pear accord is enhanced by the freshness of a bamboo accord.. Heart Notes: A delicate alliance transports the heart of the fragrance towards floral and resolutely feminine tones. The aquatic transparency of lotus accord is tinged with the purity of a white peony note.. Base Notes: At dry-down, the warm balsa wood accord reveals a tender woody trail combined with the soft sensuality of a crystal musks accord. .

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Nuxuriance Ultra The Eye & Lip Contour Cream 15ml

The GUERLAIN Terracotta Le Teint Concealer is a medium (buildable) coverage, long-wearing concealer with a satin finish on the skin. It's available in various shades to suit all skin tones and seamlessly covers imperfections, brightens shadowy areas, and blurs purple and bluish dark circles with ease.. The multi-purpose, liquid concealer has a lightweight, comfortable texture from 95% naturally-derived ingredients. The formula keeps the delicate skin around the eyes hydrated and revitalised with added argan oil (the Terracotta range's signature ingredient) and marine extract. Why It's Escentual: . Terracotta Le Teint Concealer is the result of Guerlain's expertise and years of scientific research in powder and pigment. For targeted application, dab the concealer onto the skin, then blend out with the fingertip. Then pat with the brush and blend outwards for a natural, seamless finish.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN KISSKISS Bee Glow Oil 9.5ml / 258 - Rose Glow
listings.description: "If you hate how sticky lip gloss is but love the shine it gives, you need to try the Guerlain KISSKISS Bee Glow Oil." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Guerlain Bee Glow Oil: . Mirror-like shine that isn't sticky.. Corsican-honey keeps lips comfortable.. Propolis helps to smooth the lips.. Royal jelly plumps and hydrates.. Selection of tinted shades.. Luxurious packaging.. . . What You Need To Know: . The Guerlain KISSKISS Bee Glow oil is a honey-infused lip oil with 92% natural ingredients. The luxurious lip oil has a nourishing and plumping formula to pamper lips with 24-hour care. Corsican honey provides lasting comfort while propolis smoothes, and royal jelly increases natural hyaluronic acid synthesis by 24% for plumper-looking lips.. The Bee Glow Oil has a sumptuous oil texture that glides effortlessly onto lips. It doesn't feel sticky, and you'll never see the '˜stringy' effect synonymous with lip gloss. The lip oil is extremely luxurious, from its delectable honey scent to its premium packaging. The design has gold accents, curved edges, a large doe-foot applicator for seamless application, and special touches, including a bee embossed onto the lid to symbolise the honey-infused formula and Guerlain's Bee Conservation Program.. . The Shades: . 258 Rose Glow: a soft pink.. 309 Honey Glow: a rosy pink.. 319 Peach Glow: a peachy coral.. 458 Rose Pop Glow: a fuschia pink.. 775 Poppy Glow: a red-pink.. 809 Lavender Glow: a cool-toned berry.. . Why It's Escentual: . We stock some of the best-selling lip oils on the market. From Clarins to Dior, we're proud to offer these iconic formulas. Because of this, our expectations for this makeup category are very high. Guerlain has blown our expectations out of the water. For their first lip oil, Guerlain has used their many years of expertise with honey to craft a formula that's a great example of high-end makeup; it looks and feels premium, has wonderful lip-caring benefits and makes the lips look beautifully glazed.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the Bee Glow Oil directly to the lips with the doe-foot applicator. Wear alone or layer over your favourite lip balm or lipstick.. . Sustainability and Values . Guerlain is committed to preserving biodiversity. They innovate sustainably and have a Bee Conservation Program that works to protect bees.. .

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Daylight fades. The sky turns blue. Embrace the irresistible call of twilight with new Phantom Intense by Rabanne. . Capturing the vibing energy of Paris at dusk, Phantom Intense enters new territory for all those who dare. Bolder and more intense, it's powered by your most daring side yet. . An exceptional blend of the finest ingredients forges a new frontier with an aromatic ambery fragrance. Vivid lavender surrenders to a new vanilla addiction and a frosted orange blossom twist to capture the irresistibly enigmatic aura within you. Answer the call of adventure. Follow the Phantom twilight thrill. . THE FRAGRANCE Crafted with the most exceptional ingredients, Phantom Intense by Rabanne embraces the most daring masculinity to liberate the powerful aura within. Following the mysterious facet of Phanton Parfum, a bolder face of Phantom comes alive as the story continues. With Phantom Intense, discover a fresher incarnation in an aromatic ambery accord of vivid lavender, a vanilla addiction and a frosted orange blossom twist. . THE BOTTLE Transcending the ordinary, the Phantom Intense comes in a bold design featuring new color codes. Capturing the enigmatic spirit of the Phantom, the iconic robot transforms from fully mat black to a gradient of blues that fade, like Paris at twilight, to a powerfully masculine lacquered finish. The glossy jet black spray cap meets the high shine electric blue bottle to defy expectation as a daring new icon is born. .

listings.rawTitle: Lierac The Micellar Water 200ml
listings.description: Micellar cleansing water that gently removes impurities and make-up from the skin's surface with a skin-friendly formula and moisturising action, leaving the face clean and fresh. . Composed of 96% natural ingredients, Micellar Water gently cleanses and removes makeup from the face and eyes. At the heart of its formula, the Marine Prebiotic Complex preserves and strengthens the skin microbiota. Its fresh and delicately scented texture leaves the skin perfectly clean, soft and radiant.. Suitable for all skin types, even sensitive.. THE PREBIOTIC COMPLEX offers a complete and balanced nutritional contribution, adapted to the needs of all microbiota. Composed of 3 active ingredients [sea water - green and brown algae - sugar], it provides the essential nutrients to maintain a balanced skin microbiota.. SEA WATER Provides a wide variety of minerals and trace elements essential to the diversity of the microbiota.. GREEN AND BROWN ALGAE Sources of sugars and amino acids which respectively provide carbon and nitrogen, two elements essential to the growth of the microbiota.. SUGAR Allows to maintain stable environmental conditions by protecting the bacteria..

listings.rawTitle: Lierac Premium The Silky Cream 50ml
listings.description: Complete anti-aging care for the face, The Silky Cream corrects all the signs of aging: wrinkles; fine lines; dark spots; lack of firmness, radiance, elasticity and density; and dryness.. Its incomparably soft texture leaves a subtle powdery finish on the skin. Suitable for normal to combination skin, including sensitive skin.. Formulated with 95% natural-origin ingredients, The Silky Cream corrects all the signs of aging and instantly moisturises the skin. The core formula combines [F.G.N.] Technology with Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide to target three causes of skin aging. Enriched with a plant-based mattifying powder to give a light powdery finish on the skin. All the signs of aging are corrected: wrinkles; fine lines; dark spots; lack of firmness, radiance, elasticity and density; and dryness.. Its rich and delicate cream texture glides onto the skin like silk and gives a light, mattifying finish. Its iconic delicate floral fragrance reveals the subtle notes of jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang.. How To Use . Apply to your face and neck in the morning and evening after your serum. . Apply the cream from the middle of your face outwards from the chin to the temples, the nose to the temples, and the middle of the forehead to the temples. . Repeat this movement until the texture is completely absorbed..

listings.rawTitle: Lierac Arkeskin The Menopause Night Cream 50ml
listings.description: Lierac Arkeskin Night Cream aims to correct the signs of menopause on the skin: dryness, loss of density and firmness.. Inspired by Chronobiology, this treatment combines a Night Bio-peptide which reactivates skin regeneration, redensifying flax seeds, firming chicory, and plumping hyaluronic acid. Composed of 96% ingredients of natural origin , its silky and intensely nourishing texture refreshes and plumps the skin.. Its fragrance with relaxing magnolia notes leaves the skin delicately scented. For optimal effectiveness and to help the skin regain its balance during menopause, use in duo with the Arkeskin Day Cream Rebalancing Comfort treatment.. Key Benefits . Night Cream for dry skin. Ideal for menopausal skin. Improves skin density. Firms and plumps the skin. Anti-ageing night treatment. How To Use . Apply to clean, dry skin. Apply in the evening to face and neck. Gently massage until fully absorbed.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Green Stravaganza Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: As the sun rises and shines over the eternal city, Born in Roma Green Stravaganza takes you on a bold adventure to the cool gardens of Roma, where you are free to live and express yourself. Born in Roma Green Stravaganza is a fougere ambery fragrance, revealing its magnetic aroma through the freshness of Calabrian bergamot heart, the pure energy surge of coffee accord, and the warmth of Vetiver heart essence. Born in Roma Green Stravaganza leads the way to the extravagance of Rome, allowing you to feel the energy, unleash your true personality, and live excessively - because there are many vibrant ways to be you.. The Scent: . Fresh Calabrian Bergamot Heart reveals its full vitality while the fragrance unfolds, enriching the zesty and green notes. The Calabria Bergamot Heart is sustainably sourced and crafted for the brand according to Valentino Beauty engagement.. Like a pure shot of coffee captured in the fragrance bottle, the rich dark aroma of the coffee accord amplifies the magnetism of this juice.. Warm and woody notes of Vetiver Heart Essence Haiti intensifies the fragrance, giving away the authentic elegance and sophistication. The Haiti Vetiver heart is sustainably sourced & crafted for the brand according to Valentino Beauty engagement.. . Instruction of use: . Apply on each pulse point - wrist, inner elbow and neck, from a short distance.. . Discover the Born in Roma Collection: . The spicy, woody Born In Roma Uomo Eau De Toilette.. The fresh, exotic Born In Roma Yellow Dream Uomo Eau De Toilette.. The warm, fruity Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Uomo Eau De Toilette.. The floral, ambery Born In Roma Intense Donna Eau De Parfum..

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "It's not overly sweet. It's a soft floral with sparkling, juicy-fruit accents. When you first spray it, you can almost smell the strawberry seeds and rose petals. " - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love Coach Love: . It will make you feel fresh and feminine for up to 4 hours.. Compliments include: you smell delightful!. You'll love Coach Love if you like fresh, sweet perfumes, not sticky-sweet. Even though its main power notes are strawberry, it's not like a Bubbaloo strawberry; it's the zingier, sharper side, which plays nicely with rose, as it takes away the soapiness out the petals, making the sweetness sparkly and not syrupy or gloopy.. . What Does Coach Love Smell Like? . Coach Love doesn't have the exact scent profile La Vie Est Belle by Lancome or Dior Blooming Bouquet, but if you like those scents, we're confident you'll think this is pretty. . Fragrance family: fruity-floral. . Top note: wild strawberry. . Heart note: velvet rose. . Base note: cedarwood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Coach Love is a sparklier, sweeter, softer addition to the For Her collection, which landed in 2023, and people love it (excuse the pun). We're sure it's because of its striking bold red bottle and non-syrupy berry floral scent.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .
