listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm Stick 9g
listings.description: "You can swipe on hydration wherever you are with the Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm Stick; it's a must-have if you have dry skin." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm Stick: . Invisible, lightweight balm texture.. Keeps skin hydrated all day.. Blends seamlessly over or under makeup.. Strengthens the skin's barrier.. Can be used on the face and body.. . What You Need To Know: . The Ultra Facial Barrier Balm Stick deeply hydrates all skin types. The invisible barrier balm is rich in moisturising and strengthening ingredients like squalane and pro-ceramides, which lock in moisture and strengthen the skin's barrier. The twist-up stick can be used at home, on the go, and over or under makeup.. Dry and sensitive skin types will love the balm's fragrance-free formula and its soothing balm texture that helps to ease discomfort like tightness and itchiness.. . Why It's Escentual: . Kiehl's always goes above and beyond to test the efficacy of their formulas. No, really. In 2005, they tested the original Ultra Facial Cream in extreme conditions by accompanying explorers to the ice-covered peaks in Greenland! It surpassed expectations and has gone on to become a cult favourite moisturiser for dry skin. We're thrilled to stock the new balm texture in the range; it's the perfect addition to the collection!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the stick over the skin as the last step in your skincare routine. You can also apply over makeup.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Over Red Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: A thrilling sweet temptation. Dark black coffee and luminous white flowers are dipped in a juicy cherry accord. . Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. . Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive. . Starring YSL Beauty global make-up and fragrance ambassador Zoe Kravitz. . . Scent:. Black Opium Over Red awakens the senses with a delectable rush of juicy cherry. With dark roasted black coffee and a smooth vanilla infusion, the now iconic Black Opium signature is re-interpreted with a playful twist. Sweet yet seductive, a burst of a red cherry creates the ultimate fragrance temptation. Paired with the bright floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom, the scent blooms with thrilling freshness.. Top notes: cherry accord, mandarin essence.. Heart notes: jasmine flower, black tea, orange blossom absolute.. Base notes: black coffee accord, vanilla infusion, patchouli heart.. Bottle:. In striking fashion, the Black Opium bottle goes Over Red. Translucent red lacquering dresses the glass, creating a precious jewel-like effect to the bottle. At the heart of the fragrance, its appearance intensifies, with a blacked-out window detail.. Collection:. Like the twisting of fabrics, colours and textures YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting the gourmet coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift:. Black Opium Eau de Parfum: The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising.. Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green: A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this 'mocktail in a scent'. Energising and fresh.. Black Opium Eau de Parfum Over Red: A thrilling temptation, the signature coffee and vanilla notes of Black Opium Eau de Parfum are twisted with a juicy red cherry accord. Sweet and seductive.. Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme: The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive.. Black Opium Le Parfum. Black Opium: at its most luxurious. A radical quartet of sumptuous vanilla notes, ultra-dark coffee, and luminous white flowers. Smooth, sensual, and uncompromising.. Application:. For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, let the fragrance fall gently around you.. For medium intensity: spray in a y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery it is a great alternative to spraying your neck.. For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and / or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail.. Other Application Tips. Hair & hair accessories: they can be fragranced for a gentle fragrance trail. For just a halo of scent, spray your hair brush only.. Garments: perfume the inside of your jacket and coats for a medium trail. For added intensity of fragrance go further and perfume your blouse / jumper.. Scarves: for lighter fragrance, spray a scarf and wrap the scarf around your neck to transfer fragrance onto yourself gently.. Bathing: spritz perfume on warm bath water for an indulgent experience..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30ml
listings.description: GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is a deeper interpretation of the iconic woody-oriental perfume that celebrates sensual feminity.. GUERLAIN welcomes another flanker to the best-selling Mon Guerlain collection with Intense. A head-turning Eau de Parfum, this addition lives up to its famous name, returning with the sensuously sweet juice we know and love in its most powerful composition yet. Inspired by Angelina Jolie, Mon Guerlain channels the confidence and freedom of modern femininity, inviting women everywhere to express and embrace what makes them different.. Sweet and sophisticated, this Eau de Parfum is a must-have for all vanilla lovers. The juice opens with sharp bursts of bergamot, tangy mandarin and soothing lavender, before giving way to a backdrop of floral-jasmine and a mouth-watering double dose of smooth vanilla, which seeps through every level of this perfume. As it warms on the skin, base notes of white musk, patchouli and woody-sandalwood reveal a sensual composition of alluring feminine energy.. Why We Love It . Beautifully bottled, the glass flacon mirrors the signature style of the original Mon Guerlain, but not everything is as you remember it. Its aroma isn't the only thing that's intensified; the juice is a much deeper shade of pink, and its darker rose collar marries perfectly with its stronger scent.. Just when we thought Mon Guerlain couldn't get any better, they released Mon Guerlain Intense. Even though it still has a jasmine core, the perfume promises an all in all sweeter composition, doubling up on the gourmand vanilla which, creates an aroma that doesn't rely on floral as it's overriding quality. Definitely a statement scent, Mon Guerlain is one of those fragrances that will invite the question: what you are wearing?. Works Well With . If you're looking for even more intensity, combine your Mon Guerlain perfume with one of the body products in the collection.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Carla Lavender.. Heart Notes: Sambac Jasmine, Vanilla Tincture, Tahitensis Vanilla.. Base Notes: White Musks, Patchouli, Sandalwood..

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense Spray 50ml
listings.description: Discover intensity at its utmost. A sophisticated, highly concentrated composition, BOSS Bottled Elixir encourages you to find your inner light and be your own BOSS. Launched 25 years after the original BOSS Bottled, BOSS Bottled Elixir sees a fragrance icon reinterpreted with a vigorous statement, promising unmatched depth and an immersive wearing experience.. The Fragrance . Crafted by the legendary master perfumer Annick Menardo “ creator of the BOSS Bottled signature “ in close collaboration with perfumer Suzy le Helley, this irresistible fragrance celebrates the reinvention of a contemporary classic. The Elixir smells incredible and captivates with opulent ingredients in rich concentrations. Incense and cardamom essences emit vibrancy and warmth, while a heart of vetiver and patchouli leaves a memorable, earthy imprint. With a base of cedarwood essence and labdanum absolute, BOSS Bottled Elixir serves a strong, woody charisma and a burst of bold masculinity.. The Bottle . The unique BOSS Bottled glass bottle is presented with a deep black lacquered finish that gives way to a golden glow in the centre, channelling the spirit of the modern BOSS man finding his inner light. A radiant ceramic finish and a brushed icy-gold cap further elevate the elegance of this new creation within the BOSS Bottled story.. How To Use . The scent of BOSS Bottled Elixir is perfect for any occasion and intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a stronger long-lasting fragrance. Use in combination with the BOSS Bottled shower gel and the BOSS Bottled deodorant spray for a more intense scent.. Notes . Top Notes: Incense Essence. Heart Notes: Vetiver Essence. Base Notes: Cedarwood Essence.

Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense Eau de Parfum Intense contains no artificial colouring. The vegan perfume is formulated with a 100% natural origin fragrance.. Why We Love It We love this nourishing cream because it treats severe dryness without resorting to a heavy, slick, or suffocating feel. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau de Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: "Laced with a premium blend of rare and noble ingredients, Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau de Parfum honours the tradition of 18th century French perfumery whilst offering a stunning signature scent made for the 21st century." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Parfums de Marly Haltane: . A clever niche fragrance that carefully balances light and dark notes.. Blends rich aromatics with warm woods and sensual musk and leather.. Deeply long-lasting Eau de Parfum for men.. Housed in a chic matte green bottle adorned with Parfums de Marlys' iconic emblem.. . What Does Parfums de Marly Haltane Smell Like? . Haltane kickstarts with a vibrant freshness as an aromatic duo of clary sage and lavender are lifted by a sunny touch of citrus-green bergamot. The heart is rich, opulent and utterly captivating: softly spiced saffron gently warms up balsamic cedarwood and leathery, resinous oud wood, which is balanced by a surprisingly sweet praline accord. This adds a fresh, modern tone that ensures the oud accord doesn't become too dark without allowing the sugar-coated, nutty facet of praline to become sickly sweet.. As the fragrance warms on your skin, its sensual, sophisticated base of smooth yet smoky leather, earthy patchouli, grassy vetiver and luminous agarwood and musks results in a deeply long-lasting signature.. Top notes are Bergamot, Lavender, Clary Sage. Heart notes are Saffron, Cedarwood, Praline, Oudwood. Base notes are Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk, Leather, Natural Agarwood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Haltane Eau de Parfum is a very clever fragrance; it plays with some really bold, powerful fragrance notes - like oudwood and leather - but it never feels too dark or heavy. This is thanks to its lighter, brighter touches, like bergamot and sweet, nutty praline. The end result is a really well-balanced signature that cleverly toys with radiance and shadow.. And if you love deeply long-lasting signatures, then you'll adore Haltane; when we first tried this Eau de Parfum, we were massively impressed by its strength and longevity. Not that we'd expect anything less from the niche fragrance house, Parfums de Marly, of course.. Any fan of the brand will also recognise the emblematic bottle. This time, the flacon is dressed in a muted green hue that nods to the earthy, herbal notes within. The raised emblem on the front completes the look, while honouring Parfums de Marly's French heritage; it nods to the Chevaux de Marly, a pair of marble sculptures commissioned by Louis XV of France in 1743.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Haltan directly onto your pulse points: the neck and wrists..

listings.description: "Over time, my chicken skin has dramatically improved. My thighs and knees look more even and feel smoother too." - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love Eucerin's Anti-Pigment Body Cream: . . Improve skin confidence by fading dark spots, pigmentation and marks.. See brighter results in two weeks.. 98% of subjects in clinical trials confirm it fades dark areas.. . What You Need To Know: . This body cream targets hyperpigmentation and dark spots on the body that stem from factors like sunlight, hormones, and ageing that can make your skin produce too much melanin, leading to dark patches and age spots that make your skin look uneven. . The cream isn't just talk; it's been tested by experts and clinically proven to reduce dark spots and smooth out rough patches on your knees and elbows. You'll start seeing results in just two weeks, and with regular use, your skin will look even, refined, and radiant.. The cream directly targets the root cause of dark spots and is proven to reduce them over time, thanks to Thiamadol, exclusive to Eucerin. Gentle exfoliating ingredients such as lactic acid help remove dead skin cells and encourage your skin to regenerate, making it look even and feel smoother.. The moisturiser helps your skin stay hydrated with added hyaluronic acid, leaving a soft-skin finish that's not greasy. . . Why It's Escentual: . One of our best-sellers on-site is Eucerin's Anti-Pigment Serum; it's clinically and dermatologically proven to have visibly reduce the signs of pigmentation due to Eucerin's own tech: Thiamidol - which you won't get in any other brand of anti-pigmentation skincare.. If it weren't for the pharmaceutical-style packaging, we could easily imagine this being a luxurious moisturiser due to its delicate floral scent and nourishing light cream texture. But don't be fooled - the key ingredients, like Thiamidol, deliver real results.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Note: Only on pigmentated areas that you'd like to smooth, brighten or fade.. It's best to apply it twice daily, such as in the morning and before bed, to see the best results. Don't apply it more than twice a day.. .

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Vital Perfection LiftDefine Radiance Night Concentrate Serum 40ml
listings.description: Defy the effects of gravity and wake up to a lifted, scullpted & redefined look.. WHAT ACTIONS Experience the revolutionary power of Shiseido skincare. Based on our award-winning discovery, this night concentrate effectively combats skin sagging by defying gravity while you sleep. Addressing a newly identified cause of skin sagging, this new face serum targets the decline of the skin's natural anti-gravity system.. WHAT BENEFITS Clinically proven visible results: skin sagging is reduced in 2 weeks (1)'‹ Double chin & facial contours sagging are reduced by 41% in 2 weeks (2) Clinically proven to boost effect with massage(3). After a week(4): Skin is lifted for 87% women and sculpted for 91% women Face contours are redefined for 89% women After a month(4): 100% of women witnessed a more youthful skin appearance. (1) Clinical Test on 31 women (2) Self-assesment scoring by 102 women. % after 2 weeks '‹ (3) Clinical Test on 33 women (4) Consumer Test on 102 women. HOW DOES IT WORK The night concentrate harnesses the power of LiftDynamic 4D Technology, using four-dimensional approaches: 1. Support the skin's natural anti-gravity system with Licorice Extract 2. Nighttime self-regeneration restores and prevents damage 3. Lock in the texture facilitates the penetration of active ingredients for an intensive action on skin sagging throughout the night 4. Boost the action of the night concentrate with a 4 step Night Sculpt Massage. KEY INGREDIENTS This innovative technology combines a potent complex of 2 powerful active ingredients: - Licorice extract, to help lift and redefine the skin's "Dynamic Belt" the natural anti-gravity system (5), promoting a lifted and firm look - NightG3N3 complex, including Ectoine, Burnet extract, and Yarrow extract, helps restore and prevent damages during the night (5). (5) In vitro test. WHAT MAKES IT UNIQUE '¢ Tackles a newly-identified cause of skin slackening, the decline in the skin's natural anti-gravity system, with LiftDynamic 4D technology '¢ Original texture that locks the active ingredients inside the skin from the whole night routine, for intensive action throughout the night. FOR WHO Designed for women from 40 years old, who wish to combat skin sagging and regain contour definition. Suitable for any skin type. HOW TO USE Apply as the final step of your evening routine, following the application of your cream.. 1. After cleansing and toning, incorporate Shiseido Vital Perfection Uplifting & Firming Cream or Vital Perfection Overnight Firming Treatment into your skincare routine 2. Follow by applying the new Shiseido Vital Perfection LiftDefine Radiance Night Concentrate. 3. Enhance the effects (2) with the Night Sculpt Massage technique.. NIGHT SCULPT MASSAGE TECHNIQUE 1. BELOW JAWLINE: Thumbs under your chin, gently push them upward towards the end of your jawline, beneath your ears. Repeat 6 times. 2. CHEEKS : Apply upward pressure with your fingers, starting from the jawline and moving towards the underside of your cheekbones. 3. UNDER EYES: Utilize your middle fingers to press the hollows at the inner ends of your eyebrows (3sec). Then, glide them upwards along the bony area below eyes, from the inner corners to temples. 4. NECK TO JAWLINE: Use four fingers of right hand, lift upwards from the base jaw angle to temple. Simultaneously, place the four fingers of your left hand along your left jawline and pull downward while holding the position. Repeat the same technique on the right side using your left hand. Repeat 3 times per side.. Dermatologist-tested Non comedogenic.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Abeille Royale Honey Treatment Night Cream Refill 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by clinical repairing honey bandages, refillable Honey Treatment Night Cream concentrates the most powerful bee products chosen by Guerlain research to correct 4 visible marks of collagen loss linked to ageing. Wrinkles are reduced, skin becomes denser and recovers its plumpness. The face is redefined and looks visibly younger. It is manufactured using a formulation protocol creating a filler texture with a bandage effect that seamlessly becomes one with skin, impregnating all the epidermal layers with youth-repairing active ingredients.. Formulated with 95% naturally-derived ingredients¹, Honey Treatment Night Cream is powered by advanced Dynamic BlackBee Repair technology, the combination of 4 youth-repairing honeys and an exclusive royal jelly. It is combined with polyfragmented hyaluronic acid and a pro-elasticity peptide extract to deliver the highest efficacy to the deep layers of the epidermis.. THE EXCEPTIONAL YOUTH REPAIRING POWER OF CLINICAL HONEY BANDAGES Abeille Royale was brought to life by an intuition: the biological parallel between healing mechanisms and those to repair the signs of ageing. For more than ten years, Guerlain research has been relying on the powers of honey used for millennia as healing bandages to create specialist skincare for youthful skin in collaboration with scientific experts in honey-based skin youth repair.. THE INSPIRATION OF THE T.I.M.E. MEDICAL PROTOCOL Honey bandages act on the 4 phases of the T.I.M.E clinical repair process: T: Tissular Polishing; I: Inflammation Soothing; M: Moisture Lock-In; E: Elasticity Renewal. Inspired by this protocol, Honey Treatment Night Cream targets rejuvenating self-repair: skin is smoothed and plumped-up, its radiance is amplified.. ¹Calculation based on the international ISO standard 16128, including water. The remaining 5% help to optimise the formula's integrity over time and its sensory qualities. Honey Treatment Cream falls within Guerlain's commitment approach. Its lid is kept and used with a new refill*. 1. From the purchase of the first refill, the carbon footprint is reduced by 36% . 2. The 15% lighter glass jar contains between 20% and 40% recycled glass. Its paper pack is responsibly. sourced (FSC Mix).. *Not compatible with the previous creams' lid.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Tinted Oleo-Serum 30ml / 1
listings.description: "The Clarins Tinted Oleo-Serum stands out because it's 80% skincare, making it a powerhouse of skin-loving ingredients with a touch of skin-blurring mineral makeup." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Tinted Oleo-Serum: . A tinted serum with a glowy satin finish suitable for all skin types.. Adds radiance while blurring imperfections thanks to mineral pigments.. Nourishes skin thanks to a mix of skin-caring dry plant oils and squalane.. Buildable coverage with a natural glow and no oiliness.. Delivers 8 hours of skin-quenching hydration.. A weighty glass bottle with a pipette.. Users found that skin radiance was boosted after application by +48%, +41% nourishment and comfort of bare skin and +56% brighter.*. Features light to very deep skin range that is universal for all skin tones.. . Why It's Escentual: . If your goal is naturally flawless skin and you want a foundation that cares for your skin while you wear it, then the Clarins Tinted Oleo-Serum is for you. The tinted serum contains real skincare ingredients like hazelnut and organic jojoba oil, which plump and strengthen the skin barrier with ceramides. In contrast, squalane works to hydrate even the driest complexions. The skincare experience doesn't stop there. Applying the runny formula with the convenient pipette feels like using a serum, enhancing the feeling that you're using skincare rather than makeup! The breathable finish is super glowy, giving skin a healthy radiance that looks fresh and like your skin but better. The fresh pampering sensation is complemented by the serum's subtle sun cream-like fragrance.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Shake well before use. Apply all over your complexion using a foundation brush, fingertips or a blender.. Add two drops for a natural glowy coverage.. Add three drops for a softly blurred coverage.. Add four drops for a flawless coverage.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the glass bottle and outer cardboard box.. *Statistics record from a self-assessment, 105 women, after 1 day of use. *Statistics record from a self-assessment, 103 women..

Why You'll Love the Schwarzkopf R-Two Shampoo: . Multi-purpose cleansing, hydrating and repairing shampoo without leaving a heavy film.. It makes even extremely damaged hair feel soft again.. Vegan and cruelty-free.. Safe for colour-treated and chemically processed hair.. Free from sulphates and silicones.. . What You Need To Know: . The gentle, free-from formula was made for significantly damaged, dry, over-processed hair types that frequently bleach, perm, use a relaxer, excessive blow-drying, heat application, and combing.. The Double Bonding Technology in the shampoo delicately cleanses whilst actively supporting the re-bonding process. The pH-optimised shampoo neutralises the pH level of the hair after chemical services, creating smoother results as it minimises cuticle swelling during washing.. . Why It's Escentual: . What's so cool about this is it's the same pH level as a healthy scalp. This will keep your hair soft, compromise, and keep your scalp nice and balanced. It's called the reset shampoo because it can remove all the dirt and debris and keep everything nice, soft, and in perfect order to use the following steps.. Unlike most sulphate-free shampoos that don't foam effectively, this shampoo has a soft foam that feels sufficient without having to use more to get a decent foam. . The Best Way To Use It: . The shampoo works better when used with the r-two routine. . Use the shampoo and sealer to prep the hair cuticle for future chemical services, as together they reinforce hair's resistance to combing, straightening, etc or use the shampoo and mask after your hair appointment to repair weakened bonds; the combination will help to restructure and reinforce the hair's cuticles for stronger hair.. When using the shampoo, massage it into wet hair, leave for a minute or so, then rinse well.. . Sustainability and Values . Vegan and free from sulfates, silicones, parabens, mineral oils, phthalates, microplastics and artificial colourants.. .

listings.rawTitle: Antipodes Anoint H2O De-Puffing Eye Gel 30ml
listings.description: "Give tired eyes the ultimate wakeup call with the Antipodes Anoint H2O De-Puffing Eye Gel; this hydrating eye cream with caffeine banishes puffiness, bags and dry skin in an instant." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . . Why You'll Love The Antipodes Anoint H2O De-Puffing Eye Gel: . 100% natural eye gel with seven bioactive ingredients that repair and soothe.. Improves the look of puffy eyes, eye bags and dry skin.. Suitable for all skin types.. Increases skin hydration by 39% after 2 hours.. Protects the eye area from pollutants.. . What You Need To Know: . If your eye area looks tired and dehydrated, the Antipodes Anoint H2O De-Puffing Eye Gel offers a solution. The cooling eye gel contains seven bioactive ingredients that hydrate, cool, protect and reduce the look of puffiness. Coffee, red algae, cucumber, and antioxidant-rich New Zealand superfruits work in sync to minimise puffiness, while plant hyaluronic acid and manuka honey hydrate, and bamboo soothes and protects.. . Why It's Escentual: . If you think all hydrating eye creams are the same, you haven't tried this one. Award-winning skincare brand Antipodes have levelled up the eye care category with this launch. The innovative jelly-like gel has been clinically shown to increase skin hydration by 39% after two hours, resulting in a more refreshed eye area. Best loved for their natural formulas, these results are achieved through the power of plants, which give the eye cream its natural aroma. The palm-size pot may be small, but its contents offer big results if you're concerned with signs of ageing and dehydration around the eyes.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use every morning and evening. Apply around the eye area with a clean fingertip.. . The Sustainable Side: . Antipodes is committed to recycling and use boxes made from 100% biodegradable cardboard derived from sustainable forests. All Antipodes glass bottles, aluminium tubes and printing are done with 100% eco ink from vegetables.. . Values: . Certified vegetarian by the UK Vegetarian Society, Cruelty-free.. Fragrance-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Supra Florale Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "Alien Goddess has had a glow-up for 2023. Supra Florale is the most radiant, warm and luminous perfume in the Goddess collection, especially compared to the original Eau de Parfum." - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Alien Goddess Supra Florale: . Amber-floral perfume drenched in sweet pear syrup.. Eau de parfum strength keeps you smelling sexy, fresh and confident for up to 5 hours.. Mugler's 2023 Alien Goddess perfume edition.. . What Does Supra Florale Smell Like? . Alien Goddess Supra Florale smells expensive. It's rich, endearing and one big explosion of feminity. The Eau de Parfum belongs to the floral amber family, and with this scent, you experience the signature alien DNA of jasmine in a newer, more luminous form.. When you spray it, you instantly get hit with the juiciness of pear. The freshness continues throughout the dry down, but it's as if the salty, 'amberyness' of everlasting flower crystalises the pear, creating a perfume with an aura that glows incandescently.. . Top notes are Catcus Flower Accord, Pear. . Heart notes are Jasmin Grandiflorum, Jasmin Sambac, Everlasting Flower (Imortelle). . Base notes are Everlasting Flower Absolute (Immortelle). . . . Why It's Escentual: . We are confident you'll love this perfume if you are a fan of the original Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum; Supra Florale has zero woody tones, unlike the original. Mugler have swapped them for warm amber facets, which creates more of a sunny aura with every spray. . Supra Florale will be a must-try perfume for anyone who loves solar, radiant floral perfumes. If it were a colour, it would be rose gold; if it were a celebrity, it would be Willow Smith - effortlessly beautiful. . . The Best Way To Use It: . To make the perfume last longer, wash with the Alien shower gel, then use the Alien body cream. Spray Supra Florale onto your pulse points, and you're ready to go.. .

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Deodorant Spray 150ml
listings.description: "Now you can experience the timeless and distinctive aromatic fragrance of Drakkar Noir in a deodorant spray. " - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Deodorant Spray: . A nostalgic fougere scent that amps up your Drakkar Noir for at least four hours.. A classically masculine aromatic and herbaceous scent.. A fresh and clean fragrance with a soapy undertone, evoking the image of a well-groomed gentleman.. Part of the Drakkar Noir collection, the Deodorant Spray gives you another way to wear your signature scent. It will help increase the projection and longevity of your scent while preventing body odour.. . What Does Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Deodorant Spray Smell Like? . Adding the deodorant to your routine will enhance your scent and create an aroma that will get you noticed. The fragrance's classically masculine scent comes in a convenient deodorant spray that is perfect for wearing every day.. Fragrance family is Fougere. . Top notes are Wormwood, Coriander. . Heart notes are Juniper, Geranium, Lavender. . Base notes are Treemoss, Patchouli, Fir Balsam. . . Why It's Escentual: . The Dior Sauvage of the 80s, Drakkar Noir, has had a special place in many fragrance lovers' collections for decades; even musician Drake has it tattooed on his arm! Its nostalgic aromatic, woody, and fresh spicy scent is now infused into the convenience of deodorant so you can easily swap it out for your current aerosol.. The bottle is packed into a black design to match the range's famous design.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray onto the underarms..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Cryo-Flash Cream Mask 75ml
listings.description: "Clarins Cryo Face Mask gives instant glowy results. After 10 minutes, my face looked lifted and felt tighter; this face mask is now my weekly go-to, as my skincare goal is to ensure my skin looks healthy and eliminate fine lines - this works." - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Cryo-Flash Cream Mask: . Only takes 10 minutes to see glowing, smoother skin.. Lifting cream face mask that firms normal, dry and combination skin types.. Makes skin feel fresh and taught as it speeds up collagen synthesis.. . What You Need To Know: . It's a firming mask treatment that smooths away fine lines and instantly tightens skin with Cryo-Starter technology. This tech is inspired by the age-old tradition of Cryotherapy, used to treat skin and muscle problems. . When you apply the blue face mask, the Cryo-Starter tech will start working immediately. It tingles and starts to feel fresher the more you walk around. After 10 minutes, your skin's temperature drops by 4 degrees to encourage skin renewal, which causes a spontaneous calcium flash, sending a shot of calcium to the heart of each keratinocyte cell - renewing the epidermis from within.. As your skin cools, its barrier function is boosted. Helping to reduce the signs of ageing and protect the skin from free radicals. . . Why It's Escentual: . The Cryo Flash Mask lets you experience therapist-inspired treatment without having to leave the house. We love the tech, how it feels, and the results it gives in only 10 minutes. What's different about Clarins Cryotherapy-inspired ingredients is that they are plant-based and made to work with your skin's cooling abilities to enhance the results. Cooling mint-derived cryo molecules chill and tighten the skin, while radiance-restoring evening of primrose extract makes skin glow. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Use once or twice a week in the evening. Apply a thick layer to a clean and dry face, avoiding the eye area.. Leave it on for 10 minutes. . . Use the heel of your hands to work in any excess using the following steps: . 1) From the chin following the shape of your chin x1. . 2) From the corner of the mouth to the middle of the ears x1. . 3) From the bottom of the nose to the temples x1. . 4) From the middle of the forehead to the sides x1. . . Sustainable Notes: . Recyclable glass jar made from 40% recycled glass. Evening Primrose Extract sourced organically in France. Over 93% natural origin ingredients . .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Instant Concealer 15ml / 1
listings.description: "If you're fed up with puffy eyes or persistent dark circles, then you'll be glad to know that the customer-favourite Clarins Instant Concealer is here to help; it creates the illusion that you've had a full eight hours' rest, even if you haven't." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Instant Concealer: . Best-selling under-eye concealer to mask and correct.. Diminishes signs of fatigue, including dark circles and puffiness.. Infused with caffeine extract to stimulate circulation and awaken under eyes.. Smooths, brightens and refreshes the eye area.. Available in four shades.. . Why It's Escentual: . Instant Concealer was previously discontinued. But, following public demand, it's back for 2022. And frankly, we're glad this icon has returned. Instant Concealer is the secret weapon for anyone struggling with signs of fatigue.. Its lightweight fluid texture hydrates and soothes the eye contour using aloe vera, while green coffee visibly brightens and refreshes to minimise the appearance of puffiness. Added colour pigments sit alongside a Light-Optimising complex to mask dark circles for brighter, eye-opening results. It offers long-wearing, crease-free coverage, too. And yes, it's so lightweight, you'll probably forget you've got it on.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use your ring finger or a small makeup brush to apply. Dab along the under-eye, starting at the inner corner and working outward to conceal dark circles and puffiness.. . The Sustainable Side: . The concealer is held within a small plastic tube that's housed in a cardboard box sourced from sustainably-managed forests.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Couture Mini Clutch Palette 4g / 100 - Stora Dolls
listings.description: "Every time I take the Yves Saint Laurent Couture Mini Clutch Palette out of my purse to apply, it's a fashion moment; the quilted leather case finished with the golden YSL logo reminds me of their couture bags and heels." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Yves Saint Laurent Couture Mini Clutch Palette: . A powder palette featuring four chromatic nude shades in satin, matte and shimmer finishes.. A quad of complementary shades that blend seamlessly together.. Sculpt and design your eye contour.. A couture-inspired gold and leather mirror compact case.. . Why It's Escentual: . Yves Saint Laurent Couture Mini Clutch Palettes are all extremely wearable thanks to their nude shade selection. Choose your preferred palette from a selection of dusky pinks inspired by Marrakech kasbah, the vibrant spice tones reminiscent of the souks, or the soothing colours borrowed from the designer's Paris atelier. Whichever palette you choose, you have the power to create a wide variety of captivating looks that are perfect for any occasion or mood.. Each powder eyeshadow is extremely creamy and comfortable to wear, thanks to an infusion of coffee seed oil, almond oil and fig cactus oil. These exceptional oils are sourced exclusively from the YSL Beauty Ourika Community Gardens, where a women's farming cooperative is nurtured and supported.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Create the YSL Le Smokey Eye. Apply the lighter colour on the eyelid, then deepen your eye look by adding a darker colour to the corners. Finally, add a pop of shimmer in the centre of your eyelids or the corners of your eye.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer cardboard box.. .

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: "Le Male Elixir Parfum has to be one of my most complimented fragrances of all time. It's sexy and unforgettable for all genders. " - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Le Male Elixir Parfum: . It will make you feel and smell sexier for up to 6 hours.. Compliments include: you smell incredible. . Smells like a stronger, bolder Le Male.. The 2023 version of Le Male Elixir is described as a "torrid elixir" that is "irresistibly alluring." It is a more intense and concentrated version of the original fragrance, sure to turn heads.. . What Does Le Male Elixir Parfum Smell Like? . The familiar, contrasting freshness of lavender and mint opens Le Male Elixir, recalling its iconic DNA. Meanwhile, rich, robust notes of honey, tobacco, and tonka bean add a deeper, darker dimension, making it more sensual and alluring.. . Fragrance family is fougere . Top notes are lavender and mint. . Heart notes are vanilla and benzoin. . Base notes are honey, tonka bean and tobacco. . . Why It's Escentual: . If you are a fan of the original Le Male Elixir or looking for a new and exciting fragrance, the 2023 version is a great option to consider. It is a modern and sophisticated fragrance that is sure to impress.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. When spraying, hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atelier Des Ors Riviera Sunrise Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A golden, aromatic woody fragrance, sun kissed with the glow of citrus.. Riviera Sunrise revels in the golden light of the Mediterranean sun. A bold opening combines the zesty pulp of lemon, mandarin and orange with the aromatic freshness of basil. The sparkling layers of citrus play a duet with the joyful synergy of orange blossom and fig leaf, harmonising with the faceted woody notes of vetiver and cedarwood.. Riviera Sunrise expresses an atmosphere that oscillates between the meditative morning calm and bursts of radiant solar energy.. Marie Salamagne wanted to capture and transform the beauty of these fleeting moments of happiness as an ode to the indescribable charm of the French Riviera.. A scent with an orange, golden glow kissed by childhood memories..

listings.rawTitle: Atelier Des Ors Noir By Night Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Bridal Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Like a haute couture gown, ELIE SAAB fragrances wrap a woman's body in radiant sensuality. The signature of a moment steeped in emotion, ELIE SAAB Le Parfum Bridal is the promise of a luminous fragrance, as precious and captivating as the most beautiful wedding gowns from the House of ELIE SAAB. . ELIE SAAB Le Parfum Bridal is an exceptional floral woody musky fragrance, inspired by a wedding bouquet. This opulent and musky floral reveals notes of ylang-ylang and orange blossom for a petal-filled contrast that is as precious and delicate as lace edging. . These vibrant notes are wrapped in Madagascan vanilla and ambroxan, lending persistence and volume to the creation. The sleek bottle, faceted like a gem, adorned with a warm and sensual beige hue. . The ultimate in sophistication, a floral lace motif borrowed from a gown in the Bridal collection, delicately adorns the crystalline facets of the bottle. . Olfactory family: Floral woody musky Top Notes: Essence of mandarin, orange blossom Heart Notes: Madagascan vanilla, essence of ylang-ylang, gardenia Base Notes: Musk, benzoin from Sumatra, ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to an exotic, flower-filled garden with Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum, a floral-oriental fragrance for women.. The Story Behind Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum . A revamp of the original Delina Eau de Parfum, Delina Exclusif opens with the fresh tones of bergamot, crisp pear, grapefruit and aquatic lychee before a dominant rose note unfolds in the heart. The floral heart is nuanced by the warmer, drier and earthier tones of incense and vetiver, before the perfume envelops you in a soft blanket of vanilla, musk, evernyl and amber.. Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum Smells Similar To . Delina Exclusif has a bolder opening than its predecessor, which is continued in the heart as the rose note is intensified by incense. If you loved Delina Eau de Parfum but you want a deeper, more mysterious version that replaces woody tones with more unique oriental facets, this is the fragrance for you.. About Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum's Bottle . With a gorgeous curved flacon, pretty pastel pink hues - including a velvet base that holds the bottle carefully inside its box - and the weighted silver top, Delina Exclusif feels undeniably luxurious. For a final touch of glamour, the neck is wrapped up in an elegant tassel, while the lid is topped with a glistening pale pink gem-like stone.. Why We Love It . To us, this feels like a slightly more dramatic take on the utlra-feminine Delina Eau de Parfum, which is ideal for those who like Delina but are after a slightly less sweet, classically feminine rose fragrance. Of course, rose remains here, but it's given more depth with the smokier tones of incense and vetiver.. It would be a great evening alternative for those who wear Delina in the day, but are after something slightly bolder at night.. How To Use It . Spritz onto the neck and wrists as needed.. Works Well With . The original Delina scent has been captured in a number of luxurious perfumed hair care and body products, why not explore the range to truly surround yourself with this romantic aroma?. The Notes In Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum Are . Top Notes: Bergamot, Pear, Lychee, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Rose Damascena, Incense, Vetiver. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Evernyl, Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins SOS Primer 30ml / Matifying
listings.description: "If you love multi-purpose makeup primers, Clarins SOS includes skincare benefits that pro-long your makeup, colour-correct imperfections and keep skin soft and protected." - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Clarins SOS Primers: . Less touchups are needed as this primer makes your foundation look better and last longer.. Softer skin feel: it promises 24-hour hydration.. Bonus benefits: keeps the skin barrier healthy and boosts natural defences.. Smooth texture that doesn't pill when in contact with foundation.. Great even on no-makeup days, as it makes skin glow without layers of makeup.. . What You Need To Know: . If you're looking for a skin perfector and primer in one, each formula enhances natural beauty whilst correcting key skin concerns.. Each primer keeps the skin barrier healthy and boosts natural defences thanks to Clarins' Microbiote Complex. However, each shade has a specific benefit and power for specific concerns. Each primer has the same minimal scent; the textures are soft and comfortable, plus they don't pill. Note: The mattifying primer has a smoother, tackier feel than the rest.. White: Boosts your glow with its subtle shimmering white tint and can be used as a highlighter.. Pink: Colour corrects dull tones and signs of fatigue. It leaves behind a subtle pink iridescence to help you fake radiance. . Green: Colour corrects redness and soothes with a matte pistachio green shade that makes your skin look and feel more even.. Peach: Helps mask imperfections and colour corrects dark spots. It can be worn on its own to even out the complexion without the use of foundation too,. Mattifying (blue tube): Creates a shine-free finish that also blurs pores. Men love this product to control oil as it has zero tint and is undetectable.. Key Ingredients . White: Edelweiss = Antioxidant. Pink: Beautyberry = Radiance. Green: Clary sage = Soothing. Peach: Desert date = Anti-dark spots. Matifying: Strawberry tree fruit = Mattifying. . . Why It's Escentual: . Colour correction is what makes these primers stand out from traditional primers. Each colour targets a unique skincare concern, making you more confident while giving you better makeup results.. The new and improved formula delivers many skincare benefits, including luminosity, radiance and 24H hydration.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply your primer all over your face with your fingertips after applying moisturiser.. Wear it on its own, or apply foundation on top.. .

Makeup, excess sebum and impurities are lifted away from the face and eyes, including stubborn mascara, without the need to rub. Renowned for its anti-inflammatory abilities, rose water removes dirt from clogged pores while softening and soothing the complexion, making it the perfect solution for anyone with intolerant skin.. The cleansing water takes away the dread and discomfort that cleansing can cause. Skin is kept hydrated with the inclusion of Nuxe's Skin-Respect Complex, a blend of 100% natural botanical origin moisturising sugars. Moisture is retained deep within the skin while water reserves are increased, resulting in deep hydration and moisturisation that strengthens the skin's barrier. The natural balance of skin is respected and preserved, as the formula contains a pH level that mimics the skin's own. The skin's ecosystem is also maintained as the micellar water washes away impurities without stripping it, leaving the complexion refreshed, softened and soothed.. Why We Love It . Makeup removal is an important first step in every skincare regime, and the Nuxe Soothing Micellar Water means it has never been easier or more comfortable. With 3 benefits in 1, the water lifts away makeup and impurities in one sweep, while infusing skin with moisturising and respecting benefits. The aqueous liquid is held in a pale pink bottle and fills the air with the delicate scent of roses, making the micellar water a treat for the senses as well as the skin.. How To Use It . Tilt the dispenser cap bottle, and apply the micellar water to a cotton pad, then sweep over the face and eyes. Use every morning and evening to prepare your complexion for the rest of your skincare routine.. Works Well With . If you loved the soothing water, you'll adore the full Nuxe Very Rose range. The gentle yet effective skincare products work in harmony together.. Values . Vegan. Dermatologically-tested...

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Born In Roma Uomo Intense is a seductive scent for men. The smoky blend of vetiver, ginger, and amber is addictive." - Renee Escentual Beauty Team.. . Embossed with studs, this Intense Eau de Parfum represents wider Valentino Couture, showcasing their signature irreverent influence. Personifying the streets of Rome, the bottle alludes to a new era of fashion that enables people to take risks and celebrate their uniqueness whilst harbouring love for the traditional. The Sustainable Side: . The packaging, bottle, pump and cap can be collected in your local community..

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "If you love the smell of fiery amber and creamy vanilla, you'll love the warm addictive trail of Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum: . An amber floral fragrance.. Lasts on the skin 4-6 hours.. Part of the Valentino Born In Roma collection.. A studded black and pink ombre design.. . What Does Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum Spray Smell Like? . The Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense Eau de Parfum has a warm, rich trail that makes it feel extravagant and luxurious. It opens with a creamy accord of vanilla bourbon, fresh bergamot, juicy blackcurrant and mandarin. As the scent develops on the skin it eases into a white floral heart made up of a triple dose of jasmine. The lasting impression of Donna Intense is sensually warm and deeply vanilla, ending on a base of sweet creamy benzoin resin which amplifies the other notes in the aroma.. Top notes are mandarin, bergamot, blackcurrant accord and vanilla bourbon. Heart notes are jasmine. Base notes are benzoin resin and vanilla. . Why It's Escentual: . Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense is edgy and modern. It takes inspiration from Rome's night street culture and its phenomenal sunsets. Like its aristo-punks inspiration, Valentino Donna Born in Roma Intense is meant to stand out, and never conform with its edgy studded design and intensely bold amber floral signature. The bottle takes the punky character of the street culture and adds a touch of Rome's romance with a studded glass exterior which fades from black into soft sunset pink.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz on your pulse points - wrist and neck.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer box.. .

Why You'll Love Amouage Purpose Eau de Parfum: . A woody scent with undertones of warm spice.. The scent lasts for eight hours on the skin.. Part of the Amouage Chapter III Escape collection.. Purpose unfolds with vibrant bergamot, pink pepper, smoky frankincense, and cinnamony pimento berry, leading into a heart of fresh rose, grassy vetiver, and earthy sandalwood. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "You're guaranteed to get compliments when wearing the Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum, an irresistible floral-gourmand fragrance packed with creamy vanilla." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love YSL Black Opium Le Parfum: . Floral-gourmand fragrance amplified by four vanilla notes.. Re-interprets Black Opium's coffee signature.. Part of the luxurious and captivating Black Opium fragrance collection.. Blends vanilla, ultra-dark coffee and luminous white florals.. Reflective gloss bottle with a dazzling glitter centre.. . What Does Black Opium Le Parfum Smell Like? . A sensual and delectable spin on the classic Black Opium fragrance, Le Parfum takes its iconic floral-gourmand signature and amplifies its addictive vanilla base note. YSL Le Parfum projects a honeyed freshness from a duo of pear and green mandarin. The heart blooms with white florals, including orange flower petals and jasmine sambac, with a twist of warm cinnamon. To finish, the signature Black Opium coffee accord is perfectly complemented by a quartet of vanilla notes for a creamy, smooth finish that you will keep leaning in for.. Top notes are Pear Accord, Green Mandarin. Heart notes are Orange Flower Petals, Jasmine Sambac, Cinnamon Essence. Base notes are Vanilla Quartet, Coffee Accord, patchouli Heart, Ambrox. . . Why It's Escentual: . In 1977, Yves Saint Laurent released Opium to push the boundaries of perfumery. In 2014, Black Opium reinvented the classic scent for the modern woman. Fast forward to 2023, Black Opium Le Parfum takes the coffee signature of Black Opium to a new level of indulgence, and its bottle embodies this perfectly. The flacon is coated head-to-toe with a reflective black gloss that spotlights the central heart of black glitter. If you're looking to turn heads, this fragrance is for you; every time we wear Le Parfum in the office, everyone asks: ''what are you wearing?''.. . The Best Way To Use It: . For light intensity, spray a cloud around your head and shoulders and let the fragrance fall onto you.. For a medium intensity, spray onto the pulse points (wrists, inner elbow and lower neck).. For added intensity, apply Le Parfum to your hairbrush, scarf or coat - you can even spray Le Parfum in your bath water..

Spray on the pulse points.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer glass bottle and box.. .

listings.rawTitle: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Retinol Serum 30ml
listings.description: "If you want anti-ageing results fast , the Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Retinol Serum is the one for you. It reduces four signs of ageing within just two weeks use." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Retinol Serum: . Vegan facial serum for dedicated retinol users.. Improves the look of wrinkles, pores, uneven tone and uneven texture.. Features a high dosage of retinol for enhanced results.. Leaves skin looking smooth, youthful and radiant.. . What You Need To Know: . Dermalogica's fast-acting facial serum is a quick and effective way to get younger-looking skin. It turns back time on wrinkles, retexturises skin, shrinks pores, and even unifies skin tone. It does all of this using an advanced retinoid blend of fast-acting Granactive Retinoid®, retinol, and time-released encapsulated retinol alongside a retinol booster. Together, this quartet supports a continual release of skin-smoothing actives by working at different speeds to address four signs of ageing.. To complete the mix, concentrated squalane works alongside a soothing dose of oat-derived Beta-Glucan to aid recovery for healthier-looking skin.. . Why It's Escentual: . When it comes to anti-ageing skincare, retinol is the 'it' ingredient - if you want to rejuvenate your skin, you're seriously missing a trick if you don't have retinol in your routine. If you're already a loyal retinol user, you don't need us to preach about its benefits to you - but what we'll do instead is rave about the Dynamic Skin Retinol Serum by Dermalogica. Why? Because it pushes the boundaries of retinol serum technology by offering a fast-acting multi-retinoid formula. Unsurprisingly, results are visible in as little as two weeks.. Just because this serum works hard, that doesn't mean it's a chore to use; held in a handy pump bottle, it has a very lightweight texture that sinks into your complexion in a matter of seconds. Its pale yellow texture releases a delicate citrus scent when applying it, too.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After cleansing, apply a thin layer over your face at night. Take care to avoid the eye area. If dryness or redness occurs, reduce frequency. Always use a high broad-spectrum SPF in the daytime when using retinol in your skincare routine.. . The Sustainable Side: . The plastic pump bottle is held in a cardboard carton; they can be separated for recycling after use.. . Values: . Vegan.. Gluten-free, artificial fragrance-free, artificial colour-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Advanced Repair Barrier Cream 50ml
listings.description: "Every skincare routine should include Kiehl's Ultra Facial Advanced Repair Barrier Cream; the soothing cream helps keep what's good in and anything bad out, nourishing the skin's moisture barrier function and treating common skin concerns like chapped lips and post-procedure wounds." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Cream: . Nourishing barrier cream for dry, sensitised skin.. Reduces redness by -29% in just one week of use.. 98% agreed their skin was softer after four weeks.. Lightweight, gel-cream texture with an invisible finish.. Relieves dryness up to 10 surface layers deep.. . What You Need To Know: . Kiehl's Ultra Facial Advanced Repair Barrier Cream instantly comforts and repairs dry, sensitive skin whilst keeping it protected from external aggressors. The Barrier Cream contains advanced barrier technology that mimics the skin's lipid structure to protect your skin whilst relieving dryness up to 10 surface layers deep. Powered by colloidal oatmeal and beta-glucan, the cream reduces redness by -29% in just one week. Kiehl's uses colloidal oatmeal for its soothing compounds to minimise irritation and support skin recovery. Beta-glucan, a skin-repairing molecule transforms dry, sensitised skin for a healthier complexion.. . Why It's Escentual: . The Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Cream has an endless amount of uses! Its multi-purpose formula can be used on anything from chapped lips and windburn to eczema and post-procedure wounds. The travel-size design is perfect for on-the-go moments so that you can be prepared for every scenario.. Its invisible texture is unlike any other Barrier Cream. It has the healing power of a balm and the comfortable, lightweight texture of a daily moisturiser. It sits underclothes perfectly and is not sticky or greasy.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After cleansing, apply a coin-sized amount of the Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream onto your skin and gently rub it in. Apply before heading out in cold, windy conditions.. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Men Smooth Shave Foaming Gel 150ml
listings.description: "If you're looking for a shaving foam that will deliver comfort and a clean shave, look no further than the Clarins Men Smooth Shave Foaming Gel." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Men Foaming Gel: . Premium shaving gel foam for all skin types.. Softens the hair and skin whilst protecting against the risk of shaving cuts.. Limits irritation and the appearance of ingrown hairs.. Features a blue gel texture that instantly lathers into a foam.. . What You Need To Know: . The Smooth Shave Foaming Gel does what it says on the tin: it ensures an ultra-smooth shave using its ultra-creamy foaming gel formula. It works by softening the hair and skin whilst protecting against the risk of cuts caused by shaving.. The comforting foam also boasts soothing and energising properties to limit skin irritation and the look of ingrown hairs, thanks to Clarins' Grooming Phyto-Complex, which contains bison grass, gymnema and blackcurrant.. . Why It's Escentual: . If you've been on the hunt for a shaving foam that delivers a close, clean and easy shave in one effortless stroke, you'll love the Clarins Men Smooth Shave Gel. Its rich foamy texture makes a comfy base for shaving - you'll be surprised by just how easily the razor glides across your skin, all without causing discomfort and irritation. After rinsing, it leaves your skin feeling soft, fresh and comfortable.. The foaming gel is also a joy to use. When you first push the pump down, a blue gel is released, but within seconds it froths up into a thick, creamy foam - no effort is required on your behalf. Another benefit to its expansive gel-to-foam texture is that a little goes a long way!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Smooth the foam over areas to be shaved and shave as usual. Rinse well after use.. . The Sustainable Side: . The outer carton uses paper sourced from sustainably-managed forests, and can be recycled after use.. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Men After Shave Soothing Toner 100ml
listings.description: "If you're looking to cool and refresh your skin after shaving, you need the Clarins Men After Shave Soothing Toner." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Men Soothing Toner: . Invigorating facial toner to be used after shaving.. Calms sensations of overheating for fresh, soft and soothed skin.. Exfoliates dead skin cells whilst minimising ingrown hairs.. Reduces the looks of pores whilst moisturising and mattifying skin.. Features a lightweight liquid texture.. . What You Need To Know: . Ever shave and get that hot, uncomfortable feeling? The Clarins' soothing facial toner will stop this, instantly calming sensations of overheating whilst naturally exfoliating dead skin cells and releasing ingrown hairs for smooth, clean-cut results. The toner improves the look of your freshly-shaved skin, reducing the appearance of pores whilst moisturising and mattifying.. As a part of the Clarins Men shaving routine, it features the Grooming Phyto-Complex, which comprises energising bison grass and gymnema alongside soothing blackcurrant extract.. . Why It's Escentual: . Shaving can be an irritating experience for some. But Clarins' After Shave Toner is here to change that. Its formula calms and comforts skin, so shaving no longer feels like a chore.. It has a refreshing water-like texture that's quick and easy to use. And like all Clarins skincare, it goes the extra mile. While ensuring that shaving stays a stress-free experience, it also improves the appearance of your skin by shrinking the look of pores whilst delivering a shine-free but still hydrated finish. That's especially beneficial for men's skin as it's often much oilier than women's.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After shaving, apply the toning lotion to your skin using light tapping motions across the entire face, focusing particularly on areas of irritation.. . The Sustainable Side: . The outer carton uses paper sourced from sustainably-managed forests and can be recycled after use. The glass bottle and plastic cap can be separated after use for recycling.. .

Complexion is even by +15% while skin quality is improved by +13%.. 18 adaptable shades for a variety of skin tones including cool, warm and neutral.. . Why It's Escentual: . Reformulated for 2022, the legendary Parure Gold Foundation has been reimagined and now is called GUERLAIN Parure Gold Skin Matte. For fans of the original, don't worry; the transfer-resistant formula is even more skincare while still maintaining the incredible lit-from-within glow that the original is so famous for. The finish is a little more matte than the old Parure Gold, with a lighter formula that feels more fluid than the previous edition.. There is no doubt in our mind that Parure Gold Matte is one of the world's most luxurious foundations with a superior sensorial experience and a creamy formula with a subtle white floral scent. And, infused with real 24-karat gold, one of nature's true glow-givers, the radiance power inside can't be replicated. The bottle is bejewelled in frosted glass, topped with a golden lid and emblazoned with the signature double logo. . The Best Way To Use It: . Pump one to two times. Smooth over the complexion. For best results, use Parure Gold Kabuki Brush.. . The Sustainable Side: . The new version has a reduced glass weight for a bigger bottle with a 35 ml capacity. The bottle is made from recycled materials - 10% recycled glass (PCR) - and now even the pump is recyclable. You can also recycle the outer cardboard box.. .

Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Parure Gold Matte Foundation: . Glowy matte finish that lasts 24 hours.. Hydrates skin for 24 hours.. Strengthens skin barrier with white peony.. Protects skin from ageing using SPF15 or PA+++.. A frosted glass bottle with a golden lid.. Complexion is even by +15% while skin quality is improved by +13%.. 18 adaptable shades for a variety of skin tones including cool, warm and neutral.. . Why It's Escentual: . Reformulated for 2022, the legendary Parure Gold Foundation has been reimagined and now is called GUERLAIN Parure Gold Skin Matte. For fans of the original, don't worry; the transfer-resistant formula is even more skincare while still maintaining the incredible lit-from-within glow that the original is so famous for. The finish is a little more matte than the old Parure Gold, with a lighter formula that feels more fluid than the previous edition.. There is no doubt in our mind that Parure Gold Matte is one of the world's most luxurious foundations with a superior sensorial experience and a creamy formula with a subtle white floral scent. And, infused with real 24-karat gold, one of nature's true glow-givers, the radiance power inside can't be replicated. The bottle is bejewelled in frosted glass, topped with a golden lid and emblazoned with the signature double logo. . The Best Way To Use It: . Pump one to two times. Smooth over the complexion. For best results, use Parure Gold Kabuki Brush.. . The Sustainable Side: . The new version has a reduced glass weight for a bigger bottle with a 35 ml capacity. The bottle is made from recycled materials - 10% recycled glass (PCR) - and now even the pump is recyclable. You can also recycle the outer cardboard box.. .

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast B5 - Soothing Repairing Spray 100ml
listings.description: Cicaplast Spray B5 repairs the skin barrier, respects the skin microbiome, and reduces feelings of discomfort. This lightweight, invisible, non-drying formula reduces the risk of contamination on painful-to-touch or hard-to-reach skin conditions. It is also touch-free to avoid contamination. SPECIFICALLY FORMULATED FOR Specifically formulated for uncomfortable, damaged, or irritated skin. Suitable for the whole family from adults to babies from 3 months, for use on face and body on a wide range of common skin irritations including burns, nappy rash, chickenpox, post peeling, laser & surgery. KEY RESULTS 93% agree skin looks repaired after 1 week* 100% agree the product looks invisible on skin* ACTIVE INGREDIENTS Cicaplast B5 Spray is enriched with 5% of vitamin B5 combined with madecassoside, glycerin, and copper-manganese. The formula's antibacterial action helps to protect broken skin from infection. Cicaplast Spray B5 provides the optimal environment skin needs for its healing process, reducing the causes of long-term scarring. DERMATOLOGICALLY TESTED This skin-soothing repairing spray has been through rigorous testing under dermatological, ophthalmological, and paediatric control to ensure it is suitable for use on uncomfortable, damaged or irritated skin. MINIMALIST HYPOALLERGENIC FORMULA The minimalist gentle formula is specifically designed for uncomfortable, damaged, or irritated skin. Tested and re-tested for its efficacy, the formula is hypoallergenic and suitable for use on sensitive skin. It is also fragrance-free, alcohol-free, and contains no drying agents.. *auto-evaluation conducted on 54 people. .

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Sun Melting Lotion for Face and Body SPF50 150ml
listings.description: "Keep your face and body protected with the Nuxe Sun Melting Lotion SPF50, a broad-spectrum sunscreen that prevents dark spots and defends against UV-induced ageing." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Nuxe Sun Melting Lotion SPF 50: . Broad-spectrum sun protection for face and body.. Helps prevent dark spots and defends against UV-induced ageing.. Comforting, hydrating texture.. Fast-absorbing formula with no white film or cast.. Infused with a summer scent of sweet orange, Tiare flower and vanilla.. Respects marine life, including algae and bacteria.. . What You Need To Know: . The Nuxe Sun Melting Lotion offers broad spectrum sun protection against UVA and UVB rays, whilst providing an anti-ageing cellular defence and preventing dark spots. Thanks to its blend of natural extracts, including rice, rosemary and vitamin E, the sunscreen is rich in antioxidants to protect your skin from premature ageing. Added water hyacinth extract offers a deeply hydrating texture that nourishes your skin, whilst carob extract activates tanning for a healthy glow. The best bit? You only need one sunscreen to do it all, thanks to its non-comedogenic (doesn't block pores) formula that's suitable for both the face and the body.. . Why It's Escentual: . The Nuxe Sun Melting Lotion SPF50 is the perfect blend of high-performance sun protection, sensorial textures and uplifting scents. Transport yourself to the summer sun with an uplifting infusion of sweet orange, Tiare flower and vanilla.. If you're suffering from dry, cracked skin, you will love the comforting and creamy texture of the Nuxe High Protection SPF 50 that glides across the skin for a boost of hydration. The gold-tinted cream is fast-absorbing for an invisible finish with no white film or cast.. Its photostable formula respects marine life, such as algae and bacteria, so you can stay protected on beach days without worrying about your sunscreen impacting on the marine ecosystem.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply thoroughly to the face and body before going out in sunlight. Reapply frequently, especially after swimming, sweating or towel-drying your skin.. Values: . Non-comedogenic. No animal-derived ingredients (Vegan)..

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Reve de Miel Lip Moisturising Stick 4g
listings.description: "Soothe, repair and nourish dry, chapped lips with the Nuxe Reve de Miel Lip Moisturising Stick, a comforting and soothing lip balm made using 100% natural ingredients." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Nuxe Reve de Miel Lip Balm Stick: . Soothing lip balm that repairs and protects dry, chapped lips.. 91% of women said it nourished and protected lips against external aggressions.. Part of the fan-favourite Reve de Miel collection.. Features a creamy, nourishing texture with a non-sticky finish.. Travel-friendly design for on-the-go hydration.. . What You Need To Know: . Using the restorative and healing properties of lavender honey, the Reve de Miel lip balm provides intense nourishment to lips that need comforting in order to soothe and repair chapped and cracked skin. Made using 100% natural origin ingredients, the Reve de Miel Stick deeply nourishes and softens the lips by utilising organic sunflower oil, which is rich in omega 3 and 6.. Nuxe's moisturising balm protects your lips in all weather conditions as vitamin E offers antioxidant protection against harmful free radicals that cause dryness and ageing. In fact, 91% of beauty fans agreed that their lips felt protected against external aggressors, such as the wind and cold weather, after use. To complete the mix, organic camelina oil - known as the 'gold of pleasure' - is recognised for its soothing and hydrating properties, which adds to the comforting and creamy balm texture.. . Why It's Escentual: . It's no secret that we're big fans of Nuxe's honey-infused lip balms. What makes this one special is its ultra-convenient formula, and the fact it's not as thick as the original Reve de Miel Lip Balm. Perfect for those who prefer a lipstick format over a balm, the creamy stick glides like a breeze over the lips. It doesn't pull, drag or aggravate delicate skin, but instead leaves a soothing, softening trail in its wake.. If you're a fan of the Nuxe Reve de Miel Lip Stick, you may have recognised it looks a little different. Don't panic! It offers the same nourishing results as before. But now, it has an even cleaner formula that's made using 100% natural origin ingredients, as opposed to the previous formulation of 90%.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Simply take the lid off and glide over your lips as often as you require. The lip balm is great for priming your lips before applying lipstick or gloss.. . The Sustainable Side: . Nuxe is on a mission to protect bees by working with the charity Un Toit Pour Les Abeilles ('A Home For Bees') to sponsor hives located in the Vosges region of France to create new colonies that preserve the species.. . Values: . Paraben-free and preservative-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + HA Serum (Formerly known as "Buffet") 30ml
listings.description: "If you're looking for a do-it-all anti-ageing serum to smooth, hydrate, and firm your skin, The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + HA Serum is the skincare product for you." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + HA Serum: . Multi-purpose serum designed to smooth signs of ageing.. Peptides reduce the look of crow's feet, wrinkles and fine lines.. Dry skin is deeply hydrated and smoothed for a radiant glow.. Lightweight, fluid texture is fast-absorbing.. Firms skin and improves elasticity.. . What You Need To Know: . This Multi-Peptide serum is packed full of hydrating, anti-ageing ingredients to target multiple skin concerns. Dry skin is hydrated by hyaluronic acid, whilst nutrient-rich amino acids nourish your complexion. The patented peptides, SYN™-AKE, Matrixyl™ synthe'6™, Matrixyl™ 3000, and ARGIRELOX™, work together to smooth fine lines and deeper wrinkles such as crow's feet. Skin is firmed, smoother, with improved elasticity, and has a radiant glow.. . Why It's Escentual: . If you're looking for a do-it-all serum, you've come to the right place. Topical peptides mimic natural peptides that give your skin a plump finish. The water-based serum sinks in immediately to get to work smoothing and hydrating. It only takes a few moments to add to your routine, but it has many benefits, including reducing the appearance of signs of ageing.. This serum may sound familiar to you if you're a long-term fan of The Ordinary; it used to be called the '˜Buffet' serum. It has been renamed to reflect the powerful ingredients within. You can continue enjoying the multi-purpose skincare step with the same bottle design and powerful ingredients, just with a new name.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Massage into freshly cleansed skin before any oils or cream moisturisers. This should not be used alongside vitamin C, acid formulas or ferulic acid.. . The Sustainable Side: . The outer carton can be recycled.. . Values: . Vegan.. Cruelty-free, alcohol-free, silicone-free..

listings.rawTitle: Wet Brush Glitter Shower Detangler Black
listings.description: "Easily glide through tangles and knots with the Wet Brush Glitter Shower Detangler, a hangable hairbrush designed to be used in the shower or bath. The cool glittering design is easy to clean and air-dries between uses." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Wet Brush Glitter Shower Detangler: . Shower-friendly hangable hairbrush designed for easy cleaning and air-drying.. Omniflex technology contours to the shape of your scalp for gentle detangling.. Features IntelliFlex bristles for a 45-55% reduction in breakage and split ends.. Helps to spread conditioner or hair masks through your hair evenly.. Available in an array of glittery colours.. . What You Need To Know: . Tackle knots and tangles in the shower or bath with the Wet Brush Glitter Shower Detangler, a multi-tasking hairbrush that is used and recommended by stylists. The ultra-soft IntelliFlex bristles move through your locks with ease, helping to evenly distribute conditioner and detangle. Designed with patented OmniFlex technology, the Wet Brush Shower Detangler adjusts to the shape of your scalp for ultimate comfort and reduced scalp irritation.. If you're looking to detangle tough knots without pain or breakage, you'll love the Wet Brush's gentle design that requires less force, reducing split ends and breakage by 45%. Suitable for all hair types, the detangler glides through thicker and textured hair with ease; in fact, it reduces the effort needed to brush your hair by 55%.. . Why It's Escentual: . Designed specifically for your shower, the Wet Brush Glitter Detangler is unlike your traditional hairbrush, as it doesn't have a cushion to hold the bristles in place. This design detail allows for easy cleaning and air-drying. Available in an array of fun, glittery colours, you can find a Shower Detangler that fits your bathroom aesthetic; it even has a convenient shower hook, so when you're finished with your shower, simply wash your brush and hang it up to dry on its own.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Work your Glitter Shower Detangler throughout your hair, brushing from hair tips to your roots to detangle effectively. Do not use your brush with a blow dryer as the heat may damage the bristles; if you're looking for a blowdry friendly brush, choose the Wet Brush Speed Dry.. .

The Wet Brush Mini Detangler is perfect to keep on your desk, in your gym bags or handbags." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Wet Brush Mini Detangler: . The best-selling Original Detangler in a smaller travel-friendly size.. Features IntelliFlex bristles to gently combat tangles and knots.. Minimises pain and reduces hair breakage by 55%.. Brushes hair with less force to reduce damage.. Ideal size for children, travelling or touch-ups throughout the day.. . What You Need To Know: . Take your award-winning Original Detangler anywhere with the Wet Brush Mini Detangler. The mini has the same big detangling results as the original, just in a travel-friendly and convenient design. Made with patented ultra-soft IntelliFlex bristles, the Mini Detangler combats tangles and knots with ease. The gentle technology minimises pain and protects against split ends, reducing hair breakage by 45%.. The Wet Brush Mini Detangler is a must-have for life on-the-go. The smaller size is great for kids, travelling or brushing throughout the day. listings.rawTitle: Wet Brush Original Detangler Black
listings.description: "Glide through tangles with ease when using the Wet Brush Original Detangler, a gentle and comfortable brush that reduces breakage and split ends even when brushing wet hair." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Wet Brush Original Detangler: . Best-selling detangling hairbrush for all hair types.. Minimises pain and reduces split ends and breakage by 55%.. Features flexible IntelliFlex bristles that gently loosen knots.. Ergonomic handle makes brushing easy with less force needed.. Available in various colours to suit your individual style.. . What You Need To Know: . Tackle tangles and knots with ease using the Wet Brush Original Detangler, an award-winning hairbrush with ultra-flexible bristles. The Original Detangler is Wet Brush's best-selling design for good reason; its IntelliFlex bristles reduce breakage by 55% and require 55% less effort so that you can glide through thicker and textured hair with ease.. The innovative bristles are made with proprietary technology of NYLON 66 that are coated with epoxy tips. This means the bristles are flexible with a small dot of epoxy on the end of each bristle for a soft smooth brushing experience. Each bristle is embedded in the brush head cushion with a twisting fusion technology that minimises pain and protects against split ends and breakage.. . Why It's Escentual: . How you brush your hair is the most overlooked step in your haircare regime but it could be what is causing damage. Hair is weakest when wet so brushing can cause your hair to snap. But with the Wet Brush Original Detangler you can gently loosen knots without pulling on your hair, separating tangles with ease.. The award-winning design is made to minimise pain and optimise comfort, and everyone at Escentual is hooked on the pain-free detangler! Suitable for everyone, the comfortable ergonomic handle allows you to brush any hair type, including long and thick hair with ease.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Brush your hair from the ends to roots as this helps to detangle easily. You can use the brush on wet or dry hair. Do not use your Wet Brush with your hairdryer, as the heat may damage the bristles.. .
