Created by master perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani, Parfums de Marly Oriana opens with a splash of citrus: juicy, honeyed mandarin, sunny Italian bergamot and citrus-aromatic grapefruit.. This fresh and uplifting aroma blossoms into a heart of sophisticated orange blossom, fruity blackcurrant and a crisp, frosted raspberry before the fragrance melts into delicious, gourmand sweet treats. To get the most out of this fragrance, spritz Oriana directly onto the pulse points: your neck and wrists.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum Spray 30ml

Top notes are bergamot, mandarin, ginger and saffron accord. Heart notes are orange blossom, diva lavender heart and lavandin heart. Base notes are vanilla bourbon, honey accord and vetiver. . . Why It's Escentual: . Master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim were inspired by women powerful. The intense perfume turns up the heat on the original scent making it perfect for Libre fans looking for that fiery warmth for autumn and winter.. The bottle holds Yves Saint Laurent Libre's iconic shape but with the addition of an oversized golden YSL logo. The intensified burning orange juice gives us a sneak peek of what to expect from its warm and spicy signature.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your pulse points such as your wrists, inner elbow and lower neck. The heat of your body will reveal a full trial if you're looking to prolong your scent add a spritz to your back and shoulders or items of clothing such as scarves and jumpers.. .

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Hair & Body Fragrance Mist 100ml
listings.description: "Drench yourself in the sweet candied scent of Angel with the Thierry Mugler Angel Hair & Body Fragrance Mist, a light and airy version of the gourmand Angel fragrance." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Mugler's Hair & Body Fragrance Mist is based around the same sweet gourmand notes as the original Angel Eau de Parfum. Zesty bergamot dazzles the senses before welcoming the sweet gourmand heart of honey, caramel and praline, lifted by a fruity exotic blend. But although it's lighter than the perfume, the mist still has an impressive strength - and if you haven't tried Angel before, the mist could be the perfect opportunity to try it before committing to the Eau de Parfum.... Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Ombres G Eyeshadow Quad: . A quad of complementary colour harmonies.. Silky powders in shimmer, satin and matte finishes.. Super comfortable and lightweight powder textures.. Held in a jewel-like golden case with a built-in mirror and brushes.. Wide range of shades - from regal gold and bronze to blue, green and copper.. . Why It's Escentual: . You're bound to instantly fall in love with one of the Ombres G eyeshadow palettes, thanks to its even split of eye-catching and neutral quad harmonies inspired by nature. When you want to be the centre of attention and capture everyone's gaze, opt for the brighter harmonies: 360 - Mystic Peacock, 555 - Metal Butterfly and 530 - Majestic Rose. When you're in the mood for a little more understated eyeshadow look, you can choose between the neutrals: 011 - Imperial Moon, 14 - Exotic Orchid and 940 - Royal Jungle. Each quartet features several finishes, including shimmer, satin and matte shades, to create the most spectacular eye look.. The jewel-like golden compact is embossed with the signature '˜double G', so it feels like a priceless jewel when you slide it out of its black velvet pouch. When you lift the lid, there's a mirror and two dual-ended brushes, offering a wide sponge design for building colour, a thin sponge for harder-to-reach areas and a brush for blending out.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use the wide sponge end of the brush to apply bold colours, the thin sponge end for precision and the brush for blending out.. . The Sustainable Side: . Since 2007, GUERLAIN have been committed to preserving biodiversity.. .

What You Need To Know: . The Flora Probiotic Mask is tailor made to answer angry skin's needs. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Prisme Libre On-The-Go Brush Powder Brush
listings.description: Nicolas Degennes, Givenchy Makeup and Colour Artistic Director, designed the Prisme Libre On-The-Go Brush, with soft, generous bristles, specially developed for applying the iconic Prisme Libre 4-shade loose powder.. With 4-colour synthetic bristles inspired by Givenchy's very first face brush, this brush takes up and applies just the right amount of product for a seamless makeup result without streaks and an even complexion with a sheer finish.. How To Use and Tips . The ideal brush for applying Prisme Libre loose powder for a sheer finish.. Shake the Prisme Libre loose powder into the lid of its case.. Use the Prisme Libre On-The-Go Brush to blend the four shades of powder inside the lid, then load the brush with the blended powder.. Tap the brush on the side of the lid to remove excess powder from the bristles and apply the powder to the face in circular motions.. This brush can also be used for any other type of face powder..

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Rose Perfecto Beautifying Lip Balm 2.8g / 01 - Pink Irresistible
listings.description: "GIVENCHY Le Rose Perfecto offers the benefits of a nourishing lip balm with a touch of creamy colour, deeply hydrating and defining your lips with a plumping effect." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The GIVENCHY Le Rose Perfecto: . A creamy balm infused with a pearly pigmented lip-perfecting colour.. Lips will be moisturised with 24 hours hydration.. Your lips will appear plumper for eight hours.. Packed into a genuine leather pink case.. Featuring a selection of glowy shades from pinks, nudes to plum.. . Why It's Escentual: . What makes the Le Rose Perfecto so special is it's unique formula that packs skincare with the high pigmented colour, so you can get nourishment of a lip balm with the bold lip enhancing colour of a lipstick in one quick swipe.. Each of the balms contains a careful selection of ingredients aimed at enhancing the appearance and texture of your lips with every application. The 95% natural origin formula is richly creamy yet lightweight, never overburdening. Not only does this balm nourish but it also shields them from dryness, thanks to the inclusion of pink pepper, while vitamin c promotes fuller, volumised lips. Additionally, a combination of hyaluronic acid, rose oil, and shea butter ensures that your lips remain optimally hydrated and soft.. If you want to own a GIVENCHY handbag, we've got the next best thing; the GIVENCHY Le Rose Perfecto nods to their bag designs with a pink genuine leather case with touches of silver engraved with GIVENCHY. When you take off the lid, and twist up your Le Rose Perfecto prepare to speechless as you take in the stunning balm design with white swirls, atop it's imprinted with the house's signature 4G logo.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Twist the bullet to release the lip colour and swipe over the lips.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer box.. . .

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: “BOSS Bottled Parfum has joined HUGO BOSS’ beloved fragrance collection, taking the range to the next level by offering the most concentrated BOSS Bottled fragrance to date.” - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You’ll Love HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Parfum: . Rich, textured scent with spicy, fruity and woody tones.. Long-lasting designer fragrance with a Parfum concentration.. Part of the fan-favourite BOSS Bottled fragrance collection.. Features the Boss Bottled flacon with a lacquered finish.. . What Does BOSS Bottled Parfum Smell Like? . Created by perfumers Annick Ménardo and Suzy Le Helley, BOSS Bottled Parfum kicks off with the lively, zesty tone of mandarin, which is heated up and energised by spicy incense oil. The heart has a surprisingly soft, slightly powdery side as orris pairs with an earthy fig tree root accord. Finally, cedarwood essence and a vegetal leather accord add warmth, intensity and strength to HUGO BOSS’ long-lasting fragrance.. Top notes are Mandarin, Incense. Heart notes are Orris, Fig Tree Roots Accord. Base notes are Cedarwood, Vegetal Leather Accord. . . Why It’s Escentual: . The BOSS Bottled collection is a firm-favourite with fragrance fans worldwide. So, as soon as another signature joins the range, we know it will prove a hit - and BOSS Bottled Parfum is no exception. It offers a rich, longer-lasting aroma with its unique personality while perfectly tying into the line. Although it does not feel like a copycat of its predecessors, it still honours previous fragrances in the collection, including BOSS Bottled Infinite, as it shares a similar spicy-fruity opening and warm woody base. The fragrances unveils a touch of softness and a sweetness at the heart, which is more reminiscent of BOSS Bottled Night.. The iconic BOSS Bottled design has also been given a dramatic new look for the Parfum version; it’s now lacquered in a smoky black shade, topped with a suave brushed metal cap and finished off with a touch of gold.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz BOSS Bottled Parfum directly onto your neck, chest and wrists. To get the most out of the fragrance, apply to the back of the knees and in the crease of the elbow for an even longer-lasting scent.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette Spray 35ml
listings.description: "Reinvented for 2022, GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette is an enchanting white floral bouquet enhanced by rich earthy tones that simmer over your skin - fans of the iconic L'Interdit need to try the new Eau de Toilette!" - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette: . Luminous floral fragrance with deep woody tones.. Delicate Eau de Toilette with 4 hour longevity.. Reinvention of 2019 GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette.. Sleek glass design partially made from recycled glass.. . What Does GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette Smell Like? . L'Interdit Eau de Toilette is a transformative scent, beginning with a rush of sweet fruity orange, zesty orange and mandarin. The opening quickly fades as the dazzling floral heart awakens, with the bright florals layering to have a slightly creamy, fresh floral feel. Orange blossom, neroli, tuberose and jasmine combine to be sensuous with an intense white floral dry down. The base takes the scent in an unexpected direction, with rich patchouli and vetiver adding a hint of sweetness to the earthy feel made creamy and warm by the beautiful sandalwood. The initial clean sweetness is reinvigorated by the musk and cistus flower, enhancing the floral heart and delicately dancing amongst the earthy base.. Top notes are Orange, Bergamot, Mandarin. Heart notes are Orange Blossom, Neroli Oil, Tuberose Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum, Jasmine Sambac Absolute. Base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli Essence, Vetiver Essence, Musks, Cistus Flower. . . Why It's Escentual: . GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette has both a comforting familiarity with the signature L'Interdit white floral tones as well as an unexpected woody facet that is utterly captivating. Starting delicate with a natural sweetness, L'Interdit Eau de Toilette turns into a fiery woody fragrance without losing the luminous florals that make L'Interdit so mesmerising.. The original L'Interdit scent was created in 1957 for Aubrey Hepburn, and we think it embodies her striking glamour. The updated version not only has less ambery tones to allow the florals and earthy notes to shine but the juice is housed in a more eco-conscious but chic glass design.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your wrists and neck. Freshly moisturised skin enhances the scent's longevity.. . The Sustainable Side: . The glass design has been made slimmer with less glass compared to the 2019 version. The glass is also made from 11% recycled post-consumer glass to reduce waste.. . Values: . Eco-conscious design.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk 3.4g / 110 - Beige Nu
listings.description: The ultimate fashion statement housed in a rechargeable leather case, Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk is a timeless and elegant fashion accessory. Its modern texture glides effortlessly over the lips like silk, while delivering a luminous, semi-matte finish. And, thanks to its formula enriched in hyaluronic acid spheres and Acmella Oleracea extract, lips are instantly smoothed and the inner water is locked for up to 24 hours, for absolute comfort. The intense colour is impressively long-lasting, staying vibrant for up to 12 hours.. Combining an ultra-fine film with the most vivid colour and the utmost comfort, Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk redefines the lipstick rules. Less really is more!. Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk's highly-pigmented colour palette includes the most iconic and the most fashionable reds. Discover Givenchy's signature brown-toned red (37) and the most luminous red with a hint of yellow (306).. The vibrant shades are divided into eight colour families: . RED BEAN PASTE “ dried rose tones . BRICK RED “ yellow-brown reds . TOMATO RED “ bright reds . MAPLE RED “ brown-toned reds . WINE RED “ burgundy-toned reds . CARROT RED “ orange-toned reds . PINK “ soft and vivid pink shades . MILKY NUDES “ natural pink-beige tones . Crafted from genuine black leather, Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk's case is engraved with the Givenchy 4G emblem, echoing the logo reinterpreted by Matthew Williams. For a bold and timeless fashion statement right down to the smallest detail. .

Its modern texture glides effortlessly over the lips like silk, while delivering a luminous, semi-matte finish. And, thanks to its formula enriched in hyaluronic acid spheres and Acmella Oleracea extract, lips are instantly smoothed and the inner water is locked for up to 24 hours, for absolute comfort. The intense colour is impressively long-lasting, staying vibrant for up to 12 hours.. Combining an ultra-fine film with the most vivid colour and the utmost comfort, Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk redefines the lipstick rules. Less really is more!. Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk's highly-pigmented colour palette includes the most iconic and the most fashionable reds. Discover Givenchy's signature brown-toned red (37) and the most luminous red with a hint of yellow (306).. The vibrant shades are divided into eight colour families: . RED BEAN PASTE “ dried rose tones . BRICK RED “ yellow-brown reds . TOMATO RED “ bright reds . MAPLE RED “ brown-toned reds . WINE RED “ burgundy-toned reds . CARROT RED “ orange-toned reds . PINK “ soft and vivid pink shades . MILKY NUDES “ natural pink-beige tones . Crafted from genuine black leather, Le Rouge Interdit Intense Silk's case is engraved with the Givenchy 4G emblem, echoing the logo reinterpreted by Matthew Williams. For a bold and timeless fashion statement right down to the smallest detail. .

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum Refillable Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Indulge in the intense Giorgio Armani Code Parfum, a fragrance with a captivating story and an even better aromatic-woody scent." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Giorgio Armani Code Parfum: . Sophisticated aromatic-woody fragrance.. Celebrates sensitive masculinity with unique fragrance notes.. Incredibly long-lasting Parfum for 8 hours of wear.. Intense addition to the Armani Code collection.. Features a suave black and metallic refillable design.. . What Does Giorgio Armani Code Parfum Smell Like? . Combining light unexpected notes with bold aromatic and woody tones, Armani Code Parfum is an intense yet well-balanced aromatic fragrance.. The top notes are refreshingly light; though they can't be smelt alone, Armani's two variations of bergamot work in harmony to add a vibrant zesty tinge throughout the scent. The star of Code Parfum is the clary sage heart, which leaves a herby and musky trail all day long with a tinge of natural sweetness. The other heart note is iris - both resinoid iris and aldehydes of iris add a sensual softness to elevate the scent using the tiniest hint of powdery florals. The base is rich and earthy as tonka bean draws out the woodiness of the cedar wood note.. Top notes are Vert de Bergamote, Bergamot. Heart notes are Clary Sage, Resinoid Iris. Base notes are Tonka Bean, Cedar Wood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Code Parfum is captivating from the very first spritz. And, even hours later, Code Parfum will not budge. So, if you love the Code collection, but you're after an even more intense and longer-lasting scent, you'll love the Parfum version. It has a similar aromatic and woody tone as the Eau de Parfum, but with a complex iris heart to ensure it stands out as a fragrance in its own right. All in all, Code Parfum is exhilarating yet sophisticated, so it feels at home anywhere from an outdoors setting to a suave club.. We love the narrative behind the fragrance too. The story of Code Parfum is a celebration of sensitive masculinity, emboldening the wearer to be whoever they want to be. The dazzling scent acts like a veil of confidence, combining the most typically masculine notes with strikingly soft tones and transforming on your skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your wrists and neck. Once you're finished with Code Parfum, the original bottle can be refilled by removing the atomiser and clicking the refill into place.. . The Sustainable Side: . Code Parfum is refillable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum Spray 40ml
listings.description: "Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever is a captivating chypre-floral scent with a unique boozy cherry tone that makes it a gourmand fragrance lover's dream." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever: . Sensuous amber-gourmand fragrance with green and floral undertones.. Carefully balances playful sweet notes with rich earthy tones.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum for up to 6 hours of wear.. Part of the Jimmy Choo I Want Choo fragrance line.. Housed in a glamorous grey ombre glass bottle with gold accents.. . What Does Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Smell Like? . I Want Choo Forever is a powerhouse of sweet gourmand notes, lifted by sensuous florals and enhanced by rich chypre tones. The first spritz is juicy and sweet as rose lingers on your skin. Pink peppercorn and bitter almond oil are subtle but delicious, adding a slight spice amongst the fragrance's creamy warm scent. The stand out note is the black cherry liquor at the heart, which creates a boozy trail that's full of flavour. Jasmine adds its white floral tone to the heart whilst vetiver adds a hint of greenery.. The base completes Jimmy Choo's beautiful gourmand scent as vanilla and tonka beans add a sophisticated sweetness after the opulent cherry note of the heart. The moss accord is subtle, but works to balance out the layer of sweetness in the base.. Top notes are Rose, Pink Peppercorn, Bitter Almond Oil. Heart notes are Black Cherry Liquor, Jasmine Sambac, Vetiver. Base notes are Moss Accord, Vanilla, Tonka Beans. . . Why It's Escentual: . In our view, Forever is the perfect scent for original I Want Choo fans to switch in for the evening, or for gourmand fragrance lovers to enjoy all day long. It's utterly delicious, thanks to its blend of rich good-enough-to-eat notes. The cherry facet adds a powerful boozy punch that makes Forever stand out from the original I Want Choo; it reminds us a little bit of a sweet slice of cherry bakewell - and yes, we'd definitely go back for another slice!. We love that I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum offers a rush of sweetness without being sickly sweet or cloying. Its warm ambery tones and chypre notes enhance the signature to offer a scent that's playful and yet still sensuous (and, of course, extremely wearable).. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz I Want Choo Forever onto your neck and wrists. Freshly moisturised skin can improve the longevity of a scent, too, so consider using a body lotion before applying.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent All Hours Foundation SPF39 25ml / LC1
listings.description: "Want 24 hour full coverage? Yves Saint Laurent All Hours Foundation SPF39 conceals, perfects and lasts longer than the average 9-5." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The YSL All Hours Foundation: . Full coverage matte foundation with long-lasting wear.. Lightweight, weightless fluid texture for a breathable finish.. Infused with hyaluronic acid for all-day hydration.. Luxurious frosted glass bottle with iconic YSL emblem.. Skin feels soft, smooth and hydrated after two weeks.. Transferproof, waterproof and sportproof formula.. . Why It's Escentual: . Ideal for multi-purpose makeup fans, the YSL Foundation contains SPF 39 to keep your skin protected and healthy - it's an SPF, high-coverage foundation and hydrating cream all within one weightless formula. We love the unique fluid texture that easily glides across the skin for a natural, breathable texture. The transfer-proof, waterproof and sweatproof formula means you're ready for whatever your day throws at you. If you were fan of the original don't panic! The 2022 formula offers the same great coverage with a multitude of skin loving benefits.. Available in a diverse range of shades, every skin tone can enjoy a softer, smoother and hydrated complexion with the skin-loving foundation formula. Infused with hyaluronic acid, the YSL All Hours Foundation provides all-day hydration for a comfortable, luminous finish. Added neo-skin powder keeps your complexion shine-free, while jasmine petals sourced from the YSL Ourika Gardens help combat any dullness.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply All Hours Foundation to the centre of the face and work outwards using a beauty blender or brush. By using a dabbing motion, you can achieve a fuller coverage finish; if you're looking for medium coverage, try using the fingertips or a gliding motion.. . Discover YSL All Hours Foundation’s 3 letter shade naming system for better shade finding: . 1st digit represents your skin tone, Light (L)/Medium (M)/Deep (D) 2nd digit represents your skin undertone. - Cool (C): Your skin has hints of pink, blue or purple tones. - Neutral (N): Your skin has a mixture of both warm and cool tones, or you find it difficult to determine. - Warm (W): Your skin has hints of peach or yellow tones. 3rd digit represents shade intensity from 1 - 10..

Why You'll Love The YSL All Hours Foundation: . Full coverage matte foundation with long-lasting wear.. Lightweight, weightless fluid texture for a breathable finish.. Infused with hyaluronic acid for all-day hydration.. Luxurious frosted glass bottle with iconic YSL emblem.. Skin feels soft, smooth and hydrated after two weeks.. Transferproof, waterproof and sportproof formula.. . Why It's Escentual: . Ideal for multi-purpose makeup fans, the YSL Foundation contains SPF 39 to keep your skin protected and healthy - it's an SPF, high-coverage foundation and hydrating cream all within one weightless formula. We love the unique fluid texture that easily glides across the skin for a natural, breathable texture. The transfer-proof, waterproof and sweatproof formula means you're ready for whatever your day throws at you. If you were fan of the original don't panic! The 2022 formula offers the same great coverage with a multitude of skin loving benefits.. Available in a diverse range of shades, every skin tone can enjoy a softer, smoother and hydrated complexion with the skin-loving foundation formula. Infused with hyaluronic acid, the YSL All Hours Foundation provides all-day hydration for a comfortable, luminous finish. Added neo-skin powder keeps your complexion shine-free, while jasmine petals sourced from the YSL Ourika Gardens help combat any dullness.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply All Hours Foundation to the centre of the face and work outwards using a beauty blender or brush. By using a dabbing motion, you can achieve a fuller coverage finish; if you're looking for medium coverage, try using the fingertips or a gliding motion.. . Discover YSL All Hours Foundation’s 3 letter shade naming system for better shade finding: . 1st digit represents your skin tone, Light (L)/Medium (M)/Deep (D) 2nd digit represents your skin undertone. - Cool (C): Your skin has hints of pink, blue or purple tones. - Neutral (N): Your skin has a mixture of both warm and cool tones, or you find it difficult to determine. - Warm (W): Your skin has hints of peach or yellow tones. 3rd digit represents shade intensity from 1 - 10..

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: The Fragrance Inspiration Narciso Rodriguez introduces NARCISO Cristal eau de parfum, the luminous and addictive new perfume for women in the iconic NARCISO collection. The fragrance is a tribute to radiant femininity, reflecting the inner light of the NARCISO woman, just as the facets of a crystal radiate light to reveal its natural beauty.. The Fragrance Notes This new feminine perfume captures the essence of inner light through its radiant topnotes, pure and delicate heart, and sensual base notes. As the scent awakens, a glowing halo of radiant bergamot illuminates the soft petals of blooming flowers, a lush bouquet of upcycled rose and white floral accords. The fragrance gradually unfurls to a voluptuous drydown with the iconic heart of musc, the unmistakable signature of NARCISO fragrances. The musc is enhanced with elegant woody and amber facets of sensuous cedarwood and cashmeran, giving the fragrance a mysterious, diffusive trail. A sublime alchemy of lightness and depth, the scent's luminous halo counterbalances a deep intensity.. Ingredients NARCISO Cristal eau de parfum for women introduces a new standard of naturality, with more than 85% of its ingredients from natural origin. With a bergamot ethically-sourced from Italy, and a rose note sourced using a new upcycling process of distillation, the fragrance recovers olfactive components from distillation water to create a floral note that evokes the smell of the fresh rose.. The Bottle The iconic NARCISO bottle appears in its purest form, the transparent glass tinted in a delicate pink, revealing the luminous scent within. Finished with a contrasting matte pink cap, the precious object radiates the same captivating luminosity as the NARCISO woman..

listings.rawTitle: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Eye Revival Serum-in-Cream 15ml
listings.description: "Starting to lose hope that you'll never be able to reduce those pesky dark circles? Don't give up just yet; the Philosophy Hope In A Jar Eye Revival Serum-in-Cream is very aptly named - and it's here to revitalise and rejuvenate your under-eyes for a brighter, fresher look." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philosophy Hope In A Jar Eye Cream: . Lightweight vegan eye cream for tired eyes.. Clinically proven to hydrate skin for 24 hours.. Visibly improves dark circles in one week.. Reduces the appearance of expression lines and wrinkles in two weeks.. Instantly smooths out the eye area while targeting puffiness.. Suitable for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers.. . What You Need To Know: . Pairing the comfort of a cream with the efficiency of a serum, Philosophy's powerhouse eye cream is formulated with a hardworking blend of elderberry flower and enhanced hyaluronic acid to target signs of ageing and fatigue head on. Designed to reduce puffiness, minimise dark circles and smooth out wrinkles and lines, Philosophy's all-vegan Serum-In-Cream brightens and revitalises even the most sensitive of under-eyes for a more youthful, more alert and more well-rested look.. . Why It's Escentual: . If there's one ingredient that tired, ageing skin needs, it's hyaluronic acid - and that's exactly what you get here. Philosophy's powerful multitasking formula contains a hefty dose of enhanced hyaluronic acid to deliver 24-hour hydration; but that's not the only thing that's impressive about the HA used here. Present throughout Philosophy's entire Hope In A Jar skincare collection and developed through biotechnology, the HA boasts a low molecular weight to ensure it penetrates your skin faster and deeper. Added to the mix is responsibly sourced elderberry extract to target unwanted dark circles and puffiness, while the serum-eye-cream-hybrid is also laced with an exclusive radiance complex, featuring upcycled tangerine peel extract and antioxidant pro-vitamin p to improve luminosity.. But we can't write about this under-eye treatment without mentioning its texture; although the clue is in the name, we were still surprised by just how soft and gentle this creamy eye serum was when we tried it. It melted into the skin like the most delicately buttery moisturiser without feeling at all heavy or tacky.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Using your fingertips, gently apply a small amount of the eye cream under and around the eye area in both the morning and evening.. . The Sustainable Side: . Held in a cardboard box and a small plastic pump bottle that can be separated for recycling.. . Values: . Vegan. Ophthalmologist-tested. Suitable for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Bond Builder Lipid Shield Oil 30ml
listings.description: "Repair hair damage caused by colour-treating, heat styling or chemical processing with the Philip Kingsley Bond Builder Lipid Shield Oil, a lightweight and fast-absorbing oil that strengthens hair after one use." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Bond Builder Oil: . Lightweight, fast-absorbing hair oil to strengthen damaged tresses.. Repairs damage caused by colour, chemical processing and heat styling.. Reduces tangles, smooths frizz and adds shine.. Provides heat protection up to 220°C.. 9/10 users found their hair was resistant and resilient to daily damage.. Suitable for all hair types and textures.. . What You Need To Know: . The Philip Kingsley Lipid Shield Oil restores your lipid layer - the hair's first line of defence against everyday damage - for healthy, soft and shiny locks. Using a castor oil and sebacic acid blend, the trichologist-approved formula repairs damage caused by colouring, chemical processing, UV rays and heat styling. It does this after just one use, creating an instantly softer and smoother feel.. The Bond Builder Oil contains advanced biomimetic technology that coats each hair strand to protect the hair cuticle, while restoring shine and slip to detangle and defrizz damaged tresses. The scientifically-tested formula restores your hair's resistance to water so it's less vulnerable to environmental stress using a 18-MEA derivative. Camellia oil also joins the mix as it's packed with hair-loving vitamins and antioxidants.. . Why It's Escentual: . As Philip Kingsley's first-ever hair oil for all types and textures, the Lipid Shield Oil instantly caught our attention here at Escentual HQ. We were really impressed by its formula, but we also love the way it feels just as much as we love its tech-powered formulation. The Bond Builder Oil has a lightweight, silky-soft texture that instantly absorbs into your locks to add a subtle shine without leaving behind an unwanted greasy finish. As the icing on the cake, it releases a refreshing, uplifting and clean citrus-floral scent as it does so. Plus, its travel-friendly size means that it's easy to pop into travel bags to keep your tresses protected wherever you are.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Shake well before use. Tilt the bottle and tap the base to dispense 5-6 drops into the palm of your hand; for shorter hair, start with 2-3 drops and build up your usage depending on the damage.. As the first step in your styling routine, apply to the mid-lengths and ends of towel-dried hair and leave in. Use every 2-3 washes to restore your lipid layer.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Lipid Shield Oil is housed within an 100% recyclable bottle and box.. . Values: . Cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Reve de Miel Honey Lip Care 10ml
listings.description: "Soften and smooth your lips with the Nuxe Reve de Miel Honey Lip Care, a transparent, non-sticky lip oil infused with the deliciously sweet aroma of honey." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Nuxe Honey Lip Care: . Nourishing lip oil for dry, chapped lips.. Laced with the delectable scent of honey and vanilla.. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Breathe in the sweet, delicate aroma of Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum, a woody-floral fragrance for women that centres around Turkish rose.. The Story Behind Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum . Composed by perfumer Quentin Bisch, Delina captures the essence of a sensual bouquet. The fragrance feels instantly fresh and sweet as it opens with the aquatic, almost floral tones of lychee and rhubarb, which are cleverly balanced by tangy bergamot and a light sprinkling of spicy-sweet nutmeg.. These aromas then give way to the star of the show; Turkish rose, an ultra-feminine, romantic note, which is joined by delicate peony, lily of the valley and sensual vanilla in the heart. Finally, the seductive base of woody cashmeran, musk and vetiver warms on the skin, rounding off Parfums de Marly's masterful fragrance.. Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum Smells Similar To . If you're familiar with Delina Exclusif but you're looking for a fresher and sweeter approach, this would make a perfect daytime companion.. About Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum's Bottle . Held in a curved, delicate pink bottle, everything about Delina feels elegant, feminine and sensual. A silver ball sits at the lid, with a pink gem at its crown and a tassel around its neck. The blush-pink hue perfectly captures the pretty shades of the velvety florals that lie at this heart of the scent.. Why We Love It . Delina is perfect for any woman who loves floral fragrances; it's like a walk through a blooming garden in spring. We love how sweet, pretty and feminine this fragrance feels when you first spritz it, it's almost like a high-end floral bouquet captured in a bottle, or a freshly crushed rose petal in your hand.. It''s long-lasting, too. It's a subtle yet intense fragrance that lingers beautifully.. How To Use It . Spray onto the neck and wrists.. Works Well With . If you're obsessed with the sophisticated aroma of Delina, you're in luck; Parfums de Marly has an entire collection dedicated to the timeless scent, allowing you to surround yourself in the fragrance by using a number of luxe scented body care items.. The Notes In Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum Are . Top Notes: Rhubarb, Lychee, Bergamot Essence, Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Lily Of The Valley, Peony, Vanilla. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Musk, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Acqua di Parma Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum is a celebration of velvety magnolia petals and vibrant citrus notes - it's utter bliss!" - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Acqua di Parma Magnolia Infinita: . Sparkling magnolia scent with bursts of zesty citrus fruits.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum that lingers on your skin for an average of six hours.. Magnolia Infinita by Acqua di Parma is a celebration of the creamy white floral magnolia flower, which is accented by vibrant bursts of zesty fruits. You can feel the artistic craftsmanship running through Magnolia Infinita. Its zesty and floral notes have been carefully and perfectly blended to reflect its inspiration: the idea of endless possibilities, which feels as hopeful and optimistic as pure sunlight. This feeling of opulence extends to the chic gold and black design, which Acqua di Parma fans will want to add to their collection.. . The Best Way To Use It: . listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Refill 100ml
listings.description: "Be kind to the planet with the Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Refill, which allows you to enjoy Prada's dazzling amber-floral scent for longer whilst reducing excess waste." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Prada Paradoxe Refill: . Refill for the original Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum.. Beautiful amber-floral fragrance with seductive musky tones.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Easy-to-use refill that reduces waste.. . What Does Prada Paradoxe Smell Like? . Just like your original bottle of Prada Paradoxe, the Paradoxe Refill is a dance between fresh cool tones, delicate florals and beautiful warmth. Opening with crisp neroli, the light white floral tone turns warmer as the enchanting heart of amber warms on your skin. The amber adds a familiar cosy warmth and a softly sensuous spice to the scent without overpowering the refreshing neroli tones of the top. The initially delicate and fresh feel is reintroduced by an innovative musk molecule in the base. Designed for Paradoxe, this revolutionary musk note adds depth and longevity whilst still being light enough to appear from the first spritz!. Top note is Neroli. Heart note is Amber Accord. Base note is Musk. . Why It's Escentual: . We love when a brand not only makes a delicious new floral scent, but also does good for the planet and the people who wear the scent. And Prada certainly do just that! Their refill design allows you to continue experiencing the luxury and liberation of Paradoxe whilst reducing waste.. Prada Paradoxe is all about celebrating femininity in all of its forms as it encourages you to have the freedom to express yourself. The refill continues to embody your ability to be "never the same, always yourself" as it tops up your iconic Prada triangle bottle to continue the Prada story.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Unscrew the cap and remove the fragrance pump from your original Prada Paradoxe fragrance once empty. Twist open the refill and pop it into the empty bottle, holding the refill upright before twisting into place. The refill will dispense the perfume and stop automatically once your triangle bottle is full.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Paradoxe Refill is designed to reduce waste as you can reuse your original glass bottle. The ingredients have also been sourced in an eco-friendly way.. .

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 30ml
listings.description: "Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is a must-have for floral fragrance lovers and those looking to own a piece of Prada luxury." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Creating a beautifully light and fresh feel from the get-go, Prada Paradoxe sparkles with a fruity fresh opening of bergamot, tangerine and pear. The crisp heart note of neroli leaves a refreshing trail on the skin, turning creamy and warm as it blends with jasmine and orange flowers to create a dazzling white floral bouquet.. The fragrance becomes rich and sensuous as its vibrant base of amber creates a slightly spicy, cosy feel alongside creamy vanilla and benzoin. The initially delicate and fresh feel is reintroduced by a unique musk molecule in the base; this musk note is a new innovation that is light and yet still powerful - it's so light, you can just about smell it from the very first spritz!. Top note is Calabrian Bergamot Heart, Tangerine Essence, Pear Accord. Heart note is Neroli Essence, Neroli Bud Essence, Tunisian Orange Flower Heart Absolute Blossom, Jasmine Sambac Absolute. Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is not only an icon in the making, it also offers fragrance fans the opportunity to own a piece of luxury from the high fashion brand of Prada. The perfume itself is initially delicate but it never feels too subtle as it wraps you in a beautifully sophisticated scent that is playful and yet still sensuous. It embraces the natural paradoxes found within classic perfume notes to reinvent female fragrance, celebrating the multiple dimensions of your identity as it does so.. The story behind Prada Paradoxe is nothing short of inspiring. It's been created to help the wearer embrace the freedom of self-expression, so you are "never the same, always yourself". We love how the avant-garde fragrance and design makes a powerful move towards sustainability and a reinvention of sensuality - you can express yourself however you want with Prada Paradoxe.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your wrists and neck for a long-lasting scent. Once you have finished your original bottle, the Prada Paradoxe refill screws into the cap and automatically refills your bottle with the perfect amount.. . The Sustainable Side: . Prada Paradoxe showcases Prada's first-ever refillable design..

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: "KENZO Homme Eau de Parfum is a woody-aquatic fragrance for someone who wants to be noticed: its cool freshness and leathery undertones make it a show-stopping scent." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love KENZO Homme: . Fresh aquatic scent with rugged leather tones.. Incredibly long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Part of the KENZO Homme collection.. Features a bamboo-inspired design made from 15% recycled glass.. . What Does KENZO Homme Smell Like? . Combining bold fresh marine notes with warm leather and slightly sweet yet earthy patchouli, Homme is built around a powerhouse blend of outdoorsy notes. The marine accord creates a cool aquatic vibe, which feels just like an ocean breeze. The heart of leather warms the scent whilst adding texture and depth before a hint of green spiciness rises up from the base to perfectly balance the scent.. Top note is Marine Accord. Heart note is Leather. Base note is Patchouli. . . Why It's Escentual: . We'll admit that KENZO Homme's note structure might make it seem like it will be a bold, earthy and warm scent with just the tiniest hint of freshness. But that's not the case at all! Frankly, we've been blown away by the intensity of KENZO's marine accord - it hits you like a tidal wave, adding a cool and crisp tone that aquatic fragrance fans won't be able to get enough of. As a result, Homme is loud and proud, entering the room before you do, before lingering close to your skin as its seductive leathery side works its way to the surface.. To top it off, KENZO Homme Eau de Parfum has a really cool blue-black design that's not just inspired by the bamboo shoot, but also the cut of a katana - the samurai sword - to honour KENZO's Japanese heritage.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz KENZO Homme onto your neck, chest and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . Inspired by the strength and flexibility of the bamboo shoot, KENZO's bottle is made using 15% recycled glass. What's more, its weight has been reduced by 23%, so it can hold 10ml of additional fragrance. The cap has been created to save 34% of plastic compared to its initial design, while the outer cardboard box is made using untreated kraft paper and FSC-certified paper materials, which is printed with bio-based inks.. .

listings.rawTitle: BURBERRY Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "If you love Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette, then the Eau de Parfum needs to be on your radar; it's a richer, warmer and smokier version of the scent that's even sexier than the original." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Burberry Hero: . Rich woody fragrance with a seriously smoked tone.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum take on the 2021 EDT.. Joins the fan-favourite Burberry Hero collection.. Housed in a deep oak and gold bottle.. . What Does Burberry Hero Smell Like? . Hero Eau de Parfum starts off with a vibrant, aromatic pine needle note that's reminiscent of the forest-floor before it warms through with a resinous, vanillary note of benzoin in the heart. But the heart is really powered by incense, which adds a rich and powerful smokiness that creates a deeply seductive vibe. The base of Burberry's Hero fragrance features a trio of cedarwood oils for a warm, comforting woody finish.. Top notes are Pine Needles. Heart notes are Benzoin, Incense. Base notes are Cedarwood Oil Trio. . . Why It's Escentual: . When Hero by Burberry launched as an Eau de Toilette in 2021, it was an instant hit. Not only did its fragrance make an impact, but so did its creative campaign - with Adam Driver as the face of the fragrance. And just one year after the launch of Hero Eau de Toilette, the Eau de Parfum joined the mix to offer an even richer, bolder and smokier scent that, we must admit, we're obsessed with here at Escentual.. Hero Eau de Parfum is a warmer, woodier and more ambery take on the original. It switched out the bright, citrus-green bergamot note at the top for a more aromatic, resinous tone created by pine notes. Then, you get the Burberry Hero signature cedarwood trio in the base of the Eau de Parfum, as opposed to it being at the heart of Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette. But the thing that really sets Hero Eau de Parfum apart is its rich, smoky and utterly seductive incense note, which adds a completely new dimension to the Burberry Hero line. We love that the fragrance's stronger and deeper is reflected in the Eau de Parfum oak and gold tone. Inspired by the Burberry house codes, it's a richer take on the original Hero bottle created by designer, Riccardo Tisci.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Burberry Hero directly onto your neck, chest and wrists.. .

listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO L'Absolue Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO L'Absolue is an exciting addition to the iconic FLOWER BY KENZO fragrance line. Fans of the range who are after a fierier signature will absolutely love it." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO L'Absolue: . Enticing spicy-floral perfume.. Offers a striking saffron twist on floral fragrances.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. 2022 addition to the FLOWER BY KENZO range.. Features the classic curved glass KENZO poppy design.. . What Does FLOWER BY KENZO L'Absolue Smell Like? . FLOWER BY KENZO L'Absolue starts with a dash of saffron; it's warm and spicy without being overpowering. It wraps the upcoming floral notes in a warm golden tinge as sweet rose and velvety white florals unite in the heart for a sophisticated and sensual tone. The base of vanilla becomes more prominent as the scent dries. At the same time, contrasting fresh white musks settle on the skin to lift the entire scent, so it somehow feels both bright and rich at the same time.. Top note is Saffron. Heart notes are Damascena Rose, Orange Blossom. Base notes are Vanilla, White Musks. . Why It's Escentual: . KENZO L'Absolue Eau de Parfum has an exciting spicy personality. If you're new to spice, L'Absolue's beautifully crafted floral heart will feel comforting and familiar, while the top note will gently encourage you to step outside of your comfort zone. Those who already love spice will equally adore this perfume as it dances between warm spice, intense florals and cool musks.. Fans of the FLOWER BY KENZO collection will love to explore this 2022 addition, especially as it feels different to the current lineup. Compared to the original FLOWER BY KENZO, L'Absolue loses any sense of powderiness. Instead, KENZO's floral signature is intensified by spice for a hot new take on FLOWER BY KENZO.. We love the fact that the saffron note adds a layer of spice without overwhelming the stunning florals at the heart. This is extra fitting, given the fact that the fragrance's muse, Masami Charlotte Lavault, is an activist flower farmer and the founder of the first-ever flower farm in Paris.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your neck, wrists and inner elbows for a long-lasting scent.. . The Sustainable Side: . The outer carton can be recycled and is made from responsible sources.. .

What Does Issey Miyake Eau & Cedre Smell Like? . Issey Miyake Eau & Cedre Eau de Toilette represents the interaction between water and raw, intense woods. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "JPG Scandal Pour Homme has returned to the ring for 2022 - and it's ready to pack a punch. Perfect for fans of the original Scandal Pour Homme, the Le Parfum edition is a rich and intense woody-amber fragrance with a touch of sweetness." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love JPG Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum: . Rich and warm woody-amber fragrance.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum with impressive scent projection.. An intense addition to the iconic Scandal Pour Homme fragrance collection.. Features the iconic JPG crown-topped bottle.. Boasts an eco-conscious refillable design.. . What Does Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum Smell Like? . Created by a trio of master perfumers - Quentin Bisch, Nathalie Cetto and Christophe Raynaud - the intense Scandal Pour Homme starts with a layer of geranium, which adds a subtle green aromatic tone with a slightly sweet edge. As Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum settles, a vanillary tonka bean note adds depth and richness before a long-lasting base of sandalwood warms on your skin.. Top note is Geranium. Heart note Tonka Bean. Base note is Sandalwood. . Why It's Escentual: . If you loved the original Scandal Pour Homme, then the intense Le Parfum version needs to be on your list of fragrances to try. Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Parfum shares similarities to the original, but offers a richer, more intense and - dare we say it - even sexier signature. It maintains the orginal's aromatic, woody and ambery tone but focuses on the vanillary tonka bean note - it's not resigned to the base in this Le Parfum. Instead, it takes centre stage before a creamy base that's dedicated to sandalwood is introduced.. We love that the iconic Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal crown is back for the 2022 Le Parfum. This time, though, the bottle is lined with a midnight black lacquer inside its double-walled glass - this deep colour is at the heart of the crown cap, too - for a bold, dramatic look. The icing on the cake? JPG Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum is refillable.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Scandal Le Parfum directly onto your neck and wrists to get the most out of this fragrance. Use the eco-conscious refill to top up your fragrance once it's empty.. . The Sustainable Side: . Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum is refillable.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Abeille Royale Double R Renew & Repair Advanced Serum 30ml
listings.description: "The GUERLAIN Abeille Royale Double R Renew & Repair Advanced Serum is an exceptional anti-ageing formula that harnesses the skin repairing power of honey." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Double R Serum: . Designed for dull skin lacking in firmness.. 46% of beauty lovers agreed that it improved radiance.. Features a 96% natural formula.. Smooths skin and pores for a fresh-skin effect.. Gives skin the lifted look while firming and brightening.. . What You Need To Know: . The GUERLAIN Double R Serum is split into a dual chamber design that holds two exclusive GUERLAIN technologies - with one side working to renew and the other to repair. Just like the rest of the Abeille Royale collection, Double R Serum has an unparalleled texture and GUERLAIN's signature sweet-fresh honey scent that's an unexpected delight each time you apply. For fans of Double R Serum, you may have noticed the design looks slightly different. Updated for 2022, GUERLAIN have tweaked the iconic golden design with a new glass body; the Double R Serum looks as luxurious as the formula feels with a double chamber bottle design encased in gold engraved with GUERLAIN's logo and bee insignia.. . The Best Way To Use It: . First off, warm up the formula between your fingertips. Then, start applying the formula from the centre of your face, smoothing it across your cheekbones, jawline, cheeks and forehead using an outward motion.. .

listings.description: Instantly soothe painful cracking, defend against harsh environmental exposure, and lock in 8 hours of weightless moisture with the Topicrem Hydra+ Lip Balm, a high-tolerance, clinical-grade treatment engineered to rescue dry, chapped lips.. Specially formulated for sensitive skin profiles, chronic dryness, and lips compromised by extreme weather or medical treatments, this soothing balm acts as a protective, comforting shield. Its buttery, non-sticky texture glides smoothly over delicate lip tissues without dragging or stinging. By delivering an optimal blend of natural lipids and protective waxes, it works to rapidly repair micro-cracks and restore a supple, healthy bounce, leaving your lips feeling completely comforted, smooth, and deeply hydrated.. Benefits . Rapid Chapped Relief: Instantly cools and comforts painful tightness, dry peeling, and split lips from the very first swipe. . 8-Hour Continuous Hydration: Creates an invisible, breathable moisture reservoir that keeps lips plump and soft all day.. Reinforces the Skin Barrier: Rebuilds the delicate lipid layer of the lips to prevent recurring dehydration.. Invisible, Satin-Matte Finish: Delivers deep nourishment with zero heavy, glossy, or sticky residue, perfect for both men and women.. Flawless Lipstick Primer: Smooths out dry, flaky lip texture to create an even, velvet canvas for lip colour.. Shea Butter: A nutrient-dense, plant-derived lipid packed with essential fatty acids that deeply nourishes, softens, and accelerates the repair of cracked skin cells. . Carnauba & Beeswax Complex: A protective, natural wax matrix that locks in vital moisture and forms a resilient barrier against wind, cold, and dry air.. Castor Seed Oil: A rich, comforting emollient that deeply conditions the skin layers to eliminate dry roughness and boost natural elasticity.. Why We Love It We love the Hydra+ Lip Balm because it delivers no-nonsense, clinical-strength hydration wrapped in absolute comfort. It completely moves away from heavy, petroleum-slick balms that simply sit on top of the skin; instead, it sinks in beautifully to actually repair the skin barrier. Joyful, bright and vibrant, the Serge Lutens Dans Le Bleu Qui Petille hand and body wash projects the same uplifting scent as the Dans Le Bleu Qui Petille Eau de Parfum. If you're looking for a fragrance that will transport you to the seashore, where salt crystallises on your skin under the hot summer sunshine, then the Dans Le Bleu Qui Petille fragrance collection is for you. The body wash completes the first steps in this routine by offering a nourishing foaming texture that will leave your skin silky-smooth and ready for a spritz of perfume.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the cleansing gel to the palm of your hand and massage into the skin using circular movements. Rinse thoroughly. Complete the ritual with the Serge Lutens Dans Le Bleu Qui Petille Eau de Parfum for a long-lasting scent.. .

It’s packed with honey to heal, nourish, and soothe, while propolis smoothes and beeswax creates the perfect glide. Add in shea butter and hyaluronic acid, and you’ve got a balm that’s as hydrating as it is luxurious. And the scent? A soft, natural honey aroma that’s an unexpected little treat when you apply.. listings.description: "Immerse yourself in the iconic Serge Lutens Parole d'Eau fragrance with this hand and body cleansing gel, which is laced with the exact same scent as the Eau de Parfum." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Serge Lutens Parole d'Eau Cleansing Gel: . Luxurious foaming cleanser for your hands and body.. Prolongs and intensifies the Serge Lutens Parole d'Eau Eau de Parfum.. Infused with a relaxing and refreshing aroma.. Inspired by the deepest and purest waters.. Easy-to-use pump design for fuss-free cleansing.. . What You Need To Know: . Serge Lutens' deluxe Hand And Body Cleansing Gel mimics the refreshing notes of its namesake Eau de Parfum to create a similar overall impression. Designed to recall the feeling of being immersed in pure and deep waters, the fragrance blends aromatic pine notes with calming eucalyptus. The aroma creates a moment of serenity, while invigorating citrus uplifts the senses. To finish, a cocoon of sensual musk envelopes your skin for a relaxing delicate scent.. . Why It's Escentual: . The Serge Lutens Parole d'Eau Cleansing Gel offers a truly luxurious cleanse as its silky-smooth texture bursts into a delicately scented foam. It's a treat on its own, but it's given time to shine when paired with the Eau de Parfum as they work together to build and enhance Serge Lutens' purifying scent.. As a part of the Matin Lutens collection, both the fragrance and the body wash were inspired by the simplicity of a morning ritual: water, bathing and a simple spritz of perfume. We love that this simplicity is reflected throughout the fragrance and the design; its sleek black bottle is adorned with Serge Lutens' iconic logo and topped with a mess-free pump for a luxe yet understated finish.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the cleansing gel to the palm of your hand and massage into the skin with circular movements. Rinse thoroughly. Complete the ritual with the Serge Lutens Parole d'Eau perfume for a long-lasting scent.. .

listings.description: A moment of serenity, a return to roots to reconnect with the essential through the new Matin Lutens collection.. "Colourless and odourless by definition, yet an eau can conceal a deep and discreet fragrance...". An original, modern composition which puts an end to the myth of odourless water. A fragrance which embodies a return to true deep waters. An immersion in pure water. A ritual to combine with the Matin Lutens cleansing gels for a long-lasting scent.. Matin Lutens, a line whose understated aesthetics and purity evoke the simplicity of a ritual focussed on morning essentials: water, bath and... a little spritz of perfume.. Natural ingredients, colours that reflect a return to serenity, perfectly in keeping with the organic vibe of this collection's olfactory creations, Matin Lutens promises a long-awaited return to your roots: a peaceful morning wake-up!. How to use: . Serge Lutens favours the use of premium grade raw materials of natural origin to make its fragrances, driven by the conviction that these alone can ensure full and complex evolution of the perfume on the skin. To use, spray your chosen fragrance directly onto the skin and let it sit for a few minutes. This allows the composition to take on its full character and reveal its truest, most seductive form. Serge Lutens essences always end up confessing to their deeds!.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Super Restorative Night Cream All Skin Types 50ml
listings.description: "Designed for menopausal skin, Clarins' Super Restorative Night Cream is a restoring overnight moisturiser that fights key signs of ageing: dryness, skin slackening, wrinkles and uneven tone." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Super Restorative Night Cream: . Anti-ageing moisturiser for menopausal skin.. 81% of women agreed it replenishes skin, while 80% agree it visually lifts skin.. Combats skin sagging and lifts your features.. Reduces the look of dark spots for a healthy, even glow.. Restores density to the skin at all levels.. Deeply nourishes and hydrates your skin from within.. Protects against skin-damaging pollutants.. . What You Need To Know: . The Super Restorative night cream was first launched in 2014 and it became an overnight success (no pun intended). But in 2022, Clarins unveiled a new formulation - and yes, it's even better than before. It still centres around Clarins' ground-breaking anti-sagging active, organic harungana, which is just as effective as retinol but not as irritating, so it benefits even the most sensitive skin. During the last update, Clarins added organic gorse extract too; this improves the tone of fibroblasts cells (which are responsible for producing the likes of collagen and elastic) by up to 89%, resulting in plump, firm and lifted skin.. Your skin tone is evened out and illuminated as you sleep, thanks to a brightening trio of organic desert date, a derivative of vitamin C and service tree bud extract. A blend of organic sea lily and shea butter work in harmony to hydrate and nourish your complexion as you rest.. . Why It's Escentual: . If you've ever thought that you can get away with using your day cream as a night cream, the Super Restorative Night Cream proves why you can't. As you rest, your skin naturally repairs and renews itself, so it's important that your face cream taps into this natural process. Clarins' Super Restorative Night Cream does just that, but it goes further. It adapts to the skin's chronobiology to provide menopausal skin with exactly what it lacks - and exactly what it needs - at the correct time of day. At night, your skin needs re-activating as microcirculation slows down. Organic service tree bud extract stimulates microcirculation and boosts radiance so you can wake up to fresh, glowy skin. And the fact that the cream has a subtle floral aroma and an ultra-rich but luxuriously smooth texture is just a bonus.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use every evening. Apply to a cleansed face and neck using light pressing motions, working from the centre of the face outwards. To boost your night-time skincare routine, you can also mix two drops of your favourite oil or serum in with your night cream.. . The Sustainable Side: . Separate the glass jar from the plastic lid to recycle. The cream is held in a carton made using paper from sustainably-managed forests.. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Super Restorative Day Cream SPF15 All Skin Types 50ml
listings.description: "If your skin is struggling due to hormonal changes caused by menopause, the Clarins Super Restorative Day Cream SPF15 is exactly what you need." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Clarins Super Restorative Day Cream SPF15: . Anti-ageing moisturiser to support the skin during menopause.. Instantly illuminates and smooths your complexion.. Restores density to the skin at all levels.. Reduces the look of deep wrinkles and sagging.. Deeply nourishes your skin whilst targeting dark spots.. Protects against minor sun and environmental damage.. . What You Need To Know: . Specially designed to support menopausal skin, Clarins' SPF15 Day Cream is a key player in the best-selling Super Restorative range, featuring the same benefits as the original Day Cream with the added benefit of protecting against UV rays. It shields against pollutants, too.. But how exactly does it care for menopausal skin? To start with, it uses highly innovative organic harungana. This redensifying ingredient isn't just intensely replenishing; it also offers anti-ageing benefits as effective as retinol, without causing the irritation sometimes associated with it. Harungana pairs with Clarins' new plant discovery: organic gorse extract; this improves the tone of fibroblasts (the cells involved in the formation of connective tissue) by up to 89%. The result? Firm, toned skin.. To complete the mix, tone-evening organic desert date combines with hydration-boosting organic sea lily, glow-enhancing vitamin C and ultra-nourishing shea butter. It protects your skin's natural barrier using vegetal squalene whilst smoothing out your complexion with line-filling pearls.. . Why It's Escentual: . Oestrogen levels drop during menopause, which has a knock-on effect on the production process within vital skin cells, such as fibroblasts. This cell is responsible for producing collagen and elastin - the proteins that keep your skin plump and bouncy. We love that Clarins understand this and offer an effective solution. The Super Restorative Cream adapts to the skin's chronobiology. It knows your skin is more vulnerable during the day, so squalane reinforces the hydrolipidic film and protects the skin.. The Super Restorative SPF15 face cream helps to give your skin an instant glow and a comforting, smooth texture whilst it works hard to lift, replenish and rejuvenate. listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Truth Beauty Freedom Love Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: James Skinner, scarf designer, and Sarah McCartney, our perfumer, collaborated to make a scarf and a fragrance. . They met in our studio in West London, to smell different natural and synthetic materials. The result was a collection of aromas which Sarah took as inspiration for the fragrance. She named it Truth Beauty Freedom Love, the rallying cry of the 19th Century Bohemian movement or artists, writers and free thinkers. . James illustrated the plants that the materials came from, and the wildlife they support. In the corners of the scarf he's placed the aroma molecules which cast a perfumer's spell on the blend to transform it from just a mixture of materials into an elegant, wearable fragrance. . F irst you'll probably smell honey and bergamot, then a blend of tobacco, vanilla, hay, iris, apricot, musk and violet tinted woods. We've been wearing this a lot, with the scarf too. . Perfume Dialect: Fruity Amber. Top Notes: Honey, Bergamot, Apricot. Heart Notes: Hay, Vanilla, Iris, Violets. Base Notes: Tobacco, Musk, Woods.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Meet Me On The Corner Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Meet Me On The Corner is a scent that recalls the 1970s, brought up to date. It's named after the Lindisfarne song, and captures the feeling of going on a date in the days when there were no mobile phones. We'd arrange to meet someone, then turn up on time at the right place.. It's a fragrance to evoke the excitement of 1970s citrus chypres, but with a fresh 21st Century aura from three essential oils: mandora citrus, magnolia flower and magnolia leaf. Mandora gives the top note a bright new sunshiny feeling. Using two parts of the magnolia tree brings a powerfully seductive softness to the heart of the fragrance.. Perfume Dialect: Citrus, Chypre. Top Notes: Lemon, Mandarin, Mandora, Clementine. Heart Notes: Magnolia Flowers, Magnolia Leaves, Sandalwood, Bergamot. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Musks, Patchouli, Styrax.. Meet Me On The Corner is suitable for vegans..

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Killer Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Killer Rose ought to have been made in the 1980s when floral fragrances had no fear. It was a time of big hats, big hair, bright colours, glossy lips, shoulder pads, killer heels and outstanding scents. They fell out of fashion, washed away by the fresh-light-watery trend in the 1990s, but we are so happy to see that they are back. In it, Sarah blended fruity raspberry and peach, added a dash of yuzu citrus and backed it up with patchouli, vanilla and Woody. listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Fluffy Lemon Top Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Fluffy Lemon Top is actually quite a serious scent behind its fun frontage; the citrus fruit arrival comes from orange, tangerine and bergamot essential oils. The juicy fragrance is a reminder of the joy we get from eating a lemon top ice cream at the seaside on a summer day, so the name just happened. In reality, after its happy introduction, it's a gently but perfectly constructed floral chypre with an iris-narcissus-lily of the valley heart, with a generous topping of white chocolate mousse, tonka absolute and musks. listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Amberama Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Named in honour of an 80s girl group (you know the one), 4160 Tuesdays Amberama Parfum is a playful take on amber fragrances." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love 4160 Tuesdays Amberama Parfum: . Amber-woody fragrance with a jammy raspberry heart.. Long-lasting niche Eau de Parfum.. Housed in a clear glass bottle featuring 4160's classic print.. . What Does Amberama Smell Like? . Amberama Parfum is an approachable amber perfume, so if you're unsure about this fragrance family, Amberama is a great place to start. It's a soft, woody, smooth amber scent scattered with freshly crushed raspberries, bursting with flavour.. To start, you get the uniquely green, tart, sunny and citrusy splash of bergamot, lifted by a dash of buzzy black pepper before the deep raspberry jam heart takes over. The raspberry heart - a 4160 Tuesdays signature - is nuanced by a soft, powdery touch of iris and sandalwood before the more traditional amber base is finally unveiled, adding a warm, resinous side to the scent.. Top notes are Bergamot, Black Pepper. Heart notes are Raspberry, Iris, Sandalwood. Base notes are Amber, Labdanum, Woody, Musks. . . Why It's Escentual: . Amberama was created when 4160 Tuesdays combined early versions of two fragrances they had made for a client to create an entirely new signature - they found out that, together, they made a really popular aroma, which would become Amberama. Named partly in honour of 80s girl group, Bananarama, the fragrance features the characteristic 4160 Tuesdays raspberry heart; you might not find any banana here, but there's still plenty of flirty fruity fun.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Amberama directly onto your pulse points: the neck and wrists.. . Values: . Vegan..

Sarah opened up this deep blend with modern molecules including bright, light Hedione and Maltol to add the aroma of malted barley bordering on malt whisky. listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Rosa Ribes Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Rosa Ribes (rhymes with Ebays - Latin for currant) is a blackcurrant, rose chypre fragrance with citrus fruits, moss, resins and musk.. In this eau de parfum, the chypre heart is made with oakmoss absolute, bergamot, opoponax and patchouli, and the masterplan is to mix it so you can't distinguish them - they blend with musk to become one smooth fragrant cloud to support the bright fruity notes which right pop out at you.. If like 4160Tuesdays' perfumer you were a Ribena lover as a child, this grown up blackcurrant aroma will definitely appeal.. Perfume Dialect: Fruity Floral Chypre. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Mandarin. Heart Notes: Rose, Blackcurrant . Base Notes: Opoponax, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Musk.. Rosa Ribes is suitable for vegans..

Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Moisture Extreme Shampoo: . Deeply nourishing hair wash for tightly coiled curls.. Cleanses, conditions and detangles curly hair susceptible to damage.. Tames even the toughest frizz.. Features a vegan, cruelty-free formula.. . What You Need To Know: . Suitable for natural, relaxed or synthetic hair that's prone to damage and breakage, Philip Kingsley's vegan-friendly shampoo is packed full of nourishing oils to leave your hair softer, stronger and easier to style.. While gently cleaning your hair, it hits each strand with a wave of hydration and helps repair damaged hair cuticles using Oligoquat M, whilst anti-static guar provides control and smoothness. Suitable for extremely dry, damaged or highly processed hair, the shampoo is one step ahead of your conditioner as it ensures your locks are hydrated even during a deep cleanse; a derivative of cocoa butter laces the formula to cleanse, condition and detangle your lengths, helping tame even the toughest frizz.. . Why It's Escentual: . Formulated to suit the unique needs of tightly coiled curls and very porous processed hair, the Moisture Extreme Enriching Shampoo shows why Philip Kingsley are experts in hair care - and why the brand has such a loyal fan base. It goes further than just cleansing the hair, but works hard to penetrate and fortify each individual strand, nourishing curly hair and strengthening it with time. And we have to admit that we love the gel's refreshing, revitalising aroma that creates that salon-esque feeling from the comfort of your own home.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to wet hair and lather, gently kneading the scalp for 60 seconds. Rinse well and repeat if necessary before following up with your favourite Philip Kingsley conditioner.. . The Sustainable Side: . Philip Kingsley bottles and tubes are created from either sugarcane bioplastic, made from a fully renewable origin, or post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR) created from single-use plastic that would otherwise end up in landfills. Philip Kingsley's innovative and eco-friendly packaging designs reduce landfill waste, plastic pollution and their overall pollution, greenhouse gas emissions and resources.. . Values: . Vegan.. Paraben-free, sulphate-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Moisture Balancing Combination Conditioner 75ml
listings.description: "Nourish and strengthen your ends and tresses with the weightless Philip Kingsley Moisture Balancing Combination Conditioner." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Moisture Balancing Conditioner: . Best-selling conditioner for medium-to-long combination hair.. Deeply hydrates the driest parts of your hair.. Reduces breakage, adds shine and strengthens your locks.. Features a cruelty-free formula.. . What You Need To Know: . Philip Kingsley's refreshingly-scented conditioner for combination hair works in a similar way to its partner-in-crime, the Moisturiser Balancing shampoo; it delivers targeted hydration to the parts of your hair that need it the most - namely, the mid-lengths and ends. But it goes one step further to offer an even more intensive dose of nourishment to dry-prone hair. Especially beneficial for mid-to-long locks that struggle to disrupt oil evenly, the conditioner adds shine and reduces static without adding weight, thanks to silicone, while wheat proteins strengthen and plump each individual strand. To complete the mix, hydrolysed elastin continues to support naturally fine, dry hair by adding strength, body and elasticity to guard against breakage.. . Why It's Escentual: . Hair can be a confusing thing at times, especially when you have combination hair, which can be oilier at the scalp but dry and lacklustre at the ends. But thankfully, Philip Kingsley's Moisture Balancing conditioner is full of nourishing, strengthening and anti-static ingredients that don't add weight or overload your scalp, helping to detangle your lengths for weightless, smooth and glossy results. But it's not just combination hair that Philip Kingsley had in mind when they created this best-selling conditioner; it's also been made to meet the needs of heat/colour processed hair or long fine hair, working to nourish your tresses for shiny, smooth and strong finish.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After shampooing, gently work the Moisture Balancing Combination Conditioner through the mid-lengths and ends of your hair before rinsing well.. . The Sustainable Side: . Philip Kingsley bottles and tubes are created from either sugarcane bioplastic, made from a fully renewable origin, or post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR) created from single-use plastic that would otherwise end up in landfills. Philip Kingsley's innovative and eco-friendly packaging designs reduce landfill waste, plastic pollution and their overall pollution, greenhouse gas emissions and resources.. . Values: . Paraben-free, SLS/SLES-free, sulphate-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley No Scent No Colour Gentle Conditioner 200ml
listings.description: "Strengthen and detangle your hair with the Philip Kingsley No Scent No Colour Gentle Conditioner, a hypoallergenic formula developed for sensitive scalps." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The No Scent No Colour Gentle Conditioner: . Nourishing conditioner for sensitive, irritated and delicate skin.. Provides shiny, manageable and tangle-free hair.. Improves your hair's strength and moisture retention.. For every 200ml conditioner sold, Philip Kingsley donates 50p to Look Good Feel Better.. Hypo-allergenic formula free from fragrance, colour, paraben, sulphates and MIT.. . What You Need To Know: . We know how difficult it can be to find a conditioner suitable for your sensitive, delicate and irritated scalp. Philip Kingsley's No Scent No Colour Conditioner contains only the most gentle yet effective ingredients for moisturised and healthy locks. The hypoallergenic formula includes hydrolyzed elastin to help strengthen the hair, whilst retaining natural moisture, over time reducing the frequency of breakage. Added amino silicone works to detangle hair and control frizz - making it perfect for pesky flyaways.. The kind and gentle formula is suitable for all hair types, even Brazilian Keratin treated hair.. . Why It's Escentual: . Inspired by Philip Kingsley supporting his wife through her battle with breast cancer, Philip wanted to create No Scent No Colour to be gentle enough for her scalp, which had been sensitised due to her chemotherapy treatment. This inspiration hasn't been lost through the years - for each 200ml No Scent No Colour Conditioner sold, 50p is donated to Look Good Feel Better; a charity that helps cancer patients build confidence and improve wellbeing. You can enjoy smooth, frizz-free hair whilst giving back - a win-win in our books.. The Philip Kinglsey No Scent No Colour Conditioner has a lightweight and comfortable texture, ideal for anyone who doesn't get on with a heavy or thick conditioner. The scent? As described by the name, this conditioner smells like absolutely nothing (not even your standard conditioner-smell), focusing entirely on providing gentle nourishment.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After you've shampooed your hair, gently work the conditioner into your mid-lengths and ends. Thoroughly rinse out and style as usual.. . The Sustainable Side: . Philip Kingsley bottles and tubes are created from either sugarcane bioplastic, made from a fully renewable origin, or post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR) created from single-use plastic that would otherwise end up in landfills. Philip Kingsley's innovative and eco-friendly packaging designs reduce landfill waste, plastic pollution and their overall pollution, greenhouse gas emissions and resources.. . Values: . Hypoallergenic. Vegan.. Fragrance-free, paraben-free, sulphate-free, MIT-free, colour-free.. .
