listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Body Building Maximizer Root Boosting Spray 125ml
listings.description: "Unveil instant body and lift with the Philip Kingsley Body Building Maximiser Spray, a heat-activated volumising spray that thickens and texturizes your tresses in seconds." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Body Building Spray: . Volumising hair protectant spray for fine, flat and flyaway-prone hair.. Offers instant root lift, while adding texture and body.. Controls flyaways and frizz for sleek, bouncy results.. Protects hair from UV damage and colour fade.. Features a cruelty-free formula.. . What You Need To Know: . If you're currently using Philip Kingsley's Body Building range, but you haven't tried the spray yet, your hair care routine is seriously missing out. The volumising Maximiser Spray complements the rest of the collection to add body and volume to fine, lightweight and limp hair, delivering residue-free texture to your roots. It does this using surface resins that add volume and hold, so your tresses are ready for styling. But the Body Building Root Boosting Spray goes a step further; the fine mist smooths and protects your hair to improve its overall condition using protein and conditioning agents, while polyamide UV protectors shield the hair from sun damage.. . Why It's Escentual: . If there's one thing we love here at Escentual, it's beauty products that do that little bit extra - and that's exactly what you get with the Philip Kingsley Body Building Spray. Its main benefit is adding instant lift and volume to your hair, completing your hair care routine with just a few spritzes. However, it does so much more than this as it also controls frizz and flyaways for sleek, glossy results, while also protecting your hair against damaging UV rays (yes, your hair needs protection from the sun, too!). The Root Boosting Spray can easily be introduced into your existing hair care routine without eating up too much of your time, thanks to its quick, fuss-free liquid spray format. And you can slip it into your travel bag just as easily too, thanks to its cap top, which guarantees salon-worthy volume and style wherever you are.. For optimal ease of use, the lightweight, pleasantly-scented Body Building mist can be used on dry hair for a volumising top-up between washes, but it really comes to life when it's used after your shampoo and conditioner due to its heat-activated nature.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your roots for lift or throughout your lengths before styling for overall volume. You can spray it onto damp or dry hair, but you'll see the best results when you gently blow dry your hair after.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Body Building Maximiser Spray uses planet-friendly bioplastic packaging that can be popped in the recycling once finished.. . Values: . SLS/SLES-free, sulphate-free, silicone-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Elasticizer Extreme Rich Deep-Conditioning Treatment 75ml
listings.description: "Get all the benefits of the award-winning Elasticizer and more in the super-charged Philip Kingsley Elasticizer Extreme Rich Deep-Conditioning Treatment, a pre-shampoo treatment for very dry, fragile and thirsty hair." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Elasticizer Extreme: . More potent version of the best-selling Elasticizer.. Hydrates, conditions and repairs damaged hair.. Strengthens and reduces breakage.. Adds weightless shine, gloss and bounce.. Ideal for dry, damaged, porous or curly hair.. Developed by world-leading trichologists.. Can be used as pre-shampoo treatment and overnight hair mask.. . What You Need To Know: . It's a more potent version of the iconic Elasticizer, the hair mask that sells one product every minute worldwide! It contains the same hero elastin ingredients but in higher doses to nourish over-worked and over-styled hair. It's a level up from the original, designed to bring naturally coarse, curly, and extremely dry hair back to life.. The multi-use pre-shampoo and hair mask promotes elasticity, minimises breakage and damage while locking in moisture and improving manageability. The scent-free formula has a slightly thicker texture than the original Elasticizer with a more potent amount of the hero-ingredient, hydrolyzed elastin; a flexible protein naturally found in the hair to strengthen each strand so that it breaks less. Castor oil, olive oil and glycerin are to thank for Elasticizer Extreme's hydrating qualities. Unlike other oils, castor and olive oil are emulsified oils that penetrate hair cuticles and deeply condition to rehydrate and improve shine, leaving your hair feeling brand new without feeling heavy or greasy.. . Why It's Escentual: . The original Elasticizer was created for Hollywood royalty; Philip Kingsley created the formula for Audrey Hepburn's hair because it was receiving regular colouring and styling on movie sets. With Elasticizer Extreme, even those with the most damaged or driest of hair can see the instantly bouncy, frizz-free results!. Elasticizer Extreme allows us to get salon-like results at home. Philip Kingsley use this trichologist-developed (specialists in issues like hair loss and the scalp) formula as part of the treatments clients receive in their award-winning clinics in London and New York.. . The Best Way To Use It: . For best results use the Elasticizer Extreme regularly; we recommend once a week as a minimum.. Use as a pre-shampoo by applying to thoroughly wet hair in sections. Use your fingertips to work it through the hair, cover with the included shower cap and leave for 10-20 minutes. Rinse well and follow with shampoo and conditioner (rinse twice if you have finer hair). Or, if you prefer, apply it before bed as an overnight mask, and wash it out in the morning.. Apply a generous amount to coarse, wavy, curly, and frizzy hair. If you notice the formula sinking in and disappearing, apply more until your hair feels slippery. The drier your hair is, the more Elasticizer Extreme it'll need.. Wait 72 hours after colouring/dying your hair before using the Elasticizer Extreme as it may affect how your colour takes.. . Cruelty-free.. Free from parabens, SLS and sulphates.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Flaky/Itchy Scalp Anti-Dandruff Shampoo 75ml
listings.description: "Relieve your scalp of flakes and irritation with the Philip Kingsley Flaky/Itchy Scalp Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, a soothing formula developed by trichologists." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Anti-Dandruff Shampoo: . Vegan shampoo for all hair types suffering with a flaky and itchy scalp.. Relieves your scalp of stubborn flakes and oil build-up.. Calms irritation and restores the natural microflora balance.. 100% of users found their scalp was soothed and comfortable after use.. Housed in an easy-to-use bottle created from 100% sugarcane plastic.. . What You Need To Know: . Developed by trichologists (hair specialists) in 1967 for Oscar-winning actor, Sir Laurence Olivier, the Itchy Scalp Anti-Dandruff Shampoo combines a luxurious texture with high-performance actives. The multi-award-winning Flaky Scalp Shampoo was developed with minimal ingredients to ensure it's mild enough for daily use, even on coloured hair. The ingredients lauryl betaine and piroctone olamine work together to gently cleanse your scalp, relieving flaking and itching without causing redness or irritation. In fact, 100% of users found their scalp was comfortable and soothed after use, while 99% found that their flaky scalp was cleared.. . Why It's Escentual: . Finding an anti-dandruff shampoo that doesn't dry out your hair can be a challenge. But thankfully, Phillip Kingsley are here to help; they've utilised 55 years of anti-dandruff research to create a nourishing gel texture that coats the hair for a shiny and manageable finish, all while combatting signs of dandruff. Not to forget, the subtle apple scent fills your senses for a refreshed cleansing experience - no harsh medical smells here.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Wash your scalp daily with the Flaky/Itchy Scalp Shampoo until your scalp is clear; after treatment, use it at regular intervals to prevent recurrence. For the best results, apply to wet hair and knead your scalp for 60 seconds to create a lather before rinsing thoroughly.. . The Sustainable Side: . Philip Kingsley bottles are made from 100% recyclable sugarcane bioplastic. The positive environmental impact doesn't stop there; manufactured within the UK, the brand has a negative carbon footprint, giving electricity back to communities.. . Values: . Vegan.. Paraben-free, SLS/SLES-free, gluten-free, silicone-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Elasticizer Deep-Conditioning Treatment 75ml
listings.description: "Nothing can reset over-styled and over-worked hair quite like the Philip Kingsley Elasticizer Deep-Conditioning Treatment; the award-winning hair mask has a nutrient-rich formula that helps combat breakage, leaving your tresses shiny, bouncy and healthy." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Elasticizer: . Adds elasticity, hydration and bounce to all hair types.. Developed by world-leading trichologists.. Can be used as pre-shampoo treatment and overnight mask.. Reduces breakage and frizz.. Adds weightless shine and gloss.. . What You Need To Know: . Philip Kingsley Elasticizer is the world's first pre-shampoo treatment and one sells across the world every minute. And, on the topic of time - the pre-shampoo gets to works in just three minutes! If you want stronger, healthier, and noticeably more nourished locks, there's nothing like it.. Originally created for Audrey Hepburn, to deep condition her damaged hair, Elasticizer is a rescue remedy for dry and dehydrated tresses. At the heart of the hard-working, scent-free formula lies hydrolyzed elastin, a flexible protein naturally found in the hair; this helps strengthen hair so that it breaks less. Castor oil and olive oil are to thank for Elasticizer's hydrating qualities. Unlike other oils, castor and olive oil are emulsified oils that penetrate and deeply condition to rehydrate and improve shine, leaving your feeling brand new without being heavy or greasy.. . Why It's Escentual: . Salon soft hair at home? What's not to love! Philip Kingsley use this trichologist-developed (specialists in issues like hair loss and the scalp) formula as part of the treatments clients receive in their award-winning clinics in London and New York; celebrities Cate Blanchett, Kate Winslet, Rochelle Humes and Georgia May Jagger are some of the treatment's fans.. Not only is Elasticizer the original hair mask, but it's also one of the best. Many other popular leave-in treatments weigh hair down, but the Elasticizer doesn't. As a pre-shampoo, the formula absorbs instantly, and any residue washes away to leave your hair silky soft.. . The Best Way To Use It: . For best results use the Elasticizer regularly; we recommend twice a week.. Use as a pre-shampoo by applying to thoroughly wet hair in sections. Work into your hair using your fingertips, cover with the included shower cap and leave for 10-20 minutes. Rinse well and follow with shampoo and conditioner. Or, if you prefer, apply before bed as an overnight mask, and wash out in the morning.. Apply a small amount of product to begin and add more if needed. If you notice the formula sinking in and disappearing, then apply more until your hair feels slippery. The drier your hair is, the more Elasticizer it'll need.. Wait 72 hours after colouring/dying your hair before using the Elasticizer as it may affect how your colour takes.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Elasticizer's packaging is fully recyclable, planet-friendly, and CO2 negative.. Values: . Cruelty-free.. Free from parabens, SLS and sulphates.. . Awards: . In the 45 years since it's creation, Elasticizer has won over 35 prestigious awards!. Including Best Nourishing Hair Treatment in Marie Claire Hair Awards 2021, Best Hair Product in QVC Beauty Excellence Awards and Vogue 100 Beauty Hall of Fame.. .

listings.rawTitle: Philip Kingsley Body Building Weightless Conditioner 75ml
listings.description: "Have you been looking for a way to boost your shorter-than-shoulder-length tresses? If the answer is '˜yes', the Philip Kingsley Body Building Weightless Conditioner might just be what you're looking for..." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Philip Kingsley Body Building Conditioner: . Thickening conditioner for short, fine and flat hair.. Adds moisture and volume without weighing your tresses down.. Controls flyaways and frizz for lasting smoothness and shine.. Utilises wheat protein to strengthen, volumise and plump hair strands.. Features a vegan, cruelty-free formula.. . What You Need To Know: . Philip Kinglsey's Vegan conditioner has been especially designed to promote thicker hair, volume and shine. Made for short, limp and fine tresses, the formula strengthens and volumises your tresses using the natural powers of wheat protein, while behentrimonium chloride helps to smooth cuticles, add glossiness and detangle your lengths. Fed up of uncontrollable flyaways? This conditioner will tame those too as it's laced with silicone to add shine and reduce static.. . Why It's Escentual: . It's fair to say that Team Escentual were really impressed by the Body Building Weightless Conditioner when we got to try it for ourselves. We love how it works to thicken the appearance of each individual strand, while controlling flyaways and frizz, so even the finest hair looks bouncy, smooth and shiny after use.. But what is it like to use? The ultra-lightweight conditioner has a silky liquid gel texture with a powdery aroma that makes the entire application process an absolute pleasure. It glides through your hair effortlessly - and as Philip Kinglsey are experts in haircare, you don't have to wait around for this conditioner to get to work; just a few seconds is all it takes. Once rinsed out, it leaves your tresses with enhanced volume, while it unveils a long-lasting sleek shininess right from the roots down to the tips. But don't worry if you've used thickening hair care before and it's left your hair feeling a little dry and lacklustre; yes, Philip Kinglsey's conditioner offers volume, but it also ensures that your hair gets a healthy dose of hydration too, helping to control flyaways and frizz while detangling knots.. . The Best Way To Use It: . After shampooing, gently work the Body Building Conditioner from the mid-lengths to the ends of your hair. Rinse well and follow up with your favourite Philip Kingsley Scalp Toner.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Body Building Weightless Conditioner is held in planet-friendly bioplastic packaging; simply rinse out the tube once you've used the conditioner up and then pop it in the recycling.. . Values: . Vegan.. Paraben-free, SLS/SLES-free, sulphate-free, cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Rose Perfecto Liquid Lip Balm 6ml / 110 - Milky Nude / Batch 4L01
listings.description: "Drench your lips in hydration and a stunning array of colours with the GIVENCHY Le Rose Perfecto Liquid Balm. Its impressive pigment and creamy texture brings together the best bits of a lipstick and a balm in one comfortable formula." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The GIVENCHY Le Rose Liquid Balm: . Glossy pigmented liquid lip balm.. Boasts a creamy, non-sticky texture.. Offers up to 24 hours' hydration.. Available in a gorgeous array of glossy shades.. Shades 001 and 011 are pH-reactive for made-to-measure results.. Enriched with shea butter and hyaluronic acid to plump and hydrate.. Features a luxurious marbled design with pink leather-look accents.. . Why It's Escentual: . GIVENCHY's Le Rose Liquid Balm is a piece of makeup history: it's the first-ever couture marbled liquid lip balm. And frankly, it's a makeup lover's dream. You don't have to compromise on colour or comfort - each balm is pigmented, but they still feel really smooth and creamy on the lips, keeping your lips hydrated all day long.. The Le Rose Perfecto Liquid Balm features a 97% skincare formula, including hyaluronic acid to add a deep layer of hydration to help plump the lips and keep them soft. Pink pepper extract continues to nourish your pout as it protects against the effects of dehydration, while shea butter soothes and moisturises the skin as vitamin C energises and volumises your lips for a plump pop of colour. The glossy finish isn't high-shine; it's more like a glossy satin finish that beautifies your natural skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Smooth onto your lips when they feel dry or you want to add colour. The formula works well underneath a gloss if you love a high shine glossy finish.. . The Sustainable Side: . The design features an innovative vegan cactus-based case. Le Rose Perfecto is also the first GIVENCHY liquid balm to be housed within a glass bottle.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Irresistible Hair Mist 35ml

The Best Way To Use It: . Hold GIVENCHY's perfumed hair mist 30cm away from your hair and spritz, focusing on the mid-lengths of your hair. The outer carton is made from responsible sources and fully recyclable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent NU Blotting Lotion 25ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent NU Glow in Balm 40ml

Prepare your skin for the rest of your makeup routine with the YSL NU Glow in Balm by blending it into your skin using your fingertips. Alternatively, to enhance your NU Bare Look Tint, add a touch of the Glow in Balm to the formula for a glowy finish. You can also use the primer as a highlighter by dabbing it onto the high points of your face.. .

listings.rawTitle: Avene Very High Protection Cream SPF50+ 50ml
listings.description: "Keep your dry, sensitive skin protected and hydrated for up to 8 hours with the Avene Very High Protection Cream SPF50+, a soothing formula infused with Thermal Spring Water for a comfortable finish." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Infused with Avene's iconic Thermal Spring Water for a soft, comfortable finish.. Utilises ocean-friendly sun filters to respect marine biodiversity.. Thick, velvety texture with an invisible finish on skin.. Non-comedogenic (doesn't block pores).. . What You Need To Know: . For over 30 years, Avene has been committed to offering the best photoprotection for sensitive skin to preserve skin health.. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent NU Bare Look Tint 30ml / NU 1
listings.description: "The Yves Saint Laurent NU Bare Look Tint is the perfect blend between skincare and makeup; it offers lightweight buildable coverage and 24 hours of skin hydration." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The YSL NU Bare Look Tint: . Buildable lightweight foundation for an effortlessly natural makeup look.. 97% agree the tint provides a smooth, even finish.. Provides 24 hours' hydration, thanks to its 90% skincare base.. Creates a dewy, comfortable finish for up to 12 hours.. Available in a wide range of flexible shades.. . Why It's Escentual: . The NU Bare Look Skin Tint combines the active ingredients you'd expect from your skincare with the buildable coverage you'd expect from your foundation. Developed with a 90% skincare base, the YSL Bare Look Skin Tint utilises plant-based glycerin and hyaluronic acid to achieve deeply moisturised and hydrated skin. Marsh mallow flower, sourced from the YSL Ourika Community Gardens, has also been added to the mix to soothe your complexion for a comfortable, glowy finish. The YSL Bare Look Tint's flexible, multi-tasking formula allows you to get more from your makeup as it leaves your skin looking radiant and dewy for up to 12 hours.. Part of the NU Yves Saint Laurent range, the Bare Look Tint works to enhance your skin without hiding your signature. Designed in 20 light-to-medium coverage shades, the buildable colours use super-fine pigments to allow your skin to shine through, so everyone can enjoy a natural-looking tinted glow. In fact, 97% of users said that the Bare Look Tint created an instantly smooth and even finish. Plus the formula has been allergy tested under dermatological control, so even the most sensitive complexions can enjoy a bare skin-like look.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the NU Bare Look Tint with either your fingers or a brush for targeted application. For a lighter coverage, apply a small layer to the skin; alternatively, for medium coverage, continue building layers until you reach your desired result.. .

Bergamote Calabria is housed in a recyclable box. The fragrance is also refillable, so you can keep your original bottle for longer.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Longevity Cream 50ml
listings.description: The new Longevity Cream is the first Guerlain age-defying skincare that revives cell longevity at its root to visibly master youth each day.. The culmination of twenty years’ research, Guerlain has captured the exceptional power of longevity of an orchid: Vanda coerulea. Capable of living for over one hundred years, it is known as the “flower of ten thousand generations”. Its vital force has been concentrated in the new patent filed ORCHID LONGEVITY technology.. For the first time, Guerlain has demonstrated the ability of this age-defying concentrate to revive youth connections within skin cells, at the roots of 9 longevity pathways. Cell vitality augments by 196%, encouraging high regeneration of the components of youthful skin, from the first applications.. How To Use . 1. SHAPE: Hands crossed, drain the jawline with your thumbs through firm yet fluid motions, promoting radiance and sculpting contours. 2. LIFT: Perform upward, energizing strokes, to lift the cheeks and mouth area. This helps smooth wrinkles and reveal your natural glow. 3. SMOOTH: With alternate uplifting movements, awaken the gaze and smooth crow’s feet lines. 4. STRETCH: Energize facial muscles with opposite strokes, to help improve the oval of the face..

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne Spray 50ml
listings.description: "A vibrant aromatic experience for the senses, Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne feels both modern yet classic as it explores layers of gentle spice, wood and musk." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B.: . Aromatic combination of natural scents for a fresh, comforting feel.. Explores woody and musky tones without being overpowering.. Long-lasting Eau de Cologne format.. Reinvents the original Colonia C.L.U.B scent.. Housed in the iconic Acqua di Parma flacon with dark green details.. . What Does Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Smell Like? . A fresh, light scent with a rich base for added depth, Colonia C.L.U.B. opens with vibrant bergamot and lemon for a brief breath of citrus. The citrus pairs perfectly with aromatic pink and black pepper, which uplift the fragrance heart of rosemary and shiso, adding an aromatic flare and continuing the natural outdoors feel. The base of cedarwood adds depth and a more traditionally masculine feel as it's paired with musk to round off this comforting Eau de Cologne.. Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon, Pink Pepper, Black Pepper. Heart notes are Rosemary, Shisho. Base notes are Cedarwood, Musk. . . Why It's Escentual: . The initially light, fresh citrus and aromatic tones keep Acqua di Parma's entire fragrance bright and refreshing throughout, while lingering hints of wood and musk create a long-lasting scent that is the height of sophistication. The cedarwood and rosemary notes feel especially comforting, creating an instantly relaxed feeling as you grace through life with Colonia C.L.U.B. left in your wake.. Inspired by the joy of making memories with friends and embracing your community, Colonia C.L.U.B. is a full-bodied, well-balanced fragrance. Acqua di Parma take traditionally masculine woods and musk and add an intriguing layer of citrus and aromatic spice, taking you on a scent journey that is lively and exciting before grounding your senses with Colonia C.L.U.B.'s musk-woody base.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your neck, wrists and inner elbows for a long-lasting scent.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Micro-Lift Concentrate Serum 30ml
listings.description: The ultimate alchemy of technology and nature, the Micro-Lift Concentrate combines the latest-generation microencapsulation with the extraordinary power of the orchid's longevity. It's high naturally derived ingredient formula with 7,000 micro-sculptors works like a series of micro-lifts on the skin. It has a visible lifting effect, enveloping the skin in intense comfort. 95% of women find that their skin appears lifted. At the heart of this age-defying formula lie, 7,000 skin micro-sculptors combined with the revitalizing power of millions of orchid molecules. This serum offers a long-lasting lifting effect and visibly improves the signs of ageing.. Composed of 92% naturally derived ingredients, this formula merges with the skin and envelops it in a tightening yet comfortable mesh. The skin is instantly firmed. Day after day, it appears superbly sculpted: the contours of the face are more defined. To optimize the results of the new Micro-Lift Concentrate, try the new Lifting Facial Sculpt inspired by professional sculpting techniques developed by Guerlain Spas & Institutes. . How To Use . Gently warm up the facial muscles with a rapid sweeping action using both hands . Intense Lifting Pinch: Pinch the skin between the thumb and index finger . Energetic Lifting Fist Bump: With both hands simultaneously, your fists on your cheeks. . Lifting Muscle Stretch: Sweep slowly with both hands in contact with the skin from palm to the wrist .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Light The Sun-Kissed Healthy Glow Bronzer Powder 10g / 00 - Light Cool
listings.description: "Blush meets bronzer in the GUERLAIN Terracotta Light Powder, which creates a mesmerising finish that marries flushed cheeks with a sun-kissed glow that shimmers and glistens all day long." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Terracotta Light Powder: . Part of the iconic Terracotta collection.. Creates a soft sun-kissed glow that looks healthy and natural.. 96% natural powder that is translucent and lightweight.. Hydrates the skin using natural origin Moroccan flower honey.. Features a mosaic of matte, blush, bronze and luminescent hues.. Available in three shade intensities: light, medium and deep, each split into warm and cool tones.. . Why It's Escentual: . GUERLAIN's Terracotta Light Healthy Glow Powder is made for anyone who loves a summer glow all year round. The ultra-sheer, light and silky texture is what makes this powder feel extremely premium, especially as it doesn't feel drying like some powders can. For us, the finish is where the powder truly shines; it creates the softest sun-kissed look with a delicate glistening effect, giving your complexion a glowing and contoured finish. It basically does the job of a bronzer, blush and soft highlighter in one.. The Terracotta Light The Sun-Kissed Healthy Glow Powder has everything fans love from the Terracotta collection; its iconic mirror compact, distinct honeyed floral scent and, of course, a sun-kissed finish! Die-hard fans of the collection will also be happy to see the original mosaic camo design has returned.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Swirl your brush in the powder and apply over the raised points of your face - the cheekbones, bridge of the nose and forehead.. . The Sustainable Side: . The powder is held in a recyclable box; you can also reuse the compact as a portable mirror once you've finished the powder.. .

The dermatologist-tested and hypoallergenic formula is suitable for even the most sensitive skin, so everyone can benefit from a little relief during the menopause. Why You'll Love Chloe Nomade Jasmin Naturel: . Delicate gourmand fragrance with creamy jasmine and vanilla tones.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum with a subtle presence.. A 2022 flanker to Chloe Nomade.. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Mascara Extreme Volume Lash Clash Noir Black
listings.description: "Achieve lifted, high impact lashes for up to 24 hours with the Yves Saint Laurent Mascara Extreme Volume Lash Clash, a lash-caring formula that delivers 200%+ more volume." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Lash Clash is Yves Saint Laurent's thickest formula yet! The rich, creamy design coats the lashes with an innovative wax-in-oil formula, building lash volume by up to 200%+ for an oversized, false lash look for up to 24 hours. As an added bonus, the lash-caring formula is enriched with iris florentina extract sourced from YSL Beauty's Ourika Community Gardens, so that you can enjoy an impactful eye look whilst nourishing your lashes.. Housed within a sleek, black tube that's wrapped with the iconic YSL logo, Extreme Volume is a luxurious designer accessory in its own right. The innovative double conical brush is so good, YSL have applied to patent it; the wand coats the lashes with a rich couture black finish for volumised, fuller lashes that last.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Volumising to the max! Achieve extreme lashes using five steps:. 1. SWEEP: Start applying the mascara at the root of the lash and sweep the wand upwards, separating your lashes as you go.. 2. LIFT: Apply the second layer by holding the mascara at the root of the lashes; wiggle the mascara brush and lift to your lash tip.. 3. ZIG-ZAG UP: For the third coat, apply to your lashes and zig-zag upwards.. 4. ZAG-ZAG DOWN: For the fourth coat, apply on top of your lashes and sweep the mascara wand upwards for massive impact.. 5. FLICK: Flick the brush through the lashes to separate each lash. On the inner and bottom lashes, use just the tip of the brush.. .

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "A powerful combination of woody and fruity, Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum takes you on a sensory journey to arrive at a modern magnetic scent laced with captivating earthy tones." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum: . Modern woody scent with a fruity aromatic twist.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum format.. Flanker to the original Montblanc Legend fragrance.. A fruity-fresh opening of blood orange and zesty grapefruit meets the spice of cardamom in the opening notes. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: ''Immerse yourself in nature with FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Toilette, a light yet sensual floral fragrance that blends citrus, powder and musk for an elegant aroma that's sure to entice.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Toilette: . A subtle, light floral fragrance.. Lasts two to three hours for understated elegance.. A delicate addition to the KENZO FLOWER collection.. Enclosed in an eye-catching glass bottle that honours the poppy.. . What Does FLOWER BY KENZO Smell Like? . Initially hit with a burst of Sicilian lemon, the fragrance cleverly plays with fruity and floral facets as the likes of hand-picked Bulgarian rose blends into a powdery violet heart. The base notes melt into the skin and leave behind a trail of white musk with hints of warm vanilla for a sultry finish.. Top notes are Sicilian Lemon, Acacia Farnesiana, Bulgarian Rose, May Blossom, Rose Heart note is Parme Violet Base notes are Vanilla, White Musk . . Why it's Escentual: . If you're already a Kenzo fan, then this Eau de Toilette is the ideal switch for summer. It has a lighter, citrus tone that is cleverly nuanced by a stunning rose note, which is hand-picked in the Bulgarian valleys. We love the sensuality and voluptuousness created by the base notes of white musk and vanilla. And of course, we love the way that Alberto Morillas' fragrance pays homage to the poppy with its luxury glass bottle adorned with a sun-drenched image of the flower. As this scent was inspired by nature, it's only right that it's eco-friendly, thanks to its recyclable packaging.. . The Best Way To Use It: . To get the most out of this fragrance, spray FLOWER BY KENZO directly onto your pulse points - especially the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . Kenzo's glass bottle and outer box are recyclable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Tabac Scented Candle 220g

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Bronzer 8.5g / 00 - Light Cool
listings.description: "Seamlessly blending into the skin for an effortless sun-kissed glow, the GUERLAIN Terracotta Bronzer is an absolute icon in the beauty world due to the way it recreates a true-to-skin bronzed finish in just one quick sweep." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Terracotta Bronzer: . Pressed powder bronzer that creates a true-to-skin, natural-looking radiance.. Features naturally-derived pigments and reflective particles for a lasting glow.. Infused with Moroccan argan oil to nourish the skin for a smooth, comfortable application.. Features 96% naturally-derived ingredients following a 2021 formula update.. Available in a range of shades and undertones to suit all skin tones.. Laced with the fan-favourite Terracotta aroma of ylang-ylang, orange blossom, tonka bean, vanilla and musk.. Held in a sleek compact, which includes a mirror for easy application.. . . Why It's Escentual: . A reformulation of the iconic GUERLAIN bronzer, Terracotta is packed with more natural ingredients than ever; the 96% natural formula not only respects the natural world, but also nourishes the skin whilst providing a beautiful, healthy bronzed glow. Fusing with the skin to ensure a skin-perfecting finish, the legendary bronzer offers a long-lasting sun-kissed look without drying out the complexion.. Reflecting the fact that GUERLAIN have over 40 years of experience in bronzers - yes, Terracotta first graced the beauty world all the way back in 1984 - everything about this bronzer is luxurious, including the satisfying click of the compact once you've finished applying. As an added bonus, the sleek design is ideal for travel as the large mirror makes touch-ups quick and easy.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the GUERLAIN bronzer using a fluffy brush to the areas where the sun would naturally hit. GUERLAIN's top tip is to apply the bronzing powder by drawing a figure of "3" on each side of your face, sweeping your brush from the forehead to the cheekbones, and then from the cheekbones to the chin before finishing with a stroke down the neck.. . The Sustainable Side: . Held in a recyclable outer carton.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Samsara Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the serene sensuality of the Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette.. Inspired by the bond between East and West, Samsara denotes many voyages of discovery. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Narcissus, Rose, Iris. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Amber.

He had to measure every drop to achieve the perfect harmony, to arouse unprecedented and unforgettable sensations through the power of scent.. In this combination of the chypre sensuality and the intimate facet of musk, with the bouquet of f lowers, the declaration of love symbol, he manages to express the sensuous and romantic idea of the idyll.. This fragrance merited a masterpiece.. Ora Ito, the iconoclast, designed for Idylle a tear of joy and feminine hapiness, a love drop, a golden drop.. Fragrance Description. . "I imagined for IDYLLE a bouquet of fresh and joyous flowers, symbol of love: lily of the valley, lilac, freesia, peony, jasmine and a sublimated raw material, the blend of bulgarian roses, married with the chypre sensuality."Thierry Wasser, Parfumeur Guerlain.. Perfumer's Secrets. . The bulgarian roses blend is the keystone of the Idylle fragrance, and a Guerlain characteristic.. These roses have been selected and gathered one by one by Jean-Paul Guerlain and Thierry Wasser.. The rose blend is the secret of an exceptionnal quality year after year and of a unique and inimitable Guerlain signature..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia is a sophisticated sexy duet of powdery palma violets and pure musk." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia: . Powdery chypre perfume for women.. Blends violet facets with illuminating white florals.. Part of the nature-inspired collection, Aqua Allegoria.. Ideal for layering alongside other Aqua Allegoria scents.. Housed in a clear glass bottle decorated with a golden honeycomb design.. . What Does GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Smell Like? . Flora Salvaggia opens with a wildflower facet that's reminiscent of soft, powdery iris and violet, refreshed by a slice of fresh watermelon. The heady white floral heart of jasmine and orange blossom adds to the bouquet in the opening before the fragrance fades into a clean and sensual white musk, which rounds off the Eau de Toilette's powdery and comforting quality.. Top notes are Violet, Watermelon, Wildflower Accord. Heart notes are Jasmine, Orange Blossom. Base note is White Musk. . Why It's Escentual: . Just like the other fragrances in the Aqua Allegoria collection, Flora Salvaggia has an aquatic tone that runs throughout every level of the fragrance. Inspired by expanses of fresh wildflowers, Flora Salvaggia sets a vivid water-drenched landscape of florals against a cosy musk backdrop, creating a sophisticated yet sexy feel. The Aqua Allegoria collection's aquatic tone mixed with up to 95% raw natural ingredients means that the fragrances are also perfect for layering with each other; our favourite layering combination with Flora Salvaggia has to be Bergamotte Calabria and Rosa Rossa.. In keeping with the rest of the Aqua Allegoria fragrances, Flora Salvaggia is housed in the collection's signature bee-inspired design. The clear lilac liquid is housed in a weighty glass flacon decorated with a golden top emblazoned with GUERLAIN's bee insignia. The golden honeycomb pattern that is draped around the bottle neck reminds you of its affinity with nature and GUERLAIN's commitment to improving the planet by offering a refillable fragrance.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray onto your pulse points - the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . The French beetroot alcohol used in GUERLAIN's Flora Salvaggia comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and there are refills available for Flora Salvaggia.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "Drench yourself in sun-kissed freshness with the GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole Eau de Toilette, a deliciously cool floral fragrance for women." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Aqua Allegoria Nettare di Sole: . Luminous fresh-floral fragrance for women.. Part of the collectable Aqua Allegoria range.. Ideal for layering with Aqua Allegoria fragrances.. Luxurious golden honeycomb-inspired flacon.. . What Does GUERLAIN Nettare di Sole Smell Like? . Part of the iconic GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria collection, Nettare di Sole mirrors the sophisticated signatures that run throughout the existing line to similarly reveal the beauty of nature. Nettare Di Sole opens with refreshing aquatic notes that feel like a gentle breeze on your skin, while bergamot brings an exquisite citrus green floral freshness to the aroma. The heart warms into a unique honey accord that's enhanced by flowers like rose, magnolia and jasmine to create a scent that feels like sweet, sticky honey drizzled over precious petals. Finally, the sensual earthy-woody facets of musk reveal themselves on your skin as the fragrance mellows.. Top notes are Aquatic Notes, Bergamot. Heart note is Floral Honey Accord. Base note is Musk. . Why it's Escentual: . Crafted by GUERLAIN master perfumer, Thierry Wasser, in collaboration with Delphine Jelk, this fresh-floral Eau de Toilette was inspired by the raw potential and fine ingredients nature has to offer. The ongoing Aqua Allegoria line pays homage to Thierry Wasser's personal experiences with nature - and if you're a fan of the collection, you can't miss this indulgent addition. The sun-kissed aroma exudes an overwhelming sense of freshness that makes it perfect for daytime wear, while the underlying honey facet will leave you wanting more as the day slips by.. Although we could talk about the scent all day long, we have to mention the bottle. The golden elixir is housed in a weighted glass flacon that simply oozes luxury; it's topped with a shining honeycomb collar and adorned with a ball cap that's stamped with GUERLAIN's honey bee emblem - this not only nods to the brand's black bee honey which laces many of their skincare products, but it also hints at the scent within the flacon. All in all, the beautifully opulent bottle would be a prized possession in any fragrance collection - especially if that collection is already jam-packed with Aqua Allegoria perfumes!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz GUERLAIN Nettare Di Sole onto the pulse points for prolonged wear.. .

Tiffany Rose Gold is a delicious rose scent that's enhanced by juicy blackcurrants, creating a jammy rose aroma with hints of musk. The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Tiffany & Co Rose Gold directly onto your pulse points - namely, the neck and wrists.. .

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Infinite Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Beguiling freshness and intoxicating woody notes make HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled Infinite Eau de Parfum an unusual but striking fragrance - it's a total pleasure to wear and smell on those closest to you." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled Infinite: . Refreshing and powerfully modern, Boss Bottled Infinite is cool and comforting.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Part of the sophisticated Boss Bottled range.. Iconic HUGO BOSS glass bottle with deep blue tones and a gunmetal top.. . What Does Boss Bottled Infinite Smell Like? . Combining bright, crisp mandarin and apple top notes with a touch of spice, Infinite then descends into a natural heart of rosemary, lavender and patchouli for a relaxing centre that's comfortable to wear. The rich woody base notes of olivewood and sandalwood are lifted by the fresh top notes to create an overall light but still intoxicatingly warm and woody fragrance.. Top notes are Apple, Mandarin, Cinnamon, Sage. Heart notes are Patchouli, Rosemary, Lavender. Base notes are Olivewood, Sandalwood. . . Why It's Escentual: . Boss Bottled Infinite is suave confidence in a bottle; all without being overbearing, the woody base keeps the fragrance grounded with a sense of down-to-earth sophistication. To a passer-by, the Eau de Parfum maintains a cool freshness but when inhaled deeply by the wearer or those closest, the tantalising warm woody tones and comforting lavender facet relax the senses.. The perfect balance of bright and light notes with earthy tones reflect the modern man, how he balances his passions and makes memories in the process.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray Boss Bottled Infinite onto the neck, chest and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . Created with less plastic, the glass bottle and outer cardboard packaging are recyclable.. . Selling through old packaging for 50ml. New packaging for 100ml and 200ml..

listings.rawTitle: bareMinerals Mineralist Lasting Eyeliner 0.35g / Aquamarine
listings.description: ''Achieve bold, rich and long-lasting colour for up to 12 hours with the bareMinerals Mineralist Lasting Eyeliner.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the bareMinerals Mineralist Eyeliner: . Rich, mineral-based eyeliner in pearl and matte finishes.. 12 hours of long-lasting high-pigment colour.. Soothes and nourishes with avocado oil and aloe vera.. Retractable design for mess-free, precise application.. Vegan.. . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we love the versatility of this eyeliner; whatever your personal preference or skin tone, you're bound to find your perfect match with bareMinerals' vast array of pearlescent and matte finishes. The collection features everything from sparkling reds to a traditional black liner, all of which set on the lids for long-lasting impactful colour for up to 12 hours. The Mineralist eyeliner has a unique creamy liner texture that effortlessly glides across the lids without dragging, skipping or tugging, so you can easily achieve a detailed eye look.. The dermatologist and ophthalmologist-tested formula is enriched with softening avocado oil and soothing aloe vera, while it's gentle on even the most sensitive skin and suitable for contact lens wearers.. Whether you use one shade or blend your favourite colours together, the waterproof, transfer-free and smudge-free liner will take your eye look straight from the day into the night.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the bareMinerals Lasting Eyeliner along your upper lash line, starting from the corner and working your way outward, extending just past the outer corner. If you're looking for a defined winged liner, bring the liner towards the edge of your liner.. For a smoky look, draw a thick line along your upper lash line, staying as close to lashes as possible. Diffuse the line and smoke out the edges using a small, tapered brush to blend outward. Repeat on the lower lash line.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Mineralist Eyeliner is housed within a tube that uses 15% less plastic than previous bareMinerals eyeliner designs.. . Values: . Dermatologist-tested, ophthalmologist-tested, vegan.. Fragrance-free, paraben-free, silicone-free, sulfate-free, talc-free, SLS-free, PEG-free, gluten-free, tree nut-free.. .

Diffuse the line and smoke out the edges using a small, tapered brush to blend outward. Repeat on the lower lash line.. . The Sustainable Side: . listings.rawTitle: Valentino Voce Viva Intensa Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "A sensuous and intoxicating vanilla-floral explosion, Valentino Voce Viva Intensa has me hooked throughout each and every twist and turn of its aroma." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Valentino Voce Viva Intensa: . A sensual white floral fragrance enhanced by a touch of vanilla and moss.. Intense, long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Powerful take on the original Valentino Voce Viva fragrance.. Housed in an intricate square bottle featuring the iconic Valentino rockstud.. . What Does Valentino Voce Viva Intensa Smell Like? . The Valentino Voce Viva Intensa Eau de Parfum is an intriguing blend of smoky vanilla bourbon, sweet floral facets and earthy moss. Opening with a vibrant blend of zesty Italian bergamot and juicy mandarin, the fragrance develops into an opulent orange blossom heart that's intensified by a heady jasmine facet. Finally, the perfume reveals a dark, enveloping vanilla note and an unusual, addictive moss accord to round off the fragrance.. Top notes are Italian Bergamot, Mandarin Accord. Heart notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine Absolute. Base notes are Vanilla Bourbon, Crystal Moss Accord. . Why It's Escentual: . If you love vanilla scents but you want something a tad deeper, richer and more sophisticated, Valentino Voce Viva Intensa is the one for you! The fragrance smells just how you would predict based on its glamorous bottle - timelessly classic but with an edgy, chic twist. As a nod to the brand, the bottle features the iconic signature rockstuds that will make any Valentino fan's heart swoon.. And it's not just the bottle that will make Valentino enthusiasts smile. The contrast between the bold smoky elements and rich floral notes is truly alluring; it's no surprise the perfume is inspired by the voice of a powerful woman. There is a feeling of confidence, Italian prestige and glamour exuded with every spray, showcasing Valentino's celebration of feminine strength.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your pulse points, particularly the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . The cardboard box is recyclable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons The Excelsior Bouquet Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''Take to the skies with Atkinsons The Excelsior Bouquet, a breathtakingly fresh fragrance for men that's been crafted to honour the first-ever non-stop flight over the Atlantic.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love The Excelsior Bouquet: . Aromatic fragrance with a bold leather tone.. Long-lasting Eau de Toilette.. Niche fragrance for men.. Part of Atkinsons' The Legendary Collection.. Weighted clear glass bottle that allows you to see the ever-so-subtly tinted scent within.. . What Does The Excelsior Bouquet Eau de Toilette Smell Like? . With a high-spirited blend of flint, sage and spice, Excelsior is a scent that takes you to new heights. It's the fragrance of cold air on metal, the heat of the cockpit, leathery aviator jackets - and it recalls the rush of adrenaline you feel as the airplane climbs up and up, just as your stomach drops.. But let's give you a closer look at this clever niche perfume. The fragrance takes off with citrus-aromatic grapefruit, steel-like flint and the fresh, chilled-metal tones of aldehyde. It continues its ascent with the floral and herbaceous nuances of knife-cold sage, which contrasts with the intensely spicy heat of nutmeg, cardamom and sichuan pepper. Finally, the scent glides through serene skies as vetiver and balsamic incense pairs with smoked leather, set against a quietly sexy backdrop of ambery, almond-like tonka bean.. Top notes are Grapefruit, Flint Accord, Aldehydes. Heart notes are Sage, Nutmeg, Cardamom, Sichuan Pepper. Base notes are Vetiver, Incense, Tonka Beans, Leather Accord. . Why it's Escentual: . Atkinsons' The Excelsior Bouquet is not merely a fragrance: it's the sensation of freedom and the thrill of immense open skies. We think this fresh, aromatic scent is perfect for the modern-day adventurer, who wants an exciting fragrance that captures the exhilaration, danger and heroism of the first-ever non-stop flight over the Atlantic. Accomplished in June 1919 by Englishmen John William Alcock and Arthur Whitten Brown, this key moment in modern history is honoured in every last detail of this scent - from the show-stopping 'fresh air' feeling of the start, to the iconic and utterly tangible scent of an aviator jacket lined with fur. We particularly love the heart as it cleverly unites two opposing tones; cool sage with a trio of hot facets, which we think represents the juxtaposition between the icy metal of the plane's exterior and the cosy heat of the cockpit. Overall, Benoist Lapouza's scent has a classically masculine fougere feel to it, but it's adventurously reinterpreted with flint-like coldness, sage, and vetiver, resulting in a timeless piece that soars into the 21st century with style and grace.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz The Excelsior Bouquet directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons The Other Side Of Oud Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''Atkinsons The Other Side Of Oud is an undeniably warm, seriously spiced and utterly seductive Eau de Parfum that demands the attention of both the wearer and those around them.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons The Other Side Of Oud: . Oriental fragrance that's powered by oud, but has a strong spiced tone.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Niche fragrance for all genders.. Part of Atkinsons' The Oud Collection.. Weighted glass bottle encased in a reflective gold hue.. . What Does The Other Side Of Oud Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . From the very first spritz, The Other Side Of Oud is a slice of hot ginger cake in the middle of winter. It's warm, deliciously spiced and is somehow a little moreish as cinnamon, fresh cardamom and juicy ginger unite. The heart allows oud to take centre stage - as you'd guess from both the name of the perfume and the collection it belongs to. Here, perfumers Maurice Roucel and Pierre Guéros explore oud's unexpected side, showcasing the contrast between the roasted and fresh facets of oud. This is paired with a bouquet of geranium and coffee flowers before vibrant and gourmand roasted coffee, sensual vanilla and smoked incense round off this clever composition.. Top notes are Cinnamon, Cardamom, Ginger. Heart notes are Oud, Geranium, Coffee Flowers. Base notes are Roasted Coffee, Smoked Incense, Vanilla Absolu. . . Why it's Escentual: . Powerfully evocative, The Other Side Of Oud is an epic fragrance that recalls an intrepid leap into a wondrous era, masterfully combining the classic woody notes of oud with modern, exciting elements to create a new and striking scent. The Other Side of Oud is as magnetic and captivating as the prince who inspired it: Hussein Bin Ali, Sharif Of Mecca. Envisioning a single, independent Arab State, Prince Hussain visited King George V in the early 20th century with the aim of earning British political recognition of the Arab state. Following negotiations, Prince Hussein accepted King George V's request to aid Britain in the war against Turkey in return for the recognition he desired. Before his return to Amman, Prince Hussein visited Atkinsons House, where he was hypnotised by the rich nuances of scents and looking to celebrate the pact from which an Independent Arab State would be born, so he commissioned a new fragrance to symbolise the new-found union between the Middle East and Europe. The Prince's conditions were clear: the fragrance should be modern and intriguing but still preserve a distinct heart of oud, which is a precious material in the Middle East. This vision is the inspiration behind Atkinsons' 2019 The Other Side Of Oud - and we love the way that this scent honours Prince Hussein's original commission. It's modern and yet still pays homage to traditional perfumery.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz The Other Side Of Oud directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons 44 Gerrard Street Eau de Cologne Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''Powered by impressive innovations within the world of perfume, 44 Gerrard Street is a unisex Eau de Cologne that true fans of Atkinsons' premium niche fragrances will love: it's been created to honour the location of Atkinsons' very first store.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons 44 Gerrard Street: . Citrus fragrance with woody and floral facets.. Long-lasting Eau de Cologne.. Niche fragrance for all genders.. Part of Atkinsons' The Emblematic Collection.. Weighted matte orange bottle with midnight-black detailing.. . What Does 44 Gerrard Street Eau de Cologne Smell Like? . The fragrance opens with an unconventional blend of invigorating eucalyptus, tart lemon and subtly spiced ginger for an instantly fresh, bright and invigorating mood. This then gives way to a flowery heart of refined jasmine, orchid and delicate rose before the cosy, sensual base of amber and wood warm on your skin.. Top notes are Lime, Eucalyptus, Ginger. Heart notes are Rose, Jasmine, Orchid. Base notes are Woody Notes, Amber. . . Why it's Escentual: . Atkinsons' charming Eau de Cologne celebrates the location of Atkinsons' first store, 44 Gerrard Street. It's a fresh and yet still sophisticated unisex fragrance that revises the classic cologne recipe for something that feels a little bit more modern. We love that it perfectly embodies Atkinsons' ongoing efforts to create sustainable and environmentally-responsible products. For example, the extraction of 44 Gerrard Street's fine ingredients relies on MANE's "Jungle Essence ''; this is a breakthrough in extraction technology that's environmentally-friendly, but still captures the pure essence of natural raw materials before they're recreated at industrial production levels.. And as the fragrance respects the natural environment, it seems only right that the scent itself is a celebration of the world around us. The perfume is a clever yet unconventional blend of aromatic, woody eucalyptus, fresh almost-green lemon and spicy ginger essential oil, while the bright, refined heart is like a stroll through an exuberant flower garden.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Gerrard Street directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons The Joss Flower Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ‘’Take a step into the past with The Joss Flower, a unisex Eau de Parfum designed to honour Atkinsons' history. It's a concoction of subtle spices thrown over a sweet, heady heart of rich florals and sticky fruit with a warm, rich base.’’ - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you’ll love The Joss Flower: . Floral fragrance with a spicy, peachy and ambery twist.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Niche fragrance for all genders.. Weighted flacon with a stunning gold and purple design.. . What Does The Joss Flower Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Atkinsons' fragrance opens with a sprinkling of fresh and spicy pink pepper, which gives way to a heart of rich, floral ylang-ylang, sweet, nectarous peach and intoxicatingly white floral gardenia before a dry down of Indonesian patchouli, warm amber and soft and alluring sandalwood adds an opulent, sensual flourish to this unisex fragrance.. Top note is Pink Pepper. Heart notes are Yang-ylang, Peach, Gardenia. Base notes are Indonesian Patchouli, Amber, Sandalwood. . Why it’s Escentual: . Created by master perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie, The Joss Flower by Atkinsons is an exclusive edition created to celebrate 200 years of London's Burlington Arcade, which first opened on 20 March 1819. This beautiful vintage location is currently home to Atkinsons' flagship store; and the scent is as opulent and aristocratic as you'd hope it to be. It pays homage to the politician who commissioned the building of the arcade, Lord George Cavendish, who wanted the arcade to give employment to women, although only six of the original leaseholders were female, so even male milliners and corset-makers were referred to as "Madame".. We love how this scent celebrates the rich history of Atkinsons; even the box tells the story of the brand as you peel back the exterior to reveal the fragrance and Atkinsons' heritage. You're informed that they were the official perfumer to the British Royal Court for almost 200 years, with this specific scent recapturing the original craftsmanship and artisan heritage created by brand founder, James Atkinsons. And the fragrance is as special as you'd imagine. Not only is the glistening gold and purple flacon fit for royalty, but the scent is just as charming and sophisticated as it plays with soft spices and pretty florals.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz The Joss Flower directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Robinson Bear Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''If you want a fragrance to awaken your adventurous side, then Atkinsons Robinson Bear Eau de Parfum is just that. Inspired by Daniel Defoe's famous novel, 'Robinson Crusoe', Robinson Bear is refreshing, cooling and invigorating.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons Robinson Bear: . Woody-aromatic scent with a fresh, crisp tone.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Niche fragrance for all genders.. Part of Atkinsons' The Contemporary Collection.. Weighted glass bottle that allows you to see the mint green scent within.. . What Does Robinson Bear Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Inspired by Daniel Defoe's famous novel, Robinson Bear by Atkinsons conjures memories of ocean waves and sun-filled days. The embodiment of Crusoe's adventures, Robinson Bear is exhilaratingly edgy, yet still surprisingly seductive as its marine accord washes over your senses, forcing you to pay attention as it evokes in you a sense of adventure.. The unisex fragrance starts with soft, powdery star anise and lavender-like santolina, but it's the intense sea breeze note of calone that steals the show; this note makes you feel like you're sailing on the open ocean, the fresh sea air whipping around you. Next is a heart of balsamic, piney juniper berry, Virginia cedarwood and earthy patchouli. The dry down of leathery, ambery labdanum and earthy-woody oakmoss extract rounds out the fragrance, placing you firmly back on dry land - but your journey is only just beginning.. Top notes are Calone, Star Anise, Santolina. Heart notes are Juniper Berry, Virginia Cedarwood, Patchouli. Base notes are Oakmoss Extract, Labdanum. . Why it's Escentual: . Inspired by Daniel Defoe's famous novel, 'Robinson Crusoe', Robinson Bear Eau de Parfum celebrates not only this tale's adventurous spirit, but also the charismatic personality of its author. A much-adored intellectual artist whose many works are held to great acclaim within the literary world. Just like Defoe's 1719 novel, the fragrance awakens the wandering spirit that lies in each of us; it encourages us to step outside, take in a deep breath of fresh air and go wherever our nose may take us.. What we love most about Robinson Bear is the way that it transforms. It moves from a fresh, clean, crisp aquatic tone at the start (which makes you feel like you're out at sea on a summer's day) to something earthier and aromatic. It allows you to imagine that you've landed at your destination and adventure awaits. We also love how the clear, double-walled glass ties into the rest of Atkinsons' The Contemporary Collection, with the pale mint green-tinted fragrance is just as refreshingly crisp as its aroma.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Robinson Bear directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Rose Rhapsody Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''If you're obsessed with the powdery, feminine and intensely romantic scent of rose, then try Atkinsons Rose Rhapsody Eau de Parfum: it's a niche perfume that you'll simply adore.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons Rose Rhapsody: . Floral fragrance centred around Turkish rose.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Niche fragrance for women.. Weighted transparent glass bottle with an ornate floral emblem adorning the front.. . What Does Rose Rhapsody Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Created for Atkinsons by expert perfumer Soizic Beaucourt, Rose Rhapsody is somehow fresh and delicate, and yet still richly opulent as it warms on your skin. It opens with fresher, brighter notes as juicy, honeyed mandarin and tart bergamot create an instant optimism before the deep, dark and heady base is revealed later on. Naturally, the hero note of Turkish rose takes centre stage in the heart for a powdery, floral and romantic feel as it's made a touch more mysterious by earthy patchouli and intoxicatingly white floral jasmine. Finally, the base of rich, musty oud and just-smoked leather blends with warm agarwood for an addictive oritenal twist on an iconic floral scent.. Top notes are Mandarin, Bergamot, Pink Pepper. Heart notes are Turkish Rose, Jasmine, Patchouli. Base notes are Oud, Agarwood, Leather. . Why it's Escentual: . Atkinsons' Rose Rhapsody Eau de Parfum is a deeply floral fragrance that delights noses thanks to its hero ingredient: Turkish rose. It revives the exquisite, unique note of this iconic floral, building a refreshing, sophisticated and contemporary fragrance that honours the rose while still offering an interesting twist on it. It would make a strong signature scent for those with a penchant for feminine scents, although its seductive and earthy notes of agarwood and leather make it equally as appealing to those who love oriental undertones; it has something for everyone.. And we couldn't talk about Rose Rhapsody without giving a special mention to the flacon and its premium outer boxing: a stunning gold, ruby red, pearly white and pastel jewel-like magnetic clasp adorns the front which, once you've removed the upper and lower textured white casing, you peel back to reveal the perfume laying on a bed of crushed red velvet. The bottle has the same gold-encased pattern as the clasp - and it's so ornate that you'd want to wear it as a brooch. It exudes luxury craftsmanship, which is all we've come to expect from Atkinsons!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Rose Rhapsody directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Mint & Tonic Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''As you might expect from the name, Atkinsons Mint & Tonic Eau de Parfum is just like a cool and refreshing glass of G&T on a hot summer's day - but it's a G&T laced with lashings of fresh, just-crushed mint.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons Mint & Tonic: . Fresh and uplifting citrus-aromatic scent.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Niche fragrance for all genders.. Part of Atkinsons' The Contemporary Collection.. Weighted glass bottle that allows you to see the yellow-tinted scent within.. . What Does Mint & Tonic Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Created by master perfumer Evelyne Boulanger, Mint & Tonic by Atkinson disrupts the tranquillity of an English vegetable garden to steal several handfuls of herbaceous mint. The fragrance celebrates this cool, refreshing and almost peppery green note by throwing it over an invigorating blend of fresh citrus fruit before welcoming a softer, earthier base.. The versatile unisex fragrance offers a sparkling freshness that's perfect for the summer months as mint takes centre stage in the top, with zesty lime and grapefruit adding a joyful, upbeat citrus tone. The Eau de Parfum then gives way to a luminous heart of spicy ginger, green-aromatic geranium and honeyed mandarin, resulting in an almost sippable scent. Finally, the earthy, woody and sensual dry down of cedarwood, musk and vetiver rounds out this shimmering fragrance.. Top notes are Mint, Lime, Grapefruit. Heart notes are Ginger, Geranium, Mandarin. Base notes are Cedarwood, Musk, Vetiver. . Why it's Escentual: . If you're anything like us, then nothing quite screams summer like a chilled cocktail or an ice-filled G&T in the sun; Mint & Tonic is a scent that instantaneously stirs the optimism of summer in just the same way. First launched in 2018, the niche perfume celebrates mint, a popular herb likely introduced by the civilising Romans. For centuries, freshly plucked sprigs were infused with tea to revive your spirits, while it's perhaps now best known for its role in the suave Mojito. Mint's aromatic side unleashes when teamed with the bitter and woody complexities found in a classic British tonic, and we love that Mint & Tonic Eau de Parfum echoes this. We even love the fact that clear glass allows you to see the perfume within, just like a tipple in your hand.. Atkinsons' fragrance is citrusy, aromatic and long-lasting, all without being overpowering. Its universal tones would appeal to all genders, and it offers something optimistic and fresh while still having a touch of sensuality in the base.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Atkinsons Mint & Tonic directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Gold Fair In Mayfair Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Created to celebrate Atkinsons' first year back at the historical home of Mayfair, Gold Fair In Mayfair is a nuanced limited-edition offering that exudes the absolute luxury of the world-renowned niche brand that is Atkinsons." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Atkinsons Gold Fair In Mayfair: . Amber-floral fragrance laced with the chocolatey facet of cocoa bean.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Limited-edition niche fragrance for all genders.. Part of Atkinsons' The Emblematic Collection.. Stunning flacon that looks as though it's adorned with flakes of gold.. . What Does Gold Fair In Mayfair Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Atkinsons fans: London's calling! Designed as a homage to Mayfair, Philippine Courtiere's fragrance starts out with top notes of aromatic absinthe and just-spiced nutmeg to create an instant warmth without being overpowering. This unfurls into a warm heart of powdery iris, spicy-gourmand cocoa bean and hazy sage before a deeper musky ambrox, smoky vetiver and dry balsamic styrax round off this luminous, ambery cocktail.. Top notes are Absinthe, Nutmeg. Heart notes are Iris, Cocoa Beans, Sage. Base notes are Ambrox, Vetiver, Styrax. . Why it's Escentual: . To celebrate the first year back at its historical home of Mayfair, Atkinsons' deluxe limited-edition fragrance, Gold Fair In Mayfair, pays homage to one of the most opulent neighbourhoods in the bustling city of London. Not only is Mayfair one of the most expensive districts in London, but it's also arguably one of the most expensive districts in the world - and it's name is certainly known across the globe. As a result, Gold Fair In Mayfair Eau de Parfum has a lot to live up to, and it's safe to say that it does. The fragrance itself exudes a rich, opulent tone as it centres around a premium selection of fine perfume ingredients, but it's also an entirely nuanced, well-balanced and sophisticated scent; it graces the air around you with an almost-aristocratic air. And of course, we have to mention the fact that this launch is limited to 2000 bottles - yes, just 2000! If that doesn't capture the opulence and exclusivity that's built into the very walls of Mayfair, we don't know what does!. Naturally, the premium feel is reflected in the bottle, which has been kissed by a timeless gold shade. The unique design was inspired by the striking art wall found in the new Maison in Burlington Arcade, which lies dear to the brand. Created by designer Christopher Jenner, the wall is a masterpiece of Verre Eglomise, a glass etching technique that gives the store its shimmering interior texture. This enchanting technique is celebrated in the flacon's burnished gold finish, which is a true piece of art in and of itself. For a final touch of luxury, each Gold Fair In Mayfair is individually handcrafted - but we'd expect nothing less from a luxury brand like Atkinsons!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Gold Fair In Mayfair directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Initio Oud for Happiness Eau de Parfum Spray 90ml
listings.description: ''Initio Oud For Happiness is the type of fragrance that will spark absolute joy in you. Built around the finest Indian oud, it's a pleasure-revealing perfume that Initio lovers will simply adore.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Initio Oud For Happiness: . A bright but woody, spiced scent that invites you to inhale your way to happiness.. Long-lasting niche Eau de Parfum for all genders.. Part of Initio's Black Gold Project collection.. The fragrance centres around all-natural ingredients.. Elaborate, symbolic design in black, gold and emerald green.. . What Does Oud For Happiness Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Designed to ignite a sense of joy in both the wearer and those around them, Initio Oud For Happiness is both uplifting and bright and yet still cosily spiced. It's seriously seductive, too.. A tart, sunny and joyful mood is created by bergamot. At the same time, the aphrodisiac ginger adds a warm, spicy ginger edge to the fragrance. A fresh blast of herbs and sweet liquorice mingle together - but it's the Indian oud that takes centre stage, as it adds a warm, woody and slightly smoked tone to promote a calming sensation. The fragrance flourishes with a lasting warm, cosy sweetness created by sensual musk and creamy vanilla.. Main notes are bergamot, ginger, cedarwood, Indian oud, liquorice, blast of herbs, vanilla and musk. . Why it's Escentual: . Initio Oud For Happiness is centred around the prized ancestral material of oud, a precious natural ingredient that boasts psychoactive and spiritual dimensions; it's used to promote mediation in traditional healing methods and is also a costly entity. But why does Oud For Happiness celebrate this rich natural extract? For experts, oud is the fragrance of joy, with Initio Oud For Happiness created to ignite a spark of positivity in you - in fact, this fragrance invites you to inhale your way to happiness.. Rich in terpenoids, oud boasts natural sedative and anti-anxiety powers, helping to rebalance your energy levels while relaxing both the body and mind. But just because the scent boosts your mood, that doesn't mean that you have to sacrifice those rich, luxurious and seductive notes we've come to expect from an Initio fragrance; they still lace the fragrance - with dangerously addictive results! It's joy-enhancing but still undeniably classy, bold, and a little bit sexy.. And we couldn't possibly talk about an Initio fragrance without mentioning the bottle! Tying into the Black Project collection similar to Oud for Greatness, Oud For Happiness' bottle is gorgeously elaborate and undeniably refined. It reminds us of an ancient coffret bursting with long-lost artefacts and precious gemstones. Its matte black bottle contrasts with the glistening golds and swirling emeralds that adorn its front. Even the unboxing experience feels luxurious as you unveil layer upon layer to finally reveal the fragrance, sitting on a bed of midnight-black crushed velvet.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Always apply the fragrance to your pulse points, namely your neck and wrists. Initio always advise not to rub a fragrance in; instead, pat it in to let the molecules settle.. .

listings.rawTitle: DSquared2 2 Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: '˜'DSquared2 brings you the next scent in their iconic Wood collection: 2 Wood. It's a unisex Eau de Toilette that has a dark citrus vibe with a woody undertone that's green-fresh as well as warm and sensual.'' - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love DSquared2 2 Wood Eau de Toilette: . Unisex fragrance that's part of the DSquared2 Wood series.. Offers an average of 6 hours' wear.. Woody lemony scent with hints of green.. Exclusive bottle and handcrafted top that mimics the texture of bark.. . What Does DSquared2 2 Wood Smell Like? . DSquared2 2 Wood has classic citrus and fresh-grassy tones that would be appealing to both sexes. The Eau de Toilette reminds us of a moodier take on the iconic Acqua di Parma Colonia scent with a darker lemon, a touch of warm amber and a more intensely woody base.. Top notes are Citron, Lemon Primofiore, Pink Pepper. Heart notes are Haitian Vetiver, Virginian and Alaskan Cedarwood, Silver Fir. Base notes are Vegetal Amber, Musk, Vulcanolide. . Why it's Escentual: . Belonging to a famous fashion house, founded by the Caten twins, and a fragrance formulated by Daphne Bugey and Olivier Cresp, DSquared2 2 Wood is a fragrance that has years of expertise behind its creation and is set to become a huge success.. At Escentual, we appreciate quality craftsmanship; the DSquared2 2 Wood bottle exudes this with it's handcrafted bottle design, along with a magnetised top which makes for easy use. The fragrance itself smells expensive, and its woody citrus trail is hard not to love if you appreciate Eau de Toilettes with excellent longevity, depth and warmth. And, for fans of the wood-inspired line, it's definitely one to try as you'll enjoy the woody theme that runs through the full collection.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your pulse points and reapply after 4-6 hours.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet is sure to put a smile on the face of any GUERLAIN fan; just like a beaming smile in a bottle, it's sweet, joyful and utterly radiant." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet . Crisp, light and luminous fruity-floral fragrance with an oriental twist.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum for women.. Part of the iconic Mon Guerlain collection.. Elegant glass flacon in that honours GUERLAIN.. . What Does Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Pretty, playful and highly illuminating, Sparkling Bouquet revisits and reinvents GUERLAIN's signature lavender-vanilla duo for 2021. Adding a crisp, juicy pear note, the fragrance has a sweet, light and airy feel at first as it blends with the honeyed, sunny facets of mandarin and bergamot before the where the freshness of lavender juxtaposes jasmine's sun-kissed accents in the heart, where delicate peony petals are added to the mix. Finally, the fragrance's oriental tone is revealed as rich, cosy and almost almond-esque vanilla takes to the stage as it melts into creamy sandalwood and sensual white musks.. Top notes are Mandarin, Bergamot, Pear Heart notes are Lavender, Jasmine Sambac, Peony Base notes are Sandalwood, Vanilla, White Musks. . . Why it's Escentual: . An icon within the fragrance world, the Mon Guerlain fragrance line has been loved by perfume fans ever since the original Eau de Parfum launched in 2017 - and its unwavering popularity is apparent through the number of flankers that have been added to the collection ever since. From the Eau de Toilette to the intense editions, Mon Guerlain is only set to get bigger. And we're certain that lovers of the line will fall for the charms of the 2021 Sparkling Bouquet addition. It's core DNA is very similar to existing perfumes from the perfume range - lavender, vanilla, jasmine and sandalwood included - but the fresher, sweeter and crisper pear facet in the opening adds an exciting new tone that sparkles and illuminates.. Just like the scent, the perfume bottle ties in perfectly to the existing Mon Guerlain collection; it's style and sophistication instantly reminds you that this is a GUERLAIN fragrance as anyone familiar with the brand will recall the "quadrilobe" bottle, which echoes the multiple facets of femininity through its contrast between the strength of the taut lines and the sensuality of the curves. As a finishing touch, the shimmering silver ring that lies around the neck has been reinvented with a texture quadrilobe pave setting so it looks just like a precious jewel. It's a stunning addition to any dressing table!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz GUERLAIN Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet directly onto your pulse points - the neck and wrists to get the most out of the perfume..
