listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: ''Unleash your rebellious and creative side with Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition Eau de Parfum, a woody-fruity fragrance for men who are both daring and elegant.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition: . Enticing yet sophisticated scent for men.. Perfect balance of bitter and sweet notes with a smooth, sensual base.. Long-lasting woody-fruity Eau de Parfum.. Part of the vibrant Urban Hero collection.. Modern graffiti-inspired flacon.. . What Does Urban Hero Gold Edition Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition combines timeless aromatic notes with fresh, vibrant citruses for a perfectly balanced woody-fruity fragrance for men. The EDP opens with an energising cocktail of basil, pineapple and blood orange, with the natural bitterness of orange balancing out the sweet, aromatic heart of lavandin, ambertonic and rich tonka bean. Finally, Jimmy Choo's fragrance reveals a sophisticated but addictive base of sandalwood, musk and fresh moss, which linger seductively on the skin.. Top notes are Pineapple, Blood Orange, Basil. . Heart notes are Lavandin, Tonka Bean, Ambertonic. . Base notes are Sandalwood, Moss, Musks. . . Why it's Escentual: . For this fragrance, master perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou was inspired by the unrivalled creativity and style of street art. Just like graffiti, Urban Hero Gold is daring and rebellious; it's a scent that embodies the man who openly embraces his free spirit and youthful approach to life, while still honouring his elegant side. It's a fragrance of contrasts.. Fans of the Urban Hero collection will love the 2021 Gold edition; it's a brighter but more aromatic scent, which many will particularly enjoy wearing during the summer months. Plus, pairing this edition alongside the original is a great way to transition your scent from day to night. And of course, Urban Hero fans will instantly recognise the iconic flacon, which mimics a gentleman's hip flask. But it's different to its predecessor; graffiti-inspired typography adorns the front, while the bold juxtaposing black-and-gold design echoes the vibrant paint used by street artists. All in all, Jimmy Choo's Eau de Parfum celebrates the 'Urban Hero' perfectly, reflecting his audacity and creativity.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Urban Hero Gold Edition onto the pulse points for a prolonged scent.. .

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Oud Eclat Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Oud lover or not, you'll adore the perfectly balanced intensity, sweetness and spicy-green undertones of Miller Harris' Oud Eclat." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Miller Harris Oud Eclat Eau de Parfum: . Powerful woody scent with a lasting impression of fresh green spice and a touch of sweetness.. Oud Eclat is a unisex fragrance.. The heavy composition of this scent means it lasts around 12 hours.. Part of the luxurious Miller Harris Private Collection.. Matte black bottle with a luxurious gold cap and plaque.. . What Does Miller Harris Oud Eclat Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . The scent puts a modern spin on the heavy composition associated with traditional oud fragrances by adding a range of notes that counterbalance the richness, like sugar and florals. The opening of the scent feels creamy and woody, followed by a warm heart filled with amber, florals and spicy nutmeg. As the fragrance settles on the skin, it leaves a sensual green-fresh oud tone that smells expensive with a little uplifting sweetness.. Top notes are Agarwood, Tagete, Cashmere Wood. Heart notes are Amber, Floral Transparent, Fir Balsam, Nutmeg. Base notes are Moss, Musk, Leather, Sugar. . . Why It's Escentual: . Don't be put off if you don't traditionally like ouds. Oud Eclat isn't an oud that's overpowering; instead, it has intensity and depth but with a subtle sweetness that almost gives it a slightly feminine side!. Niche perfumers, Miller Harris, are known for their luxe and unique perfume creations - and their 2021 Oud Eclat is just that. Like all the fragrances in the Private Collection, Oud Eclat has only been made in smaller quantities, which means this scent is incredibly rare and exclusive. The unusual mix of notes in the composition gives a unique spin on the traditional oud scent and fits into the style of the rest of the Private Collection.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray onto your pulse points: the neck and wrists.. .

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle 100ml
listings.description: ''The Mugler Alien Goddess Refill Bottle is an eco-friendly and cost efficient way to enjoy your favourite fragrance again and again!'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Refill: . Allows you to replenish your existing Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum.. Compatible with the 30ml, 60ml and 90ml sizes.. Eco-friendly and cost-effective substitute that's perfect for Alien fans.. Features an easy-to-use funnel design.. . What Does Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Luminous and mesmerising, the much-loved Alien Goddess fragrance is a blend of floral, warm and woody tones. The EDP opens with a sparkling and radiant nod to the Alien Goddess through a blend of Italian bergamot and refreshing coconut water. The heart blooms with opulent white jasmine flowers, which are nuanced by hazy heliotrope, before the scent warms into a seductive bourbon vanilla base that's perfectly balanced by comforting cashmeran.. Top notes are Coconut Water, Bergamot. Heart notes are Jasmine, Heliotrope. Base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran. . . Why it's Escentual: . Inspired by glory, kindness and perfect harmony, Alien Goddess is both a delight for the senses and kind to the planet. As a part of Mugler's commitment to sustainability, the Alien Goddess refill bottle offers an eco-friendly alternative to purchasing a new glass flacon each and every time that you reach the end of your signature scent. By making this easy switch, you can enjoy a smaller CO2 footprint and save 67% on plastic, 54% on cardboard and 53% on glass compared to rebuying the original.. The effortless funnel design is super easy to use and compatible with the 30ml, 60ml and 90ml sizes, so you can replenish your existing Alien Goddess flacon over and over again.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Start with your original perfume bottle; take off the cap and remove the spray pump. Decant the refillable bottle into your original bottle using the funnel, and reattach the spray pump and cap on the original. Make sure it's tight to avoid leaks!. .

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 30ml
listings.description: ''Get lost on a sparkling, solar escape with the Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum, a refillable woody-amber fragrance for women.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum: . A bright, warm scent that embodies optimism and positivity.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum for women.. Part of the avant-garde Alien collection.. Iconic Alien bottle drenched in luxurious gold.. . What Does Alien Goddess Smell Like? . Mugler's Alien Goddess is an amber-floral fragrance based on three olfactory revelations that embody a Goddess: radiance, miraculous and mindfulness. Goddess opens with a radiant and sparkling Italian bergamot that encourages positivity. The solar flowers bloom for a heart filled with jasmine grandiflorum that elicit a femine sensuality. To finish, the aroma warms into a creamy vanilla that's perfectly balanced with a veil of silky cashmeran that delights the senses.. Top notes are Coconut Water, Bergamot. Heart notes are Jasmine, Heliotrope. Base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran. . . Why it's Escentual: . Master Perfumers Nathalie Lorson and Marie Salamagne designed Alien Goddess to project a solar radiance that magnifies glory, generosity and kindness. The warm, comforting scent is the perfect escape of winter months, transporting us to a tropical island drenched in sunlight.. Alien fans will instantly recognise the iconic glass bottle, that's signature to the fragrance collection. Drenched in a sun-kissed glow, Alien Goddess is wrapped in a luxurious gold lacquer to signify the rising sun. . . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray a cloud in the air and then walk through it to let the fragrance gently settle on your skin, hair and clothes. Finish off by applying the fragrance to the pulse points: on the wrist, at the top of the neck and at the bend of the arms to release a long-lasting, lingering scent..

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Take an adventure through warm woods, aromatic florals and mossy notes with Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum, an intense fougere for all day wear.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Montblanc Legend EDP: . Captivating woody-aromatic-fougere fragrance for men.. Bold, concentrated and long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Part of the iconic Montblanc Legend collection.. Flanker of the best-selling Montblanc Legend EDT.. Iconic flask-like flacon dipped in a black lacquer.. . What Does Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Montblanc Legend EDP offers a richer, more intense version of the best-selling EDT, revamping the original olfactive identity of Legend for a more intense and adventurous scent. The aromatic journey starts with energising bergamot and fresh violet for a sensory awakening. The floral heart is balanced by vibrant woods for a classic elegance before the Eau de Parfum finishes with a captivating trail of oakmoss, which is reminiscent of the forest floor, as sensual leather lingers on the skin for hours on end.. Top notes are Bergamot, Violet Leaf. Heart notes are Geranium, Magnolia, Jasmine, Woody Accord. Base notes are Oak Moss, Leather Accord. . . Why it's Escentual: . Created by master perfumer Oliver Pescheux, Legend Eau de Parfum embodies the charisma, authenticity and courage of the Legend man. And now, Pescheux invites every man to challenge himself and work out what kind of a Legend he is by discovering this scent. Fans of Legend Eau de Toilette will enjoy the traditional signature notes - namely, the likes of bergamot and jasmine - but the Eau de Parfum is enhanced by a number of captivating additions, including violet leaf. Legend is stronger than ever, and it's a scent that effortlessly transitions from day to night.. Housed in the iconic Montblanc signature flask-like bottle, the fragrance pays homage to its predecessor, while the deep black lacquering expresses the powerful, intense aroma within. Adorned with the Montblanc emblem and subtle gold details, the flacon echoes the opulent detail of the fashion house.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum onto your pulse points for a prolonged fragrance.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Rouge Eau de Parfum Spray 35ml
listings.description: '˜'GIVENCHY L'Interdit Rouge Eau de Parfum is a red-hot take on the original white floral tone of L'Interdit with a new spicy accord that feels undeniably sexy - and it's my favourite flanker in the collection so far!'' - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love GIVENCHY L'Interdit Rouge: . Fiery woody-floral with two key notes: ginger and orange blossom.. Last for 4-6 hours.. Part of the iconic GIVENCHY L'Interdit fragrance line.. Features sustainably sourced orange blossom and ginger.. Classic L'Interdit bottle but in a daring red shade.. . What Does L'Interdit Rouge Smell Like? . L'Interdit Rouge is a spicy version of the original Eau de Parfum; it has the same heart notes but with the addition of a fiery, red-hot spicy accord that gives this classic scent a searing femininity. For those who haven't tried L'Interdit, the Rouge edition shares similarities with the soft sweetness and white floral tones of Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum, but with added heat.. Top notes are Sicilian Blood Orange Essence, Spicy Red Accord. Heart notes are Tunisian Orange Blossom Absolute, Indian Sambac Jasmine Absolute. Base notes are Indonesian Patchouli Heart Essence, New Caledonian Sandalwood Essence. . . Why it's Escentual: . If you're already a fan of the original L'Interdit and you love to try every flanker in the collection, then this is the one to try; to us, Rouge is the fire cracker in the line. It feels the most unique addition to the couture fragrance collection, which was originally inspired by Audrey Hepburn.. Any fan of L'Interdit will recognise the classic bottle shape of GIVENCHY Rouge, but this time it's been stained in a daring red hue to match the sensual Eau de Parfum inside. The couture feel of this fragrance is finished off by the signature GIVENCHY logo, which adorns the neck of the bottle as an ode to Hubert de Givenchy.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz on the pulse points and top up throughout the day.. . The Sustainable Side: . Features ginger that's sustainably sourced from Nigeria, and orange blossom harvested by hand in Tunisia..

Formulated with 100% natural origin ingredients, the award-winning EDP opens with energising cedrat citrus notes that are expertly blended with sparkling blackcurrant tones for an invigorating feeling in the very first spritz. Chloe fragrance lovers will recognise the iconic flacon shape, elegantly tied with a timeless green ribbon collar. listings.rawTitle: BURBERRY Hero Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Magnetic, sporty and sensual Burberry Eau de Toilette is a woody-aromatic fragrance that perfectly balances warmth and freshness.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Master Perfumer Aurelien Guichard perfectly marries vibrant freshness with comforting woody nuances, for a fragrance that embodies modern masculinity. The base of British juniper blends with spicy, aromatic black pepper for an addictive trial.. Top notes are bergamot essence Heart notes are a cedarwood trio Base notes are black pepper, juniper . . Why it's Escentual: . Inspired by the designer fashion house's signatures, Riccardo Tisci interrupts Burberry's house codes into a woody-aromatic scent. Fueled by duality, contradiction and the animal kingdom, Hero is for any man searching for transformation in a modern world. If you're a fan of Burberry's classic woody signature, featured in Burberry Original and Mr Burberry Eau de Toilette, you'll love the aromatic, freshness of Hero.. Style comes first for this brand; the golden flacon's luxurious design is the Inspired by the Burberry horse's hoof,. The glass bottle has a sleek, modern cap is also embossed with the logo for the perfect blend of modernity and elegance.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spitz onto your pulse points for a prolonged freshness.. .

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Retinol Skin-Renewing Daily Micro-Dose Serum 30ml
listings.description: '˜'Tackle fine lines, wrinkles and skin texture with the Kiehl's Retinol Skin-Renewing Daily Micro-Dose Serum, a gentle anti-ageing treatment that visibly renews your skin.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Kiehl's Retinol Daily Micro-Dose Serum: . Firming and smoothing anti-ageing serum suitable for all skin types.. 93% of beauty lovers found their skin's texture was more refined.. 85% of users agreed that their skin looked years younger.. Centres around a powerful trio of ingredients that increase cell turnover and strengthen the skin barrier.. Suitable for sensitive skin and first-time retinol users.. Features a daily-strength dose of pure retinol.. . What You Need To Know: . Designed to refine your skin for a more youthful-looking complexion, the Kiehl's Micro-Dose Serum is an anti-ageing treatment enriched with a potent dose of pure retinol - in fact, it features a daily-dose of the purest form of retinol available over-the-counter. This show-stopping active accelerates skin cell turnover to bring younger and radiant skin to the surface as the formula smooths away fine lines and wrinkles. Ceramides work to strengthen the skin barrier and enhance sensitive skin's tolerance to retinol, while the addition of peptides supports optimal youth-renewing results. Oh, and the serum does all this without causing major signs of redness, dryness or peeling.. . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we love multi-functional skincare - and this Kiehl's Retinol anti-ageing serum is just that! It harnesses the refining and skin-smoothing benefits of retinol, while still being suitable for even the most sensitive skin. But don't just take our word for it - 90% of beauty lovers agreed that their skin felt comfortable after application, making it perfect for first-time retinol users.. Kiehl's fans will love the luxurious deep purple glass bottle - and we think that everyone will appreciate the fact that the anti-wrinkle serum comes with a handy pump dispenser for non-messy and fuss-free application. Plus, a little goes a long way as the soft and non-sticky texture easily glides across your skin, so you can enjoy supple and youthful skin for longer.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use at night-time. After cleansing, apply the Retinol Skin-Renewing Daily Micro-Dose Serum to the entire face and the neck if needed. You can apply it to the under-eye area, but take care to avoid contact with the eyes and the eyelid area.. Always use SPF the following day as retinol increases the skin's sensitivity to sunlight.. . Values: . Dermatologist tested.. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Double Serum Eye Global Age Control Concentrate 20ml
listings.description: ''You can now get Clarins' iconic Double Serum for your eyes! This anti-ageing eye serum makes the eye area look younger in just seven days by nourishing, firming, smoothing, depuffing, and reducing dark circles. '' - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Clarins Double Serum Eye: . Anti-ageing eye serum for all skin types and ages.. Visibly younger-looking eyes in just seven days.. 96% natural origin ingredients.. Helps boost production of proteins and helps the skin regain strength and vitality.. Anti-pollution complex protects against indoor and outdoor pollutants, plus blue light.. Classic Double Serum packaging and innovative twist dial applicator, which helps to reduce wastage.. Suitable for sensitive skin and those who wear contact lenses.. . What You Need To Know: . One bottle of Clarins Double Serum sells every five seconds worldwide; it's a cult product without a doubt, and now, its award-winning formula comes customised for your eye area. The Clarins Double Serum Eye is highly anticipated, but it was worth the wait; Clarins has developed a formula that promises younger-looking eyes in just one week.. The eye serum is for all skin types and all ages. If you're looking to target all signs of ageing around the eye contour, this is the one for you. The dual-phase formula is made of 96% natural ingredients and contains 13 plant extracts, many of which are borrowed from the 5-star Double Serum we know and love, while others like squalane and caffeine have been added specifically for your eyes. Chervil extract, which helps skin regain its strength, is one of the star ingredients, alongside turmeric extract, which boosts skin renewal for smoother, brighter skin. With continued use, the lightweight, comfortable eye serum leaves the delicate skin around the eyes nourished, firmer, smoother, depuffed and dark circles reduced.. . Why it's Escentual: . Clarins was one of the first brands we launched at Escentual. For that, it holds a special place in our hearts. Double Serum is equally important to us; many of our team swear by it. Others have fond memories of seeing it on their mothers and grandmothers dressing tables growing up. We predict that Double Serum Eye will be as much of an icon in years to come!. People often overlook eye cream as a non-essential skincare step. But, the skin around your eyes is the thinnest and the most delicate, which makes it most susceptible to signs of ageing like lines and wrinkles. Clarins are experts in anti-ageing skincare, with over 35 years of experience, and so we're confident to recommend their products to our customers. They think of everything; not only is the formula carefully crafted with the most hard-working ingredients, but it comes in a dual-phase hydric and lipidic formula to stimulate the skin's five essential functions (hydration, nutrition, oxygenation, regeneration and protection). In addition, the packaging has an adjustable dial to help you deliver the perfect dose and limit wastage.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use morning and night. Adjust the dial to a small or large dose, and dispense the desired amount onto fingers. Mix the dual-phase formula with fingertips. Press onto the eyelids, then apply to the under-eye area, from the inner corner to the temples - finally, press between your brows.. .

Boosts skin circulation and the function of immunity cells for strong skin defence.. Protects against the effects of stress and pollution.. Winner of 200 beauty awards worldwide.. . What You Need To Know: . Shiseido have harnessed 25 years of research to create an innovative serum that's both highly effective and appealing to the senses. The formula contains Shiseido's patented ImuGenerationRED anti-ageing technology, which works to boost the skin's immunity and circulation for a plumper, stronger complexion. Plus, the natural blend of botanical ingredients offers a stronger defence against external aggressors that may cause ageing and irritation. Enriched with rosella, heart leaf, reishi mushroom and iris, the hydrating elixir improves the function and number of immune cells for a smoother and more resilient complexion. But don't just take our word for it: 90% of beauty lovers said their skin felt and looked renewed after 8 weeks.. . Why it's Escentual: . Adored by skincare fans worldwide, Shiseido sells one Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate every seven seconds - and we can see why! Not only does it leave skin feeling smooth and nourished, but it also renews your skin's radiance, improves firmness and diminishes wrinkles.. But just because the formula works incredibly hard, that doesn't mean Shiseido sacrifice on comfort; the thick dewy texture melts into the skin to form a protective veil across your complexion, resulting in a satin-smooth feeling that lasts all day. Plus, the green floral fragrance is both practical and ultra-sensory, helping to comfort and relax the senses as the inclusion of the ImuCalm compound prevents the damage of emotional stress on the skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the Shiseido anti-ageing serum mornings and evenings after cleansing. Dispense two pumps of the serum into the palm of your hands and smooth over your face.. Top tip: tap the serum onto your cheeks, forehead, nose and chin using your middle and ring fingers before smoothing from the centre outwards.. . The Sustainable Side: . Shiseido wants to achieve 100% sustainable packaging by 2025 - and the Ultimune Power serum is no exception with its recyclable bottle. If you're looking to be more eco-friendly, try the new 75ml refill.. . Awards: . Winner of 200 awards worldwide.. .

Those with reactive complexions will reap the benefits of finding formulas they can trust, and the Soothing Recovery Cream is one of those products. We know our customers will love this everyday moisturiser because it's a revamp of a classic product; its predecessor was a best-seller and we think this updated version will prove just as popular - if not more so! Fragrance-free, preservative-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Avene Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser Lotion 200ml

Avene designed this fragrance-free formula with reactive skin in mind; it's a revamp of a classic Avene product, and removes all traces of dirt and makeup from the face, eyes and lips without irritating the complexion. The no-rinse makeup remover has a gel-lotion texture that removes impurities from the skin in a delicate sweep, while protecting against dryness with Avene Thermal Spring Water, leaving the face feeling soft and comfortable after every use.. . Why it's Escentual: . 51% of UK women have sensitive skin. That means over half of us need a kind-to-skin face wash; the Extremely Gentle Cleanser is that and then some! It's crafted by sensitive-skin experts Avene, whose entire brand caters to the delicate needs of reactive, hypersensitive skin. There's no fear of flare-ups when this makeup remover is around, and we know how important that peace of mind is to those who have skin conditions.. If you dread washing your face or taking your makeup off because the discomfort is too much to bear, this gel-lotion is what you've been waiting for. No tugging, rubbing or water is needed to take off every last trace of the day. In moments, your skin is left completely clean and fresh; it's a welcomed change to the irritation and redness you may be used to.. . The Best Way To Use It: . listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures of the Sun Transparent Eau de Parfum Spray 3 x 12ml Gift Set 3 x 12ml
listings.description: ''Whether you're a lifelong Acqua di Parma fan or new to the brand, I think everyone will enjoy the vibrant and uplifting notes of the Signatures Transparent Eau de Parfum Gift Set. It's a unisex fragrance set centred around the dazzling and precious aromas of nature as celebrated in the Signatures Of The Sun collection.'' Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Acqua di Parma Signatures of the Sun Transparent Gift Set: . Contains three travel-sized Eau de Parfums.. Features iconic unisex perfumes from the Signatures Of The Sun range.. Showcases a trio of uplifting sunny scents.. Acts as a great way to introduce a friend (or yourself) to Acqua di Parma.. Travel-sized bottles ideal for jet-setters.. . The Gift Set Includes: . Acqua di Parma Yuzu Eau de Parfum 12ml. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus Eau de Parfum 12ml. Acqua di Parma Sakura Eau de Parfum 12ml. . What You Need To Know: . An ode to the glorious sun sprinkling daylight over nature's wonders, the Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun perfume set is an invitation to take your love of fragrance to dazzling new heights with bold sparkling depths. Yuzu Eau de Parfum is an energising fragrance that celebrates the bittersweet aroma of yuzu fruit, blending it with citruses, pepper and elegant florals, with a twist of musk, sandalwood and liquorice in the base. Sakura is fresh and delicate; it captures the rich and beautiful aroma of the blossoming cherry trees of Japan. The exquisite tone of this fragile flower is uplifted by notes of bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper, with jasmine and sakura providing a floral elegance with a sensual musk base. Finally, Osmanthus Eau de Parfum is a sun-filled scent; the lively fragrance opens with floral-fruity top notes of mandarin and neroli before welcoming a peony, ambrette and pink pepper heart. An addition of patchouli in the base adds an earthy tone to this intensely luminous aroma, but the lingering osmanthus flower is the true sensual star of the show.. . Why it's Escentual: . We love how Acqua di Parma's Signatures Transparent discovery kit takes your senses on an olfactory journey through nature's finest natural ingredients. From the yuzu fruit and sakura flower in Japan, to the osmanthus plant found in the rock forests of South East Asia, this perfume set will allow you to travel to destinations far and wide - without ever leaving your house.. Held in a sleek and suave black box, the Acqua di Parma set exudes luxury and class. The Signatures Of The Sun range is one of their most premium and opulent collections, so we think this set would be an ideal gift for your friend who lavishes quality and finery. Whether you're introducing a loved one to Acqua di Parma, indulging in a treat for yourself, or fuelling your fragrance-obsessed friend's addiction, this fragrance discovery kit is sure to delight, surprise and excite the receiver (and those around them).. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray the Eau de Parfums directly onto your pulse points.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Crushliner Waterproof Stylo Eyeliner 0.35g / 1 - Noir Intense
listings.description: '˜'Enjoy bold, high pigment colour for up to 24 hours with the Yves Saint Laurent Crushliner Waterproof Stylo Eyeliner.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the YSL Crushliner Eyeliner: . Bold long-lasting eyeliner with up to 24 hours' wear.. Waterproof, smudge-proof and transfer-resistant.. Enriched with pomegranate extract for highly pigmented colour.. Sleek black design with a hidden pencil sharpener.. . Why it's Escentual: . The YSL Crushliner Waterproof Stylo Eyeliner showcases a super blendable and buildable formula in a cabinet of shades to suit every eye colour. The soft, creamy gel texture is both comfortable and highly pigmented for rich, vivid colour that lasts up to 24 hours. Plus, the innovative smudge-resistant and waterproof formula reduces the likelihood of fading and smudging, making it ideal for anyone prone to eye rubbing. If that wasn't all, YSL's Crushliner is enriched with natural pomegranate extract sourced from the YSL Community Gardens in Morocco for a high-quality colour that will take you from day to night.. Whether you're after a precise winged eye, bold graphic lines or a smokey cat eye, YSL's blendable eyeliner has you covered. But the best bit? The innovative sleek design makes the liner incredibly easy to hold so you can achieve detailed precision - and it even contains a hidden sharper at the end of the pencil, which is perfect for makeup emergencies when you're out and about!. . The Best Way To Use It: . If you're after a classic winged liner, apply three dots across the lash line from the inner to the outer corner and connect the dots. Tidy up any mistakes with your favourite concealer. Alternatively, you can get creative by trying out any of the following looks: a smokey eye, a graphic eyeliner look, a negative space look, or a barely-there finish.. .

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Lily of the Valley Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: '˜'Experience true Italian craftsmanship and perfume expertise with Acqua di Parma Lily of the Valley Eau de Parfum, a floral fragrance that redefines the lily of the valley using a blend of fresh citruses and woody musks.'' -Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Acqua di Parma Lily of the Valley: . Radiant, uplifting Eau de Parfum for both men and women.. Blends delicate florals, vibrant citruses and sensual musks.. Part of the Signatures of the Sun collection.. Luxurious weighted glass flacon.. . What Does Lily of the Valley EDP Smell Like? . Harnessing 105 years of perfume know-how, Acqua di Parma's floral Eau de Parfum showcases an artistic combination of lily of the valley alongside luminous citruses. Lily of the Valley Eau de Parfum opens with a sparkling array of Italian bergamot and sharp grapefruit that blends into deep, tangy blackcurrant for an uplifting tone. The rich floral heart blooms with three distinct florals that effortlessly blend into the lily of the valley note: jasmine, magnolia and geranium, all of which are nuanced by leafy petitgrain. The final touch is the most addictive as the blend of warm cedarwood and sensual musk lingers on the skin for a radiant trail.. Top notes are Bergamot, Grapefruit, Blackcurrant. Heart notes are Petitgrain, Lily Of The Valley, Jasmine, Magnolia, Geranium. Base notes are Cedarwood, Musk. . . Why it's Escentual: . A 2021 addition to the Signatures of the Sun collection, Acqua di Parma Lily of the Valley exudes the same sun-kissed feeling as the rest of the fragrance line. Inspired by the signature lily of the valley note, the EDP spotlights the strength and power of the delicate flower; it's a true celebration of the flower in springtime.. Acqua di Parma fans will appreciate the Italian craftsmanship behind this high-quality fragrance, while the premium feel is carried through to its clear, weighted glass flacon, which is adorned with the iconic black and gold logo. But what do we love most about the design? The way that the transparent glass captures the light as it shines through it, paying homage to the summery essence of the fragrance within.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Lily of the Valley onto the pulse points for a longer-lasting fragrance.. . The Sustainable Side: . The Acqua di Parma flacon and hat box are both recyclable and reusable.. .

Part of the Prada Luna Rossa collection inspired by modern sailing.. Dynamic, deep blue glass bottle.. . What Does Prada Luna Rossa Ocean EDT Smell Like? . From the very first spritz, Luna Rossa Ocean opens with a refreshing sharpness of bergamot that is joined by a touch of aromatic pink pepper. Subtle spice is continued into the heart of sage and iris for a warm earthiness that is undeniably masculine. The earthy base of vetiver lingers on the skin for a subtle sophistication that has an addictive sensuality.. Top notes are bergamot, pink pepper, artemisia. Heart notes are iris accord, lavender, sage accord. Base notes are vetiver essence, musk, patchouli. . . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we love how the uplifting, freshness of the Eau de Toilette fills our lungs, just like how the fresh ocean breeze clears the mind, for internal tranquility and energy. If you love the greenness of the great outdoors or equally are a long-standing fan of Prada aftershaves, we are sure you'll be a fan of this scent; the light-weight softness is a truly addictive everyday scent for the modern man.. Master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carloss Benaim embody the modern voyage of Prada's Luna Rossa sailing boat with the sleek, deep blue bottle that glistening just like the turbulent Atlantic Sea and of course we love the touch of red, a subtle nod to the designer fashion house that is instantly recognisable. Plus, the capless design is ideal for explorers on the move - just spritz and go!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray the Eau de Toilette on your pulse points for enhanced intensity and wear.. .

listings.rawTitle: Dermalogica Biolumin-C Gel Moisturiser 50ml
listings.description: ''If you want fresh, glowy skin, then you're going to want to try Dermalogica's Biolumin-C Gel Moisturiser. Powered by vitamin C, it unlocks your skin's radiance for a bright, renewed glow.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Dermalogica Biolumin-C Gel Moisturiser: . Daily face cream for dull, lacklustre complexions.. Instantly hydrates and brightens skin.. Evens out tone and renews skin for a natural glow.. Packed with vitamin C, hyaluronic acid and squalane.. Visibly reduces fine lines and wrinkles after just 4 weeks.. Vegan.. . What You Need To Know: . Dermalogica's gel moisturiser provides weightless hydration and glowing skin in one. It works to strengthen the skin's moisture barrier for a more radiant and uniform look, all while smoothing away fine lines and wrinkles for a healthier, younger-looking complexion.. The glow-enhancing vegan formula celebrates all things vitamin C, a powerhouse ingredient that's renowned for its impressive brightening abilities. An ultra-stable complex built around this vitamin offers improved potency and enhanced penetration due to Dermalogica's leading technology, while the formula encourages the reactivation of vitamin C for lasting brightness and luminosity. But that's not all: vitamin C is also paired with verbascum flower, phytic acid and pumpkin enzymes to brighten and renew, with verbascum featured as it harnesses the energy of UV rays and turns it into visible light for instant radiance, while phytic acid and pumpkin delicately smooth and gently exfoliate the complexion for a lit-from-within renewed glow.. To deeply moisturise your complexion, the Dermalogica BioLumin-C facial formula features five types of hyaluronic acid of differing molecular weights to hydrate across multiple layers of skin for a plump, smooth and fine-line free look. To round off the mix, saccharides further encourage skin hydration while vegan-friendly, sugar cane-derived squalane restores the skin's barrier function.. . Why it's Escentual: . When we first launched Dermalogica here at Escentual, we fell for so many of their clever, results-driven formulas, but we must admit that the Dermalogica Biolumin-C Eye Serum was a particular favourite for a lot of us - and for good reason! Its powerhouse, vitamin C-fuelled formula offers impressive brightening results to tackle dark circles. And it's not just us; it's loved by skinfluencers just as much!. So, as soon as we heard about the Dermalogica Biolumin-C Gel Moisturiser, it was fair to say that we were incredibly excited. And it certainly didn't disappoint! The lightweight gel-cream moisturiser absorbs into your skin for an instant glowiness that's sure to turn heads, all while it continues to care for and strengthen your complexion. Plus, we must admit that we love that a little goes a long way when it comes to this radiance-revealing moisturiser, while the zesty orange juice-like scent and weightless texture makes application a breeze.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use in both the morning and the evening. After cleansing and toning, apply two or three pumps to the face and neck, massaging it into the skin using light, upward strokes.. Stop use if you develop redness or itching.. . Values: . Vegan.. Artificial fragrance-free, paraben-free, gluten-free. Cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Calm-Essentiel Restoring Treatment Oil 30ml
listings.description: ''The Clarins Calm-Essentiel Restoring Treatment Oil is an SOS saviour for reactive and sensitive skin in need of a soothing and calming touch of nourishment; it instantly and continuously soothes redness, discomfort and irritation.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Plus, an added dose of camellia oil nourishes the skin while providing antioxidant protection against environmental aggressors, with organic apricot kernel oil providing non-greasy moisture.. . Why it's Escentual: . We're big fans of Clarins as they expertly balance nature with scientific advancements, and the Calm-Essentiel range is no different! We love this lightweight oil and how quickly it nourishes and softens the complexion. It's ideal for those with sensitive skin, and also those who struggle with occasional flare-ups - due to weather changes, hormones or stress - as it instantly eases discomfort, dryness, tightness and redness. The nourishing oil is lightweight and leaves skin velvety smooth and silky-soft, helping you achieve calmer and more supple skin.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Massage the oil into your face and neck every evening.. . The Sustainable Side: . The matte white glass bottle is made from recycled glass while the outer packaging is recyclable and comes from sustainably managed forests..

listings.rawTitle: bareMinerals Mineralist Lip Gloss Balm 4g / Imagination
listings.description: ‘’The bareMinerals Mineralist Lip Gloss Balm looks like a gloss but acts like a balm. listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Gorgeous! Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: '˜'When I spray Michael Kors Gorgeous! I feel nothing short of, yes - gorgeous! The bold white floral and tobacco smokiness makes me feel like a laid-back boss woman in a clean suit, wearing head-to-toe MK accessories!'' - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Michael Kors Gorgeous!: . A smoky, white floral fragrance with a base of creamy woods.. Embodies the glamorous modern style of Michael Kors.. Eye-catching bottle with rose gold detailing.. . What Does Michael Kors Gorgeous! Smell Like? . Gorgeous! Eau de Parfum shares similarities to the best-selling YSL Libre; it has a similar floral-woody tone with a calming lavender feel to it (even though it isn't listed!). However, Michael Kors' fragrance leaves a floral trail that feels altogether more classically feminine and smokier than Libre.. Gorgeous! has a laid-back chic vibe which, as it wears, releases prominent notes of jasmine and tuberose; this is combined with an undeniably smoky tobacco accord that weaves through every level of the fragrance, enhancing the sensuality of the woody base.. Top notes are Bergamot, Citrus, Mandarin, Pink Pepper. Heart notes are Jasmine Sambac, Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, Neroli (Orange Blossom), Orange Flower, Tobacco. Base notes are Cashmeran, Cedar, Cedarwood, Suede, Tonka Bean, Guaiac Wood, Styrax, Wood. . Why it's Escentual: . Everything about this Michael Kors fragrance is absolutely gorgeous; the message behind it, which aims to empower women and inspire optimism and confidence, is one that Escentual can get behind - and of course, we're all for the deliciously smoky and creamy floral scent too! Even down to the smallest detail, Gorgeous! is intended to make you feel good. This is reflected in the way that the tiny affirmation of "Hello Gorgeous" is engraved into the base of the bottle neck, reminding you every time you spray - even if you don't feel it - that you are beautiful and strong!. . The best way to use it: . Spray on your pulse points and top up after 4 hours to make sure your scent lasts.. .

listings.rawTitle: Vichy Mineral 89 Probiotic Fractions 30ml
listings.description: ''If you're a fan of Vichy's iconic Mineral 89, but you're looking for a serum that targets your acutely stressed skin, then the Vichy Mineral 89 Probiotic Fractions serum is made for you.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Vichy Mineral 89 Probiotic Fractions: . Repairing serum for stressed skin.. Clinically proven to improve dullness, elasticity, stress lines and radiance.. Supports the repair and regeneration of the disrupted skin barrier.. Enhances skin strength to guard against stressors.. . What You Need To Know: . Mineral 89 with added benefits for stressed skin, Vichy's probiotic serum uses the probiotic fractions cultivated in their world-renowned Volcanic Mineralising Water. This natural mineral-rich water strengthens the skin's natural defence while boosting weakened skin in need of extra care. The serum also features 4% niacinamide to protect against environmental damage, soothe skin and even out tone. With additional antioxidants, the serum helps repair and reinforce the skin's natural strength to futureproof your complexion against skin stressors.. . Why it's Escentual: . If you're a fan of Vichy, the chances are, you've either tried their Mineral 89 serum for yourself or you've heard others rave about it; it's an icon that's adored worldwide. So, as soon as we saw a new addition to the line up - a probiotic version - we were excited to say the least! We were incredibly intrigued to see what changes had been made to their cult classic serum and try it for ourselves. And it's safe to say that the serum certainly doesn't disappoint.. The thing we love most about this serum is how it's been specially created for those who suffer from stressed skin. Not only can stress play a huge part in our general health and wellbeing, but it can have a knock-on effect when it comes to our skin, too, as it may result in weakened skin that struggles to defend itself.. The serum cares for stressed skin to help your complexion feel its healthiest and happiest; it's the reparative recharge that stressed skin craves. And just because it's hardworking - it targets everything from dullness to stress lines - that doesn't mean that the serum isn't comfortable to wear. Its liquid gel texture absorbs really quickly and easily, so it doesn't feel sticky, heavy or greasy. Instead, it's so featherlight that you'd be forgiven for forgetting you had it on!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to clean, dry skin before moisturising. Gently pat the serum into your skin using soft, pressured dabs, allowing the skin to fully absorb the formula.. When applying in the morning, use alongside an SPF after moisturising to finish off your routine for a nourished, radiant and shielded skin barrier.. . Values: . Dermatologist-tested and hypoallergenic.. Fragrance-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Pharmaceris T Comedo Acne Anti-Comedone Cream 40ml
listings.description: ''Mattify your complexion with the Pharmaceris T Comedo Acne Anti-Comedone Cream, a daily treatment that reduces the size of blackheads and whiteheads for smoother, clearer skin.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Pharmaceris' Acne Treatment: . Improves skin texture in as little as 6 hours.. Reduces the visibility of imperfections and congested pores in only 6 days.. Lightweight, mattifying texture.. Easy-to-use precision applicator.. Dermatologically-tested.. . What You Need To Know: . Created by Dr Irena Eris in collaboration with the Centre of Science and Research, this efficient formula uses a synergy of azeloglicina and shikimic acid to lighten dark patches caused by acne scarring while minimising the visibility of blackheads and whiteheads, so you can achieve a clearer and more even complexion. Rounded off with niacinamide to ease redness caused by painful spots or pimples, the formula also helps to reduce excess oil production. Pharmaceris have delivered fast-acting results - ideal for anyone who likes to see an instant improvement in their skin.. . Why it's Escentual: . We know that the battle with oily, acne-prone skin can be draining, so we love that Pharmaceris' Anti-Comedone Cream meets the exact needs of this skin type by unclogging pores and refining skin texture. We also love how practical the dermatologist-approved formula is; it instantly absorbs into the skin for a mattified look that's prepped for your makeup routine.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to the face every morning and evening after cleansing.. Please note that this treatment may cause visible, temporary peeling; this shows that the formula is working hard behind the scenes.. . Values: . Dermatologically-tested.. .

listings.rawTitle: Ferragamo Oceani di Seta Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''If you love nothing more than the ocean lapping at your feet and an ice-cream in hand, then Salvatore Ferragamo Oceani di Seta should be on your list of fragrances to try.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Oceani di Seta: . Salty, oceanic fragrance with an aquatic-floral tone.. Long-lasting unisex Eau de Parfum.. Designed to be layered with the Storie di Seta collection.. Features an exclusive accord that uses 62.2% renewable ingredients and 99.1% biodegradable ingredients.. Glass bottle adorned with red corals and precious marine elements.. . What Does Giardini di Seta Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Emilie Coppermann and Aliénor Massenet's Eau de Parfum hits you with a wave of fresh, salty seawater before a handful of velvety magnolia petals are thrown into the mix. The lemon-like, luscious floral facet blends with Ferragamo's exclusive Filo di Seta accord before the base of vanillary, almond-like heliotrope creates a warm, hazy mood.. Top note is a Salty Accord. Heart notes are Magnolia and an exclusive Filo di Seta Accord. Base note is Heliotrope. . Why it's Escentual: . We love the way that Oceani di Seta Eau de Parfum certainly plays with the oceanic theme, especially when you first spritz the fragrance. Still, it also has a charming floral tone before the seductive, cosy vanilla-like base kicks in. It almost smells like creamy white flowers that are bobbing around after the shore has picked them up. Plus, heliotrope adds a gourmand, almond-like tone that's truly addictive, and could even recall ice cream on the beach!. We also love that this fragrance is bold and confident enough on its own, but it's not overbearing or intense, meaning that it pairs beautifully with any - or all - of the Storie di Seta perfumes. Plus, they are all united by the Filo di Seta facet to help them work in harmony. But as much as we could talk about the scent all day long, we have to give a special mention to the bottle. The flacon is decorated with vivid corals and sea creatures; the design wouldn't feel at all out of place on one of Ferragamo's iconic silk creations, which has wowed the fashion world since the '60s.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto the pulse points to get the most out of this scent. To enhance and reimagine the perfume, pair with one or more fragrances from the Storie di Seta collection.. . The Sustainable Side: . Oceani di Seta includes an exclusive Filo di Seta exclusive accord made using 62.2% renewable and 99.1% biodegradable ingredients. This accord is made using the likes of Lilybelle® - a note created from orange peel using a sustainable extraction process - and Timut pepper, which is sourced from Fair Trade farms.. .

listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream SPF30 75ml
listings.description: ''The Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Hand Cream SPF 30 offers UVA and UVB protection for the prevention of age spots whilst the active ingredients combat existing damage caused by sun exposure; it's softening, nourishing and protective!'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Eucerin Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream: . Nourishing hand cream for mature skin types and dark spots.. Provides skin with 24 hour hydration.. SPF 30 protection against UVA and UVB rays.. Active ingredients target age spots, loss of elasticity and deep wrinkles.. Dermatologically-tested.. High efficiency formula containing hyaluronic-acid, thiamidol and acrtiin.. . What You Need To Know: . Part of the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range, this hand cream is ideal for mature skin types concerned with age spots and loss of elasticity. Eucerin's dermatologically-tested formula contains active ingredients, including their patatended thiamidol, which reduces the uneven distribution of melanin, one of the main causes of age spots. This is blended with hydrating and plumping hyaluronic acid, alongside acrtiin, which encourages collagen production for younger looking hands. Plus, the Eucerin hand cream also helps to prevent the occurrence of future age spots with added SPF 30 protection against UVA and UVB rays.. . Why it's Escentual: . With over 100 years of skincare experience, Eucerin has created an all-rounder with the Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity hand cream, which both prevents and repairs damage caused by sun exposure. We love this thick, nourishing texture as it melts into the skin easily, leaving behind a natural, moisturised feel for up to 24 hours. This handy bottle is great for travelling and easily slots in your handbag for a top up of protective nourishment throughout the day. Plus, Eucerin's clinical tested formulas are suitable for all skin-types, so everyone can protect their hands in the sun.. . The Best Way To Use It: . A little goes a long way! Squeeze a small amount onto the hands and massage in until the cream is absorbed. Do not use any products containing thiamidol more than 4 times a day.. . Values: . Dermatologically-tested..

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Men Face Cleanser 125ml
listings.description: ''A must-have for male skin, the Shiseido Face Cleanser for men takes cleansing seriously; it removes everyday dirt and oil, helps lock in moisture and leaves skin visibly fresh and smooth.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Shiseido Men Face Cleanser: . Rich, fine-textured foam face wash for men.. Leaves skin refreshed, hydrated and purified.. Centres around an innovative Dirt Tracker Complex.. Also doubles up as a shaving foam.. . What You Need To Know: . Made for male skin, Shiseido's face wash is powered by a clever Dirt Tracker Complex to offer an antioxidant effect while deeply cleansing skin and locking in much-needed hydration. It also targets excess sebum for a healthy, fresh and oil-free look. The male cleanser contains a botanical Japanese TSUBAKI Extract for antioxidant protection to defend skin continuously. At the same time, it works hard to remove dirt, oil and leftover product for fresh and invigorated skin.. . Why it's Escentual: . When it comes to Shiseido, we always expect impressive tech, and it's safe to say that their Dirt Tracker Complex is just that. We love that it helps address excess sebum - which is more typical for male skin - while still ensuring that skin retains moisture.. Plus, we love how quick and effortless this facial cleanser is to use. It has a rich, creamy texture at first, but it lathers up to cover the entire complexion in a rich, fine-textured foam in seconds. It's ideal that the foam doesn't run but instead covers skin in a thin layer, making the cleansing process much easier. The foamy cleanser is perfect to use as a shaving foam, while you can even use it to cleanse your complexion in the shower if you're pushed for time. Oh, and you'll love the fresh, herbal and aromatic scent as it interacts with warm water. After use, skin feels fresh, smooth and thoroughly cleansed.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Wet your hands and face before using a small amount of the cleanser, working it up into a rich lather, and cleansing the face using circular motions. Take care to avoid the eyes. Rinse thoroughly after use.. . Values: . Dermatologist-tested.. Non-comedogenic.. .

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Men Ultimune Power Infusing Serum 50ml
listings.description: ''The Shiseido Men Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate is a lightweight serum for men that strengthens skin, provides targeted antioxidants and helps with damage recovery, all while offering lasting hydration.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Shiseido Men Ultimune Power Serum: . Anti-ageing serum for male skin.. Provides 32 hours of continuous hydration.. Boosts the skin's resistance to damage.. Strengthen skin's defences.. Minimises signs of ageing and fatigue.. . What You Need To Know: . Powered by Triple TSUBAKI Technology - which centres around antioxidant Japanese camellia extract - the Shiseido Men serum strengthens the skin's defences while minimising signs of ageing and fatigue. While skin benefits from a boost of antioxidants, the serum also helps with damage recovery and provides a lasting shot of moisture. The result? Skin looks and feels healthy, vibrant and energetic from the inside out.. . Why it's Escentual: . When it comes to Shiseido, we always have high expectations that their formulas will feature impressive ingredients and powerhouse technologies; unsurprisingly, this serum doesn't disappoint. As Shiseido's research has found that men's skin differs from women's in its ability to protect and defend itself from intrinsic and environmental aggressors, the formula boosts the skin's natural defences while promoting a well-rested, youthful look.. But that's not all we've come to expect from Shiseido; we also expect luxe designs and sophisticated bottles, and with the classy yet still undeniably masculine ombre bottle of this serum, Shiseido delivers on this front, too. The Ultimune Power Concentrate has a lightweight liquid texture that melts into skin with ease for a non-sticky and non-greasy feel, with a subtle aromatic scent to perk up and revive your complexion.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use both morning and night after cleansing and before moisturising. Press the pump twice into the palm of your hand and spread evenly over the entire face.. . Values: . Dermatologist-tested. Non-comedogenic..

listings.description: ''Looking to lock in moisture for up to 32 hours? The Shiseido Energising Moisturiser for men is just what you're looking for; the ultra-light facial fluid offers continuous hydration but it still absorbs really quickly for a non-greasy finish.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Combats the look of fine lines, dullness and dehydration.. Can also be used as an eye cream.. . What You Need To Know: . listings.rawTitle: Hollister Canyon Escape for Him Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''Take your senses on a trip to the west coast of America with Hollister Canyon Escape for Him, a woody-fresh Eau de Toilette that exudes a sense of excitement, optimism and untamable energy.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Hollister Canyon Escape for Him: . Creates a fresh, uplifting feeling.. Lasting Eau de Toilette.. Part of the Canyon Escape collection.. Square glass bottle with a rock formation-inspired top. . What Does Canyon Escape Smell Like? . Canyon Escape for Him opens with a bold collision of spices and citrus for a fresh yet nuanced feel as the zest of bergamot meets the warmth of black pepper. The heart combines soothing herbal notes with warm woody facets, before the earthy dry down of patchouli, oakmoss and amber offers a free-spirited and natural edge. Top notes are Bergamot, Black Pepper, Cardamom. Heart notes are Sage, California Juniper, Vetiver. Base notes are Patchouli, Oakmoss, Amber. . . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we're all for any fragrance that creates a memory or mood, especially if that mood reminds us of the fun and carefree spirit you adopt on holiday. So, as soon as we heard that Canyon Escape for men was inspired by the unexpected excitement of a detour while road tripping across the glorious west coast of America, we knew we'd be hooked. And let's just say; it's definitely an escape for the senses. The fragrance feels fresh and energetic at first, while we love how the warm woody notes recall the natural aromas of the world - especially the California juniper facet, which celebrates the American heritage of the fashion house of Hollister.. Even the double-walled glass flacon creates a feeling of an American road trip - from the fun, optimistic blue-sky coloured liquid to the angled glass top that looks like a jagged rock face. And of course, all Hollister fans will love and appreciate the rich, woody cap embossed with Hollister's iconic bird-in-flight logo.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz the Eau de Toilette onto the neck, chest and wrists to get the most out of Canyon Escape for Him.. .

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Canyon Escape For Her Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: ''Escape to the desert with Hollister Canyon Escape For Her, an ode to free-spirited adventure and late summer evenings. This Eau de Parfum takes you on a trip through Californian canyons, allowing you to breathe in fruity splashes, floral bursts and woody tones on your journey.'' - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Hollister Canyon Escape For Her: . Creates a warm, care-free feeling.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Part of the Canyon Escape collection.. A glass bottle with an embossed wooden lid reflective of rock formations.. . What Does Hollister Canyon Escape Eau De Parfum Smell Like? . Initially, this perfume greets you with a burst of sweet citrus reminiscent of a walk through the streets of Seville. There is a subtle floral tone in the heart, which is reflective of Hollister's summer inspiration. Finally, the warm musky notes in the base add a sensual tone that mimics sun-kissed skin.. Top notes are Blood Orange, Mandarin, Cactus Water. Heart notes are Solar Accord, Orange Blossom, Desert Rose, Oris Fusion. Base notes are Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Musk. . . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, any perfume that takes us on an olfactory adventure is an instant win. Hollister's inspiration for Canyon Escape For Her celebrates the experience of an escape through the Californian canyons. This theme immediately comes across through the initial burst of fresh floral fun, reflected in the desert rose and cactus water facets, before the scent welcomes the toasty, woody base notes.. The subtle pink colour reminds us of daylight fading against a backdrop of cactus flowers as friends enjoy an American road trip; plus, the jagged glass bottle reflects the rock formations you might see along your journey through the canyons, finished off by a beautiful natural wood cap embossed with the instantly recognisable Hollister logo.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto the neck and wrists for a scent that lasts.. .

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum 60ml
listings.description: SHOW YOUR POWER. SHOW Y. . "If you're looking for a bold, sophisticated and intense woody fragrance, then I think you'll love the Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum, it's a deep aromatic-fougere fragrance for men that starts with a rush of sweetness and is enveloped in dark and sensual woods." - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Y Le Parfum : . Smooth and intense Parfum.. Long-lasting masculine aroma.. Intense flanker to the iconic Y range.. Signature weighted rectangle bottle dressed in lacquered black.. . What Does Y Le Parfum Smell Like? . Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum is a bolder take on the original Eau de Parfum, it's more complex and is utterly masculine and sophisticated. It starts with a light sweetness, which is in contrast to the depth of the scent. This is achieved through zesty grapefruit and the fresh lightness of aldehydes. This warms to a vibrant aromatic heart of French lavender with sage and geranium, but it's the dark backdrop that's the true star. The sensual base brings together black cedarwood with patchouli, incense and tonka bean for a dark, smoky woodiness that lingers beautifully on the skin. Top notes are grapefruit, ginger, elemi, aldehydes. Heart notes are French lavender, sage, geranium. Base notes are American black cedarwood, olibanum, patchouli, tonka bean, incense. . . Why it's Escentual: . We love when a brand takes an already captivating scent and gives it even more depth and complexity, and that's exactly what Yves Saint Laurent has done with this fragrance. Y Le Parfum is a darker and woodier take on the original, making it perfect for your new signature evening scent. We love the way it plays with sharp citrus and envelops it in a cocoon of dark woods and sensual musky tones for an undeniably seductive and masculine scent. We imagine it would make the perfect companion to a clean and crisp black shirt.. And we have to tell you about the bottle. The weighted rectangle flacon takes inspiration from its Y predecessors, but it's now dressed in an elegant glossy midnight black. Its edges are sleek and sharp, with the signature Y cut out of the glass. '˜Yves Saint Laurent' is written across the front in silver, reflecting the lightness of the start amidst the depth of the dark scent. The black lid has a textured feel to it, with a brushed silver top embossed with the iconic YSL logo.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray the Le Parfum on the pulse points for the most intensified version of this scent..

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Greenley Eau de Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: '˜'Breathe in the utterly fresh and vibrant scents of the natural world with Parfums de Marly Greenley Eau de Parfum, a niche premium fragrance for men that centres around a masterful blend of fruity and woody notes.'' - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Parfums de Marly Greenley: . Woody, fruity scent that honours the natural world.. Incredibly long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Held in an elegant emerald green bottle with the Parfums de Marly emblem. . What Does Greenley Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Parfums de Marly Greenley is a whirlwind of fruit, citrus, bark and sap; it's just like walking through a sun-dappled wood in the heart of the summer when the air is alive with the sounds and scents of the natural environment. Greenley is a true celebration of nature's finest aromas; it starts with a burst of freshness as crisp green apple mingles with bright, sunny citrus facets, while cashmere wood hints at the woodier, earthier tones to come. The heart creates a woody, leaf-like feel before the earthier, softer and more sensual base warms through on the skin. It lasts for hours too, so you can enjoy this long-lasting scent long into the night. Top notes are Sicilian bergamot, mandarin, green apple and cashmere wood. Heart notes are cedarwood, petitgrain, violet and pomarose. Base notes are oakmoss, musk and an amberwood accord. . Why it's Escentual: . Parfums de Marly are always greatly inspired by the history of France and the opulence of French nobility, which is why both their name and heritage is so closely tied to the setting of ChÃ¢teau of Marly, one of the finest French palaces commissioned by Louis XIV. We love that Parfums de Marly has taken their love for this palace a step further as the exuberant, elegant home is now also the direct inspiration for their scent of 2021, Greenley. The stately home merges true splendour with an appreciation for nature, as does the Greenley scent, thanks to its blend of high-quality perfume notes that are inspired by the natural world.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz Greenley directly onto your pulse points to get the most out of this fragrance.. .

Features concealing mineral pigments to tint and cover fair to very fair skin.. . Why it's Escentual: . We were incredibly excited when we first read about Uriage's Roseliane CC Cream. Why? But it doesn't stop there; the patented TLR2-Regul complex works alongside ginseng and red algae to soothe skin and minimise redness. The lightweight cream also features an organic UV filtering complex that offers very high protection against UVB and UVA rays, helping to further prevent signs of redness. Plus, the CC cream also includes light, mineral-rich pigments to instantly unify and correct redness-prone or dulling complexions.. The formula has a creamy, melting texture with a very subtle fragrance that adds a pampering experience to your routine. It keeps skin soothed, hydrated, protected and comfortable while helping you achieve a natural-looking flawless complexion, that's free from redness and irritation.. . The best way to use it: . Massage a generous amount into a clean, dried complexion every morning, taking care to avoid the eye area.. . Values: . Dermatologically-tested. Non-comedogenic..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Self Tanning Milky Lotion 125ml
listings.description: ''Build a natural and even tan with the Clarins Self Tanning Milky Lotion, a gradual tanning body lotion that provides a radiant and bronzed warmth while smoothing and hydrating the skin.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Clarins Self Tanning Milky Lotion: . 89% natural origin self-tanning lotion.. Moisturises skin for 24 hours.. Builds a natural-looking and radiant tan.. Blurring the lines between a self tan and a body lotion, the Clarins Self Tanning Milky Lotion is a nourishing delight that provides a gradual golden tan. Apply daily until you achieve the intensity of tan you want, then reduce application frequency to maintain your tan..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Express Self-Tanning Fresh Gel 125ml
listings.description: ''Get that vacation-fresh golden glow in no time at all with the Clarins Express Self-Tanning Fresh Gel a lightweight and 100% natural self tanner for the body that leaves a warm bronzed glow while hydrating and softening skin.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why it's Escentual: . The Clarins Express Self-Tanning Fresh Gel is a pampering way to enhance your skin's glow! If you hate thick, greasy and sticky self-tan formulas that leave unwanted streaks, then this one was made for you. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 50ml
listings.description: ''Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum is perhaps even sexier than its predecessor; it's intense, full-bodied and effortlessly seductive as it blends the iconic tonka bean note with a zesty citrus start and a cosy vanilla backdrop.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Code Eau de Parfum: . Effortlessly seductive and subtly intense fragrance for men.. Impressive lasting power with a lingering masculine warmth.. 2021 addition to the iconic Code family with the latest 2024 renovated look.. Sustainably-sourced Provencal lavender offers a soft, powdery aromatic heart.. Sleek and elegant glossy black bottle with a chrome-gold lid.. . What Does Code Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Smooth, sensual and seductive, Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Parfum conveys the mood of intense yet effortless seduction. The warm and intense scent opens with a surprisingly zesty start thanks to the sparkling essence of lemon, which is energised by luminous mandarin and tart bergamot. The heart is both soft and aromatic as rosemary and lavender provide a magnetic aromatic effect before the warm base of Code's signature tonka bean shines through. This is now even more sensual and rich, thanks to an enhanced roasting process, while cedar wood provides a dry and musky woodiness. A suede accord offers a masculine and powdery edge, but the true star has to be the vanilla, which shines through with a multifaceted depth and a creamy warm cosiness.. Top notes are lemon essence, mandarin and bergamot. Heart notes are rosemary and lavender. Base notes are tonka bean, suede, vanilla and cedar. . . Why it's Escentual: . Here at Escentual, we're big fans of the Code range, and have fallen in love with each of its flankers. Code Eau de Parfum is no exception; it's beautifully unique in its cosy warmth yet shares a similar DNA as the rest of the Code family, so you can tell it's a signature Armani scent. It's ideal for the modern man who likes his fragrance to remain sensual and seductive, but with a sweet and soft edge. It plays with contrasts as the zesty lemon start soon warms to a soft aromatic feel before welcoming in that cosy addictive vanilla note that will make you want to snuggle up and stay close.. And we have to tell you about the bottle! Standing tall, the Code Eau de Parfum bottle exudes an understated elegance. The signature flacon retains the same elongated design, and is dressed in a glossy black shade, like the original. It now has the addition of a sleek chrome gold lid, which only fits on in a certain way to maintain the slightly-curved yet silky-smooth shape. Our favourite part has to be the textured band at the neck of the bottle; it's inspired by the classic tailoring of a tuxedo's cummerbund, ensuring the bottle is dressed in pure sophistication.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray Armani Code Eau de Parfum onto the pulse points for an intense and prolonged wear..

Adds a subtle shimmer to the skin as it catches the light.. Features Ultrasun's iconic lamellar technology.. Water-resistant formula.. Suitable for all skin types - including sensitive skin.. Reef-friendly vegan formula.. . Why it's Escentual: . Ultrasun's Glimmer MAX SPF30 is a sun protector with a difference; the advanced lamellar formula of course protects against harmful UVA, UVB and Infrared-A rays - which you'd expect from such an expert suncare brand. listings.rawTitle: Pharmaceris W Hydro-Protective Brightening Day Cream SPF50+ 30ml
listings.description: ''The Pharmaceris W Hydro-Protective Brightening Day Cream SPF50+ is highly concentrated in niacinamide, which is dermatologically proven to reduce the appearance of dark spots and even out skin tone, while also protecting against future pigmentation marks forming.'' - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love Pharmaceris W Hydro-Protective Brightening Day Cream SPF50+ : . Broad-spectrum SPF50+ protection.. 4% niacinamide fades existing dark spots and prevents them from forming.. Vitamin C and Biomimetic-Peptide Complex reduces hyperpigmentation and even skin tone.. Vitamin E's antioxidant powers delay skin ageing.. . What You Need To Know: . Fading and preventing dark spots is the Albucin Day Cream SPF50+'s speciality, and you'll see results in just four weeks. The formula contains 4% niacinamide, with properties comparable to hydroquinone, an ingredient used in lightening medical treatments. Niacinamide is very safe and works by blocking melanin synthesis and its movement to the skin's surface, preventing pigmentation marks in the future.. Vitamin C and E are also in the cream moisturiser; this antioxidant duo helps to even skin tone and delay skin ageing, along with the very high, broad-spectrum SPF50+ with chemical filters.. . Why it's Escentual: . Hyperpigmentation can appear for a variety of reasons from sun exposure and hormonal changes to pregnancy; the Pharmaceris W Hydro-Protective Brightening Day Cream SPF50+ can help tackle your dark spots, no matter how they were caused. The lightweight cream, when used daily, will fade your pigmentation marks, and don't worry, the formula doesn't cause de-pigmentation of healthy skin.. The travel-size tube is ideal for your handbag, which is perfect as it's advised - for best results - to re-apply during the day. What's even better, the formula feels like nothing on the skin, and leaves no white cast.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to pigmentation marks 2-4 times a day.. . Values: . Dermatologically-tested.. Cruelty-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Pharmaceris V Viti-Melo Repigmentation Night Cream 40ml
listings.description: ''Nourish your vitiligo-affected skin and wake up to a more even and unified complexion with the Pharmaceris V Viti-Melo Night Cream, an overnight moisturiser that reverses discolouration while preventing vitiligo patches from reappearing.'' - Caitlin, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you'll love the Pharmaceris V Night Cream: . Specialist night cream for vitiligo skin.. Supports pigment production and prevents depigmentation.. Stimulates vitamin D receptor.. Reduces vitiligo lesions and prevents their enlargement.. Prevents new vitiligo patches.. High tolerance for even very sensitive skin.. Can be used from 5 years of age and with NB-UVB lamp.. . What You Need To Know: . A powerful formula packed with unique complexes and patents, the Pharmaceris V Viti-Melo Night Cream has been created for those with vitiligo-affected skin; it works to undo the damage and prevent it from reappearing. A unique blend of rosmarinic acid and thioproline interacts with vitiligo cells and provides an anti-inflammatory effect. The overnight moisturiser protects the mitochondria against oxidative damage - a cause of vitiligo - and provides supreme protection against free radicals. The active ingredients prevent discolouration while supporting the production of new pigment and silencing the genes responsible for vitiligo. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: Experience the blue scent of Parfums de Marly Percival, an aromatic unisex fragrance with citrus and woody facets that is both fresh and powerful.. The perfume features all the quality and refinement that you've come to expect from this prestigious fragrance house.. An iconic blue Eau de Parfum, Percival opens with a truly fresh burst of bergamot and mandarin, which are then enhanced with the soft spice of pink peppercorn. The aromatic heart blends lavender and geranium with the warmth of cardamom, before revealing the woody backdrop of balsam fir, woody spices and creamy tonka bean for a deep and masculine ending to this fresh scent.. Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum Smells Similar To . When you first spray this fragrance it reminds you of diving into an icy blue ocean, and the first moment the cool water hits your face.. The traditional shape of the body of the bottle is blue to match the cool Eau de Parfum inside, bottled with a weighty top in pale gold.. Why We Love It . We love this fragrance as it's a niche take on a classic blue fragrance but made more premium with the addition of refined ingredients and exceptional longevity. When you first spray you get a hit of citrus notes like bergamot and mandarin for that fresh feel, but it also has masculine sophistication thanks to traditional male note lavender, as well as a sensual note of woody spice. The aroma itself is wearable and not too overpowering, which makes it great for the office or during the summer months.. How To Use It . Apply to the pulse points and wait for it to diffuse.. The notes in Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum are . Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Pink Pepper.. Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium, Cardamom.. Base Notes: Balsam Fir, Woody spices, Tonka Bean..

The Story Behind Parfums de Marly Pegasus Eau de Parfum . Formulated by perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani, Pegasus Eau de Parfum is named after a winning racehorse from the 18th Century. As a bestseller, it's clear that the niche fragrance has inherited the same prestigious qualities of this thoroughbred with a refined selection of ingredients that aim to recreate the golden age of perfume refinery shown in King Louis XV's court. Thoroughbred horses and perfumery were two of his specialities and this fragrance encapsulates both of these qualities, along with class and regal sophistication.. At first, Pegasus blends woody cypress with bergamot and vanilla-like heliotrope before balancing white floral jasmine with aromatic lavender and bitter almond in the heart. Finally, the sensual, cosy base of sweet vanilla, amber and sandalwood is unveiled.. Parfums de Marly Pegasus Eau de Parfum Smells Similar To . When this perfume develops on the skin, it emits a scent that reminds us of vanilla ice cream, giving this fragrance an undeniable nostalgic and comforting feel. However, this doesn't mean it lacks the elegance and style that fans of Parfums de Marly appreciate - it's still elegant and sophisticated.. About Parfums de Marly Pegasus Eau de Parfum Bottle . As soon as you glance over at this bottle you know that it belongs to a niche perfume house. The pale golden bottle is eye-catching, and the unusual shape of the triangle lid and rounded square bottle matches the rest of the Parfums de Marly collection. Any fan will recognise the two equestrian statues emblematic of King Louis XV's Chevaux de Marly.. Why We Love It . We know we are not alone when we say that we love this fragrance.
