listings.rawTitle: Phyto Phytocyane Reactional Anti-Hair Loss Treatment for Women 12 x 5ml
listings.description: Restore your hair's thickness, health and density with the Phyto Phytocyane Thinning Hair Treatment for Women, a scalp serum solution that supports fuller, thicker locks.. With triple action results on fine, thinning and lacklustre locks, the Phyto Thinning Hair Treatment is an advanced formula that supports thickness, fullness and shine. The hair serum stimulates microcirculation in the scalp and provides essential nutrients to create an optimal environment for new hair growth. The expert blend increases the thickness and density of each hair strand by boosting keratin synthesis at the follicle level.. Packed with botanical active ingredients, the Phyto serum helps to promote hair growth with the inclusion of ginkgo biloba. The conditioning and antioxidant abilities of cinchona bark extract stimulates and purifies the scalp, helping to protect hair from external aggressors. Grape seed procyanidins restore your hair's natural shine and vibrancy, while a duo of B vitamins offer nourishment to rebuild and strengthen damaged strands.. An added bonus? This hair care treatment course will also help to keep grey at bay when used year-round, so you can enjoy healthy and younger-looking hair that's bouncing with life.. Why We Love It . All sorts of things can cause women's hair to thin, including stress, fatigue, diet, pregnancy, medication and menopause. This is completely normal for many women and isn't anything to be embarrassed about, but it can knock peoples' confidence, especially if they're used to thicker hair. If this is the case for you and you're looking to restore your own confidence in yourself and your locks then the Phytocyane treatment is here to help.. The powerful serum is held in individual amber ampulets that adds a scientific-salon touch to your at-home hair care experience. The Phytocyane three month treatment has become a cult favourite as it epitomises Phyto's innovative expertise to create enhanced and beautifying hair care products using the power of plants to target common concerns of women when it comes to their tresses and provide results.. How To Use It . Apply to dry or towel-dried hair. Apply one full application at the roots and massage in to stimulate the scalp and encourage diffusion. Leave in and do not rinse, style as usual.. To use as an intensive treatment, apply three times a week for one month, then once a week for two months.. To use to maintain your hair, apply once a week.. Works Well With . To enhance the efficacy of this hardworking hair treatment, make sure you match it with a thickening shampoo from the Phyto Phytocyane collection..

listings.rawTitle: Phyto Phytocyane Anti-Hair Loss Shampoo 250ml
listings.description: Revitalise a sluggish scalp, strengthen fragile hair fibres from the root, and unlock a visibly denser, fuller head of hair with the Phyto Phytocyane Invigorating Anti-Hair Loss Shampoo, a high-performance botanical treatment engineered to combat thinning hair.. Specially designed for individuals experiencing temporary or chronic hair thinning, increased shedding, and fine, lifeless strands, this advanced daily shampoo acts as an essential stimulating prep step for anti-hair loss treatments. Its lightweight fluid texture builds into a rich, active lather that gently sweeps away excess sebum and environmental impurities without stripping the scalp's delicate ecosystem. By delivering a concentrated dose of vital nutrients directly to the hair follicle, it works to optimise the scalp environment and boost natural thickness, leaving your hair looking beautifully voluminous, shiny, and structurally reinforced.. Benefits . Optimises Thinning Hair Routines: Preps the scalp canvas perfectly, maximising the absorption and efficiency of leave-on hair loss ampoules. . Anchors and Strengthens Fibres: Fortifies the hair structure from root to tip, significantly reducing breakage and shedding during brushing.. Boosts Instant Volume: Plumps and coats fine strands to deliver immediate body, lift, and bounce right from the first wash.. Stimulates Scalp Micro-circulation: Invigorates the hair root to support healthy, active, and robust hair growth.. Improves Hair Elasticity and Shine: Smooths down the hair cuticle to restore a vibrant, healthy light reflectivity and smooth texture.. The Science Behind the Formula Phyto leverages pioneering botanical extraction and trichological science to structurally protect and fuel the hair follicle:. Ginkgo Biloba Extract: A high-potency botanical stimulant that re-energises the hair bulb, boosting micro-circulation to supply essential nutrients to growing hair.. Grapeseed Proanthocyanidins (Grapeseed Extract): A powerful natural antioxidant matrix that shields the hair bulb from oxidative stress, preventing premature ageing and weakening of the hair root.. Cinchona Bark Decoction: An exclusive botanical infusion that replaces traditional water in the formula, utilising natural toning properties to stimulate and fortify the scalp tissue.. Pro-Vitamins B5 & B6: A vital vitamin synergy that deeply hydrates the hair shaft, increases structural elasticity, and stimulates the synthesis of keratin for thicker strands.. Why We Love It We love the Phytocyane Shampoo because it treats the root cause of hair thinning rather than just masking the symptoms. It completely shatters the mould of standard volume shampoos that rely on heavy, artificial coatings that eventually weigh down fine hair; instead, it uses clean, concentrated botanical active ingredients to breathe new life into a tired scalp. It serves as the ultimate confidence-boosting morning wash, transforming limp, flat hair into a visibly denser, thicker-looking mane with an elegant, healthy shine.. How To Use It . Use 2-3 times a week, or daily as your primary treatment wash during periods of high hair shedding.. Apply a small amount of the shampoo to a wet scalp and hair matrix.. Massage gently using your fingertips to stimulate the scalp and work into a rich lather.. Crucial Step: Leave the active lather on the scalp for 2 minutes to allow the botanical extracts to penetrate the hair follicles thoroughly, then rinse away completely with warm water.. Works Well With To deliver an uncompromising, clinical punch against hair thinning, follow this stimulating wash with the targeted Phyto Phytocyane Reactional Anti-Hair Loss Treatment for Women massaged directly into towel-dried roots.. Values Cruelty-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free, silicone-free, mineral oil-free, and expertly dermatologically tested for all thinning hair and sensitive scalp profiles..

More full-bodied than its predecessor, Libre, the Libre Intense Eau de Parfum is a rich and warm scent that blends elegant florals with seductive gourmands and golden ambers.. The sensual fragrance opens with aromatic lavender, juicy bergamot and honeyed tangerine, moving on to a melting bouquet heart. The dry-down is rich and powerful, it'll tantalise you and those around you.. Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Smells Similar To . If you enjoyed the sensual aroma of the original Libre but are looking for something with a seductive depth, then you're sure to be captivated by this long-lasting intense version. listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Discover the deep and seductive scent of HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum, a spicy-woody fragrance for men.. The Story Behind HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled . A warmer and more seductive fragrance than its predecessor, the Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum is a warm-spicy and sensual aroma that's sure to captivate those around you.. The deeply masculine scent opens with a surprisingly juicy start as crisp apple and zesty bergamot offer a hint of freshness which is contrasted quickly with the essence of spicy black pepper. The warm heart brings together sweet and spicy cardamom and cinnamon for a vibrant warmth that's balanced with the peppery and aromatic tones of sage.. The dry down smells very different to the perfumes beginning as it takes a more smokey and leathery route. Olive wood offers a savoury woody edge, which is met with earthy vetiver and enhanced by ethereal musk for a deeply masculine and long-lasting scent.. HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled Smells Similar To . If you like the warm spicy facets of Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum or the hint of spice in the original Boss Bottled Eau de Toilette but want a more intense and seductive punch then this alluring scent will tick all of your boxes.. About HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled's Bottle . The iconic bottle may be familiar to fans of HUGO BOSS' male fragrances as it maintains the simple yet sturdy design of the Eau de Toilette with a few differing notes. The brown-grey juice is unique and unusual yet reflects the musky-woody scent and its masculine tones, while the brushed gold lid and nozzle allude to the hints of spicy warmth within.. Why We Love It . This distinctively masculine and surprising scent is alluring, captivating and magnetic - we love how it moves from fresh and juicy to deep, dark and smokey. It's multifaceted, just like the modern man. We think it would go well with a clean, crisp shirt on freshly showered skin for ultimate charisma and sex appeal.. How To Use It . Spray the Eau de Parfum on the pulse points - wrists, neck, elbows - to intensify and prolong the scent.. Works Well With . If you liked the masculine and captivating aroma of this Eau de Parfum, why not layer it up to experience it fully? Match this fragrance with a body or bathing product from the HUGO BOSS Bottled collection to layer up and intensify this alluring and seductive scent.. The notes in HUGO BOSS Boss Bottled are . Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot, Black Pepper.. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Cardamom, Sage.. Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk, Olivewood.. . 100ml is the new version. .

This perfume is a true celebration of Grasse, and it's clear to see the inspiration and passion in this fragrance, from the central note of orange blossom - which is the heart of both the fragrance and the town - to the illuminated, fresh tone.. Shiseido's high-tech eye cream helps to visibly reduce age-related signs of fatigue - including wrinkles, dark circles and eye bags - in just one week, as it works to create a more radiant, tighter look within a month.. With continued use, the eye area looks firmer, lifted, tightened and more radiant, so you can boast a refreshed, alert and youthful look.. Why We Love It . This eye cream follows in the footsteps of a number of Shiseido's Uplifting and Firming face creams, which all work to lift and tighten the complexion for a more youthful look. So, we love that Shiseido have created a powerful eye cream that's also powered by research, technology and results. If you're a fan of the moisturisers, you'll be just as excited by the eye cream!. listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Intense and impactful, Rabanne 1 Million Parfum for men is stronger and more handsome than ever with its exaggerated leathery scent.. Fans of the original 1 Million fragrance will be aware of its ruggedly handsome scent. When it launched back in 2008, Million was known as '˜the fragrance to be wearing', and over a decade later, it's still at the top spot.. The Eau de Parfum is perfect for men that want more; more intensity, more vibrancy and more longevity. The striking aroma amplifies the sultry notes of leather to bring you a signature that turns heads for the right reasons.. 1 Million Parfum opens with salty tuberose, a white floral note that offers a sophistication to the fragrance, while adding a sense of opulence. This note sits alongside a soft, woody cashmeran accord and dry, musky ambroxide.. The scent then welcomes a hit of leather to create a more intense, masculine scent that draws on the original, before Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud's fragrance reveals a solar leather note and a resinous undertone.. Just like the fragrance, the bottle epitomises wealth and luxury. Like a glistening block of gold, the flacon will take centre stage on your bedside table or bathroom cabinet.. Why We Love It . Just when we thought 1 Million was bold enough, Rabanne launched the incredible Eau de Parfum. For years, the original has been a best-seller at Escentual, so the team was extremely excited to smell it, and we are extremely impressed with its silage, scent and longevity.. Men and women love its floral masculine twist; it's one of those scents that makes you say '˜wow' as soon as you smell it - trust us!. How To Use It . Spray onto your chest, neck and wrist.. Works Well With . Why not feel like a million dollars every day and explore the rest of the 1 Million collection?. Notes . Top Notes: Salty Tuberose, Ambroxide, Cashmeran Accord.. Heart Notes: Leathery Opulence.. Base Notes: Solar Leather Accord, Rockrose Resin..

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Be bold, be daring with the new BVLGARI Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum, a green-woody fragrance for men inspired by the crisp freshness of air.. Quintessentially masculine and deeply seductive, Glacial Essence is the latest flanker to the BVLGARI Man series; it's a contrasting fragrance that's icy, fresh and aromatic. The scent opens with balsamic juniper berries, spicy ginger extract and rosy geranium before welcoming Australian sandalwood, orris concrete and artemisia essence for a green and woody heart.. The dry down comprises Alaskan cedarwood and an exclusive clearwood accord for a long-lasting woodiness that's both charming and powerful, while musk provides an intimate and earthy aroma that lingers beautifully long into the night.. Why We Love It . As big fans of the original BVLGARI Man, we couldn't wait to try the latest edition to the range. From the nose of Alberto Morillas, the contrasting scent is masterful and unique. Each carefully selected note highlights the other, with berries and spices being balanced by petals, and herbs accentuated by a variety of woods. It's cool, unique and fresh - just like the modern man who wears it.. Plus, the icy fragrance is held in a bottle that's just as bold and matches the rest of the BVLGARI Man series perfectly, while still being original. The blue ombre glass is adorned with flashes of silver and white, which represents the purity of air, which the scent was inspired by. We love that the silver spray top twists round to prevent spraying, meaning you can take it on-the-go with you without having to worry about spillages.. How To Use It . Spritz liberally on the pulse points.. Works Well With . Continue to experience the BVLGARI Man charm by losing yourself in the multitude of original fragrances.. Notes . Top Notes: Juniper Berry Essence, Ginger Extract, Geranium Essence.. Heart Notes: Sandalwood Essence, Orris Concrete, Artemisia Essence.. Base Notes: Cedarwood Alaska Essence, Clearwood Accord, Musk Accord..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Ombre 4 Colour Eyeshadow Palette 4.2g / 01 - Fairy Tale Nude Gradation
listings.description: Create show-stopping eye looks with the Clarins Ombre 4 Colour Eyeshadow Palette, a quartet of eyeshadows in matte, satin, glitter and shimmer finishes with up to 12 hours' staying power.. With a quad of intense gradient shades in a multitude of colour harmonies, the possibilities are endless with the Clarins Ombre eyeshadow palette. Each ultra-pigmented, vibrant shade works beautifully together, whether you want to go bold or natural. You can easily achieve a daring smokey eye or opt for a more demure look with a single sweep of colour - the options are exciting and never-ending!. With matte, satin, shimmer and glitter finishes in one palette, the beautifying eyeshadows allow you to create a different eye look every time with a variety of shades, finishes and textures. They blend together seamlessly for a streak-free finish, so even if you're a smokey-eye novice you can ensure your eyes always pop with effortless colour.. With 12 hours' hold, your eyes stay dazzling all night long. The expert formula not only provides intense colour, but it also contains bamboo powder which acts as a primer. This helps the shadow stay put and stay smooth, while antioxidant-rich vitamin E helps to keep the eyelids protected from free radicals with each wear.. Why We Love It . We love multitasking beauty products and the Clarins Ombre 4 Colour Palette is one of those eyeshadow quads that you can use every day and for every occasion - but create a different look each time!. The different colour harmonies; from shimmering pinks to glistening golds, smokey blues to jaded greens, means each eyeshadow palette is elegant, beautiful and ultra-wearable.. And is there anything better than when a palette comes with a compact mirror? The gold circle compact case - with a beautiful shaded lid corresponding to shadow choice - has an integrated mirror and dual-ended eyeshadow brush, making top-ups and sweeps of colour on-the-go effortless.. How To Use It . Using your favourite eyeshadow and blending brushes, sweep the colours over your lids to achieve your desired results. Start with a lighter shade on the lid and sculpt the eye by using a darker shade in the crease, corner and water-line for a dramatic effect.. The shades can be used on their own or combined to create a multitude of dramatic looks - get creative!. Works Well With . Continue to enhance your natural beauty and let it shine through by pairing the Clarins Ombre 4 Colour eyeshadow palette with a Clarins mascara to finish your eye look..

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 75ml
listings.description: Experience the elegantly masculine aroma of Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum, an intense woody-oriental version of the original Le Male fragrance for men.. If you're a fan of the original Le Male, but you're after something more bold and confident, the Le Parfum edition is made for you.. It draws on the aromatic, spicy scent of cardamom when first spritzed, before soothing lavender and powdery iris provide a fresh and sophisticated tone. Jean Paul Gaultier's Eau de Parfum then reveals an addictive and sensual note of cosy vanilla in the base, rounding off Quentin Bisch and Natalie Garcia-Cetto's clever composition.. Just like the scent, the bottle similarly recalls the original Le Male, while giving it an elegant and stylish revamp. The bottle is shaped into a male torso - an iconic Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male emblem - which is dressed in black, with gold trim. The flacon recalls an officer's uniform, with the matte and shiny charcoal black stripes reminding you of the famous sailor advert that debuted our TV screens back in 2009.. Why We Love It . We love how this fragrance combines vibrant and powerful scents like cardamom with aromatic lavender and gourmand vanilla. The result is a fragrance that is both utterly masculine and bold, while still entirely wearable, stylish and elegant. It develops on the skin to reveal a sensual and seductive tone that you'll want to surround yourself with time and again.. How To Use It . Slip off the guard around the neck of the bottle. Spray onto the pulse points - including the neck, chest and wrist.. Works Well With . If you've fallen for this scent, why not explore the rest of the Le Male range?. Notes . Top Notes: Cardamom.. Heart Notes: Lavender, Iris.. Base Notes: Vanilla..

listings.description: Achieve your smoothest possible skin with the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant, a powerful anti-pollution and anti-ageing exfoliant for all skin types, which effectively detoxifies pores.. Perfect for city dwellers who are concerned about ageing, Daily Superfoliant resurfaces skin and fights biochemical and environmental triggers that speed up skin ageing.. Helping you to achieve clearer skin, the highly-active exfoliator absorbs environmental toxins from the pores using activated binchotan charcoal, which purifies the skin. The complexion is guarded against pollution through a blend of niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit, which reduces inflammation and pore appearance.. Harnessing over 30 years of dermatological expertise, Dermalogica has also enriched the daily exfoliant with a blend of skin-smoothing alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Dead skin cells are washed away as lactic acid targets dullness, while malic acid gently exfoliates the skin. A trio of water-activated enzymes - papain, lipase and subtilisin - dissolve dull cells and remove them with ease. The result? Smooth, soft and even skin, which boasts a renewed radiance.. Why We Love It . The innovative Daily Superfoliant is the perfect choice for individuals who lead busy lives, and might see their skin suffering from dullness, clogged pores and signs of premature ageing as a result of their lifestyles.. The vegan exfoliating powder activates upon contact with water, releasing powerful enzymes, AHAs and anti-pollution ingredients to help you achieve smoother and more youthful skin, while allowing you to enjoy the transformative texture as it works into a gentle, creamy paste.. After use, the complexion feels smooth and soft to the touch. And another bonus, this formula can be used daily, so you can enjoy smooth skin everyday.. How To Use It . After cleansing, dispense a half-teaspoon amount of the powder into very wet hands and create a creamy paste by rubbing your hands together. Apply to the face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Massage gently for one minute, then rinse thoroughly with warm water.. Use daily. If you have more sensitive skin, you can apply on alternate days until skin acclimates.. Note: Not recommended for users of medically-prescribed exfoliation products.. Works Well With . Dermalogica's Dynamic Skin range features a vast range of skincare products to help you achieve both healthy and youthful-looking skin, so why not take a closer look at the collection?. Values . listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mad Eyes Mascara 8.5ml / 01 - Noir
listings.description: Achieve full and fluttery lashes with the GUERLAIN Mad Eyes Mascara, a water-resistant mascara with 24-hour wear that strengthens and fortifies lashes with each use.. The Mad Eyes Mascara coats lashes in a lengthening and thickening formula. The soft-fibre brush increases the density of each lash with every clump-free stroke allowing you to customise your result. The water-resistant mascara is suitable for contact lens wearers and is resistant to tears and humidity, ensuring 24-hour lifted lashes with boosted volume.. Like skincare for your lashes, the Mad Eyes Mascara improves and conditions lashes with each use. Every lash is individually coated for defined and clump-free volume thanks to the addition of beeswax. The lashes are smoothed and the fibres are densified with the extract of cotton, while they're kept hydrated with the inclusion of D-panthenol, which prevents lash fallout. After four weeks, lash fibres are longer, thicker and have a boosted curl, resulting in naturally enhanced and healthy lashes.. Why We Love It . The Mad Eyes Mascara is one of a kind; it's a lengthening and thickening mascara with all of the benefits of a lash serum. And what's more? The scent! Blending together rose, jasmine, raspberry, peach and white musk, the mascara has a sparkling fruity-floral aroma that will excite the senses each time you use it.. How To Use It . Place the brush at the bottom of the lash line and apply using zigzag motions from the roots to the tips of lashes. For a more intense look, repeat and apply several layers until you reach the desired volume.. Works Well With . To further enhance and add drama to your eyes pair with a GUERLAIN Mad Eyes liner.. Values . Ophthalmologically-tested..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Exude confidence with the GUERLAIN L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum, a woody-oriental fragrance for men, which is centred around almond.. For this interpretation of L'Homme, you can expect everything you love about the original scent to be intensified. Warm, spicy and seductive, Ideal Extreme opens with nutty almond, which is blended with refreshing bergamot and subtly warmed by pink pepper, resulting in a truly head-turning fragrance.. In the heart, cosy cinnamon and fruity plum notes marry with heliotrope, a sophisticated floral note with almond facets.. Finally, expert perfumer Thierry Wasser blends woody patchouli with soft cedar to create a woody base, which is intensified with masculine tobacco and leather to round off this bold and daring fragrance.. Polished and refined, the bottle itself reflects the elegant and audacious aroma within. Enhanced with bold red hues, the flacon also pays homage to the art of watchmaking, as the heavy matte cap features guilloche detailing, adding a final touch of style.. Why We Love It . L'Homme Ideal Extreme is a celebration of all things almond, which is L'Homme Ideal's olfactory signature note. The fragrance opens with an almond tone before welcoming heliotrope, a flowering plant which Thierry Wasser has carefully selected to tie in with the theme. Not only does heliotrope add to the fragrance itself, but it also helps to enhance the almond top note.. How To Use It . Spritz onto the pulse points.. Works Well With . Why not check out the rest of GUERLAIN's L'Homme Ideal collection? This range features a number of masculine fragrances and scented body products which are just as addictive as this aroma.. Notes . Top Notes: Almond, Pink Pepper, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Plum Note, Heliotrope Note. Base Notes: Cedar, Patchouli, Tobacco, Leather.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "Fresh, citrusy and bursting with sweet fruits, GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia is like a refreshing glass of pink lemonade on a hot summer's day." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia: . An uplifting red berry scent with hints of rose, citrus and woods.. Typically lasts around two to three hours on the skin.. Part of the famous nature-inspired Aqua Allegoria collection.. Made with up to 95% natural ingredients.. Bottled in the classic style of the Aqua Allegoria range.. . What Does GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Smell Like? . Granada Salvia smells like juicy red berries as it kicks off with a delicious, mouth-watering opening of pomegranate and blackcurrant, enhanced by the sparkling citrus freshness of cypress, lemon and bergamot. The watery heart gives it a turkish delight quality as a perfumed rose accord is balanced by aromatic sage. The base leaves a lasting impression of woods with sensual white musk, moss and patchouli.. Top notes are Pomegranate, Blackcurrant, Cypress, Lemon, Bergamot. Heart notes are Rose, Sage. Base notes are White Musk, Moss, Patchouli. . Why It's Escentual: . If you adore light sweet fragrances with a touch of rose, then you will enjoy Granada Salvia. One of the sweetest signatures of the Aqua Allegoria perfume collection, Granada Salvia has a fresh Mediterranean citrus feel that is complemented by the sweet tartness of ripe summer berries.. Granada Salvia is an elegant perfume from start to finish, with its fruity scent, candied pink tint and its iconic honeycomb design. It's topped with an unscrewable cap emblazoned with GUERLAIN's iconic bee, which you can remove to refill your signature scent time and time again.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz on your pulse points - the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . The French beetroot alcohol used in GUERLAIN's perfumes comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and there are refills available for Granada Salvia.. .

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Synchro Skin Self-Refreshing Custom Finish Powder Foundation 9g / 110 - Alabaster
listings.description: Achieve flawless, even coverage with the Shiseido Synchro Skin Self-Refreshing Custom Finish Powder Foundation, a long-lasting foundation for all skin types that adapts to your complexion.. The Synchro Skin powder foundation is driven by Shiseido's ActiveForce technology, which helps your complexion resist heat, humidity and motion throughout the day. The inclusion of Responsive Sensory Technology works with your skin's individual needs to create an illuminated yet natural finish.. But the technology doesn't stop there - this sheer-to-medium powder also cares for your skin's health by featuring an antioxidant wild thyme extract and a protective polymer to prevent pollution from adhering to skin.. And the finish? Shiseido's powder foundation offers immediate hydration while absorbing excess oil for up to eight hours, resulting in a shine-free look. The creamy, weightless compact foundation also minimises the appearance of pores, creating a smooth, fresh and natural-looking complexion.. With 24-hour wear, Shiseido's foundation is buildable, blendable and breathable, so the coverage is endurable and wearable.. Why We Love It . There are so many things to love about this powder foundation! Shiseido have really thought of everything that we want out of a foundation - a formula which is long-lasting, adaptive, comfortable and doesn't cake - and placed it in a chic slimline case which you can pop into any handbag.. Plus, it even maintains your skin's general well being by including protective technologies which can help minimise premature ageing. What's not to love?. How To Use It . Apply wet or dry. To apply wet: dampen the sponge with water and squeeze out excess. Use the black side of the sponge to pick up a small amount of the foundation and gently press onto the skin.. To apply dry: use the white side of the sponge to pick up a small amount of the foundation. Apply from the centre of the face and sweep outward.. Works Well With . Create an even more flawless look with a Shiseido Synchro Skin concealer, which effectively masks blemishes..

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Florale Multi-Purpose Dry Oil - Face, Body and Hair 50ml
listings.description: Intensely nourish your skin with luxurious moisture and a delicate floral fragrance with the Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Florale Multi-Purpose Dry Oil, a 96.9% natural-origin oil for the body, face and hair.. Perfect for fans of the iconic original, the Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Florale Dry Oil is the same nourishing blend of seven 100% botanical oils with a floral twist. The cult-classic oil has been reimagined to leave your skin and hair just as soft, smooth and moisturised but now leaves a tantalising trail of zesty-floral after application.. From the first spritz, notes of magnolia instantly grab your attention, which is met with a hint of zesty grapefruit peel and lingering earthy musk. The subtle floral scent cocoons the body and will instantly transport the senses to a blooming garden on a fresh summer day.. The multi-tasking oil contains seven 100% botanical oils which blend together to soothe, soften and protect the skin. Replenishing camellia oil, conditioning argan oil, nourishing macadamia oil and calming borage oil is blended with protecting hazelnut oil, softening sweet almond oil and moisturising tsubaki oil. These seven botanicals work together with antioxidant vitamin e to smooth, hydrate and intensely nourish your skin and hair. Your natural tan is enhanced while the appearance of stretch marks is minimised and split ends are reduced.. The oils create a protective anti-pollution veil over the skin, improving your overall skin health and quality with each use and keeping you protected from environmental aggressors and ageing free radicals.. Why We Love It . At Escentual, we're big fans of the Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse collection, so we couldn't wait to try the floral edition. Like cocooning your body in a nourishing bath of delicate petals, the Florale Dry Oil is a true sensorial experience. The lightweight dry oil melts effortlessly into the skin and leaves it satin-soft with a delicate sheen, alongside the aroma of a fresh floral fragrance that will uplift your senses and invigorate your mind.. As with everything Nuxe, the oil perfectly balances pleasure of use with efficacy. We love the way this oil makes our skin and hair feel, it truly is the perfect all-in-one for moisture! Skin is intensely hydrated and protected, with the oil leaving no greasy or sticky residue; it's perfect for those days you're in a hurry and want to get dressed straight away. Skin stays silky-smooth all day and hair has a glossy shine that releases the delicate floral fragrance with each swish.. The luxurious golden oil is held in a square glass bottle with a soft pink hue and a rose-gold lid. The spray nozzle makes application easy, meaning you can effortlessly spray all over with no mess or fuss.. How To Use It . Spray the oil over your body, face and hair and then massage in. Use as often as necessary for an instant boost of floral nourishment.. Works Well With . If you love the Florale version of the iconic dry oil, you're sure to love them all. Why not explore the full Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse range and find your favourite?. Values . Mineral oil-free, silicone-free, preservative-free..

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Le 9 De Givenchy Eyeshadow Palette 8g / Le 9.01
listings.description: "Experience the iconic GIVENCHY Le 9 De Givenchy Eyeshadow Palette in six colour harmonies, each housing nine high-pigmented shades in a sleek palette ideal for crafting a subtle chic eye look." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Givenchy Le 9 De Givenchy Eyeshadow Palette: . A sleek black palette featuring a range of shimmering, metallic, pearly and satin shades.. Silky powders that offer 12 hours of wear.. Crease-proof seamless finish.. A slick black palette with an in-built mirror.. A selection of nine complimentary shades that work in harmony with each other.. . Why It's Escentual: . If you have an eye for couture makeup, then you're going to absolutely adore Givenchy Le 9 De Givenchy Eyeshadow Palette. Every palette within the collection centres around one signature colour mix and matches it with a harmony of colour variations and neutral tones, so you can experiment inside the lines. Each intensely pigmented eyeshadow allows you build an eye look to match your mood so you can switch between neutral or daring eye looks.. The GIVENCHY Le 9 De Givenchy Eyeshadow Palette palette is the height of luxury packed into its sleek black compact that is stamped with the couture Maison's signature logo on the lid. Flip up the top, and inside is a mosaic of powders pressed into a pyramid, with two mini brushes that slot together to make a double-ended brush, plus a large mirror so you can top or apply your eye makeup wherever you are.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Connect the two brush bases together, add soft satin shades in the crease, deep shades in the outer corner and a touch of sparkle on the centre eyelid.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the outer box.. . Values: . Talc-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido LipLiner InkDuo 1.1g / 01 - Bare
listings.description: Prime and define lips with the Shiseido InkDuo Lipliner, a two-in-one crayon that offers 8-hour matte colour one end and a balm-like primer on the other.. Blending innovation with beauty, the InkDuo Lipliner is everything you need for healthy and bold lips. The primer locks in hydration and prepares lips for colour, ensuring smooth application and long-lasting colour payoff.. The double-ended lip liner corrects and enhances the shape of lips. Even better? The high pigmentation means it not only lines lips but can be used to fill them with a full-coverage matte finish for up to 8 hours. The weightless retractable liner glides effortlessly over the lips for precise and easy application that won’t dry out. If you are layering lipstick on top, the creamy liner will prevent colour from bleeding, while intensifying and prolonging your lip colour.. Why We Love It . Combining the best of both worlds, the InkDuo Lipliner offers a plethora of bold shades while improving the texture and feel of lips. With all the benefits of a lip balm combined with the vibrant pigmented colour of a lipstick, the two-in-one lip liner makes it effortless to achieve a perfectly plump and hydrated pout.. The compact double-ended retractable pencil can easily be popped in your handbag, so you can top up your colour and give your lips a fresh boost of moisture as often as you like!. How To Use It . Firstly, glide the balm-like primer over lips to douse them in moisture and prepare them for colour. Next, using the pencil end of the InkDuo liner, trace your natural lip line to define and enhance the shape of your lips. Begin at the Cupid’s bow and work outwards for a precise application. For a matte finish, use the liner to fill in the lips.. Works Well With . For further intense lip coverage, layer with a Shiseido lipstick or lip gloss on top for even more long-lasting lip colour.. Values . Dermatologist-tested..

listings.rawTitle: Ferragamo FERRAGAMO Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Bold yet suave and elegant, Salvatore Ferragamo FERRAGAMO Eau de Toilette Spray is a fougere-citrus-woody fragrance for men.. Created by expert perfumer Antoine Maisondieu, the Eau de Toilette opens with a burst of Mediterranean citrus, by blending vibrant bergamot, sharp lemon and aromatic sage.. The fragrance develops into an unexpected floral-metallic heart as violet accord and violet leaf absolute merge with soft cedarwood and a unique Ferragamo leather note - which evokes Salvatore Ferragamo's heritage in luxury leather goods production.. Earthy and sensual, the dry-down marries warm musk and woody vetiver with an oakmoss accord, completing this modern and sophisticated composition.. Designed for a man who is as passionate as he is sophisticated, FERRAGAMO celebrates Salvatore Ferragamo's Italian roots and the brand's tradition of craftsmanship.. Why We Love It . Shaped to reflect a contemporary skyscraper, the bottle makes a number of small nods to the Salvatore Ferragamo brand - much like the captivating, distinctive leather note within.. Featuring a leather-like navy band and Salvatore Ferragamo's Gancini buckle, both the flacon and the scent exude style, innovation and creativity, representing the well-loved brand.. How To Use It . Spritz one or two sprays around your neck and on your pulse points, including the wrists, ankles, inside the elbows and behind the knees, from a minimum distance of six inches. Allow to dry without rubbing.. Works Well With . The FERRAGAMO scent has been captured in a number of additional skincare products, allowing you to envelop yourself in this elegant aroma. To get the most of this fragrance, indulge in the rest of the collection to successfully layer your skin.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Sage. Heart Notes: Violet Accord, Violet Leaf Absolute, Cedarwood, Leather. Base Notes: Musk, Vetiver, Oakmoss Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Expert Sun Protector Face Cream SPF50+ 50ml
listings.description: Experience innovative sun defence with very high protection with Shiseido Expert Sun Protector Face Cream SPF50+, a chemical facial sun cream for all skin types.. The sunscreen harnesses Eucerin's Advanced Spectral Technology to combine broadband and photostable UVA/UVB filters with SPF 50 defence.. Skin is shielded against oxidative stress and damaging free radicals (which can cause skin ageing) thanks to the inclusion of antioxidant liquorice extract, while glycyrrhetinic acid boosts skin's renewal systems; cells' own DNA repair mechanism is supported, soothing and protecting against sun-induced damage.. listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Anti-Age Refreshing Mist Spray 150ml
listings.description: Give your complexion a shot of hydration with the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Anti-Age Refreshing Mist Spray, a water spray for all skin types that helps you achieve a smooth, radiant and moisturised look.. Skin needs water to stay smooth, supple and glowing, but sometimes our complexions need an additional boost of moisture - especially as skin ages. So, Eucerin's mist spray has been designed to enhance the skin's own hydration system using a thirst-quenching blend of hyaluronic acid and gluco-glycerol.. The formula that lies behind the ultra-fine mist distributes water evenly and helps lock in moisture, so skin looks smooth, radiant and dewy as it's been thoroughly hydrated.. The refreshing water spray helps transport water between skin cells using gluco-glycerol - a component that helps increase the number of aquaporins in skin, which controls water transfer into and out of cells. And sadly, all skin types can become dehydrated due to external factors. So, we love that this spray helps provide skin with an intense shot of hydration, especially when our skin struggles to maintain optimum hydration levels.. It's also a pleasure to use; the water is really refreshing and revitalising to use, so it's great to pop on in the morning, or to cool and rehydrate skin after a day in the sun. We also love the ultra-fine mist format of this water spray; it feels so light and soothing as it coats your complexion.. How To Use It . Rose Pompon is a radiant, sweet Eau de Parfum that opens with a vibrant, mouth-watering blend of juicy raspberry, blackcurrant, and pink pepper. Soon after spritzing, the scent reveals a full-bodied, luminous floral heart where fresh Bulgarian rose and honeyed Taïf rose blend seamlessly with powdery violet and white musks. As it dries down, a comforting, long-wearing base of Indonesian patchouli, Thai benzoin resin, vanilla, ambrette, and amber wraps the skin in a soft, irresistible veil.. . Fragrance family: Fruity-Floral. . Top notes: Raspberry, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper. . Heart notes: Taif Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Violet. . Base notes: Patchouli from Indonesia, Benzoin, Vanilla, Ambrette, white musks. . . Why It's Escentual:. Perfumers Camille Goutal and Philippine Courtière created Rose Pompon to express pure, uninhibited happiness—capturing the charming essence of a fresh, sun-drenched rose garden in full bloom.. Housed in the Maison's emblematic Art Deco-inspired gadroon bottle—a tribute to Annick Goutal’s background as an antique dealer—it comes topped with their signature tied bow to symbolise generosity. listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau De Parfum Intense is an alluring floral fragrance for women, featuring fresh and creamy facets.. Building on the feminine qualities of The Only One original, Intense is a richer, smoother take on the signature floral scent. Its enchanting sweetness makes it addictive and sensuous - it's hard to stop reaching for more. Perfumer, Violaine Collas, who created D&G's Dolce Garden has elevated the sweetness with hints of woody nuances, making it irresistibly seductive.. Similar to the original, The Only One Intense opens with a slight citrus freshness as the Italian mandarin, green apple and neroli are fused together. Once settled on the skin, the heart of the fragrance emerges with D&G's signature honeyed orange blossom but uniquely blended with dark vanilla and a hint of coconut, to give a hypnotic, modern twist. The Eau De Parfum Intense's warmth is enhanced by the cedar and cashmere found in the base notes, creating a subtle yet lingering woody dry-down.. Why We Love It . Dolce & Gabbana have replicated the sophistication of The Only One Intense fragrance in its packaging. Its sleek and modern glossy black bottle is accented with subtle gold details, in true D&G style. While the gold ring symbolises female elegance and brings an element of class to the bottle.. Works Well With . The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense is an addition to Dolce & Gabbana's The Only One collection, a range of fragrances that epitomise femininity. Notes . Top Notes: Italian Mandarin, Green Apple, Green Neroli. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Coconut. Base Notes: Vanilla, Cedar, Cashmere.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 50ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Intense continues the legacy of iconic The One fragrance with an amber woody-spicy Eau de Parfum that's warm and mysterious.. The One Intense brings a new and magnetic dynamic to the D&G The One For Men range. It's true to the original scent's DNA, remaining masculine and sophisticated, but Perfumer, Jean-Christophe Herault has elevated its heat and sensuality to create an aroma that is deep and inviting.. Intense has a citrus-spice first impression, which mirrors the classic The One For Men Eau de Toilette. Its top notes radiate freshness with golden nuances of neroli and green bursts of cypress. The bright introduction is quickly softened in the heart, as the composition moves away from the original, forging its own path. Musky cashmeran and spicy-aromatic cardamom blend smoothly giving the eau an addictive quality, before a dark and smoky base of leather and a sweet-woody trail of patchouli make for a lingering and intoxicating dry down.. Why We Love It . It's not only The One's aroma that's been reinvented here, the bottle has been reimagined too. The square-shaped bottle is now gloss black with gold detailing, in keeping with the house codes of Dolce & Gabbana. Modern and luxurious, it's the epitome of the suave scent that's inside.. Women will love The One Intense just as much as men. The Eau de Parfum has a handsome sweetness that sits closely on the skin and exudes confidence.. Works Well With . If you're a fan of The One Intense, explore the rest of the coveted The One For Men line-up for more charismatic fragrances for him and her.. Notes . Top Notes: Neroli Essence, Cypress, Cardamom. Heart Notes: Cashmeran. Base Notes: Leather, Patchouli. Cistus Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Body Partner Stretch Mark Expert 175ml
listings.description: Improve skin elasticity with Clarins Body Partner Stretch Mark Expert, an intensely nourishing cream that will smooth and improve the marks left as a result of overstretched skin from pregnancy, growth or weight gain.. Clarins Body Partner is the perfect natural solution to managing your stretch marks. The weightless cream will effortlessly absorb as it soothes and heals your tight skin, red skin. Each time you apply, it will help to restore your skin's original colour, texture and elasticity for a more soft, supple feel.. Enriched with Clarins phytostretch complex packed with the healing properties of asiaticoside from centella asiatica (also known as tiger grass) and green banana, which work together to improve skin firmness and elasticity caused by stretch marks. Finally, a calming dose of liquorice-derived glycyrrhetinic acid, aswell soothing hazelnut oil that hydrates while it protects your sensitive skin from harmful pollutants in the air. The ingredients work to target the four dimensions of stretch marks - width, length, depth and colour and helps to reduce the appearance of both existing stretch marks and ones that are just beginning to appear.. Why We Love It . We loved the original Clarins Stretch Mark Minimizer, so we knew we would adore this reformulation! Fragrance and colourant-free, it's perfect to use during and after pregnancy. So, whether you're a mum-to-be be or you're just looking to smooth and comfort your existing stretch marks, this nourishing formula is a great choice.. Practical and easy-to-use too; the handy pump ensures you always dispense the right amount, combined with its air locked design which preserves the freshness of the formula. As well as being eco-friendly, the outer packaging is sourced sustainably, and the pink tube is made from recycled plastic - we can't fault it!. How To Use It . Use in the morning, and evening for best results.. Pump the formula into your palm, and bring to body temperature. Then, apply to affected area i.e thighs, hips, stomach and breasts in a circular motion.. To apply to the stomach, make a triangle shape with your hands move them up and down without lifting from the skin.. To apply to the breast, apply to the left palm, and apply from the underarm all the way towards the centre of your right breast. And, repeat on the left breast.. Works Well With . If you're looking to care for your changing shape during pregnancy, why not pair Clarins Body Partner with another product from the Clarins Pregnancy Care collection?. Values . Fragrance-free, colourant-free..

Its fragrance-free formula is dermatologically developed to tackle dark circles caused by lifestyle, fatigue and ageing. Lightweight, its velvety texture effortlessly imparts a nourishing film over the eye contour leaving an instant warming sensation, as well as (clinically proven) more radiant eyes that appear more youthful.. Infused with 12.5% eye-brightening vitamin C, which works to illuminate blue and brown dark circles including those caused by skin surface pigmentation. Together, with a tri-peptide complex that will help to balance the darkness of the eye contour, as well as reduce puffiness and improve skin texture. Finally, an intensely hydrating dose of hyaluronic acid combines with 15% moisturising glycerin to bind water, helping to plump fine lines and crows feet for a hydrated, softer and healthier eye area.. Why We Love It . We adore the Powerful-Strength Line-Reducing Concentrate, so we couldn't wait to add The Kiehl's Vitamin C Eye Serum to our skincare regime, too. It sits perfectly underneath makeup and after a few applications, we really noticed the difference it made. Suitable for sensitive skin and contact lens wearers, this innovative cream can be enjoyed by everyone. The design also has to get a mention; its pump lid makes dispensing just the right amount formula every time so easy. Plus, its bottle, designed with a metallic stripe to remind us of the potency of radiance-boosting vitamin C inside.. How To Use It . Every morning and evening after cleansing, pump a small amount onto the finger, then apply to a clean eye area along the sub-orbital bone. Gently massage the formula to reduce the appearance of puffiness.. Works Well With . This creamy eye serum would work perfectly in conjuction with other products from the Kiehl's Powerful Strength collection.. Values . Dermatologist tested, ophthalmologist tested..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Sleeping Serum 30ml
listings.description: Target the signs of ageing and puffiness while you sleep with the GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Sleeping Serum, a youth-enhancing overnight formula infused with the precious raw ingredient, the orchid.. If you're looking for a high-end skincare regime that offers extraordinary results, then pair The Sleeping Serum with any product from the GUERLAIN? ?Orchidee? ?Imperiale? ?collection..

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Experience pure elegance with Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau de Toilette, a white-floral fragrance for women with a powdery twist that will captivate.. The True Love Eau de Toilette is destined to be your next forever fragrance. Its powdery yet unexpectedly sexy composition is laced with delicate floral notes to create a romantic aroma that will win hearts. Love at first spray; its clean-cut scent will leave a gentle woody trail that's perfect for wearing every day.. listings.rawTitle: Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Day Cream 50ml
listings.description: Discover the exceptional anti-ageing effects of the Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Day Cream, a moisturiser for mature skin that targets key signs of ageing such as deep wrinkles, dark spots and dullness.. Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Day Cream is specially designed to take care of skin from 60 years and onwards. Its hardworking formula works to replenish your skin's micro-nutrient network (youth network) that's diminished over the years. After you apply this fresh floral-scented cream its oil-infused light texture melts into the skin instantly to reveal a hydrated complexion that looks visibly smoother, lifted and glowy without any greasiness.. Your skin will be revitalised thanks to the radiance-boosting organic flower and fruit molecule, escin, both derived from the horse chestnut. They work together to deliver smoother, healthier skin. Wakame seaweed will help to firm, while plant squalane locks-in moisture and plumps fine lines. And to smooth, lift, tighten, brighten and tone, a complex array of active plant extracts including harungana, leaf of life, desert date extract, huang qi extract, hibiscus sabdariffa flower acids, oat sugars ginseng and green coffee are included in this beautifying daily moisturiser.. Skin will be softer, luminescent and supple due to a nourishing dose of shea oil. Finally, Clarins anti-pollution technology strengthens your fragile skin's natural barrier and protects your it from harmful pollutants free in the environment.. Why We Love It . If your skin concern is ageing, then you'll love the Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Day Cream. Visible wrinkles, skin slackening, age spots and uneven skin tone are no problem for this efficacious formula. We love that it instantly adds radiance, plus it's eco-friendly too. Made with sustainably sourced ingredients from fairtrade projects, its premium champagne gold glass jar is made 25% recycled glass.. How To Use It . After cleansing and applying any serums or essences, take a little of the cream between your palms and warm slightly. Next, using the natural weight of your hands, apply in an upward motion all over the face and neck.. Works Well With . Pair your day cream with one of the night products from the Clarins Nutri-Lumière collection, for a 24 hour anti-ageing treatment..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Night Cream 50ml
listings.description: Replenish and revitalise your ageing skin overnight with Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Night Cream, an evening moisturiser developed to restore mature complexions that are dull, dry and lacking in radiance.. Clarins Nutri-Lumiere Night Cream is designed for mature skin over 60 years of age looking for a younger-looking, glowy complexion. Created with Clarins micro-nutrient network (youth network) technology it will help to reduce the signs of ageing such as age spots, deep and fine wrinkles. The soothing, rich gel texture has a fresh floral scent and effortlessly soaks into the skin as it delivers smoother skin that appears to be lifted, hydrated and tighter by morning.. Enriched with the hero ingredient, powerful horse chestnut plant flower and active fruit, it will help to rejuvenate your skin. Together, with organic wakame seaweed extract that firms for a bouncier, plump complexion. Shea oil softens and comforts while brightening huang qi works to restore balance. For added protection, your skin will be shielded from collagen breakdown from external aggressors thanks to its anti-pollution complex.. Finally, a variety of nourishing plant extracts harungana, desert date, and leaf of Life penetrate deep into the epidermis overnight to help to reduce sagging, dryness and common signs of ageing.. Why We Love It . Anti-ageing night creams can often feel rich and heavy on the skin. What we enjoy about the Clarins Night Cream is the fact that it feels light yet intensely nourishing, so your skin never feels overburdened. Being sustainable and more eco-conscious is a direction that Clarins is moving towards, so you'll be happy to hear its ingredients are organically farmed, and sourced from fair trade projects; plus, its gold pot is made from 25% recycled glass.. How To Use It . At night, after cleansing and applying and serums or essences, take a little of the cream in the palms of your hands and warm before applying to face and neck in an upward motion.all over your face and neck.. Works Well With . For a 24 hour anti-ageing skincare regime, combine your Clarins night cream with any of the day creams from the Clarins Nutri-Lumiere range..

listings.description: Experience the mood-lifting aroma of the Ariana Grande Ari Body Mist, a fruity floral gourmand spray that will leave your skin beautifully scented all over.. Fans of the original Ari by Ariana Grande will love this body fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Scherzo Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: The pages of F.Scott Fitzgerald's Tender is the Night comes to life with the Miller Harris Scherzo Eau de Parfum Spray, a chypre floral fragrance for men and women.. Scherzo Eau de Parfum is the work of perfumer, Mathieu Nardin, as an olfactory interpretation of a passage from the iconic novel, Tender is the Night. Vibrant and captivating with an intriguing depth, Scherzo pays homage to a confectioner's window, tempting the senses with a trail of floral and sweet notes.. The dazzling Eau de Parfum opens with delicious bites of tangerine, contrasted by the dark richness of davanna. listings.rawTitle: Ghost The Fragrance Purity Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Indulge in the sweet scent of Ghost The Fragrance Purity Eau de Toilette Spray, a timeless women's fragrance with fruity and floral facets.. Purity is the next aroma in the iconic Ghost The Fragrance collection. Its reimagines the classic scent with a sugared twist for a gourmand aroma that incorporates the dewy floral and elegant musk facets of the original. Each spritz will leave a delicate trail with a playful hint of fresh spice that's perfect for wearing every day.. Purity opens with honeyed top notes of mandarin, freesia, sugar loaf pineapple which is met by a floral heart of violet, heliotrope, zingy orange flower and heady jasmine. Heart Notes: Violet, Heliotrope, Moroccan Orange Flower, Egyptian Jasmine. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Musks, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Excitement meets tenderness with the Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray, a spicy, woody fragrance for men that will give you the freedom to be different.. Moschino's iconic teddy mascot is back with the first male fragrance in the Moschino Toy collection. Created by perfumer Yann Vasnier, Toy Boy is a sexier, much darker version of the original Eau de Parfum. Intensely peppery yet wearable for every day, its playful rose, vetiver and clove notes create an energising trail that is loved by men and women alike.. It opens with fresh notes of citrusy bergamot, green elemi, nutmeg, sweet pink berries, and pear to gently tease the senses. A powdered heart of dusty rose, flax flowers, magnolia and peppery clove weaves through every level of this scent. As this Eau de Parfum warms on the skin a sensual base of cashmeran, vetiver, ambermax and sylkolide reveal a seductive trail with a soft touch of spice.. Why We Love It . Invigorating and just as fiery, this unique Eau de Parfum feels like nothing we've smelt before. Moschino Toy Boy, the perfect fragrance if you're looking to smell a little different to everyone else. Although it's technically a fragrance for men, it's also been extremely popular amongst the females working at Escentual - we definitely think this could be a unisex fragrance.. Finally, we can't talk about the fragrance without mentioning its bottle. In signature Mochino style, it's bottled in a black lacquered teddy with hints of silver. It's safe to say we wouldn't expect anything less from an eccentric fashion house such as Moschino!. Works Well With . For a powerful scent with incredible impact, pair with any of the body products from the Moschino Toy Boy collection.. Notes . Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Pink Berries, Indonesian Nutmeg, Pear, Elemi Heart Notes: Clove, Rose Absolute, Flax flowers, Magnolia Base Notes: Cashmeran, Haitian Vetiver, Ambermax, Sylkolide.

listings.description: Express your femininity with KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Poppy Bouquet Eau de Parfum Florale Spray, a woody floral fragrance incorporating notes of nashi pear, bulgarian rose, jasmine and almond wood.. To celebrate the 20th anniversary of the release of the iconic KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO a new and very different interpretation is born. Poppy Bouquet is comprised of precious, raw ingredients featuring an awash of bright florals such as Bulgarian rose, jasmine and gardenia. listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler 10% Pure Vitamin C Booster 8ml
listings.description: Supercharge your complexion with the radiance-revealing Hyaluron-Filler 10% Pure Vitamin C Booster from Eucerin, an anti-ageing serum for all skin types that plumps, smooths and illuminates.. Eucerin's Vitamin C Booster acts like a reset button for skin; you only need to use the potent serum for 15 days to revitalise and rejuvenate your complexion. It's clinically and dermatologically proven to strengthen skin and plump wrinkles, so you can boast a smoother, fresher and more radiant look after just seven days.. The skin-boosting serum is perfect for skin that looks dull and prematurely aged as a result of common aggressors, like UV rays, pollution and smoking, which all play a part in oxidative stress and free radicals.. Eucerin's answer is to provide your complexion with an intense 10% shot of pure, freshly-activated vitamin C, which has been carefully formulated to fight free radicals for a more healthy, youthful and glowing complexion.. The lightly-fragranced formula is driven by free radical-fighting vitamin C, a powerhouse antioxidant that strengthens the skin's defence system. It also encourages collagen production for a plump, youthful appearance as it supports the skin's structure.. The formula is supported by low molecular hyaluronic acid, which hydrates skin and plumps up wrinkles, while antioxidant licochalcone A works alongside vitamin C to neutralise the free radicals caused by UV rays and HEVIS light. Finally, the formula also stimulates hyaluronic acid in cells using glycine saponin, an active ingredient extracted from soya bean that increases HA by up to 256% on cell level within your skin.. Why We Love It . Vitamin C is a powerhouse anti-ageing ingredient; it fights free radicals and boosts radiance. And Eucerin knows that it's at its most potent when freshly-activated (and when it's such an impressive ingredient, we all want to use it when it's highly effective!). So, Eucerin's innovative packaging allows you to activate this powerful ingredient yourself on the first use. We recommend you use it if your skin is looking a little lacklustre or a few weeks before a big occasion, when you want to look your best.. How To Use It . At the base of the serum, peel off the protective foil but leave the cap on. Press the button at the base two to three times to release the vitamin C. Shake the dispenser for at least 10 seconds to activate. Remove the cap at the top by twisting it, and press the button at the base to release the formula onto the tip of a finger before applying it to skin.. Works Well With . If you want to find the perfect follow-up moisturiser to use after this serum, take a look at the rest of Eucerin's Hyaluron-Filler collection to find the best one for your skin type and concern.. Values . Non-comedogenic..

listings.description: Protect, repair and intensely nourish your complexion with the Nuxe Reve de Miel Ultra Comforting Face Balm, a honey-based daily moisturiser for dry and sensitive skin.. Made with 92.9% natural-origin ingredients, the Reve de Miel face cream is rich yet lightweight blam that melts into skin and leaves it soft, smooth and comfortable. Sensations of irritation are soothed as redness and dryness are diffused for a comforted and repaired complexion while the intoxicating aroma of honey, mimosa and acacia will captivate the senses.. Centred around the restorative powers of honey, the moisturiser is also infused with propolis oleoactive, a 100% natural ingredient that soothes and strengthens skin. This beehive-derived treasured ingredient contains 300 active molecules with repairing, purifying and soothing abilities (along with antioxidant benefits) to leave your complexion soft-to-touch with a healthy radiance.. Non-greasy but extremely moisturising, the buttery face balm envelops the complexion in a comforting, hydrating cocoon. Shea butter offers intense moisturisation while a trio of hydrating botanical oils - argan, macadamia and rice bran - work together to soften and soothe. Lipids are replenished and the skin feels plumped and hydrated with each use, while barley extract offers an antioxidant shield to fend off damaging daily aggressors.. Why We Love It . We love the fact that Nuxe is dedicated to giving back to the bees who produce the honey that they celebrate in their Reve de Miel collection. They use an innovative and environmentally-friendly oleo-eco-extraction method to extract the propolis, which enhances the skin-saving abilities of the prized beehive treasure.. Plus, Nuxe takes part in sustainable development projects to save and protect the bees. They're committed to erecting more beehives and support the preservation of these vital (and hardworking) insects.. They don't just focus on making a product good for the environment, they ensure it's good for the skin and the senses, too. The rich balm absorbs instantly into the skin with a melting, buttery texture that instantly soothes, while the delectable honeyed-floral aroma will stay with you long after you've applied the cream.. How To Use It . Massage the face balm to cleansed and dry skin every morning and/or evening.. Works Well With . listings.rawTitle: Sachajuan Anti Pollution Shampoo 250ml
listings.description: Protect your hair from everyday environmental pollutants with the Sachajuan Anti Pollution Shampoo, a gentle but effective hair cleanser that will protect the scalp, prevent pollution build-up and restore healthy shine.. The Anti Pollution Shampoo's lavender-scented formula works to protect the hair from daily aggressors such as industrial emissions, gases, dust, smoke and free radicals. The result is hair that feels cleaner and fresher for longer with reduced colour fade and more shine.. It prevents pollution particles from coating the scalp and provides a long-lasting shield, while a cocktail of fruit-derived alpha-hydroxy acids (AHA's) smooth the hair shaft - this stops any nasties in the air from clinging onto the hair by reducing any dry, rough or porous areas, ensuring that hair stays shiny, fresh and clean for longer with more bounce and less frizz.. Why We Love It . We've all had those days where our hair just feels lank, lifeless, and even though you've just washed it, it still doesn't look as great as it should. Pollution build-up can often be the cause for this, and Sachajuan shampoo provides the perfect solution. The best news though? The formula's system is powered by three highly concentrated natural ingredients! They work in tandem to effectively counteract drab hair in need of a refresh. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Experience the bold aromatic freshness of lavender paired with sensual orange blossom with Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray, a bold floral fragrance that will inspire you to be yourself.. Libre is the French word for '˜free', and that's exactly what this contemporary Eau de Parfum from YSL wants you to be. The modern woman is continuously pushing boundaries, living life to the full and embracing the idea of freedom. This fragrance encapsulates these notions perfectly because it's the first female floral-lavender scent produced by YSL. It incorporates an unusual but addictive contrast of aromatic lavender notes with a creamy-heady blend of jasmine and orange blossom from Morocco. The result is a white floral perfume with a herbal undertone that exudes sophistication.. Master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim have created a unique and couture-infused scent. YSL has dressed the golden juice in a bottle that echoes the androgenous and statement style of Saint Laurent. The flacon is structured and feels like an accessory, rather like the YSL bags and shoes that have the same oversized logo. With sharp and elegant lines the gold emblem bends around the bottle, and if you look closely, you'll notice a cut out in the glass, that mimics a low V cut neckline. Underneath the asymmetric black lacquered top is a row of gold chains elegantly wrapped around the bottle - an extra touch that's inspired by the luxurious chains of iconic Yves Saint Laurent handbags. This is a perfume bottle you'll be proud to show off.. Why We Love It . We love the concept of this scent and the fact that it centres itself around the idea of freedom, to be yourself and make your own rules. And that goes for the way you wear the perfume, too. If you are wearing jewellery around your neck and want to avoid that area, spritz it in a Y shape, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. Or spray a little into your hairbrush and then run it through your hair to lightly scent it. Our favourite way to enjoy Libre, however, is to spritz a bit of the perfume into our bathwater. It's a luxurious treat that makes our skin smell beautiful afterwards.. Notes . Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Petitgrain Oil, Lavandine France Oil, Blackcurrant Accord.. Heart Notes: Lavender Oil, Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum India Absolute, Orange Flower Absolute.. Base Notes: Vanilla Extract Madagascar, Cedarwood Oil, Ambergris Accord, White Musk..

YSL has dressed the golden juice in a bottle that echoes the androgenous and statement style of Saint Laurent. The flacon is structured and feels like an accessory, rather like the YSL bags and shoes that have the same oversized logo. With sharp and elegant lines the gold emblem bends around the bottle, and if you look closely, you'll notice a cut out in the glass, that mimics a low V cut neckline. Underneath the asymmetric black lacquered top is a row of gold chains elegantly wrapped around the bottle - an extra touch that's inspired by the luxurious chains of iconic Yves Saint Laurent handbags. This is a perfume bottle you'll be proud to show off.. Why We Love It . We love the concept of this scent and the fact that it centres itself around the idea of freedom, to be yourself and make your own rules. And that goes for the way you wear the perfume, too. If you are wearing jewellery around your neck and want to avoid that area, spritz it in a Y shape, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. Or spray a little into your hairbrush and then run it through your hair to lightly scent it. Our favourite way to enjoy Libre, however, is to spritz a bit of the perfume into our bathwater. It's a luxurious treat that makes our skin smell beautiful afterwards.. Notes . Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Petitgrain Oil, Lavandine France Oil, Blackcurrant Accord.. Heart Notes: Lavender Oil, Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum India Absolute, Orange Flower Absolute.. Base Notes: Vanilla Extract Madagascar, Cedarwood Oil, Ambergris Accord, White Musk..

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K By Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance fit for royalty; K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray is a fresh men's fragrance with woody aromatic facets.. Fashion meets fragrance. K by Dolce&Gabbana is a symbol of scent nobility, and we're not just talking about the fact it has hand-crafted 24k gold in the cap. Marrying classic aromas of patchouli, and woods with innovative unique spices and sharp citruses that reign supreme to Dolce&Gabbana's Italian heritage, the Eau de Toilette makes a sophisticated statement with its contemporary juice and standout fragrance bottle.. Handsome inside and out, the royal blue juice is enriched with a wave of rejuvenation from splashes of Sicilian lemon and blood orange. The energising core of lavandin unites with a slightly spicy geranium note, which complements a fiery pimento essence. The composition continues to heat up as warm woods and earthy patchouli rise and dominate the base - it's a signature scent made for nobility.. Why We Love It . Dolce&Gabbana know how to cause a stir, and K by Dolce&Gabbana is certainly drawing a lot of excitement in the press. The brand has pulled out all the stops to make this one of the biggest male fragrance launches of 2019.. If we start with the bottle, the crown has been a significant statement throughout their fashion shows; it's a symbol that means a great deal to both designers. The fragrance's ornate crown cap is hand-crafted with a marble effect lid and embellished with 24-carat gold. No two are the same, making this fragrance unique and collectable.. For men, you can't go wrong with a woody aromatic aftershave, and the clean-cut scent definitely takes the crown for undeniable sex appeal, to both male and females.. Notes . Top Notes: Blood Orange, Juniper Berry. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Lavandin. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli..
