listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Red Potion Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Travel to the Northern borders of the African coast with The Merchant Of Venice Red Potion Eau de Parfum Spray, an oriental floral fragrance that will ignite passion within every woman.. The luxurious house of The Merchant Of Venice introduces the next chapter in the Murano Collection. Red Potion is a potent fusion of fragrant botanicals, transported across the ocean from North Africa, all the way to Venice. Scarlett by name, Red Potion borrows its theme from Venetian culture, channelling the nations red flag, the velvets of the gondolas, and the natural rouge pigments of the buildings to create this fiery and unforgettable aroma.. Red Potion has a heady composition, crafted from plants and flowers for an aromatic blend that exudes sex appeal. The perfume opens with a caramelised accord of golden immortelle, paired with bright facets of orange, tagete, and a tangy blend of orange flower, rosemary and sweet honeysuckle. The warm scent adheres to the skin, revealing an alluring core of creamy tonka bean, cut with sharp lichen, and finished with a woody sandalwood accord.. Why We Love It . When it comes to the Murano Collection, you always know what to expect: exquisite glasswork, unique travel-inspired scent and precious raw materials imported by Venetian merchants. With all this and more, Red Potion is definitely in good company. It's clear the fragrance house's Venetian heritage has an influence on their creations, through the enchanting red and gold molten glass flacon, which pays homage to the ancient technique used by Murano glassmakers. We can't forget the golden embellishment, and matching lava style patterned box either; more evidence that this Eau de Parfum is truly one of a kind.. Notes . Top Notes: Orange, Tagete, Immortelle.. Heart Notes: Orange Flower, Rosemary, Honeysuckle.. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Lichen Accord, Tonka Beans..

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Blue Tea Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Take a trip to the Far East with The Merchant Of Venice Blue Tea Eau de Parfum Spray, a fresh green-floral fragrance for women that's centred around the precious qualities of blue tea.. This Eau de Parfum is truly a work of alchemy, and the result is a refreshing aromatic blend that is distinctly unique. The perfume brings to life the tales of Marco Polo, an Italian merchant that travelled along the fabled silk road, returning with ingredients that had never been seen or smelled before. The blue tea flower is one of those treasures, and this composition marks the first time it was used in perfumery; a feat that took hundreds of combinations and elaborations to accomplish.. Infused with regenerating blue petals of the butterfly pea flower, and spices, the juice is inspired by the refined Chinese blue tea. The elegant threads of blue tea are woven throughout, and a dash of spicy-nutmeg enhances the aroma, giving it a Middle Eastern feel. The floral heart of green-rose, lemony-magnolia and sweet-neroli, combined with the base notes of green-vetiver, mate and musk, create a scent that is energising, and distinctly fresh. Lovers of green fragrances, this one's definitely for you.. Why We Love It . If you've encountered The Merchant of Venice before, then you'll know that behind every fragrance is an adventure and an exclusive raw material. All housed in beautifully unique bottles, signature tassel and all, Blue Tea is no exception. The story and flacon pair perfectly, adorned with a beautiful watery blue and white painting of a merchant's boat sailing. It's clear how much craftsmanship has gone into this design and wrapped up in an oriental red and navy box, this Eau de Parfum really is perfumery at its finest.. Notes . Top Notes: Blue Tea Leaves, Nutmeg.. Heart Notes: Rose, Magnolia, Neroli.. Base Notes: Vetiver, Mate, Musk..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Parure Gold Setting Mist 30ml
listings.description: Add the finishing touch to your makeup with GUERLAIN Parure Gold Setting Mist, a setting spray that enhances your skin's natural radiance, and keeps your makeup on lockdown from day to night.. Packed with skin-loving ingredients, the finishing spray provides a beauty boost while fixing your makeup. A collagen-boosting peptide rejuvenates and smoothes your complexion, helping to reduce the look of fine lines and wrinkles. Glycerin hydrates and plumps; while echinacea plant, coveted for its antioxidant properties, reinforces the skin's barrier function to protect from external aggressors that cause premature ageing. The perfect multi-tasker, the mist sets, hydrates, and protects from pollution, making it an excellent fit for anyone that lives in the city.. One of GUERLAIN's best-kept secrets, this Parure Gold Setting Mist is a quick an easy makeup fixer that really lasts all day. No need for touch-ups, a few spritzes at the end of your makeup routine will give an instant glow and ensure that all your mornings' hard work doesn't go to waste. Why We Love It . A couple of sprays at the start of the day is all you need to keep your complexion looking flawless all day long - although it's so eye-catching so it's a real shame you only need to use it once! The formula is housed in an elegant clear glass bottle so you can catch a glimpse of the golden elixir within, and topped with gold for full-blown luxury. The glamourous bottle means you won't mistake this for any ordinary setting mist; truly stunning it will stand tall on your dressing table.. Radiance, staying power and a jaw-dropping bottle aren't all this mist has to offer either. It smells incredible too! The glowing liquid is infused with a delicate fruity-floral aroma of peach, jasmine and white musk.. How To Use It . After applying your makeup, hold 20cm from the face, and spray 2-3 times evenly. Spray in a 'Z' motion from your forehead to your jaw.. Works Well With . Stay looking flawless and glowing with GUERLAIN's full Parure Gold collection, containing more gold inspired makeup formulas..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Joli Blush 5g / 05 - Cheeky Boum
listings.description: Create a healthy flush of long-wearing colour with the Clarins Joli Blush, a range of colourful, compact powder blushes with a buildable finish suitable for all skin types.. If a uniform finish and smooth skin are what you crave from your blusher, these Joli cheek colours are precisely what you need. Each pigmented shade has a lightweight, breathable texture that seamlessly blends into the skin.. Each cheek colour contains unique tinted pigments, that will deliver a boost of colour as well as an anti-pollution complex to protect against environmental aggressors. Hazelnut oil has also been incorporated into the formula to keep skin hydrated and comfort the skin.. The colour-coded casing is compact, light and also has the benefit of an included synthetic hairbrush, for application on-the-go.. Why We Love It . Before we opened them up, the Joli blushers stole our hearts. With their gorgeous coloured compact packaging (which matches the shade held inside), they are easy to pop in your bag and also have the benefit of a handy mirror inside the lid.. We're fans of the buildable formula; it's perfect for when you want just a natural pop of colour to your cheeks, or create more of a statement look with blush.. How To Use It . Using your favourite blusher brush or the brush provided in the compact, sweep a little of the product onto the apples of your cheeks. The colour can be intensified by building the coverage, simply keep applying and work into the skin until you reach your desired intensity.. Works Well With . Pair your Joli blush with a flawless complexion. The Clarins foundation collection offers a range of coverages for every skin type and texture and will provide the perfect base for your blush..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Instant Light Intense Lip Perfector 12ml / 16 - Intense Rosebud
listings.description: The Clarins Instant Light Natural Lip Perfector is a nourishing and plumping lip treatment that will give your lips a kissable tint of shimmering colour.. The Lip Perfector is much more than a lip gloss. If you're looking for a product that will add a touch of colour and shine; but will also help to keep your lips soft and smooth, Clarins' Lip Perfectors do that and more. Each pigmented shade has a melting gel-balm texture that doesn't feel heavy. It feels comfortable as it nourishes, repairs and protects lips with its vanilla-scented moisturising formula. The cushion applicator has been designed to dispense the perfect amount of product to the lips to give a smooth and even finish, hugging every contour. Its glossy formula is enriched with shea butter provides lips with an intense hit of hydration and will help to protect them from harsh weather conditions.. Why We Love It . This lip colour is perfect for when your lips are dry and chapped, but you still want to wear something other than lip balm. The Natural Light Lip Perfectors are a hybrid of a caring lip treatment and a colourful lip gloss. Their handy tube design makes them ideal for popping into a bag and applying on-the-go without a mirror. We wouldn't be without one of these in our makeup bags for lip SOS moments.. How To Use It . Squeeze the tube slightly to disperse the product onto the cushion applicator and apply straight to the lips.. Top tip: Try applying over your favourite lipstick for a hydrating glossy effect.. Works Well With . To add a little more dimension to your lips, pair your Clarins gloss with one of Clarins' lip liners. We recommend using a slightly darker colour than your chosen shade of lip perfector to create the illusion of a fuller lip..

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Push boundaries with Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray, a woody aromatic fragrance for men who are rebellious and spontaneous by nature.. Urban Hero is a distinctly confident and masculine scent. Full of contrasts, its aroma is fitting for every type of man. At first, the classic gentleman comes to mind thanks to a smooth leather accord, while vibrant undertones of lemon caviar gives it a modern and youthful feel. This duality comes from the perfumers, Antoine Maisondieu and Marion Costero's vision to create a contemporary urban signature. It's traditional with a dash of colour.. Woody yet fresh, Urban Hero is a sophisticated signature with a difference. The composition opens with facets of bright lemon caviar and fiery black pepper, a duo that gives the Eau de Parfum its spicy freshness. In the heart, sweet rosewood and woody-vetiver meet and the result is a sexy sophistication, a mood that's continued into the base and beyond with lingering facets of warm grey amber and mysterious smoky-leather.. Why We Love It . We don't know about you, but when we look at this bottle, we are instantly reminded of a modern gentleman's hip flask. Suave and stylish, its chrome finish and contemporary design mirrors the urban landscape perfectly. No detail has been overlooked; the weighted chevron top, soft blue juice and refined logo all add a touch of class, which pairs perfectly with the graphic patterned box, which is designed by L'Atlas, a French street artist who also doubles as the face of the Urban Hero campaign.. Notes . Top Notes: Lemon Caviar, Black Pepper.. Heart Notes: Rosewood, Vetiver.. Base Notes: Grey Amber, Leather Accord..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum Spray 25ml
listings.description: It's fragrance like you've never experienced it before. Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern chypre-floral perfume for women, in the world's thinnest bottle to date.. Lancome Idole marks a new generation of fragrance. It has modernised the classic rose note and revolutionised the perfume bottle; all the while delivering a message of strong and powerful feminity. Made for those who dream big, Idole has future icon written all over it.. Designed by Architect, Chafik Gasmi, Idole has the world's slimmest perfume bottle in history at just 15mm thick. Described as the bottle of today, the ultra-thin flacon has been made with two objectives in mind: to look beautiful with its gold trim and jewel-like design, and to be practical; its slender shape fits neatly into the hand and is a dream to travel with.. The Eau de Parfum Spray celebrates a note close to Lancome's heart, the rose; the hero of its logo, and the main facet in many of its best-selling fragrances. The result is an Eau with tradition at its core but an entirely contemporary energy. Sustainably-sourced rose and rose water is at the centre of this transformation, and lends a dewy, yet radiant freshness that doesn't smell artificial in the slightest. The composition's modern twist comes from a fruity bergamot opening, and subtle threads of sensual jasmine with creamy musk; a blend that is clean and glowing.. Why We Love It . What says female empowerment more than three women working together! That's exactly what's happened with Idole. Perfumers, Shyamala Maisondieu, Nadege Le Garlantezec and Adriana Medina, joined forces to create this luminous aroma, and the result is a scent that speaks of women being leaders; a message that echoes that of Lancome's '˜Made by Women For Women' campaign. With an ambition like that at its core, the question is: how could we not love it?. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot Essence.. Heart Notes: Rose Essence, Rose Absolute, Rose water, Jasmine Infusion, Jasmine.. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence, Cedar Essence, Vanilla Extract..

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: The Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette Spray is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men inspired by temptation and allure.. Confidence bottled; Le Beau is playful and timelessly handsome. It's an Eau de Toilette that appeals to both men and women, thanks to its aromatic aroma that leaves a powerful and magnetic trail.. Gaultier's Le Beau Eau de Toilette scent speaks to a new generation of men who love to experiment and try something different. The masculine fragrance cocktails the freshness of coconut, and the addictiveness of tonka bean to create a familiar but modern take on the cult-favourite Le Male, only more irresistible.. Why We Love It . It's likely you've seen this Gaultier male torso before, but Le Beau offers something completely different. Imagine Le Male, but with an earthy and modern edge. Gaultier has created a cosmopolitan concoction of an old favourite, with subtle nods to the clean, comforting aroma we commonly associate with the JPG sailor story.. Le Beau's emerald green bottle may represent a story about the forbidden fruit, but its aroma tells a contrasting tale that only reigns true when it comes to being a symbol of temptation. Stand-out exotic notes mix effortlessly with citruses, creating a signature scent that feels good to wear and smells incredible on the skin.. Notes . Top Note: Bergamot. Heart Note: Coconut Wood. Base Note: Tonka Bean.

Gaultier's Le Beau Eau de Toilette scent speaks to a new generation of men who love to experiment and try something different. The masculine fragrance cocktails the freshness of coconut, and the addictiveness of tonka bean to create a familiar but modern take on the cult-favourite Le Male, only more irresistible.. Why We Love It . It's likely you've seen this Gaultier male torso before, but Le Beau offers something completely different. Imagine Le Male, but with an earthy and modern edge. Gaultier has created a cosmopolitan concoction of an old favourite, with subtle nods to the clean, comforting aroma we commonly associate with the JPG sailor story.. Le Beau's emerald green bottle may represent a story about the forbidden fruit, but its aroma tells a contrasting tale that only reigns true when it comes to being a symbol of temptation. Stand-out exotic notes mix effortlessly with citruses, creating a signature scent that feels good to wear and smells incredible on the skin.. Notes . Top Note: Bergamot. Heart Note: Coconut Wood. Base Note: Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: The sweet scent of Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum Spray was made for women and even men who can't resist the temptation of creamy vanilla fragrances.. The world-famous torso perfume has a new identity, intertwining floral fantasies into the Classique story, and taking them to the next level. La Belle is an exploration of attraction and of all things that seduce, its provocative bottle is the perfect match for its alluring, feminine aroma; one spray of this 'boozy' vanilla scent just isn't enough.. La Belle by Jean Paul Gaultier smells almost edible. It's a fruity-sweet fragrance with an oriental twist that's not sickly or overpowering. The base of vanilla pod adds a wave of warmth that's addictive and hard to ignore.. Why We Love It . Gaultier has chosen to take a different route for this fragrance and we're into it. Unlike the tale of the sailor guy and girl, this story starts in the Garden of Gaultier where La Belle and Le Beau (her male counterpart) indulge in the forbidden.. In true Gaultier style, the campaign is very risque, but this Eau de Parfum is truly good enough to eat. La Belle is a lot softer and creamier than you'd imagine, the pairing of crunchy pear and creamy vanilla make a stunning signature that says '˜I'm empowered, but elegant'.. Regardless of whether you're a Gaultier fan or not, you'll love the presentation of this perfume. In-keeping with the Classique and Le Male podium tins, as soon as you open it, you get to see the real beauty of the fragrance itself. Inside, there's an opulent amethyst-tinted juice and embellished floral neck of the bottle to look at in awe, even if only for a few seconds before you start spritzing.. Notes . Top Note: Green Pear. Heart Note: Bergamot. Base Note: Vanilla Pod.

listings.description: Help to reduce the appearance of discolouration and marks with Kiehl's Epidermal Re-Texturizing Micro-Dermabrasion, an exfoliating cream that will immediately smooth your skin.. Enriched with micronised shells, a natural exfoliant that's used to polish away dead skin cells on the surface layer of the skin, this highly efficient treatment will intensely smooth the complexion. Added willow herb will restore softness while shea butter, a natural fat, works exceptionally well to protect the skin from dehydration.. Upon first application, your skin will appear softened and smoothed whilst after regular, tri-weekly use, discolorations and small marks will be visibly minimised. Feel the difference as this hardworking exfoliator gets to work in providing you with a complexion that is significantly smoother and clearer.. Why We Love It . If tone and clarity is your biggest skin bugbear, this smoothing formula will be your ticket to a more flawless finish. It helps to retexturise a rough complexion and assist with the appearance of acne scars and fine lines, while improving the efficiency of all skincare you use afterwards. It's such a great product!. How To Use It . Dispense a penny-sized amount into the palm of your hand and gently massage into damp skin using your fingertips for around 30 seconds, but no more than 2 minutes. If you desire, you can increase pressure to maximise efficiency depending on your skin's sensitivity level. Close your eyes, and rinse skin thoroughly to reveal a fresher complexion.. Warning: Don't use this scrub within 24 hours of other exfoliation products including peels, retinol, glycolic acid and acne medication; the results may be too intense for your skin. Follow your micro-dermabrasion treatment with a sunscreen of SPF15 or more to ensure that skin is protected.. Works Well With . After refining your skin's texture with this micro-dermabrasion treatment, nourish and hydrate afterwards with the Kiehl's Centella Recovery Skin-Salve and immediately restore comfort..

listings.description: Plump and restore your skin's natural radiance with the Vichy Neovadiol Rose Platinium - Revitalising and Replumping Night Care, an overnight repair cream for mature skin with age-spots, dullness, and loss of elasticity caused by menopause.. Made to reactivate your skin's bounce and glow, the anti-ageing cream works by eliminating toxins and restoring balance to your complexion. The silky formula reduces the appearance of pillow marks, and its rosy pigments give your skin a youthful blush.. Made for women post-menopause, the Neovadiol Night Cream is enriched with hard-working natural-origin active ingredients, including anti-inflammatory rose flower extract, soothing Vichy thermal water, moisturising shea butter, and rich beeswax which all help to soften and nourish the skin. The powerful infusion of natural calcium and plant sugars work together to fortify your skin's natural barrier and re-plump, compensating for the loss of density and dullness many people face after menopause.. Dermatologist tested, and suitable for sensitive skin, Neovadiol Rose Platinium is nourishing on mature skin and prevents skin pulling and tightness. Thanks to the mixture of the calming properties of revitalizing rose, skin appears glowing with no irritation.. Why We Love It . If you haven't come across the Vichy Rose Platinium line before, then you're in for a treat! We love the rosy mineral pigments and hydrating effect of the original Neovadiol Rose Platinium day cream, so we were happy to see Vichy add a night-time moisturiser to the range. Not as rosy, and richer and more repairing, the night cream ensures you wake up to fresh, and rested skin. Not only does it work, but it's a pleasure to apply too - it smells amazing with a subtle rose aroma and looks great in its pearlescent pink pot.. How To Use It . Apply the cream every night; massage onto the face and neck in light upward strokes, trying to avoid contact with the eye area.. Works Well With . Want more youthful-looking skin? listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 50ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Eau de Parfum Intense Spray has the freshness of the original L'Eau D'Issey for men scent, but with an earthy and warm twist.. L'Eau D'Issey Wood & Wood makes you forget what you know about traditional 'woody' male fragrances, thanks to its citrus edge. A contrast of warm and cold, its alluring aroma encapsulates everything you love about Issey Miyake: Zesty, clean and comforting but with a rugged and modern slant.. The wood edition smells and looks handsome. It's one of those unique but familiar scents that's strong but not overpowering. In our opinion, the double-strength of woods, cedarwood and sandalwood make a masculine match for a man who wants a contemporary spin on a current classic - you can't beat it.. Why We Love It . Wood & Wood just works, from the inside out, its aromatic interpretation of nature doesn't go unnoticed. Unlike the other L'Eau D'Issey fragrances, this Issey Miyake flacon is tinted with a deep shade of oak and has an accompanying wooden cap; the perfect finishing touch for the 'wood' theme.. When you lift the cap and spray this Eau de Parfum, you instantly get hit by sharp cuts of grapefruit; a reminder of the signature freshness we all associate with Issey Miyake fragrances. That soon changes, a double dose of warm woods soon prevails, warming up the composition, taking you confidently from day to night.. Works Well With . Enhance the longevity and scent of L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood with the accompanying L'Eau D'Issey shave and shower products in the range.. Notes . Top Note: Grapefruit Essence.. Heart Notes: Virginia Cedar Essence, Sandal Essence.. Base Note: Patchouli Essence.. How to Use: . Warmth intensifies fragrance. Apply it to your body's warmest points, such as the creases of your elbows and wrists for more strength and longevity.. Avoid rubbing or dabbing after application, as this can break down the fragrance.. For wrist application, apply the fragrance after hand washing which can rinse off the scent..

Kiehl's Buttermask for Lips is an overnight lip treatment that cocoons dry and cracked skin with an indulgent layer of exotic fairtrade ingredients for an intensely hydrated and more supple pout by morning.. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Volume Disturbia Volume & Curve 24 Hour Wear Mascara 8g / 01 - Black Disturbia

listings.description: Experience freshness with a Mediterranean twist with Goutal Eau d'Hadrien For Men Eau de Parfum Spray, a citrus-aromatic unisex fragrance that will spark the senses with its sweet and sharp aroma.. Originally created in 1981 by Annick Goutal, Eau d'Hadrien's zesty blend of Sicilian lemon, juicy grapefruit and mandarin coupled with woody cypress notes give this Eau de Parfum a universally pleasing freshness and a timeless elegance. For the original and this parfum, Annick wanted to recreate the hottest hour of the day in Tuscany.. The first spray immediately hits you with a fusion of fresh citrus notes. Sicilian lemon, citron and bergamot powerfully intertwine with cypress, grapefruit and basil leaf in the heart to give body to this classic scent. The base rounds off finishes with woody and sweet notes of sandalwood, amber, patchouli and creamy vanilla. In its robust glass flacon, with a pale yellow juice and contrasting gunmetal lid, this is a fragrance that you'll want to reach for everyday.. Why We Love It . Citrus-powered freshness at its best, it's easy to see why Eau d'Hadrien has been worn and loved by many people all over the world for years.. If you're a lover of citrus fragrances and want to enhance your daily routine, why not explore the full Goutal Eau d'Hadrien collection for more products to complement your new fragrance.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Citron. Heart Notes: Mediterranean Cypress, Basil Leaf, Grapefruit. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, Vanilla.

listings.description: Fall in love with Angel all over again with Mugler Angel Eau de Toilette Spray, a floral gourmand fragrance for women with sweet and sensual facets.. Mugler's Angel Eau de Toilette gets a lighter and more refined update with this deliciously delicate pale pink juice. Angel Eau de Toilette opens with an immediate hit of mandarin that is quickly softened with a subtle note of peony that fuses in the heart with creamy praline, berries and apple oil. This dreamy combination is completed with a sensual and empowering base of patchouli and warm blond wood and conjures up the idea of silkiness and subtle seduction.. Why We Love It . We are long-time fans of the iconic Mugler Angel scent. However, there are a few of us who found it just a little too heavy to wear every day. This updated version is slightly lighter and more refined than the original Eau de Toilette; however, it still features the same notes, so fans of the legendary scent shouldn't be worried. It's a more delicate version of the much-loved classic but with a little less patchouli and some additional floral and sugary facets that make it more universally appealing.. Works Well With . Mugler understands that when you love a perfume you want to immerse yourself in it and Angel is definitely one of those scents. Why not explore the full Angel range, and perhaps begin your fragrance ritual in the bathroom with a luxurious body product from Mugler?. Notes . Top Notes: Mandarin, Peony. Heart Notes: Praline, Berries, Apple Oil. Base Notes: Patchouli, Warm Blond Wood.

L'Eau de Paille blends the sweet smell of dried hay, woody vetiver and the aromatic scent of frankincense to create a clean and pleasing Eau de Parfum reminiscent of a walk through a field of wheat with the late afternoon sun beating down.. listings.description: Plump and smooth your eye area with the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Eye Cream, a rejuvenating anti-ageing eye cream for all skin types that eases deep wrinkles, while offering SPF20 protection.. Eucerin's blendable eye cream is designed to target common signs of ageing around the eye contour as it plumps up deep wrinkles and improves elasticity for a more youthful appearance.. The fragrance-free formula offers multiple anti-ageing benefits, so the eye contour of those with mature complexions looks smoother, firmer and more radiant. It's richer texture melts into the complexion with ease, and it even makes a great base for makeup.. The eye area is intensely moisturised due to hydrating hyaluronic acid, which also plumps up and fills out deep wrinkles, while arctiin helps skin to become more resilient, and even boosts collagen renewal to firm and redensify the thin skin in the eye contour. By triggering collagen renewal, the cream discourages future fine lines and wrinkles from developing.. The cream also helps you achieve a more luminous, well-rested look as Eucerin's patented thiamidol is clinically proven to reduce dark spots and prevent them from reappearing. Plus, the formula features SPF20 broad-spectrum protection; which includes UVA filters, so the cream shields against the type of solar ray that causes photoaging.. Why We Love It . And as the body struggles to produce HA as we age, skin becomes dry, dehydrated and wrinkled - so it's great that this cream offers a must-needed shot of it.. How To Use It . listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Light Cream 50ml
listings.description: A refreshing way to add radiance and moisture to your skin with the GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Light Cream, an anti-ageing day cream for all skin types that will offer deep hydration and replump the complexion while combatting the visible signs of ageing.. Fans of the original Orchidee Imperiale The Cream rejoice, here is a lighter textured alternative with all the same skin-boosting properties but with a weightless, non-oily consistency for water light skin. Its beautiful floral scent with notes of orchid, rose, white musk and cedarwood will make it a pleasure to apply, day after day as it intensively hydrates and strengthens the skin's barrier without overburdening it.. A complete care cream that will address signs of ageing, the Orchidee Imperiale The Light Cream harnesses its power from a duo of orchids that make up the Orchidee Imperiale Cell Respiration technology that is used throughout the whole range of products. Cell respiration maximises the cells energy production and accelerates their regeneration, helping to reduce all visible signs of ageing (including wrinkles, fine lines and lack of firmness). The Light Cream boasts 2 forms of hyaluronic acids which assists in helping the skin to rehydrate itself and recreate its water reserves while enhancing its protective barrier. Meanwhile, knotweed extract, a great source of reservatrol, will also help to visibly plump the skin and give a more youthful appearance as well as offer protection from environmental aggressors thanks to its high antioxidant levels.. Why We Love It . If you're a fan of the original GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Cream but perhaps at times find it a little more heavy than you'd like, for example in the summer months, then this lighter version is exactly what you're looking for. Offering the same skincare and anti-ageing benefits as the original formulation, it has a lighter texture that offers continuous hydration throughout the day, and we think it feels gorgeous on the skin (and makes a great base for makeup).. How To Use It . After cleansing your skin and applying any lotions or serums take a small amount of The Light Cream using the spatula apply to the face with your fingertips from the centre of the face outwards. GUERLAIN has a special massaging method that can be used to enhance the effects of the cream, and this is featured within the product packaging.. Works Well With . This is beautifully light and airy face cream, but perhaps you'd like something richer for the night time, or serum to pair with your moisturiser? The GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale collection contains a range of high-performance skincare solutions for those who are looking for youth-boosting formulas that will lift, restore elasticity, bright and perfect the complexion while offering an anti-ageing action.. Values . Non-comedogenic.

listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Day Cream SPF30 for All Skin Types 50ml
listings.description: "Target common signs of ageing with the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Day Cream SPF30, a lightweight formula that plumps up your skin for a youthful look." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Centella Sensitive Facial Cleanser 250ml
listings.description: One for all you sensitive skin sufferers! The Kiehl's Centella Sensitive Facial Cleanser is an unscented ultra gentle face wash for those with a reactive complexion in need of a mild yet effective solution to removing impurities.. A hypersensitive skin must-have, this ultra-caring pH balanced facial cleanser will gently remove dirt, oil and any impurities while ensuring the skin remains soothed, comforted and hydrated for up to 8 hours with its barrier strengthening formula. It can be used with or without water so would be a great choice for those looking for a no-rinse method, too.. Thanks to the inclusion of centella asiatica extract, skin remains comfortable and soothed as this ancient medicinal plant offers skin-calming properties and won't clog the pores.. Why We Love It . Here at Escentual, we have a few members of staff who suffer from sensitive skin, and they often complain that most face washes they've tried can, unfortunately, cause their skin to react. Then, along came Kiehl's Centella Sensitive Facial Cleanser to make their cleansing woes disappear! It's so mild and calming that it will effectively remove dirt and debris but without the stringent action of other cleansers. And for those that dislike using water to cleanse with, great news, the Centella cleanser can be used as both a wash and a no-rinse cleanser, so you can choose whichever method is best for you.. listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Calendula Serum-Infused Water Cream 50ml
listings.description: Harness the power of flowers into your everyday skincare routine with the Kiehl’s Calendula Serum-Infused Water Cream, a soothing hydrator for normal, oily and combination skin types formulated with concentrated calendula serum for fresh and radiant skin, every day.. Using one of Kiehl’s heritage ingredients, calendula, this fresh gel moisturising cream has a weightless texture that will provide soothing and long-lasting hydration. But that’s not all; it will also help to strengthen the skin’s natural barrier by protecting the skin from environmental aggressors and helping to resist the early signs of skin-ageing. In fact, it will help to improve the look of fine dry lines as well your skin texture, helping it to feel smoother and look more even while softening the complexion and giving it a boost of radiance and a gorgeous visible healthy glow.. The starring ingredient in this skin-quenching water cream is calendula. Its petals are steeped at a very high temperature before being mixed into the cream in the water phase and are suspended there until the product is applied to the face. This is when this soothing cream gets to work! The infusion transforms and will deliver hundreds of micronised calendula petals directly to the skin that contain 5 discomfort reducing compounds to provide instant relief to any irritation while helping to alleviate any redness. Containing the highest concentrate of calendula flower extract in any of the Kiehl’s formulas, this serum-infused cream is a refreshing step for your skincare routine that will help protect, hydrate and calm the skin while giving it a dewy-fresh appearance.. Why We Love It . With so many fans of the calendula range here at Escentual HQ, we were excited about this new launch because now we have a moisturising cream to use within our calendula routine. But this isn’t just any old hydrator, this Kiehl’s Calendula Water Cream also has a concentrated serum infused into the formula, so you’re technically including two phases of your skincare routine in one easy step!. How To Use It . Both morning and evening, after cleansing and applying your toner and serum apply a pea-sized amount to the skin and massage in before patting the product into the skin.. Works Well With . If you’re interested in trying more products that have been infused with the skin-loving benefits of Calendula, why not take a look at the Calendula range from Kiehl’s? Known for its skin-soothing properties, it’s perfect for normal, oily and combination skin types..

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Ultra Light Daily UV Defense Aqua Gel SPF50 30ml
listings.description: Daily sunscreen you can rely on, no matter your skin type! Introducing Kiehl's Ultra Light Daily UV Defense Aqua Gel SPF50, a lightweight formula that will offer high UV protection as well as shielding the complexion from everyday pollution.. Are you searching for a sunscreen that will keep your normal to oily complexion shine-free all day yet won't compromise on protection? The search is over. Kiehl's have created a non-greasy water-light formula that will not only shield your skin from UV rays; it will also help to tackle environmental aggressors while keeping your skin hydrated, smooth and feeling comfortable throughout the day.. Tested in humid conditions, Kiehl's combines sunscreen filters with pollution protection technology to defend the skin beyond just UVA and UVB rays. This intelligent formulation also forms a protective barrier on the surface of the skin to reduce UV induced oxidation and to stop pollutants from entering the pores and causing stress and inflammation to the skin. These environmental aggressors can also be responsible for accelerated skin ageing which can cause the skin to look dry and dull with an uneven skin tone. The addition of a boost of antioxidant vitamin E, which is naturally occurring in the skin, will help to neutralise these free-radicals and at the same time, also give the complexion a hit of moisture and hydration!. Why We Love It . We all know the importance of wearing a facial sun cream; it protects our skin from the damage caused those pesky UV rays and prevents premature ageing. However , trying to find an SPF for the face that won't interfere with makeup, leave a white cast or create a greasy film on the skin can be hard work in itself! Until now. Kiehl's Aqua Gel SPF will sit perfectly under your make up because it isn't sticky and absorbs quickly and won't cause your base to break down thanks to its matte finish. It's a definite yes from us and a product that has already become a staple in many of our daily routines. Thank you Kiehl's!. How To Use It . Apply every morning as the final step in your skincare regime (after any serums or moisturisers) and taking care to avoid the eye area.. Works Well With . If you're looking for more products to suit your skin that has a tendency for shine and oiliness why not take a look at the products in the Kiehl's Oily Skin line-up? Each product allows you to get on with your day without worrying about your skin letting you down.. Values . Non-comedogenic, tested under dermatological control.. Fragrance-free, oil-free, paraben-free..

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Mystic Incense Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Incense gets sophisticated with The Merchant Of Venice Mystic Incense Eau de Parfum Spray, a woody and gourmand fragrance that oozes a rich elegance.. Salted caramels blend perfectly with dried fruit accords in the opening of this seductive scent before an intense heart comes into play where facets of blond woods surround the popular note of incense. The intensity doesn't stop there though, as darker notes of thick and indulgent chocolate are provided by cocoa absolute in the base, giving this addictive fragrance a vigorous personality that will not be forgotten!. This new interpretation of incense (an oily resin exuded by the Boswellia plants typical of the Arabian Peninsula and Africa) creates a harmonious and wearable scent that has a seductive quality to it.. Why We Love It . Sometimes gourmand scents can be a touch too sweet for some people. What we love about this offering from The Merchant Of Venice is that fact that although it has some sweeter notes, when combined with the prominent incense accord it changes their composition and creates a gorgeously elegant and sophisticated scent that is quite unique.. Notes . Top Notes: Salty Caramel, Dried Fruit Accord. Heart Notes: Blond Woods, Somalia Incense. Base Notes: Cocoa Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Andalusian Soul Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Immerse your senses in the sensuality of The Merchant Of Venice Andalusian Soul Eau de Parfum Spray, a bold fragrance for women.. An audacious fragrance made for those who love to make a sophisticated statement, Andalusian Soul Eau de Parfum opens with refined acacia, amber and rum. Heart notes of cistus labdanum enhanced by smoky and balsamic accords create an earthy warmth, before a dry-down of vanilla, amber and sage allow for a refined and elegant sillage.. A feminine scent, this Eau de Parfum recalls the warmth and the mystery of the sunny lands from which it comes, and is an olfactory expression of the maritime trading route connected to the Venetian Republic and the raw materials and savoury herbs transported within it.. Why We Love It . One thing we love about this fragrance? The inspiration behind it and the heritage it pays homage to. The top alcoholic notes refer to the drinks produced in Malaga during ancient times, while the elegant yellow and orange bottle is reminiscent of the warm climate (and atmosphere) in Southern Spain and Morocco. Whenever we wear this scent, it transports us to the Mediterranean!. Notes . Top Notes: Acacia, Amber, Rum. Heart Notes: Smoky Accord, Balsamic Accord, Cistus, Labdanum.. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Sage.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Petite Chérie Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Petite Chérie is like a tender hug in a bottle! Usually, fruity-floral scents can feel overly sweet, but this delicate balance of crisp pear, fresh grass, and velvety rose is pure, effortless perfection on the skin." - Escentual Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Annick Goutal Petite Chérie:. It's a whisper of tenderness that evokes pure emotion, making you feel instantly cherished and comforted.. Petite Chérie is a pioneer of fruity florals; its timeless simplicity makes it impossible not to fall for!. Soft vanilla and white musks create a cozy, second-skin veil that gently warms on the body.. Musk rose brings a subtle, romantic elegance that complements the playful fruitiness.. Fragrance lovers adore its authentic blend of juicy, mouth-watering pear and crisp green notes.. It's a touching tribute from a mother to her daughter—capturing innocence, affection, and beauty in every spritz.. . What Does Annick Goutal Petite Chérie Smell Like?. Petite Chérie is a tender, innocent Eau de Parfum that opens with the dewy freshness of juicy pear paired with the green crispness of freshly cut grass. As the scent unfolds, a delicate heart of musk rose blossoms, bringing a soft, floral grace to the composition. The fragrance then settles into a soothing, cocooning base of sweet vanilla and smooth white musks, wrapping the skin in a velvety, second-skin warmth.. . Fragrance family: Fruity-Floral. . Top notes: Pear, Cut Grass. . Heart notes: Musk Rose. . Base notes: Vanilla, White Musks. . . Why It's Escentual:. Master perfumers Annick Goutal and Isabelle Doyen created Petite Chérie as a heartfelt ode to love—born from Annick's deep affection for her daughter, Camille. Celebrated as a pioneer in the fruity-floral family, its charm lies in its masterclass precision and its celebration of genuine emotion.. Housed in the Maison's emblematic Art Deco-inspired gadroon bottle—a nod to Annick Goutal’s history as an antique dealer—it is topped with their signature tied bow to symbolise generosity. Petite Chérie has an innocent, luminous quality that shines brightest in the spring and summer, making it a beloved everyday treasure.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We also recommend the following perfume tips: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows. . Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent. . Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance. . Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance. . If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm. . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Transport your senses to Tuscany with the lemony freshness of Annick Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum Spray, an aromatic unisex scent made for citrus lovers." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Annick Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum: . Refreshing aromatic-citrus scent with a vibrant lemon aroma.. Long-lasting Eau de Parfum that lasts 6 hours on the skin.. Part of the unisex d'Hadrien collection.. New-for-2022 elegant glass-bow design with same iconic fragrance.. . What Does Annick Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . The first spray is a breath full of fresh citrus notes. A fusion of Sicilian lemon, citron, grapefruit and bergamot powerfully intertwines with juicy mandarin and juniper berries in the heart to give body to this classic unisex scent. The base is clean and refreshing, introducing creamy and fresh musky tones. To finish, cypress adds a green herbaceous note that lingers amongst the bright, zesty citrus.. . Top notes: Sicilian lemon, citron, grapefruit and bergamot. . Heart notes: Italian green mandarin and juniper berries. . Base notes: Cyprus and White musks. . . Why It's Escentual: . Fresh and uplifting, Eau d'Hadrien is made for lovers of citrus scents. The bright lemony tones were first blended in 1981 by Annick Goutal, and now in 2022, the same iconic scent has had a design makeover. The new glass bottle is adorned with a beautiful golden bow with golden metallic accents, creating a luxurious vintage feel that is true to the heritage of Annick Goutal. The same unisex scent is also available in a more androgynous bottle, designed to be a '˜his and hers' way to display the fragrance.. When crafting d'Hadrien, Annick wanted to recreate the hottest hour of the day in Tuscany, and you can really smell the warmth in this citrus-powered fresh fragrance. One spritz will whisk you away to sunnier days, which is perfect for the height of summer or to refresh your memory all year round.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz onto your neck and wrists. For a longer-lasting fragrance apply to freshly moisturised skin.. . The Sustainable Side: . The presentation box can be recycled..

listings.rawTitle: Vichy Mineral 89 Eyes - Repairing Eye Fortifier 15ml
listings.description: Let tired and puffy eyes be a thing of the past with Vichy Mineral 89 Eyes. A daily treatment for the eye contour that will hydrate, smooth and brighten as well as help to improve eye bags, dark circles and fine lines. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and also contact lens wearers it's a multi-benefit product you're going to want in your skincare regime!. Following the success of the Mineral 89 Serum, Vichy have produced a fresh, light-textured eye gel enriched with hyaluronic acid that will revitalise and protect this delicate area of the face. Providing an instant refreshing sensation, this moisturising gel will absorb quickly; it's non-greasy and non-sticky texture helping the eye contour to feel soothed and look less fatigued as it gets to work on plumping fine lines while smoothing and brightening the skin.. Ensuring optimum skin tolerance without compromising on formula efficacy, Mineral 89 Eyes contains caffeine 0.3% which will help to depuff the under eye area and reduce the appearance of eye bags. Natural origin hyaluronic acid 0.2% works to hydrate and plump the eye area for up to 24 hours, making it look brighter and more radiant while adenosine and 89% Vichy Thermal Water from French volcanoes will leave the skin looking healthy, glowing and less tired.. Why We Love It . With so many of us here at Escentual being long-standing fans of the original Mineral 89 Serum for the face, you can imagine how excited we were for the release of an eye serum in this skin-boosting range! Not only is this a great product for those who don't get enough sleep because it really brightens and depuffs the eye area, but it also helps to make eyelashes stronger and silkier as well as being an excellent makeup base for any under-eye products.. How To Use It . Both morning and evening, apply to clean, dry skin. Pump 1 to 2 drops onto your fingertips and gently tap all around your eye-contour using your ring finger. Then using 2 fingers, massage with care under the eyes to help with any de-puffing.. Works Well With . Vichy Mineral 89 Eyes is the perfect partner to the Vichy Mineral 89 Serum, used in conjunction with one another you can expect beautifully plumped and hydrated skin that will look healthy, smooth and fully revitalised.. Values . Dermatologically tested, Opthalmologically tested, hypoallergenic.. Fragrance-free..

Moreover, it's enriched with provitamin E, a powerful antioxidant that protects against free radical damage that causes dullness, dryness and premature ageing.. Avene's water-resistant sunscreen is perfect for the whole family, thanks to its softening, soothing and anti-irritating formula, which is both lightweight and non-sticky on the skin. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Reveal your soft and playful side with the Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray, a floral and woody fragrance for women with a hint of musk.. Moschino's infamous teddy bear makes a distinctive come-back with Toy 2, a unique second edition fragrance for 2019 that combines fresh fruity notes with elegant flowers and comforting musk for a delicious and wearable scent that you'll want to wear every day.. Toy 2 is a scent to make you feel good. Sparkling mandarin and sharp granny smith apple combine with delicate magnolia at the top before blending into the sophisticated combination of jasmine, peony and crisp white currant creating an addictive blend that captivates before it mellows into a radiant and soft dry down of amber wood, sandalwood and crystalline musk.. Why We Love It . We can't talk about this fragrance without mentioning its gorgeous bottle. The iconic Moschino teddy has been transformed into a luxurious and collectable frosted glass teddy bear, his gold collar adding that all-essential and classy finishing touch! Toy 2 captures the playfulness of the original Toy fragrance but has been pared back for a softer and sophisticated interpretation, and we think this is a must for any Moschino fan!. Works Well With . For the full Toy 2 experience, why not layer your perfume with the shower gel or body moisturiser from the same range, it will prolong and intensify this beautiful fragrance.. Notes . Top Notes: Magnolia, Granny Smith Apple, Mandarin. Heart Notes: White Currant, Peony, Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk, Amber Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Cleansing Oil 500ml
listings.description: Nourish your skin as you remove impurities with the Uriage Cleansing Oil, a soap-free hypoallergenic makeup removing cleanser suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and very dry conditions.. With an ultra-soft cleansing base, the Cleansing Oil effortlessly eliminates makeup, sebum, dirt and debris from the skin. Even waterproof and stubborn makeup is captured by the oil and lifted away from the face and eyes, leaving the complexion completely clear. It's been ophthalmologically tested for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers too, ensuring no irritation or stinging.. Not only does the soap-free cleanser rid the skin of dirt, but it infuses it with a plethora of nourishing and hydrating ingredients. The skin's moisture level is preserved to leave it feeling soft and comfortable after washing. Dryness is prevented with sunflower oil, while cranberry oil protects the skin and enhances its radiance.. Formulated with 25% glycerin, the cleansing oil creates an invisible and non-greasy film over skin to allow moisture to deeply penetrate the epidermis, shield against environmental aggressors and strengthen skin's moisture balance. The complexion is protected from the drying effects of hard water, while the inclusion of Uriage Thermal Water keeps skin soothed and hydrated.. Why We Love It . Despite being an oil, the cleansing has a unique gel-like texture like nothing else we've ever tried. The golden liquid dissolves upon contact with water to create an almost milky emulsion, with a light floral fragrance that refreshes and subtly lingers on the skin. Cleansing has never felt so pampering!. How To Use It . Pump one to two drops of oil onto dry hands and apply to dry skin. Massage the oil in circular motions, and add a little water to emulsify using light smoothing strokes. Rinse thoroughly with water.. Works Well With . Uriage's products all contain their renowned Thermal Water, so why not pair this cleansing oil with a nourishing face cream from their moisturisers collection?. Values . listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Institut Esthederm Excellage Serum 30ml
listings.description: Rediscover youthful skin with the Institut Esthederm Excellage Serum, an innovative serum cream that will tackle all types of ageing including chronological, hormonal and environmental.. Formulated for skin that is weakened, sagging or thinning and lacking radiance and comfort; this luxurious serum-cream will immediately nourish and leave the skin feeling firmer and naturally luminous. Apply morning and evening to the face, neck and decollete by warming two pumps of the serum in your hands and then placing them for 3 seconds on your cheeks, forehead, chin and neck to help penetrate. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Touche Eclat Radiant Touch Illuminating Pen 2.5ml / 0 - Luminous Milk
listings.description: A worldwide icon for over 25 years, Yves Saint Laurent Touche Eclat Radiant Touch Illuminating Pen is an innovative highlighting and concealing pen that gives the complexion an instant lift.. Perfect for use on the go, Touche Eclat is perfect for brightening skin in a flash. It can be used all over the face to lighten shadows and highlight your best features, with a famously natural, luminous and buildable finish that suits a variety of skin tones.. When you want to feel polished, reach for this pen! Its blend of Light-reflecting pigments will diffuse the look of fine lines and wrinkles, disguise tired eyes and help to sculpt your complexion for a fresh result at any time of day.. Why We Love It . This beauty icon almost needs no introduction. An emblematic click-and-go pen that has been brightening skin since 1992, Touche Eclat kick-started a highlighting revolution that is now a staple in makeup routines the world over. There's nothing quite like the subtle lift that the highlighter / illuminator pen gives to skin; you need to try it to believe it.. How To Use It . Click the pen to dispense the liquid (you may find that you need to click up to 20 times before the first use), then brush it directly onto the skin. It's truly multi-purpose: blend a little underneath your eyes to fake 8 hours' worth of sleep; blend along the brow bone to give brows a lift; use it on cheekbones and the bridge of the nose as a highlight; use it as a primer for eyeshadow; or use it on the bow of your lips to enhance their shape. The possibilities are endless!. Targeted Illumination for Key Features: . EYES: Apply to the inner corner of the eye for an instantly wide-awake look. Dab around the eye area to add light, helping to improve the appearance of dullness or dark circles for a bright-eyed appearance.. MOUTH: Apply the product into smile lines, from the base of the nose downwards, to bring natural light into dark creases around the mouth, softening their appearance.. LIPS: Apply a small amount into the middle of the cupid’s bow to add light to the top of the lips, creating the appearance of plumpness & subtle volume.. FACE : Apply the product onto the highest points of your cheekbones & brow bones to naturally highlight and sculpt your features, enhancing your glow..

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Touche Eclat Radiant Touch Illuminating Pen 2.5ml / 6 - Luminous Amber
listings.description: A worldwide icon for over 25 years, Yves Saint Laurent Touche Eclat Radiant Touch Illuminating Pen is an innovative highlighting and concealing pen that gives the complexion an instant lift.. Perfect for use on the go, Touche Eclat is perfect for brightening skin in a flash. It can be used all over the face to lighten shadows and highlight your best features, with a famously natural, luminous and buildable finish that suits a variety of skin tones.. When you want to feel polished, reach for this pen! Its blend of Light-reflecting pigments will diffuse the look of fine lines and wrinkles, disguise tired eyes and help to sculpt your complexion for a fresh result at any time of day.. Why We Love It . This beauty icon almost needs no introduction. An emblematic click-and-go pen that has been brightening skin since 1992, Touche Eclat kick-started a highlighting revolution that is now a staple in makeup routines the world over. There's nothing quite like the subtle lift that the highlighter / illuminator pen gives to skin; you need to try it to believe it.. How To Use It . Click the pen to dispense the liquid (you may find that you need to click up to 20 times before the first use), then brush it directly onto the skin. It's truly multi-purpose: blend a little underneath your eyes to fake 8 hours' worth of sleep; blend along the brow bone to give brows a lift; use it on cheekbones and the bridge of the nose as a highlight; use it as a primer for eyeshadow; or use it on the bow of your lips to enhance their shape. The possibilities are endless!. Targeted Illumination for Key Features: . EYES: Apply to the inner corner of the eye for an instantly wide-awake look. Dab around the eye area to add light, helping to improve the appearance of dullness or dark circles for a bright-eyed appearance.. MOUTH: Apply the product into smile lines, from the base of the nose downwards, to bring natural light into dark creases around the mouth, softening their appearance.. LIPS: Apply a small amount into the middle of the cupid’s bow to add light to the top of the lips, creating the appearance of plumpness & subtle volume.. FACE : Apply the product onto the highest points of your cheekbones & brow bones to naturally highlight and sculpt your features, enhancing your glow..

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Dial up the intensity with Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette Spray, an amber fougere fragrance for men that contains a blend of hot spices, vibrant citruses and warm woods.. The best things happen after dark, and Spicebomb makes those after-hour affairs just that extra bit more enthralling. A mysterious, daring and provocative rendition of the original fragrance, Spicebomb Night Vision is an invitation to entice and captivate and is made for the man that is just as much sophisticated as he is seductive.. An explosion of contrasts, Spicebomb opens with an electric blend of green mandarin, cardamom and apple enhanced by a powerful fusion of bergamot, grapefruit and a black spices complex. In the heart, a fresh flurry of clary sage, geranium, rosemary and lavendin creates an intriguing sensuality, before giving way to a base of vibrant woodsy notes set alight by accords of roasted almond and musk.. Why We Love It . Here at Escentual, we're loving Night Vision's bottle design. Inspired by the green light of Night Vision Technology, the iconic bottle of Spicebomb has been reinterpreted with the electric-green tint of a lens, merging into sophisticated black glass that ensures it will take pride of place in your cologne collection. Made for the night, simply spritz on your pulse points to unleash this scent and prepare to captivate!. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Green Mandarin, Grapefruit, Apple Accord, Green Cardamom, Black Spices Complex. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Rosemary, Lavandin. Base Notes: Roasted Almond, Tonka Bean Absolute, Patchouli, Cedarwood, Vibrant Woods, Musks..

listings.description: Indulge your skin with the Lancome Absolue Precious Cells Revitalising Night Ritual Mask and achieve skin so nourished and youthful, you'll never look back!. The best part? It does it while you're sleeping - no effort required!. This luxurious night-mask also contains Pro-Xylane, the holy grail of youth-rejuvenating ingredients. This truly luxurious night mask reinforces the skin's moisture barrier whilst you catch up on sleep; it's the ultimate night-time replenisher that turns your routine into a decadent ritual.. listings.rawTitle: Lancome Absolue Revitalising Eye Cream 20ml
listings.description: Target visible signs of ageing with Lancome Absolue Revitalising Eye Cream, infused with 3 rose extracts. Try the Lancome Absolue Eye Cream, infused with Grand Rose Extract 3 roses: Lancome Rose (TM), Centifolia Rose and Rose Damascena. Introducing Absolue, Lancôme's exceptional collection of indulgent formulas. Inspired by nature, refined by science. Lancôme's gold standard to target visible signs of ageing. The extract of the rose is combined in a high tech alliance with Pro-Xylane, Absolue's iconic ingredient. . Why We Love It . Promising gorgeously youthful eyes, the Absolue Revitalising Eye Cream is, quite literally, a feast for the eyes. Its smoothing, comforting properties make your eyes feel immediately rested, while visible signs of ageing are reduced. It's Lancome's gold standard of eye care.. How To Use It . Using the tip of your ring finger, tap onto the eye contour both morning and night for brighter looking eyes in an instant.. Works Well With . This eye cream is ideal for use just before applying your Absolue moisturiser for complete age-defying care..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Absolue Regenerating Brightening Rich Cream 60ml
listings.description: Indulge your complexion with the Lancome Absolue Regenerating Brightening Rich Cream, a nurturing formulation enriched with three rose extracts that will gently promote skin renewal and leave skin feeling softer, supple and more comfortable.. listings.rawTitle: Bioderma Photoderm Invisible Mist SPF50+ 150ml
listings.description: Very high UVA and UVB protection in a flash with the Bioderma Photoderm MAX Sun Mist SPF50+, a spray-on sunscreen for the face and body that you can use on-the-go.. This convenient sun mist from Bioderma is suitable for all skin types, its excellent tolerance ideal for even the most sensitive of skin and can be used on the complexion as well as all over the body. It offers high-level protection with a minimal-fuss application. Simply spray the product onto the skin, and you're done! It's transparent and lightly scented mist has a refreshing and hydrating texture.. Photoderm MAX Sun Mist's very water resistant formulation is perfect for outdoor activities and will even work for hairy areas of the skin. Its wide-angle spray offers continuous diffusion for an even application. Containing powerful UV filters and patented Cellular BIOprotection to activate the skin's natural defences, it protects cells and will also combat premature ageing while shielding your skin from the sun.. Why We Love It . When you're at the beach or laying on a sunlounger, cocktail in hand, the last thing you want to do is fuss around with ensuring sun lotions are applied evenly. Photoderm MAX Sun Mist has a hands-free application that makes applying your sunscreen quick and fuss-free. The multi-position application means that you can reach all those difficult parts with ease and applying all-over sun protection takes a matter of seconds. This is effective sun care for lazy people!. How To Use It . You're going to love how easy and simple this is to use and apply. No need to shake, before sun exposure simply hold the can 20cm away from the skin and spray on the areas of skin you want to protect. Reapply every 80 mins or after swimming.. Works Well With . If you're planning a holiday or planning on spending a lot of time in the sun and want to ensure your skin is fully protected from the sun, why not take a look at the full Bioderma Suncare range? With everything you need to protect your skin and defend it from the harmful rays of the sun, you can be sure you are fully shielded at all times.. Values . Hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic.. Paraben-free..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Essentiel Natural Glow Foundation SPF20 30ml / 06N - Very Deep
listings.description: Fear no more about foundation being bad for your skin thanks to the GUERLAIN L'Essentiel Natural Glow Foundation SPF20, a 97% naturally-derived makeup base inspired by the beauty of bare skin.. Foundation reinvented, with L'Essentiel naturalness and high performance go hand-in-hand. The radiant-finish foundation hydrates and balances the skin with white cocoa bean and red algae, while added SPF20 protects from harmful UV rays and pollution. Upon application, the comfortable, liquid texture will effortlessly envelop the complexion, while allowing your skin to breathe and offering a buildable, light to medium coverage that will stay even and flawless for up to 16 hours.. Infused with a kind-to-skin fragrance, L'Essentiel Natural Glow smells just as good as it looks and feels. Its woody, musky aroma opens with a delicious note of white almond that melts into a heart of white tea before giving way to a soft and creamy base of sandalwood that will leave your skin delicately scented and your senses awakened.. Why We Love It . Does foundation get much better than this? We especially can't take our eyes off of the exquisite bottle! Designed by Matheieu Lehanneur, and inspired by the refined art of balance, it reflects the harmony between nature and makeup performance, a principle that the L'Essentiel Foundation was born from. Available in a variety of shades to match every skin tone and finished with GUERLAIN's luxury edge, L'Essentiel Natural Glow Foundation is deserving of a spot on everyone's vanity.. How To Use It . Apply 1 drop to your foundation brush to achieve a light coverage or 2-3 pumps for medium coverage. Then, dab the foundation onto the face at five points: forehead, nose, chin, left and right cheeks and blend and buff the foundation into the skin from the centre of the outwards using your foundation brush.. Works Well With . Get the best from the L'Essentiel Foundation by partnering it with the L'Essentiel Retractable Foundation Brush. Specifically created to be used with the GUERLAIN L'Essentiel Foundation, it will enhance the result of your makeup, offering a fresh and flawless finish.. Values . Dermatologically tested, tested on sensitive skin, non-comedogenic.. Alcohol-free, silicone-free, oil-free..

listings.rawTitle: Kiehl's Lip Balm #1 15ml
listings.description: Help to make chapped skin a thing of the past with the Kiehl's Lip Balm #1 and get ready for lips that will look and feel soft, supple and smoother.. Any beauty lover's dream, this lip balm has it all! Featuring a soothing formula containing nourishing vitamin E, soothing aloe vera and hydrating squalane, this lip balm gives you natural-looking, glossy lips. Thanks to its hydration-loving formula, your lips are guaranteed to be lusting over this balm from the get-go.. Upon applying, your lips will instantly be boosted with antioxidant protection and lasting care. Its infusion of sweet almond oil pampers your skin with impeccable care, ensuring that your smile always looks beautiful.. Why We Love It . Soft and kissable lips? Yes please. Designed for the busy, Kiehl's Lip Balm #1 is the perfect companion for your handbag so whether you're exploring a new city or going on that date, you can be sure that this nurturing lip balm will soothe your lips.. How To Use It . Easy to apply, simply dispense a small amount onto your lips and massage in. Reapply whenever you want to enhance the softness of your skin.. listings.rawTitle: Urban Decay Brow Blade - Waterproof Pencil & Ink Stain 0.05g/0.4ml / Neutral Nana
listings.description: Say hello to flawless brows with the Urban Decay Brow Blade - Waterproof Pencil & Ink Stain, a double-ended eyebrow tool that features a brow-perfecting, waterproof retractable pencil and precise ink stain felt tip pen.. This revolutionary dual-ended dream from Urban Decay is part ink stain and part waterproof pencil and offers results that mimic those achieved by microblading. An ideal solution for filling in thinning or uneven brows, it allows you to define and sculpt your arches to perfection.. Brow Blade is available in a range of versatile shades created to match and flatter your natural assets and turn flat, shapeless, fine eyebrows into an immaculately defined pair of arches and not only that; its slim design means it's perfect for travelling with for on-the-go application.. Why We Love It . Why spend a fortune on microblading when the Brow Blade offers similar results for a fraction of the price? We can see why this is one of Wende Zamnir's (the founder of Urban Decay) personal favorites from the Street Style Brow collection. This multi-use brow styling pencil allows you to easily create detailed, defined arches even on fine brows. Plus, for all you redheads out there, Urban Decay have created the perfect shade for those with red or ginger locks “ Gingersnap!. How To Use It . Apply to clean brows. Using the creamy, waterproof pencil fill in any sparse areas, then follow with the ink stain felt tip to create natural hair-like strokes to complete your look.. Works Well With . Do you know what goes hand in hand with perfect brows? Beautiful eyes to mesmerise! Why not spoil your peepers with one of Urban Decay's legendary eyeshadow palettes and complete your makeup look.. Values . Cruelty-free.. Waterproof..

Look no further as the Kiehl’s Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution will promote youthful clarity and a more even complexion.. Follow up your treatment with a daily SPF from for the face from the Kiehl’s suncare collection.. Values . Silicone-free, paraben-free, fragrance-free..

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Spray 35ml
listings.description: Experience a world without rules with the GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Spray, a feminine floral woody fragrance for the fearlessly elegant and spontaneous woman.. L'Interdit by GIVENCHY is an enigmatic and sensual blend of celestial white florals and rich, dark woods. Its scent is inspired by a modern heroine who radiates sophistication and charm but combines these characteristics with an impulsive and intriguing side to her personality. Never compromising and always daring, she lives her life without boundaries. She's a secret thrill-seeker who forbids herself nothing.. L'Interdit opens with a flourish of innocent white floral notes, its dreamy bouquet of sweet orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose intertwining with fresh facets of bergamot. In the base, this luminous femininity begins to flirt with the dark side; sensual and alluring accords of patchouli and vetiver fuse with pure white petals to create a contrasting scent that is intense, addictive and truly unforgettable.. Why We Love It . Inspired by GIVENCHY's classic L'Interdit fragrance first launched in 1957, this new interpretation truly captures the spirit of the forbidden. Its blend of deep, magnetic notes and voluptuous white florals creates perfect balance, ensuring it's just as perfect for evening wear as it is during the day; it leaves just the right amount of fragrance trail for people to wonder what the captivating scent is.. Perfect for the office, a date or that unexpected night out you weren't planning, the L'Interdit woman lives her life precariously!. Works Well With . Push boundaries just a touch more by incorporating the GIVENCHY L'Interdit Hydrating Body Lotion into your evening ritual. The luxurious body cream is delicately scented with the notes of L'Interdit to intensify and prolong your matching Eau de Parfum.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Pear.. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Tuberose.. Base Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Ambroxan, Vanilla..

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density 30ml
listings.description: Replenish your hair and keep it looking full and lustrous with The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density, a high-potency serum that improves hair health.. The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum blends together different technologies to create a unique formulation that is committed to growing and protecting your hair. The REDENSYL complex blends four molecules that target the hair follicle stem cells, helping it to favour growth over loss, increasing both the number of hair strands and the quality of the hair.. Additionally, the Procapil peptide complex uses a combination of vitaminated matrikine and oleanolic acid to strengthen hair and minimise strand loss, while the BAICAPIL complex combines three botanical active ingredients designed to reduce hair loss, stimulate growth and increase hair density. It also infuses AnaGain, which includes high-solubility caffeine that helps to increase blood circulation to the scalp, promoting healthy hair follicles.. Why We Love It . The Ordinary has combined a wide range of natural vitamins, minerals, amino acids, peptides and other active extracts at extremely high concentrations in this high-quality serum that all work together to encourage hair growth and volume, giving your hair a boost. The formula is ultra-lightweight and has an emollient base for the most efficient penetration, meaning it doesn't leave hair feeling greasy or weighed down. It's also silicone-free, so it won't prevent moisture from getting to your hair.. How To Use It . Use the pipette to apply a few drops of the lightweight serum to a clean, dry scalp and massage thoroughly. Apply as needed or once daily, ideally before bedtime so that the oil can work overnight. The formulation of this treatment is designed to be left in, so don't rinse your hair or scalp after application.. Works Well With . Choose from The Ordinary's selection of oils, perfect for using on your hair after using this serum to give your locks a soft sheen as well as leaving it stronger and protected.. Values . Vegan, pH 4.75-5.75.. Alcohol-free, silicone-free, fragrance-free, nut-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free..

listings.description: Follow your passion and experience success with the Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Spray, a deep, fresh and masculine scent that seduces and inspires.. Created for men of conviction, the Y Eau de Parfum is instantly arresting. It encapsulates the enduring energy of the Y Eau de Toilette with more intensity and arousing depth, ensuring a lasting impression that lingers long after you've left the room.. The Y Eau de Parfum opens with the freshness of bergamot and ginger, further intensified by juicy apple accords. This is swiftly mellowed by the powerful masculinity of sage and juniper with a hint of elegant geranium absolute, before deep and sensual woody facets amplify the mystery of vetiver, creating a powerful and gallant base to this enigmatic scent.. Why We Love It . Y Eau de Parfum is a multifaceted fragrance that is perfectly suited to a self-assured, modern and visionary man. Its contrast of light and dark tones creates an approachable, yet intense and wearable scent suitable for everyday.. Y has a certain something about it that's incredibly alluring; it creates a suave mood. It's perfect for a first date or an occasion where you want to make the right impression.. Works Well With . Fully experience the Y Collection and build a fragrance ritual by using the Yves Saint Laurent Y After Shave Balm after cleansing the face.. Notes . Top Notes: Apple Accord, Bergamot Essence, Ginger Essence, Elemi Essence, Aldehydes. Heart Notes: Geranium Absolute, Juniper Essence, Sage Essence, Lavender Essence. Base Notes: Vetiver Essence, Frankincense Essence, Operamide.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Pure XS For Her Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Prepare to have it all with the Rabanne Pure XS For Her Eau de Parfum Spray, an electrifying floral oriental fragrance with disarming allure.. Pure XS For Her oozes seductive sex appeal. Let your senses be exhilarated by the carnal collision of aromatic sensations, which recreates the feeling of skin heated with pleasure and shivering with desire.. Wild and provocative, an opening note of creamy ylang-ylang fuses with tempting vanilla to create a smouldering undertone of passion, before making way for a distinctive heart of warm popped puffed corn, musk and milkwood. As it simmers down to a seductive base, chiselled sandalwood blends with a daring facet of hot ambrette seed to create a sensuous, liberated power.. Why We Love It . A celebration of freedom, Pure XS For Her is for the woman who's not afraid to embrace her femininity. Intoxicating, intriguing and absolutely irresistible, one spritz of this eau de parfum will be sure to set hearts racing. Don't say we didn't warn you!. Works Well With . Infuse an extra touch of Pure XS into your everyday beauty ritual with the Paco Rabanne Pure XS Sensual Body Lotion. It will envelop your body in the wonderfully passionate aroma of ylang-ylang, popcorn and vanilla, and it can be used alongside your Eau de Parfum to amp up the sex appeal!. Notes . Top Notes: Ylang-ylang, Vanilla. Heart Notes: Popcorn, Musk, Milkwood. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Ambrette Seed.
