listings.rawTitle: Moschino So Real Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Life's an adventure with the Moschino So Real Cheap And Chic Eau de Toilette Spray, a fun and flirty fragrance for women.. The house of Moschino launches a colourful new chapter in its iconic Cheap And Chic story with So Real. Inspired by the artistic style of its founder Franco Moschino and the enduring creative influence of Salvador Dali, the shape of the bottle reflects that of Dali's iconic perfume creations whilst the vibrant art adorning it mirrors the marvellously eccentric world of Moschino.. This lively and joyful essence opens with a deliciously fruity mix of zesty orange and mandarin paired with a tantalising raspberry and blackcurrant sorbet. The heart bursts with an energising, floral bouquet of pink peony, delicate jasmine petals and magnolia blossoms to give the scent a romantic undertone, before simmering down to an irresistible base of cedarwood, oakmoss and ambroxan crystals to create a powdery depth.. Why We Love It . Fun in a way that only Moschino knows how to be, this Eau de Toilette has a gigantic personality. It's a true embodiment of happiness paired with an invigorating composition that makes this sparkling scent ideal for any day or occasion. One spritz and you'll be hooked!. Works Well With . If rich floral scents are more your style, try the Original Moschino Cheap and Chic fragrance; it's a classic!. Notes: . Top Notes: Orange, Mandarin, Raspberry.. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine, Peony.. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Cedarwood, Ambroxan..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Orchidee Imperiale The Fundamental Oil 30ml
listings.description: The Fundamental Oil is an exceptional morpho-sculpting skincare developed with the Guerlain Spas expert facialists. After 20 years’ research, Guerlain has created Orchid Morpho-Peptideᵀᴹ technology, which targets skin’s anchoring bonds required to maintain a youthful morphology. . Infused with this technology, The Fundamental Oil visibly delays the appearance of the structural signs of ageing such as wrinkles, skin sagging and cheek folds. A real feat of formulation, its bi-phase texture combines Orchid Morpho-Peptideᵀᴹ technology with a blend of 20 precious oils, including revitalising orchid oleo-concentrate. . Richness and finesse come together, offering a feeling of rapid absorption and instantly transforming skin to leave it visibly softer, more supple and more elastic, perfect for beginning a resculpting massage. . How To Use It . Designed to be used a pre-serum, use morning and night before your usual treatments. Shake well before use and dispense into your hand, rubbing lightly into your fingers to activate the formula and then gently smoothing over your face and neck.. Works Well With . Indulge yourself and discover the rest of the Orchidee Imperiale Collection. Containing a wealth of products to suit every need, these exceptional formulas will target all areas of concern and create a luxurious ritual..

listings.rawTitle: Amouage Love Tuberose Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Irresistible Tuberose. . Creamy and fruity Tuberose, diaphanous Gardenia and honeyed Jasmine blossoms open a solar bouquet of incomparable smoothness. This burst of waxy flowers is soon followed by a pearly and ingenuous heart of sweet Vanilla and buttery Chantilly Cream, smoothening out the narcotic and carnal edges of the overture to transform it into an irresistibly delicious and sensual delight. Addictive though innocent, it culminates in a diffusive base of milky Sandalwood revived by dry and resinous whiffs of Virginian Cedarwood. . Tropical blossom, sun-drenched skin and sugary rays of sunlight, Love Tuberose is an ode to falling in love with oneself. . Fragrance Family: Floral . Top Notes: Tuberose, Gardenia, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Chantilly Cream, Vanilla. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Ferragamo Uomo Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: The Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature Eau de Parfum Spray is a leathery oriental fragrance that captures the spirit of the contemporary man.. A daring and powerful reimagining of the classic Uomo, this charismatic creation leaves a lasting impression, just like the man who wears it. An elegant embodiment of masculinity where deep, earthy notes interplay with invigorating accords, this Eau de Parfum spray embodies strength and sophistication.. Uomo Signature opens with brightening mandarin and grapefruit to instantly awaken the senses and offer an irreverent sense of charm, while an unexpected fusion of pink pepper creates an undertone of pure seduction. The heart is built around spicy facets of cypress, cardamom and cinnamon, providing a balmy warmth that exudes class. The base of tonka bean, coffee and patchouli is where refinement meets rogue, sealing the fragrance with a rugged dynamic and irresistible depth.. Why We Love It . Smooth, suave and utterly delectable, this fragrance is full of character. Whether at work or play, every man needs a signature scent and this is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the finer things. Uomo Signature has a classic feel with a modern twist that makes it perfect for all ages and it can be worn both day and night, so don't be surprised if it becomes your daily go-to.. Works Well With . Discover the rest of the Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature collection. Designed for the contemporary and uncomplicated man, enjoy luxe products with style.. Notes . Top Notes: Grapefruit, Mandarin, Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Cypress, Cardamom, Cinnamon. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Coffee, Leather, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Be allured by the Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray, a sophisticated oriental vanilla women's fragrance that's as mesmerising as it is refined.. A new chapter in the Dolce & Gabbana The One collection, The Only One is an elegant and intriguing fragrance inspired by an endearing play on opposites. Its unpredictable fusion of violet and coffee notes captivates the senses, making it the perfect fit for a worldly woman with an enchanting side.. The Only One opens with flirtatious and fresh violet notes combined with subtle hints of bergamot, which transition into an addictive combination of rich coffee and iris. Finally, this delectable scent warms and comforts the senses with vanilla and patchouli.. Why We Love It . The Only One is not an obvious combination of notes to blend but it certainly creates something gracious and irresistible - exactly like the woman it represents. It's the perfect scent for evening wear; its rich notes have an air of mystery and leave a delicate trail after you've left the room.. Notes . Top Notes: Violet, Bergamot.. Heart Notes: Coffee, Iris.. Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Eau Thermale Water Hand Cream 50ml
listings.description: Keep your dry hands soft, conditioned and nourished with the Uriage Eau Thermale Water Hand Cream, an intensely hydrating hand moisturiser that will help to soften skin and fortifies nails.. A daily treat for hardworking hands, the Eau Thermale Hand Cream instantly softens and moisturises. The non-sticky and non-oily cream is absorbed quickly and effortlessly, giving a comforting moisture boost to dry, cracked and weakened hands.. Like an imaginary pair of gloves, the Water Hand Cream forms an invisible and protective veil over the skin to protect against climatic aggressions. Naturally healing Uriage Thermal Water soothes and repairs skin, while a conditioning blend of shea butter and glycerin provide ultimate nourishment and optimal comfort.. Hands are left soft, supple and repaired, and over time nails are strengthened and fortified.. Why We Love It . If your hands are dry from over-washing or vulnerable due to environmental stresses then the Uriage hand cream is about to be your next can't-go-without product. Hands are enveloped in a softening and comfortable blend, with a light, pleasant aroma that gently lingers.. Even better, the compact white tube can easily be stored in your handbag for a boost of hydration on the go. The vibrant blue cap ensures no spillages, and the instantly absorbing formula means you can effortlessly top-up wherever you are and carry on with your day.. How To Use It . Apply as often as necessary by massaging into clean, dry hands.. Works Well With . Keep your complexion as soft, nourished and hydrated as your hands by exploring the full Uriage Eau Thermale range.. Values . Hypoallergenic..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Bebe 1st Peri-Oral Care 30ml
listings.description: Soothe, purify and repair redness around the mouth of your infant with the Uriage Bebe 1st Peri-Oral Care, a treatment cream for babies.. Little ones can suffer with redness and irritation around their lips for a number of reasons - from teething to illness - which cause discomfort and irritability. So, Uriage's cream is developed to calm and repair irritated skin of the lip contour, so your little cherub can feel happy and healthy again.. It effectively relieves irritation and eases redness around the mouth using Uriage's naturally soothing Thermal Water, cooling aloe vera and an innovative patented TLR2-Regul complex, which work together to reduce discomfort caused by microorganisms.. The soft, gentle and fragrance-free cream also purifies the area as copper and zinc gluconates limit bacterial proliferation, which is the growth of bacteria.. Finally, the formula works to repair the affected area, as its powerful active ingredients repair the skin barrier, so skin feels comfortable and supple once more. And, the cream delivers oleo-mineral protection to the skin's surface to help prevent further irritation.. Why We Love It . All parents want to keep their little ones as comfortable and healthy as possible, and hate to see their little one suffering with irritation or minor injuries, which can occur when the skin is red and irritated. So, we love that Uriage's cream prioritises the comfort of babies, while also helping to put the parents' mind at ease, as the formula soothes and nurtures the delicate skin of little ones.. It's held in a handy tube that can be popped up in a handbag, backpack or changing bag to calm skin when you're out and about.. How To Use It . Apply to cleansed, dry skin. Use two to three times a day on irritated areas.. Works Well With . Uriage offers a full bath and body collection for babies, so be sure to check out the Bebe range in full.. Values . Hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic.. Fragrance-free..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Instant de Guerlain Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A modern-day classic, the GUERLAIN L'Instant de Guerlain Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance for men of untold possibility.. Steeped in sophistication this timeless GUERLAIN fragrance uses its warm and sensual aroma to captivate and inspire the senses. Its unique trail of gourmand and woody facets effortlessly merge to create a unique aroma that's both memorable and elegant; there are no half-measures when it comes to this visionary scent.. Nothing less than surprising, the spiced star anise opening of L'Instant de Guerlain Pour Homme simmers before being cooled by the powdered beauty of jasmine. The arousing composition explores the addiction of cocoa facets and smoked tea in the dry down, before a combination of powerful woods provide a lasting, sensuous warmth.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Star Anise. Heart Notes: Hibiscus Seed, Jasmine. Base Notes: Cocoa, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Smoked Tea.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Foundation Brush Foundation Brush
listings.description: The incomparably soft, cruelty-free Clarins Foundation Brush will deliver perfect coverage in just a few swipes.. Rapidly apply, blend and layer your foundation with this essential brush. It performs beautifully with liquid, cream or powder foundation, as well as concealer, for a smooth and luminous complexion that doesn't feel overloaded.. The flat and rounded cat tongue mimics the shape of your fingers in order to contour and blend around the angles of the face with ease, whilst the dense, smooth bristle design will help you to achieve coverage exactly where you need it.. Why We Love It . The perfect staple for a gorgeous base, the Clarins Foundation Brush will ensure your foundation feels like a second skin, instantly accentuating your natural beauty and giving you the option to build coverage if you so desire.. How To Use It . Dispense a small amount of foundation or concealer onto the back of your hand or edge of the brush, and then apply to the face using gentle swipes, starting in the centre of your face and working outwardly until you have reached your desired level of coverage.. Works Well With . The Clarins Everlasting Foundation works perfectly with this brush. It will perfect your base and give you up to 18 hours of matte, luminous skin. The Clarins Foundation Brush will ensure that this foundation is distributed onto your face with ease and precision.. Values . Cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Blush Brush Blush Brush
listings.description: Achieve a radiant complexion with the Clarins Blush Brush, an ultra-effective tool designed for sculpting, contouring and illuminating the face.. The Clarins Blush Brush contains super-soft bristles that are designed to pick up and distribute product with precision, effortlessly gliding across your face to achieve a radiant finish in moments.. Its tapered style offers ultimate precision to beautifully accentuate your features. This brush is shaped specifically to fit the contour of the cheekbones and apples of the cheeks, making it ideal for the application of bronzers and blushers.. Why We Love It . If you're looking for a reliable brush that will do the job, the Clarins Blush Brush is just what you need. Built to last and delivering perfect results every time, this brush is made using synthetic bristles which are antibacterial, super-easy to clean and have been proven to last longer than natural-haired brushes. Plus, it's even suitable for use on sensitive skin.. How To Use It . Pick up a small amount of blush or bronzer, tap to remove excess product and then sweep onto your cheeks, blending outwardly for a natural finish.. Values . Cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Skin Illusion Natural Hydrating Foundation SPF15 30ml / 103N
listings.description: Discover the secret to a flawless complexion with the Clarins Skin Illusion Natural Hydrating Foundation SPF15, an ultra-lightweight makeup base that will create a radiant, barely-there finish.. Created for all skin types, Skin Illusion will help you to achieve immediate freshness and a beautiful glow without masking your skin's natural beauty. It's created with red jania extract, a seaweed found in calm waters, which will encourage cellular turnover whilst promoting a clearer complexion. The inclusion of the leaf of life extract will reboot your skin's mechanisms to promote hydration on multiple levels of the skin, inducing a lit-from-within glow.. Long-lasting and protective, this ultra-fresh base is created with a Light Optimising Complex in order to subtly accentuate your features, while an Anti-Pollution Complex will act as a protective barrier from external aggressors and offer a rich source of antioxidants in order to neutralise free radicals.. Why We Love It . This natural hydrating foundation is perfect for all skin types that want a fresh and natural finish. It's even suitable for those who have an oily or a combination skin type as Clarins has included a subtle dose of non-greasy oils, which will ensure a smooth, non-cakey finish, giving your skin a completely new feel.. How To Use It . Just a few drops are enough to instantly enhance. Thanks to its silky texture, it will blend seamlessly onto your face, leaving your complexion nourished and luminous without a weighty feel. Simply dispense a few drops onto a brush, sponge or your fingertips and apply to your skin.. Works Well With . If you want a little more coverage, the Clarins Instant Light Brush-On Perfector will freshen up your complexion instantly, delivering radiance with a lightweight texture that will smooth, brighten and perfect shadows, dark spots and unevenness..

listings.description: Hydrate your skin for up to 48 hours with Vichy Aqualia Thermal Rehydrating Light Cream for normal skin types, an intensive moisturiser that restores the balance of sensitive and dehydrated skin with a lightweight touch.. Renovated for 2018, this daily lightweight moisturiser contains an ultra-hydrating blend of hyaluronic acid and sugars to keep the complexion happy and hydrated.. The feather-light, refreshing texture of the Aqualia Thermal Rehydrating Light Cream is rich in 15% Vichy Thermal Water, which immediately cools irritation and tightness. The cream instantly melts into the skin without greasiness or stickiness, ensuring that skin is replenished with water.. Apply both morning and night to the face and neck either alone, or under makeup. Massage gently until thoroughly absorbed.. Hypoallergenic. Tested on sensitive skin under dermatological control.. Silicon-free, mineral oil-free, PEG-free, paraben-free..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Xemose C8+ Face Cream 40ml
listings.description: Soothe and nourish your atopic and severely dry complexion with the Uriage Xemose Face Cream, a hypoallergenic daily moisturiser for dry and sensitive skin suitable for all ages.. With 24 hours' effective moisturisation, the Xemose Face Cream is a rich lotion that calms sensations of tightness. Itchiness and dryness are instantly soothed with patented chronoxin, providing skin with long-lasting comfort.. The Xemose moisturiser helps to restore and strengthen the skin's barrier using a patented cerasterol 2F, while the innate immune barrier is regulated with patented TLR2-Regul. These complexes work together to prevent future flare-ups and provide continuous relief.. The rich, creamy and non-sticky formula also contains 10% shea butter, which conditions, comforts and intensely softens areas of roughness. Uriage's Thermal Water is extremely isotonic and naturally healing, helping to restore comfort to lipid deficient and damaged skin while also rebalancing the microbial barrier.. Why We Love It . The Uriage moisturiser is a must-have for anyone who struggles with feelings of tightness, dryness or itchiness. We know how uncomfortable that can be, which is why we love the Xemose range so much. It provides instant relief and calming sensations to even the most sensitive, atopic and dry skin.. The creamy lotion melts in quickly for fast absorption - despite being so rich - and leaves skin immediately softer and more supple, and can be used on even your little one's delicate skin.. How To Use It . Apply the Xemose cream every morning and evening to a thoroughly cleansed and dry face.. Works Well With . If the rest of your body struggles with atopy, dryness or discomfort then ensure you have a look at the full Uriage Xemose collection as it's been specially formulated for those with irritable and severely dry skin.. Values . Hypoallergenic.. Fragrance-free..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Roseliane Anti-Redness Rich Cream 50ml
listings.description: Nourish and calm your redness-ness prone skin with the Uriage Roseliane Anti-Redness Rich Cream, a hypoallergenic moisturiser for all skin types - including sensitive - prone to rosacea.. The Roseliane Rich Cream is a silky face cream that works to soothe skin while diffusing redness. The moisturiser provides skin with instant comfort as feelings of heat and tightness are relieved to leave skin soft and comfortably hydrated, while the inclusion of Uriage Thermal Water refreshes and heals damaged skin.. Perfect for those who struggle with rosacea, the Roseliane moisturiser uses an expert blend of hardworking yet gentle complexes. Redness is reduced with ginseng and red algae, which strengthens the blood vessel walls to reduce their appearance on the skin. Shea butter and glycerine intensely moisturise and condition the skin, while light-reflecting green particles counteract redness for a hydrated and even finish.. Plus, Uriage has infused the anti-redness cream with a trio of exclusive patents. The skin's barrier is strengthened and restructured with cerasterol 2f, while TLR2-Regul decreases inflammation. A new, high-performance SK5R complex works to regulate the activity of kallikrein-5, which is the protease responsible for irritation and vascular problems, providing a highly effective and long-lasting soothing action against sensations of heating or inflammation.. Why We Love It . The rich, silky texture of the Anti-Redness Rich Cream is truly special. Not only is the cream effective, but it feels ultra-pampering and sensorial as you massage it in, with a melting formula and a sweet, fruity aroma.. Plus, because the moisturiser leaves skin so soft, smooth and comfortable, the Roseliane cream creates the perfect makeup base, which makes it even better!. How To Use It . Massage over cleansed, dry skin every morning and evening.. Works Well With . For more ways to tackle redness, make sure you match the Rich Cream moisturiser with other skincare products from the Uriage Roseliane collection.. Values . Hypoallergenic..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Roseliane Anti-Redness Cream 40ml
listings.description: Calm, soothe and strengthen your rosacea-prone skin with the Uriage Roseliane Anti-Redness Cream, a daily hypoallergenic moisturiser for normal, dry and sensitive skin types prone to redness.. The Roseliane face cream is a rich and creamy - yet lightweight lotion that targets the key factors that trigger redness. The cream shields the skin's vascular system and strengthens blood vessel walls with a mix of ginseng and red algae extracts, which reduce their appearance on the skin's surface. Aggravation is limited while green pearlescent particles instantly diffuse and counteract redness.. Highlighting Uriage's dermatological expertise, the Roseliane face cream also contains a new patent-pending SK5R complex. This works to regulate kallikrein-5, which is a protein that causes inflammation and local irritation to soothe sensations of heating and tingling.. Bursting with a host of patented complexes, the Anti-Redness Cream helps to repair and strengthen the skin's barrier. The inclusion of cerasterol 2F durably restructures and restores the barrier and limits water loss, while TLR2-Regul offers intensely soothing abilities to relieve and calm irritated skin.. Plus, as with all of Uriage's skincare, the high-tolerance moisturiser contains naturally isotonic Uriage Thermal Water, which is the most active thermal water on the market. This enriches skin with many trace elements and mineral salts - such as copper, zinc and magnesium - to soothe, heal and restore your skin, while glycerine and shea butter work together to intensely soften, condition and moisturise your skin.. Why We Love It . Redness in skin can be caused by a multitude of factors: stress, temperature, UV radiations, allergens and genetics. No matter the cause, the Roseliane face cream is here to help soothe the consequences.. Not only does this hardworking cream work to soothe and reduce redness, but it's also incredibly pleasurable to use. The silky cream is rich yet melts in instantly, enveloping skin in a sweet, fruity fragrance. The cream leaves the complexion soft and perfectly moisturised, and even leaves the perfect base for your makeup.. How To Use It . Must be used twice a day to be effective. Apply the Roseliane moisturiser to cleansed, dry face every morning and evening, avoiding the eye area.. Works Well With . Treat your sensitive and redness-prone skin by taking a look at the full Uriage Roseliane range to target, prevent and reverse skin redness.. Values . Hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic..

listings.rawTitle: Uriage Eau Thermale Power 3 Anti-Perspirant Roll-On Deodorant 50ml
listings.description: Fresh and clean all day long with the Uriage Power 3 Anti-Perspirant, a roll-on deodorant that's suitable for sensitive skin and will combat underarm odours and perspiration.. Uriage's hardworking deodorant effectively fights perspiration to mask unwanted odours. The formula also prevents white and yellow stains, while preventing the 'cardboard effect' on clothing.. Power3 provides a fresh and clean feeling for up to 24 hours, as aluminum salts control perspiration, while odours are stopped from forming thanks to a clever complex of anti-bacterial and anti-enzyme ingredients.. The rollerball also takes care of the more delicate underarm areas by calming sensitive skin using Uriage's iconic Thermal Water alongside a range of soothing ingredients while cocooning skin in a fresh, delicate and comforting unisex scent.. Why We Love It . Finding a deodorant that you can rely on is important, and for some people, it's not as simple as picking one out of a line up. If you are struggling with skin sensitivity, or alcohol-based formulas have resulted in stinging, then it can make you weary about which deodorants you use. That's why we love that this hypoallergenic, alcohol-free formula is enriched with Uriage's thermal water, a natural water that can soothe sensitivity, thanks to its high calcium and magnesium salt content.. How To Use It . Apply the roll-on deodorant to clean, dry underarms.. Works Well With . If you want to calm and protect the rest of your skin from head to toe, be sure to check out Uriage's impressive skincare range to find the perfect cleanser, moisturiser and more.. Values . Hypoallergenic. Alcohol-free..

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water 30ml
listings.description: Cocoon your skin in the scent of summer with the Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water, a blissful Eau de Toilette for women that pays homage to all things sunny.. The Story Behind Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water . Sun Delicious is inspired by the addictive fragrance of Nuxe's sun care, a beloved collection that's infused with an uplifting fruity-floral scent that instantly transports you to a far off destination.. Nuxe's non-photosensitising fragrant water bottles the essence of summer; it smells like sun-kissed skin that's caressed with lashings of sunscreen. The Eau de Toilette opens with a fresh, positive and radiant tone as sweet and juicy oranges blend with green, citrusy petitgrain. The creamy notes of coconut and rich, exotic tiare flowers bloom in the heart, before vanilla and sensual musk whisk you away to the tropics.. Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water Smells Similar To . Nuxe's scented spray reminds us of GUERLAIN's Terracotta Le Parfum, another luminous, sun-inspired fragrance that ocntracisntly opens with bergamot, but shows similarities with elements of tiare flower and vanilla creating that creamy, sunscreen vibe.. About Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water's Bottle . Just like a vibrant, breathtaking sunset, Nuxe's bottle is truly eye-catching. Its ombre hue blends from a bold, sun-drenched orange through to a sandy yellow, before revealing a tranquil turquoise beach that reminds you of a dip in the pool.. Why We Love It . If we had to create a scent that captured summer, we would struggle - but this fragranced mist does it perfectly. It blends fresh, juicy and almost edible fruity tones with a creamy heart of coconut and tiare flower, resulting in a scent that feels exactly like sipping cocktails by the beach, covered in sunscreen.. And as the fragrance is such a celebration of the sun and natural scents, we love that it contains 85.6% natural origin ingredients.. How To Use It . Spray Nuxe's Delicious Fragrant Water in the air and walk through to delicately infuse your clothing, or for an even more subtle effect, spray your hair brush and brush your locks to delicately perfume your tresses.. For a final touch of indulgence that will leave you dreaming of holidays and relaxation, you can also mist it over your bed sheets.. Works Well With . Why not indulge in this scent for longer, while protecting yourself from the harmful effects of the sun with the Nuxe sun care collection?. The Notes In Nuxe Sun Delicious Fragrant Water Are . Top Notes: Sweet Orange, Petitgrain.. Heart Notes: Coconut, Tiare.. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk.. Values . Non-comedogenic.. Mineral oil-free, paraben-free..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Cologne du Parfumeur Eau de Cologne Spray 100ml
listings.description: Play your part in GUERLAIN history with the GUERLAIN Cologne du Parfumeur Eau de Cologne Spray, a citrus-aromatic unisex fragrance with crisp green facets.. Since 1853, every generation of GUERLAIN perfumer has created their very own Eau de Cologne, and in 2010 it was the turn of iconic perfumer, Thierry Wasser. Fresh and inviting, Thierry Wasser created an Eau de Cologne that is intimate and contemporary, marrying modern green facets with musky notes; a combination never before used in GUERLAIN's history.. An olfactory masterpiece, the Cologne du Parfumeur Eau de Cologne Spray is presented in a bottle adorned with 69 bees, the symbol of the GUERLAIN family of 'Eaux'.. Unlike the other fragrances in the Les Eaux collection, the Cologne du Parfumeur is designed to be worn alone and has an Eau Fraiche concentration.. Top Note: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Green Notes, Orange Blossom. Base Note: White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary Mandelic Acid 10% + HA 30ml
listings.description: Achieve a smooth, glowing complexion with The Ordinary Mandelic Acid 10% + HA, a high strength dermal peeling treatment that is gentle enough for sensitive skin.. Creating a radiant appearance and an even skin texture, The Ordinary Mandelic Acid 10% + HA anti-bacterial formula provides visibly smoother skin through a gentle, delicate approach to exfoliation.. The 10% mandelic acid has a larger weight than other alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs), so the acid takes longer to penetrate the skin; this means that the formula gently exfoliates the top layer of the skin without causing irritation.. The transparent, oil-like treatment easily absorbs into skin, and is enriched with hyaluronic acid, which visibly hydrates and soothes skin. It also minimises the appearance of fine lines, making this formula suitable for both sensitive and ageing skin.. Why We Love It . Sensitive skin can often be triggered by exfoliation, which can cause inflammation and visible redness. But exfoliation is still an important step in your skincare routine, so it's great that The Ordinary has created a dermal peeling treatment specifically for those with sensitive skin that doesn't require any rubbing.. To make sure you never over apply the direct acid is made with a handy pipette for easy application.. How To Use It . Use once a day. Using the pipette, apply a few small drops to a dry face during the evening. If necessary, you can dilute this product with other treatments until the skin builds up a tolerance.. Note: Use sunscreen for a week after using this product because your skin will be more sensitive to UV light.. Works Well With . The Ordinary offers a number of Direct Acids that are all targetted to creating a smooth and healthy complexion, why not explore the full collection?. Values . pH 3.50-3.70, Vegan.. Alcohol-free, oil-free, silicone-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free..

listings.rawTitle: The Ordinary 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder 20g
listings.description: Illuminate your complexion with The Ordinary 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder, a powerful vitamin c powder that is added to your favourite serum or moisturiser* to help with signs of ageing like dullness and uneven skin tone.. L-ascorbic acid Powder provides the most direct exposure of high concentrations of vitamin c, which is renowned for its radiance-boosting properties. The ultra-fine vitamin c powder helps to boost collagen production, which keeps skin looking plump, supple and glowing.. Antioxidant, vitamin c protection from free radicals, which can cause premature ageing. A sprinkle of this powerful vitamin c powder in your moisturiser will deliver youthful-looking skin that is smooth and even as well as brighten dull skin.. Why We Love It . The Ordinary has created this innovative powder so that you can amplify the results of your favourite anti-ageing skincare with all of the benefits of vitamin c. Not only will it help transform your skin, but it will also transform the skincare products you already have, and give skin additional protection thanks to the antioxidant qualities of vitamin c.. The extremely potent Ascorbic Acid is protected in a glass jar and includes a small white spoon for easy distribution of the powder.. How To Use It . Mix a small amount of the fine white powder with other treatments* in the palm of your hand and then massage onto your skin. Use once daily, either in your morning or evening skincare regime.. Due to the high potency of the vitamin c, a non-irritating tingling sensation is expected during the first 1-2 weeks, lessening over time as your skin becomes accustomed.. *The L-Ascorbic Acid Powder shouldn’t be used with treatments containing niacinamide of EUK 134, as they can affect the integrity of this pure-form vitamin c.. Works Well With . Love the effects of vitamin c? Discover The Ordinary’s full Vitamin C collection for a range of lower and higher potencies and formats.. Values . Vegan.. Water-free, alcohol-free, oil-free, silicone-free, gluten-free, cruelty-free..

listings.description: Amplify your magnetism with the Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Eau de Parfum Spray, a fresh woody men's fragrance with musk facets.. listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette is an explosion of fresh dewy rose and juicy citrus fruits and berries." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa: . A bright and joyful tribute to the rose flower.. Part of the nature-inspired Aqua Allegoria collection.. Great for layering with other scents from the range.. Made with up to 95% natural ingredients.. Features the classic Aqua Allegoria honeycomb bottle.. . What Does GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Smell Like? . It smells just like Turkish delight; it's a delicate watery rose blended with sugary sweetness. Opening with a burst of mandarin, lychee and blackcurrant, the fragrance then unveils a fresh and light floral heart of rose and peony that feels slightly jammy, thanks to the fruity top notes. Finally, a sensual blend of white musks and sandalwood is mixed with vanillary benzoin to create a delicious woody-gourmand trail that's sophisticated and feminine.. Top notes are Mandarin, Lychee, Blackcurrant. Heart notes are Rose, Plum, Peony. Base notes are Sandalwood, White Musks, Benzoin. . Why It's Escentual: . If you're a lover of fresh fruity-florals, you'll adore the best-selling Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa. And if you're looking for a new fragrance this summer, then Rosa Rossa is the perfect fit. Its cool and light sun-soaked signature makes it perfect for wearing in hotter weather, or while on holiday.. Rosa Rossa's sophisticated citrusy floral trail has a bottle that is equally as elegant to match; bottled in the Aqua Allegoria style, the bee-inspired bottle is encased in golden honeycomb pattern, with a round golden lid embossed with GUERLAIN's signature bee insignia. All aspects of the design are linked to GUERLAIN's ongoing commitment to nature; from its bee-inspired design to its up-to-95% natural ingredient formula.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray the perfume on your pulse points - the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . The French beetroot alcohol used in GUERLAIN's Rosa Rossa comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and there are refills available for Rosa Rossa.. .

listings.rawTitle: Klorane Eco-friendly Dry Shampoo with Oat Milk 50g
listings.description: "Refresh your hair with the Klorane Eco-friendly Dry Shampoo with Oat Milk, an easy-to-use dry shampoo powder that eliminates oil and adds volume." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Klorane Eco-friendly Dry Shampoo: . Organic oats soften and enrich the hair.. Gently cleanses whilst reducing excess oil.. Aerosol-free biodegradable powder spray.. Vegan.. . What You Need To Know: . If you're a fan of the Klorane Oat Milk haircare range, you'll love this gentle dry shampoo as it nourishes the hair whilst regulating excess sebum for an instant refreshed feeling. The unique formulation contains organically grown oats from the south of France, which soften your locks while restoring natural lightness. Ultra-absorbent powders naturally blend into the hair to regain volume and texture in only two minutes.. . Why It's Escentual: . The dry shampoo powder allows you to achieve clean, rejuvenated hair while reducing water consumption. We know how difficult it can be to find a dry shampoo for your sensitive scalp. That's where the Klorane Eco-friendly Dry Shampoo with Oat Milk comes in! Its dermatologically-tested formula contains minimal ingredients for suitability on all hair types and scalps. listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Riche Multi-Purpose Nourishing Oil Spray - Face, Body and Hair 100ml
listings.description: Repair, replenish and intensely nourish your tresses and skin with the Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Riche Multi-Purpose Oil Spray, a rich face, body and hair oil made with 98.1% natural ingredients for very dry skin.. An even richer formulation than the original, the Huile Prodigieuse Riche Dry Oil is specially designed for drier and severely dry skin types and will restore comfort to even the driest skin. The iconic sunny scent of orange blossom, magnolia and sweet vanilla will transport the senses to a beach far away as the golden elixir soothes and softens your skin and hair.. With an even higher concentration of precious oils, the Riche formula blends together seven 100% botanical oils to soften and nourish your skin. Replenishing tsubaki, softening argan, moisturising camellia, nourishing macadamia, repairing borage, softening sweet almond and protecting hazelnut oils work together to repair and hydrate areas of dryness. The body and hair are cocooned in a conditioning veil that restores skin's suppleness and leaves a delicate satin sheen.. The multi-tasking oil will keep you soft, supple and hydrated from head-to-toe while creating an anti-pollution shield over the skin using antioxidant vitamin e. Hair is left silky smooth and glossy as the rich oil reduces split ends while enhancing skin's natural tan. It's also effective at reducing stretch marks as the oil encourages even and smoother skin.. Why We Love It . Combining intense nourishment with luxurious pleasure of use, the Nuxe Riche Oil is a truly sensorial formula that you won't be able to get enough of. The non-sticky and non-greasy oil has a slightly richer consistency than the original, which makes it an even more nourishing treat. The oil melts into skin beautifully and leaves a fragrant trail that captures the essence of the sun's warmth.. We love the multi-purpose aspect of this wonder oil. It's perfect for when you go away and only want to pack the essentials because it's so multipurpose! It's an all-in-one for intense hydration and silky-soft skin and hair.. Plus, the frosted glass that holds the golden oil has a gold lid that prevents spillages. The spray nozzle makes all-over application effortless so you can spritz your way to ultimate moisturisation.. How To Use It . For the face, either use on its own or apply a few drops to your daily moisturiser.. For the body, massage over the skin using circular motions, paying particular attention to stretch marks (if desired).. For the hair, massage through the lengths as often as required.. Tip: For an intense nourishing boost, use it as a hair treatment once or twice a week by applying it as a mask 10 minutes before shampooing.. Works Well With . If your hair and skin loved the rich and softening abilities of this multi-tasking oil, make sure you experience each wonderful scent and variation by exploring the full Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse range.. Values . Mineral oil-free, paraben-free, silicone-free, preservative-free..

listings.rawTitle: bareMinerals Gen Nude Powder Blush 6g / Call My Blush

The bareMinerals Powder Blush creates a smooth, perfected finish - while feeling weightless on the skin.. Why We Love It . We love that these shades have been created using bareMinerals' complexion expertise, resulting in a wide range of shades to suit a variety of skin tones. Whether you opt for a peach or a beige, the blur-effect blush helps you achieve a flawless finish by adding an instant glow to skin. Plus, it layers incredibly well over other makeup!. How To Use It . After foundation, use a powder brush to apply to the apples of the cheeks, and blend along the cheekbones.. Before finishing your look, be sure to take a look at bareMinerals' full Gen Nude collection for skin-loving eyeshadows and eye primers.. Values . Hypoallergenic, dermatologist-tested.. listings.rawTitle: Goutal Tenue de Soirée Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Tenue de Soirée is pure glamour in a bottle! Usually, chypre fragrances can lean very formal or traditional, but this liberated twist of sparkling berries, elegant iris, and sweet praline makes night-out seduction feel completely effortless. " - Escentual Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Annick Goutal Tenue de Soirée:. It's a liberated and adventurous scent that celebrates free, joyful, and unapologetic seduction. . Tenue de Soirée is a statement fragrance; its confident, captivating trail makes it impossible not to fall for! . Gourmand touches of praline soften the intense chypre base for a mouth-watering, modern finish. . Powdery iris, jasmine, and rose give the heart a luminous, ultra-feminine sophistication. . Women love its magnetic blend of lively spice, juicy red fruits, and deep, lingering patchouli. . It's a chic evening aroma contrasted by playful sweetness; a resolutely modern take on classic chypre perfumery. . . What Does Annick Goutal Tenue de Soirée Smell Like?. Tenue de Soirée is an Eau de Parfum for women that opens with an energetic, fruity-spicy burst of bergamot, tangy red fruits, and pink peppercorns. Soon after spritzing, the night reveals a luminous floral heart where elegant iris blends seamlessly with jasmine and rose. As the fragrance wears on the skin, it settles into a sophisticated, chypre patchouli base, softened by comforting musk and a sweet, addictive touch of praline that accompanies self-assurance. . . Fragrance family: Gourmand-Chypre. . Top notes: Bergamot, Red Fruits, Pink Peppercorns. . Heart notes: Jasmine, Rose, Iris. . Base notes: Patchouli, Praline, Musk. . . Why It's Escentual:. Created by master perfumer Mathieu Nardin, Tenue de Soirée—which translates to "evening dress"—captures the thrill of getting ready for a night out in Paris, radiating flair, spontaneity, and glamour. . Housed in the Maison’s updated clear bottle with refined gadroons—inspired by Art Deco and topped with a gold cap—it pays homage to Annick Goutal’s background as an antique dealer. For this fragrance, it is adorned with a large, fluffy purple pom-pom, adding a touch of bold, tactile luxury to symbolise generosity. Tenue de Soirée has an intoxicating, lingering presence that comes into its own during cool evening air, making it the ultimate accessory for date nights and special occasions . . The Best Way To Use It: . We also recommend the following perfume tips: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows. . Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent. . Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance. . Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance. . If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm. . .

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant Of Venice Mandarin Carnival Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml

Mandarin Carnival is a tribute to this beautiful scene, with the essence of native, juicy mandarins at its heart.. The enchanting composition drifts between the vivacity of Sicily with the mystique of exotic lands, blending mandarin with sundrenched orange flower, a bite of white peach and a shimmer of aquatic rose.. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bitter Almond. Heart Notes: Orange Flower, White Peach. Base Notes: Aquatic Rose, Musk, Cashmere Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lubin Upper Ten For Her Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Dare to dance with the Lubin Upper Ten Eau de Parfum, an enticing, spicy oriental fragrance for women.. Upper Ten was made for a woman who is provocative and free. She was destined to live a champagne lifestyle, and now, she wouldn't have it another way. Fun-loving and infectious, this eccentric Eau de Parfum leads you to the dance floor, whilst its alluring trail of raspberry liquor and precious woods encourage your wild side to take centre stage.. This feminine oriental fragrance opens with a rhythmic beat of Isabella grape and bergamot, smooth grooves of elemi move with the spicy heart of Sichuan pepper and raspberry liquor to reveal an intoxicating core that leaves you wanting more. As the tempo slows, the smoky base of frankincense slow dances with a precious base of dark chocolate, evoking a sensual dry down with longevity.. Top Notes: Isabella Grape, Bergamot, Elemi, Artemisia. Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Raspberry Liqueur, Sichuan Pepper. Base Notes: Dark Chocolate, Amber, Frankincense, Precious Wood.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum Intense is like a timeless black dress you can slip into on every occasion, and you know its guaranteed to turn heads." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum Intense: . A gourmand fragrance with notes of rose, berries and vanilla.. Lasts for 4-6 hours.. Part of the iconic La Petite Robe Noire collection.. Made with organically grown beetroot alcohol.. Classic inverted heart design bottle made from recycled glass.. . What Does La Petite Robe Noire Intense Smell Like? . The Intense version of La Petite Robe Noire replaces its original opening note of cherry with juicy blueberry joined by sparkling bergamot. The fragrance gets its sweet floral signature from the heart, with notes of a sugar-spun Bulgarian rose wrapped in a candyfloss accord. As the fragrance settles on the skin, it becomes more sensual thanks to white musk, sandalwood-patchouli accord and a new sweet lashing of addictive vanilla which appears moments after the first spritz.. Top notes are Bergamot and Blueberry. Heart notes are Bulgarian Rose, Candyfloss Accord. Base notes are White Musk, Sandalwood-Patchouli Accord, Vanilla. . . Why It's Escentual: . GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum Intense is an ode to Parisian style and the understated power of the little black dress. Hence, its name translates from French to the little black dress. A prime fixture in almost every woman's wardrobe, the LBD is a trusty staple that you know is always going to WOW, which can also be said for La Petite Robe Noire Intense.. We are sure that fans of the original EDT and ADP will love this latest edition of the collection; it has all the original characteristics with a deeper intensity. The iconic inverted heart design used throughout the collection has been a feature of GUERLAIN perfumes for over a century. This time the glass is coloured in a deeper ombre, from black to powdered pink, to reflect the new deeper notes inside. At the back of the bottle, you'll see a print of a black dress to show the name La Petite Robe Noire. And to finish, the bottleneck is wrapped with a pink bow emblazoned with GUERLAIN's logo.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spritz on your pulse points for long-lasting wear.. . The Sustainable Side: . The fragrance composition is made from organic beetroot alcohol. The recyclable bottle is made from recycled glass. You can also recycle the outer cardboard box.. .

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Sun After-Sun Hair & Body Shampoo 200ml
listings.description: After a day in the sun, cleanse and condition from head to toe with the Nuxe Sun After-Sun Hair & Body Shampoo, a gentle shower gel for all skin and hair types.. Nuxe's After-Sun Shampoo is the perfect way to refresh yourself after a trip to the beach or a holiday, as it gently cleanses both the skin and hair without causing a drying effect.. After a day's sunbathing, or a trip away, it's sometimes all too easy to forget about the build of sunscreen, chlorine and sand that can cling to your skin and tresses, but it's important to remove them to keep clean. So, we love that this hair and body shampoo has been created to target this, while also doubling up an after-sun by showcasing powerhouse natural ingredients to guard against the skin dryness that's common after sun exposure.. How To Use It . Apply the gel to wet skin and hair, lather and rinse thoroughly.. Works Well With . Make sure you stay safe in the sun with the rest of the Nuxe Sun range.. Values . listings.rawTitle: Ultrasun Sports Gel SPF30 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Drakkar Noir is a bold, aromatic fougre for a man of strength with a natural, seductive allure. listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Baume B5+ - Soothing Repairing Balm SPF50 40ml
listings.description: "Soothe and repair your damaged or irritated skin with the double action of La Roche-Posay's Cicaplast Baume B5 SPF 50." - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love The Cicaplast Baume B5 SPF 50: . Repairing balm clinically proven to accelerate repair from first use.. Contains SPF 50 sun protection.. Multi-purpose soothing action for sunburn, mosquito bites and blisters.. Reduces post-surgery scars: suitable for those undergoing cancer treatment.. Dermatological, Ophthalmological, and Paediatric approved.. . What La Roche-Posay Say: . Ultra-repairing soothing balm clinically proven to immediately soothe uncomfortable, damaged, or irritated skin, and to provide the optimal conditions for faster and better repair from day 1*. La Roche-Posay's Cicaplast Baume B5+ is a skin barrier repair specifically formulated for damaged, uncomfortable & irritated skin.. Use balm for face and/or body on a wide range of common skin irritations including nappy rashes, heating sensations, post peeling & laser. Suitable for the whole family from adults to babies from 3 months. Also suitable skincare for cancer patients undergoing treatment. The new and improved La Roche Posay Balm formula accelerates the natural skin recovery process while respecting the skin microbiome and reducing feelings of discomfort. The balm texture acts as a barrier cream, leaving an invisible protective layer on the skin, making it ideal as an everyday nappy change balm. *Skin barrier repair, instrumental test, 26 subject's vs untreated skin.. . Why It's Escentual: . Cicaplast is a multipurpose solution from which the whole family will benefit - you can use it on the face and body. It will heal chapped lips, stop scratching and soothe any uncomfortable itchiness and tightness associated with dry skin - plus, it works for baby's skin; think nappy rashes, bumps and more!. Even if you haven't got dry skin, this multipurpose moisturiser is the perfect aftercare cream for tattoos, peels, and laser treatment, as its addition of SPF 50 will protect your sensitised skin. Cicaplast+ is also suitable for patients undergoing cancer treatment, where wearing SPF is vital. Its unique formula speeds up your skin's repairing process to reduce the visibility of long-term scarring.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply Cicaplast twice daily to clean dry skin in a generous layer; the balm can be used on the face and body. It's also suitable for children from 3 years old.. . Values: . Tested under dermatological, ophthalmological, and paediatric control.. Paraben-free, fragrance-free..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Abeille Royale Midnight Secret 15ml
listings.description: In an urban world in which nights are often too short and stress is ever present, more than one in three people regularly do not get enough sleep.. Guerlain’s experts analysed the signs of tiredness on the face. Their research led them to conclude that the central third of the face is where the most visible signs of fatigue tend to manifest, including dark circles, puffiness, drooping eyelids, wrinkles, fine expression lines, and a dull complexion.. Guerlain now reinvents Midnight Secret, the high-rescue formula designed specifically for late nights. Guerlain’s secret formula for waking up to smoother-looking skin and a rested complexion combines repairing Ouessant Black Bee honey, Face-Taping technology and three powerful dermo-flash active ingredients for targeted action. Equipped with a cannula for targeted application, it acts on wrinkles and fine lines, dark circles, puffiness, drooping eyelids, and dull complexion. . Its dermo-flash active ingredients help target the visible signs of fatigue: . Face-Taping Technology: retightens the skin within 1 hour for a smoothing effect . Hyaluronic acid: with hydrating and plumping properties . Vitamin Cg: helps activate a key cell protection enzyme by +123% for revitalized skin . Energizing caffeine: delivers a true energizing boost to the skin . A true energizing formula, Midnight Secret targets the panoramic eye area, the first to reveal signs of fatigue, including eye contour, frown lines, and nasolabial folds. . How to Use . 1. To reduce forehead and frown lines Alternating the right and left thumbs, sweep the fingertips over skin in a small upward movement, moving up from the area between the eyebrows to the hairline. 2. To reduce dark circles and wrinkles in the eye contour Going from the inner corner of the eye to the temple, use the pads of two or three fingers to make “gliding walking” movements over the surface of the dark circle. For crow’s feet and nasolabial folds, this time use the pads of three fingers to make “gliding walking” movements perpendicular to the wrinkles, as if the fingers were trying to widen the wrinkle to blur it. 3. To drain the area Placing the index finger on the browbone and the middle finger on the lower eyelid, smooth the eye contour area, making horizontal movements in an outward direction. .

listings.rawTitle: NIOD Hydration Vaccine 50ml
listings.description: Seal in vital skin moisture, prevent transepidermal water loss, and restore a smooth, supple texture with the NIOD Hydration Vaccine (HV), an advanced dermal breathing barrier engineered to preserve the skin’s natural hydration.. Specially formulated for skin profiles suffering from chronic moisture loss, surface dehydration, rough texture, and barrier depletion, this high-tech breathing membrane acts as a protective shield for your complexion. Unlike traditional heavy occlusives that block pores, its velvety balm-like gel matrix forms an invisible, breathable seal over the skin. By supplementing the skin's natural moisturising factors (NMF) and physically preventing water evaporation, it locks in previous treatment layers and preserves optimal skin hydration levels throughout the day.. Benefits . Locks In Multi-Depth Moisture: Forms an advanced breathable seal to prevent transepidermal water loss (TEWL) and preserve hydration. . Supplements Natural Moisturising Factors: Replenishes essential amino acids and building blocks naturally present in healthy skin.. Smooths Surface Texture: Fills in fine dehydration lines and rough patches for an instantly soft, velvety canvas.. Breathable Non-Clogging Shield: Delivers powerful occlusive benefits without feeling greasy, heavy, or clogging pores.. Improves Long-Term Elasticity: Keeps skin cells continuously hydrated to maintain firmness, bounce, and resilience.. The Science Behind the Formula NIOD utilises bio-tech fungi, skin-identical amino acids, and advanced silicone membranes to reinforce the skin matrix:. Fungi Composite Organisms: Bio-tech extracts derived from lichens and fungi that support cellular water retention and reinforce skin structure under stress. . Skin-Identical NMF Complex: A precise complex of amino acids (including proline, alanine, and serine) that replenishes the natural moisture reserves in the stratum corneum.. Blue Algae Molecular Film: A protective marine-derived film that prevents water evaporation and supports physical barrier health.. Breathable Silicone Network: Advanced flexible polymers that form a porous, breathable film, shielding against moisture loss while allowing normal skin oxygenation.. Why We Love It We love Hydration Vaccine because it reimagines traditional heavy moisturisers into an ultra-modern, velvet-soft treatment. Instead of relying on thick waxes or oils that can feel greasy, HV uses a unique cushiony balm gel that glides over the skin like silk. It acts as the ultimate "hydration lock," ensuring every serum applied beneath it stays trapped in the dermal layers where it belongs. It leaves a touch-dry, semi-matte finish that blurs fine dehydration lines, making it an incredible final step before sunscreen or makeup.. How To Use It . Use daily, every morning and evening as the final step in your skincare routine (or before sun protection in the AM).. Step One: Scoop a small, pea-sized amount onto dry fingertips. . Step Two: Warm slightly between your hands and gently press over your entire face, neck, and chest.. Step Three: Smooth gently across the skin matrix until an even, velvety veil is achieved.. Works Well With For ultimate eye contour revival before sealing in your face hydration, apply the target-driven NIOD Fractionated Eye-Contour Concentrate around the entire eye area.. Values Cruelty-free, vegan, alcohol-free, nut-free, water-free, and formulated to suit all skin types, especially dehydrated profiles.. *50ml is the new packaging and 100ml is the old packaging. .

One of the best ways to target premature ageing is by using sunscreen, so we love that this SPF not only offers high SPF defence against UVA rays (they're the type that are responsible for sun-induced skin ageing!), but it also offers your complexion a shot of hydration using hyaluronic acid, which helps skin stay moisturised and plump.. How To Use It . Apply to your complexion in the morning. Use after or in the place of your regular day care product and reapply regularly throughout the day to maintain protection.. Works Well With . To keep your skin healthy and well looked after from head to toe, make sure to pair with a sunscreen for the body from Eucerin's sun care range.. Values . Non-comedogenic.. Fragrance-free..

Specially engineered for the complex structural needs of the delicate eye contour, this ultra-lightweight treatment combines 28 bio-tech technologies in a single formula. Unlike traditional eye creams that sit heavily on the surface, its water-thin fluid matrix absorbs rapidly into the dermal layers. By targeting both upper and lower eye concerns—including puffiness, hollows, crow's feet, and sagging—it works to re-densify the skin structure, leaving the entire eye area visibly lifted, smooth, and refreshed.. Benefits . 360° Eye Contour Treatment: Addresses the entire eye area, including the upper eyelids, lower contour, expression lines, and inner corners. . Fibroblast Drone Technology: A high-precision delivery system that targets skin fibroblasts to boost elastic tissue synthesis and improve eyelid firmness. . Darutoside Complex: An active plant-derived complex that targets upper eyelid sagging and fortifies microvascular walls.. Full-Spectrum Hyaluronic Acid Complex: Multi-molecular hyaluronic technologies that deliver multi-depth hydration to immediately plump surface crepiness.. listings.rawTitle: NIOD Multi-Molecular Hyaluronic Complex 15ml
listings.description: Flood your skin with multi-depth hydration, encourage natural hyaluronic acid production, and restore structural bounce with the NIOD Multi-Molecular Hyaluronic Complex (MMHC2), an advanced serum engineered to re-drench the skin matrix.. Specially formulated for skin profiles suffering from persistent dehydration, surface crepiness, loss of volume, and fine lines, this second-generation hydration serum moves far beyond traditional hyaluronic acid products. While basic HA serums use large molecules that rest on the surface, MMHC2 combines 15 forms of hyaluronic compounds, precursors, and peptide complexes in a water-thin fluid. By penetrating multiple dermal layers simultaneously, it delivers multi-depth moisture, visibly plumps expression lines, and supports long-term skin elasticity.. Benefits . Multi-Depth Hydration Network: Combines 15 hyaluronic compounds to drench skin from the surface down to deep dermal layers. . Encourages Natural HA Synthesis: Infused with hyaluronic precursors that signal skin cells to produce their own hydration internally.. Instant Plumping & Smoothing: Fills out fine dehydration lines and restores cushiony bounce to sagging skin structures.. Protects Against Hydration Loss: Shields the skin’s natural moisture barrier from environmental stress and water loss.. Ultra-Featherlight Water Fluid: Absorbs instantly without feeling sticky, tacky, or rolling under subsequent skincare layers.. The Science Behind the Formula NIOD utilises bio-tech peptide complexes and low-molecular HA technologies to structurally transform skin hydration:. Direct Form Hyaluronan (Direct HA): Provides immediate surface hydration and softening for an instantly smooth, dewy canvas. . Enzyme-Reacted Hydrolysed HA: Ultra-low molecular weight HA that penetrates deep into dermal layers to support skin elasticity and structural repair.. Bio-Complex HA Precursors: Specialised yeast-derived building blocks that support natural hyaluronic acid synthesis within skin cells.. Mushroom-Derived Hyaluronic Complex: A natural botanical complex that delivers 400 times more surface hydration than standard HA molecules alone.. Why We Love It We love MMHC2 because it completely redefines what a hyaluronic acid serum should feel like and achieve. Unlike standard HA serums that can feel thick, tacky, or pull moisture out of skin in dry environments, MMHC2 has a weightless, water-like consistency that sinks in within seconds. It leaves no sticky residue just cool, refreshed, and intensely plumped skin. It acts as an indispensable foundation layer in any regimen, creating a dewy, cushioned canvas for subsequent treatments.. How To Use It . Use daily, every morning and evening after cleansing and misting, before heavier oils and creams.. Step One: Dispense a small drop (about the size of a large pea) onto clean palms.. Step Two: Press gently into your face, neck, and chest using smooth, upward motions.. Step Three: Allow a few seconds for the water-thin fluid to fully absorb before layering target serums or creams.. Works Well With To seal in this multi-depth moisture and form a breathable, protective membrane over your skin, follow with the velvety NIOD Hydration Vaccine. . Values Cruelty-free, vegan, silicone-free, alcohol-free, oil-free, nut-free, and formulated to suit all skin types, including sensitive profiles..

Pretty opens with a delectable fruity combination of mandarin, peach nectar and orange blossom, before a heart of jasmine, iris and peony shape the signature note, petalia. In the base, a smooth and creamy combination of fluffy musk, jacaranda wood and creamy amber warm the skin.. Top Notes: Italian Mandarin Orpur, Orange Blossom, Peach Nectar. Heart Notes: Star Jasmine, Petalia, Pink Iris, White Peony. Base Notes: Fluffy Musk, Jacaranda Wood, Creamy Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum Spray 125ml
listings.description: Take a walk down the most famous street in the world with the Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum, a fresh floral fragrance that exudes the energy of New York.. 5th Avenue is for a woman that possesses a sense of style, a woman that is successful, poised and holds her head high with New York's skyline. She feels good in her own skin, and the 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum ensures everyone in her wake remembers her, even in the busy streets of Manhattan.. This sophisticated aroma opens with feminine notes of lilac, linden blossom and exotic mandarin. The luxurious top notes are meet an elegant heart of rare Bulgarian rose, violet and jasmine, before intertwining with a warming base of amber and Tibetan musk.. Notes . Top Notes: Lilac, Linden Blossom, Dewy Magnolia, Muguet, Exotic Mandarin, Bergamot.. Heart Notes: Rare Rose Bulgarian, Violet, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Indian Tuberose, Peach, Clove, Nutmeg.. Base Notes: Amber, Tibetan Musk, Sandalwood, Iris, Vanilla..

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Blue Grass Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden Blue Grass embraces the skin with the lightness of florals and the freshness of the air on a warm summer's day.. Inspired by the wild freedom of the countryside, Blue Grass scintillates the senses with plush flower petals, tall grasses, aromatic herbs and rich woods. It is a fresh and natural evocation of femininity, one that celebrates nature at its most beautiful. A bouquet of flora in the top notes is made up of decadent rose, jasmine and lily, together with the relaxing essence of lavender. A green and aromatic heart of vetiver, clove and laurel introduce depth and greenery, before a woody dry down of cedar, sandalwood and musk leave a kiss of warmth on the skin.. Top Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Lily, Lavender, Geranium. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Clove, Laurel. Base Notes: Virginia Cedar, Sandalwood, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Advanced Ceramide Capsules Daily Youth Restoring Serum 30 Capsules
listings.description: Restore the youthful glow of your complex with the Elizabeth Arden Advanced Ceramide Capsules Daily Youth Restoring Serum, a silky anti-ageing serum.. The youth-enhancing formula will work to visibly reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by replenishing the skin's natural production of ceramides, whilst retexturising and hydrating the epidermis. The serum will be quickly absorbed in to the skin, as essential fatty acids strengthen and firm without leaving a greasy after-feel.. The skin's tone, clarity and dryness will be improved, balancing the complexion, for more radiant and youthful-looking skin.. Gently twist tab around twice and squeeze capsule with fingertips. Smooth over cleansed face and neck morning and night before moisturiser..

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Energizing Bath & Shower Gel 200ml
listings.description: Enwrap yourself in the luxuriously refreshing scent of Green Tea with the Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Energize Bath and Shower Gel .. Gently cleanse your skin without stripping it of natural oils. The softly foaming Bath and Shower Gel will lather to create a luxurious blanket that will deeply cleanse and nourish your skin. Take the invigorating and sparking Green Tea aroma with you into the bath and shower for the ultimate in fragranced refreshment.. Lather the Bath and Shower Gel over the body and rinse well..

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette Intense Spray 125ml
listings.description: Devastatingly handsome and more intense than ever, the Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette Intense Spray tells the tale of a roguish sailor.. Ultra Male is a fragrance built upon contrasts, moving from deeply seductive facets to casual freshness like the rolling of the tides. In this voyage, the sailor is well travelled and thoroughly modern, with a fresh outlook and a streak of rebellion.. The fragrance opens with the torrid sensuousness of black lavender accented with mint and juicy pear. In the heart, a frisson of cool spices create contrast, before a dry down of black vanilla, amber and woods create an unforgettable trail.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Juicy Pear, Black Lavender, Mint. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Clary Sage. Base Notes: Black Aztec Flower, Black Vanilla, Amber, Cedar, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays New York 1955 Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: The scent of a New York milk bar with the volume turned up, 4160 Tuesdays New York 1955 Eau de Parfum is a satisfyingly delectable floriental gourmand fragrance.. An exuberantly cheerful sweet floral fragrance, using notes that were popular in the 1950s, but playing a new tune. Imagine a 1950s New York diner serving a whipped milkshake, piled with vanilla ice cream and raspberries, loaded with candy floss, crystalised roses and violets, and smoothed with soft, huggable musks. In a bottle. . Our fragrance expert says: . "Inspired by American ice-cream parlours of the 1950s, New York 1955 is a delicious sundae made with generous scoops of rose, raspberry and violet in neon colours. This is ditzy and sweet technicolor gourmand with vibrant flavours that is never sickly or too much. I'll have two scoops, please.". Top Notes: Candy Floss. Heart Notes: Raspberry , Rose, Violet. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Ealing Green Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: The fragrance of a midsummer's night, 4160 Tuesdays Ealing Green Eau de Parfum has an invigorating green and earthy aroma.. In creating Ealing Green, Sarah McCartney was inspired by the place where she first met her husband, and the magic of A Midsummer Night's Dream. The result is the aroma of Ealing green in the early 17th Century, a light and fresh scent of cut grass, herbs, meadow flowers, wild roses and the warm earth.. Our fragrance expert says: . "Ealing green is well, green, I suppose, but not overly so. Created as an ode to Sarah's adopted home this is a herbal green floral with accents of rose and violet (the 4160 Tuesdays signature) that is fresh, lively and slightly earthy. I've never been to Ealing, but Ealing Green makes me want to take a trip!". Top Notes: Cut Grass, Rose, Thyme. Heart Notes: Geranium, Lavender, Violet. Base Notes: Patchouli, Earth, Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Tokyo Spring Blossom Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Aerial and cheerful, 4160 Tuesdays Tokyo Spring Blossom (Urara's Tokyo Cafe) captures the delightful beauty of the breeze blowing through spring blossoms.. The fragrance of citrus fruits and flowers is blended so smoothly it feels as free and fluid as the movement of branches in the wind, its plush petals dancing on the breeze.. Our fragrance expert says: . "I don't have a top ten fragrances (I'm far too fickle for such a thing) but if I did, Tokyo Spring Blossom would certainly hold a place somewhere near the top. Inspired by a warm breeze blowing through cherry blossom, Tokyo Spring Blossom is a joyful blend of rose, violet and raspberry jam. It makes me so happy I wear it to bed to make sure my dreams are suitably sweet.". Top Notes: Pink Grapefruit, Mandarin. Heart Notes: Violet, Rose. Base Notes: Raspberry Leaf, Opoponax.

listings.description: 4160 Tuesdays Tart's Knicker Drawer Eau de Parfum is a fun yet sophisticated number, and the scent of someone absolutely up to no good.. An elegant, sophisticated powdery flowery amber, generous with its favours. This is a luxurious 1950s style scent “ picture it with a fitted waistline, hat, heels, lipstick, elegant eyebrows and perfectly applied lipstick, . Our fragrance expert says: . "Tart's Knicker Drawer is the ultimate glam fragrance. It is the fragrant equivalent of red lips, stilettos, (faux) fur coats and gigantic jewellery. Filled to the brim with fruits, flowers and plenty of make up powder, Tart's Knicker Draw is Sarah McCartney at her cheekiest. Glam has never been so much fun.". listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays Pillow Talk Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Like an intimate embrace, 4160 Tuesdays Pillow Talk Eau de Parfum enwraps skin in tactile warmth.. Originally created to be sprayed onto pillows as an aphrodisiac, Pillow Talk is the sensual scent of shared secrets, perfect to wear all over at times of heightened seduction. . Fresh citrus fruits and light blossom, seductive jasmine and sandalwood, softened with musk and a hint of vanilla. . Our fragrance expert says: . "Pillow talk is a bit of a sexy little number. It pairs the erotic tones of white flowers, namely jasmine and ylang ylang, with smooth woods and pepper to make a dreamy fragrance that feels soft, but hot at the same time. I'm happy to let this pillow do the talking.". Top Notes: Yuzu, Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Sandalwood. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Black Pepper.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays The Sexiest Scent On The Planet. Ever. (IMHO) Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Unassuming and sensuous, 4160 Tuesdays The Sexiest Scent on the Planet. Ever. (IMHO) Eau de Parfum is a fragrance to be enjoyed up close.. Smooth, soft and seductive, it opens with the surprising scent of sweet, tart lemon meringue pie, then smoulders down to velvety woods. It's a great perfume to take out with you and add a layer of scented sensuality for evening. A fragrance with which to woo and be wooed. . Our fragrance expert says: . "First things first, you need a bottle of this in your life. Secondly, the name is delivered with tongue firmly pressed in cheek, so don't get snotty. This is the smoothest and most satisfying vanilla fragrance. It's sweet, spicy and powdery, with oodles of bergamot, cedar wood and ISO E Super (an ingredient that makes things super smooth) to make a warm and comforting skin scent. Oh, and it's super sexy too!". Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon Meringue. Heart Notes: Wood, Modern Amber. Base Notes: Vanilla, Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays The Dark Heart Of Old Havana Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Take a scented walk through the streets of La Habana with 4160 Tuesdays The Dark Heart of Old Havana Eau de Parfum.. This rich and intoxicating fragrance takes you from the Hotel Sevilla to the Caseon del Tango , where dances, smiles and songs are traded like currency. A fruity oriental aroma described as 'an adult vanilla', with w afts of coffee and tobacco, sweet, sugary desserts cooked with baskets of oranges and mangoes. . Our fragrance expert says: . "Most perfume houses would be tempted to showcase the more pleasant side of an exotic destination such as Cuba, but not 4160 Tuesdays. Sarah McCartney tells stories and paints pictures with her fragrances, and The Dark Heart of Old Havana is a rich tapestry of vanilla, stewed fruits and tobacco that isn't afraid to celebrate the darker, and slightly less aesthetically pleasing aspects of a richly cultured city. Check this out if you're an olfactory renegade.". Top Notes: Orange, Peach, Grapefruit, Sugar. Heart Notes: Tobacco, Bergamot, Tonka, Jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Black Pepper.

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays The Lion Cupboard Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: An intimate fragrance redolent of dark woods, mint and tobacco, 4160 Tuesdays The Lion Cupboard Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that embraces.. The Lion Cupboard is crafted from all of Sarah McCartney's father's favourite aromas, coming together to create the comforting scent of a Victorian oak sideboard that's spent 150 years absorbing the fragrances of herbs, fruits, tobacco and coffee. Rich with woody and herbal fougere facets, it's a reminder of happy times.. Our fragrance expert says: . "Perfume so often acts as an olfactory time capsule filled with liquid memory. Once the lid is cracked open, a thousand emotions come rushing forward. The Lion Cupboard is an intensely personal fragrance inspired by the smell of a cabinet owned by Sarah's father. It smells rich, woody and oily with patchouli, juniper and lavender. Beautiful and moving.". Top Notes: Mint, Lavender, Juniper Berry, Grapefruit, Aniseed. Heart Notes: Ylang, Rose, Cedar, Sandalwood, Black Pepper. Base Notes: Tobacco, Vetivert. Vanilla, Cocoa.

listings.description: The fragrance of an elegant, idiosyncratic woman, 4160 Tuesdays Doe in the Snow Eau de Parfum speaks of beautiful contrasts.. Inspired by the fruity chypre fragrances of the 1960s and 70s, but with a layer of frost and a frosty topping, Doe in the Snow smells of light fresh peach sorbet with flowers and woods, all stirred with an icicle. . Our fragrance expert says: . "4160 Tuesdays goes vintage for Doe in the Snow and channels the great fruity chypres of the 1970s. A chilly start of fruit and aldehydes leads to a peachy floral in pastel shades and a leathery base, accompanied by a hint of green tea. Beautiful, understated and fabulously retro." . Top Notes: Grapefruit, Cedrat, Yuzu, peach Aldehyde, Snow. Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Rose, Jasmine, Oak. Base Notes: Opoponax, Oakmoss, Leather, Green Tea Absolute.

listings.description: Take a trip to the British seaside with 4160 Tuesdays What I Did On My Holidays Eau de Parfum, a nostalgic, sun bleached fragrance.. Reminiscent of beach-front amusement arcades, rock shops and candy floss stands, with every spray you can almost hear the delighted laughter of children and the mechanical whirr of well-loved rides.. Our fragrance expert says: . "When one thinks of holiday-inspired fragrances they imagine exotic blends of rare flowers, rich spices and cocktail-esque citruses. What I Did on my Holidays asks us politely to think again. This is a fragrance that celebrates the best kind of holiday - the day trip to the British seaside. Salty rock pools, suntan lotion, mint-flavoured rock and a cool sea breeze make for a fascinating and fun fragrance unlike any other holiday scent out there.". Top Notes: Mint, Coconut Suntan Lotion, Sea Air. Heart Notes: Lavender, Candy Floss. Base Notes: Vanilla.

A powerful strong hold formulation, not only designed with, but used by salon professionals. Delivering salon results and salon experience at home.. Manipulator paste is Bed Head’s iconic hair styling product! This hair styling putty adds definition, body and texture to hair and provides style control. The putty helps to defend hairstyles from frizz and humidity. It has a strong, flexible hold. For incredible texture and style! Formulated with Ozokerite that builds texture between hair fibres for style control, flexible hold, definition and thicker-looking hair, Propylene Glycol that absorbs and retains moisture from the surroundings to help defend hairstyles against frizz and humidity, and Styling-Boosting Polymers that act like ‘style scaffolding’ for an even application and flexible hold.. For Who . Great for styling short to medium hair length. How to Use . Work a small amount through clean hair for a natural finish. Use hands to scrunch, twist or spike into shape for finished look. Let your hair air dry or gently blast to dry. It can be used on both finished dry hair or wet hair. Top tip: a little Manipulator goes a long way, so be careful not to overdose on it. Start with a small amount at first and only apply more if needed.

listings.rawTitle: TIGI Bed Head Control Freak Serum 250ml
