listings.rawTitle: TIGI Bed Head After Party Smoothing Cream 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Nuit d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: Between tension and attraction is the Issey Miyake Nuit d'Issey Eau de Toilette, a sensuous fragrance that draws its strength from the dark.. At night, sensations are intensified and emotions are magnified. Nuit d'Issey takes its inspiration from this unique nocturnal energy, balancing darkness with light to produce a magnetic and majestic masculine fragrance.. Base Notes: Patchouli, Incense, Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum presents a darkly sensuous and thrilling fragrance for women.. Created for modern heroines who seek adventure above all else, this electrifying fragrance is like a shot of pure energy. An adrenaline boost that encourages you to pursue unspoken desires and live life to the fullest, always seeking the next electrifying encounter.. This newest chapter in the opulent Opium saga is as free, confident and glamorous as ever before, with a fast-paced, contemporary twist. A terribly addictive and impertinent gourmand floral that smells so good you'll want to taste it.. At the heart of Black Opium is an addictive black coffee accord blended with luminous white flowers, the ultimate play of shadow and light. A gourmet dose of vanilla envelops the fragrance in celestial beauty, creating a trail that is indulgent, sensuous and absolutely unforgettable.. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Orange Blossom, White Flowers. Base Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Cedarwood Essence, White Musk, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: DHC Deep Cleansing Oil - Facial Cleanser 70ml
listings.description: “The DHC Deep Cleansing Oil is a cult-classic for a reason, effortlessly dissolving even the most stubborn waterproof mascara while leaving your skin feeling incredibly soft and nourished.” - Escentual Beauty Team.. . The Most Important Thing About This Facial Cleanser Is.... This is the gold standard of oil cleansers and a true pillar of Japanese beauty. It tackles the common struggle of removing heavy makeup and sunscreen without the need for harsh scrubbing. The biggest benefit is its unique water-soluble formula; it binds to impurities like a magnet but rinses away as a milk, leaving absolutely no greasy residue behind.. . Why You’ll Love This Deep Cleansing Oil:. It effortlessly breaks down waterproof mascara, SPF, and excess sebum in seconds.. The 100% organic olive oil base nurtures the skin barrier rather than stripping it.. It transforms your sink-side routine into a spa-like ritual with its silky texture and natural aroma.. This clever formula saves you time by acting as a powerful makeup remover and deep cleanser in one single step.. . Product Claims:. DHC has formulated this oil to provide a thorough deep clean while respecting the skin’s natural moisture balance. It uses the scientific principle of like attracts like to lift oil-based impurities from the pores. The formulation is water-soluble, meaning it emulsifies instantly upon contact with water for a clean, fresh finish.. . What The Brand Say:. DHC’s bestselling, cult-classic Deep Cleansing Oil is truly one of a kind.. The original Japanese first step oil cleanser melts away makeup and dissolves impurities, leaving your skin clean, soft and radiant.. The 100% organic olive oil-based formulation works on the scientific premise that like attracts like.. Applied with dry hands on your dry face, this rich, naturally golden-hued olive oil-based cleanser binds with dirt and effortlessly breaks down sunscreen, sebum and stubborn makeup, like waterproof mascara and eyeliner, without clogging your pores.. The water-soluble formula rinses away with zero oily residue.. Its silky feel and delicate, natural rosemary aroma make washing your face feel like a luxurious spa experience.. This botanical formulation features antioxidant-rich organic olive oil and vitamin E to hydrate, soften and protect, and rosemary leaf oil to invigorate and refresh.. Also works great as a makeup brush cleaner.. . Hero Ingredients:. Organic Olive Oil is the star here, rich in antioxidants to protect and hydrate your skin while it cleanses. Rosemary Leaf Oil provides a refreshing, herbaceous scent and helps to invigorate the complexion. Vitamin E acts as a natural skin conditioner, helping to keep your face looking youthful and feeling supple.. . What Does It Feel and Smell Like?. It has a rich, golden, and velvety texture that glides over the skin with zero friction. Unlike some oils that can feel heavy, this feels cushioning and luxurious. The scent is a delicate, natural hint of rosemary - clean, earthy, and incredibly soothing after a long day.. . The Best Way To Use It:. Always start with dry hands and a dry face. Dispense two to three pumps and massage it in circular motions to melt your makeup. Once you see everything dissolving, add a little lukewarm water to emulsify the oil into a milky lather, then rinse thoroughly. My expert tip? It also makes a fantastic, gentle deep-cleaner for your makeup brushes to keep them soft and hygienic.. . Why It’s Escentual:. We pride ourselves on curating only the very best, and DHC Deep Cleansing Oil is a global icon that we wouldn't be without. It represents the heritage of J-Beauty; simple, effective, and rooted in high-quality ingredients. We love how it makes the skin feel plump and hydrated before you’ve even reached for your moisturiser. It is a reliable, trustworthy staple that delivers exactly what it promises every single time.. . Sustainability:. DHC focuses on high-quality organic olive oil and straightforward, functional packaging that protects the integrity of the botanical formula. The brand is committed to efficient production processes that honour its Japanese roots.. . Values:. This cleanser is rooted in the use of natural botanicals and the highest grade of organic olive oil for skin health.. It is completely fragrance-free and colourant-free, making it a kind choice for those who prefer clean, simple formulations.. .

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Ma Vie Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for women is a delightfully fresh floral fragrance that expresses the ideals of modernity, femininity and confidence.. Hugo Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme is a soft fragrance created in partnership with Jason Wu, the Artistic Director for BOSS Womenswear. In his desire to create a scent that symbolized the new, modern aspects of femininity Wu drew parallels between this latest era of womanhood and the cactus flower, which perseveres to bloom beautifully despite the difficulties it endures. Wu sought to create a fragrance that was as invigorating and exceptional as this uncompromising desert plant and achieved his vision with Ma Vie Pour Femme.. This exquisite scent complements the free spirit of a woman who pauses to indulge in the simple moments of life; a walk home at dawn, the feel of the sun's warmth on her skin, the soft touch of a flower. It is in these moments that the Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme woman is her most captivating, radiating a glow of poise and self-assurance.. Hugo Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme opens with the revitalizing green freshness of the Cactus Blossom, leading into the blooming bouquet heart notes of delicate Rose Buds; blended expertly with Jasmine Petals and Pink Freesia to create a natural floracy. Warmth is gifted to this scent through the alluring accords of Sheer Woods in the base notes, with charismatic Cedarwood forming the grounding signature of this fine fragrance.. Top Notes: Cactus Blossom Heart Notes: Pink Freesia, Jasmine Petals, Rose Buds Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sheer Woods.

listings.description: Protect and perfect your complexion with the Ultrasun Tinted Face Anti-Ageing Sun Protection SPF 30 in Honey, a tinted SPF moisturiser for all skin types, including sensitive.. Featuring an advanced blend of hardworking ingredients and innovative complexes, the Tinted Face cream provides broad-spectrum protection and a sheer, even coverage that's warm and radiant.. The high protection sunscreen absorbs 90% of UVA rays while tackling UVB rays with SPF 30 defence. Skin is shielded from blue light (from mobile devices and screens) with titanium dioxide and GSP offers infrared protection. A blend of antioxidants keep skin youthful and healthy by neutralising free radicals and protecting skin from oxidative stress.. Ultrasun has been leading the way in suncare expertise since 1992, and that's evidenced in their use of lamellar technology. This locks in the sun-defence formula to the skin and keeps it there for hours, ensuring long-lasting protection from just one application. It also ensures a fast-absorption and helps to prevent sun allergies and prickly heat.. Blending skincare, suncare and makeup, the anti-ageing formula coats skin in a sheer and luminous wash of bronzed colour. The face cream is enriched with ectoin, which is an enzyme that targets UV-induced ageing. Fine lines and wrinkles are smoothed away while larger pores are minimised. Skin is left soft, unified and glowing with a healthy youthfulness.. Why We Love It . People might skip their daily SPF in the hopes of getting a tan, so we love the fact that this tinted sunscreen means you don't have to choose. It protects your skin from the damaging and ageing effects of the sun while still providing an even and bronzed glow. It's the perfect multi-tasker and is a must-have for travelling as it's got three uses in one! Wave goodbye to your SPF, moisturiser and foundation - this wonder product does it all.. Not only is the hardworking cream effective, it's also incredibly gentle and pleasurable to use. Free from fragrance and preservatives, the blend is suitable for even the most sensitive skin. The tinted fluid is like milk as it blends seamlessly over the skin and instantly absorbs, ensuring an even coverage, a unified finish and a comfortable bronze glow.. How To Use It . Apply a cleansed and dry face, neck and decollete 30 minutes before sun exposure as the last step in your skincare routine or the first step in your makeup routine.. Works Well With . If you love having a unified and protected complexion then you're going to want to keep your body the same, right? If so, make sure you take a wander through Ultrasun's Tinted Body range to stay defended and bronzed from head-to-toe.. Values . Vegan, non-comedogenic.. Fragrance-free, emulsifier-free, paraben-free, mineral oil-free, silicone-free..

listings.description: Fend off sun-damage and pigmentation with the Ultrasun Face Anti-ageing & Anti-Pigmentation Sun Protection SPF 50+, a very high protection daily SPF moisturiser for those with sensitive skin prone to pigmentation.. A host of antioxidants shield the skin from oxidative stress and free radicals, keeping the skin healthy and youthful.. Designed to tackle hyperpigmentation caused by sun exposure, the vegan sunscreen contains a blend of anti-pigmentation ingredients and expert complexes to brighten up areas of existing pigmentation. Dark spots are evened out for a unified and even complexion.. The SPF 50+ moisturiser also protects the skin from UVA-induced damage and photoageing using anti-ageing enzyme ectoin. Fine lines and wrinkles are smoothed away and the appearance of larger pores are reduced, while the cream helps maintain skin's optimal moisture levels for long-lasting hydrated and comfortable skin that's protected against the sun, ageing and pigmentation.. Why We Love It . As with all Ultrasun products, the SPF 50+ face cream focuses just as much on the pleasure of use as the effectiveness of the formula. People often think high protection suntan lotions come with a thick and sticky texture that's heavy and uncomfortable on the skin, but Ultrasun has changed that. The fluid is incredibly lightweight and blends in seamlessly for an easy, non-greasy application.. Skin feels smooth, soft and hydrated as the invisible protection is locked in, you can forget you're wearing it and go about your day with confidence knowing your complexion is protected for whatever the day brings.. Plus, because the skin is left so smooth and plump, the sunscreen doubles up as a makeup primer as it provides the perfect moisturised base.. How To Use It . If your sensitive skin loves the protecting and weightless properties of this powerful sunscreen then ensure you have a look at Ultrasun's Body range for even more lightweight and hardworking suncare to keep you shielded from head-to-toe.. listings.description: Immerse yourself in the scent of summer with the Nuxe Prodigieux Le Parfum, a radiant floral Eau de Parfum with the same fragrance as Nuxe's iconic Huile Prodigieuse Dry Oil.. Expertly capturing the essence of a warm summer evening, the radiant fragrance blends together white florals with warm sands and cosy gourmands for truly sun-drenched scent.. Launched in 2012 from the nose of Serge Majoullier, the feminine perfume opens with the white floral note of orange blossom, with subtle hints of bergamot and tangerine tinging the petals with freshness. The elegant heart of rose, gardenia and magnolia creates a beautiful bouquet that's light, feminine and perfect for the brighter seasons.. Truly bottling the spirit of the beach, the creamy base lingers seductively on the skin and epitomises all of the tropical scents we associate with summer.. Just like the oil, the carefree and laidback scent harnesses the same warmth and radiance that will transport the senses to a sunny beach or lounging by the pool. Whether you're going on holiday or just wish you were, the Nuxe Prodigieux Le Parfum is as blissful and sensual as a cocktail in the sun and as luxurious as the legendary oil itself.. About Nuxe Prodigieux Le Parfum's Bottle . Held in a tall, elegant glass, the bottle is simplistic yet sophisticated. The ombre amber-bronze echoes the warm shades of the sun and the radiant scent within, expertly reflecting the warmth of the sun setting in the evening.. Why We Love It . It's no secret that we're obsessed (like the rest of the world) with Nuxe's iconic dry oil, so we love the fact that we can experience the same beautiful aroma in an Eau de Parfum.. The floral scent is incredibly wearable and would be the perfect fragrance to take you from day-to-night as the floral notes make it lighthearted enough for the daytime, while the sultry base offers the sensuality that we look for in an evening scent.. How To Use It . Spritz the Eau de Parfum on the pulse points. Layer up the scent by using the Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Dry Oil first to intensify and prolong this warm aroma.. Works Well With . Make sure you explore the full Nuxe Prodigieux collection to further lose yourself in this tantalising scent and experience it in even more sensorial formulas, such as a shower oil and a body lotion.. The notes in Nuxe Prodigieux Le Parfum are . Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Bergamot, Tangerine.. Heart Notes: Rose, Gardenia, Magnolia.. Base Notes: Warm Sand, Coconut Milk, Vanilla.. Values . 88% natural origin ingredients, non-photosensitising..

listings.description: Restore and nourish your dry soles with the Eucerin Urea Repair Plus Foot Cream, a 10% urea rich foot cream for very dry and calloused feet that delivers up to 48 hours' intense moisturisation.. Providing comforting moisture to the hard skin on feet, the Eucerin foot cream is a soothing and nourishing treatment for calloused, thickened heels. The lightweight yet powerful lotion is enriched with moisturising urea and protective ceramides, which help prevent moisture loss and to block out irritants that can cause itching, inflammation and discomfort.. The hardworking cream regenerates the skin's natural barrier to lock in moisture and inhibit dryness. Using other natural moisturising factors naturally found in skin, the Eucerin foot cream attracts moisture and binds it to the skin. This helps stop it from getting dry, scaly and damaged for super soft and smooth soles.. Suitable for those who may be prone to xerosis and psoriasis, the comforting foot lotion will relieve dry, sore and uncomfortable feet.. Why We Love It . We all love to lather our faces and bodies in rich, nourishing skincare, but our poor feet can sometimes be forgotten about. Not only do we walk on them everyday, but they're also exposed to many daily aggressors, and this can lead them to getting rough, very dry and uncomfortable. We love the Urea Repair Foot Cream because it solves this issue promptly and restores moisture and comfort to your sore heels.. Plus, the oil-in-water emulsion is quickly absorbed by skin and melts in instantly. The cream is held in a white tube with a navy-blue lid. It's simple and minimal, but packs big results.. We love coating our feet in this pampering foot cream before bed and popping on a nice pair of cosy cotton socks. Wake up to soft, healthy soles!. How To Use It . listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Urea Repair 5% Urea Hand Cream 75ml
listings.description: Nourish and hydrate dry, rough hands with the Eucerin Urea Repair 5% Urea Hand Cream, which is clinically proven to deliver instant relief and intense moisture to dry hands for 48 hours.. Eucerin understands that our hands are constantly exposed to external aggressors, while regular hand-washing, contact with chemicals, and temperature changes can all play a part in causing dry, rough skin on the hands - they can even end up looking red and scaly.. Eucerin's Urea Repair Hand Cream blends urea, ceramide and other natural moisturising factors (NMFs) to offer an effective boost of hydration to even the most dry, dehydrated skin. The quick-absorbing, snow-white cream has been clinically proven to both immediate relief, while it's also shown to offer intense moisturisation for very dry, rough hands, even after repeated hand-washing.. The nourishing cream works by strengthening the skin's natural barrier, so skin becomes resilient to dryness for up to 48 hours. The formula uses urea, a natural substance that regulates moisture levels in the skin, which acts by binding water in the uppermost layer of skin. The cream also supports and regenerates the skin's natural barrier using ceramide-3, which locks in moisture and defends against skin dehydration, while additional NMFs prevent dry, scaly skin.. As this non-greasy hand cream cocoons the hands in instant hydration, it's even suitable for those with xerosis, psoriasis and mature skin.. Why We Love It . There are times when we can all suffer from dry hands, whether it's the cold winter months, or from excess hand-washing, but we love that Eucerin's UreaRepair cream offers a more thorough burst of hydration for skin that's suffering with very dry skin more regularly.. listings.rawTitle: Eucerin Sun Allergy Protect Sun Cream Gel For Face and Body SPF50+ 200ml
listings.description: Shield your skin with the Eucerin Sun Allergy Protect Sun Cream Gel SPF50+, a superior face and body sunscreen specifically engineered to prevent sun-induced allergies and protect against high-intensity UV damage.. Living with sun-reactive skin requires more than just standard protection. The Eucerin Sun Allergy Protect Sun Cream Gel is designed to make outdoor life comfortable again for those prone to Polymorphous Light Eruption (PLE) and other sun sensitivities. Now offering SPF50+—the highest level of protection—this advanced, water-resistant gel-cream ensures that your skin remains defended without the heavy, uncomfortable feeling of traditional sunscreens.. Benefits . Very High Protection: Updated to SPF50+ to provide maximum defence against UVA and UVB rays.. Targeted Allergy Defence: Specifically formulated to prevent the itching, redness, and blisters associated with sun allergies.. HEVIS Light Defence: Guards against High-Energy Visible light, which can trigger oxidative stress and premature skin ageing.. Skin Comfort: A fragrance-free and emulsifier-free formula that minimises the risk of irritation for highly reactive skin.. Advanced Texture: The non-greasy, non-sticky gel-cream absorbs quickly and is highly water-resistant.. The Science Behind the Formula Eucerin utilises Advanced Spectral Technology to provide more than just surface-level shielding. This formula combines broadband and photostable filters with biological cell protection:. Alpha-Glucosylrutin (AGR): A natural, powerful antioxidant extracted from the Pagoda Tree. It helps neutralise the free radicals that are the primary triggers for sun-induced allergies like PLE.. Licochalcone A: This potent antioxidant works in the deeper epidermal layers to soothe skin and neutralise free radicals caused by both UV rays and High-Energy Visible (HEVIS) light.. Why We Love It For anyone who has experienced the discomfort of a sun allergy, the upgrade to SPF50+ provides ultimate peace of mind. We love that this formula manages to offer such high protection while remaining incredibly lightweight. It absorbs into the skin instantly, leaving no white cast or sticky residue, making it the perfect daily companion for those who need to stay safe in the sun without compromising on skin comfort.. How To Use It . Apply generously to the face and body before sun exposure.. Reapply frequently at least every two hours and especially after swimming, perspiring, or towelling to maintain the original level of protection.. Note: Avoid contact with the eyes. To prevent staining, avoid direct contact with fabrics and hard surfaces until the product is fully absorbed.. Works Well With To care for your skin after a day in the sun, pair this with the Eucerin After Sun Sensitive Relief Gel-Cream to further soothe and hydrate allergy-prone skin.. Values Fragrance-free, emulsifier-free, non-greasy, non-sticky, water-resistant..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Terracotta Joli Teint Tinted Moisturiser SPF20 30ml / 20 - Golden
listings.description: Terracotta Joli Teint has been reinvented in an innovative, ultra-sensory formula, now with 90% naturally derived ingredients¹. . Lighter than a foundation, this protecting tinted moisturizer guarantees a corrected and sun-kissed complexion. Plumped and revitalized, skin displays a natural golden glow, inspired by the radiance of the Mediterranean sun. Thanks to its second-skin texture, the makeup result is ultra-natural, fingertip application intuitive and the coverage buildable, from light to medium. This 24-h wear, no-transfer makeup result is now combined with a multiprotective action and powerful skincare active ingredients to offer skin the best of the sun while protecting it from its harmful effects linked to UV rays thanks to a SPF 20 – PA+++. Skin is also durably hydrated, plumped and revitalised, for a naturally radiant complexion. The non-comedogenic formula adapts to all skin types. Its iconic fragrance is instantly recognizable, thanks to its ylang-ylang and orange blossom heart, fusing with a musky and vanilla-inflected tonka bean note. Resisting heat and humidity, Terracotta Joli Teint is the perfect ally for makeup creating a sun-kissed complexion, whatever the season or climate. ¹Based on ISO 16128 standard. The remaining 10% contribute to the product’s integrity and sensoriality. . How to use Apply the product with your finger or directly with the Kabuki Brush¹ created by Guerlain to apply its foundations, and blend in circular motions from the center of the face outwards to apply the texture. . Upon application, the complexion is evened out, corrected, and illuminated with a golden sun-kissed glow. This subtle result can be adjusted to modulate its intensity, without demarcation. . For a more intense bronzed makeup look, reapply the product to the cheekbones, bridge of the nose, and temples.¹Sold separately. .

listings.rawTitle: Ultrasun Family SPF30 100ml

Ultrasun is committed to caring for your skin and caring for the environment. The vegan sunscreen is certified reef-friendly and Ultrasun have been awarded the EcoSun Pass, which guarantees their products are sustainable and won't affect the environment or the ocean. This means you can enjoy the sun and the sea knowing you're fully protected and aren't contributing to environmental damage..

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus After Shave Lotion 100ml
listings.description: Round off your shave with the scented Rabanne Invictus After Shave Lotion.. Pour a few drops into a cupped hand, rub the lotion between your palms and then pat onto the face and neck. For a gentler alternative, use the Invictus After Shave Balm ..

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Triumphant and masculine, the Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette is an ode to the champion at the top of his game.. Invictus represents a clash of powers and sensations, where biting freshness meets magnetism in a virile, enduring signature. It is the incarnation of the contemporary hero, a son of Olympus whose invincible success borders on the mythological. A god of the stadium who is first and foremost a man.. The addictive, tactile fragrance takes flight with an invigorating marine accord, paired with the sharpness of grapefruit and aromatic bay leaf. Its other half is deeper and more seductive, revealing the unusual headiness of gaiac wood with ambergris and patchouli. Invictus is a true weapon of seduction for the hero whom nothing and no one can resist.. Our Fragrance Expert says: . " "Invictus is a sports fragrance with unique touches. It uses metallic notes to create a new kind of freshness and an almost piquant level of clarity. A warm base of salty ambergris, spiky woods and a touch of amber help make for a fully realised and versatile fragrance that is suitable for wear on and off the pitch. . Housed in a bottle shaped like a trophy and fronted by Australian Rugby League Player Nick Youngquest, Invictus is a fragrance that speaks of champions, victory and almost mythical sporting achievements fought for in vast arenas where sportsmen are viewed as rock stars “ gods and gladiators of the stadia.". Vibrant Accord: Marine Accord, Grapefruit Zest, Bay Leaf. Magnetic Accord: Gaiac Wood, Ambergris, Patchouli.

Tested under dermatological, ophthalmological, and paediatric control.. Paraben-free, fragrance-free.. .

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Triumphant and seductive, the Versace Eros Eau de Toilette presents an intensely refreshing, virile signature for men.. The fragrance is inspired by ancient Greek mythology, specifically Eros, the god of love. Strong, fervent and a master of himself, Eros is a man of passion and desire, using his bow and arrow to make people fall in love.. Like its namesake, the Eros fragrance is one of primal desire. It exudes a unique aura right from the top notes, creating a luminous and intensely fresh impression. Mint, citrus and crisp apple peel blend seamlessly, a triumphant and sensual on the skin.. Normally reserved for the base, a heart of addictive tonka bean and ambroxan shape the heart, creating an intriguing oriental signature. The base of vanilla aids this creaminess, before greenery in the form of oakmoss and cedarwood round off the sensuality.. Top Notes: Mint Oil, Italian Lemon Zest, Green Apple Heart Notes: Tonka Bean, Ambroxan, Geranium Flower Base Notes: Madagascan Vanilla, Oak Moss, Cedarwood.

The gentle, soap-free formula can be used on the face and other imperfection-prone areas of the body, such as the chest and the back. The non-comedogenic Sebium Foaming Gel reduces sebum secretion with its patented Fluidactiv ® sebum-correcting complex and ensures that the sebum is of better quality to reduce the risk of breakouts.. Use daily, both morning and night. Moisten your face with lukewarm water, work the Sebium Purifying Cleansing Foaming Gel into a lather between your hands and then apply the foam to your face. Rinse away thoroughly, and then pat dry with a clean towel. After use, the skin is left feeling purified and fresh. Over the long term, imperfections become less frequent. Can be used as shaving foam. . Values . Soap-free, paraben-free, colourant-free.. Hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic..

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Nutritic Intense 50ml
listings.description: Get rid of dry sensitive skin with an in-depth nutri-reconstituting cream from La Roche Posay. The highly effective Nutritic Intense cream is a paraben free formula which increases suppleness in the skin.. Working with new INNOVATION MP-lipids, this formulation works to soothe the painful symptoms associated with dry/very dry skin so you don't have any more tightness, stinging or tingling.. This formulation is ultra-fine and envelopes the skin in a cream that intensely reconstitute superior layers of the epidermis. It's sensitive formula is great for sensitive, problematic dry to very dry skin. Use La Roche-Posay Nutritic Intense in the morning and/or evening over the whole face. Paraben free. Non-comedogenic. .

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Nutritic Intense Riche 50ml
listings.description: Relieve your skin from the painful sensations that excessive dryness can cause with the La Roche Posay Nutritic Intense Rich cream, a comforting and soothing treat for sensitive, problematic skin.. By wrapping the skin in a cream which is formulated with new INNOVATION MP-lipids (a new generation of lipids with a high efficacy on the synthesis of moisturizing factors, lipids and proteins essential to skin's comfort and protection) this cream comforts, soothes and increases suppleness. It gets rid of the painful sensations you experience when you have very dry skin. No more tingling, stinging or tightness, just perfectly balanced, easy to maintain, moisturised skin.. La Roche-Posay Nutritic Intense Riche is for use in the morning and/or evening over the whole face. Paraben free. Non-comedogenic. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: As timeless and feminine as a little black dress, Guerlain La Petite Robe Noir (Little Black Dress) Eau de Parfum is the epitome of couture for the skin.. The romantic signature essence marries the finesse of Guerlain's fragrance heritage with an irresistible, mischievous sense of femininity. A cheeky wink of Guerlinade sweetness and seduction that makes for the ultimate temptation.. In the top notes of the Guerlain La Petite Robe Noir scent, ripe black cherry and berries meet with the exquisite creaminess of almond. This delicious sweetness is made more voluptuous with a heart of velvety rose, before the shadowy temptation of liquorice and aromatic black tea hint at an enigmatic intensity.. Our Fragrance Expert says: . "I personally dare anyone to sniff this perfume and not smile. Guerlain's ode to the little black dress is a trendy, glamorous and delicious perfume stuffed to the brim with French style and whimsy. By crafting a delicate cherry and raspberry pastry with hints of rose, liquorice and smoky black tea, Guerlain has created an olfactory signature that is as unforgettable as it is beautiful. You owe it to yourself to sniff this" . . Top Notes: Bergamot, Black Cherry, Almond, Berries. Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose Absolute. Base Notes: Liquorice, Patchouli, Black Lapsang Tea Leaves. . .

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Just Cavalli Eau de Toilette Spray 90ml
listings.description: Be tempting with the Roberto Cavalli Just Cavalli Eau de Parfum, a sexy and provocative fragrance for women.. Just Cavalli Eau de Parfum was created in the image of the Cavalli woman: young, free and captivating, with an insatiable zest for lust and life. She is snake charmer, created to seduce and inspire, and her scent ensnares her prey.. Her fragrance is a mix of gold, intense pink and animal print, a magnetic combination that demands all attention. Neroli flower blends with the exotic beauty of tiare flower for remarkable luminosity, before a bite of palisander wood leaves a lasting impression.. Top Note: Neroli flower. Heart Note: Tiare Flower. Base Note: Palisander Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff The Game Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Don't be afraid to stand out from the crowd with the confident and refined new scent by Davidoff, The Game.. Existence is a game that should always be played to win. Strive to inspire confidence, breed success and win admiration with this bold and distinctive fragrance, because in the end, only the assertive will win the game and conquer the queen of their heart.. Charismatic, self aware and totally in control, The Game's player knows no limits and is a natural winner. Skilled in the art of seduction he has an aura of elegance that commands a man's respect and bewitches a woman's heart.. Opening with a shot of gin and a hint of Juniper Berries, this woody aromatic fragrance develops into a floral heart of Iris and Precious Woods. A base of Ebony Wood languishes on the skin for a masculine and intriguing dry down.. Notes . Top Notes: Gin and Juniper Berries. Middle Notes: Iris and Precious Woods. Base notes: Ebony Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lubin Idole de Lubin Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Experience the perfume that embodies bold femininity and a fierce desire for pleasure, with the Lubin Idole de Lubin Eau de Parfum. Go boldly into hazardous lands to search for forbidden pleasures and excitement with this daring and intoxicating scent. Daring, bold and fearless she roams these exotic countries in search of excitement that she can exploit. She's a daredevil and wants to taste the unknown.. Idole de Lubin Eau de Parfum is a unique twist on the Eau de Toilette of the same name, this is a fragrance with a difference. It opens with a wave of Rum and Cumin for a spicy and pleasing initiation. A rather full heart is mellowed with Smoked Ebony and Incense and this leads to a base that is sensual with its leather note, tactile, luminous and distinctive.. Femininity is something that should be celebrated in all its forms; it is paradoxical, mysterious and steadfast and this perfume is dedicated to all the extraordinary women out there.. Top Notes: Rum, Saffron, Black Cumin and Bitter Orange.. Heart Notes: Doum, Palm, Smoked Ebony, Olibanum, Incense and Sugar Cane.. Base Notes: Leather, Red Amber, Labdanum and Sandalwood..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Abeille Royale Eye Cream 15ml
listings.description: Replenish the youthful look of your eyes with the Guerlain Abeille Royale Eye Cream, a treatment that enhances your most precious feature.. Highly concentrated in Guerlain Exclusive Royal Jelly, the Abeille Royale Eye Cream specifically targets the delicate eye area and works to smooth, even out and restore density to the skin. Eye Zone Replenishing Technology works to reinforce the skin's support mattress, ensuring that eyes take on a more youthful appearance.. With continued use, the Abeille Royale Eye Cream firms and smoothes the eye contour, whilst dark circles and puffiness are visibly reduced. Its rich and firm balm texture melts upon contact with the skin, caressing the eye contour with exquisite comforting care.. Apply morning and evening as part of your Abeille Royale routine..

listings.description: "Comfort your dry and dehydrated skin with 48 hours of hydration thanks to the microbiome-friendly Nuxe Creme Fraiche de Beaute Moisturising Rich Cream 48H." - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . It's a sensory experience perfectly complemented by the iconic scent of Creme Fraiche de Beaute, a blend of fresh petitgrain, orange blossom and cedar.. If you're a fan of the original Fraiche de Beaute Moisturising Rich Cream, don't panic. The updated Rich Cream provides the same long-lasting hydration with a cleaner formula that contains 4% more natural-origin ingredients.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply the Creme Fraiche de Beaute Cream in the morning and evening to the face, neck and decollete.. . The Sustainable Side: . Recyclable plastic pot and FSC approved cardboard box. Nuxe obtain this active ingredient using an environmentally-friendly approach; the red algae is sourced using a sustainable development approach that harnesses the energy released during manufacturing - and doesn't produce polluting waste.. . Values: . Vegan.. . *Use test under dermatological supervision “ 22 volunteers..

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Orangers En Fleurs Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Luxuriate in the refinement of orange blossom with the Houbigant Orangers En Fleurs Eau de Parfum, a multifaceted and ultra feminine fragrance for women.. Inspired by the voluptuous blossoms, verdant greenery and the woodiness of the orange tree, Orangers En Fleurs captures the senses in a cascade of harmonious notes.. The elixir of silky florals opens with an inviting orange blossom, rose and jasmine in the top notes, before an enveloping heart of creamy tuberose and ylang-ylang are warmed with a delicious note of nutmeg. Finally, a dry down of white cedarwood and musk linger close to the skin, making for a decidedly sensual end to the fragrance.. Orangers en Fleurs is showcased in a modernised version of a classical crystal bottle from the beginning of the 20th century, that was originally designed and manufactured by Baccarat for Houbigant.. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Rose, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Eau de Brouts, Ylang-Ylang, Nutmeg. Base Notes: White Cedarwood, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Experience the freshness of vast open spaces with the Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Toilette, a noble and agile scent for him.. Inspired by the infamous sailing boat of the same name, the Prada Luna Rossa fragrance for men brings together a reverence for the natural world and a passion for innovation. A scent that takes its lead from technological elegance and the sleek styling of extreme sailing boats, Luna Rossa is a signature for the man whose spirit resides in the great outdoors with its rugged, vast open spaces.. With a backbone of aromatic lavender and the slightly bitter freshness of orange essence, the Luna Rossa fragrance opens with a keen sense of invigoration. The heart explodes with the natural brightness of clary sage and spearmint, before a woody, ambery dry down of ambroxan and ambrette absolute assert a resolute trail.. Top Notes: Lavender, Orange Essence. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Spearmint Nanah. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Ambrette Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Deodorant Spray 150ml
listings.description: Ensure comfort with the Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Deodorant Spray, a portable, practical spray that provides immediate freshness.. The lightweight spray provides lasting deodorising efficacy, respecting the skin with its conditioning agents while regulating perspiration. Its alcohol base ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience while respecting the delicate balance of the skin.. An ideal way to enjoy the inimitable fragrance of Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza daily; a signature blend of classical Italian citrus, a heart of rosemary, rich flora and a soft touch of clove, together with a dry down of a vibrant woods, intense patchouli, soft white moss and warm amber notes..

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Experience the essence of Dolce & Gabbana femininity with the Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray for women.. Warm and voluptuous and a touch of creamy sweetness, this fragrance is for a woman who is compelling and sensual. It is made up of contrasts, an exuberance of sinuous details that strike the balance between strength and gentleness. Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme for women is not afraid to face any challenge, and does so with a strong sense of self and a fierce determination.. Her Dolce & Gabbana fragrance is as resolute as she is, with an innately soft yet seductive character. Soothing neroli is intertwined with juicy raspberry and a hint of tart green mandarin. A melting heart of velvety, potent florals temper a sweet and creamy dry down of full bodied vanilla, powdery heliotrope and a showstopping '˜guimauve' marshmallow accord.. Notes . Top Notes: Neroli, Raspberry, Green Mandarin. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Marshmallow Accord, Vanilla, Heliotrope, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Vichy Dercos Energising Shampoo 200ml
listings.description: Enliven your thinning, lifeless hair with the Vichy Dercos Energising Shampoo.. Made up of a 1.5% concentration of patented anti hair loss molecule Aminexil together with vitamins PP, B5 and B6, Dercos Energising Shampoo reinvigorates your hair from root to tip while working to maintain the density and thickness of the hair shaft.. Clincally proven to restore vigour and vitality to the hair, the formula can be used frequently. It is suitable for all hair types, and even sensitive scalps thanks to its light and fresh texture.. Work the Vichy Energising Shampoo into a lather in dampened hair and then rinse away. Use in conjunction with Dercos Aminexil Hair Loss Treatments for men and women..

listings.description: Inspire the night with the Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum, a deeply sensual fragrance for men.. A perfume of extreme contrasts, Le Parfum presents carnal attraction at its height. The fragrance is made up of noble ingredients that represent the freshness of light and the intensity of shadow. The essence of seduction in a cascade of overdosed notes: a magnetic tension.. YSL La Nuit de L'Homme Le Parfum opens with a clean burst of bergamot and anise, immediately followed by the heat of black pepper. Powerful, aromatic notes of lavender and labdanum are made even headier by the sensuality of patchouli and vanilla. A final touch of vetiver adds lasting resonance.. Turning powdery under the influence of bitter cacao, the sandalwood plunges deep into a velvety trap.. Our Fragrance Expert says: . "Santal Majascule is sandalwood with a gourmand twist. Candied fruits and gingerbread are added to the plush quality of sandalwood, creating a woody perfume that really does verge on being edible. You won't find a sandalwood fragrance quite like this one elsewhere.".

listings.rawTitle: Vichy Normaderm 3 In 1 Cleanser + Scrub + Mask 125ml
listings.description: Regulate your complexion with the Vichy Normaderm 3 in 1 Cleanser, Scrub and Mask, an all-in-one solution for oily skin.. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Experience the unexpected and sensual aroma of KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO, a floral Eau de Parfum for women.. FLOWER BY KENZO is inspired by the poppy, a scarlet flower that thrives in the most unusual of places. Deeply feminine, the fragrance is built around floral notes.. Expert perfumer, Alberto Morillas marries elegant Bulgarian rose, honey-like acacia farnesiana, and May blossom to create a bouquet that envelopes the senses.. The fragrance then welcomes a parme violet note, creating a sensuous and yet understated mood. Pink pepper provides a fresh and spicy essence that harmonises with the floral top notes with a sparkling effervescence.. The Eau de Parfum finally adopts an addictive softness, by pairing white musk with sweet vanilla to create a truly irresistible and long-lasting aroma.. Why We Love It . Inspired by the poppy, this fragrance perfectly captures the duality of the flower, which is both elegant and delicate, and bold and resilient - just like the woman who wears it.. We love the creativity behind FLOWER BY KENZO; it's both unique in its essence and in its design. A poppy shoots up the side of the curved glass bottle; it's crimson petals sitting atop an elongated green stem. The flacon is simple, sophisticated and beautiful, and will add a delicate pop of colour to any dresser.. How To Use It . Spritz directly onto the pulse points to get the most out of this scent.. Works Well With . KENZO FLOWER is a range of sophisticated and unique floral perfumes, why not experience them all?. Notes . Floral Accord: Bulgarian Rose, Acacia Farnesiana, May Blossom.. Vibrant Accord: Parme Violet, Pink Pepper.. Powdery Accord: White Musk, Bourbon Vanilla..

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Un Matin d'Orage Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "Un Matin d'Orage feels like stepping into a lush garden right after a summer downpour! Usually, tuberose can feel heavy or opulent, but this dew-kissed blend of green florals and zesty spices is pure, airy magic on the skin." - Escentual Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Annick Goutal Un Matin d'Orage:. It captures the fragile moment a garden wakes up after the rain, making you feel instantly refreshed and serene.. Un Matin d'Orage offers an airy, delicate elegance; it's a unique floral fragrance that's truly hard not to love!. Lively shiso leaf and spicy ginger bring an unexpected, dewy freshness to classic white florals.. Guaiac wood, myrrh, and a touch of vanilla create a soothing, earthy base that prolongs the scent of nature reborn.. Fragrance lovers adore its rare expression of tuberose—green, slightly fruity, and beautifully weightless.. It's a damp, luminous garden aroma softened by creamy gardenia; a modern, uplifting take on traditional white florals.. . What Does Annick Goutal Un Matin d'Orage Smell Like?. Un Matin d'Orage is an airy, fresh Eau de Parfum for women that opens with a lively burst of crisp shiso and invigorating ginger under a rain-heavy sky. As the fragrance unfolds, a rare and delicate heart of green, subtly fruity tuberose emerges, accompanied by gardenia and a touch of nutmeg to soften its contours. The scent then settles into a comforting base of guaiac wood, rich myrrh, and a hint of sweet vanilla, evoking the serene beauty of earth glistening after a storm.. . Fragrance family: Fresh Floral. . Top notes: Shiso, Ginger. . Heart notes: Tuberose, Gardenia, Nutmeg. . Base notes: Guaiac Wood, Myrrh, Vanilla. . . Why It's Escentual:. Master perfumers Camille Goutal and Isabelle Doyen created Un Matin d'Orage to capture the tranquil magic of a Japanese garden after a thunderstorm—distilling the scent of wet petals, damp foliage, and electric freshness in the air.. Housed in the Maison's emblematic Art Deco-inspired gadroon bottle—a nod to Annick Goutal’s background as an antique dealer—it comes topped with their signature tied bow to symbolise generosity. Un Matin d'Orage has a delicately luminous quality that shines brightest during spring and summer mornings, or whenever you crave a clean, serene floral escape.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We also recommend the following perfume tips: . Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows. . Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent. . Hold the perfume bottle about 6–8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance. . Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance. . If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm. . .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: A luxurious new flacon to celebrate the 85th anniversary of the unmistakable fragrance of Guerlain Shalimar.. Designed by rock royalty, this beautiful bottle with its smooth curves and elegant simplicity harks back to the original Shalimar design.. Jade Jagger, daughter of the enigmatic Rolling Stones front man Mick Jagger and South American beauty and style icon Bianca Perez-Mora Macias, created the new interpretation of the Shalimar bottle after discovering the classic fragrance for herself.. Having studied painting in Florence, and then moving on to become an established jewelery and interior designer, Jade Jagger has used all of her experience and has approached the creation of the new bottle with same design criteria. It must be pleasing to behold, it must make you desire and covet it, and above all, it must make you feel special.. The smooth, voluptuous curves of the body of the bottle stand elegantly on the pedestal which harks back to the original Shalimar bottle.. The blue stopper is carved like a jewel into a faceted fan with the Guerlain signature.. The insignia of Guerlain, which once adorned Guerlain's finest creations, also returns and rests on a midnight blue leather ribbon.. The classic fragrance of Shalimar, which has seduced women for generations since its appearance in 1925, is unaltered.. The romantic story of the garden of Shalimar was its inspiration, and Jacques Guerlain drew from this story to create a floral, woody fragrance - the world's first oriental perfume.. Bergamot is calmed by the powdery notes of iris, jasmine and rose. Soft vanilla and rounded opoponax resin are grounded by Tonka bean, and create the lasting base to this sensual and elegant fragrance..

listings.description: "Deliciously sweet but with a sharp bitter pop, the Roger & Gallet Bois d'Orange Wellbeing Fragrant Water is a must-have for lovers of orange scents." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Roger & Gallet Bois d'Orange: . Invigorating citrus fragrance packed with bitter orange.. Fresh water spray format that lasts around 4 hours on the skin.. Fresh juicy oranges are given an earthy twist here. Petitgrain has a floral-woody scent, working with the patchouli base to add depth to the vibrant bitter orange opening. listings.rawTitle: Tisserand Lavender Ethically Harvested Pure Essential Oil 9ml
listings.description: Tisserand Lavender Essential Oil is an ethically harvested light oil with a distinctive floral aroma that's ideal for massage.. The lavender in this pure essential oil has been distilled from lavender flowers grown in France. Lavender has frequently been used to calm a restless mind and soothe a tired body as a sleep aide for both adults and children. Lavender oil is also great for massage when combined with a blending oil, and it blends especially well with bergamot, clary sage and geranium. Try adding a few drops to hot bath water for a truly relaxing experience.. Add 8-10 drops to your favourite burner or vaporiser to create an atmosphere ideal for relaxation. For general body massage, add up to 5 drops of this essential oil to at least 10ml of blending oil. Before use please ensure you read the Essential Oil Safety Information Leaflet, enclosed in the packaging..

The tall, amethyst-inspired bottle has a handy refill feature, so it's easy to replenish your favourite Eau de Parfum using the Alien Refill Bottle.. Why We Love It . listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle 100ml
listings.description: Keep your original Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum Star fully replenished with the eco-conscious refill bottle, which allows you to continue your obsession with Mugler's oriental-gourmand fragrance for women.. Mugler's timeless scent was the first modern fragrance to fall into the gourmand category as it centres around a delicious combination of notes that smell good enough to eat. Now, you can give in to the cravings and keep your perfume topped up with the use of this smooth, glass refill. Simply remove the top of your existing Angel Star, insert the funnel and carefully decant.. The revolutionary fragrance opens with a burst of bergamot, which instantly demands attention. This develops into an irresistible heart of fresh exotic fruits, sweet caramel, honey and praline, while the base balances earthy patchouli and sensual vanilla. The almost-edible scent is glamorous, charming and known for its long-lasting effects.. Why We Love It . This statement scent speaks for itself. It continues to be a favourite for women looking for a scent that skillfully recalls the tempting treats of childhood while being effortlessly sophisticated. We love that it was inspired by Mugler's childhood as this adds a personal, nostalgic twist to a timeless fragrance.. How To Use It . Remove the top of your existing Angel Eau de Parfum, insert a funnel and carefully refill. Once replenished, spritz the fragrance onto your pulse points to get the most out of this captivating scent.. Works Well With . Mugler's Angel scent has been a well-loved classic since it was first introduced in 1992. The sensual, chic aroma has been featured in a number of scented body products, which pair perfectly with the Eau de Parfum.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Exotic Fruits, Honey, Caramel, Praline. Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler A*Men Eau de Toilette Rubber Flask Spray 50ml
listings.description: A * Men, the first male fragrance created by MUGLER, materializes the contemporary hero, a man who imposes himself by his inner strength, his desire to win. It is the scent of the confident and adventurous man.. An Ambery Woody Vigourous family fragrance, MUGLER's A * Men Eau de Toilette evokes the virility of a sculpted body through its woody notes of patchouli, and the daring strength of the hero through its notes of Coffee Absolute. An ardent and full-bodied fragrance with an intense character and woody energy that reveals the essence of the hero that lies dormant in every man.. Bold, intense and fascinating, A * Men materializes an authentic and innovative vision of the contemporary hero. This powerfully virile fragrance combines elegance, sophistication and charisma.. AMBERY WOODED DIMENSION The woody and masculine notes of patchouli imbued with Bourbon vanilla vibrate with intensity and virility.. BLIND DIMENSION Used in overdose, the absolute of coffee note brings a full-bodied and resolutely masculine character to the fragrance.. THE BOTTLE A black rubber with a second-skin feel, the tapered lines of the A * Men bottles are reminiscent of travel flasks and acquire an energetic and virile price in the hand.. MUGLER is committed to more responsible luxury by offering infinitely refillable bottles thanks to the Refill Bottle.. As with all MUGLER creations, spray a cloud in the air and then cross it to let the fragrance settle on hair and clothes. Complete this gesture whenever you want, by applying the fragrance to the pulse points: in the hollow of your wrist, at the top of the neck or at the bend of the arm..

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Chergui Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fire fanned by the wind, a desert in flames. As if bursting from the earth, Chergui, a desert wind, creates an effect that involves suction more than blowing, carrying plants, insects and twigs along in an inescapable ascent. Its full, persistent gusts crystallize shrubs, bushes and berries, which proceed to scorch, shrivel up and pay a final ransom in saps, resins and juices. Night falls on a still-smouldering memory, making way for the fragrant, ambery and candied aromas by the alchemist that is Chergui.. Key notes of tobacco, immortal flower, Russian leather and hay..

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Un Bois Vanille Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: To paraphrase Freud, it's not the evil who are full of regrets, but the good. Both the devil and vanilla like black. No sentimentality here! Within each of us, this mellowness grows stronger and more refined thanks to contrasting wood notes.. Our Fragrance Expert says: . "Un Bois Vanille is vanilla seen through a prism where the spicy, creamy, cherry and woody facets of the ingredient are all intensified to create a vanilla taken to the extreme. It straddles the line between hedonism and cloying sickliness quite dangerously so only those who adore truly delicious perfumes need apply.".

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Huile Prodigieuse Or Multi-Purpose Golden Dry Oil - Face, Body and Hair 50ml Splash

listings.rawTitle: Klorane Mango Nourishing Shampoo for Dry Hair 200ml
listings.description: “Deeply moisturise your locks without weighing them down with the Klorane Mango Nourishing Shampoo for dry hair, a deeply hydrating shampoo that leaves hair supple, soft and shiny.” - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You’ll Love The Klorane Mango Shampoo: . Hydrates and protects dry and malnourished hair.. Contains 86% natural origin ingredients.. Gently cleanses and detangles locks.. Features 90% mango butter for a naturally sweet, fruity scent.. Vegan, biodegradable formula.. . What You Need To Know: . Klorane’s Mango Shampoo is arguably one of Klorane’s most iconic and beloved hair care products. It effectively cleanses dry hair with a rich formula that reveals soft, hydrated locks. Juicy mango lies at the heart of the formula for its natural nourishing and protective properties; thanks to its fatty acid and polysaccharide-rich content, it’s the perfect remedy for malnourished and dry hair types. The lightweight texture protects each individual strand without weighing it down for bouncy volume. Created using 86% natural origin ingredients, the shampoo helps to repair the hair shaft for stronger and healthier locks. Its dermatologist-approved formula is suitable for all hair types and scalps, even those with sensitivity.. . Why It’s Escentual: . Klorane’s idea to include 90% mango butter in this range was a stroke of genius; rich and juicy mango leaves a sweet, uplifting scent that can be enjoyed throughout the day. The creamy texture easily lathers into the hair, nourishing each strand from root to tip for maximum nutrition. We love Klorane’s commitment to the ecosystem - and this shampoo is no exception with its biodegradable, vegan formula and 100% recyclable bottle.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply a small amount to wet hair, work into a lather and massage into your scalp for a few seconds before rinsing thoroughly. For maximum moisture, use alongside Klorane’s mango collection.. . The Sustainable Side: . Biodegradable formula. 100% recyclable bottle made using 50% recycled PET..

listings.rawTitle: Klorane Quinine Shampoo for Thinning Hair 200ml
listings.description: “Restore strength to thinning hair with the Klorane Quinine Shampoo, an 80% natural origin hair wash for those who struggle with hair loss and breakage.” - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You’ll Love The Klorane Quinine Shampoo: . Cleanses and refreshes thin, tired hair.. Promotes hair growth whilst restoring hair strength.. Detangles hair to reduce breakage.. Derived from 80% natural ingredients.. Features a vegan, biodegradable formula.. . What You Need To Know: . If you’re struggling with hair loss or thinning, the Klorane Quinine Shampoo will give your hair an invigorating and revitalising boost. Its gently cleansing formula combines quinine and B vitamins to restore hair vigour and strength. In fact, 84% of users agreed their hair had restored strength and vitality. It even detangles hair to prevent further breakage caused by brushing. The vegan shampoo has a minimal dermatologist-approved formula that’s free from sulphates, silicones and mineral oils, making it ideal for anyone with hair extensions or sensitive scalps.. . Why it’s Escentual: . The Quinine Shampoo nurtures weak, damaged hair and scalps to support growth in a kind, caring way using the power of 80% natural ingredients. Whether you’re suffering from hair loss caused by stress, diet, pregnancy or fatigue, the quinine shampoo will help you achieve stronger and thicker locks. Its strong scent will invigorate your senses with each use.. Formulated using 80% natural origin ingredients; we love that Klorane’s vegan, biodegradable formula is part of its mission to protect and promote botanical treasures. All of Klorane’s rinse-off formulas are now vegan and biodegradable, reducing the impact of wastewater on marine environments. They’ve also removed 100+ controversial ingredients from all of their formulas to expand their efforts.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Apply to wet hair and work into a lather, making sure to massage the shampoo into your scalp for a few seconds before rinsing thoroughly with water. Try to avoid wastage by only using a hazelnut-sized amount.. . The Sustainable Side: . Klorane’s biodegradable formula is held inside a 100% recyclable and recycled bottle.. Values: . Dermatologically-tested and vegan.. Sulphate-free, silicone-free and mineral oil-free..

listings.description: “Gently wash delicate hair with the Klorane Oat Milk Ultra-Gentle Shampoo, a dermatologist-approved hair wash that restores softness.” - Darcey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Klorane’s Oat Milk Shampoo keeps hair soft, silky and nourished, while it gently cleanses both the hair and scalp. The shampoo centres around oat milk for its richness in sugar, lipids and vitamins that work to soften, protect and detangle hair.. Inspired by an oriental love story, Shalimar is the dazzling essence of a woman who is endlessly desirable and forever desired.. Like her, Shalimar is at once sublime and intimate.. Suave and luscious, this elegantly sensual and undeniably attractive perfume expresses itself in multiple and astonishing facets depending on the moment, the skin or the hour.. Shalimar is the essence of femininity.. Like all legendary elixirs, it springs from the basin of a magic fountain.. The curves of the bottle evoke a gentle roundness while the transparent blue stopper recalls the eternal water fountains of the gardens of Shalimar.. Inside the clear glass bottle emblazoned in gold, the mythic perfume glistens with a secret flame.. Fragrance Description. . Soft oriental Voluptuous, sensual, spellbinding Tonic top notes of fresh flowers and bergamot are calmly intrepid.. Like the savvy disorder of rumpled silk sheets, powdery notes of iris, jasmine and rose suggest or promise sensual embraces.. The creamy softness of addictive vanilla, the penetrating charm of iris, the balmy roundness of opoponax and the gourmand warmth of Tonka bean orchestrate an intimate symphony of scent for languorous interludes.. Perfumer's Secret. . Perfume, which is also called an Extract, is the most concentrated and therefore the most faithful version of a perfume.. Created to be in osmosis with the skin, an Extract creates a unique alchemy upon contact with the skin and expresses itself differently on every woman.. A few drops applied on the inside of the wrists and elbows, at the base of the neck, at the roots of the hair or in the hollow of the decollete will reveal their presence with the movements of their wearer and the passage of time without ever becoming overpowering..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vetiver Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN Vetiver Eau de Toilette is a classic fresh woody fragrance for men refined by a light touch of citrus, spice and smokey tobacco." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Vetiver Eau de Toilette: . An aromatic fragrance with a fresh spicey kick.. Inspired by a grassy moor at dawn.. Lasts 2-4 hours.. A square glass bottle with a heavy black cap.. . What Does GUERLAIN Vetiver Eau de Toilette Smell Like? . The citrusy opening of orange, bergamot and lemon gives Vetiver energy. It becomes fresh and spicey in the heart thanks to nutmeg and a sprinkle of invigorating pepper. The energising pepper continues until the end of the fragrance, setting the foreground for the star note of grassy vetiver mixed with smoking tobacco and creamy tonka bean.. Top notes are Orange, bergamot, lemon. Heart notes are Nutmeg, Pepper. Base notes are Vetiver, Tobacco, Tonka Bean. . . Why It's Escentual: . Created in the 1950s, GUERLAIN Vetiver Eau de Toilette is a timeless fragrance that has captured the hearts of many over decades. GUERLAIN delved into the vetiver note's earthy sun-soaked grassy quality, giving it a sophisticated elegance thanks to an infusion of a woody accord, spice and tobacco. Inspired by a grassy moor at dawn, GUERLAIN replicates the earthy scent of dewy grass as the sun rises.. You may have noticed that the classic men's fragrance bottle has changed. The Eau de Toilette has the same fresh spicey aroma you love, but it looks different. Vetiver is bottled in a new square glass flacon with refined lines to match GUERLAIN's style, capped with a metal black lid with luxury guilloche detailing taken used in the craft of watchmaking.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray onto your pulse points - wrists and neck.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Elegance is the ultimate freedom.. Habit Rouge incarnates the magnificent and unpredictable hunter, a man who is enamored of refinement and capable of all manner of audacity.. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with an allure that combines sophistication and sensuality.. An oriental that is by turns citrusy, warm and accented with vanilla, Habit Rouge expresses the genius of contrast and well-mastered emotions.. The bottle's mastery of form, sharp shoulders and modern geometry give it an eternally elegant appeal.. Fragrance Description. . Oriental Citrus Passionate, sophisticated, audacious. Bitter becomes fresh when played in refined accords of lime and tangy orange.. Its spicy pedigree heart is warmed by patchouli and rests on a noble base where leather relaxes under the lavish caress of benzoin and vanilla.. It is the rich and sensual use of vanilla that gives Habit Rouge its complex and mysterious personality, the hallmark of Guerlain's greatest perfumes.. Perfumer's Secret. . A few drops of Eau de Toilette on a little leather ball placed in the car or in the home leaves a lasting, warm and sensual impression..

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca smells like all of my favourite refreshing green aromas combined - freshly cut grass, spearmint and green tea." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca: . Aromatic minty green Eau de Toilette with hints of fresh spice and citrus.. Lasts on the skin for around two to three hours.. Offers the greenest scent in the GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria collection.. Housed in the iconic Aqua Allegoria bottle.. . What Does GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette Smell Like? . Thierry Wasser bottles the green scent of freshly cut grass in Herba Fresca. The scent is undeniably green from start to finish; it opens with green notes and bright Italian lemon that is zesty and bright. At the heart is where the scent gets its minty-fresh spiciness, thanks to notes of spearmint, cyclamen and floral lily of the valley. At the base, aromatic green tea affirms Herba Fresca's distinct cool green edge.. Top notes are Green Notes, Italian Lemon. Heart notes are Cyclamen, Spearmint, Lily of the Valley. Base note is Green Tea. . Why It's Escentual: . Herba Fresca is more than just a fragrance; it's an energising tonic that you can tap into when you have a lull of energy. The bright energising green scent of Herba Fresca is different to the rest of the Eau de Toilettes in the Aqua Allegoria collection, and it's probably the most distinct too. A breath of fresh air, its fresh minty scent is definitely one that everyone can appreciate and love!. Green like the scent itself, the perfume resides in the classic Aqua Allegoria bottle, which is decorated with gold honeycomb detailing around the neck of the bottle. At the top, the gold continues to the unscrewable top that has been embossed with GUERLAIN's iconic bee emblem to show their commitment to nature. The iconic bottle will sit beautifully next to the other Aqua Allegorias in your perfume collection on your dresser.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray on your pulse points - the neck and wrists.. . The Sustainable Side: . The French beetroot alcohol used in GUERLAIN's Herba Fresca comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass, while Herba Frescais also refillable.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: "GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette is so much more than a classic grapefruit scent; it has unexpected depth and longevity, thanks to its milky vanilla and woody patchouli notes." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune: . Energising and uplifting fragrance that centres around grapefruit.. Ideal for layering with other scents in the Aqua Allegoria line.. Part of the iconic Aqua Allegoria collection.. Made with up to 95% natural ingredients.. Features the signature bee-inspired bottle design.. . What Does Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette Smell Like? . Pamplelune is like a citrus you've never experienced before. From the first spray, it releases an extremely realistic grapefruit accord. This bright grapefruit note is enhanced by the sunny green-citrus tone of bergamot, which is met by a fruity heart of honeyed neroli, petitgrain and berry-like cassis. In the base, woody patchouli and creamy vanilla add an unexpected depth and dimension.. Top notes are Grapefruit, Bergamot. Heart notes are Neroli, Petitgrain, Cassis. Base notes are Patchouli, Vanilla. . Why It's Escentual: . Perfumer, Thierry Wasser, took inspiration for his creation of Pamplelune directly from nature. When formulating Pamplelune, he imagined a citrus garden packed with golden fruits but dominated by grapefruit; his vision is evident in Pamplelune, through its vibrant grapefruit tone that's complemented by neroli and bergamot. It has to be said that the grapefruit tone may seem more realistic as Pamplelune's formula is made with up to 95% natural ingredients - which shows GUERLAIN's ongoing commitment to nature.. Another aspect of the Aqua Allegoria fragrance line which takes its inspiration from nature is its iconic bee inspired design. Any fans will recognise the weighty glass bottle, golden top engraved with GUERLAIN's famous bee and the golden honeycomb design that encases the neck of the bottle. But now, the flacon is even more impressive, thanks to its refillable design.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray the fragrance on your pulse points - the wrists and neck.. . The Sustainable Side: . The French beetroot alcohol used in GUERLAIN's Pamplelune comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and there are refills available for Pamplelune.. .

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum Spray 80ml
listings.description: Delve into delicate sensuality with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum Spray, a floral aromatic scent for women.. This ultra feminine scent is for a woman who is chic and sophisticated, her style effortless and her smile magnetic. Drawn to her infectious manner, her elegant personality imprints on your memory, making the Givenchy Very Irresistible scent the perfect accompaniment to this alluring figure of grace.. Fresh bursts of crisp green apple slice open the juicy notes of pear, provoking the velveteen rose petal core. Delicate and empowered, the special Liv Tyler rose blooms open, flirting with the creamy base of vanilla and patchouli to reveal a sensuous dry down with longevity.. Top Notes: Green Apple, Pear, Star Anise. Heart Notes: Liv Tyler Rose, Centfolia Rose, Peony Rose. Base Notes: Passion Rose, Fantasia Rose, Emotion Rose, Vanilla, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Xeryus Rouge Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Vivid and energetic, Xeryus Rouge plays with heat to ignite a sensual fire. A powerful Eau de Toilette for the elegant man.. This man fragrance opens with the exotic notes of American and Mexican Grapefruit Essence, followed by a spicy Pimento Accord. The base notes are then transported by the sensuality of Canadian Cedar Leaf Essence.. Givenchy has reinvented its iconic fragrances, including Xeryus Rouge, with a new refined bottle emblematic of Maison's style. Reminiscent of Hubert de Givenchy's taste for purity, it evokes the authentic luxury born of the designer's talent for Haute Couture.. Les Mythiques, is Givenchy's iconic fragrances in a timeless heritage collection.. Notes . Top Notes: Grapefruit Essence. Heart Notes: Pimento Accord. Base Notes: Cedar Leaf Essence.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette Spray 80ml
listings.description: Choose to live a spontaneous life with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette, an alluring floral fragrance for women.. Even more endearing than her magical smile, this flirtatious scent was made for a provocative woman. When you're touched by her presence, she's hard to resist. Her eyes sparkle with spontaneity, whilst her signature scent lingers with delight. Similar to its wearer, this playful fragrance exudes innocence, charm and complete irresistibility.. Blended with the beauty of five delicate roses, a dominate burst of flower power storms open the scent. Accentuated by sparkling verbena, the elegant core of centifolia and peony rose toy with the velvet petals of passion and fantasia rose, creating an elegant affair for all to enjoy.. Notes: Star Anise, Verbena Leaf, Centifolia Rose, Peony Rose, Passion Rose, Fantasia Rose, Emotion Rose.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Organza Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Bask in the pure delight of the Givenchy Organza Eau de Parfum Spray, a woody, warm scent for women.. This classic scent is a magical mix of classic sensuality and refinement. A symbol of the eternal woman, the fragrance is for a modern day goddess whose beauty shines from within. Inspired by the glowing desire that lies within all women, this opulent silhouette is the perfect signature to her elegant manner.. Glowing streams of bergamot burst open the scent, sparking the effervescent nuances of orange flower. Awakened by the spicy sprinkle of nutmeg, the floral heart of honeysuckle and tuberose flirt with the creamy base of vanilla and amber, revealing a playful yet elegant dry down with longevity.. Top Notes: Bergamot, African Orange Flower, Gardenia, Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Honeysuckle, Tuberose, Jasmine, Iris. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Virginia Cedar, Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Amarige Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Devote yourself to a sweet floral signature when you wear the Givenchy Amarige Eau de Toilette Spray. A symbolic feminine scent for women.. The anagram of the French word for marriage, this joyous Eau de Toilette is for a woman in love. Bursting with happiness, she is faithful and her love is everlasting. Her passionate soul pays homage to her magical touch, whilst her elegant choice of fragrance celebrates her tender and loving heart with its delicate floral bouquet. Amarige is love at first blend. Glowing nuances of tangerine spark open the scent, attracting the cool and crisp nuances of violet and rosewood to fall head over heels with its white floral heart. Deeply committed to the core, gorgeous gardenia forms an unbreakable bond with feminine mimosa, vowing a deeply sensual dry down from the deep base of precious woods and vanilla.. Top Notes: Tangerine, Violet, Rosewood. Heart Notes: Mimosa, Red Fruits, Ylang-Ylang, Gardenia. Base Notes: Ambergris, Precious Woods, Musk, Vanilla.

listings.description: Aspire to rebel or act innocent with the Givenchy Ange ou Demon Eau de Parfum Spray, a warm scent for women with noble lily facets.. Born under the sign of light and mystery, the Givenchy Ange ou Demon woman is bewitching and breathtaking. Her majestic beauty is haunting, whilst her innocent aura continues to inspire from sunrise until sunset. The perfect match for her eye for elegance and feel for mischief is this daring Eau de Parfum, which enwraps her senses in bittersweet sin.. Shimmering splashes of mandarin succumb to the dark and spicy nuances of saffron, revealing a mysterious and inviting opening to this sophisticated scent. As the light from the saffron gilds heavenly nuances of lily and ylang-ylang in a white floral core, whilst it's not so innocent base of addictive tonka bean and oakwood cast a wicked spell on the composition.. Top Notes: Mandarin, White Thyme, Saffron. Heart Notes: Lily, Maxillaria Orchid, Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Oak Wood Absolute, Rosewood, Vanilla, Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Rediscover Omnia Amethyste in a new shape, with its inimitable original scent untouched.. Like a frame of light, the iconic fascination of OMNIA is now characterised by a new, more precious flacon design.. Evoking the soft shine and noble refinement of amethyst, the fragrance of BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste is an incredibly nuanced bouquet embodying the myriad scents of Iris gardens dappled with morning dew. A flower of great luxury and originality, the iris' velvety petals capture the multiple textures of light and reflect them with intense and enchantingly feminine shades.. Bottle Design Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold coloured frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweller to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections.. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.. Notes Top Notes: A pink grapefruit note illuminates the fragrance with its bright and citrusy facets. Heart Notes: In the heart, two iconic flowers in perfumery intertwine, revealing a delicately opulent bouquet where the richness of Damascena Rose Absolute is accompanied by the woody and powdery elegance of iris notes. Base Notes: A warm, woody trail completes the fragrance. The sweetness of a heliotrope accord melts into the vibrations of solar wood notes. Heliotrope accord | Solar woods accord.
