listings.rawTitle: Uriage Eau Thermale Water Spray 50ml
listings.description: Soothe, protect and hydrate your complexion with the Uriage Eau Thermale Water Spray, a hypoallergenic multipurpose face mist suitable for the whole family and for all skin types, including sensitive,. The most active thermal water on the market, the Eau Thermale Water Spray is a quick and effortless way to intensely moisturise your face. The isotonic water is the perfect balance for skin as it's packed with trace elements and mineral salts similar to skin's natural moisturising factors. The skincare water provides unique hydrating abilities thanks to its pure minerality to enhance skin's health and natural radiance.. One of Uriage's hero products and at the heart of each of their formulations, the powerful facial mist is suitable for use on dermatological issues. It soothes inflammatory conditions such as eczema and psoriasis as well as being a good choice for superficial burns and post-surgery. The high content of naturally occurring calcium and magnesium salts soothes sensitivity, while the combined effects of copper and zinc help to heal damaged skin.. The refreshing water spray reinforces the skin's hydrolipidic film and restores its barrier, thanks to the action of softening silicone. Manganese provides antioxidant protection against free radicals, helping to protect your skin as well as heal it.. Why We Love It . Uriage Thermal Water is from a small town in the French Alps and was discovered by the Romans 2000 years ago! It has a composition that's similar to our tears, which shows how gentle it is. Uriage packages it directly at the source and the face spray is extracted in a pure environment that's protected from pollution, so you can trust its naturally healing and soothing properties.. The Eau Thermale Water Spray is a multi-tasking wonder. It can be used at any time of the day, anywhere on the body and by anyone in the family. Held in a spray bottle, you can effortlessly spritz your skin for a boost of healing hydration on-the-go. Whether it's for calming razor burns or soothing nappy rash, this is a one-stop product for all of your skincare needs.. How To Use It . Use as often as often as required. Close eyes and spray liberally over the skin. Leave to absorb and don't pat dry or wipe off.. Works Well With . Enhance the hydrating powers of the Uriage Thermal Water Spray by matching it with the other skincare products in the Eau Thermale range.. Values . Hypoallergenic, dermatologically-tested..

listings.rawTitle: TABAC Original Aftershave Lotion 50ml
listings.description: "Finish your grooming routine with a splash of TABAC Original Aftershave Lotion. " - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love TABAC Original Aftershave Lotion: . Your skin will appear healthier and moisturised.. Cuts and nicks are repaired and hygienic.. Infused with TABAC's signature woody floral scent.. Since 1959, TABAC has been selected as the preferred grooming brand for men worldwide.. . What Does TABAC Original Aftershave Lotion Smell Like? . The Aftershave Lotion is infused with TABAC's iconic scent that's infused with woods and subtle spices that are so distinctive to TABAC. Its signature scent has an old-school feel that wouldn't be out of place at a barbershop.. Fragrance family is Woody Floral. . Top notes are Black Pepper, Petit Grain, Lemon. . Heart notes are Lavender, Chamomile, Geranium. . Base notes are Carnation, Sandalwood, Vetiver. . . Why It's Escentual: . The Aftershave Lotion is the ideal step after shaving for soothing skin and replenishing any hydration from shaving. Its antiseptic formula cleans any cuts and soothes irritation from razor burns and bumps post-shaving.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Tip the lotion in the palm of your hand and apply to the shaven area.. We also recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

listings.description: Cleanse your irritated skin and scalp with the QV Gentle Wash Soap Alternative for Dry Skin Conditions, a gentle replacement for soap for dry sensitive skin that may be used by the whole family.. QV Gentle Wash Soap Alternative is your answer to an all-over wash that will cleanse and calm your skin all at the same time. The ideal first step in your QV routine, it relieves uncomfortable symptoms of skin conditions including dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, xerosis and ichthyosis. Its soothing gel texture starts to foam as you lather it on your skin for intense moisture and comfort.. The nourishing pH formula of this gel cleanser will help to restore the natural balance of your epidermis as well as soothe any irritation, tightness and redness. Its 15% glycerol formula will leave skin feeling smooth and silky-soft without blocking your pores. Soap-free, the infusion of mild surfactants give the formula a comforting bubbly texture that you'll love. A caring alternative to regular soap, the ultra-gentle cleanser won't strip, or dry out the skin either.. Why We Love It . Yes, it smells natural, and not clinical! We love this body wash for its real soap feel and the gentle comfort it provides. The QV Gentle Wash is so versatile, it can be used by all the family including infants, and is a great soothing solution for nappy rash. It can even be used to remove your makeup, which is an absolute bonus as far us beauty-lovers are concerned!. How To Use It . Use as often as required for bathing, showering and hand washing. Wet skin, apply a small amount via the easy-to-use pump, massage and rinse off.. Works Well With . Discover the full QV collection for more super gentle formulas made to take care of skin suffering from specialised conditions.. Values . Hypoallergenic, dermatologist-tested.. listings.description: Explore a fresh and cool interpretation of almond with the Prada Les Infusions de Prada Amande Eau de Parfum Spray, a unisex fragrance with powdery-floral facets.. Mouth-watering and refreshing at the beginning, then sweet and soft at the heart, the Prada Les Infusions Amande is a multifaceted almond fragrance with everything to offer. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Althair Eau de Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: "Expect to be asked what perfume you're wearing all day long with Althair; this bold, sexy scent turns heads for all the right reasons." - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team. . . Why You'll Love Althair Eau de Parfum: . Niche perfume that exudes a confident, assertive persona of its own.. Reflects your sophisticated style with its luxurious scent and packaging.. Leaves a memorable, luxurious, and long-lasting impression.. . What Does Parfums de Marly Althair Smell Like? . Althair belongs to the gourmand-amber family, which means it smells expensive and almost edible. When we sprayed this in our office, " vanilla " was the most common word." However, Althair's sweetness is subjective. It's not a sticky, honeyed sweetness; the soft, cosy, intimate side draws you in. Perfumers Hamid Merati-Kashani and Julien Sprecher purposely added the freshness of citrus fruits to keep the scent rich and decadent.. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Bergamot, and Cinnamon. . Heart notes include Bourbon Vanilla and Elemi. . Base notes are Guaiacwood, Ambrox, Praline, and Musk. . . . Why Althair is Escentual: . Parfums de Marly is a highly regarded brand at Escentual. For every new perfume launch, there's a queue of our staff waiting to try and buy it because we trust that they will always smell incredible and make you feel incredible. Althair does all that and more.. Althair's soft, warm, sweet, but spicy edge adds something new to the Parfums de Marly collection. If you love the warmth of Haltane and the sweetness of Valaya, this combines the best of both to give you a signature scent guaranteed to earn you daily compliments on its appeal.. . Parfums de Marly Say... . ALTHAIR is a vanilla-infused fragrance that is not sticky but that is powerful and modern; an addictive signature with lots of projection on the top and is very long lasting. Elegance starts from the top with an aromatic combination of citruses and spices: orange flower, sparkling bergamot, warm cardamom and evocative cinnamon.. The overdose of vanilla beans brings a very refined, warm and textured addiction in the heart. To achieve this elegant and modern signature, there was a combination of the sensual note's amber, woods, and leather, contrasted with notes of clean and fresh musk.. "Althair explores a majestic, subtle and surprisingly fresh vanilla that is elegant, generous and charismatic." Julien Sprecher,. An unexpected, modern ode to a universal ingredient of perfumery: Bourbon vanilla, a direct descendant of the vanilla introduced in France under the reign of Louis XV.. . The Best Way To Use Althair: . Spray it onto your pulse points, but do not rub the perfume in; pat it in to avoid disrupting the development of the notes in the perfume.. .

listings.rawTitle: Mustela Stelatopia+ Lipid-Replenishing Cream 150ml
listings.description: Stelatopia+ is a certified organic cream designed to soothe atopic skin, providing peace of mind for parents. This lipid-replenishing, anti-itching cream is specifically formulated for extremely dry and eczema-prone skin in babies from birth*, as well as for the entire family. Made with 99% natural origin ingredients, it features a complex of patented active ingredients, including certified organic Sunflower Oil Distillate and prebiotic Bioecolia ®. These ingredients work together to immediately reduce redness and have an anti-relapse effect, minimising the frequency of severe dryness peaks.. Fragrance-free. Vegan formula**. Does your family struggle with extremely dry, eczema-prone skin? Mustela's Stelatopia+ lipid-replenishing cream, formulated with certified organic Sunflower Oil Distillate, is specifically designed for you. This fragrance-free cream, co-developed with over 200 families, features a soft texture that is quickly absorbed, bringing immediate relief and comfort.. Stelatopia+ reinforces and rebalances the skin barrier, restoring its natural defence capacity. The result? Redness and irritation are reduced immediately and durably.. The Stelatopia + relipidant Cream is without perfume and vegan**.. *Newborns out of the NICU **Vegan formula: free from ingredients of animal origin. 90% of parents find an immediate reduction in redness (1a) and 88% a lasting reduction in irritation on their baby or child's skin (1b). 90% of parents note the anti-relapse effect which limits the frequency of severe dryness peaks (1b) Clinically proven efficacy.. (1) ) Clinical study conducted under dermatological and paediatric control on 63 subjects from ages 3 months to 8 years old with atopic-prone skin, with 1 to 2 applications per day during a. 28 days and b. 84 days (self-assessment)..

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Secret Gardenia Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to the height of summer with the Miller Harris Secret Gardenia Eau de Parfum Spray, a white floral fragrance for women with radiant zesty facets.. Part of the Miller Harris Colour Collection, this heady Eau de Parfum infuses the purest beauty of white flowers picked from one of London's secret gardens in full bloom. Classic and elegant, Secret Gardenia's bright composition offers a blossoming olfactory experience created for the noses of flower lovers everywhere.. The scent feels bright, cool and sensual; opening with a burst of fresh bergamot, zingy yuzu, sweet nashi pear, before the hidden floral heart of soft gardenia, hypnotic jasmine and ylang-ylang add a touch of sophistication. The base notes of creamy sandalwood and voluptuous musk create a light-filled trail that's distinctly feminine.. Why We Love It . Secret Gardenia is one of those timeless scents you'll never grow tired of. The perfect choice if you're looking for a new signature to take you through the next few seasons. It's sophisticated aroma is paired with a matte white bottle embossed with a golden Miller Harris logo. This perfume would definitely add the perfect finishing touch to your dressing table.. Works Well With . If you're looking for more fragrances that are inspired by moments, why not explore the full Miller Harris Colour Collection and discover your new signature scent.. Notes . Top Notes: Bergamot, Yuzu, Aqual, Nashi Pear.. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmin abs Egypt, Ylang Ylang, Violet Petal.. Base Notes: Driftwood, Creamy Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Musk..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome L'Absolu Rouge Intimatte Soft Matte Lipstick Shade / 273 - French Nude
listings.description: "The Lancome L'Absolu Rouge Intimatte Lipstick gives my lips a bare-skin, comfortable blurred matte finish that makes me forget about matte lipsticks drying reputation." - Keavy, Escentual Beauty Team.. Why You'll Love Lancome L'Absolu Rouge Intimatte Lipstick: . Your lips will have a flawless lick of soft matte colour.. Keeps your lips comfortably hydrated.. Lives up to the ultra-luxe reputation of the Lancome L'Absolu Rouge line.. . What You Need To Know: . Forget about your misconceptions that matte lipsticks are drying, this creamy formula bucks the trend. It's a long-wearing formula that melts into lips so easily, smoothly imparting your long-lasting chosen shade onto your lips.. Infused with lip-conditioning grand rose extract that gives your lips creamy comfort as you wear your Lancome L'Absolu Rouge Intimatte, while your lips are plumped with moisture and barrier function is repaired. And of course, blended with Lancome's radiant pigments that give lips blurred flawless matte finish.. A nourishing creamy texture.. Similar click-bullet design to the rest of L'Absolu Rouge range with a new blurred matte finish to enjoy.. Lasts on the lips for 12 hours.. Why It's Escentual: . Lancome creates a soft-focus matte lipstick that looks flawless and lasts, but also ensures your lips are cared for thanks to a infusion of nourishing skincaring ingredients. The naked-touch finish is understated and never cakey and lips won't be dry and crusty when your lipstick is removed.. The Best Way To Use It: . Press the end of the bullet, to release the lid. Twist the bullet, and swipe accross lips. . Sustainability and Values . Purchase refills so you can keep your bullet forever. You can recycle the outer box..

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Idole Nectar Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: "A trail of rose, caramelised popcorn and vanilla'¦ could a perfume be more delicious than Lancome Idole Nectar Eau de Parfum Spray? If you love sweet floral gourmands, try this!" - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Lancome Idole Nectar Eau de Parfum: . Sweet cosy gourmand scent with a rosey undertone.. Eau de Parfum lasts 6 hours on the skin.. Part of the Lancome Idole fragrance collection.. Features sustainably sourced rose and vanilla.. Housed in a vibrant peach holographic design.. . What Does Lancome Idole Nectar Smell Like? . A rich, seductive sweet scent, Idole Nectar is a powerhouse of gourmand-floral tones. Opening with a rose souffle accord, a trio of fresh jammy roses that remain strong as the scent settles. The heart is a neo-gourmand duo, combining the saltiness of popcorn with sticky sweet caramel. As the fragrance wears, the base introduces the warmth of sweet vanilla, settling over your skin leaving a creamy moreish trail.. Top notes are Isparta Rose, Centifolia Roses, Rose Absolute. Heart notes are Popcorn Accord, Caramel. Base notes are Bourbon Vanilla. . Why It's Escentual: . Sweeter than the original Idole and with no white floral jasmine, Nectar is the Idole designed for the gourmand fragrance lovers who also love a pop of rose.. listings.rawTitle: Initio Atomic Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: ‘’Atomic Rose is intensely romantic. It's a voluptuous, full-bodied floral fragrance that possesses the power to incite pleasure and provoke desire. - Chelsey, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why you’ll love Initio Atomic Rose: . Studies show the star note of hedione is responsible for a heightened libido. It smells like a glass of champagne rose' sprinkled with red rose petals.. It’s the connection persona from the Carnal collection. It lasts longer than a traditional Eau de Parfum. The bottle feels and looks like luxury. . What Does Atomic Rose Smell Like? . Picture a fault-less red rose; you see the soft velvet petals, the thorny green stem and an overall vision of beauty. Well, this is how Initio have faceted the composition. First, you get hit with the fresh, green nuance of bergamot, then a sharp dose of pink pepper shocks you. Then, suddenly, soft petals of rose caress the sweetness of vanilla in the base.. Top notes are bergamot, pink pepper, hedione. . Heart notes are Bulgarian rose, Turkish rose and jasmine. . Base note is vanilla. . . Why it’s Escentual: . No expense was spared for this perfume. Initio have used natural Turkish and Bulgarian rose for a purer, more long-lasting rosy scent. They travelled the world to source the very best bergamot from Italy, natural jasmine from Egypt, and natural vanilla from Madagascar.. In training, we learnt that Bochum University in Germany recently proved that certain fragrances containing key compounds like hedione, can tap into regions of the brain linked to libido. Initio have made sure this perfume includes at least 50% of hedione for long-lasting pleasure. . The Best Way To Use It: . Always apply the fragrance to your pulse points, and Initio always advise not to rub it in; always pat it in to let the molecules settle.. . The Sustainable Side: . You can recycle the cardboard outer case; however, the box and bottle will need to be checked with your local recycling authority.. .

Why You'll Love The GUERLAIN Shine Bloom Lipstick: . Buttery soft lipstick with a shiny finish.. Laced with hyaluronic acid, rose extract and shea butter for long-lasting comfort and hydration.. Buildable pigment that lasts up to 12 hours.. Luxurious gold metallic case.. . Why It's Escentual: . Combining lip care, high pigment colour and a premium gold metallic design, GUERLAIN KISSKISS Shine Bloom is the perfect everyday lipstick to keep you looking and feeling glamorous. Featuring 95% natural ingredients, the formula is incredibly comfortable and long-lasting as it works to keep your lips soft, smooth and nourished thanks to an intensely hydrating blend of hyaluronic acid, winter rose extract and shea butter.. Inspired by the colour of flowers, Shine Bloom leaves a high-impact shiny sheen over your pout, while the delicious vanilla-floral fragrance adds the finishing touch; the overall experience exudes luxury!. . The Best Way To Use It: . Swipe over the lips, layering up until the desired colour intensity is achieved.. .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: As a homage to the equestrian art, Jean-Paul Guerlain created the first oriental fragrance for men in perfumery in 1965. Habit Rouge refers to the famous red jackets worn by the riders. It is a fragrance mix of earth, warm leather and the forest... This is a high-flying figure, the reflection of mastered, refined and powerful instinct.. Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes; an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.. Habit Rouge expresses itself directly in a spicy, woody heart, nuanced with neroli and jasmine notes. Leather and oud wood notes blossom in the base, tempered by the sweetness of vanilla and patchouli..

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Nectar Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: "Giorgio Armani My Way Nectar is a delicious, fruity take on traditional white floral perfumes; it smells feminine and playful! " - Ceryn, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love My Way Nectar: . Fruity interpretation of the original My Way.. You'll feel beautiful wearing it!. It's a lighter take on classic white floral perfumes.. A pear accord makes it juicy and sweet.. Its uplifting scent is perfect for spring/summer.. Refillable bottle and responsibly sourced ingredients.. . Giorgrio Armani Say: . My Way Eau de Parfum Nectar invites you on a sensorial journey, capturing a liberated and free-spirited vision of femininity. This fruity floral fragrance, born from the delightful encounter of succulent Pear and the radiant Tuberose, is encapsulated in a new pink bottle crowned with a translucent pink talisman cap. The fragrance opens with a burst of freshness, juicy Pear accord and vibrant, aromatic Rhubarb accord. These fruity notes harmonise with the zesty Bergamot Heart and the captivating Orange Blossom, creating an intense and invigorating blend. At its heart, a white floral bouquet, unveiling a creamy heart of Tuberose Absolute. A blend of white woods and warm cedarwood enhances the sensually comforting Vanilla Bourbon infusion at base, with the comforting second-skin effect of white musks. I AM WHAT I LIVE.. Fragrance family is fruity floral. . Top notes are Pear Accord, Rhubarb Accord, Bergamot Heart, Orange Blossom. . Heart notes are Tuberose Absolute Heart. . Base notes are White Musk, Cedarwood, Vanilla Bourbon. . . My Way Nectar is a luxurious fragrance that blends rich, sweet notes with a hint of freshness. At its heart, it features a captivating combination of tuberose and pear; many have compared it to Marc Jacob's best-selling Daisy perfume.. . Why It's Escentual: . What makes My Way Nectar by Giorgio Armani stand out from the rest of the My Way range is its unique, juicy pear accord that adds a fresh, fruity twist. While the original My Way is bright and floral, My Way Nectar takes it up a notch with the luscious sweetness of pear, blending beautifully with orange blossom and tuberose.. . The Best Way To Use It: . We recommend the following perfume tips:. Target areas where the blood vessels are closest to the skin, allowing the fragrance to emanate. Common pulse points include the wrists, neck, behind the ears, and inner elbows.. Resist the urge to rub your wrists together after applying perfume. This can break down the fragrance molecules and alter the scent.. Hold the perfume bottle about 6“8 inches away from your skin when spraying. This ensures a more even distribution of the fragrance.. Keep your perfume in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight and temperature fluctuations. This helps maintain the integrity of the fragrance.. If your perfume fades throughout the day, consider reapplying to pulse points or areas where your skin is warm.. .

Conveniently sized, the lip protectant stick will keep lips looking healthy whilst adding a touch of sheer colour.. Smooth stick over lips alone or underneath lipstick..

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: As unique as the Dolce & Gabbana image: a blend of true irony and casualness that each man can identify with.. A stimulating, dynamic, attractive, aggresive freshness that expresses it's duality through citrus notes that simultaneously recall the sweetness of the Valley of the Oranges and it's wild and in some ways remote side.. The reassuring freshness of lavender that evokes the south of France, so familiar yet so distant.. The simplicity of sage and terragon mixed with intense, powerful cardamom and impertinent pepper.. The ruggedly masculine yet exotic, free fragrance of precious woods, a strong, introverted touch of tobacco, the pleasurable fresh scent of musky notes and the surprising notes of cumarin and tonka bean.. Notes . Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Mandarin, Lavender. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Cardamon, Terragon, Pepper. Base Notes: Coumarin, Tonka Bean, Tobacco.

Unleash your inner lip artist with 111 Ultra Night, a deep, dramatic black designed to transform your beauty routine. Whether you want to add moody intensity to your favourite red or make a bold standalone statement, this shade gives you complete creative freedom.. High-Impact Colour Meets Weightless Comfort. Forget everything you know about long-wear, dark lipsticks. Rouge Dior Ultra Rouge bridges the gap between intense pigmentation and all-day hydration.. 12-Hour Wear: Infused with a revolutionary polymer and plant-based oil blend, it locks in rich, saturated colour for up to 12 hours without drying out your lips.. Tattoo-Ink Feel: Acts like a weightless, luminous film that adheres to the lips with zero tight or heavy sensation.. Semi-Matte Finish: Delivers a velvety, modern finish with high-voltage pigment in a single stroke.. "Because the formula acts as an overprint, like an ink tattooing the lips... it enabled me to develop new, highly saturated and luminous shades. Like a painter with a new colour palette." — Peter Philips, Creative & Image Director for Dior Makeup 3 Ways to Style Ultra Night. 1. The Modern Vamp. Wear Ultra Night solo for a sharp, runway-ready monochromatic look. Pair with clean skin and minimal eye makeup to let your lips steal the spotlight.. . 2. The Custom Ombré. Apply a red or nude lipstick, then dab Ultra Night on the outer corners or centre of your lips. Blend outward for a sultry gradient effect.. . 3. The Nighttime Booster. Dab a tiny amount over any lipstick shade to instantly deepen its tone, transforming a daytime pink or berry into a dramatic evening shade.. . . How to Apply. Define: Line and prep your lips using your favourite lip liner.. Blend: Apply from the bullet, or using a lip brush, working from the centre of the lips outward for a flawless, even finish..

listings.rawTitle: Dermalogica Daily Milkfoliant 13g
listings.description: "If you're a fan of Dermalogica's iconic Daily Microfoliant but you have dehydrated skin, then the new-for-2022 Dermalogica Daily Milkfoliant should be at the top of your wish-list. Just like Microfoliant, its fine powder texture smooths and polishes all skin types, but it also helps support your skin's moisture barrier." - Kate, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love Dermalogica Daily Milkfoliant: . Chemical, physical and enzymatic facial exfoliant for all skin types.. 90% of consumers saw significant skin smoothness after just one use.. Unlocks polished, soft and vibrant skin without risking skin health.. Buffs away dulling surface debris for even skin tone and texture.. Replenish the skin's moisture barrier for hydrated, healthy-looking skin.. Features an ultra-fine powder texture that lathers upon contact with water.. Housed in a 50% recycled plastic bottle.. . What You Need To Know: . Milkfoliant is the peaceful way to exfoliate. Designed to polish and soothe all skin conditions, Daily Milkfoliant is clinically proven to smooth skin calmly; in fact, 90% of consumers saw significant smoothness in just one use. Activating upon contact with water to buff away dead, dulling skin cells, Dermalogica's gentle exfoliating powder unveils smooth, soft skin thanks to a blend of nourishing coconut milk, grape extract and arginine, which is rich in chemical exfoliants: Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs) and Beta Hydroxy Acids (BHAs). It works to resurface the skin using exfoliating papain extract whilst naturally-derived saccharide works with atomised sea salt to infuse the skin with nourishing essential minerals like magnesium and potassium.. But what really sets Daily Milkfoliant apart from Dermalgoica's other iconic facial exfoliators is that it features hyaluronic acid to help support the skin's moisture barrier; this skin-quenching active is supported by a calming oat bran extracts containing nourishing lipids to replenish and soothe skin.. . Why It's Escentual: . Exfoliation is essential for smooth, healthy-looking skin. But the idea of daily exfoliation is pretty terrifying for a lot of people. In fact, there's a lot of confusion and fear around exfoliation; there are often concerns about stripping skin of its natural oils and causing breakouts, increased sensitivity, or dry, flaky skin. But Daily Milkfoliant proves that these fears are unfounded.. Created by experts in skincare with over 30 years of experience, Daily Milkfoliant leads on from Daily Microfoliant - the iconic, best-selling exfoliating powder - to offer a solution that everyone can benefit from, but dehydrated skin in particular will absolutely adore. It promotes super smooth, soft and vibrant skin, all without risking your skin's health. We love that all skin types - even sensitive - can benefit from it, but it's especially beneficial if your skin feels tight and dehydrated as it supports your skin's moisture levels.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Use Daily Milkfoliant everyday use. Dispense a small amount of the powder into wet hands and work it into a rich, creamy lather - you can add an extra splash of water if needed. Then, massage onto a clean face, taking care to avoid the eye area. Rinse well.. Make sure to always wear high SPF protection in the day when you're using facial exfoliators.. . The Sustainable Side: . Daily Milkfoliant is housed in a bottle made from 50% recycled plastic.. . Values: . Vegan.. .

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity For Men Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: "Perfect for an outdoors lover looking for a sophisticated yet comforting fragrance, Calvin Klein Eternity For Men Eau de Parfum is destined to be a modern classic." - Hannah, Escentual Beauty Team.. . Why You'll Love CK Eternity For Men Eau de Parfum: . Modern woody-fougere scent with a suede base.. Powerful and long-lasting Eau de Parfum.. Part of the timeless Calvin Klein Eternity collection.. Held in a sophisticated green glass bottle.. . What Does Eternity For Men Eau de Parfum Smell Like? . Aromatic, hazy sage and ozonic notes open the fragrance, joined by the fresh, crisp scent of apple to give a slightly fruity twist. The other top note - pamplezest - is zesty and green, so it prepares you for the rolling green scents about to be unleashed. Geranium and cypress make CK Eternity for Men feel like the outdoors bottled, while the warming spices of nutmeg and floral lavender add a modern feel to the heart. Finally, the base is both refined and rugged as suede, orris and vetiver deepen the scent with their smoky, leathery feel. To complete the mix, a touch of salty ambergris balances out the woody cypriol note to offer an elegant but powerful woody trail.. Top notes are Sage, Ozonic Notes, Pamplezest, Apple. Heart notes are Geranium, Majestic Cypress, Nutmeg, Lavandin. Base notes are Orris, Vetiver, Ambergris, Cypriol, Suede Notes. . . Why It's Escentual: . A stunning addition to the iconic CK Eternity fragrance line, Eternity For Men Eau de Parfum is a sophisticated scent that honours the fan-favourite collection while making its own mark on the range as the first-ever Eau de Parfum for men within the portfolio.. It maintains CK Eternity For Men's signature fougere tone, but welcomes a modern woody side that's warmed through by a touch of smoke and spice without losing a sense of freshness. Smoky ingredients can sometimes be overpowering, but the master perfumer behind this Eau de Parfum - Pascal Gaurin - has mastered the combination of bright greenery and subtly smoked earthy undertones, creating a comforting base for the spicy facets to work their magic.. Though described as a men's fragrance, we believe that everyone can fall for Eternity's clever balance of crisp freshness and warmly spiced woods, which allow you to keep a snippet of the outdoors with you at all times.. . The Best Way To Use It: . Spray onto your neck, chest and wrists to elevate the scent.. . The Sustainable Side: . The outer packaging is recyclable.. .

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: The Cacharel Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a balance of audacity and elegance.. The woody spicy fragrance is created for intrepid explorers; those men who dream of the discovery of new places, and with them new adventures. It exudes a burning freshness that is strong, serene and resolutely masculine.. Cacharel Pour Homme opens with a meeting of citrus and aromatic facets, lemon and lavender, before sinking into a sun-warmed heart of ylang-ylang and subtly spicy nutmeg. As the fragrance dries down, woods and musk reveal their strength.. Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Lavender. Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum Spray 60ml
listings.description: The mythical power of fire captured in an intense and charismatic ambery woody signature for a very sophisticated and unique masculinity. Exuding a unique elegance, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum takes the original Eau de Parfum to a new level of density, richness and refinement, embodying a contemporary masculinity through its ambery woody signature.. With addictive and vibrant spicy top notes that smoothly morph into the lavish floralcy of tuberose and iris, before yielding to the intensity of dark wood accord, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a contrasted and textured composition. Crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, it is the richest and most concentrated fragrance in the Bvlgari Man collection as we know it now.. The all-black flacon delivers an intense interpretation of the Bvlgari Man in Black aesthetic codes. The dramatic and audacious use of the colour black visually recalls the higher concentration of the Parfum, differing from the more marked contrast between the black and rose gold of the Eau de Parfum. .

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo di Sicilia Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo di Sicilia is a fragrance that perfectly expresses this multi-faceted island set within a landscape of enchanting beauty.. Fresh star anise and Italian citrus meet green almond notes and ylang-ylang for a caressing sensation. Mandorlo di Sicilia Eau de Toilette embodies the warmth of Sicily bottled in a caressing perfume symbolised by the native Avola almond, famous for its distinctively fine taste. The sparkling freshness of star anise and Italian citrus fruits come together with the soft and enchanting notes of green almond and ylang-ylang in a delicate composition with a cedarwood, vanilla, and white musk base.. Mandorlo di Sicilia comes in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle, a must-have design object with Art deco influences. The glass, which is pure, luxurious, and thick, is tinged with a deep blue that in a play of reflections evokes the transparency of the sea..

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance of supreme elegance, Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum captures the serene, natural beauty of a noble Italian flower garden in full bloom.. At the centre of this exclusive garden, where art and beauty meet in a crescendo of emotion, is the rose. For this chapter in the Le Nobili fragrance universe, Acqua di Parma bestows its unequivocal charm to this queen of flowers to create a modern ode to the precious velveteen petals that is a fresh and rich as a bouquet of freshly picked stems.. Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile opens with the soft, vibrant notes of Sicilian mandarin and Calabrian bergamot spiced with pepper. In the heart, the core centifolia rose note is accented with the intense floralcy of peony, violet and lily, before the sensuality of woods, ambergris and musk brush the skin with their warm yet refined sensuality.. Top Notes: Sicilian Mandarin, Calabrian Bergamot, Pepper. Heart Notes: Peony, Violet, Lily of the Valley, Centifolia Rose. Base Notes: Cedar Wood, Ambergris, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Yuzu Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Experience the unique freshness of Acqua di Parma Yuzu Eau de Parfum Spray, a citrus fragrance with bitter and sweet facets centred around a rare Japanese fruit, yuzu.. Masterfully blended, this refreshing and balanced Eau de Parfum embodies the heart of Colonia but combines this with facets of oriental yuzu, bitter bergamot and spicy Sichuan pepper. At its core, a bright bouquet explodes with soft waves of mimosa, violet and jasmine. As it wears your senses experience warm sandalwood and sophisticated musk, intertwining with fresh base notes of liquorice.. The Signatures Of The Sun collection uses only precious ingredients that are enriched by the sun, and this scent is no exception. Part of Acqua di Parma Frutti d'˜Oro range, this perfume sources one of rarest fruits in Japan; the Yuzu. This fruit's bittersweet signature works with the citrus notes to create a fresh, energising and utterly unique fragrance.. Why We Love It . If you've experienced this collection before, you know what to expect: rare and precious ingredients sourced from sun-soaked landscapes around the world. But you may have noticed that it looks a little different to their usual black bottle. With it's transparent glass update, but still in its signature art deco flacon, and packaged in a black cylinder, this perfume is the height of luxury.. Works Well With . The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun collection was made for layering. Why not pair your Yuzu fragrance with one of the other sun-inspired scents to create your signature!. Notes . Top Notes: Yuzu, Bergamot, Sichuan Pepper.. Heart Notes: Lotus, Mimosa, Violet Leaves, Jasmine.. Base Notes: Musk, Liquorice, Sandalwood..

listings.rawTitle: 4160 Tuesdays White Queen Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: White Queen was first made as a collaboration with the online perfume community CaFleureBon. It's inspired by the White Queen from Alice in Wonderland, an elixir of magic spells.. Perfumer Sarah McCartney grew up in one of the gardens in which the real Alice used to play, so she took aromas from her own childhood - raspberry, grapefruit, rock rose and jasmine - adding hazelnut and creamy materials to make a gourmand with absolutely no sweet candy notes.. It's really unusual; if you want to experience a sense of wonder, and celebrate the idea of disappearing down the rabbit hole to find yourselves in a new world of aromatic delight, use this potion.. Perfume Dialect: Creamy, Gourmand. Top Notes: Incense, Cream, Hazelnut, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Raspberry, Iris, Jasmine. Base Notes: Vetiver, Labdanum, Opoponax, Musk. White Queen is suitable for vegans..

listings.description: Between exhilaration and seduction is where you'll find the Acqua di Parma Peonia Nobile Eau de Parfum Spray, a refined interpretation of the peony flower.. This exalted bloom is hailed as a flower of the gods, but the magical trail from its elegant scent is no myth. Idealised with a sensuous woman in mind, the exotic blend of scintillating raspberry and glowing amber are the perfect match for her radiant aura. Beaming with exuberance, her magnetic nature is accentuated by this powerful and spontaneous fragrance.. Heart Notes: Peony, Geranium, Turkish Rose, Freesia. Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli.
